Matthew
Matthew 1
1. 耶穌基督—— 大衛 的後裔、 亞伯拉罕 的後代——他的家譜： The historical record of Jesus Christ, the Son of David, the Son of Abraham:
2. 亞伯拉罕 生 以撒， 以撒 生 雅各， 雅各 生 猶大 和他的兄弟們， Abraham fathered Isaac, Isaac fathered Jacob, Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers,
3. 猶大 與 塔瑪爾 生 法勒斯 和 謝拉， 法勒斯 生 希斯崙， 希斯崙 生 亞蘭， Judah fathered Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez fathered Hezron, Hezron fathered Aram,
4. 亞蘭 生 亞米拿達， 亞米拿達 生 拿順， 拿順 生 撒門， Aram fathered Aminadab, Aminadab fathered Nahshon, Nahshon fathered Salmon,
5. 撒門 與 瑞荷 生 波阿斯， 波阿斯 與 路得 生 俄備得， 俄備得 生 耶西， Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab, Boaz fathered Obed by Ruth, Obed fathered Jesse,
6. 耶西 生 大衛 王。 大衛 與 烏利亞 的妻子生 所羅門， and Jesse fathered King David. Then David fathered Solomon by Uriah's wife,
7. 所羅門 生 羅波安， 羅波安 生 亞比雅， 亞比雅 生 亞撒， Solomon fathered Rehoboam, Rehoboam fathered Abijah, Abijah fathered Asa,
8. 亞撒 生 約沙法， 約沙法 生 約蘭， 約蘭 生 烏西亞， Asa fathered Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat fathered Joram, Joram fathered Uzziah,
9. 烏西亞 生 約坦， 約坦 生 亞哈斯， 亞哈斯 生 希西家， Uzziah fathered Jotham, Jotham fathered Ahaz, Ahaz fathered Hezekiah,
10. 希西家 生 瑪拿西， 瑪拿西 生 阿蒙， 阿蒙 生 約西亞， Hezekiah fathered Manasseh, Manasseh fathered Amon, Amon fathered Josiah,
11. 在被迫遷徙 巴比倫 的時候， 約西亞 生 耶哥尼雅 和他的兄弟們。 and Josiah fathered Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
12. 被迫遷徙 巴比倫 以後， 耶哥尼雅 生 撒拉鐵， 撒拉鐵 生 所羅巴伯， Then after the exile to Babylon Jechoniah fathered Salathiel, Salathiel fathered Zerubbabel,
13. 所羅巴伯 生 亞比玉， 亞比玉 生 以利亞敬， 以利亞敬 生 亞所， Zerubbabel fathered Abiud, Abiud fathered Eliakim, Eliakim fathered Azor,
14. 亞所 生 撒督， 撒督 生 亞金， 亞金 生 以律， Azor fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Achim, Achim fathered Eliud,
15. 以律 生 以利亞撒， 以利亞撒 生 瑪坦， 瑪坦 生 雅各， Eliud fathered Eleazar, Eleazar fathered Matthan, Matthan fathered Jacob,
16. 雅各 生 約瑟，就是 瑪麗亞 的丈夫， 那稱為基督的耶穌是由 瑪麗亞 所生的。 and Jacob fathered Joseph the husband of Mary, who gave birth to Jesus who is called the Messiah.
17. 這樣，從 亞伯拉罕 到 大衛 的各世代，一共有十四代；從 大衛 到被迫遷徙 巴比倫 的時候，也有十四代；從被迫遷徙 巴比倫 的時候到基督，又有十四代。 So all the generations from Abraham to David were 14 generations; and from David until the exile to Babylon, 14 generations; and from the exile to Babylon until the Messiah, 14 generations.
18. 耶穌基督的誕生是這樣的：耶穌的母親 瑪麗亞 已經許配給 約瑟，在他們成婚 以前， 瑪麗亞 就由聖靈懷了孕。 The birth of Jesus Christ came about this way: After His mother Mary had been engaged to Joseph, it was discovered before they came together that she was pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
19. 她的丈夫 約瑟 是個義人，不願意公開羞辱她，想要暗中把她休了。 So her husband Joseph, being a righteous man, and not wanting to disgrace her publicly, decided to divorce her secretly.
20. 約瑟 思考這些事以後，忽然主的一位天使在 約瑟 夢中顯現，說：「 大衛 的後裔 約瑟，不要怕迎娶 瑪麗亞 做你的妻子，因為她裡面所懷的是由聖靈而來的。 But after he had considered these things, an angel of the Lord suddenly appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, don't be afraid to take Mary as your wife, because what has been conceived in her is by the Holy Spirit.
21. 瑪麗亞 將要生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫耶穌，因為他將要把自己的子民從他們的罪孽中拯救出來。」 She will give birth to a son, and you are to name Him Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins."
22. 不過這整個事的發生，是為要應驗主藉著先知所說的話： Now all this took place to fulfill what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet:
23. 「看哪，那童貞女要懷孕，她要生一個兒子， 人們將稱他的名為 以馬內利 。」 —— 「 以馬內利 」翻譯出來就是「神與我們同在」。 See, the virgin will become pregnant and give birth to a son, and they will name Him Immanuel, which is translated "God is with us."
24. 約瑟 從夢中醒過來，就依照主的天使所吩咐他的去做，把他的妻子迎娶過來， When Joseph got up from sleeping, he did as the Lord's angel had commanded him. He married her
25. 只是在她生兒子 以前，一直沒有與她同房。 約瑟 給孩子起名叫耶穌。 but did not know her intimately until she gave birth to a son. And he named Him Jesus.
Matthew 2
1. 在 希律 王的那些日子裡，耶穌誕生在 猶太 的 伯利恆 。當時，有幾個博士從東方來到 耶路撒冷 。 After Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, wise men from the east arrived unexpectedly in Jerusalem,
2. 他們問：「生下來做 猶太 人之王的那一位在哪裡？我們在東方看見了他的星，就來了要朝拜他。」 saying, "Where is He who has been born King of the Jews? For we saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him."
3. 希律 王聽說了，就驚慌不安，全 耶路撒冷 的人也與他一起不安。 When King Herod heard this, he was deeply disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
4. 希律 就召集了所有的祭司長和民間的經文士，向他們詢問基督誕生在哪裡。 So he assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people and asked them where the Messiah would be born.
5. 他們對 希律 說：「在 猶太 的 伯利恆，因為藉著先知有這樣的記載： "In Bethlehem of Judea," they told him, "because this is what was written by the prophet:
6. 『 猶大 之地 伯利恆 啊！ 你在 的首要城鄉 中， 絕不 是最小的， 因為將來有一位領袖要從你那裡出來， 他要牧養我的子民 以色列 。 』 」 And you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the leaders of Judah: because out of you will come a leader who will shepherd My people Israel."
7. 於是， 希律 暗暗地召見了那幾個博士，向他們仔細詢問那顆星出現的時間， Then Herod secretly summoned the wise men and asked them the exact time the star appeared.
8. 然後打發他們前往 伯利恆，說：「你們去仔細查問有關那孩子的事，一旦查出來了就向我報告，好讓我也去拜他。」 He sent them to Bethlehem and said, "Go and search carefully for the child. When you find Him, report back to me so that I too can go and worship Him."
9. 他們聽了王的話就去了。看哪，他們在東方看見的那顆星在前面引導他們，直到那孩子所在的地方，就在上頭停住了。 After hearing the king, they went on their way. And there it was-- the star they had seen in the east! It led them until it came and stopped above the place where the child was.
10. 他們看見那顆星，極其歡喜快樂。 When they saw the star, they were overjoyed beyond measure.
11. 他們進了屋子，看見那孩子與他的母親 瑪麗亞 在一起，就俯伏拜那孩子，然後打開他們的寶盒，把黃金、乳香和沒藥做為禮物獻給他。 Entering the house, they saw the child with Mary His mother, and falling to their knees, they worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
12. 他們在夢中得了神的指示不要回到 希律 那裡去，就從另一條路回到自己的家鄉去了。 And being warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their own country by another route.
13. 那些博士離開以後，忽然主的一位天使在 約瑟 夢中顯現，說：「起來，帶著孩子和他的母親逃往 埃及，留在那裡，直到我再指示你，因為 希律 要搜尋這孩子並殺害他。」 After they were gone, an angel of the Lord suddenly appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, "Get up! Take the child and His mother, flee to Egypt, and stay there until I tell you. For Herod is about to search for the child to destroy Him."
14. 約瑟 就起來，連夜帶著孩子和他的母親逃往 埃及， So he got up, took the child and His mother during the night, and escaped to Egypt.
15. 住在那裡，直到 希律 死了。這是為要應驗主藉著先知所說的話： 「我從 埃及 召我的兒子出來。」 He stayed there until Herod's death, so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet might be fulfilled: Out of Egypt I called My Son.
16. 希律 發現自己受了博士們的愚弄，就十分惱怒。於是，他按照從博士們那裡所詢問到的時間，派人把 伯利恆 城裡和周圍各個地區內兩歲以下的男孩，全都殺了。 Then Herod, when he saw that he had been outwitted by the wise men, flew into a rage. He gave orders to massacre all the male children in and around Bethlehem who were two years old and under, in keeping with the time he had learned from the wise men.
17. 這就應驗了藉著先知 耶利米 所說的話： Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled:
18. 「從 拉瑪 聽見了聲音， 是哀哭 和極其傷痛的聲音， 是 瑞秋 為她的兒女哀哭， 不肯接受安慰， 因為他們不在了。」 A voice was heard in Ramah, weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; and she refused to be consoled, because they were no more.
19. 希律 死了以後，在 埃及，忽然主的一位天使在 約瑟 夢中顯現， After Herod died, an angel of the Lord suddenly appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
20. 說：「起來，帶著孩子和他的母親回 以色列 地去，因為那些追索這孩子性命的人已經死了。」 saying, "Get up! Take the child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, because those who sought the child's life are dead."
21. 約瑟 就起來，帶著孩子和他的母親進了 以色列 地。 So he got up, took the child and His mother, and entered the land of Israel.
22. 但是，聽說 亞基勞 接續他父親 希律 做了 猶太 王， 約瑟 就怕往那裡去，而且他在夢中得了神的指示，就退到 加利利 地區， But when he heard that Archelaus was ruling over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And being warned in a dream, he withdrew to the region of Galilee.
23. 來到一個叫 拿撒勒 的鎮，住了下來。這是為要應驗那藉著先知們所說的話：「他將被稱為 拿撒勒 人。」 Then he went and settled in a town called Nazareth to fulfill what was spoken through the prophets, that He will be called a Nazarene.
Matthew 3
1. 在那些日子裡，施洗者 約翰 來了，在 猶太 的曠野傳道， In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the Wilderness of Judea
2. 說：「你們應當悔改，因為天國近了。」 and saying, "Repent, because the kingdom of heaven has come near!"
3. 這 約翰 就是藉著先知 以賽亞 所說的那個人。 以賽亞 說： 「在曠野有聲音呼喊著： 『你們當預備主的道， 當修直 他的路！』」 For he is the one spoken of through the prophet Isaiah, who said: A voice of one crying out in the wilderness: "Prepare the way for the Lord; make His paths straight!"
4. 約翰 穿著駱駝毛做的衣服，腰束皮帶。他的食物是蝗蟲和野蜜。 John himself had a camel-hair garment with a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.
5. 那時， 耶路撒冷 、全 猶太 地區和整個 約旦 河一帶的人，都出來到他那裡， Then [people from] Jerusalem, all Judea, and all the vicinity of the Jordan were flocking to him,
6. 承認自己的罪孽，在 約旦 河裡受他的洗禮。 and they were baptized by him in the Jordan River as they confessed their sins.
7. 約翰 看見許多 法利賽 人和 撒都該 人也來要受他的洗禮，就對他們說：「你們這些毒蛇的子孫！誰指示你們逃避那將要來臨的震怒呢？ When he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to the place of his baptism, he said to them, "Brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
8. 你們應當結出果子，與悔改的心相稱！ Therefore produce fruit consistent with repentance.
9. 你們不要心裡想『我們有 亞伯拉罕 為先祖。』我告訴你們：神能從這些石頭中給 亞伯拉罕 興起兒女來。 And don't presume to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you that God is able to raise up children for Abraham from these stones!
10. 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，所有不結好果子的樹都要被砍下來，被丟進火裡。 Even now the ax is ready to strike the root of the trees! Therefore every tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
11. 「我用水 給你們施洗，是為了你們的 悔改。但在我之後來的那一位，是比我更強有力的，我就是為他提鞋子也不配。他要用聖靈和火給你們施洗。 "I baptize you with water for repentance, but the One who is coming after me is more powerful than I. I am not worthy to take off His sandals. He Himself will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
12. 他手裡拿著揚穀的杴，要揚淨他的打穀場，把他的麥子收進倉庫，卻把糠秕用不滅的火燒掉。」 His winnowing shovel is in His hand, and He will clear His threshing floor and gather His wheat into the barn. But the chaff He will burn up with fire that never goes out."
13. 那時，耶穌從 加利利 來到 約旦 河，到了 約翰 那裡，要受他的洗禮。 Then Jesus came from Galilee to John at the Jordan, to be baptized by him.
14. 約翰 想要阻止他，說：「我需要受你的洗禮，你反而到我這裡來嗎？」 But John tried to stop Him, saying, "I need to be baptized by You, and yet You come to me?"
15. 耶穌回答他，說： 「現在你就答應吧，因為我們如此成全一切的義，是合宜的。」 於是 約翰 答應了他。 Jesus answered him, "Allow it for now, because this is the way for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he allowed Him [to be baptized].
16. 耶穌受了洗，一從水裡上來，看哪，諸天就為他 開了，他看見神的靈好像鴿子降下，臨到他身上。 After Jesus was baptized, He went up immediately from the water. The heavens suddenly opened for Him, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming down on Him.
17. 這時候，忽然有聲音從諸天傳來，說： 「這是我的愛子， 我所喜悅的。」 And there came a voice from heaven: This is My beloved Son. I take delight in Him!
Matthew 4
1. 隨後，耶穌被聖靈領到曠野去，受魔鬼的試探。 Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the Devil.
2. 耶穌禁食了四十晝夜，後來就餓了。 After He had fasted 40 days and 40 nights, He was hungry.
3. 那試探者前來對他說：「你如果是神的兒子，就吩咐這些石頭變成食物吧！」 Then the tempter approached Him and said, "If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread."
4. 耶穌回答說： 「經上記著： 『人活著不是單靠食物， 而是靠神口裡所出的每一句話。』 」 But He answered, "It is written: Man must not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of God."
5. 接著，魔鬼帶他到聖城，讓他站在聖殿的頂端， Then the Devil took Him to the holy city, had Him stand on the pinnacle of the temple,
6. 對他說：「你如果是神的兒子，就跳下去吧！因為經上記著： 『他會為你吩咐他的天使； 他們會用手托住你， 免得你的腳撞在石頭上。』 」 and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down. For it is written: He will give His angels orders concerning you and, they will support you with their hands so that you will not strike your foot against a stone."
7. 耶穌對他說： 「經上又記著： 『不可試探主——你的神。』 」 Jesus told him, "It is also written: Do not test the Lord your God."
8. 接著，魔鬼帶耶穌上了一座很高的山，給他看世界萬國和萬國的榮耀， Again, the Devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor.
9. 對他說：「你如果俯伏拜我，我就把這一切都給你。」 And he said to Him, "I will give You all these things if You will fall down and worship me."
10. 耶穌對他說： 「 撒旦，退去 ！因為經上記著： 『要敬拜主——你的神， 唯獨事奉他。』 」 Then Jesus told him, "Go away, Satan! For it is written: Worship the Lord your God, and serve only Him."
11. 於是，魔鬼離開了耶穌。看哪，有天使們前來伺候他。 Then the Devil left Him, and immediately angels came and began to serve Him.
12. 耶穌聽說 約翰 被逮捕了，就退到 加利利 地區。 When He heard that John had been arrested, He withdrew into Galilee.
13. 後來，他離開 拿撒勒，來到 西布倫 和 拿弗他利 境內，住在湖邊的 迦百農 。 He left Nazareth behind and went to live in Capernaum by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali.
14. 這是為要應驗那藉著先知 以賽亞 所說的話： This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
15. 「 西布倫 地、 拿弗他利 地， 沿湖 的路， 約旦 河的對岸， 外邦人的 加利利 —— Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, along the sea road, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles!
16. 那坐在黑暗中的民眾 看到了大光； 那坐在死亡之地和死亡陰影中的人們， 曙光為他們升起。」 The people who live in darkness have seen a great light, and for those living in the shadowland of death, light has dawned.
17. 從那時候起，耶穌開始傳道，說： 「你們應當悔改，因為天國近了。」 From then on Jesus began to preach, "Repent, because the kingdom of heaven has come near!"
18. 耶穌在 加利利 湖邊行走，看見兄弟兩個人，就是那叫 彼得 的 西門 和他弟弟 安得烈，正在湖裡撒網；他們本來是漁夫。 As He was walking along the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon, who was called Peter, and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, since they were fishermen.
19. 耶穌就對他們說： 「來跟從我！我將要使你們成為得人的漁夫。」 "Follow Me," He told them, "and I will make you fish for people!"
20. 他們立刻捨棄漁網，跟從了耶穌。 Immediately they left their nets and followed Him.
21. 耶穌從那裡往前走，看見另外兩個兄弟，就是 西庇太 的兒子 雅各 和他弟弟 約翰，正在船上與他們的父親 西庇太 一起修補漁網。耶穌就召喚他們， Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and his brother John. They were in a boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets, and He called them.
22. 他們立刻捨棄了船，告別他們的父親，跟從了耶穌。 Immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him.
23. 耶穌走遍全 加利利，在他們的會堂裡教導人，傳天國的福音，並且使民中各樣的疾病和各樣的症狀痊癒。 Jesus was going all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
24. 他的消息就在全 敘利亞 省傳開了。人們把所有的病人，就是患各種疾病的、受疼痛折磨的、有鬼魔附身的、癲癇的、癱瘓的，都帶到耶穌那裡。耶穌就使他們痊癒。 Then the news about Him spread throughout Syria. So they brought to Him all those who were afflicted, those suffering from various diseases and intense pains, the demon-possessed, the epileptics, and the paralytics. And He healed them.
25. 於是有一大群人從 加利利 、 德卡波利斯 、 耶路撒冷 、 猶太 和 約旦 河對岸來，跟隨耶穌。 Large crowds followed Him from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
Matthew 5
1. 耶穌看見人群，就上了山，坐下來。他的門徒們來到他面前， When He saw the crowds, He went up on the mountain, and after He sat down, His disciples came to Him.
2. 他就開口教導他們，說： Then He began to teach them, saying:
3. 「靈裡貧乏的人是蒙福的， 因為天國是他們的。 "Blessed are the poor in spirit, because the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
4. 悲傷的人是蒙福的， 因為他們將受到安慰。 Blessed are those who mourn, because they will be comforted.
5. 謙和的人是蒙福的， 因為他們將繼承那地。 Blessed are the gentle, because they will inherit the earth.
6. 飢渴慕義的人是蒙福的， 因為他們將得飽足。 Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, because they will be filled.
7. 憐憫人的人是蒙福的， 因為他們將蒙憐憫。 Blessed are the merciful, because they will be shown mercy.
8. 心裡潔淨的人是蒙福的， 因為他們將看見神。 Blessed are the pure in heart, because they will see God.
9. 使人和睦的人是蒙福的， 因為他們將被稱為『神的兒女』。 Blessed are the peacemakers, because they will be called sons of God.
10. 為義受逼迫的人是蒙福的， 因為天國是他們的。 Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness, because the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
11. 「當人們因我的緣故責罵你們、逼迫你們、用各種捏造出來的惡事毀謗你們的時候，你們就是蒙福的。 "Blessed are you when they insult you and persecute you and falsely say every kind of evil against you because of Me.
12. 你們當歡喜，當快樂，因為你們在天上的報償是大的。要知道，那些人也這樣逼迫了在你們以前的先知們。 Be glad and rejoice, because your reward is great in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
13. 「你們是地上的鹽。鹽如果失去了味道，還能用什麼來把它醃成鹹的呢？它再也沒有用處，只好被丟在外面，任人踐踏。 "You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt should lose its taste, how can it be made salty? It's no longer good for anything but to be thrown out and trampled on by men.
14. 「你們是世界的光。建在山上的城是不能隱藏的； "You are the light of the world. A city situated on a hill cannot be hidden.
15. 人點亮了油燈，也不會放在斗 底下，而會放在燈臺上，它就照亮屋子裡所有的人。 No one lights a lamp and puts it under a basket, but rather on a lampstand, and it gives light for all who are in the house.
16. 同樣，你們的光也應當照耀在人前，使他們看見你們的美好工作，就榮耀你們在天上的父。 In the same way, let your light shine before men, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
17. 「你們不要以為我來是要廢除律法和先知，我來不是要廢除，而是要成全。 "Don't assume that I came to destroy the Law or the Prophets. I did not come to destroy but to fulfill.
18. 我確實地告訴你們：即使天和地都消逝了，律法的一點一畫也絕不會消逝，直到一切都成就。 For I assure you: Until heaven and earth pass away, not the smallest letter or one stroke of a letter will pass from the law until all things are accomplished.
19. 所以，如果有人違犯了這些誡命中最小的一條，又教導人也這樣做，他在天國裡將被稱為最小的；但無論誰遵行這些誡命，又教導人也這樣做，這個人在天國裡將被稱為大的。 Therefore, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches people to do so will be called least in the kingdom of heaven. But whoever practices and teaches [these commandments] will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
20. 我告訴你們：你們的義如果不勝過經文士們和 法利賽 人的義，就絕不能進入天國。 For I tell you, unless your righteousness surpasses that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
21. 「你們聽過那吩咐古人的話：『 不可殺人。 殺人的，當遭受審判。』 "You have heard that it was said to our ancestors, Do not murder, and whoever murders will be subject to judgment.
22. 但是我告訴你們：所有向他弟兄 發怒的，當遭受審判；罵他弟兄『廢物』的，當遭受議會的審判；罵『蠢貨』的，當遭受烈火的地獄。 But I tell you, everyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. And whoever says to his brother, 'Fool!' will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But whoever says, 'You moron!' will be subject to hellfire.
23. 所以，如果你在祭壇獻上祭物的時候，在那裡想起弟兄向你懷著怨， So if you are offering your gift on the altar, and there you remember that your brother has something against you,
24. 就要把祭物留在祭壇前，先去與弟兄和好，然後再回來獻上你的祭物。 leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and be reconciled with your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
25. 你要趁著與你的對頭還在路上的時候，趕快與他和解，免得他把你交給審判官，審判官把你交給差役，你就會被投進監獄了。 Reach a settlement quickly with your adversary while you're on the way with him, or your adversary will hand you over to the judge, the judge to the officer, and you will be thrown into prison.
26. 我確實地告訴你：除非你還清了最後的一個銅幣，否則你絕不能從那裡出來。 I assure you: You will never get out of there until you have paid the last penny!
27. 「你們聽過那吩咐 ： 『不可通姦。』 "You have heard that it was said, Do not commit adultery.
28. 但是我告訴你們：所有懷著欲念看女人的，就已經在心裡和她通姦了。 But I tell you, everyone who looks at a woman to lust for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
29. 如果你的右眼使你絆倒，就把它剜出來丟掉！因為對你來說，失去你身體的一部分，總比你全身被丟進地獄要好。 If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. For it is better that you lose one of the parts of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
30. 如果你的右手使你絆倒，就把它砍下來丟掉！因為對你來說，失去你身體的一部分，總比你全身下地獄要好。 And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. For it is better that you lose one of the parts of your body than for your whole body to go into hell!
31. 「又有吩咐： 『如果有人休妻，要給妻子一份休書。』 "It was also said, Whoever divorces his wife must give her a written notice of divorce.
32. 但是我告訴你們：凡是休妻的，除非為了淫亂的緣故，否則就是讓她犯通姦罪了；凡是娶了被休的女人的，也是犯通姦罪。 But I tell you, everyone who divorces his wife, except in a case of sexual immorality, causes her to commit adultery. And whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
33. 「另外，你們聽過那吩咐古人的話： 『不可起假誓。你所起的誓，總要向主償還。』 "Again, you have heard that it was said to our ancestors, You must not break your oath, but you must keep your oaths to the Lord.
34. 但是我告訴你們：根本不可起誓。不可指著天起誓，因為天是神的寶座； But I tell you, don't take an oath at all: either by heaven, because it is God's throne;
35. 不可指著地起誓，因為地是神的腳凳；不可用 耶路撒冷 起誓，因為 是那大君王的城； or by the earth, because it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, because it is the city of the great King.
36. 也不可指著自己的頭起誓，因為你不能使一根頭髮變白或變黑。 Neither should you swear by your head, because you cannot make a single hair white or black.
37. 你們的話語應該如此：是，就說是；不是，就說不是。再多說，就是出於那惡者。 But let your word 'yes' be 'yes,' and your 'no' be 'no.' Anything more than this is from the evil one.
38. 「你們聽過這吩咐： 『以眼還眼，以牙還牙。』 "You have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.
39. 但是我告訴你們：不要與惡人作對。有人打你的右臉，把左臉 也轉給他； But I tell you, don't resist an evildoer. On the contrary, if anyone slaps you on your right cheek, turn the other to him also.
40. 有人想要控告你，並要拿走你的裡衣，你就連外衣也由他拿去； As for the one who wants to sue you and take away your shirt, let him have your coat as well.
41. 有人強迫你走一里 路，你就與他一起走兩里； And if anyone forces you to go one mile, go with him two.
42. 有人求你，你要給他；有人要向你借什麼，你不要拒絕。 Give to the one who asks you, and don't turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
43. 「你們聽過這吩咐：『 要愛你的鄰人， 恨你的敵人 。』 "You have heard that it was said, Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.
44. 但是我告訴你們：要愛你們的敵人， 為那些 逼迫你們的人禱告， But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
45. 好讓你們成為你們天父的兒女。因為他使太陽升起，對著惡人，也對著好人；降雨給義人，也給不義的人。 so that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. For He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
46. 其實你們如果只愛那些愛你們的人，會有什麼報償呢？連稅吏不也這樣做嗎？ For if you love those who love you, what reward will you have? Don't even the tax collectors do the same?
47. 你們如果只問候自己的兄弟，這樣做有什麼特別呢？連外邦人 不也這樣做嗎？ And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing out of the ordinary? Don't even the Gentiles do the same?
48. 所以，你們當成為完全的，就像你們的天父是完全的。 Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
Matthew 6
1. 「你們要謹慎，不可為了讓別人看到而在人面前行你們的義，否則就得不到你們天父的報償了。 "Be careful not to practice your righteousness in front of people, to be seen by them. Otherwise, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
2. 所以你施捨的時候，不要在自己前面吹號，像偽善的人那樣。他們在會堂裡和大街上這樣做，是為了要得人的榮耀。我確實地告訴你們：他們已經得到了他們的報償。 So whenever you give to the poor, don't sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be applauded by people. I assure you: They've got their reward!
3. 你施捨的時候，不要讓你的左手知道右手所做的， But when you give to the poor, don't let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
4. 好使你的施捨行在隱祕中。這樣，你那在隱祕中察看的父 就將回報你 。 so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
5. 「你們禱告的時候，不要像偽善的人那樣。他們喜愛站在會堂裡和十字路口禱告，好讓人看見。我確實地告訴你們：他們已經得到了他們的報償。 "Whenever you pray, you must not be like the hypocrites, because they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by people. I assure you: They've got their reward!
6. 至於你，你禱告的時候，要進入你的內室，關上門，向你在隱祕中的父禱告。這樣，你那在隱祕中察看的父就將回報你 。 But when you pray, go into your private room, shut your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
7. 你們禱告的時候，不要像外邦人那樣，重複無意義的話。他們以為話多了就蒙垂聽。 When you pray, don't babble like the idolaters, since they imagine they'll be heard for their many words.
8. 不要像他們那樣，因為在你們祈求以前，你們的父就已經知道你們有什麼需要了。 Don't be like them, because your Father knows the things you need before you ask Him.
9. 「因此，你們要這樣禱告： 我們在天上的父， 願你的名被尊為聖， "Therefore, you should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, Your name be honored as holy.
10. 願你的國度來臨。 願你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上。 Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
11. 我們日用的食糧，願你今天賜給我們。 Give us today our daily bread.
12. 願你饒恕我們的虧欠， 如同我們也饒恕了虧欠我們的人。 And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
13. 不要讓我們陷入試探， 救我們脫離那惡者 。 因為國度、權柄、榮耀， 全是你的，直到永遠！阿們。 And do not bring us into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. [[For Yours is the kingdom and the power and the glory forever. Amen.]]
14. 「要知道，你們如果饒恕別人的過犯，你們的天父也會饒恕你們。 "For if you forgive people their wrongdoing, your heavenly Father will forgive you as well.
15. 你們如果不饒恕別人，你們的父也不會饒恕你們的過犯。 But if you don't forgive people, your Father will not forgive your wrongdoing.
16. 「你們禁食的時候，不要像偽善的人那樣愁眉苦臉。他們裝出難看的樣子，好讓人看出他們在禁食。我確實地告訴你們：他們已經得到了他們的報償。 "Whenever you fast, don't be sad-faced like the hypocrites. For they make their faces unattractive so their fasting is obvious to people. I assure you: They've got their reward!
17. 至於你，你禁食的時候，要梳頭 洗臉， But when you fast, put oil on your head, and wash your face,
18. 免得被人看出你在禁食；你反而要讓你在隱祕中的父看見。這樣，你那在隱祕中察看的父就將回報你 。 so that you don't show your fasting to people but to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
19. 「你們不要為自己在地上積蓄財寶，地上有蟲蛀，會鏽蝕，也有盜賊鑽進來偷竊； "Don't collect for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy and where thieves break in and steal.
20. 而要為自己在天上積蓄財寶：天上既沒有蟲蛀，也不會鏽蝕，也沒有盜賊鑽進來偷竊。 But collect for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys, and where thieves don't break in and steal.
21. 要知道，你的財寶在哪裡，你的心也在哪裡。 For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
22. 「眼睛是身體的燈，所以，如果你的眼睛純淨，你的全身就光明； "The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eye is good, your whole body will be full of light.
23. 如果你的眼睛汙濁，你的全身就黑暗。因此，光如果在你裡面成了黑暗，那是多麼大的黑暗！ But if your eye is bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. So if the light within you is darkness-- how deep is that darkness!
24. 「一個人不能服事兩個主人。他不是厭惡這個、喜愛那個，就是忠於這個、輕視那個。你們不能既服事神，又服事財富 。 "No one can be a slave of two masters, since either he will hate one and love the other, or be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot be slaves of God and of money.
25. 「所以我告訴你們：不要為你們的生命而憂慮吃什麼、喝什麼；也不要為你們的身體而憂慮穿什麼；難道生命不比食物更重要，身體不比衣服更重要嗎？ "This is why I tell you: Don't worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Isn't life more than food and the body more than clothing?
26. 應該看天空的飛鳥：牠們不撒種、不收割，也不收集在倉庫裡，你們的天父尚且養活牠們；難道你們不比飛鳥更重要嗎？ Look at the birds of the sky: they don't sow or reap or gather into barns, yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren't you worth more than they?
27. 你們當中誰能因著憂慮使自己的壽命延長一刻 呢？ Can any of you add a single cubit to his height by worrying?
28. 你們為什麼為衣服憂慮呢？應該觀察野地裡的百合花是怎麼生長的：它們不勞動，也不紡織。 And why do you worry about clothes? Learn how the wildflowers of the field grow: they don't labor or spin thread.
29. 但是我告訴你們：就連 所羅門 在他最榮耀的時候，所穿戴的也不如這些花中的一朵。 Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was adorned like one of these!
30. 你們這些小信的人哪！野地裡的草今天還在，明天就被丟進火爐裡，神尚且這樣裝扮它，更何況你們呢！ If that's how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and thrown into the furnace tomorrow, won't He do much more for you-- you of little faith?
31. 所以不要憂慮，說『我們吃什麼？喝什麼？穿什麼？』 So don't worry, saying, 'What will we eat?' or 'What will we drink?' or 'What will we wear?'
32. 因為這一切都是外邦人所尋求的，而你們的天父已經知道你們需要這一切了。 For the idolaters eagerly seek all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
33. 所以你們應當先尋求神的 國和神的義，這一切都將加給你們了。 But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be provided for you.
34. 因此，不要為明天憂慮，明天自有明天的憂慮。要知道，每一天自有它的難處，這已經夠了。 Therefore don't worry about tomorrow, because tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
Matthew 7
1. 「不要評斷人，免得你們被評斷。 "Do not judge, so that you won't be judged.
2. 因為，你們用什麼標準來評斷，也會同樣地被評斷；你們用什麼量器 來衡量，也會同樣地被衡量。 For with the judgment you use, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
3. 你為什麼看見你弟兄眼裡的木屑，卻不想自己眼裡的梁木呢？ Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye but don't notice the log in your own eye?
4. 又怎麼能對你弟兄說『讓我除掉你眼裡的木屑』呢？看哪，你自己眼裡還有梁木呢！ Or how can you say to your brother, 'Let me take the speck out of your eye,' and look, there's a log in your eye?
5. 你這偽善的人！先除掉你自己眼裡的梁木，然後你才能看得清楚，好除掉你弟兄眼裡的木屑。 Hypocrite! First take the log out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother's eye.
6. 不要把神聖之物丟給狗，也不要把你們的珍珠丟在豬面前，免得牠們用腳把這些踐踏了，然後轉身撕咬你們。 Don't give what is holy to dogs or toss your pearls before pigs, or they will trample them with their feet, turn, and tear you to pieces.
7. 「不斷祈求吧，就會給你們；不斷尋找吧，就會找到；不斷敲門吧，就會為你們開門。 "Keep asking, and it will be given to you. Keep searching, and you will find. Keep knocking, and the door will be opened to you.
8. 因為凡祈求的，就得到；尋找的，就找到；敲門的，就為他開門。 For everyone who asks receives, and the one who searches finds, and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.
9. 你們當中有哪個人，兒子要餅，卻給他石頭呢？ What man among you, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
10. 兒子要魚，卻給他蛇呢？ Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
11. 所以，如果你們做為惡人也知道把好的東西給自己的兒女，更何況你們在天上的父要把美好的賜給求他的人呢！ If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
12. 因此在任何事上，你們希望別人怎樣對待你們，你們也應當怎樣對待別人。要知道，這就是律法和先知 的教導 。 Therefore, whatever you want others to do for you, do also the same for them-- this is the Law and the Prophets.
13. 「你們要從窄門進去；因為那通向滅亡 的門是大的，那條路是寬的，從那裡進去的人也多； "Enter through the narrow gate. For the gate is wide and the road is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who go through it.
14. 然而，那通向永生 的門是多麼小，路是多麼窄，找到它的人是多麼少。 How narrow is the gate and difficult the road that leads to life, and few find it.
15. 「你們要提防假先知。他們披著羊皮來到你們這裡，裡面卻是凶殘的狼。 "Beware of false prophets who come to you in sheep's clothing but inwardly are ravaging wolves.
16. 憑著他們的果子，你們就能認出他們來。難道從荊棘上能收葡萄，從蒺藜中能收無花果嗎？ You'll recognize them by their fruit. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes or figs from thistles?
17. 同樣，好樹都結好果子，壞樹就結壞果子； In the same way, every good tree produces good fruit, but a bad tree produces bad fruit.
18. 好樹不能結壞果子，壞樹也不能結好果子。 A good tree can't produce bad fruit; neither can a bad tree produce good fruit.
19. 所有不結好果子的樹都要被砍下來，被丟進火裡。 Every tree that doesn't produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
20. 因此憑著他們的果子，你們就能認出他們來。 So you'll recognize them by their fruit.
21. 「不是每一個稱呼我『主啊，主啊』的人，都能進入天國；只有遵行我天父旨意的人，才能進去。 "Not everyone who says to Me, 'Lord, Lord!' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but [only] the one who does the will of My Father in heaven.
22. 在那一天，有許多人會對我說：『主啊，主啊，我們不是奉你的名做先知傳道，奉你的名驅趕鬼魔，奉你的名行了很多神蹟嗎？』 On that day many will say to Me, 'Lord, Lord, didn't we prophesy in Your name, drive out demons in Your name, and do many miracles in Your name?'
23. 那時候，我要向他們宣告：『我從來不認識你們。 離開我，你們這些作惡 的人！ 』 Then I will announce to them, 'I never knew you! Depart from Me, you lawbreakers!'
24. 「因此，凡是聽了我這些話而實行的人，就好比一個聰明的人把自己的房子建在磐石上。 "Therefore, everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them will be like a sensible man who built his house on the rock.
25. 大雨降下，急流沖來，狂風颳起，撞擊那房子，房子卻沒有倒塌，因為它在磐石上立定根基。 The rain fell, the rivers rose, and the winds blew and pounded that house. Yet it didn't collapse, because its foundation was on the rock.
26. 可是，凡是聽了我這些話而不實行的人，就好比一個愚拙的人把自己的房子建在沙灘上。 But everyone who hears these words of Mine and doesn't act on them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
27. 大雨降下，急流沖來，狂風颳起，撞擊那房子，房子就倒塌了，並且倒塌得非常厲害。」 The rain fell, the rivers rose, the winds blew and pounded that house, and it collapsed. And its collapse was great!"
28. 當耶穌講完了這些話，眾人都對他的教導驚嘆不已， When Jesus had finished this sermon, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,
29. 因為耶穌教導他們，就像有權柄的人，不像他們的經文士們。 because He was teaching them like one who had authority, and not like their scribes.
Matthew 8
1. 耶穌從山上下來，有一大群人跟隨他。 When He came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
2. 這時候，忽然有一個痲瘋病人前來拜他，說：「主啊，如果你願意，你就能潔淨我。」 Right away a man with a serious skin disease came up and knelt before Him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."
3. 耶穌伸出手來摸他，說： 「我願意，你潔淨了吧！」 那人的痲瘋病立刻就被潔淨了。 Reaching out His hand He touched him, saying, "I am willing; be made clean." Immediately his disease was healed.
4. 耶穌對他說： 「你要注意，不可告訴任何人，只要去把自己給祭司看，並且獻上 摩西 所吩咐的祭物，好對他們做見證。」 Then Jesus told him, "See that you don't tell anyone; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses prescribed, as a testimony to them."
5. 耶穌進了 迦百農，有個百夫長前來懇求他， When He entered Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, pleading with Him,
6. 說：「主啊，我的僕人癱瘓了，躺在家裡，受劇烈的折磨。」 "Lord, my servant is lying at home paralyzed, in terrible agony!"
7. 耶穌對他說： 「我去使他痊癒。」 "I will come and heal him," He told him.
8. 百夫長回答說：「主啊，我實在不配請你進我家。其實只要你說一句話，我的僕人就會痊癒的。 "Lord," the centurion replied, "I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But only say the word, and my servant will be cured.
9. 事實上，我也在人的權下，也有士兵在我之下。我對這個說『去』，他就去；對那個說『來』，他就來；對我的奴僕說『做這事』，他就去做。」 For I too am a man under authority, having soldiers under my command. I say to this one, 'Go!' and he goes; and to another, 'Come!' and he comes; and to my slave, 'Do this!' and he does it."
10. 耶穌聽了，十分感慨，對跟隨他的人說： 「我確實地告訴你們：在 以色列 我沒有見過有這麼大信心 的人。 Hearing this, Jesus was amazed and said to those following Him, "I assure you: I have not found anyone in Israel with so great a faith!
11. 我告訴你們：將有許多人從東從西而來，在天國裡與 亞伯拉罕 、 以撒 雅各 一同坐席。 I tell you that many will come from east and west, and recline at the table with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
12. 但那些『天國的兒女』，卻將被丟在外面的黑暗裡。在那裡將有哀哭和切齒。」 But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
13. 於是耶穌對那百夫長說： 「回去吧，照著你所信的，給你成全吧！」 他的僕人就在那一刻痊癒了。 Then Jesus told the centurion, "Go. As you have believed, let it be done for you." And his servant was cured that very moment.
14. 耶穌來到 彼得 家，看見 彼得 的岳母正發燒躺著。 When Jesus went into Peter's house, He saw his mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.
15. 耶穌一摸她的手，燒就退了。於是她就起來服事耶穌。 So He touched her hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and began to serve Him.
16. 到了傍晚，人們把許多有鬼魔附身的人帶到耶穌那裡。耶穌話語一出就把那些邪靈都趕了出去，並且使所有患病的人痊癒了。 When evening came, they brought to Him many who were demon-possessed. He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all who were sick,
17. 這樣，那藉著先知 以賽亞 所說的話就應驗了： 「他親自代替了我們的軟弱， 擔當了我們的疾病。」 so that what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled: He Himself took our weaknesses and carried our diseases.
18. 耶穌看見一群人 圍著他，就吩咐渡到對岸去。 When Jesus saw large crowds around Him, He gave the order to go to the other side [of the sea].
19. 有一個經文士前來對他說：「老師，無論你到哪裡去，我都要跟從你。」 A scribe approached Him and said, "Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go!"
20. 耶穌對他說： 「狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。」 Jesus told him, "Foxes have dens and birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head."
21. 耶穌的另一個門徒對他說：「主啊，請准許我先去埋葬我的父親。」 "Lord," another of His disciples said, "first let me go bury my father."
22. 但是耶穌對他說： 「你跟從我，讓死人去埋葬他們的死人吧。」 But Jesus told him, "Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead."
23. 耶穌上了船，他的門徒們跟著他。 As He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
24. 這時候，忽然湖 上起了大風暴，以致波浪蓋過了船，耶穌卻睡著了。 Suddenly, a violent storm arose on the sea, so that the boat was being swamped by the waves. But He was sleeping.
25. 門徒們上前來叫醒他，說：「主啊，救救我們，我們沒命了！」 So the disciples came and woke Him up, saying, "Lord, save [us]! We're going to die!"
26. 耶穌對他們說： 「為什麼膽怯呢？你們這些小信的人哪！」 耶穌就起來，斥責風和浪，湖面就變得一片平靜。 But He said to them, "Why are you fearful, you of little faith?" Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea. And there was a great calm.
27. 他們都感到驚奇，說：「這個人究竟是什麼人？連風和浪 也聽從他！」 The men were amazed and asked, "What kind of man is this?-- even the winds and the sea obey Him!"
28. 耶穌來到對岸 格達拉 人的地方，兩個有鬼魔附身的人，從墓地迎著他出來。他們非常凶猛，以致沒有人能從那條路經過。 When He had come to the other side, to the region of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men met Him as they came out of the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
29. 忽然，他們喊叫說：「神的兒子 啊，我們與你有什麼關係？時候來到之前，你就來這裡折磨我們嗎？」 Suddenly they shouted, "What do You have to do with us, Son of God? Have You come here to torment us before the time?"
30. 當時，離他們很遠的地方，有一大群豬正在吃食。 Now a long way off from them, a large herd of pigs was feeding.
31. 那些鬼魔就央求耶穌，說：「如果你要把我們趕出去，就叫我們進入這群豬裡面去吧。」 "If You drive us out," the demons begged Him, "send us into the herd of pigs."
32. 耶穌對它們說： 「去吧！」 它們就出來，進入豬 裡面去了。忽然，那整群豬 從山崖衝到湖裡，在水裡淹 死了。 "Go!" He told them. So when they had come out, they entered the pigs. And suddenly the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and perished in the water.
33. 那些放豬的人就逃跑，進城去傳報了這一切事，包括鬼魔附身之人的事。 Then the men who tended them fled. They went into the city and reported everything-- especially what had happened to those who were demon-possessed.
34. 看哪，全城的人都出來看耶穌，見了耶穌以後，就央求他離開他們的地區。 At that, the whole town went out to meet Jesus. When they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
Matthew 9
1. 耶穌上了船，渡過去，來到自己的城裡。 So He got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
2. 這時候，有幾個人把一個躺在床榻上癱瘓的人抬到他面前。耶穌看見他們的信心，就對癱瘓的人說： 「孩子，鼓起勇氣吧！你的罪孽被赦免了。」 Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a stretcher. Seeing their faith, Jesus told the paralytic, "Have courage, son, your sins are forgiven."
3. 但這時候，有些經文士心裡說：「這個人說褻瀆的話！」 At this, some of the scribes said among themselves, "He's blaspheming!"
4. 耶穌知道他們的想法，就說： 「你們心裡為什麼懷著惡念呢？ But perceiving their thoughts, Jesus said, "Why are you thinking evil things in your hearts?
5. 或說『你的罪孽被赦免了』，或說『你起來走路』，到底哪一樣更容易呢？ For which is easier: to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up and walk'?
6. 不過為要使你們知道人子在地上有赦免罪的權柄——」 於是他對癱瘓的人說： 「起來，拿起你的床榻，回家去吧！」 But so you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"-- then He told the paralytic, "Get up, pick up your stretcher, and go home."
7. 那個人就起來，回家去了。 And he got up and went home.
8. 眾人看見就起了敬畏之心，就榮耀神，因為他賜給人這樣的權柄。 When the crowds saw this, they were awestruck and gave glory to God who had given such authority to men.
9. 耶穌從那裡往前走，看見一個叫 馬太 的人在稅關坐著。耶穌對他說： 「你跟從我！」 就站起來，跟從了耶穌。 As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax office, and He said to him, "Follow Me!" So he got up and followed Him.
10. 耶穌在屋子裡坐席，這時候來了許多稅吏和罪人，與耶穌和他的門徒們一同坐席。 While He was reclining at the table in the house, many tax collectors and sinners came as guests to eat with Jesus and His disciples.
11. 有些 法利賽 人看見了，就對耶穌的門徒們說：「你們的老師為什麼與那些稅吏和罪人一起吃飯呢？」 When the Pharisees saw this, they asked His disciples, "Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
12. 耶穌聽見了就說： 「健康的人不需要醫生，有病的人才需要。 But when He heard this, He said, "Those who are well don't need a doctor, but the sick do.
13. 你們去學 『我要的是憐憫，而不是祭祀』 這話是什麼意思吧！我來不是要召喚義人，而是要召喚罪人 。」 Go and learn what this means: I desire mercy and not sacrifice. For I didn't come to call the righteous, but sinners."
14. 隨後， 約翰 的門徒們前來問耶穌：「為什麼我們和 法利賽 人經常 禁食，而你的門徒們卻不禁食呢？」 Then John's disciples came to Him, saying, "Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but Your disciples do not fast?"
15. 耶穌對他們說： 「新郎與賓客 在一起的時候，難道賓客能悲傷嗎？可是日子將要來到：當新郎從他們中間被帶走的時候，他們那時就要禁食了。 Jesus said to them, "Can the wedding guests be sad while the groom is with them? The days will come when the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
16. 沒有人把沒縮過水的布塊補在舊衣服上，因為所補上的布塊會扯壞衣服，造成更大的裂口。 No one patches an old garment with unshrunk cloth, because the patch pulls away from the garment and makes the tear worse.
17. 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裡，否則皮袋會脹破，酒會流出來，皮袋也被糟蹋了；相反，他們是把新酒裝在新皮袋裡，這樣兩者都保全了。」 And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the skins burst, the wine spills out, and the skins are ruined. But they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved."
18. 耶穌正對他們講這些事的時候，忽然有一個會堂 主管來拜他，說：「我的女兒剛才死了，求你來按手在她身上，她就會活了。」 As He was telling them these things, suddenly one of the leaders came and knelt down before Him, saying, "My daughter is near death, but come and lay Your hand on her, and she will live."
19. 於是耶穌起身跟著他去，他的門徒們也跟著去了。 So Jesus and His disciples got up and followed him.
20. 這時候，忽然有一個患血漏十二年的女人，從耶穌後面過來，摸了一下耶穌的衣服穗子， Just then, a woman who had suffered from bleeding for 12 years approached from behind and touched the tassel on His robe,
21. 原來她心裡想：「只要我摸到他的衣服，就會得救治。」 for she said to herself, "If I can just touch His robe, I'll be made well!"
22. 耶穌轉過身來看著她，說： 「女兒，鼓起勇氣吧！你的信救了你。」 從那一刻起，那個女人就得了救治。 But Jesus turned and saw her. "Have courage, daughter," He said. "Your faith has made you well." And the woman was made well from that moment.
23. 耶穌來到那會堂 主管的家，看見吹笛的人和慌亂的人群， When Jesus came to the leader's house, He saw the flute players and a crowd lamenting loudly.
24. 就說： 「你們退去吧！這女孩不是死了，而是睡了。」 他們就譏笑他。 "Leave," He said, "because the girl isn't dead, but sleeping." And they started laughing at Him.
25. 那群人被趕出去以後，耶穌進去，握著女孩的手，那女孩就起來了。 But when the crowd had been put outside, He went in and took her by the hand, and the girl got up.
26. 於是，這消息傳遍了那整個地區。 And this news spread throughout that whole area.
27. 耶穌從那裡往前走，有兩個瞎眼的跟著他，呼叫說：「 大衛 的後裔，可憐我們吧！」 As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, shouting, "Have mercy on us, Son of David!"
28. 耶穌進了屋子，那兩個瞎眼的來到他面前。耶穌問他們： 「你們相信我能做這件事嗎？」 他們回答說：「主啊，是的，我們信 。」 When He entered the house, the blind men approached Him, and Jesus said to them, "Do you believe that I can do this?" "Yes, Lord," they answered Him.
29. 於是耶穌摸他們的眼睛，說： 「照著你們所信的，給你們成全吧。」 Then He touched their eyes, saying, "Let it be done for you according to your faith!"
30. 他們的眼睛就開了。耶穌嚴厲地告誡他們： 「你們要注意，不可讓任何人知道。」 And their eyes were opened. Then Jesus warned them sternly, "Be sure that no one finds out!"
31. 但他們一出去，就把耶穌的消息傳遍了那整個地區。 But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout that whole area.
32. 兩個人離去了。這時候有幾個人把一個有鬼魔附身的啞巴帶到耶穌那裡。 Just as they were going out, a demon-possessed man who was unable to speak was brought to Him.
33. 鬼魔一被趕出去，啞巴就說出話來。眾人都感到驚奇，他們說：「這樣的事，在 以色列 從來沒有見過。」 When the demon had been driven out, the man spoke. And the crowds were amazed, saying, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!"
34. 但 法利賽 人卻說：「他是靠鬼魔的王驅趕鬼魔的。」 But the Pharisees said, "He drives out demons by the ruler of the demons!"
35. 耶穌走遍各個城鎮鄉村，在他們的會堂裡教導人，傳天國的福音，並且使 各樣的疾病和各樣的症狀痊癒。 Then Jesus went to all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness.
36. 耶穌看見眾人，就對他們動了憐憫之心，因為他們困苦流離，像羊沒有牧人那樣。 When He saw the crowds, He felt compassion for them, because they were weary and worn out, like sheep without a shepherd.
37. 於是他對自己的門徒們說： 「收割的工作 多，而工人少。 Then He said to His disciples, "The harvest is abundant, but the workers are few.
38. 所以你們要祈求收割 的主催促工人參與他的收割工作 。」 Therefore, pray to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest."
Matthew 10
1. 耶穌召來他的十二個門徒，賜給他們權柄，能驅趕汙靈，也能使各樣的疾病和各樣的症狀痊癒。 Summoning His 12 disciples, He gave them authority over unclean spirits, to drive them out and to heal every disease and sickness.
2. 以下是十二使徒的名字： 首先是 西門 ——也叫 彼得， 然後是他的弟弟 安得烈， 西庇太 的兒子 雅各， 雅各 的弟弟 約翰， These are the names of the 12 apostles: First, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
3. 腓力 和 巴多羅邁， 多馬 和稅吏 馬太， 亞勒腓 的兒子 雅各，還有 達太， Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
4. 激進派 的 西門， 還有那出賣耶穌的 加略 人 猶大 。 Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.
5. 耶穌差派這十二使徒出去，吩咐他們說： 「外邦人的路，你們不要走； 撒馬利亞 人的城，你們不要進； Jesus sent out these 12 after giving them instructions: "Don't take the road leading to other nations, and don't enter any Samaritan town.
6. 寧願到 以色列 家迷失的羊那裡去。 Instead, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
7. 你們去的時候，要傳講說『天國近了。』 As you go, announce this: 'The kingdom of heaven has come near.'
8. 要使病人痊癒，使死人復活，使痲瘋病人潔淨，把鬼魔趕出去。你們無償地得來，也要無償地給與。 Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those with skin diseases, drive out demons. You have received free of charge; give free of charge.
9. 腰包裡不要帶金銀或銅錢。 Don't take along gold, silver, or copper for your money-belts.
10. 在路上不要帶行囊，不要帶兩件衣服，也不要帶鞋子和手杖，因為工人配得自己的食物。 Don't take a traveling bag for the road, or an extra shirt, sandals, or a walking stick, for the worker is worthy of his food.
11. 「你們無論進哪個城鎮或鄉村，要查問其中配得的人，就住在他那裡，直到你們離去。 "When you enter any town or village, find out who is worthy, and stay there until you leave.
12. 你們進了他家，要祝那家平安。 Greet a household when you enter it,
13. 如果那一家是配得的，你們的平安就臨到那一家；如果那家是不配得的，你們的平安就歸回你們。 and if the household is worthy, let your peace be on it. But if it is unworthy, let your peace return to you.
14. 如果有人不接受你們，也不聽你們的話語，你們離開那家那城的時候，要把腳上的塵土跺掉。 If anyone will not welcome you or listen to your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that house or town.
15. 我確實地告訴你們：在那審判的日子， 所多瑪 和 格摩拉 之地所受的，將要比那城還容易受呢！ I assure you: It will be more tolerable on the day of judgment for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town.
16. 「看哪，我差派你們出去，就像把羊送進狼群中，所以你們要像蛇那樣聰明，像鴿子那樣純潔。 "Look, I'm sending you out like sheep among wolves. Therefore be as shrewd as serpents and as harmless as doves.
17. 你們要提防人們，因為他們將要把你們送交議會，並且在他們的會堂裡鞭打你們。 Because people will hand you over to sanhedrins and flog you in their synagogues, beware of them.
18. 為我的緣故，你們將被帶到總督和君王面前，好對他們和外邦人做見證。 You will even be brought before governors and kings because of Me, to bear witness to them and to the nations.
19. 當他們把你們交出去的時候，不要憂慮怎樣說或說什麼。到時候，你們就會被賜予該說的話， But when they hand you over, don't worry about how or what you should speak. For you will be given what to say at that hour,
20. 因為說話的不是你們自己，而是你們父的靈在你們裡面說話。 because you are not speaking, but the Spirit of your Father is speaking through you.
21. 「兄弟將要把兄弟出賣，置於死地；父親對孩子也會這樣。兒女會起來與父母作對，並且害死他們。 "Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will even rise up against their parents and have them put to death.
22. 為了我的名，你們將被所有的人憎恨，但是忍耐到底的，這個人將會得救。 You will be hated by everyone because of My name. But the one who endures to the end will be delivered.
23. 他們在這城逼迫你們，你們就逃到別的城去。我確實地告訴你們：在你們走遍 以色列 的城鎮之前，人子必定來臨。 When they persecute you in one town, escape to another. For I assure you: You will not have covered the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
24. 學生不高於他的老師，奴僕也不高於他的主人。 A disciple is not above his teacher, or a slave above his master.
25. 學生能像他的老師一樣，奴僕能像他的主人一樣，就已經夠了。如果人們稱一家的主人為『 別西卜 』，更何況他的家人呢！ It is enough for a disciple to become like his teacher and a slave like his master. If they called the head of the house ' Beelzebul,' how much more the members of his household!
26. 「所以不要怕他們，因為被遮蓋的事沒有將不被顯露出來的，隱祕的事也沒有將不被知道的。 "Therefore, don't be afraid of them, since there is nothing covered that won't be uncovered, and nothing hidden that won't be made known.
27. 我在暗中告訴你們的，你們要在明處說出來；你們在耳邊聽到的，要在屋頂上宣揚出去。 What I tell you in the dark, speak in the light. What you hear in a whisper, proclaim on the housetops.
28. 你們不要怕那些能殺死身體卻不能殺死靈魂的；反而倒要懼怕那位能把靈魂和身體都毀滅在地獄裡的。 Don't fear those who kill the body but are not able to kill the soul; rather, fear Him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
29. 兩隻麻雀不是賣一個小錢 嗎？但如果沒有你們父的允許，一隻也不會掉在地上。 Aren't two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them falls to the ground without your Father's consent.
30. 至於你們，就是每一根頭髮也都被數過了。 But even the hairs of your head have all been counted.
31. 所以不要怕！你們比一大群麻雀還重要。 Don't be afraid therefore; you are worth more than many sparrows.
32. 「凡是在人面前承認我的，我在我天上的父面前也將承認他； "Therefore, everyone who will acknowledge Me before men, I will also acknowledge him before My Father in heaven.
33. 但無論誰在人面前不認我，我在我天上的父面前也將不認他。 But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.
34. 不要以為我來了，是給地上帶來和平。我來並不是帶來和平，而是刀劍， Don't assume that I came to bring peace on the earth. I did not come to bring peace, but a sword.
35. 因為我來就是為了： 使 『人與父親對立， 女兒與母親對立， 媳婦與婆婆對立， For I came to turn a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law;
36. 這樣，一個人的敵人， 就是自己家裡的人。』 and a man's enemies will be the members of his household.
37. 「那愛父親或母親過於愛我的，不配屬於我；那愛兒子或女兒過於愛我的，不配屬於我； The person who loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; the person who loves son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me.
38. 不背起自己的十字架來跟從我的，也不配屬於我。 And whoever doesn't take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
39. 尋得自己生命的，將失去生命；為我的緣故失去自己生命的，將尋得生命。 Anyone finding his life will lose it, and anyone losing his life because of Me will find it.
40. 「接受你們的，就是接受我；接受我的，就是接受差派我來的那一位。 "The one who welcomes you welcomes Me, and the one who welcomes Me welcomes Him who sent Me.
41. 因著先知的名份接受先知的，將得到先知的報償；因著義人的名份接受義人的，將得到義人的報償。 Anyone who welcomes a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet's reward. And anyone who welcomes a righteous person because he's righteous will receive a righteous person's reward.
42. 無論誰，因著門徒的名份，就是拿一杯涼水給這些卑微人中的一個喝，我確實地告訴你們：他絕不會失去他的報償。」 And whoever gives just a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is a disciple-- I assure you: He will never lose his reward!"
Matthew 11
1. 當耶穌吩咐完了他的十二個門徒，就離開了那裡，到各城鎮去傳道、教導人。 When Jesus had finished giving orders to His 12 disciples, He moved on from there to teach and preach in their towns.
2. 約翰 在監獄裡聽說了基督所做的事，就派自己的幾個 門徒去 When John heard in prison what the Messiah was doing, he sent [a message] by his disciples
3. 問耶穌：「將要來的那一位就是你嗎？還是我們應該等候別人呢？」 and asked Him, "Are You the One who is to come, or should we expect someone else?"
4. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「你們去把所聽見、所看見的告訴 約翰， Jesus replied to them, "Go and report to John what you hear and see:
5. 就是：瞎眼的得以看見，瘸腿的行走，痲瘋病人被潔淨，耳聾的聽見，死人得以復活，窮人得以聽到福音。 the blind see, the lame walk, those with skin diseases are healed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor are told the good news.
6. 凡不因我被絆倒 的人，就蒙福了。」 And if anyone is not offended because of Me, he is blessed."
7. 約翰 的門徒們走了，耶穌就開始對眾人談論 約翰，說： 「你們曾經到曠野去，是要觀看什麼呢？一根被風吹動的蘆葦嗎？ As these men went away, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
8. 你們出去，究竟是要看什麼呢？一個身穿細軟衣服的人嗎？看哪，那些穿細軟衣服的人在王宮裡。 What then did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft clothes? Look, those who wear soft clothes are in kings' palaces.
9. 你們出去，究竟是要看什麼呢？一位先知嗎？是的，我告訴你們：他比先知還大。 But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and far more than a prophet.
10. 他就是經上記載的那個人： 『看哪，我要差派我的使者在你前頭， 他要在你之前預備你的道 。』 This is the one it is written about: Look, I am sending My messenger ahead of You; he will prepare Your way before You.
11. 「我確實地告訴你們：在女人所生的人中，沒有出現過一個比施洗者 約翰 更大的；然而在天國裡，再小的也比 更大。 "I assure you: Among those born of women no one greater than John the Baptist has appeared, but the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
12. 從施洗者 約翰 的日子到現在，天國是努力爭取的，努力爭取的人就得著它。 From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been suffering violence, and the violent have been seizing it by force.
13. 在 約翰 之前，所有的先知和律法都說預言。 For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John;
14. 如果你們願意接受， 約翰 就是那位要來的 以利亞 。 if you're willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who is to come.
15. 凡是有耳的，就應當聽！ Anyone who has ears should listen!
16. 「我要把這世代比做什麼呢？它就好比孩子們坐在街市上呼叫別的孩子， "To what should I compare this generation? It's like children sitting in the marketplaces who call out to each other:
17. 說： 『我們為你們吹笛， 你們卻不跳舞； 我們唱哀歌， 你們也不捶胸。』 We played the flute for you, but you didn't dance; we sang a lament, but you didn't mourn!
18. 「因為 約翰 來了，不吃也不喝，他們就說：『他有鬼魔附身！』 For John did not come eating or drinking, and they say, 'He has a demon!'
19. 人子來了，也吃也喝，他們就說：『看，這個貪食好酒的人！稅吏和罪人的朋友！』然而，智慧是憑著智慧的行為 被證明為義的。」 The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, 'Look, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!' Yet wisdom is vindicated by her deeds."
20. 接著，耶穌開始斥責那些他曾經在其中行了許多神蹟的城市，因為那裡的人不肯悔改： Then He proceeded to denounce the towns where most of His miracles were done, because they did not repent:
21. 「 哥拉汛 哪，你有禍了！ 伯賽達 呀，你有禍了！因為在你們當中行過的神蹟，如果行在 提爾 和 西頓，那裡的人早就會披麻蒙灰悔改了。 "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented in sackcloth and ashes long ago!
22. 不過我告訴你們：在那審判的日子， 提爾 和 西頓 所受的，將要比你們還容易受呢！ But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
23. 而你—— 迦百農 啊，你將被高舉到天上嗎？不，你將下到陰間。因為在你中間行過的神蹟，如果行在 所多瑪，它就會存留到今天。 And you, Capernaum, will you be exalted to heaven? You will go down to Hades. For if the miracles that were done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until today.
24. 不過我告訴你們：在那審判的日子， 所多瑪 之地所受的，將要比你還容易受呢！」 But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment than for you."
25. 那時候，耶穌說： 「父啊，天地的主，我讚美 你，因為你把這些事向有智慧的和有學問的人隱藏起來，而向小孩子們顯明出來。 At that time Jesus said, "I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned and revealed them to infants.
26. 是的，父啊！因為這正是你的美意。 Yes, Father, because this was Your good pleasure.
27. 我父把一切都交給了我。除了父，沒有人認識子；除了子和子所願意啟示的人，也沒有人認識父。 All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and anyone to whom the Son desires to reveal Him.
28. 「所有勞苦和背負重擔的人哪，到我這裡來吧！我將使你們得到安息。 "Come to Me, all of you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
29. 你們當負起我的軛，向我學，因為我心地柔和、謙卑。這樣，你們就將尋得靈魂的安息。 All of you, take up My yoke and learn from Me, because I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for yourselves.
30. 要知道，我的軛是容易負的，我的擔子是輕省的。」 For My yoke is easy and My burden is light."
Matthew 12
1. 在安息日那天，耶穌從麥田經過。他的門徒們餓了，就開始摘麥穗吃。 At that time Jesus passed through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick and eat some heads of grain.
2. 有些 法利賽 人看見了，就對耶穌說：「你看，你的門徒們做了在安息日不可以做的事。」 But when the Pharisees saw it, they said to Him, "Look, Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath!"
3. 耶穌對他們說： 「 大衛 和那些與他在一起的人飢餓時所做的事，你們難道沒有讀過嗎？ He said to them, "Haven't you read what David did when he and those who were with him were hungry--
4. 他不是進了神的殿，和他們吃了 陳設餅嗎？這餅是他和那些與他在一起的人不可以吃的，唯有祭司才可以吃。 how he entered the house of God, and they ate the sacred bread, which is not lawful for him or for those with him to eat, but only for the priests?
5. 再者，你們難道沒有在律法書上讀過：當安息日，祭司們在聖殿裡觸犯了安息日，也是無罪的嗎？ Or haven't you read in the Law that on Sabbath days the priests in the temple violate the Sabbath and are innocent?
6. 但是我告訴你們：比聖殿更大的就在這裡！ But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here!
7. 你們如果明白 『我要的是憐憫，而不是祭祀』 這話是什麼意思，就不會把無罪的定為有罪了。 If you had known what this means: I desire mercy and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the innocent.
8. 因為人子是安息日的主。」 For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
9. 耶穌離開那地方，進了他們的會堂。 Moving on from there, He entered their synagogue.
10. 看哪，有個一隻手枯萎的人。有些人就問耶穌，說：「在安息日使人痊癒，是否可以呢？」這是為要控告耶穌。 There He saw a man who had a paralyzed hand. And in order to accuse Him they asked Him, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"
11. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們當中有哪一個人，如果他有一隻羊在安息日掉進坑裡，他不會抓住羊，把牠拉上來呢？ But He said to them, "What man among you, if he had a sheep that fell into a pit on the Sabbath, wouldn't take hold of it and lift it out?
12. 人比羊重要多了！所以，在安息日做好事是可以的。」 A man is worth far more than a sheep, so it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
13. 於是耶穌對那個人說： 「伸出你的手！」 他一伸出來，手就復原了，和另一隻一樣健全。 Then He told the man, "Stretch out your hand." So he stretched it out, and it was restored, as good as the other.
14. 那些 法利賽 人就出去，商議怎樣對付耶穌，好除滅他。 But the Pharisees went out and plotted against Him, how they might destroy Him.
15. 耶穌知道了，就離開那裡。有一大群人跟隨他，耶穌使他們都痊癒了， When Jesus became aware of this, He withdrew from there. Huge crowds followed Him, and He healed them all.
16. 並且告誡他們不要把他傳揚出去。 He warned them not to make Him known,
17. 這是為要應驗那藉著先知 以賽亞 所說的話： so that what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled:
18. 「看哪，我所揀選的僕人， 我所愛的，心所喜悅的。 我要把我的靈賜給他， 他要向外邦人宣揚審判的事。 Here is My Servant whom I have chosen, My beloved in whom My soul delights; I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.
19. 他不爭競、不喧嚷， 大街 上也沒有人聽見他的聲音。 He will not argue or shout, and no one will hear His voice in the streets.
20. 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷； 將熄的燈火，他不吹滅， 直到他使公義得勝， He will not break a bruised reed, and He will not put out a smoldering wick, until He has led justice to victory.
21. 外邦人將要仰望他的名。」 The nations will put their hope in His name.
22. 那時，一個有鬼魔附身、又瞎又啞的人被帶到耶穌那裡。耶穌使他痊癒，那啞巴就能說話，也能看見了。 Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and unable to speak was brought to Him. He healed him, so that the man could both speak and see.
23. 眾人都十分驚訝，說：「難道這個人就是『 大衛 的後裔』？」 And all the crowds were astounded and said, "Perhaps this is the Son of David!"
24. 但 法利賽 人聽見了卻說：「這個人如果不是靠著鬼魔的王 別西卜，就不能驅趕鬼魔！」 When the Pharisees heard this, they said, "The man drives out demons only by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons."
25. 耶穌知道他們的想法，就對他們說： 「任何一個國家，如果自相紛爭就成為荒蕪；任何一個城或家庭，如果自相紛爭就站立不住。 Knowing their thoughts, He told them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is headed for destruction, and no city or house divided against itself will stand.
26. 如果 撒旦 驅趕，就是自相紛爭，它的國怎麼能站立得住呢？ If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
27. 如果我是靠 別西卜 驅趕鬼魔，那麼，你們的子弟是靠誰驅趕鬼魔呢？為此，你們的子弟就將要成為你們的審判者了。 And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, who is it your sons drive them out by? For this reason they will be your judges.
28. 然而，如果我藉著神的靈驅趕鬼魔，那麼，神的國就已經臨到你們了。 If I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come to you.
29. 人怎麼能進入一個壯士的家搶奪他的東西呢？如果不先把那壯士捆住，就不能搶奪他的家。 How can someone enter a strong man's house and steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can rob his house.
30. 不與我在一起的，就是在反對我；不與我一起收集的，就是在拆散。 Anyone who is not with Me is against Me, and anyone who does not gather with Me scatters.
31. 為此，我告訴你們：人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都能被赦免，但褻瀆聖靈卻不能被赦免。 Because of this, I tell you, people will be forgiven every sin and blasphemy, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
32. 凡是說話抵擋人子的，還能被赦免；但如果有人說話抵擋聖靈，無論在這世代，或在將要來的世代，都不能被赦免。 Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him. But whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age or in the one to come.
33. 「你們讓一棵樹好，它的果子就好；你們讓一棵樹壞，它的果子就壞；這樣，一棵樹是憑著果子被認出來。 "Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree bad and its fruit bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.
34. 你們這些毒蛇的子孫！你們做為惡人，怎麼能說出善的來呢？因為心裡所充滿的，口裡就說出來。 Brood of vipers! How can you speak good things when you are evil? For the mouth speaks from the overflow of the heart.
35. 好人從他心裡 所存的善，發出善來；壞人從他心裡所存的惡，發出惡來。 A good man produces good things from his storeroom of good, and an evil man produces evil things from his storeroom of evil.
36. 我告訴你們：人所說的每一句無益的話，在那審判的日子，句句都要做出交代， I tell you that on the day of judgment people will have to account for every careless word they speak.
37. 因為憑你的話，你將被稱為義；也憑你的話，你將被定有罪。」 For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned."
38. 當時，有一些經文士和 法利賽 人對耶穌說：「老師，我們希望你顯個神蹟給我們看。」 Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from You."
39. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「一個邪惡、淫亂的世代會尋求神蹟；可是除了先知 約拿 的神蹟以外，不會有神蹟賜給它了。 But He answered them, "An evil and adulterous generation demands a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
40. 就是說，正如 約拿 在大魚的肚子裡三天三夜，人子也照樣將要在地心三天三夜。 For as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish three days and three nights, so the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.
41. 在審判的時候， 尼尼微 人將要與這世代一起復活，並且要定這世代的罪，因為 人因著 約拿 的傳道就悔改了。看，比 更大的就在這裡！ The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at Jonah's proclamation; and look-- something greater than Jonah is here!
42. 在審判的時候，南方的女王 將要與這世代一起復活，並且要定這世代的罪，因為她從極遠的地方來，要聽 所羅門 智慧的話語。看，比 更大的就在這裡！ The queen of the south will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and look-- something greater than Solomon is here!
43. 「有個汙靈從一個人身上出來以後，走遍無水之地，尋找安歇的地方，卻找不到， "When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it roams through waterless places looking for rest but doesn't find any.
44. 就說：『我要回到我離開的那屋裡去。』於是它回去，發現那裡空著，已被打掃乾淨，擺設整齊， Then it says, 'I'll go back to my house that I came from.' And when it arrives, it finds [the house] vacant, swept, and put in order.
45. 就去帶了另外七個比自己更邪惡的靈，進去住在那裡。那個人最後的情況就比先前更壞了。這邪惡的世代也將是這樣。」 Then off it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and settle down there. As a result, that man's last condition is worse than the first. That's how it will also be with this evil generation."
46. 耶穌正在向人群講話，這時候他的母親和弟弟們 站在外面，想要和他說話。 He was still speaking to the crowds when suddenly His mother and brothers were standing outside wanting to speak to Him.
47. 有人告訴他：「看，你母親和弟弟們站在外面，想和你說話。」 Someone told Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You."
48. 耶穌回答那對他說話的人，說： 「我的母親是誰呢？我的弟兄是誰呢？」 But He replied to the one who told Him, "Who is My mother and who are My brothers?"
49. 他就伸手指著他的門徒們，說： 「看，我的母親、我的弟兄！ And stretching out His hand toward His disciples, He said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!
50. 因為凡是遵行我天父旨意的人，他才是我的弟兄、姐妹和母親。」 For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven, that person is My brother and sister and mother."
Matthew 13
1. 那一天，耶穌從屋子裡出來，在湖 邊坐下。 On that day Jesus went out of the house and was sitting by the sea.
2. 有一大群人聚集到他那裡，所以他上了一條船坐下來。眾人都站在岸邊。 Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while the whole crowd stood on the shore.
3. 耶穌用比喻對他們講了很多事。他說： 「看哪，有一個撒種的出去撒種。 Then He told them many things in parables, saying: "Consider the sower who went out to sow.
4. 他撒的時候，有些種子落在路邊，飛鳥來把它們吃掉了。 As he was sowing, some seeds fell along the path, and the birds came and ate them up.
5. 有些落在岩石地上，那裡沒有多少泥土，它們立刻就發芽了，因為土不深； Others fell on rocky ground, where there wasn't much soil, and they sprang up quickly since the soil wasn't deep.
6. 當太陽升起，它們被暴曬，就枯萎了，因為沒有根。 But when the sun came up they were scorched, and since they had no root, they withered.
7. 有些落進荊棘叢裡，荊棘長起來，就把它們擠住了。 Others fell among thorns, and the thorns came up and choked them.
8. 但是另有落在好土壤上的，就不斷地結出果實來，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。 Still others fell on good ground, and produced a crop: some 100, some 60, and some 30 times [what was sown].
9. 凡是有耳的，就應當聽！」 Anyone who has ears should listen!"
10. 門徒們上前來，問耶穌：「你對他們講話，為什麼用比喻呢？」 Then the disciples came up and asked Him, "Why do You speak to them in parables?"
11. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「天國的奧祕已經賜下來讓你們知道，而沒有賜給那些人； He answered them, "Because the secrets of the kingdom of heaven have been given for you to know, but it has not been given to them.
12. 因為凡是有的，還要賜給他，使他豐足有餘；凡是沒有的，連他有的也將從他那裡被拿走。 For whoever has, [more] will be given to him, and he will have more than enough. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
13. 我之所以用比喻對他們說，是因為他們雖然看了，卻看不見；聽了，卻聽不進，也不領悟。 For this reason I speak to them in parables, because looking they do not see, and hearing they do not listen or understand.
14. 在他們身上，正應驗了 以賽亞 的預言，他說： 『你們將聽了又聽，但絕不會領悟； 你們將看了又看，但絕不會明白； Isaiah's prophecy is fulfilled in them, which says: You will listen and listen, yet never understand; and you will look and look, yet never perceive.
15. 因為這子民的心麻木了， 他們充耳不聞，眼睛閉著； 免得他們眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裡領悟， 回轉過來，我就使他們痊癒。』 For this people's heart has grown callous; their ears are hard of hearing, and they have shut their eyes; otherwise they might see with their eyes and hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn back-- and I would cure them.
16. 「但你們的眼睛是蒙福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵是蒙福的，因為聽見了。 "But your eyes are blessed because they do see, and your ears because they do hear!
17. 我確實地告訴你們：曾經有許多先知和義人渴望看你們所看見的，卻沒有看到；渴望聽你們所聽見的，卻沒有聽到。 For I assure you: Many prophets and righteous people longed to see the things you see yet didn't see them; to hear the things you hear yet didn't hear them.
18. 「所以，你們應當聽這撒種的比喻： "You, then, listen to the parable of the sower:
19. 無論誰聽了天國的話語而不領悟，那惡者就來，把那撒在他心裡的奪走；這就是那被撒上種子的『路邊之地』。 When anyone hears the word about the kingdom and doesn't understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the one sown along the path.
20. 那被撒上種子的『岩石地』是這樣的人：他聽了這話語，立刻懷著喜樂的心接受了它； And the one sown on rocky ground-- this is one who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy.
21. 只是他裡面沒有根而不能持久，一旦為這話語受患難或逼迫，他立刻就放棄 了。 Yet he has no root in himself, but is short-lived. When pressure or persecution comes because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
22. 那被撒進種子的『荊棘叢』是這樣的人：他聽了這話語，但今世的憂慮和財富的迷惑把話語擠住了，他就成了不結果實的。 Now the one sown among the thorns-- this is one who hears the word, but the worries of this age and the seduction of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
23. 那被撒上種子的『好土壤』是這樣的人：他聽了這話語，就領悟了，必然結出果實來，結出的有一百倍的、有六十倍的、有三十倍的。」 But the one sown on the good ground-- this is one who hears and understands the word, who does bear fruit and yields: some 100, some 60, some 30 times [what was sown]."
24. 耶穌對他們講了另一個比喻說： 「天國好比一個人把好種子撒在自己的田裡。 He presented another parable to them: "The kingdom of heaven may be compared to a man who sowed good seed in his field.
25. 但是當人們睡覺的時候，他的仇敵來把稗子撒在麥子中間，然後離開了。 But while people were sleeping, his enemy came, sowed weeds among the wheat, and left.
26. 到了麥苗長大結穗的時候，稗子也顯出來了。 When the plants sprouted and produced grain, then the weeds also appeared.
27. 奴僕前來問那家的主人，說：『主人，你不是把好種子撒在你的田裡嗎？從哪裡來的這些稗子呢？』 The landowner's slaves came to him and said, 'Master, didn't you sow good seed in your field? Then where did the weeds come from?'
28. 「主人告訴他們：『這是仇敵做的。』 「奴僕問：『那麼，你要我們去把稗子拔掉嗎？』 " 'An enemy did this!' he told them. " 'So, do you want us to go and gather them up?' the slaves asked him.
29. 「主人說：『不，免得你們把稗子拔掉的時候，也把麥子一同連根拔出來。 " 'No,' he said. 'When you gather up the weeds, you might also uproot the wheat with them.
30. 讓兩樣一起長吧，直到收割的季節。在收割的時候，我要吩咐收割的人先把稗子拔掉，把它們綁成一捆一捆的好去燒掉，然後把麥子收進我的倉庫裡。』」 Let both grow together until the harvest. At harvest time I'll tell the reapers: Gather the weeds first and tie them in bundles to burn them, but store the wheat in my barn. '"
31. 耶穌對他們講了另一個比喻說： 「天國好比一粒芥菜種子，有人拿去種在他的田裡。 He presented another parable to them: "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man took and sowed in his field.
32. 它雖然比所有的種子更小，長大以後，卻比各種蔬菜更大，成了一棵樹，結果天空的飛鳥來了，在它的枝子上搭窩。」 It's the smallest of all the seeds, but when grown, it's taller than the vegetables and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the sky come and nest in its branches."
33. 耶穌又對他們講了另一個比喻： 「天國好比酵母，一個婦人拿去拌在 三斗 麵裡，直到整團麵都發了酵。」 He told them another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into 50 pounds of flour until it spread through all of it."
34. 耶穌用比喻向人群講了這一切；他向他們講話，沒有不用比喻的。 Jesus told the crowds all these things in parables, and He would not speak anything to them without a parable,
35. 這是為要應驗那藉著先知所說的話： 「我要開口， 用比喻說出創世以來被隱藏的事。」 so that what was spoken through the prophet might be fulfilled: I will open My mouth in parables; I will declare things kept secret from the foundation of the world.
36. 然後，耶穌離開了人群，進了屋子。他的門徒們上前來，說：「請給我們解釋一下田裡稗子的比喻。」 Then He dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples approached Him and said, "Explain the parable of the weeds in the field to us."
37. 耶穌回答說： 「那撒好種子的是人子。 He replied: "The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man;
38. 田地是這世界，這些好種子就是天國的兒女，稗子是那惡者的兒女， the field is the world; and the good seed-- these are the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one, and
39. 撒稗子的仇敵是魔鬼，收割的季節是世代的終結，收割的人是天使。 the enemy who sowed them is the Devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
40. 就像稗子被拔出來用火燒掉，在這世代的終結也將是這樣。 Therefore just as the weeds are gathered and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the age.
41. 人子要差派他的天使們，從他的國度裡挑出來所有絆腳的和作惡 的， The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will gather from His kingdom everything that causes sin and those guilty of lawlessness.
42. 把他們丟進火爐裡。在那裡將有哀哭和切齒。 They will throw them into the blazing furnace where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
43. 那時，義人會在他們父的國度裡像太陽一樣發光。凡是有耳的，就應當聽！ Then the righteous will shine like the sun in their Father's kingdom. Anyone who has ears should listen!
44. 「天國好比被藏在田裡的財寶。有人發現了，就把它再藏起來，然後高高興興地去賣掉他所擁有的一切，買下了那塊地。 "The kingdom of heaven is like treasure, buried in a field, that a man found and reburied. Then in his joy he goes and sells everything he has and buys that field.
45. 「天國又好比一個商人尋找精美的珍珠。 "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
46. 當他發現了一顆極其貴重的珍珠，就去賣掉他所擁有的一切，買下了那顆珍珠。 When he found one priceless pearl, he went and sold everything he had, and bought it.
47. 「天國又好比一張漁網撒在海裡，網到了各種魚類。 "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a large net thrown into the sea. It collected every kind [of fish],
48. 網一滿了，漁夫們就把它拉上岸來，然後坐下，把好的收進筐裡，把壞的丟在外面。 and when it was full, they dragged it ashore, sat down, and gathered the good [fish] into containers, but threw out the worthless ones.
49. 在這世代的終結也將是這樣。天使們要出去，把惡人從義人中分別出來， So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will go out, separate the evil people from the righteous,
50. 丟進火爐裡。在那裡將有哀哭和切齒。」 and throw them into the blazing furnace. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
51. 耶穌問他們 ： 「這一切你們都領悟了嗎？」 他們說：「是的，領悟了 。」 "Have you understood all these things?" "Yes," they told Him.
52. 耶穌對他們說： 「為此，凡是成為天國門徒的經文士，就好比一家的主人，從他的寶庫裡拿出新的和舊的東西來。」 "Therefore," He said to them, "every student of Scripture instructed in the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who brings out of his storeroom what is new and what is old."
53. 當耶穌講完了這些比喻，就離開了那地方。 When Jesus had finished these parables, He left there.
54. 他來到自己的家鄉，在他們的會堂裡教導人，以致他們驚嘆不已，說：「這個人的這種智慧和能力是從哪裡來的呢？ He went to His hometown and began to teach them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, "How did this wisdom and these miracles come to Him?
55. 這不就是那木匠的兒子嗎？他的母親不是叫 瑪麗亞 嗎？他的弟弟們 不是 雅各 、 約西 、 西門 和 猶大 嗎？ Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't His mother called Mary, and His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
56. 他的妹妹們 不是都和我們在一起的嗎？那麼，他這一切是從哪裡來的呢？」 And His sisters, aren't they all with us? So where does He get all these things?"
57. 這樣，他們就對耶穌很反感 。 耶穌對他們說： 「先知除了在本鄉、本家以外，沒有不受尊重的。」 And they were offended by Him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his hometown and in his household."
58. 因為他們的不信，耶穌在那裡就沒有行很多神蹟。 And He did not do many miracles there because of their unbelief.
Matthew 14
1. 那時候，分封王 希律 聽到耶穌的消息， At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the report about Jesus.
2. 就對他的臣僕說：「這個人是施洗者 約翰 從死人中復活了！所以這些能力在他裡面做工。」 "This is John the Baptist!" he told his servants. "He has been raised from the dead, and that's why supernatural powers are at work in him."
3. 原來， 希律 為了他弟弟 菲利普 的妻子 希羅迪婭 的緣故，拘捕了 約翰，把他捆起來關進監獄。 For Herod had arrested John, chained him, and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife,
4. 這是因為 約翰 一直對他說：「你占有這婦人是不可以的。」 since John had been telling him, "It's not lawful for you to have her!"
5. 希律 想要殺 約翰，可是怕民眾，因為他們認為 約翰 是先知。 Though he wanted to kill him, he feared the crowd, since they regarded him as a prophet.
6. 到了 希律 生日的時候， 希羅迪婭 的女兒在眾人面前跳舞，使 希律 非常喜悅， But when Herod's birthday celebration came, Herodias' daughter danced before them and pleased Herod.
7. 故此王就起誓承諾，無論她求什麼都給她。 So he promised with an oath to give her whatever she might ask.
8. 女兒受母親的指使，就說：「請把施洗者 約翰 的頭放在盤子裡給我。」 And prompted by her mother, she answered, "Give me John the Baptist's head here on a platter!"
9. 王就憂憂愁愁，但因所起的誓，又因一同坐席的人，就下令給她。 Although the king regretted it, he commanded that it be granted because of his oaths and his guests.
10. 於是派人去，在監獄裡砍下了 約翰 的頭， So he sent orders and had John beheaded in the prison.
11. 把他的頭放在盤子上，端給女孩，女孩就拿去給她母親。 His head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
12. 後來， 約翰 的門徒們前來把遺體領去埋葬了，又去告訴耶穌。 Then his disciples came, removed the corpse, buried it, and went and reported to Jesus.
13. 耶穌聽了這事，就上船離開那裡，獨自到一個荒僻的地方去。眾人聽到了，就從各城鎮徒步來跟隨他。 When Jesus heard about it, He withdrew from there by boat to a remote place to be alone. When the crowds heard this, they followed Him on foot from the towns.
14. 耶穌下了船，看見一大群人，就對他們動了憐憫之心，使其中的病人痊癒。 As He stepped ashore, He saw a huge crowd, felt compassion for them, and healed their sick.
15. 黃昏的時候，門徒們來到耶穌面前，說：「這是個荒僻的地方，而且天已經晚了。請遣散人群，好讓他們到村莊去為自己買些食物。」 When evening came, the disciples approached Him and said, "This place is a wilderness, and it is already late. Send the crowds away so they can go into the villages and buy food for themselves."
16. 但耶穌說： 「他們不需要離開，你們給他們吃的吧。」 "They don't need to go away," Jesus told them. "You give them something to eat."
17. 門徒們對耶穌說：「我們這裡除了五個餅和兩條魚，就沒有什麼了。」 "But we only have five loaves and two fish here," they said to Him.
18. 耶穌說： 「拿到我這裡來。」 "Bring them here to Me," He said.
19. 於是耶穌吩咐眾人坐在草地上，就拿起這五個餅和兩條魚，抬頭望天，祝福了，然後掰開餅，遞給門徒們，他們又分給眾人。 Then He commanded the crowds to sit down on the grass. He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed them. He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples [gave them] to the crowds.
20. 大家都吃了，並且吃飽了。他們把剩下的碎塊收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。 Everyone ate and was filled. Then they picked up 12 baskets full of leftover pieces!
21. 吃的人，不算婦女和孩子，約有五千。 Now those who ate were about 5,000 men, besides women and children.
22. 耶穌立刻催促門徒們上船，要他們先往對岸去；這期間，他自己遣散了人群。 Immediately He made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.
23. 他遣散了人群以後，就獨自上山去禱告。到了晚上，只有他一個人在那裡。 After dismissing the crowds, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone.
24. 那時，船已經離岸有幾百公尺，由於逆風，被波浪沖擊。 But the boat was already over a mile from land, battered by the waves, because the wind was against them.
25. 天快亮的時候，耶穌在湖 面上行走，向他們而去。 Around three in the morning, He came toward them walking on the sea.
26. 門徒們看見耶穌在湖面上行走，就驚慌不安，說：「是幽靈！」他們害怕得喊叫起來。 When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. "It's a ghost!" they said, and cried out in fear.
27. 耶穌立刻對他們說： 「鼓起勇氣吧！是我，不要怕。」 Immediately Jesus spoke to them. "Have courage! It is I. Don't be afraid."
28. 彼得 對他說：「主啊，如果是你，請吩咐我，從水面上走到你那裡去。」 "Lord, if it's You," Peter answered Him, "command me to come to You on the water."
29. 耶穌說： 「你來吧！」 彼得 就從船上下去，在水面上行走向耶穌那裡去。 "Come!" He said. And climbing out of the boat, Peter started walking on the water and came toward Jesus.
30. 但是，他一看到風極大，就懼怕起來，開始往下沉，於是呼叫說：「主啊，救救我！」 But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid. And beginning to sink he cried out, "Lord, save me!"
31. 耶穌立刻伸手拉住他，說： 「小信的人哪，你為什麼疑惑呢？」 Immediately Jesus reached out His hand, caught hold of him, and said to him, "You of little faith, why did you doubt?"
32. 他們一上船，風就停了。 When they got into the boat, the wind ceased.
33. 船上的人都 拜耶穌，說：「你真是神的兒子！」 Then those in the boat worshiped Him and said, "Truly You are the Son of God!"
34. 他們渡過去，到 革尼撒勒 上岸。 Once they crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret.
35. 那裡的人一認出是耶穌，就派人到周圍整個地區，把所有患病的都帶到耶穌那裡， When the men of that place recognized Him, they alerted the whole vicinity and brought to Him all who were sick.
36. 懇求耶穌只要讓他們摸一下他的衣服穗子。凡是摸著的人，都得了救治。 They were begging Him that they might only touch the tassel on His robe. And as many as touched it were made perfectly well.
Matthew 15
1. 那時，有些 法利賽 人和經文士從 耶路撒冷 來到耶穌那裡，說： Then Pharisees and scribes came from Jerusalem to Jesus and asked,
2. 「你的門徒們為什麼違犯古人的傳統呢？他們吃飯 的時候不洗手！」 "Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? For they don't wash their hands when they eat!"
3. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「你們為什麼為了你們的傳統而違犯神的命令呢？ He answered them, "And why do you break God's commandment because of your tradition?
4. 神吩咐過 『你要孝敬你的父母』， 又說 『咒罵父親或母親的人，必須處死。』 For God said: Honor your father and your mother; and, The one who speaks evil of father or mother must be put to death.
5. 你們卻說『如果有人對父親或母親說：我本該給你的已經做了聖殿奉獻， But you say, 'Whoever tells his father or mother, "Whatever benefit you might have received from me is a gift [committed to the temple]"--
6. 他就可以完全不孝敬父母 。』這樣，為了你們的傳統，你們就廢棄了神的話語 。 he does not have to honor his father.' In this way, you have revoked God's word because of your tradition.
7. 你們這些偽善的人哪！ 以賽亞 指著你們所說的預言是對的，他說： Hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you when he said:
8. 『這子民 用嘴唇尊重我， 他們的心卻遠離我。 These people honor Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me.
9. 他們敬拜我也是徒然的， 因為他們把人的規條當做教義教導人 。』 」 They worship Me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commands of men."
10. 耶穌召來眾人，對他們說： 「你們當聽，也當領悟： Summoning the crowd, He told them, "Listen and understand:
11. 不是進到口裡的使人汙穢；而是從口裡出來的，這才使人汙穢。」 It's not what goes into the mouth that defiles a man, but what comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man."
12. 那時，門徒們前來對他說：「 法利賽 人聽了這話很反感，你知道嗎？」 Then the disciples came up and told Him, "Do You know that the Pharisees took offense when they heard this statement?"
13. 耶穌回答說： 「凡不是我天父所栽種的，都將被連根拔起。 He replied, "Every plant that My heavenly Father didn't plant will be uprooted.
14. 隨他們吧！他們是給瞎子領路的瞎子 。如果瞎子給瞎子領路，兩個人都會掉進坑裡。」 Leave them alone! They are blind guides. And if the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit."
15. 彼得 對耶穌說：「請把這個比喻解釋給我們聽。」 Then Peter replied to Him, "Explain this parable to us."
16. 耶穌說： 「到如今，你們也無知嗎？ "Are even you still lacking in understanding?" He asked.
17. 你們難道不明白：一切進入口裡的，要進到肚子，然後被排到廁所； "Don't you realize that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach and is eliminated?
18. 而從口裡出來的，是由心裡發出的，這些才使人汙穢。 But what comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this defiles a man.
19. 因為從心裡發出種種惡念：殺人、通姦、淫亂、偷竊、做偽證、毀謗， For from the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual immoralities, thefts, false testimonies, blasphemies.
20. 這些才會使人汙穢；而不洗手就吃飯，不會使人汙穢。」 These are the things that defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile a man."
21. 耶穌離開那地方，退到 提爾 和 西頓 地區。 When Jesus left there, He withdrew to the area of Tyre and Sidon.
22. 這時候，忽然來了一個住在那地區的 迦南 婦人，她呼叫說：「主啊， 大衛 的後裔，可憐我吧！我的女兒有鬼魔附身，痛苦萬分。」 Just then a Canaanite woman from that region came and kept crying out, "Have mercy on me, Lord, Son of David! My daughter is cruelly tormented by a demon."
23. 耶穌一句話也不回應，他的門徒們上前來求他，說：「這婦人一直跟在我們後面喊叫，請讓她走吧。」 Yet He did not say a word to her. So His disciples approached Him and urged Him, "Send her away because she cries out after us."
24. 耶穌回答說： 「我奉差派，只到 以色列 家迷失的羊那裡去。」 He replied, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."
25. 那婦人來拜他，說：「主啊，求你幫助我！」 But she came, knelt before Him, and said, "Lord, help me!"
26. 耶穌回答說： 「拿兒女的餅扔給小狗，是不合宜的。」 He answered, "It isn't right to take the children's bread and throw it to their dogs."
27. 婦人說：「是的，主啊！不過連小狗也吃得到主人桌子上掉下來的碎渣！」 "Yes, Lord," she said, "yet even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table!"
28. 於是耶穌回答她，說： 「哦，婦人哪，你這信心 是大的！照你所願的，給你成全吧。」 從那一刻起，她的女兒就痊癒了。 Then Jesus replied to her, "Woman, your faith is great. Let it be done for you as you want." And from that moment her daughter was cured.
29. 耶穌離開那地方，來到 加利利 湖 邊，上了山坐在那裡。 Moving on from there, Jesus passed along the Sea of Galilee. He went up on a mountain and sat there,
30. 有一大群人來到他面前，帶著瘸腿的、瞎眼的、殘疾的、聾啞的還有許多其他人，把他們放在耶穌腳前；耶穌就使他們痊癒了。 and large crowds came to Him, having with them the lame, the blind, the deformed, those unable to speak, and many others. They put them at His feet, and He healed them.
31. 結果眾人看見聾啞的說話，殘疾的康復，瘸腿的行走，瞎眼的看見，都感到驚奇，就榮耀 以色列 的神。 So the crowd was amazed when they saw those unable to speak talking, the deformed restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they gave glory to the God of Israel.
32. 耶穌召來他的門徒們，說： 「我憐憫這群人，因為他們與我在一起已經三天了，也沒有什麼東西吃。我不願意讓他們餓著肚子回去，恐怕他們在路上暈倒。」 Now Jesus summoned His disciples and said, "I have compassion on the crowd, because they've already stayed with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry; otherwise they might collapse on the way."
33. 門徒們說：「我們在曠野，從哪裡得這麼多的食物讓這麼大一群人吃飽呢？」 The disciples said to Him, "Where could we get enough bread in this desolate place to fill such a crowd?"
34. 耶穌問他們： 「你們有多少餅？」 他們回答說：「七個，還有幾條小魚。」 "How many loaves do you have?" Jesus asked them. "Seven," they said, "and a few small fish."
35. 耶穌就吩咐眾人坐在地上， After commanding the crowd to sit down on the ground,
36. 於是拿起這七個餅和幾條小魚，祝謝以後，掰開，不斷遞給門徒們，他們又分給眾人。 He took the seven loaves and the fish, and He gave thanks, broke them, and kept on giving them to the disciples, and the disciples [gave them] to the crowds.
37. 大家都吃了，並且吃飽了。然後，他們把剩下的碎塊收拾起來，裝滿了七個筐子。 They all ate and were filled. Then they collected the leftover pieces-- seven large baskets full.
38. 吃的人，不算婦女和孩子，就有四千。 Now those who ate were 4,000 men, besides women and children.
39. 耶穌遣散了人群以後，就上了船，來到 茉加丹 地區。 After dismissing the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
Matthew 16
1. 有些 法利賽 人和 撒都該 人前來試探耶穌，要求他把一個從天上來的神蹟顯給他們看。 The Pharisees and Sadducees approached, and as a test, asked Him to show them a sign from heaven.
