2. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「黃昏的時候你們說：『天要晴了，因為天色通紅』； He answered them: "When evening comes you say, 'It will be good weather because the sky is red.'
3. 清晨的時候你們說：『今天會有風雨，因為天色通紅又變得陰沉。』 你們能分辨天象，卻不能分辨時代的徵兆。 And in the morning, 'Today will be stormy because the sky is red and threatening.' You know how to read the appearance of the sky, but you can't read the signs of the times.
4. 一個邪惡、淫亂的世代會尋求神蹟，可是除了 約拿 的神蹟以外，不會有神蹟賜給它了。」 然後耶穌就離開他們走了。 An evil and adulterous generation wants a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah." Then He left them and went away.
5. 門徒們到了對岸，忘了帶餅。 The disciples reached the other shore, and they had forgotten to take bread.
6. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們要注意，要提防 法利賽 人和 撒都該 人的酵母。」 Then Jesus told them, "Watch out and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
7. 門徒們就彼此討論說：「這是因為我們沒有帶餅吧。」 And they discussed among themselves, "We didn't bring any bread."
8. 耶穌知道了，就說： 「小信的人哪，你們為什麼彼此討論沒有帶 餅的事呢？ Aware of this, Jesus said, "You of little faith! Why are you discussing among yourselves that you do not have bread?
9. 你們還不明白嗎？難道不記得那五個餅給五千人，你們收拾了幾個籃子的碎塊 嗎？ Don't you understand yet? Don't you remember the five loaves for the 5,000 and how many baskets you collected?
10. 也不記得那七個餅給四千人，你們收拾了幾個筐子的碎塊 嗎？ Or the seven loaves for the 4,000 and how many large baskets you collected?
11. 你們怎麼不明白，我對你們說的不是餅的事，而是要你們提防 法利賽 人和 撒都該 人的酵母呢？」 Why is it you don't understand that when I told you, 'Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees,' it wasn't about bread?"
12. 門徒們這才領悟耶穌所說的不是要他們提防餅的酵母，而是要他們提防 法利賽 人和 撒都該 人的教導。 Then they understood that He did not tell them to beware of the yeast in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
13. 耶穌來到 凱撒里亞菲利彼 地區，就問他的門徒們，說： 「人們說 人子是誰？」 When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He asked His disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?"
14. 他們回答說：「有的說是施洗者 約翰，有的說是 以利亞，另有的說是 耶利米 或是先知中的一位。」 And they said, "Some say John the Baptist; others, Elijah; still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
15. 耶穌問他們： 「那麼你們呢？你們說我是誰？」 "But you," He asked them, "who do you say that I am?"
16. 西門彼得 回答說：「你是基督，是永生神的兒子！」 Simon Peter answered, "You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God!"
17. 耶穌對他說： 「 約拿 的兒子 西門，你是蒙福的，因為這不是任何人 啟示你的，而是我在天上的父啟示你的。 And Jesus responded, "Simon son of Jonah, you are blessed because flesh and blood did not reveal this to you, but My Father in heaven.
18. 我還告訴你：你是 彼得，我要在這磐石上建立我的教會，陰間的門 不能勝過它。 And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the forces of Hades will not overpower it.
19. 我要把天國的鑰匙賜給你，你在地上所捆綁的，在天上將是已經被捆綁了的；你在地上所釋放的，在天上將是被釋放了的。」 I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you bind on earth is already bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth is already loosed in heaven."
20. 接著耶穌吩咐門徒們，不要對任何人說他就是基督。 And He gave the disciples orders to tell no one that He was the Messiah.
21. 從那時候起，耶穌開始向他的門徒們指示他必須到 耶路撒冷 去，經受長老們、祭司長們和經文士們的很多苦害，並且被殺，然後在第三天要復活。 From then on Jesus began to point out to His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, be killed, and be raised the third day.
22. 彼得 把耶穌拉到一邊，開始勸阻他，說：「主啊，千萬不可，這事絕不能臨到你身上。」 Then Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, "Oh no, Lord! This will never happen to You!"
23. 但耶穌轉身對 彼得 說： 「 撒旦，退到我後面去！你是我的絆腳石，因為你不是思想神的事，而是思想人的事。」 But He turned and told Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan! You are an offense to Me because you're not thinking about God's concerns, but man's."
24. 於是，耶穌對他的門徒們說： 「如果有人想要來跟從我，他就當捨棄自己，背起自己的十字架，然後跟從我。 Then Jesus said to His disciples, "If anyone wants to come with Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.
25. 因為凡想要保全 自己生命的，將失去生命；凡為我的緣故失去自己生命的，將尋得生命。 For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of Me will find it.
26. 一個人就是賺得了全世界，卻賠上了自己的生命，到底有什麼益處呢？人還能拿什麼來換回自己的生命呢？ What will it benefit a man if he gains the whole world yet loses his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
27. 人子將要在他父的榮耀中，與他的天使們一起來臨。那時候，他要按照各人的所作所為回報每個人。 For the Son of Man is going to come with His angels in the glory of His Father, and then He will reward each according to what he has done.
28. 我確實地告訴你們：站在這裡的有些人，在還沒有嘗到死的滋味之前，必定見到人子在他的國度中來臨。」 I assure you: There are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom."
Matthew 17
1. 過了六天，耶穌帶著 彼得 、 雅各 和 雅各 的弟弟 約翰，領他們悄悄地上了一座高山。 After six days Jesus took Peter, James, and his brother John, and led them up on a high mountain by themselves.
2. 在他們面前，耶穌變了形像，臉面光耀如日，衣服潔白如光。 He was transformed in front of them, and His face shone like the sun. Even His clothes became as white as the light.
3. 這時候，忽然 摩西 和 以利亞 向他們顯現，與耶穌談話。 Suddenly, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Him.
4. 彼得 對耶穌說：「主啊，我們在這裡真好！如果你願意，我就在這裡搭 三座帳幕，一座為你，一座為 摩西，一座為 以利亞 。」 Then Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it's good for us to be here! If You want, I will make three tabernacles here: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
5. 彼得 還在說話的時候，忽然有一朵燦爛的雲彩籠罩了他們，看哪，有聲音從雲中出來，說： 「這是我的愛子， 我所喜悅的。 你們當聽從他！」 While he was still speaking, suddenly a bright cloud covered them, and a voice from the cloud said: This is My beloved Son. I take delight in Him. Listen to Him!
6. 門徒們聽見了，就把臉伏在地上，極其懼怕。 When the disciples heard it, they fell facedown and were terrified.
7. 耶穌前來，拍拍他們說： 「起來，不要怕！」 Then Jesus came up, touched them, and said, "Get up; don't be afraid."
8. 他們抬頭一看，只看見耶穌一個人，沒有別人。 When they looked up they saw no one except Him-- Jesus alone.
9. 他們下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們： 「人子從死人中復活以前，不要把這異象告訴任何人。」 As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, "Don't tell anyone about the vision until the Son of Man is raised from the dead."
10. 門徒們問耶穌，說：「那麼，經文士們為什麼說 以利亞 必須先來呢？」 So the disciples questioned Him, "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
11. 耶穌回答說： 「 以利亞 確實要來，並且要恢復萬事。 "Elijah is coming and will restore everything," He replied.
12. 但是我告訴你們： 以利亞 已經來了，人們卻不認他，反而任意對待他；照樣，人子也將受到他們的苦害。」 "But I tell you: Elijah has already come, and they didn't recognize him. On the contrary, they did whatever they pleased to him. In the same way the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands."
13. 門徒們這才領悟，耶穌向他們說的是指施洗者 約翰 。 Then the disciples understood that He spoke to them about John the Baptist.
14. 他們來到眾人那裡，有一個人來到耶穌面前，跪下來， When they reached the crowd, a man approached and knelt down before Him.
15. 說：「主啊，可憐我的兒子吧！他患了癲癇病，十分痛苦，經常跌進火裡，也經常跌進水裡。 "Lord," he said, "have mercy on my son, because he has seizures and suffers severely. He often falls into the fire and often into the water.
16. 我帶他到你的門徒們那裡，可是他們不能使他痊癒。」 I brought him to Your disciples, but they couldn't heal him."
17. 耶穌回答說： 「唉，這個不信、歪曲的世代！我還要與你們在一起多久呢？我還要容忍你們多久呢？把孩子帶到我這裡來吧！」 Jesus replied, "You unbelieving and rebellious generation! How long will I be with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring him here to Me."
18. 耶穌斥責那鬼魔，鬼魔就從孩子身上出來；從那一刻起，孩子就痊癒了。 Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of him, and from that moment the boy was healed.
19. 門徒們悄悄地前來問耶穌：「我們為什麼不能趕出那鬼魔呢？」 Then the disciples approached Jesus privately and said, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"
20. 耶穌回答說： 「因為你們小信。我確實地告訴你們：如果你們有像一粒芥菜種子那樣的信仰，就是對這座山說『從這裡移到那裡！』它也將移開；而且在你們，將沒有不可能的事。 "Because of your little faith," He told them. "For I assure you: If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.
21. 不過對這一類的鬼魔，如果不藉著禱告和禁食，它就不出來。 」 [[However, this kind does not come out except by prayer and fasting.]]"
22. 他們聚集在 加利利 的時候，耶穌對門徒們說： 「人子將要被交在 人的手中。 As they were meeting in Galilee, Jesus told them, "The Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men.
23. 他們要殺害他，然後在第三天，他要復活。」 門徒們就極其憂傷。 They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised up." And they were deeply distressed.
24. 他們來到 迦百農，那些收聖殿稅 的人來到 彼得 那裡，說：「你們的老師不納聖殿稅嗎？」 When they came to Capernaum, those who collected the double-drachma tax approached Peter and said, "Doesn't your Teacher pay the double-drachma tax?"
25. 彼得 說：「當然納。」 彼得 進了屋子，耶穌先問他： 「 西門，這件事你怎麼看？地上的眾君王向誰徵收關稅和丁稅呢？向自己的兒女，還是向外人呢？」 "Yes," he said. When he went into the house, Jesus spoke to him first, "What do you think, Simon? Who do earthly kings collect tariffs or taxes from? From their sons or from strangers?"
26. 彼得 回答說：「向外人。」 耶穌說： 「因此兒女可以免了。 "From strangers," he said. "Then the sons are free," Jesus told him.
27. 但為了不絆倒他們，你到湖 邊去投下魚鉤，拿起釣上來的第一條魚，打開魚的嘴，會發現一個大銀幣 。你就把它拿去，為我和你交給他們吧。」 "But, so we won't offend them, go to the sea, cast in a fishhook, and catch the first fish that comes up. When you open its mouth you'll find a coin. Take it and give it to them for Me and you."
Matthew 18
1. 那時，門徒們前來問耶穌：「在天國裡究竟誰更大？」 At that time the disciples came to Jesus and said, "Who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"
2. 耶穌叫來一個小孩子，讓他站在他們當中， Then He called a child to Him and had him stand among them.
3. 說： 「我確實地告訴你們：你們如果不回轉，變得像小孩子一樣，絕不能進入天國。 "I assure you," He said, "unless you are converted and become like children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
4. 所以，誰像這小孩子自我降卑，誰在天國裡就更大。 Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this child-- this one is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
5. 無論誰奉我的名接受這樣一個小孩子，就是接受我。 And whoever welcomes one child like this in My name welcomes Me.
6. 「但無論誰使信我的這些卑微人中的一個絆倒，對那人來說，倒不如脖子上被拴上大磨石，沉到深海裡。 "But whoever causes the downfall of one of these little ones who believe in Me-- it would be better for him if a heavy millstone were hung around his neck and he were drowned in the depths of the sea!
7. 這世界有禍了，因為有使人絆腳的事；要知道，那些使人絆腳的事必然出現，不過使它出現的人有禍了。 Woe to the world because of offenses. For offenses must come, but woe to that man by whom the offense comes.
8. 如果你的一隻手或一隻腳使你絆倒，就把它砍下來丟掉！對你來說，缺一隻手或缺一隻腳進入永生，要比手腳雙全被丟進永遠的火裡好多了。 If your hand or your foot causes your downfall, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life maimed or lame, than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
9. 如果你的一隻眼使你絆倒，就把它剜出來丟掉！對你來說，缺一隻眼進入永生，要比雙眼齊全被丟進烈火的地獄裡好多了。 And if your eye causes your downfall, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye, rather than to have two eyes and be thrown into hellfire!
10. 「你們要注意，不可輕視這些卑微人中的一個。我告訴你們：他們的天使在天上常常看見我天父的面。 "See that you don't look down on one of these little ones, because I tell you that in heaven their angels continually view the face of My Father in heaven.
11. 要知道人子來，是為了拯救迷失的人。 [[For the Son of Man has come to save the lost.]]
12. 你們怎麼看以下的事？如果一個人有一百隻羊，其中一隻迷失了，難道他不把九十九隻留在山上，去尋找那一隻迷失的嗎？ What do you think? If a man has 100 sheep, and one of them goes astray, won't he leave the 99 on the hillside and go and search for the stray?
13. 如果找到了，我確實地告訴你們：他為這一隻羊歡喜，會比為那九十九隻沒有迷失的羊更歡喜。 And if he finds it, I assure you: He rejoices over that sheep more than over the 99 that did not go astray.
14. 照樣，你們 在天上的父也不願意失去這些卑微人中的一個。 In the same way, it is not the will of your Father in heaven that one of these little ones perish.
15. 「如果你的弟兄對你 犯了罪，你就要去，只在你和他之間責備他。如果他聽你的，你就贏得了你的弟兄； "If your brother sins against you, go and rebuke him in private. If he listens to you, you have won your brother.
16. 如果他不聽，你就另外帶一個或兩個人一起去，為要使 「任何事，憑兩個或三個見證人的口，才能成立。」 But if he won't listen, take one or two more with you, so that by the testimony of two or three witnesses every fact may be established.
17. 如果他不聽他們的，就告訴教會；如果他連教會也不聽，就應當把他看做像外邦人或稅吏一樣。 If he pays no attention to them, tell the church. But if he doesn't pay attention even to the church, let him be like an unbeliever and a tax collector to you.
18. 我確實地告訴你們：你們在地上所捆綁的，在天上將是已經被捆綁了的；你們在地上所釋放的，在天上將是被釋放了的。 I assure you: Whatever you bind on earth is already bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth is already loosed in heaven.
19. 我再確實地告訴你們：如果你們當中有兩個人，在地上同心地為任何事祈求，我在天上的父就會為你們成全； Again, I assure you: If two of you on earth agree about any matter that you pray for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
20. 因為哪裡有兩三個人奉我的名聚集，我就在哪裡，在他們當中。」 For where two or three are gathered together in My name, I am there among them."
21. 那時， 彼得 前來問耶穌：「主啊，如果弟兄對我犯罪，我該饒恕多少次呢？到七次可以嗎？」 Then Peter came to Him and said, "Lord, how many times could my brother sin against me and I forgive him? As many as seven times?"
22. 耶穌對他說： 「我告訴你：不是七次，而是七十個七次 。 "I tell you, not as many as seven," Jesus said to him, "but 70 times seven.
23. 為此，天國就好比一個君王，要與他的奴僕們清算帳目。 For this reason, the kingdom of heaven can be compared to a king who wanted to settle accounts with his slaves.
24. 他開始算的時候，一個欠了一千萬兩銀子 的奴僕被帶到他面前。 When he began to settle accounts, one who owed 10,000 talents was brought before him.
25. 因為那奴僕沒有可償還的，主人就下令把他和他的妻子兒女，以及他所擁有的一切都賣掉來償還。 Since he had no way to pay it back, his master commanded that he, his wife, his children, and everything he had be sold to pay the debt.
26. 「那奴僕就俯伏拜他，說：『 請寬容我吧，將來我會把一切償還給你。』 "At this, the slave fell facedown before him and said, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you everything!'
27. 那奴僕的主人動了憐憫之心，把他釋放了，並且免了他的債。 Then the master of that slave had compassion, released him, and forgave him the loan.
28. 「但那奴僕出去以後，遇見一個與他同做奴僕的；這人欠他一百個銀幣 。他就抓住這人，掐住這人的喉嚨，說：『把欠我的還給我。』 "But that slave went out and found one of his fellow slaves who owed him 100 denarii. He grabbed him, started choking him, and said, 'Pay what you owe!'
29. 「這人就俯伏在地 央求他，說：『請寬容我吧，我會還給你的。』 "At this, his fellow slave fell down and began begging him, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you back.'
30. 可是他不肯，反而把這人投進監獄，直到這人能還清所欠的債。 But he wasn't willing. On the contrary, he went and threw him into prison until he could pay what was owed.
31. 那些與他同做奴僕的看見所發生的事，就極其憂傷，去把一切都告訴他們的主人。 When the other slaves saw what had taken place, they were deeply distressed and went and reported to their master everything that had happened.
32. 「於是主人把那奴僕叫來，對他說：『你這惡奴！因為你求我，我就免了你所有的債。 "Then, after he had summoned him, his master said to him, 'You wicked slave! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
33. 難道你不也該憐憫與你同做奴僕的，像我憐憫了你一樣嗎？』 Shouldn't you also have had mercy on your fellow slave, as I had mercy on you?'
34. 主人就發怒，把他交給掌刑官，直到他能還清所欠的一切債。 And his master got angry and handed him over to the jailers until he could pay everything that was owed.
35. 如果你們每個人不從心裡饒恕自己的弟兄，我的天父也會照樣對待你們。」 So My heavenly Father will also do to you if each of you does not forgive his brother from his heart."
Matthew 19
1. 當耶穌講完了這些話，就離開 加利利，來到 約旦 河對岸的 猶太 地區。 When Jesus had finished this instruction, He departed from Galilee and went to the region of Judea across the Jordan.
2. 有一大群人跟隨他，他就在那裡使他們痊癒。 Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
3. 有些 法利賽 人前來試探耶穌，說：「無論出於什麼緣故，人是否可以休妻呢？」 Some Pharisees approached Him to test Him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife on any grounds?"
4. 耶穌回答說： 「你們難道沒有讀過嗎？造物主從起初就 把人造成男的和女的 。 "Haven't you read," He replied, "that He who created them in the beginning made them male and female,
5. 並且說： 『為這緣故，人將離開父母， 與妻子結合， 兩個人就成為一體。』 and He also said: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh?
6. 這樣，夫妻不再是兩個人，而是一體了。因此，神所配合的，人不可分開。」 So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, man must not separate."
7. 他們問耶穌：「那麼，為什麼 摩西 吩咐說，給一份休書，就可以休妻呢？」 "Why then," they asked Him, "did Moses command [us] to give divorce papers and to send her away?"
8. 耶穌對他們說： 「 摩西 因著你們的心裡剛硬，才准許你們休妻，但並不是從起初就這樣的。 He told them, "Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of the hardness of your hearts. But it was not like that from the beginning.
9. 我告訴你們：如果有人不是由於淫亂的緣故而休妻，另娶別人，就是犯通姦罪。 」 And I tell you, whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery."
10. 他的門徒們對耶穌說：「如果丈夫與妻子的關係是這樣，結婚就沒有益處了。」 His disciples said to Him, "If the relationship of a man with his wife is like this, it's better not to marry!"
11. 耶穌就對他們說： 「這話不是所有人都能接受的，只有誰被賜予了， 誰才能接受： But He told them, "Not everyone can accept this saying, but only those it has been given to.
12. 就是說，有些獨身者 是生來 如此的；有些獨身者是別人使他們成為獨身的 ；還有些獨身者是為了天國的緣故自己成為獨身的。誰能接受，就接受吧。」 For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother's womb, there are eunuchs who were made by men, and there are eunuchs who have made themselves that way because of the kingdom of heaven. Let anyone accept this who can."
13. 那時，有一些小孩子被帶到耶穌那裡，好讓耶穌按手在他們身上，給他們禱告。門徒們卻責備那些人。 Then children were brought to Him so He might put His hands on them and pray. But the disciples rebuked them.
14. 耶穌就說： 「讓小孩子到我這裡來，不要阻止他們，因為天國正屬於這樣的人。」 Then Jesus said, "Leave the children alone, and don't try to keep them from coming to Me, because the kingdom of heaven is made up of people like this."
15. 於是，耶穌按手在他們身上，然後離開那地方。 After putting His hands on them, He went on from there.
16. 看哪，有一個人上前來對耶穌說：「老師，我該做什麼良善的事，才能得到永恆的生命呢？」 Just then someone came up and asked Him, "Teacher, what good must I do to have eternal life?"
17. 耶穌對他說： 「你為什麼問我有關良善的事呢？只有一位是良善的 。如果你想進入永生，就應該遵守誡命。」 "Why do you ask Me about what is good?" He said to him. "There is only One who is good. If you want to enter into life, keep the commandments."
18. 那個人就問：「哪些誡命呢？」 耶穌回答說： 「不可殺人、 不可通姦、 不可偷竊、 不可做偽證、 "Which ones?" he asked Him. Jesus answered, Do not murder; do not commit adultery; do not steal; do not bear false witness;
19. 要孝敬父母、 要愛鄰如己。」 honor your father and your mother; and love your neighbor as yourself.
20. 那年輕人對耶穌說：「這一切 我都遵守了，我還缺少什麼呢？」 "I have kept all these," the young man told Him. "What do I still lack?"
21. 耶穌對他說： 「如果你想要成為完全的，就當去賣掉你所擁有的，分給窮人，這樣你將有財寶在天上；然後你來跟從我。」 "If you want to be perfect," Jesus said to him, "go, sell your belongings and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me."
22. 那年輕人聽了這話，就憂憂愁愁地走開了，因為他有很多財產。 When the young man heard that command, he went away grieving, because he had many possessions.
23. 耶穌對他的門徒們說： 「我確實地告訴你們：富有的人進入天國會很困難。 Then Jesus said to His disciples, "I assure you: It will be hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven!
24. 我再告訴你們：駱駝穿過針眼，比富有的人進入神的國更容易呢！」 Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."
25. 門徒們聽了這話，極其驚訝，就說：「究竟誰能得救呢？」 When the disciples heard this, they were utterly astonished and asked, "Then who can be saved?"
26. 耶穌注視著他們，說： 「在人，這是不可能的；但是在神，凡事都可能。」 But Jesus looked at them and said, "With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."
27. 這時候， 彼得 對耶穌說：「看，我們捨棄一切跟從了你，我們將來究竟會怎麼樣呢？」 Then Peter responded to Him, "Look, we have left everything and followed You. So what will there be for us?"
28. 耶穌對他們說： 「我確實地告訴你們：在新的世界裡，當人子坐在他榮耀寶座上的時候，你們這些跟從我的人也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判 以色列 的十二個支派。 Jesus said to them, "I assure you: In the Messianic Age, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on 12 thrones, judging the 12 tribes of Israel.
29. 凡是為我名的緣故而捨棄房屋，或兄弟，或姐妹，或父親，或母親， 或兒女，或田產的人，都將得到百倍，並且繼承永恆的生命。 And everyone who has left houses, brothers or sisters, father or mother, children, or fields because of My name will receive 100 times more and will inherit eternal life.
30. 不過許多在前的，將要在後；許多在後的，將要在前。 But many who are first will be last, and the last first.
Matthew 20
1. 「天國好比一家的主人，一大早出去雇人到他的葡萄園工作。 "For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
2. 他與工人彼此說好一天一個銀幣，就派他們進他的葡萄園去。 After agreeing with the workers on one denarius for the day, he sent them into his vineyard.
3. 大約上午九點，他又出去，看見還有人閒站在街市上， When he went out about nine in the morning, he saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
4. 就對他們說：『你們也進葡萄園去吧，理當給的，我會給你們。』 To those men he said, 'You also go to my vineyard, and I'll give you whatever is right.' So off they went.
5. 他們就去了。大約中午十二點 和下午三點，主人又出去，也是這麼做。 About noon and at three, he went out again and did the same thing.
6. 下午五點 左右，他出去看見還有人站著，就問他們：『你們為什麼整天閒站在這裡呢？』 Then about five he went and found others standing around, and said to them, 'Why have you been standing here all day doing nothing?'
7. 「他們回答說：『因為沒有人雇用我們。』 「他就說：『你們也進葡萄園去吧。 』 " 'Because no one hired us,' they said to him. " 'You also go to my vineyard,' he told them.
8. 到了傍晚，葡萄園的主人對管事的說：『把工人叫來，發給他們工錢，從最後來的開始，到最先來的為止。』 When evening came, the owner of the vineyard told his foreman, 'Call the workers and give them their pay, starting with the last and ending with the first.'
9. 「那些下午五點 左右被雇 的人來了，每人領了一個銀幣。 "When those who were hired about five came, they each received one denarius.
10. 那些最先被雇 的人也來了，以為會得到更多，可是他們每人也只領到一個銀幣。 So when the first ones came, they assumed they would get more, but they also received a denarius each.
11. 他們拿到錢以後，就對那家的主人抱怨， When they received it, they began to complain to the landowner:
12. 說：『這些最後來的人只工作了一個小時，而我們經受了一天的勞累和炎熱，你卻把他們和我們同等看待！』 'These last men put in one hour, and you made them equal to us who bore the burden of the day and the burning heat!'
13. 「主人回答他們其中的一個人，說：『朋友，我並沒有虧負你。我們不是彼此說好了一個銀幣嗎？ "He replied to one of them, 'Friend, I'm doing you no wrong. Didn't you agree with me on a denarius?
14. 你拿自己的走吧！我願意給那最後來的，就像我也給你一樣。 Take what's yours and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.
15. 難道我不可以用我的東西，做我願意做的事嗎？還是因為我好心，你就嫉妒了嗎 ？』 Don't I have the right to do what I want with my business? Are you jealous because I'm generous?'
16. 「這樣，那些在後的，將要在前；那些在前的，將要在後。 」 "So the last will be first, and the first last."
17. 耶穌上 耶路撒冷 去的時候，在路上單獨把十二個門徒帶到一邊，對他們說： While going up to Jerusalem, Jesus took the 12 disciples aside privately and said to them on the way:
18. 「看，我們現在上 耶路撒冷 去，人子將被出賣給祭司長們和經文士們。他們要定他死罪， "Listen! We are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn Him to death.
19. 並且要把他交給外邦人去戲弄、鞭打、釘上十字架；然後在第三天，他要復活。」 Then they will hand Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked, flogged, and crucified, and He will be resurrected on the third day."
20. 那時， 西庇太 兒子的母親帶著她的兩個兒子上前來拜耶穌，向他求一件事。 Then the mother of Zebedee's sons approached Him with her sons. She knelt down to ask Him for something.
21. 耶穌問她： 「你要什麼呢？」 她說：「請准許我這兩個兒子，在你的國裡，一個坐在你的右邊，一個坐在你的左邊。」 "What do you want?" He asked her. "Promise," she said to Him, "that these two sons of mine may sit, one on Your right and the other on Your left, in Your kingdom."
22. 耶穌就回答說： 「你們不知道自己在求什麼。我將要喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？ 」 他們說：「我們能。」 But Jesus answered, "You don't know what you're asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?" "We are able," they said to Him.
23. 耶穌對他們說： 「我的杯你們固然要喝，但坐在我的右邊或左邊，不是我所賜的，而是我父已經預備給誰，就賜給誰。」 He told them, "You will indeed drink My cup. But to sit at My right and left is not Mine to give; instead, it belongs to those for whom it has been prepared by My Father."
24. 其他十個使徒聽了，就對這兄弟兩個人很不滿。 When the 10 [disciples] heard this, they became indignant with the two brothers.
25. 於是耶穌把他們召來，說： 「你們知道，外邦人有首領壓制他們，也有為大的管轄他們。 But Jesus called them over and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles dominate them, and the men of high position exercise power over them.
26. 你們當中卻不是這樣；相反，誰想在你們當中為大，誰就該做你們的僕人； It must not be like that among you. On the contrary, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
27. 無論誰想在你們當中為首，誰就該做你們的奴僕， and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave;
28. 就像人子來不是為了受人的服事，而是為了服事人，並且獻上自己的生命，替許多人做救贖的代價。」 just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life-- a ransom for many."
29. 他們離開 耶利哥 的時候，有一大群人跟隨耶穌。 As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
30. 這時候有兩個瞎眼的坐在路邊，他們聽說是耶穌經過那裡，就呼叫說：「主啊， 大衛 的後裔，可憐我們吧！」 There were two blind men sitting by the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, "Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!"
31. 眾人責備他們，叫他們不要做聲。可是他們越發呼叫說：「主啊， 大衛 的後裔，可憐我們吧！」 The crowd told them to keep quiet, but they cried out all the more, "Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!"
32. 耶穌就停住，叫他們過來，說： 「你們要我為你們做什麼呢？」 Jesus stopped, called them, and said, "What do you want Me to do for you?"
33. 他們說：「主啊，願你開我們的眼睛。」 "Lord," they said to Him, "open our eyes!"
34. 耶穌動了憐憫之心，摸了他們的眼睛。他們立刻重見光明，於是跟隨了耶穌。 Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes. Immediately they could see, and they followed Him.
Matthew 21
1. 當耶穌和門徒們臨近 耶路撒冷，來到 橄欖山 附近的 伯法其 的時候，耶穌派了兩個門徒， When they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage at the Mount of Olives, Jesus then sent two disciples,
2. 對他們說： 「你們到對面的村子裡去，會立刻發現一頭驢拴在那裡，還有一頭驢駒與牠在一起。把牠們解開，牽來給我。 telling them, "Go into the village ahead of you. At once you will find a donkey tied there, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to Me.
3. 如果有人對你們說什麼，你們就說『主需要牠們，會很快把牠們送來的。』」 If anyone says anything to you, you should say that the Lord needs them, and immediately he will send them."
4. 這件事發生，是為要應驗那藉著先知所說的話： This took place so that what was spoken through the prophet might be fulfilled:
5. 「要對 錫安 的女兒說 『看哪，你的王來到你這裡， 是謙和的，騎著驢—— 一頭小驢， 就是驢的駒子。』」 Tell Daughter Zion, "See, your King is coming to you, gentle, and mounted on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a beast of burden."
6. 兩個門徒就去，照著耶穌所吩咐的做了。 The disciples went and did just as Jesus directed them.
7. 他們牽來了驢和驢駒，把外衣搭在牠們背上，耶穌就坐在上面。 They brought the donkey and the colt; then they laid their robes on them, and He sat on them.
8. 有一大群人把自己的外衣鋪在路上，也有人從樹上砍下枝子鋪在路上。 A very large crowd spread their robes on the road; others were cutting branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
9. 前行後隨的人群呼喊說： 「 和散那 歸於 大衛 的後裔！ 奉主名而來的那一位—— 是蒙祝福的！ 在至高之處—— 和散那！ 」 Then the crowds who went ahead of Him and those who followed kept shouting: Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest heaven!
10. 耶穌進了 耶路撒冷，全城都轟動了，人們問：「這個人是誰？」 When He entered Jerusalem, the whole city was shaken, saying, "Who is this?"
11. 眾人說：「這就是從 加利利 的 拿撒勒 來的先知耶穌。」 And the crowds kept saying, "This is the prophet Jesus from Nazareth in Galilee!"
12. 耶穌進了 聖殿，把所有在聖殿裡做買賣的人都趕了出去。他推翻了兌換銀幣之人的桌子和賣鴿子之人的凳子， Jesus went into the temple complex and drove out all those buying and selling in the temple. He overturned the money changers' tables and the chairs of those selling doves.
13. 對他們說： 「經上記著： 『我的殿將被稱為禱告的殿』，而你們卻使它成為 賊窩 了！」 And He said to them, "It is written, My house will be called a house of prayer. But you are making it a den of thieves!"
14. 耶穌在聖殿裡，一些瞎眼的和瘸腿的來到他面前，耶穌就使他們痊癒了。 The blind and the lame came to Him in the temple complex, and He healed them.
15. 祭司長們和經文士們看見耶穌所行的神蹟，又見孩子們在聖殿裡呼喊說：「和散那歸於 大衛 的後裔」，就很生氣。 When the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonders that He did and the children in the temple complex cheering, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" they were indignant
16. 他們問耶穌：「你聽見這些小孩在說什麼嗎？」 耶穌回答他們，說： 「是的，聽見了 。難道你們從來沒有讀過 『從孩子和吃奶嬰兒的口中，你預備了讚美』 這話嗎？」 and said to Him, "Do You hear what these [children] are saying?" "Yes," Jesus told them. "Have you never read: You have prepared praise from the mouths of children and nursing infants?"
17. 然後，耶穌離開他們，出城到 伯大尼 去，在那裡過夜。 Then He left them, went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.
18. 清晨，回城的時候，耶穌餓了。 Early in the morning, as He was returning to the city, He was hungry.
19. 他看見路邊有一棵無花果樹，就上前去，可是樹上除了葉子，什麼也找不到。於是他對那棵樹說： 「你永遠不會再結果子了！」 那棵無花果樹立刻就枯萎了。 Seeing a lone fig tree by the road, He went up to it and found nothing on it except leaves. And He said to it, "May no fruit ever come from you again!" At once the fig tree withered.
20. 門徒們看見了，感到驚奇，說：「這棵無花果樹怎麼立刻枯萎了呢？」 When the disciples saw it, they were amazed and said, "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?"
21. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「我確實地告訴你們：你們如果存著信而不疑惑，不僅能做我對這無花果樹所做的，即使對這座山說『願你被挪開，被丟進海裡去！』事情也將成就。 Jesus answered them, "I assure you: If you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you tell this mountain, 'Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' it will be done.
22. 你們在禱告中無論求什麼，只要信，就必得著。」 And if you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer."
23. 耶穌進了聖殿，正教導人的時候，祭司長們和民間的長老們前來問他：「你憑什麼權柄做這些事？是誰給你這權柄的？」 When He entered the temple complex, the chief priests and the elders of the people came up to Him as He was teaching and said, "By what authority are You doing these things? Who gave You this authority?"
24. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「我也要問你們一個問題，如果你們回答我，我就告訴你們我憑什麼權柄做這些事。 Jesus answered them, "I will also ask you one question, and if you answer it for Me, then I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
25. 約翰 的洗禮是從哪裡來的？是來自天上，還是來自人間呢？」 他們就彼此討論，說：「如果我們說『是來自天上』，他就會問我們『那麼你們為什麼不相信他呢？』 Where did John's baptism come from? From heaven or from men?" They began to argue among themselves, "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say to us, 'Then why didn't you believe him?'
26. 但如果說『是來自人間』——我們又怕民眾，因為大家都認為 約翰 是先知。」 But if we say, 'From men,' we're afraid of the crowd, because everyone thought John was a prophet."
27. 於是他們回答耶穌，說：「我們不知道。」 耶穌就對他們說： 「我也不告訴你們我憑什麼權柄做這些事。」 So they answered Jesus, "We don't know." And He said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
28. 「這件事你們怎麼看？一個人有兩個兒子，他前來對大兒子說：『孩子，你今天到葡萄園去做工吧。』 "But what do you think? A man had two sons. He went to the first and said, 'My son, go, work in the vineyard today.'
29. 「大兒子回答說：『我不願意去。』可是後來他悔改，就去了。 "He answered, 'I don't want to!' Yet later he changed his mind and went.
30. 父親前來對小兒子也說同樣的話。 「小兒子回答說：『主啊，我去。』可是他沒有去。 Then the man went to the other and said the same thing. " 'I will, sir,' he answered. But he didn't go.
31. 「這兩個兒子中，哪一個遵行父親的意願呢？」 他們回答說：「大兒子。」 耶穌說： 「我確實地告訴你們：稅吏和妓女要在你們的前面進神的國， "Which of the two did his father's will?" "The first," they said. Jesus said to them, "I assure you: Tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you!
32. 因為 約翰 來到你們這裡指明義的道路，你們不相信他，而那些稅吏和妓女們卻相信了他。你們雖然看見了，後來還是沒有悔改去相信他。 For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn't believe him. Tax collectors and prostitutes did believe him, but you, when you saw it, didn't even change your minds then and believe him.
33. 「你們當聽另一個比喻：有一個人，是一家的主人，他栽種了一個葡萄園，四面圍上籬笆，裡面挖了一個榨酒池，蓋了一座守望樓，然後把葡萄園租給一些農夫，就出外旅行。 "Listen to another parable: There was a man, a landowner, who planted a vineyard, put a fence around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a watchtower. He leased it to tenant farmers and went away.
34. 當收果子的季節近了，主人就派了奴僕們到那些農夫那裡去收取他的果子。 When the grape harvest drew near, he sent his slaves to the farmers to collect his fruit.
35. 但那些農夫抓住他的奴僕，打了一個，殺了一個，還用石頭砸死一個。 But the farmers took his slaves, beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
36. 主人又派別的奴僕去，比先前的更多，那些農夫也照樣對待他們。 Again, he sent other slaves, more than the first group, and they did the same to them.
37. 後來他差派自己的兒子到他們那裡，說：『他們一定會尊重我的兒子。』 Finally, he sent his son to them. 'They will respect my son,' he said.
38. 「可是那些農夫看見他的兒子，就彼此說：『這是繼承人。來，我們把他殺了，占有他的繼業！』 "But when the tenant farmers saw the son, they said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him and take his inheritance!'
39. 於是他們抓住他，把他扔出葡萄園外，殺了。 So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
40. 那麼，葡萄園的主人回來的時候，會怎麼對待那些農夫呢？」 Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?"
41. 他們回答說：「他會狠狠地除滅那些惡人，把葡萄園另租給按時交果子的農夫們。」 "He will completely destroy those terrible men," they told Him, "and lease his vineyard to other farmers who will give him his produce at the harvest."
42. 耶穌對他們說： 「難道你們從來沒有讀過這段經文嗎？ 『工匠所棄絕的石頭， 它已經成了房角的頭塊石頭； 這是主所成就的， 在我們眼中實在奇妙！』 Jesus said to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures: The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This came from the Lord and is wonderful in our eyes?
43. 為此，我告訴你們：神的國要從你們中間被奪走，賜給那結神國果子的人。 Therefore I tell you, the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a nation producing its fruit.
44. 那跌落在這石頭上的人，就將被破碎；這石頭落在誰的身上，就會把誰砸得稀爛。」 [[Whoever falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; but on whomever it falls, it will grind him to powder!"]]
45. 祭司長們和 法利賽 人聽了耶穌的這些比喻，知道他是針對他們而說的， When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard His parables, they knew He was speaking about them.
46. 就想拘捕他，可是怕民眾，因為他們都認為耶穌是先知。 Although they were looking for a way to arrest Him, they feared the crowds, because they regarded Him as a prophet.
Matthew 22
1. 耶穌又用比喻對他們說： Once more Jesus spoke to them in parables:
2. 「天國好比一個君王，為自己的兒子預備婚宴。 "The kingdom of heaven may be compared to a king who gave a wedding banquet for his son.
3. 他派了奴僕們去叫那些被邀請的人前來赴宴，可是他們不肯來。 He sent out his slaves to summon those invited to the banquet, but they didn't want to come.
4. 王又派了別的奴僕，說：『你們去對那些被邀請的人說，看哪，我的午餐我已經預備好了，公牛和肥畜已經宰殺了，一切都預備好了，請你們來赴婚宴。』 Again, he sent out other slaves, and said, 'Tell those who are invited: Look, I've prepared my dinner; my oxen and fattened cattle have been slaughtered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.'
5. 「但那些人不理，就走開了，有的到自己的田裡去，有的做自己的生意去。 "But they paid no attention and went away, one to his own farm, another to his business.
6. 其餘的竟抓住王的奴僕們，凌辱他們，並且把他們殺了。 And the others seized his slaves, treated them outrageously and killed them.
7. 王 就發怒，派軍兵除滅那些凶手，燒毀了他們的城。 The king was enraged, so he sent out his troops, destroyed those murderers, and burned down their city.
8. 「然後對奴僕們說：『婚宴預備好了，但那些被邀請的人不配。 "Then he told his slaves, 'The banquet is ready, but those who were invited were not worthy.
9. 所以你們要到大街小巷去，把所見到的人都請來赴宴。』 Therefore, go to where the roads exit the city and invite everyone you find to the banquet.'
10. 那些奴僕就出去，到大街上，把所見到的，無論好人壞人都召集起來，婚宴上就坐滿了賓客。 So those slaves went out on the roads and gathered everyone they found, both evil and good. The wedding banquet was filled with guests.
11. 王進來會見賓客，發現有一個人沒有穿婚宴的禮服， But when the king came in to view the guests, he saw a man there who was not dressed for a wedding.
12. 就對他說：『朋友，你進到這裡來怎麼沒有穿婚宴的禮服呢？』那個人啞口無言。 So he said to him, 'Friend, how did you get in here without wedding clothes?' The man was speechless.
13. 「於是王吩咐僕人們：『把他的手腳捆起來， 丟到外面的黑暗裡去！在那裡將有哀哭和切齒。』 "Then the king told the attendants, 'Tie him up hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'
14. 「要知道，蒙召喚的人多，而蒙揀選的人少。」 "For many are invited, but few are chosen."
15. 法利賽 人就去商議，怎樣找耶穌的話柄來陷害他。 Then the Pharisees went and plotted how to trap Him by what He said.
16. 他們派了自己的門徒們與 希律 黨的人一同去見耶穌，說：「老師，我們知道你是真誠的，並且按真理教導神的道 。你不顧忌任何人，因為你不看人的情面。 They sent their disciples to Him, with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know that You are truthful and teach truthfully the way of God. You defer to no one, for You don't show partiality.
17. 請告訴我們，你認為向凱撒納稅，可以不可以呢？」 Tell us, therefore, what You think. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
18. 耶穌看出他們的惡意，就說： 「你們這些偽善的人！為什麼試探我呢？ But perceiving their malice, Jesus said, "Why are you testing Me, hypocrites?
19. 拿一個納稅的錢幣給我看。」 他們就拿來了一個銀幣 給他。 Show Me the coin used for the tax." So they brought Him a denarius.
20. 耶穌問他們： 「這是誰的像和名號？」 "Whose image and inscription is this?" He asked them.
21. 他們回答說：「是凱撒的。」 耶穌對他們說： 「那麼，凱撒的歸給凱撒；神的歸給神。」 "Caesar's," they said to Him. Then He said to them, "Therefore, give back to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."
22. 他們聽了，感到驚奇，就離開耶穌走了。 When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away.
23. 在那一天， 撒都該 人來到耶穌那裡，他們一向說沒有復活的事。他們問耶穌， The same day some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came up to Him and questioned Him:
24. 說：「老師， 摩西 說： 如果一個人死了，沒有兒女，他的一個兄弟就要娶他的妻子，為他兄弟留後裔。 "Teacher, Moses said, if a man dies, having no children, his brother is to marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
25. 我們這裡曾經有兄弟七人，第一個結了婚，死了，沒有後裔，留下妻子給他的一個兄弟。 Now there were seven brothers among us. The first got married and died. Having no offspring, he left his wife to his brother.
26. 第二個、第三個、一直到第七個，都是如此。 The same happened to the second also, and the third, and so to all seven.
27. 到了最後，這婦人也死了。 Then last of all the woman died.
28. 既然他們都娶過她，那麼，在復活的時候，她將是這七個人中哪一個的妻子呢？」 Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had married her."
29. 耶穌回答說： 「你們錯了，因為你們不明白經上的話，也不明白神的大能。 Jesus answered them, "You are deceived, because you don't know the Scriptures or the power of God.
30. 復活的時候，人既不娶也不嫁，而是像天上的 天使一樣。 For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage but are like angels in heaven.
31. 關於死人復活的事，你們難道沒有讀過神對你們所說的話嗎？神說 Now concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven't you read what was spoken to you by God:
32. 『我是亞伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神。』 『我是 神不是死人的神，而是活人的神。」 I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living."
33. 眾人聽了這話，對他的教導驚嘆不已。 And when the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.
34. 法利賽 人聽說耶穌使 撒都該 人啞口無言，就聚集在一起。 When the Pharisees heard that He had silenced the Sadducees, they came together in the same place.
35. 他們當中有一個是律法師， 來試探耶穌，問他： And one of them, an expert in the law, asked a question to test Him:
36. 「老師，律法中最大的誡命是哪一條呢？」 "Teacher, which commandment in the law is the greatest?"
37. 耶穌對他說： 「 『你要以全心、全靈、全意愛主——你的神』， He said to him, "Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.
38. 這是最大的，也是最重要的誡命。 This is the greatest and most important commandment.
39. 其次的也和它類似， 『要愛鄰如己。』 The second is like it: Love your neighbor as yourself.
40. 全部律法和先知書都是以這兩條誡命為依據的。」 All the Law and the Prophets depend on these two commandments."
41. 法利賽 人聚集在一起的時候，耶穌問他們 While the Pharisees were together, Jesus questioned them,
42. 說： 「關於基督，你們怎麼看？他是誰的後裔呢？」 他們說：「是 大衛 的後裔。」 "What do you think about the Messiah? Whose Son is He?" "David's," they told Him.
43. 耶穌問他們： 「那麼， 大衛 藉著聖靈，怎麼還稱他為『主』呢？ 說： He asked them, "How is it then that David, inspired by the Spirit, calls Him 'Lord':
44. 『主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我把你的敵人放在你的腳下 。』 The Lord declared to my Lord, 'Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet'?
45. 「因此， 大衛 如果稱基督為『主』，基督怎麼會是 的後裔呢？」 "If David calls Him 'Lord,' how then can the Messiah be his Son"
46. 沒有人能回答他一句話。從那天起，再也沒有人敢質問耶穌了。 No one was able to answer Him at all, and from that day no one dared to question Him any more.
Matthew 23
1. 那時，耶穌對眾人和自己的門徒們說： Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples:
2. 「經文士和 法利賽 人坐在 摩西 的位子上， "The scribes and the Pharisees are seated in the chair of Moses.
3. 所以，他們所吩咐你們的，你們都要去做，也要遵守；但是不要效法他們的行為，因為他們說而不做。 Therefore do whatever they tell you and observe [it]. But don't do what they do, because they don't practice what they teach.
4. 他們把沉重難挑的 擔子捆起來，放在人們肩上，但自己卻連一根指頭也不肯動它們一下。 They tie up heavy loads that are hard to carry and put them on people's shoulders, but they themselves aren't willing to lift a finger to move them.
5. 他們所做的一切事，都是為了給人看：他們把自己的經文盒加寬，把衣服的 穗子加長； They do everything to be observed by others: They enlarge their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.
6. 他們喜愛宴席中的上座和會堂裡的首位， They love the place of honor at banquets, the front seats in the synagogues,
7. 喜愛街市上的致敬問候，又喜愛被人們稱為『老師 』。 greetings in the marketplaces, and to be called ' Rabbi' by people.
8. 「但你們不可被稱為『老師 』，因為你們的老師只有一位， 而你們都是弟兄。 "But as for you, do not be called 'Rabbi,' because you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
9. 不要稱地上的任何人為『父』，因為你們的父只有一位，就是天父。 Do not call anyone on earth your father, because you have one Father, who is in heaven.
10. 你們也不要被人稱為『主人』，因為你們的主人只有一位，就是基督。 And do not be called masters either, because you have one Master, the Messiah.
11. 你們當中誰更大，誰就該做你們的僕人， The greatest among you will be your servant.
12. 因為凡是自我高舉的都會被降卑，而自我降卑的都會被高舉。 Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
13. 「經文士和 法利賽 人哪，你們這些偽善的人有禍了！因為你們在人的面前封閉了天國。你們自己不進去，也不讓正要進的人進去。 "But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You lock up the kingdom of heaven from people. For you don't go in, and you don't allow those entering to go in.
14. 「經文士和 法利賽 人哪，你們這些偽善的人有禍了！因為你們侵吞寡婦的家產，又假意做很長的禱告。因此，你們將受到更重的懲罰。 [["Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You devour widows' houses and make long prayers just for show. This is why you will receive a harsher punishment.]]
15. 「經文士和 法利賽 人哪，你們這些偽善的人有禍了！因為你們為了使一個人入教，走遍海洋和陸地，一旦那人成了教徒，你們就使他成為比你們加倍壞的地獄之子。 "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to make one proselyte, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as fit for hell as you are!
16. 「你們這些瞎眼的領路人有禍了！你們說：『如果有人指著聖所起誓，算不得什麼；但如果有人指著聖所裡的金子起誓，就必須遵守。』 "Woe to you, blind guides, who say, 'Whoever takes an oath by the sanctuary, it means nothing. But whoever takes an oath by the gold of the sanctuary is bound by his oath.'
17. 你們這些又愚拙又瞎眼的人哪，到底哪一樣更重要呢？是金子，還是使金子成聖的聖所呢？ Blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the sanctuary that sanctified the gold?
18. 你們還說：『如果有人指著祭壇起誓，算不得什麼；但如果有人指著祭壇上的祭物起誓，就必須遵守。』 Also, 'Whoever takes an oath by the altar, it means nothing. But whoever takes an oath by the gift that is on it is bound by his oath.'
19. 你們這些 瞎眼的人哪，到底哪一樣更重要呢？是祭物，還是使祭物成聖的祭壇呢？ Blind people! For which is greater, the gift or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
20. 所以，指著祭壇起誓的，就是指著祭壇和祭壇上的一切起誓； Therefore the one who takes an oath by the altar takes an oath by it and by everything on it.
21. 指著聖所起誓的，就是指著聖所和住在裡面的那一位起誓； The one who takes an oath by the sanctuary takes an oath by it and by Him who dwells in it.
22. 指著天起誓的，就是指著神的寶座和坐在寶座上的那一位起誓。 And the one who takes an oath by heaven takes an oath by God's throne and by Him who sits on it.
23. 「經文士和 法利賽 人哪，你們這些偽善的人有禍了！因為你們奉獻薄荷、蒔蘿、香芹的十分之一，卻放棄了律法上更重要的：就是公義、憐憫、信實。這些才是你們應該做的，至於前者也不可放棄。 "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You pay a tenth of mint, dill, and cumin, yet you have neglected the more important matters of the law-- justice, mercy, and faith. These things should have been done without neglecting the others.
24. 你們這些瞎眼的領路人哪，你們濾掉蠓蟲，卻吞下駱駝！ Blind guides! You strain out a gnat, yet gulp down a camel!
25. 「經文士和 法利賽 人哪，你們這些偽善的人有禍了！因為你們洗淨杯子、盤子的外面，裡面卻盛滿了貪心和放縱。 "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence!
26. 你這瞎眼的 法利賽 人哪！當先洗淨杯子 的裡面，好使外面也潔淨。 Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup, so the outside of it may also become clean.
27. 「經文士和 法利賽 人哪，你們這些偽善的人有禍了！因為你們好像粉飾的墳墓，外面固然顯得美麗，裡面卻裝滿了死人骨頭和一切汙穢。 "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which appear beautiful on the outside, but inside are full of dead men's bones and every impurity.
28. 你們也是這樣，你們外面對人顯出公義，裡面卻充滿了偽善和罪惡 。 In the same way, on the outside you seem righteous to people, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
29. 「經文士和 法利賽 人哪，你們這些偽善的人有禍了！因為你們建造先知的墳墓，裝飾義人的墓碑， "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous,
30. 說：『如果我們活在我們祖先的時代，我們就不會與他們合夥流先知們的血。』 and you say, 'If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn't have taken part with them in shedding the prophets' blood.'
31. 這樣，你們就見證了自己是殺害先知們的那些人的後代。 You therefore testify against yourselves that you are sons of those who murdered the prophets.
32. 你們去充滿你們祖先的惡貫吧！ Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers' sins!
33. 「你們這些蛇類，這些毒蛇的子孫！你們怎麼能逃避地獄的懲罰呢？ "Snakes! Brood of vipers! How can you escape being condemned to hell?
34. 看，我為此差派先知、智者、經師到你們這裡來；有些你們要殺害、要釘上十字架，有些要在會堂裡鞭打，從一個城追逼到另一個城。 This is why I am sending you prophets, sages, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will flog in your synagogues and hound from town to town.
35. 所以，從義人 亞伯 的血起，直到你們在聖所和祭壇之間所殺的 巴拉加 的兒子 撒迦利亞 的血為止，在地上所流的義人的血都要歸在你們身上。 So all the righteous blood shed on the earth will be charged to you, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah, son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar.
36. 我確實地告訴你們：這一切都要臨到這世代。 I assure you: All these things will come on this generation!
37. 「 耶路撒冷 啊， ！這城殺害先知們，又用石頭砸死被差到她這裡的人！我多次想聚集你的兒女，像母雞把自己的小雞聚集在翅膀下，可是你們不願意！ "Jerusalem, Jerusalem! The city who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her. How often I wanted to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, yet you were not willing!
38. 看哪，你們的家 要被廢棄成為荒場。 See, your house is left to you desolate.
39. 我告訴你們：今後你們絕不會再見到我了，直到你們說： 『奉主名而來的那一位，是蒙祝福的。』 」 For I tell you, you will never see Me again until you say, Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!"
Matthew 24
1. 耶穌從聖殿出來，往前走的時候，他的門徒們上前來，把聖殿的建築指給他看。 As Jesus left and was going out of the temple complex, His disciples came up and called His attention to the temple buildings.
2. 耶穌回應說： 「你們不是看見了這一切嗎？我確實地告訴你們：這裡將絕不會有一塊石頭留在另一塊石頭上而不被拆下。」 Then He replied to them, "Don't you see all these things? I assure you: Not one stone will be left here on another that will not be thrown down!"
3. 耶穌在 橄欖山 上坐著，門徒們悄悄地前來問他：「請告訴我們，這些事什麼時候會發生呢？你的來臨和這世代的終結會有什麼預兆呢？」 While He was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples approached Him privately and said, "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what is the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?"
4. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「你們要當心，免得有人迷惑你們。 Then Jesus replied to them: "Watch out that no one deceives you.
5. 因為許多人會以我的名而來，聲稱『我是基督』，並且會迷惑許多人。 For many will come in My name, saying, 'I am the Messiah,' and they will deceive many.
6. 你們也將會聽見戰爭和戰爭的消息。要注意，不可驚慌，因為這些事必須發生，不過結局還沒有到。 You are going to hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not alarmed, because these things must take place, but the end is not yet.
7. 一個民族要起來反對另一個民族，一個國家要起來反對另一個國家；到處都會有饑荒 和地震。 For nation will rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
8. 這些都像臨產陣痛的開始。 All these events are the beginning of birth pains.
9. 「那時，他們將要出賣你們，使你們受患難，甚至殺害你們。為了我的名，你們將被萬民憎恨。 "Then they will hand you over for persecution, and they will kill you. You will be hated by all nations because of My name.
10. 那時，許多人將被絆倒，彼此出賣，彼此憎恨； Then many will take offense, betray one another and hate one another.
11. 並且會有許多假先知起來，迷惑許多人； Many false prophets will rise up and deceive many.
12. 由於罪惡 增多，許多人的愛心就會冷淡。 Because lawlessness will multiply, the love of many will grow cold.
13. 但是忍耐到底的，這個人將會得救。 But the one who endures to the end will be delivered.
14. 這天國的福音將被傳遍天下，好對萬國做見證，然後結局才會到來。 This good news of the kingdom will be proclaimed in all the world as a testimony to all nations. And then the end will come.
15. 「當你們看見藉著先知 但以理 所說的 『那帶來毀滅的褻瀆者 』 站在聖地的時候 ——讀者應當思考—— "So when you see the abomination that causes desolation, spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place" (let the reader understand),
16. 那時，在 猶太 的人應當逃到山裡； "then those in Judea must flee to the mountains!
17. 在屋頂上的人，不要下來拿屋子裡的東西； A man on the housetop must not come down to get things out of his house.
18. 在田裡的人，不要返回去拿自己的衣服。 And a man in the field must not go back to get his clothes.
19. 在那些日子裡，孕婦和哺乳的女人有禍了！ Woe to pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days!
20. 你們要禱告，好讓你們逃難的時候不在冬天，也不在安息日。 Pray that your escape may not be in winter or on a Sabbath.
21. 因為那時將有大患難。這樣的患難從世界開始直到如今，從來沒有發生過，也絕不再發生。 For at that time there will be great tribulation, the kind that hasn't taken place from the beginning of the world until now and never will again!
22. 如果那些日子不被減少，就沒有一個人 能得救。可是為了那些蒙揀選的人，那些日子將被減少。 Unless those days were limited, no one would survive. But those days will be limited because of the elect.
23. 「那時候，如果有人對你們說『看哪，基督在這裡！』或『他在那裡！』你們不要相信。 "If anyone tells you then, 'Look, here is the Messiah!' or, 'Over here!' do not believe it!
24. 因為假基督們和假先知們會出現，行大神蹟和奇事，如果有可能，甚至迷惑那些蒙揀選的人。 False messiahs and false prophets will arise and perform great signs and wonders to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
25. 看哪，我已經預先告訴你們了！ Take note: I have told you in advance.
26. 所以，如果有人對你們說『看哪，基督在曠野裡！』你們不要出去；有人說：『看哪，他在內室裡！』你們也不要相信； So if they tell you, 'Look, he's in the wilderness!' don't go out; 'Look, he's in the inner rooms!' do not believe it.
27. 因為就像閃電從東邊發出，直照到西邊，人子的來臨也將要這樣。 For as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
28. 屍體在哪裡，禿鷹就聚集在哪裡。 Wherever the carcass is, there the vultures will gather.
29. 「那些日子的患難一過去， 『太陽就要變黑， 月亮也不發光， 星辰要從天上墜落， 諸天的各勢力也將被震動。』 "Immediately after the tribulation of those days: The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not shed its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the celestial powers will be shaken.
30. 「那時候，人子的徵兆將要顯現在天上，地上的萬族都要捶胸哀哭。他們將要看見人子帶著極大的權能和榮耀，在天上的雲彩中來臨。 "Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and then all the peoples of the earth will mourn; and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
31. 在嘹亮的號角聲中，他要差派他的天使們從四方，從天這邊到天那邊，召集他所揀選的人。 He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
32. 「你們要從無花果樹那裡學個比喻：當無花果樹的枝子發嫩長出葉子的時候，你們就知道夏天快到了。 "Now learn this parable from the fig tree: As soon as its branch becomes tender and sprouts leaves, you know that summer is near.
33. 照樣，當你們看見這一切的時候，你們就知道人子 快到了，就在門口了。 In the same way, when you see all these things, recognize that He is near-- at the door!
34. 我確實地告訴你們：在這一切事發生之前，這世代絕不會過去。 I assure you: This generation will certainly not pass away until all these things take place.
35. 天和地將要消逝，但是我的話絕不會消逝。 Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
36. 「至於那日子和那時刻，沒有人知道，連諸天之上的天使們也不知道，子也不知道， 唯有父知道。 "Now concerning that day and hour no one knows-- neither the angels in heaven, nor the Son-- except the Father only.
37. 挪亞 的那些日子怎樣，人子的來臨也將要怎樣。 As the days of Noah were, so the coming of the Son of Man will be.
38. 在洪水以前的那些日子裡，人們繼續吃、喝、嫁、娶，直到 挪亞 進方舟的那一天。 For in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day Noah boarded the ark.
39. 他們毫不察覺，直到洪水到來，把一切沖走。人子的來臨，也將是這樣。 They didn't know until the flood came and swept them all away. So this is the way the coming of the Son of Man will be:
40. 那時，兩個人在田裡，一個被接去，一個被留下。 Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one left.
41. 兩個女人在磨石那裡推磨，一個被接去，一個被留下。 Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one left.
42. 所以你們要警醒，因為你們不知道你們的主哪一天 回來。 Therefore be alert, since you don't know what day your Lord is coming.
43. 不過你們應當知道這一點：一家的主人如果知道賊什麼時刻 來，他就會警醒，不讓他的房子被人鑽進。 But know this: If the homeowner had known what time the thief was coming, he would have stayed alert and not let his house be broken into.
44. 你們為了這緣故也應當做好準備，因為在你們意想不到的時候，人子就來了。 This is why you also must be ready, because the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect.
45. 「究竟誰是那又忠心又聰明的奴僕——受主人委任統管他家裡的人、按時給他們分糧的人呢？ "Who then is a faithful and sensible slave, whom his master has put in charge of his household, to give them food at the proper time?
46. 主人回來的時候，看見哪個奴僕這樣做，那個奴僕就蒙福了。 That slave whose master finds him working when he comes will be rewarded.
47. 我確實地告訴你們：主人會委任他統管自己所擁有的一切。 I assure you: He will put him in charge of all his possessions.
48. 但如果這惡奴心裡說『我的主人會遲延回來 』， But if that wicked slave says in his heart, 'My master is delayed,'
49. 就動手毆打與他同做奴僕的，並且與醉酒的人一起吃喝， and starts to beat his fellow slaves, and eats and drinks with drunkards,
50. 那麼，這奴僕的主人就要在意想不到的日子、在他不知道的時刻回來， that slave's master will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know.
51. 並且會嚴厲懲罰他，使他與那些偽善的人有同樣的下場。在那裡將有哀哭和切齒。 He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Matthew 25
1. 「那時，天國好比十個童女，拿著她們的燈出去迎接新郎 。 "Then the kingdom of heaven will be like 10 virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the groom.
2. 她們當中有五個是愚拙的，五個是聰明的。 Five of them were foolish and five were sensible.
3. 那些愚拙的童女帶著她們的燈，卻沒有帶油； When the foolish took their lamps, they didn't take oil with them.
4. 而那些聰明的帶著瓶子裡的油，以及自己的燈。 But the sensible ones took oil in their flasks with their lamps.
5. 後來新郎遲延不到，她們都打盹，睡著了。 Since the groom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
6. 「半夜裡，有人喧嚷：『看哪，是新郎！你們出來迎接他！』 "In the middle of the night there was a shout: 'Here's the groom! Come out to meet him.'
7. 「十個 童女都醒過來，修整她們的燈。 "Then all those virgins got up and trimmed their lamps.
8. 愚拙的對聰明的說：『請把你們的油分一點給我們，因為我們的燈要滅了。』 But the foolish ones said to the sensible ones, 'Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.'
9. 「但那些聰明的回答說：『不行，絕不夠我們和你們用的。你們還是到賣油的那裡去，為自己買吧。』 "The sensible ones answered, 'No, there won't be enough for us and for you. Go instead to those who sell, and buy oil for yourselves.'
10. 「可是她們去買的時候，新郎就來了。那些預備好了的，與新郎一同進去赴婚宴，門就關上了。 "When they had gone to buy some, the groom arrived. Then those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
11. 「後來其餘的童女也來了，說：『主啊，主啊，請給我們開門！』 "Later the rest of the virgins also came and said, 'Master, master, open up for us!'
12. 「但是新郎回答說：『我確實地告訴你們：我不認識你們。』 "But he replied, ' I assure you: I do not know you!'
13. 「所以你們要警醒，因為你們不知道 那日子和那時刻。 "Therefore be alert, because you don't know either the day or the hour.
14. 「天國又好比一個人要出外旅行，就叫來自己的奴僕們，把他所擁有的交託給他們。 "For it is just like a man going on a journey. He called his own slaves and turned over his possessions to them.
15. 他按照每個人自己的能力，一個給了五千兩銀子，一個給了兩千兩，一個給了一千兩，然後就出外旅行。 To one he gave five talents; to another, two; and to another, one-- to each according to his own ability. Then he went on a journey. Immediately
16. 那領了五千的，立刻用這些錢去做生意，另外賺了五千。 the man who had received five talents went, put them to work, and earned five more.
17. 那領了兩千的，也照樣另賺了兩千。 In the same way the man with two earned two more.
18. 可是那領了一千的，卻出去挖地，把他主人的銀子藏起來。 But the man who had received one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master's money.
19. 「過了很久，那些奴僕的主人回來，與他們清算帳目。 "After a long time the master of those slaves came and settled accounts with them.
20. 那領了五千兩銀子的，帶著另外的五千兩上前來，說：『主啊，你交託給我五千兩銀子，請看，我另外賺了五千兩。』 The man who had received five talents approached, presented five more talents, and said, 'Master, you gave me five talents. Look, I've earned five more talents.'
21. 「主人對他說：『做得好，忠心的好奴僕！你在少許的事上忠心，我要委任你統管很多的事。進來分享你主人的快樂吧！』 "His master said to him, 'Well done, good and faithful slave! You were faithful over a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Share your master's joy!'
22. 「那領了兩千兩銀子的也上前來，說：『主啊，你交託給我兩千兩銀子，請看，我另外賺了兩千兩。』 "Then the man with two talents also approached. He said, 'Master, you gave me two talents. Look, I've earned two more talents.'
23. 「主人對他說：『做得好，忠心的好奴僕！你在少許的事上忠心，我要委任你統管很多的事。進來分享你主人的快樂吧！』 "His master said to him, 'Well done, good and faithful slave! You were faithful over a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Share your master's joy!'
24. 「接著，那領了一千兩銀子的也上前來，說：『主啊，我知道你是個嚴厲的人，不是你播種的地方，你收穫；不是你投放的地方，你收集。 "Then the man who had received one talent also approached and said, 'Master, I know you. You're a difficult man, reaping where you haven't sown and gathering where you haven't scattered seed.
25. 我懼怕，就去把你的銀子藏在地裡。請看，你的銀子在這裡。』 So I was afraid and went off and hid your talent in the ground. Look, you have what is yours.'
26. 「主人回答他，說：『你這又惡又懶的奴僕！你既然知道：不是我播種的地方，我收穫；不是我投放的地方，我收集， "But his master replied to him, 'You evil, lazy slave! If you knew that I reap where I haven't sown and gather where I haven't scattered,
27. 你就應該把我的銀子存到錢莊裡，這樣我回來的時候，可以連本帶利得回來。 then you should have deposited my money with the bankers. And when I returned I would have received my money back with interest.
28. 「所以，你們把那一千兩銀子從他那裡拿走，給那個有一萬兩的； " 'So take the talent from him and give it to the one who has 10 talents.
29. 因為凡是有的，還要賜給他，使他豐足有餘；那沒有的，連他有的也將從他那裡被拿走。 For to everyone who has, more will be given, and he will have more than enough. But from the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
30. 把這個無用的奴僕丟到外面的黑暗裡去！在那裡將有哀哭和切齒。』 And throw this good-for-nothing slave into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'
31. 「當人子在他的榮耀中，與所有的 天使一起來臨的時候，他那時就要坐在他榮耀的寶座上。 "When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, then He will sit on the throne of His glory.
32. 萬民都將被召集到他面前。他要把他們互相分別，就像牧人把綿羊從山羊中分別出來那樣， All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate them one from another, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
33. 把綿羊放在他的右邊，山羊放在左邊。 He will put the sheep on His right, and the goats on the left.
34. 那時王要對在他右邊的人說：『來吧，蒙我父所祝福的人哪，來繼承創世以來已經為你們所預備好的國度吧！ Then the King will say to those on His right, 'Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
35. 因為我餓了， 你們給我吃； 我渴了， 你們給我喝； 我在異鄉時， 你們收留了我； For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat; I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink; I was a stranger and you took Me in;
36. 我衣不蔽體，你們給我穿； 我患了病，你們照顧我； 我在監獄裡，你們探望我。』 I was naked and you clothed Me; I was sick and you took care of Me; I was in prison and you visited Me.'
37. 「那時義人將回答說：『主啊，我們什麼時候見你餓了就給你吃，見你渴了就給你喝呢？ "Then the righteous will answer Him, 'Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?
38. 我們什麼時候見你在異鄉就收留了你，見你衣不蔽體就給你穿呢？ When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or without clothes and clothe You?
39. 又什麼時候見你患病或在監獄裡，就到你那裡去呢？』 When did we see You sick, or in prison, and visit You?'
40. 「王要回答他們，說：『我確實地告訴你們：你們為我這些弟兄中最小的一個所做的事，就是為我做了。』 "And the King will answer them, 'I assure you: Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.'
41. 那時王要對在左邊的人說：『你們這些被詛咒的人！離開我！進到那已經為魔鬼和他的使者們所預備好的永遠的火裡去！ Then He will also say to those on the left, 'Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the Devil and his angels!
42. 因為我餓了， 你們沒有給我吃； 我渴了， 你們沒有給我喝； For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat; I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink;
43. 我在異鄉時， 你們沒有收留我； 我衣不蔽體， 你們沒有給我穿； 我患了病、在監獄裡， 你們沒有照顧我。』 I was a stranger and you didn't take Me in; I was naked and you didn't clothe Me, sick and in prison and you didn't take care of Me.'
44. 「那時他們也要回答說：『主啊，我們什麼時候見你餓了，或渴了，或在異鄉，或衣不蔽體，或患了病，或在監獄裡，而沒有服事你呢？』 "Then they too will answer, 'Lord, when did we see You hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or without clothes, or sick, or in prison, and not help You?'
45. 「那時王要回答他們，說：『我確實地告訴你們：你們沒有為我這些弟兄中最小的一個所做的事，也就是沒有為我做。』 "Then He will answer them, 'I assure you: Whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me either.'
46. 「結果這些人將離去，進入永遠的刑罰。然而，義人將進入永恆的生命。」 "And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life."
Matthew 26
1. 當耶穌講完了這一切話，就對自己的門徒們說： When Jesus had finished saying all this, He told His disciples,
2. 「你們知道，過兩天就是逾越節，人子要被交出去釘上十字架。」 "You know that the Passover takes place after two days, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified."
3. 那時，祭司長們 和民間的長老們聚集在叫 該亞法 的大祭司的宅院裡， Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
4. 商議要用詭計拘捕耶穌，把他殺掉。 and they conspired to arrest Jesus in a treacherous way and kill Him.
5. 不過他們說：「不可在節日期間，免得民中發生騷亂。」 "Not during the festival," they said, "so there won't be rioting among the people."
6. 耶穌在 伯大尼，在痲瘋病人 西門 家裡的時候， While Jesus was in Bethany at the house of Simon, a man who had a serious skin disease,
7. 有一個女人拿著一個盛了極其貴重香液的玉瓶上前來，在耶穌坐席的時候，把香液澆在他的頭上。 a woman approached Him with an alabaster jar of very expensive fragrant oil. She poured it on His head as He was reclining at the table.
8. 門徒們看見了就很不滿，說：「為什麼這樣浪費？ When the disciples saw it, they were indignant. "Why this waste?" they asked.
9. 這香液 本來可以賣很多錢，分給窮人。」 "This might have been sold for a great deal and given to the poor."
10. 耶穌知道了，就對他們說： 「你們為什麼為難這婦人呢？她為我做了一件美好的事。 But Jesus, aware of this, said to them, "Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a noble thing for Me.
11. 要知道，你們總是有窮人與你們在一起，但你們不總是有我。 You always have the poor with you, but you do not always have Me.
12. 她把這香液澆在我身上，是為了預備安葬我而做的。 By pouring this fragrant oil on My body, she has prepared Me for burial.
13. 我確實地告訴你們：在全世界，福音無論傳到什麼地方，這女人所做的事也將被述說，做為對她的記念。」 I assure you: Wherever this gospel is proclaimed in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be told in memory of her."
14. 那時候，十二使徒 中的一個，就是那稱為 加略 人 猶大 的，到祭司長們那裡去， Then one of the Twelve-- the man called Judas Iscariot-- went to the chief priests
15. 說：「如果我把他交給你們，你們願意給我什麼？」他們就約定給他三十個銀錢。 and said, "What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?" So they weighed out 30 pieces of silver for him.
16. 從那時候起， 猶大 就開始找機會要把耶穌交出去。 And from that time he started looking for a good opportunity to betray Him.
17. 除酵節的第一日，門徒們前來問耶穌：「你要我們到哪裡去預備，好讓你吃逾越節的晚餐呢？」 On the first day of Unleavened Bread the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Where do You want us to prepare the Passover so You may eat it?"
18. 耶穌說： 「你們進城去，到某人那裡，告訴他：『老師說，我的時候快到了。我要在你那裡與我的門徒們一起守逾越節。』」 "Go into the city to a certain man," He said, "and tell him, 'The Teacher says: My time is near; I am celebrating the Passover at your place with My disciples. '"
19. 門徒們就依照耶穌所吩咐的去做，預備了逾越節的晚餐。 So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
20. 到了晚上，耶穌與十二使徒一同坐席。 When evening came, He was reclining at the table with the Twelve.
21. 在他們吃的時候，耶穌說： 「我確實地告訴你們：你們當中有一個人要出賣我。」 While they were eating, He said, "I assure you: One of you will betray Me."
22. 他們極其憂傷，就一個一個地開始問耶穌：「主啊，不會是我吧？」 Deeply distressed, each one began to say to Him, "Surely not I, Lord?"
23. 耶穌回答說： 「那與我一同把手蘸在盤子裡的，就是要出賣我的人。 He replied, "The one who dipped his hand with Me in the bowl-- he will betray Me.
24. 人子確實要離去，正如經上指著他所寫的，但是出賣人子的那個人有禍了。對他來說，沒有出生倒好。」 The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born."
25. 那出賣耶穌的 猶大 應聲說：「拉比，不會是我吧？」 耶穌對他說： 「你已經說了。」 Then Judas, His betrayer, replied, "Surely not I, Rabbi?" "You have said it," He told him.
26. 在他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝福了，就掰開，遞給門徒們，說： 「你們領受吃吧，這是我的身體。」 As they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed and broke it, gave it to the disciples, and said, "Take and eat it; this is My body."
27. 接著，他拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們，說： 「你們都來喝， Then He took a cup, and after giving thanks, He gave it to them and said, "Drink from it, all of you.
28. 因為這是我的血，是為立約 的，為許多人所流的，使罪得赦免。 For this is My blood [that establishes] the covenant; it is shed for many for the forgiveness of sins.
29. 我告訴你們：從今以後我絕不喝這葡萄汁，直到我在我父的國裡與你們一起喝新的那一天。」 But I tell you, from this moment I will not drink of this fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it in a new way in My Father's kingdom with you."
30. 他們唱了讚美詩，就出來，往 橄欖山 去了。 After singing psalms, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
31. 那時，耶穌對他們說： 「今天晚上，你們都將因我被絆倒，因為經上記著： 『我將擊打牧人， 群羊就被分散。』 Then Jesus said to them, "Tonight all of you will run away because of Me, for it is written: I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.
32. 但是我復活以後，要在你們之前到 加利利 去。」 But after I have been resurrected, I will go ahead of you to Galilee."
33. 彼得 對耶穌說：「即使所有的人因你被絆倒，我也絕不會被絆倒。」 Peter told Him, "Even if everyone runs away because of You, I will never run away!"
34. 耶穌對他說： 「我確實地告訴你：今天晚上雞叫以前，你會三次不認我。」 "I assure you," Jesus said to him, "tonight-- before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times!"
35. 彼得 對耶穌說：「即使我必須與你同死，我也絕不會不認你。」所有的門徒也都如此說。 "Even if I have to die with You," Peter told Him, "I will never deny You!" And all the disciples said the same thing.
36. 隨後，耶穌與他們來到一個叫 客西馬尼 的地方。耶穌對門徒們說： 「我走開在那裡禱告的時候，你們坐在這裡。」 Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and He told the disciples, "Sit here while I go over there and pray."
37. 他帶了 彼得 和 西庇太 的兩個兒子一起去，開始感到憂慮，極其難過， Taking along Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, He began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
38. 就對他們說： 「我的靈魂很憂傷，幾乎要死。你們留在這裡，與我一同警醒。」 Then He said to them, "My soul is swallowed up in sorrow-- to the point of death. Remain here and stay awake with Me."
39. 耶穌稍往前走，把臉伏在地上禱告說： 「我父啊，如果有可能，讓這杯離開我吧！但不要照我的意願，而要照你的意願。」 Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, "My Father! If it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will."
40. 耶穌回到門徒們那裡，看見他們睡著了，就對 彼得 說： 「你們怎麼就不能與我一同警醒一個小時呢？ Then He came to the disciples and found them sleeping. He asked Peter. "So, couldn't you stay awake with Me one hour?
41. 要警醒禱告，免得陷入試探。你們心靈雖然願意，肉體卻是軟弱的。」 Stay awake and pray, so that you won't enter into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."
42. 耶穌第二次又去禱告說： 「我父啊，如果這杯不能離開我，一定要我喝下，那就願你的旨意成就！」 Again, a second time, He went away and prayed, "My Father, if this cannot pass unless I drink it, Your will be done."
43. 他又回來，看見他們在睡覺，因為他們的眼皮發沉。 And He came again and found them sleeping, because they could not keep their eyes open.
44. 耶穌又離開他們，第三次去禱告，又說了同樣的話。 After leaving them, He went away again and prayed a third time, saying the same thing once more.
45. 然後，他回到門徒們那裡，對他們說： 「你們還在睡覺、休息嗎？看哪，時候快到了！人子被交在 罪人的手裡了。 Then He came to the disciples and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the time is near. The Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
46. 起來，我們走吧！看，那出賣我的人快到了！」 Get up; let's go! See-- My betrayer is near."
47. 耶穌還在說話的時候，忽然十二使徒之一的 猶大 來了。有一大群人拿著刀劍和棍棒與他一起來，他們是祭司長們和民間的長老們所派來的。 While He was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, suddenly arrived. A large mob, with swords and clubs, was with him from the chief priests and elders of the people.
48. 那出賣耶穌的人已經和他們定了一個暗號，說：「我如果親吻誰，誰就是那個人。你們把他抓住。」 His betrayer had given them a sign: "The One I kiss, He's the One; arrest Him!"
49. 猶大 立刻上前來對耶穌說：「拉比，願你歡喜！」然後親吻了他。 So he went right up to Jesus and said, "Greetings, Rabbi!"-- and kissed Him.
50. 耶穌對他說： 「朋友，你為什麼來到這裡？」 於是，那些人上前來，下手拘捕了耶穌。 "Friend," Jesus asked him, "why have you come?" Then they came up, took hold of Jesus, and arrested Him.
51. 這時候，忽然有一個與耶穌在一起的人伸手拔出刀來，向大祭司的奴僕砍去，削掉了他的一個耳朵。 At that moment one of those with Jesus reached out his hand and drew his sword. He struck the high priest's slave and cut off his ear.
52. 耶穌就對他說： 「把你的刀收回原處！因為凡動刀的，必死在刀下。 Then Jesus told him, "Put your sword back in place because all who take up a sword will perish by a sword.
53. 難道你想我不能求我父，現在就為我派來十二個軍團以上的天使嗎？ Or do you think that I cannot call on My Father, and He will provide Me at once with more than 12 legions of angels?
54. 如果這樣，『事情必須如此發生』的經文怎麼應驗呢？」 How, then, would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?"
55. 這時候，耶穌對那群人說： 「你們帶著刀劍和棍棒出來抓我，就像對付強盜那樣嗎？我天天坐在聖殿裡教導人，你們並沒有抓我。 At that time Jesus said to the crowds, "Have you come out with swords and clubs, as if I were a criminal, to capture Me? Every day I used to sit, teaching in the temple complex, and you didn't arrest Me.
56. 不過這整個事的發生，是為要應驗先知書的那些經文。」 這時候，所有的門徒都離開他，逃跑了。 But all this has happened so that the prophetic Scriptures would be fulfilled." Then all the disciples deserted Him and ran away.
57. 拘捕耶穌的人把他帶到大祭司 該亞法 那裡。經文士們和長老們已經聚集在那裡了。 Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had convened.
58. 彼得 遠遠地跟著耶穌，一直到大祭司的院子。他進到裡面，與差役們坐在一起，想看看結果如何。 Meanwhile, Peter was following Him at a distance right to the high priest's courtyard. He went in and was sitting with the temple police to see the outcome.
59. 當時，祭司長們 和全議會的人為了要處死耶穌，都在尋找偽證來控告他。 The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false testimony against Jesus so they could put Him to death.
60. 雖然有許多假見證人上前來，可是他們找不出什麼。後來有兩個人 上前來， But they could not find any, even though many false witnesses came forward. Finally, two who came forward
61. 說：「這個人說過：『我能拆毀神的聖所，三天內又建起來。』」 stated, "This man said, 'I can demolish God's sanctuary and rebuild it in three days.'"
62. 於是大祭司就站起來，問耶穌：「對這些人控告你的事，你什麼都不回應嗎？」 The high priest then stood up and said to Him, "Don't You have an answer to what these men are testifying against You?"
63. 耶穌卻沉默不語。大祭司又對他說：「我命令你指著永生的神起誓，告訴我們你是不是基督——神的兒子？」 But Jesus kept silent. Then the high priest said to Him, "By the living God I place You under oath: tell us if You are the Messiah, the Son of God!"
64. 耶穌回答他，說： 「你已經說了。不過我告訴你們：將來你們會看見 人子坐在 全能者的 右邊，在天上的雲彩中來臨。 」 "You have said it," Jesus told him. "But I tell you, in the future you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of the Power and coming on the clouds of heaven."
65. 大祭司就撕裂自己的衣服，說：「他說了褻瀆的話！難道我們還需要什麼見證人嗎？看，現在你們都聽見了這褻瀆的話。 Then the high priest tore his robes and said, "He has blasphemed! Why do we still need witnesses? Look, now you've heard the blasphemy!
66. 你們怎麼看？」 他們回答說：「他是該死的！」 What is your decision?" They answered, "He deserves death!"
67. 當時他們就往他臉上吐唾沫，用拳頭打他，也有人用手掌打他， Then they spit in His face and beat Him; others slapped Him
68. 說：「給我們說預言吧！基督！打你的是誰？」 and said, "Prophesy to us, Messiah! Who hit You?"
69. 彼得 坐在外面的院子裡，有一個女僕過來對他說：「你也與那個 加利利 人耶穌是一夥的。」 Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. A servant approached him and she said, "You were with Jesus the Galilean too."
70. 彼得 卻在眾人面前否認說：「我不知道你在說什麼。」 But he denied it in front of everyone: "I don't know what you're talking about!"
71. 他出去到門口，另有一個女僕看見他，對那裡的人說：「這個人與 拿撒勒 人耶穌是一夥的。」 When he had gone out to the gateway, another woman saw him and told those who were there, "This man was with Jesus the Nazarene!"
72. 彼得 又起誓否認說：「我不認識那個人！」 And again he denied it with an oath, "I don't know the man!"
73. 過了一會兒，旁邊站著的人過來對 彼得 說：「你真的也是與他們一夥的，因為連你的口音也把你暴露了。」 After a little while those standing there approached and said to Peter, "You certainly are one of them, since even your accent gives you away."
74. 彼得 就開始賭咒並起誓說：「我不認識那個人！」立時，雞就叫了。 Then he started to curse and to swear with an oath, "I do not know the man!" Immediately a rooster crowed,
75. 彼得 想起耶穌說過的話： 「雞叫以前，你會三次不認我」，就到外面去，痛哭起來。 and Peter remembered the words Jesus had spoken, "Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times." And he went outside and wept bitterly.
Matthew 27
1. 到了清晨，所有的祭司長和民間的長老商議對付耶穌，為要處死他。 When daybreak came, all the chief priests and the elders of the people plotted against Jesus to put Him to death.
2. 他們把耶穌捆起來帶走，交給總督 彼拉多 。 After tying Him up, they led Him away and handed Him over to Pilate, the governor.
3. 這時候，那出賣耶穌的 猶大 看見耶穌被定了死罪，就後悔，去把三十個銀錢退還給祭司長們和長老們， Then Judas, His betrayer, seeing that He had been condemned, was full of remorse and returned the 30 pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.
4. 說：「我出賣了無辜人的血，我有罪了。」 但是他們說：「這與我們有什麼關係？你自己看著辦吧！」 "I have sinned by betraying innocent blood," he said. "What's that to us?" they said. "See to it yourself!"
5. 猶大 把銀錢丟在聖所裡就退了出來，去上吊自殺了。 So he threw the silver into the sanctuary and departed. Then he went and hanged himself.
6. 祭司長們撿起銀錢，說：「這既然是血錢，不可以放到聖殿奉獻裡。」 The chief priests took the silver and said, "It's not lawful to put it into the temple treasury, since it is blood money."
7. 他們商議之後，就用那錢買了陶匠的一塊地，做為外國人的墳地。 So they conferred together and bought the potter's field with it as a burial place for foreigners.
8. 因此，那塊地就被稱為「血田」，直到今天。 Therefore that field has been called "Blood Field" to this day.
9. 這就應驗了藉著先知 耶利米 所說的話： 「他們拿了那三十個銀錢，就是那人被定的價錢，是 以色列 子民所定的； Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled: They took the 30 pieces of silver, the price of Him whose price was set by the sons of Israel,
10. 他們用這錢買了陶匠的那塊地，正如主所指示我的。」 and they gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord directed me.
11. 耶穌站在總督面前，總督問他，說：「你是 猶太 人的王嗎？」 耶穌說： 「是你說的。」 Now Jesus stood before the governor. "Are You the King of the Jews?" the governor asked Him. Jesus answered, "You have said it."
12. 可是當他被祭司長們和長老們控告的時候，什麼都不回應。 And while He was being accused by the chief priests and elders, He didn't answer.
13. 彼拉多 對他說：「他們控告你這麼多的事，你沒有聽見嗎？」 Then Pilate said to Him, "Don't You hear how much they are testifying against You?"
14. 耶穌連一句話也不回答，以致總督感到非常驚奇。 But He didn't answer him on even one charge, so that the governor was greatly amazed.
15. 每逢這節日，總督會照慣例，給民眾釋放一個他們所要的囚犯。 At the festival the governor's custom was to release to the crowd a prisoner they wanted.
16. 那時有一個出名的囚犯，叫 巴拉巴 。 At that time they had a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.
17. 當民眾聚集的時候， 彼拉多 問他們：「你們要我給你們釋放哪一個呢？是 巴拉巴，還是那稱為基督的耶穌？」 So when they had gathered together, Pilate said to them, "Who is it you want me to release for you-- Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Messiah?"
18. 其實 彼拉多 知道他們是出於嫉妒才把耶穌交給他的。 For he knew they had handed Him over because of envy.
19. 彼拉多 正坐在審判席上，他的妻子派人到他那裡說：「這義人的事，你什麼也不要管。要知道，我今天因他的緣故，在夢中受了很多苦。」 While he was sitting on the judge's bench, his wife sent word to him, "Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for today I've suffered terribly in a dream because of Him!"
20. 祭司長們和長老們挑唆眾人，叫他們要 巴拉巴，而除滅耶穌。 The chief priests and the elders, however, persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to execute Jesus.
21. 總督問他們，說：「這兩個人中，你們要我給你們釋放哪一個呢？」 他們回答說：「 巴拉巴 ！」 The governor asked them, "Which of the two do you want me to release for you?" "Barabbas!" they answered.
22. 彼拉多 對他們說：「那麼，我該怎麼處理這稱為基督的耶穌呢？」 他們都說：「把他釘上十字架！」 Pilate asked them, "What should I do then with Jesus, who is called Messiah?" They all answered, "Crucify Him!"
23. 彼拉多 說：「他到底做了什麼惡事呢？」但他們卻越發喊叫說：「把他釘上十字架！」 Then he said, "Why? What has He done wrong?" But they kept shouting, "Crucify Him!" all the more.
24. 彼拉多 知道自己無濟於事，反而騷亂倒要發生，就拿水在眾人面前洗手，說：「流這人 的血，罪不在我，你們自己看著辦吧！」 When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that a riot was starting instead, he took some water, washed his hands in front of the crowd, and said, "I am innocent of this man's blood. See to it yourselves!"
25. 全體民眾都回答說：「他的血歸在我們和我們兒女的身上！」 All the people answered, "His blood be on us and on our children!"
26. 於是 彼拉多 給他們釋放了 巴拉巴，然後將耶穌鞭打 了，把他交出去釘上十字架。 Then he released Barabbas to them. But after having Jesus flogged, he handed Him over to be crucified.
27. 那時，總督的士兵們把耶穌帶進總督府，召集了全隊士兵在他周圍。 Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into headquarters and gathered the whole company around Him.
28. 他們剝下耶穌的衣服，給他套上一件深紅色的袍子， They stripped Him and dressed Him in a scarlet robe.
29. 用荊棘編了冠冕，戴在他的頭上，又把一根蘆葦放在他的右手裡，然後跪在他面前，戲弄他說：「萬歲， 猶太 人的王！」 They twisted together a crown of thorns, put it on His head, and placed a reed in His right hand. And they knelt down before Him and mocked Him: "Hail, King of the Jews!"
30. 接著向他吐唾沫，拿蘆葦打他的頭。 Then they spit at Him, took the reed, and kept hitting Him on the head.
31. 他們戲弄完了，就脫下他深紅色的袍子，給他穿上他自己的衣服，然後把他帶走，要釘上十字架。 When they had mocked Him, they stripped Him of the robe, put His clothes on Him, and led Him away to crucify Him.
32. 他們出去的時候，遇見一個名叫 西門 的 古利奈 人，就強迫這個人來背耶穌的十字架。 As they were going out, they found a Cyrenian man named Simon. They forced this man to carry His cross.
33. 他們來到一個地方，叫「 各各他 」——這意思是「骷髏地」； When they came to a place called Golgotha (which means Skull Place),
34. 他們把膽汁調和的酒 給耶穌喝。耶穌嘗了，不肯喝。 they gave Him wine mixed with gall to drink. But when He tasted it, He would not drink it.
35. 他們把耶穌釘上十字架以後，抽籤分了他的衣服， After crucifying Him they divided His clothes by casting lots.
36. 然後坐在那裡看守著他， Then they sat down and were guarding Him there.
37. 又在他的頭上方，安了他的罪狀牌，上面寫道：「這是耶穌， 猶太 人的王。」 Above His head they put up the charge against Him in writing: THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS
38. 那時，有兩個強盜與耶穌一起被釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。 Then two criminals were crucified with Him, one on the right and one on the left.
39. 那些路過的人辱罵耶穌，搖著頭， Those who passed by were yelling insults at Him, shaking their heads
40. 說：「你這個要拆毀聖所、三天內又建起來的人哪，救救你自己吧！你如果是神的兒子，就從十字架上下來吧！」 and saying, "The One who would demolish the sanctuary and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!"
41. 同樣，祭司長們也與經文士們和長老們 一起嘲笑，說： In the same way the chief priests, with the scribes and elders, mocked Him and said,
42. 「他救了別人，卻不能救自己！他是 以色列 的王！現在讓他從十字架上下來吧，這樣我們就信靠他！ "He saved others, but He cannot save Himself! He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
43. 他依靠神，如果神喜悅他，就讓神現在救他吧！因為他說過『我是神的兒子。』」 He has put His trust in God; let God rescue Him now-- if He wants Him! For He said, 'I am God's Son.'"
44. 與耶穌一起被釘十字架的強盜也同樣地責罵他。 In the same way even the criminals who were crucified with Him kept taunting Him.
45. 從中午十二點 起，黑暗籠罩了整個大地，一直到下午三點 。 From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over the whole land.
46. 下午三點左右，耶穌大聲呼叫： 「以利，以利！拉瑪撒巴克達尼？ 」 ——這意思是： 「我的神，我的神！你為什麼離棄我？」 At about three in the afternoon Jesus cried out with a loud voice, " El�, El�, lem� sabachth�ni? " that is, " My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"
47. 站在那裡的一些人聽見了，就說：「這個人在呼喚 以利亞 呢！」 When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "He's calling for Elijah!"
48. 其中有一個人立刻跑去，拿了海綿蘸滿了酸酒，套在蘆葦上，要給他喝。 Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge, filled it with sour wine, fixed it on a reed, and offered Him a drink.
49. 其他的人說：「等著吧，我們看 以利亞 會不會來救他。」 But the rest said, "Let's see if Elijah comes to save Him!"
50. 耶穌又大喊一聲，就交出了靈魂。 Jesus shouted again with a loud voice and gave up His spirit.
51. 忽然，聖所裡的幔子從上到下裂成兩半。大地震動，岩石裂開。 Suddenly, the curtain of the sanctuary was split in two from top to bottom; the earth quaked and the rocks were split.
52. 墳墓也開了，許多已睡了的聖徒的身體復活了。 The tombs also were opened and many bodies of the saints who had gone to their rest were raised.
53. 耶穌復活以後，他們從墳墓裡出來，進了聖城，向許多人顯現。 And they came out of the tombs after His resurrection, entered the holy city, and appeared to many.
54. 百夫長和那些與他一起看守耶穌的人，看見地震和所發生的事，就極其懼怕，說：「這個人真是神的兒子！」 When the centurion and those with him, who were guarding Jesus, saw the earthquake and the things that had happened, they were terrified and said, "This man really was God's Son!"
55. 那裡有許多婦女從遠處觀看，她們從 加利利 開始就跟隨耶穌，服事他。 Many women who had followed Jesus from Galilee and ministered to Him were there, looking on from a distance.
56. 其中有 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 、 雅各 和 約西 的母親 瑪麗亞，以及 西庇太 兒子們的母親。 Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.
57. 到了傍晚，來了一個 亞利馬太 的財主，名叫 約瑟，他自己也是耶穌的門徒。 When it was evening, a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph came, who himself had also become a disciple of Jesus.
58. 他來到 彼拉多 面前，請求要耶穌的遺體， 彼拉多 就下令給他。 He approached Pilate and asked for Jesus' body. Then Pilate ordered that it be released.
59. 約瑟 領了耶穌的遺體，用潔白的細麻布裹好， So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in clean, fine linen,
60. 安放在自己的新墓穴裡，這墓穴是他鑿在岩石裡的。他又滾來一塊大石頭，堵住墓穴口，就離開了。 and placed it in his new tomb, which he had cut into the rock. He left after rolling a great stone against the entrance of the tomb.
61. 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 和另一個 瑪麗亞 在那裡，對著墳墓坐著。 Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were seated there, facing the tomb.
62. 第二天，就是預備日的後一天，祭司長們和 法利賽 人在 彼拉多 那裡聚集， The next day, which followed the preparation day, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate
63. 說：「大人，我們想起當那個迷惑人的還活著時曾經說過：『在第三天我要復活。』 and said, "Sir, we remember that while this deceiver was still alive, He said, 'After three days I will rise again.'
64. 所以，請你下令嚴密看守那墳墓，一直到第三天，免得他的門徒們 來把他偷走，然後對民眾說他從死人中復活了，這樣，那最後的迷惑就要比先前的更厲害了。」 Therefore give orders that the tomb be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come, steal Him, and tell the people, 'He has been raised from the dead.' Then the last deception will be worse than the first."
65. 彼拉多 對他們說：「你們有一隊衛兵，盡你們所能，嚴密看守吧！」 "You have a guard [of soldiers]," Pilate told them. "Go and make it as secure as you know how."
66. 於是，他們帶著衛兵去，用印封上墓口的 石頭，嚴密看守墳墓。 Then they went and made the tomb secure by sealing the stone and setting the guard.
Matthew 28
1. 過了安息日，在一週的頭一天，黎明的時候， 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 和另一個 瑪麗亞 來看墳墓。 After the Sabbath, as the first day of the week was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to view the tomb.
2. 忽然發生了強烈的地震，主的一位天使從天上降下來，上前把那石頭 滾開，坐在上面。 Suddenly there was a violent earthquake, because an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and approached [the tomb]. He rolled back the stone and was sitting on it.
3. 他的容貌像閃電，衣服潔白如雪。 His appearance was like lightning, and his robe was as white as snow.
4. 看守的衛兵們因怕天使就渾身發抖，變得像死人那樣。 The guards were so shaken from fear of him that they became like dead men.
5. 天使對婦女們說：「你們不要怕！我知道你們是在尋找被釘十字架的耶穌。 But the angel told the women, "Don't be afraid, because I know you are looking for Jesus who was crucified.
6. 他不在這裡，因為他已經復活 了，正如他所說過的。你們來看安放他 的地方。 He is not here! For He has been resurrected, just as He said. Come and see the place where He lay.
7. 趕快去告訴他的門徒們：『他從死人中復活了。看哪，他要在你們之前到 加利利 去。在那裡，你們將見到他。』看哪，我已經告訴你們了！」 Then go quickly and tell His disciples, 'He has been raised from the dead. In fact, He is going ahead of you to Galilee; you will see Him there.' Listen, I have told you."
8. 她們立即離開墓穴，又懼怕，又大大歡喜，跑去告訴耶穌的門徒們。 So, departing quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, they ran to tell His disciples the news.
9. 這時候，忽然耶穌迎面而來，說： 「願你們歡喜！」 她們就上前來抱住他的腳拜他。 Just then Jesus met them and said, "Good morning!" They came up, took hold of His feet, and worshiped Him.
10. 耶穌對她們說： 「不要怕！去告訴我的弟兄們，要他們到 加利利 去。在那裡，他們將見到我。」 Then Jesus told them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell My brothers to leave for Galilee, and they will see Me there."
11. 她們離去的時候，正好有一些衛兵進了城，把所發生的事都報告給祭司長們。 As they were on their way, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
12. 祭司長們就與長老們一起聚集商議，給了士兵們許多銀錢， After the priests had assembled with the elders and agreed on a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money
