13. 說：「你們要說：『他的門徒們夜裡來，趁我們睡著的時候，把他偷走了。』 and told them, "Say this, 'His disciples came during the night and stole Him while we were sleeping.'
14. 如果這事被總督聽見了，我們會說服他，保證你們無事。」 If this reaches the governor's ears, we will deal with him and keep you out of trouble."
15. 士兵們收了銀錢，就照所指示的去做。於是這說法就流傳在 猶太 人當中，直到今天。 So they took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been spread among Jewish people to this day.
16. 十一個門徒往 加利利 去，到了耶穌給他們指定的那座山上。 The 11 disciples traveled to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had directed them.
17. 他們看見耶穌，就拜他，不過還有人疑惑。 When they saw Him, they worshiped, but some doubted.
18. 耶穌前來，對他們說： 「天上和地上所有的權柄都賜給我了。 Then Jesus came near and said to them, "All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth.
19. 所以你們要去，使萬民成為我的門徒；奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗 ； Go, therefore, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
20. 凡我所吩咐你們的，都教導他們遵守。看哪，我就天天都與你們同在，直到這世代的終結。」 teaching them to observe everything I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age."
Mark
Mark 1
1. 神的兒子耶穌基督福音的開始 。 The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
2. 正如先知 以賽亞 書上所記載的： 「看哪，我要差派我的使者在你前頭， 他要 預備你的道 。 As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: Look, I am sending My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.
3. 在曠野有聲音呼喊著： 『你們當預備主的道， 當修直 他的路！』 」 A voice of one crying out in the wilderness: "Prepare the way for the Lord; make His paths straight!"
4. 於是 約翰 就來了。他在曠野施洗，並宣講為罪得赦免而悔改的洗禮。 John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
5. 全 猶太 地區和整個 耶路撒冷 的人，都出來到他那裡，承認自己的罪孽，在 約旦 河裡受他的洗禮 。 The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem were flocking to him, and they were baptized by him in the Jordan River as they confessed their sins.
6. 約翰 穿的是駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲和野蜜。 John wore a camel-hair garment with a leather belt around his waist and ate locusts and wild honey.
7. 他宣講，說：「在我之後，有一位比我更強有力的要來。我就是彎腰為他解鞋帶也不配。 He was preaching: "Someone more powerful than I will come after me. I am not worthy to stoop down and untie the strap of His sandals.
8. 我用水 給你們施洗，但他要用聖靈給你們施洗。」 I have baptized you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
9. 在那些日子裡，耶穌從 加利利 的 拿撒勒 來，在 約旦 河裡受 約翰 的洗禮 。 In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized in the Jordan by John.
10. 耶穌一從水裡上來，就看見諸天裂開了，聖靈好像鴿子降臨在他身上。 As soon as He came up out of the water, He saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending to Him like a dove.
11. 這時候，有聲音從諸天傳來，說： 「你是我的愛子， 我喜悅你。」 And a voice came from heaven: You are My beloved Son; I take delight in You!
12. 聖靈立刻催促耶穌到曠野裡去。 Immediately the Spirit drove Him into the wilderness.
13. 他在曠野裡四十天，受 撒旦 的試探。他與野獸在一起，並有天使們伺候他。 He was in the wilderness 40 days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels began to serve Him.
14. 約翰 被逮捕以後，耶穌來到 加利利，傳神的 福音， After John was arrested, Jesus went to Galilee, preaching the good news of God:
15. 說： 「日期滿了，神的國近了！你們應當悔改，相信福音！」 "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe in the good news!"
16. 耶穌從 加利利 湖 邊經過，看見 西門 和他弟弟 安得烈，正在湖裡撒網；他們本來是漁夫。 As He was passing along by the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew, Simon's brother. They were casting a net into the sea, since they were fishermen.
17. 耶穌就對他們說： 「來跟從我！我將要使你們成為得人的漁夫。」 "Follow Me," Jesus told them, "and I will make you fish for people!"
18. 他們立刻捨棄漁網，跟從了耶穌。 Immediately they left their nets and followed Him.
19. 稍往前走，耶穌看見 西庇太 的兒子 雅各 和他弟弟 約翰 。他們正在船上修補漁網。 Going on a little farther, He saw James the son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in their boat mending their nets.
20. 耶穌隨即召喚他們。他們就離開了在船上的父親 西庇太 和雇工們，並且跟著耶穌去了。 Immediately He called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
21. 他們來到 迦百農 。安息日一到，耶穌就進了會堂教導人。 Then they went into Capernaum, and right away He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
22. 眾人對耶穌的教導都驚嘆不已，因為他教導他們，就像有權柄的人，不像經文士們。 They were astonished at His teaching because, unlike the scribes, He was teaching them as one having authority.
23. 忽然，在他們的會堂裡，有一個被汙靈附身的人喊叫， Just then a man with an unclean spirit was in their synagogue. He cried out,
24. 說：「 拿撒勒 人耶穌，我們與你有什麼關係？你來毀滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，你是神的那位聖者。」 "What do You have to do with us, Jesus-- Nazarene? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are-- the Holy One of God!"
25. 耶穌斥責汙靈說： 「住口！從這個人裡面出來！」 But Jesus rebuked him and said, "Be quiet, and come out of him!"
26. 汙靈使那個人抽瘋，然後大聲喊叫著從他裡面出來了。 And the unclean spirit convulsed him, shouted with a loud voice, and came out of him.
27. 結果大家都驚訝不已，彼此談論說：「這是怎麼回事？！一個帶有權柄的新的教導！他命令汙靈，汙靈就都聽從他！」 Then they were all amazed, so they began to argue with one another, saying, "What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him."
28. 於是耶穌的消息很快地傳遍了 加利利 周圍所有的地區。 His fame then spread throughout the entire vicinity of Galilee.
29. 他們從會堂出來，隨即到 西門 和 安得烈 的家去， 雅各 和 約翰 也一起去。 As soon as they left the synagogue, they went into Simon and Andrew's house with James and John.
30. 西門 的岳母正發燒躺著，他們立刻把她的事告訴耶穌。 Simon's mother-in-law was lying in bed with a fever, and they told Him about her at once.
31. 耶穌上前去，握著她的手，扶她起來，燒就 退了。於是她就服事他們。 So He went to her, took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
32. 到了傍晚，日落的時候，人們帶著所有患病的、有鬼魔附身的，到耶穌那裡去。 When evening came, after the sun had set, they began bringing to Him all those who were sick and those who were demon-possessed.
33. 全城的人都聚集在門前。 The whole town was assembled at the door,
34. 耶穌就使許多患有各種疾病的人痊癒，又驅趕了很多鬼魔。他不准鬼魔說話，因為那些鬼魔知道他是誰。 and He healed many who were sick with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not permit the demons to speak, because they knew Him.
35. 大清早，天還沒亮，耶穌就起來，走出去，到一個荒僻的地方，在那裡禱告。 Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, He got up, went out, and made His way to a deserted place. And He was praying there.
36. 西門 和那些與他在一起的人去尋找耶穌， Simon and his companions went searching for Him.
37. 找到了，就對他說：「大家都在找你呢！」 They found Him and said, "Everyone's looking for You!"
38. 耶穌對他們說： 「我們往別的地方去， 到鄰近的鄉村去吧。我也好在那裡傳道，因為我是為此而來的。」 And He said to them, "Let's go on to the neighboring villages so that I may preach there too. This is why I have come."
39. 於是耶穌在全 加利利 往來，在他們的會堂裡傳道，並且驅趕鬼魔。 So He went into all of Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
40. 有一個痲瘋病人來到耶穌面前，跪下來 懇求他說：「如果你願意，你就能潔淨我。」 Then a man with a serious skin disease came to Him and, on his knees, begged Him: "If You are willing, You can make me clean."
41. 耶穌動了憐憫之心，就伸出手來摸他，說： 「我願意，你潔淨了吧！」 Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched him. "I am willing," He told him. "Be made clean."
42. 痲瘋病立刻離開他，他就被潔淨了。 Immediately the disease left him, and he was healed.
43. 耶穌當下催他離開，並嚴厲地告誡他， Then He sternly warned him and sent him away at once,
44. 說： 「你要注意，對任何人都不要說什麼，只要去把自己給祭司看，並且為了你的潔淨，獻上 摩西 所吩咐的祭物，好對他們做見證。」 telling him, "See that you say nothing to anyone; but go and show yourself to the priest, and offer what Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them."
45. 但那個人一出去，就開始大加宣揚，把這件事傳開了，結果耶穌不能再公開進城，只好留在外面荒僻的地方。可是人們還是從各處來到他那裡。 Yet he went out and began to proclaim it widely and to spread the news, with the result that Jesus could no longer enter a town openly. But He was out in deserted places, and they would come to Him from everywhere.
Mark 2
1. 過了些日子，耶穌又進了 迦百農 。人們聽說他在房子 裡， When He entered Capernaum again after some days, it was reported that He was at home.
2. 許多人就聚集，甚至連門前都沒有空處了。於是耶穌就向他們講道。 So many people gathered together that there was no more room, not even in the doorway, and He was speaking the message to them.
3. 這時候，一些人帶了一個癱瘓的人來到耶穌那裡，是被四個人抬來的； Then they came to Him bringing a paralytic, carried by four men.
4. 但由於人多，無法抬到耶穌面前，他們就把耶穌上方的屋頂拆了。拆通之後，就把躺在墊子上那癱瘓的人縋了下去。 Since they were not able to bring him to Jesus because of the crowd, they removed the roof above where He was. And when they had broken through, they lowered the stretcher on which the paralytic was lying.
5. 耶穌看見他們的信心，就對癱瘓的人說： 「孩子，你的罪孽被赦免了。」 Seeing their faith, Jesus told the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven."
6. 可是，有一些經文士坐在那裡，心裡想： But some of the scribes were sitting there, thinking to themselves:
7. 「這個人怎麼這樣說話呢？他說褻瀆的話！除了神一位之外，誰能赦免罪呢？」 "Why does He speak like this? He's blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
8. 耶穌靈裡立刻知道他們心裡這樣想，就對他們說： 「你們心裡為什麼想這些事呢？ Right away Jesus understood in His spirit that they were reasoning like this within themselves and said to them, "Why are you reasoning these things in your hearts?
9. 對這癱瘓的人說『你的罪孽被赦免了』，或說『你起來，拿起墊子走路』，哪一樣更容易呢？ Which is easier: to say to the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up, pick up your stretcher, and walk'?
10. 不過為要使你們知道人子在地上有赦免罪的權柄——」 耶穌就對癱瘓的人說： But so you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins," He told the paralytic,
11. 「我吩咐你：起來，拿起你的墊子，回家去吧！」 "I tell you: get up, pick up your stretcher, and go home."
12. 那個人就立刻起來，拿起墊子在大家面前出去了。結果大家都驚訝，就榮耀神，說：「我們從來沒有見過這樣的事。」 Immediately he got up, picked up the stretcher, and went out in front of everyone. As a result, they were all astounded and gave glory to God, saying, "We have never seen anything like this!"
13. 後來，耶穌又出去，到了 加利利 湖 邊。眾人都來到他那裡，他就教導他們。 Then Jesus went out again beside the sea. The whole crowd was coming to Him, and He taught them.
14. 耶穌往前走，看見 亞勒腓 的兒子 利未 在稅關坐著。耶穌對他說： 「你跟從我！」 就站起來，跟從了耶穌。 Then, moving on, He saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office, and He said to him, "Follow Me!" So he got up and followed Him.
15. 耶穌在 利未 家裡坐席的時候，許多稅吏和罪人與耶穌及他的門徒們一同坐席，因為有許多這樣的人也跟隨了耶穌。 While He was reclining at the table in Levi's house, many tax collectors and sinners were also guests with Jesus and His disciples, because there were many who were following Him.
16. 有些 法利賽 派的經文士 見耶穌與罪人和稅吏一起吃飯，就對耶穌的門徒們說：「他怎麼與那些稅吏和罪人一起吃飯 呢？」 When the scribes of the Pharisees saw that He was eating with sinners and tax collectors, they asked His disciples, "Why does He eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
17. 耶穌聽見了，就對他們說： 「健康的人不需要醫生，有病的人才需要。我來不是要召喚義人，而是要召喚罪人 。」 When Jesus heard this, He told them, "Those who are well don't need a doctor, but the sick [do need one]. I didn't come to call the righteous, but sinners."
18. 約翰 的門徒們和 法利賽 人 正禁食的時候，有些人來問耶穌：「為什麼 約翰 的門徒們和 法利賽 人的門徒們都禁食，而你的門徒們卻不禁食呢？」 Now John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. People came and asked Him, "Why do John's disciples and the Pharisees' disciples fast, but Your disciples do not fast?"
19. 耶穌對他們說： 「新郎與賓客 在一起的時候，難道賓客能禁食嗎？只要他們與新郎在一起，他們就不能禁食。 Jesus said to them, "The wedding guests cannot fast while the groom is with them, can they? As long as they have the groom with them, they cannot fast.
20. 可是日子將要來到：當新郎從他們中間被帶走的時候，他們那時——在那一天就要禁食了。 But the time will come when the groom is taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
21. 沒有人把沒縮過水的布塊補在舊衣服上。否則所補上的新布會扯壞舊衣服，造成更大的裂口。 No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new patch pulls away from the old cloth, and a worse tear is made.
22. 同樣，也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裡，否則酒 會脹破皮袋，酒和皮袋都糟蹋了 。因此，新酒必須裝 在新皮袋裡。」 And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and the wine is lost as well as the skins. But new wine is for fresh wineskins."
23. 有一次在安息日，耶穌從麥田經過，他的門徒們開始邊走邊摘麥穗。 On the Sabbath He was going through the grainfields, and His disciples began to make their way picking some heads of grain.
24. 有些 法利賽 人對耶穌說：「你看，他們為什麼做安息日不可以做的事呢？」 The Pharisees said to Him, "Look, why are they doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
25. 耶穌對他們說： 「 大衛 和那些與他在一起的人飢餓缺乏時所做的事，難道你們從來沒有讀過嗎？ He said to them, "Have you never read what David and those who were with him did when he was in need and hungry--
26. 在 亞比亞達 任大祭司的時候，他難道不是進了神的殿，吃了陳設餅，還分給與他在一起的人嗎？這餅除了祭司，誰都不可以吃。」 how he entered the house of God in the time of Abiathar the high priest and ate the sacred bread-- which is not lawful for anyone to eat except the priests-- and also gave some to his companions?"
27. 接著，耶穌對他們說： 「安息日是為人而存在的，人不是為安息日而存在的。 Then He told them, "The Sabbath was made for man and not man for the Sabbath.
28. 所以，人子是主，也是安息日的主。」 Therefore the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath."
Mark 3
1. 耶穌又進了會堂。那裡有個人，他的一隻手枯萎了。 Now He entered the synagogue again, and a man was there who had a paralyzed hand.
2. 有些人就密切注意耶穌會不會在安息日使那個人痊癒，這是為要控告耶穌。 In order to accuse Him, they were watching Him closely to see whether He would heal him on the Sabbath.
3. 耶穌對那手枯萎的人說： 「起來，站到中間來！」 He told the man with the paralyzed hand, "Stand before us."
4. 耶穌問他們： 「在安息日可以行善還是作惡，救命還是害命？」 他們卻不做聲。 Then He said to them, "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" But they were silent.
5. 耶穌憤怒地環視他們，又為他們心裡剛硬而憂傷，就對那個人說： 「伸出手來！」 他一伸出來，手就復原了 。 After looking around at them with anger and sorrow at the hardness of their hearts, He told the man, "Stretch out your hand." So he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
6. 那些 法利賽 人就出去，立刻與 希律 黨的人一起商議怎樣對付耶穌，好除滅他。 Immediately the Pharisees went out and started plotting with the Herodians against Him, how they might destroy Him.
7. 耶穌與他的門徒們退到湖 邊，有一大群從 加利利 來的人跟隨他；還有來自 猶太 、 Jesus departed with His disciples to the sea, and a great multitude followed from Galilee, Judea,
8. 耶路撒冷 、 以杜邁亞 、 約旦 河對岸，以及 提爾 和 西頓 周圍的一大群人來到他那裡，因為他們聽說了耶穌所做的事。 Jerusalem, Idumea, beyond the Jordan, and around Tyre and Sidon. The great multitude came to Him because they heard about everything He was doing.
9. 由於人多，耶穌就吩咐他的門徒為他預備一條小船，免得眾人擁擠他。 Then He told His disciples to have a small boat ready for Him, so the crowd would not crush Him.
10. 因為他使許多人痊癒，所以有病痛的人都向他擠過來，想要摸到他。 Since He had healed many, all who had diseases were pressing toward Him to touch Him.
11. 汙靈每當見到耶穌，就俯伏在他面前，喊叫說：「你是神的兒子！」 Whenever the unclean spirits saw Him, those possessed fell down before Him and cried out, "You are the Son of God!"
12. 可是，耶穌嚴厲地斥責它們不要把他傳揚出去。 And He would strongly warn them not to make Him known.
13. 耶穌上了山，召來那些他想要的人，他們就來到他那裡。 Then He went up the mountain and summoned those He wanted, and they came to Him.
14. 於是，耶穌委任了十二個人，稱他們為使徒，是要他們常與他在一起，並要差派他們出去傳道， He also appointed 12-- He also named them apostles-- to be with Him, to send them out to preach,
15. 又使他們有權柄 驅趕鬼魔。 and to have authority to drive out demons.
16. 這樣，他委任了十二使徒 ： 西門 ——耶穌給他起名叫 彼得 ； He appointed the Twelve: To Simon, He gave the name Peter;
17. 西庇太 的兒子 雅各， 雅各 的弟弟 約翰 ——耶穌給他們起名叫「 波阿內格 」—— 這意思是「雷霆之子」； and to James the son of Zebedee, and to his brother John, He gave the name "Boanerges" (that is, "Sons of Thunder");
18. 又有 安得烈， 腓力 和 巴多羅邁， 馬太 和 多馬， 亞勒腓 的兒子 雅各 和 達太， 激進派 的 西門， Andrew; Philip and Bartholomew; Matthew and Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot,
19. 還有那出賣耶穌的 加略 人 猶大 。 and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.
20. 耶穌進了房子，人群又聚集而來，以致他和門徒們連飯 都不能吃。 Then He went home, and the crowd gathered again so that they were not even able to eat.
21. 耶穌的親屬聽說了，就來制止他，因為有人 說他發瘋了。 When His family heard this, they set out to restrain Him, because they said, "He's out of His mind."
22. 從 耶路撒冷 下來的一些經文士說：「他有 別西卜 附身，他是靠鬼魔的王驅趕鬼魔的。」 The scribes who had come down from Jerusalem said, "He has Beelzebul in Him!" and, "He drives out demons by the ruler of the demons!"
23. 耶穌把他們召來，用比喻對他們說： 「 撒旦 怎麼能夠驅趕 呢？ So He summoned them and spoke to them in parables: "How can Satan drive out Satan?
24. 一個國家如果自相紛爭，這個國家就站立不住； If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
25. 一個家庭如果自相紛爭，這個家庭就站立不住； If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
26. 撒旦 如果起來反對自己而紛爭，他不但站立不住，而且要完了。 And if Satan rebels against himself and is divided, he cannot stand but is finished!
27. 「沒有人能進入一個壯士的家搶奪他的東西，如果不先把那壯士捆住，就不能搶奪他的家。 "On the other hand, no one can enter a strong man's house and rob his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he will rob his house.
28. 我確實地告訴你們：人類 的一切罪和褻瀆的話，無論怎樣褻瀆，都能被赦免。 I assure you: People will be forgiven for all sins and whatever blasphemies they may blaspheme.
29. 但如果有人褻瀆聖靈，他永遠得不到赦免，而且必擔當永遠的罪 。」 But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin"--
30. 這話是因為他們說：「他有汙靈附身。」 because they were saying, "He has an unclean spirit."
31. 後來，耶穌的母親和弟弟們來了，站在外面，派人去叫耶穌。 Then His mother and His brothers came, and standing outside, they sent [word] to Him and called Him.
32. 有一群人正圍著耶穌坐著，他們對他說：「看，你母親和弟弟妹妹們 在外面找你。」 A crowd was sitting around Him and told Him, "Look, Your mother, Your brothers, and Your sisters are outside asking for You."
33. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「我的母親、我的弟兄是誰呢？」 He replied to them, "Who are My mother and My brothers?"
34. 他環視坐在他周圍的人，說： 「看，我的母親、我的弟兄！ And looking about at those who were sitting in a circle around Him, He said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!
35. 因為凡是遵行神旨意的人，他才是我的弟兄、姐妹和母親。」 Whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother."
Mark 4
1. 又一次，耶穌開始在湖 邊教導人。有一大群人聚集到他那裡，所以他上了湖中的一條船坐下來。眾人都在岸邊，面對湖站著。 Again He began to teach by the sea, and a very large crowd gathered around Him. So He got into a boat on the sea and sat down, while the whole crowd was on the shore facing the sea.
2. 耶穌用比喻教導他們很多事，在教導時對他們說： He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said to them:
3. 「你們當聽好：看哪，有一個撒種的出去撒種。 "Listen! Consider the sower who went out to sow.
4. 他撒的時候，有的種子落在路邊， 飛鳥來了，就把它吃掉了。 As he sowed, this occurred: Some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
5. 另有落在岩石地上的，那裡沒有多少泥土，它立刻就發芽了，因為土不深； Other seed fell on rocky ground where it didn't have much soil, and it sprang up right away, since it didn't have deep soil.
6. 當太陽升起，它被暴曬，就枯萎了，因為沒有根。 When the sun came up, it was scorched, and since it didn't have a root, it withered.
7. 另有落進荊棘叢裡的，荊棘長起來把它擠住，它就結不出果實了。 Other seed fell among thorns, and the thorns came up and choked it, and it didn't produce a crop.
8. 可是另有落進好土壤裡的，就發芽、生長，不斷地結出果實，結出的有三十倍的、有六十倍的、有一百倍的。」 Still others fell on good ground and produced a crop that increased 30, 60, and 100 times [what was sown]."
9. 耶穌說： 「凡是有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」 Then He said, "Anyone who has ears to hear should listen!"
10. 耶穌獨自一人的時候，跟隨他的人與十二使徒 一起問他這些比喻的意思。 When He was alone with the Twelve, those who were around Him asked Him about the parables.
11. 耶穌對他們說： 「神國的奧祕已經賜給你們了，但是對外人，一切都是用比喻的。 He answered them, "The secret of the kingdom of God has been granted to you, but to those outside, everything comes in parables
12. 這是為要使 『他們看了又看，卻不明白， 聽了又聽，卻不領悟， 免得他們回轉過來， 就 被赦免。』 」 so that they may look and look, yet not perceive; they may listen and listen, yet not understand; otherwise, they might turn back-- and be forgiven."
13. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們不明白這個比喻，又怎麼能領會所有的比喻呢？ Then He said to them: "Do you not understand this parable? How then will you understand any of the parables?
14. 撒種的人所撒的是話語。 The sower sows the word.
15. 那被撒上話語的『路邊之地』是這樣一些人：他們聽了話語以後， 撒旦 就立刻來把那撒在他們心裡 的話語奪走。 These are the ones along the path where the word is sown: when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word sown in them.
16. 那被撒上話語的『岩石地』是這樣一些人：他們一旦聽了這話語，就立刻懷著喜樂的心接受了它； And these are the ones sown on rocky ground: when they hear the word, immediately they receive it with joy.
17. 可是他們裡面沒有根而不能持久，一旦為這話語受患難或逼迫，他們立刻就放棄 了。 But they have no root in themselves; they are short-lived. When affliction or persecution comes because of the word, they immediately stumble.
18. 那被撒進話語的『荊棘叢』是另外一些人，那些人是這樣的：他們聽了這話語， Others are sown among thorns; these are the ones who hear the word,
19. 但今世的各種憂慮、財富的迷惑，以及其他各種欲望紛紛進來把這話語擠住了，他就成了不結果實的。 but the worries of this age, the seduction of wealth, and the desires for other things enter in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
20. 而那被撒上話語的『好土壤』是這樣的人：他們聽了這話語就接受，並且結出果實來，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，也有一百倍的。」 But the ones sown on good ground are those who hear the word, welcome it, and produce a crop: 30, 60, and 100 times [what was sown]."
21. 耶穌又對他們說： 「油燈拿進來，難道是為了放在斗 底下，或床底下嗎？不是為了放在燈臺上嗎？ He also said to them, "Is a lamp brought in to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn't it to be put on a lampstand?
22. 這樣，就算是隱祕的事，也沒有不顯明出來的；即使是隱藏的事，也沒有不顯露出來的。 For nothing is concealed except to be revealed, and nothing hidden except to come to light.
23. 凡是有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」 If anyone has ears to hear, he should listen!"
24. 耶穌又說： 「你們要留心所聽到的。你們用什麼量器 來衡量，也會同樣地被衡量，而且還將加添給你們 ； Then He said to them, "Pay attention to what you hear. By the measure you use, it will be measured and added to you.
25. 因為凡是有的，還要賜給他；凡是沒有的，連他有的也將從他那裡被拿走。」 For to the one who has, it will be given, and from the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away."
26. 耶穌又說： 「神的國就像這樣：有人在地上撒了種子， "The kingdom of God is like this," He said. "A man scatters seed on the ground;
27. 黑夜白晝，或睡或起，他卻不知道那種子怎樣發芽和長大。 he sleeps and rises-- night and day, and the seed sprouts and grows-- he doesn't know how.
28. 大地自然長出五穀 ——先長苗，再吐穗，然後穗上結出飽滿的子粒。 The soil produces a crop by itself-- first the blade, then the head, and then the ripe grain on the head.
29. 當果實成熟的時候，他立刻伸出鐮刀，因為收割的季節到了。」 But as soon as the crop is ready, he sends for the sickle, because harvest has come."
30. 耶穌又說： 「我們把神的國比做什麼呢？用什麼比喻來表明 它呢？ And He said: "How can we illustrate the kingdom of God, or what parable can we use to describe it?
31. 它好像一粒芥菜種子，被種入地裡的時候，比地上所有的種子更小， It's like a mustard seed that, when sown in the soil, is smaller than all the seeds on the ground.
32. 可是被種下去以後，它就長起來，長得比所有蔬菜更大，並且長出大枝子，以致天空的飛鳥能在它的蔭下搭窩。」 And when sown, it comes up and grows taller than all the vegetables, and produces large branches, so that the birds of the sky can nest in its shade."
33. 耶穌照著他們所能聽的，用許多這樣的比喻，向他們講道。 He would speak the word to them with many parables like these, as they were able to understand.
34. 他向眾人講話，沒有不用比喻的。可是，他卻單獨給自己的門徒們解釋一切。 And He did not speak to them without a parable. Privately, however, He would explain everything to His own disciples.
35. 那天晚上，耶穌對門徒們說： 「我們渡到對岸去吧。」 On that day, when evening had come, He told them, "Let's cross over to the other side [of the lake]."
36. 門徒離開眾人，耶穌仍然在船上，他們就把他一同帶去；也有別的船 與他同行。 So they left the crowd and took Him along since He was [already] in the boat. And other boats were with Him.
37. 這時候，起了大風暴，以致波浪打進船裡，船幾乎灌滿了水。 A fierce windstorm arose, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that the boat was already being swamped.
38. 耶穌卻在船尾靠著枕頭睡著了。門徒們叫醒他，說：「老師！我們沒命了，你不管嗎？」 But He was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him up and said to Him, "Teacher! Don't you care that we're going to die?"
39. 耶穌就起來，斥責了風，對浪 說： 「不許做聲！平靜下來！」 於是風就停了，湖面就變得一片平靜。 He got up, rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, "Silence! Be still!" The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
40. 耶穌對門徒們說： 「為什麼膽怯呢？你們還沒有信嗎？」 Then He said to them, "Why are you fearful? Do you still have no faith?"
41. 門徒們就大為驚恐，彼此說：「這個人究竟是誰？連風和浪也聽從他！」 And they were terrified and asked one another, "Who then is this? Even the wind and the sea obey Him!"
Mark 5
1. 他們來到湖 的對岸，進了 格拉森 人的地方。 Then they came to the other side of the sea, to the region of the Gerasenes.
2. 耶穌剛下船，就有一個被汙靈附身的人，從墓地迎著他來。 As soon as He got out of the boat, a man with an unclean spirit came out of the tombs and met Him.
3. 這個人住在墓地裡，沒有人能捆住他，就是用鐵鏈也不行。 He lived in the tombs. No one was able to restrain him any more-- even with chains--
4. 他經常被腳鐐和鐵鏈捆起來，然而他總是掙斷鐵鏈、打碎腳鐐。沒有人能制伏他。 because he often had been bound with shackles and chains, but had snapped off the chains and smashed the shackles. No one was strong enough to subdue him.
5. 不管黑夜白晝，他常常在墓地和山上喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。 And always, night and day, he was crying out among the tombs and in the mountains and cutting himself with stones.
6. 他遠遠地看見耶穌，就跑過去，向他下拜， When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and knelt down before Him.
7. 大聲喊叫說：「至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你有什麼關係？我藉著神懇求你，不要折磨我！」 And he cried out with a loud voice, "What do You have to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God, don't torment me!"
8. 這是因為耶穌對他說： 「你出來，汙靈！離開這個人！」 For He had told him, "Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!"
9. 耶穌問他： 「你叫什麼名字？」 他回答說：「我名叫『 軍團 』，因為我們眾多。」 "What is your name?" He asked him. "My name is Legion," he answered Him, "because we are many."
10. 他一再央求耶穌不要把它們趕出那個地方。 And he kept begging Him not to send them out of the region.
11. 當時，那裡有一大群豬正在附近的山上吃食。 Now a large herd of pigs was there, feeding on the hillside.
12. 那些汙靈 就央求耶穌，說：「求你打發我們到豬群裡，好讓我們進入豬裡面去吧！」 The demons begged Him, "Send us to the pigs, so we may enter them."
13. 耶穌 准許了它們，汙靈就出來，進入豬裡面。那群豬約有兩千頭，牠們從山崖衝到湖裡，在湖裡淹死了。 And He gave them permission. Then the unclean spirits came out and entered the pigs, and the herd of about 2,000 rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned there.
14. 那些放豬的人就逃跑了，去把這事傳到城裡城外。於是人們就來 看發生了什麼事。 The men who tended them ran off and reported it in the town and the countryside, and people went to see what had happened.
15. 他們來到耶穌那裡，看見那曾經有鬼魔附身的，就是被『 軍團 』所附的那個人，穿著衣服，神志清醒地坐著，他們就懼怕起來。 They came to Jesus and saw the man who had been demon-possessed by the legion, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
16. 那些看見的人，把發生在有鬼魔附身的人身上和有關豬群的事，都告訴了大家。 The eyewitnesses described to them what had happened to the demon-possessed man and [told] about the pigs.
17. 他們就開始央求耶穌離開他們的地區。 Then they began to beg Him to leave their region.
18. 耶穌上船的時候，那曾被鬼魔附身的人懇求他，要與他在一起。 As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed kept begging Him to be with Him.
19. 耶穌沒有答應，卻對他說： 「你回家去吧，到你的親友那裡，告訴他們主為你做了什麼，以及他怎樣憐憫你。」 But He would not let him; instead, He told him, "Go back home to your own people, and report to them how much the Lord has done for you and how He has had mercy on you."
20. 於是那個人離開了，開始在 德卡波利斯 地區傳揚耶穌為他做了什麼樣的事。眾人都感到驚奇。 So he went out and began to proclaim in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him, and they were all amazed.
21. 耶穌又上船渡到對岸。有一大群人聚集到他那裡，他就留在湖邊。 When Jesus had crossed over again by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him while He was by the sea.
22. 這時候，來了一個名叫 睚魯 的會堂主管。他一見到耶穌，就俯伏在耶穌腳前， One of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at His feet
23. 迫切地懇求他，說：「我的小女兒快要死了。求你來按手在她身上，好讓她得救治，能活下去。」 and kept begging Him, "My little daughter is at death's door. Come and lay Your hands on her so she can get well and live."
24. 耶穌就與他一起去，有一大群人跟隨耶穌，並擁擠他。 So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd was following and pressing against Him.
25. 有一個婦人，患了十二年的血漏病。 A woman suffering from bleeding for 12 years
26. 她在許多醫生手裡受了很多苦，花盡了她所有的一切，沒有任何效果，反而倒變得更嚴重了。 had endured much under many doctors. She had spent everything she had and was not helped at all. On the contrary, she became worse.
27. 她聽說了耶穌的事，就夾在人群中，從後面摸了一下耶穌的衣服， Having heard about Jesus, she came behind Him in the crowd and touched His robe.
28. 原來她想：「只要我摸到他的衣服，就會得救治。」 For she said, "If I can just touch His robes, I'll be made well!"
29. 立刻，她的血漏就止住了，她也感覺到身體從病痛中痊癒了。 Instantly her flow of blood ceased, and she sensed in her body that she was cured of her affliction.
30. 耶穌自己裡面立刻知道有能力從他而出，就在人群中轉過身來，問： 「誰摸了我的衣服？」 At once Jesus realized in Himself that power had gone out from Him. He turned around in the crowd and said, "Who touched My robes?"
31. 他的門徒們對他說：「你看這群人擁擠著你，你還問『誰摸了我』嗎？」 His disciples said to Him, "You see the crowd pressing against You, and You say, 'Who touched Me?'"
32. 可是耶穌環視周圍，要知道是誰做了這事。 So He was looking around to see who had done this.
33. 那婦人知道發生在自己身上的事，就懼怕起來，戰戰兢兢地上前俯伏在耶穌面前，把真實情況全告訴了他。 Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came with fear and trembling, fell down before Him, and told Him the whole truth.
34. 耶穌對她說： 「女兒，你的信救了你，平平安安地去吧。你從病痛中痊癒了吧！」 "Daughter," He said to her, "your faith has made you well. Go in peace and be free from your affliction."
35. 耶穌還在說話的時候，有些人從會堂主管的家裡來，對 睚魯 說：「你的女兒已經死了，何必再麻煩老師呢？」 While He was still speaking, people came from the synagogue leader's house and said, "Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?"
36. 耶穌卻當做沒聽見他們所說的話，對會堂主管說 ： 「不要怕，只要信！」 But when Jesus overheard what was said, He told the synagogue leader, "Don't be afraid. Only believe."
37. 然後他除了 彼得 、 雅各 和 雅各 的弟弟 約翰 以外，不准別的人跟著。 He did not let anyone accompany Him except Peter, James, and John, James' brother.
38. 他們來到會堂主管的家裡，耶穌看見一片混亂，有人哭泣，有人哀號。 They came to the leader's house, and He saw a commotion-- people weeping and wailing loudly.
39. 耶穌進去對他們說： 「為什麼慌亂哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，而是睡了。」 He went in and said to them, "Why are you making a commotion and weeping? The child is not dead but asleep."
40. 他們就譏笑耶穌。耶穌把他們都趕出去，只帶著孩子的父母和一起來的人，進入孩子所在的地方 。 They started laughing at Him, but He put them all outside. He took the child's father, mother, and those who were with Him, and entered the place where the child was.
41. 他握著孩子的手，對她說： 「塔利達，庫莫！ 」 ——這翻譯出來就是 「小女孩，我吩咐你起來！」 Then He took the child by the hand and said to her, "Talitha koum!" (which is translated, "Little girl, I say to you, get up!").
42. 那女孩隨即起來，開始走動。她那時十二歲。大家立刻目瞪口呆，大為驚訝。 Immediately the girl got up and began to walk. (She was 12 years old.) At this they were utterly astounded.
43. 耶穌鄭重地吩咐他們，不要讓任何人知道這事，又吩咐給孩子吃東西。 Then He gave them strict orders that no one should know about this and said that she should be given something to eat.
Mark 6
1. 耶穌離開那地方，來到自己的家鄉，他的門徒們也跟著他。 He went away from there and came to His hometown, and His disciples followed Him.
2. 到了安息日，他開始在會堂裡教導人。許多人聽了就驚嘆不已，說：「這個人從哪裡得來這些呢？賜給這個人的到底是什麼樣的智慧？藉著他的手所行出來的到底是怎麼樣的神蹟？ When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. "Where did this man get these things?" they said. "What is this wisdom given to Him, and how are these miracles performed by His hands?
3. 這不就是那木匠嗎？不就是 瑪麗亞 的兒子， 雅各 、 約西 、 猶大 和 西門 的哥哥 嗎？他的妹妹們 不也和我們在這裡嗎？」這樣，他們就對耶穌很反感 。 Isn't this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? And aren't His sisters here with us?" So they were offended by Him.
4. 耶穌對他們說： 「先知除了在本鄉、本族、本家以外，沒有不受尊重的。」 Then Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his household."
5. 所以，耶穌無法在那裡行什麼神蹟，只是按手在幾個病人身上，使他們痊癒。 So He was not able to do any miracles there, except that He laid His hands on a few sick people and healed them.
6. 因為他們的不信，耶穌十分感慨。 於是，他就走遍各村莊四處教導人。 And He was amazed at their unbelief. Now He was going around the villages in a circuit, teaching.
7. 耶穌召來十二使徒，開始差派他們兩個兩個地出去，賜給他們權柄勝過汙靈， He summoned the Twelve and began to send them out in pairs and gave them authority over unclean spirits.
8. 並且吩咐他們說： 「在路上除了手杖什麼都不要帶。不要帶食物，不要帶行囊，腰包裡也不要帶錢。 He instructed them to take nothing for the road except a walking stick: no bread, no traveling bag, no money in their belts.
9. 要穿上鞋子。不要穿兩件衣服 。」 They were to wear sandals, but not put on an extra shirt.
10. 他又對他們說： 「無論在哪裡，你們進了一家，就要住在哪裡，直到離開那地方。 Then He said to them, "Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that place.
11. 如果有什麼地方的人不接受你們，也不聽你們，你們離開那裡的時候，要把腳底的塵土跺掉，做為對他們的見證。 」 If any place does not welcome you and people refuse to listen to you, when you leave there, shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them."
12. 使徒們就出去宣講道：人人都當悔改。 So they went out and preached that people should repent.
13. 他們驅趕了很多鬼魔，又用油來膏抹許多病人，使他們痊癒。 And they were driving out many demons, anointing many sick people with oil, and healing.
14. 耶穌的名聲被傳揚出去， 希律 王也聽見了。有些人 說：「施洗者 約翰 從死人中復活了，所以這些能力在他裡面做工。」 King Herod heard of this, because Jesus' name had become well known. Some said, "John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that's why supernatural powers are at work in him."
15. 也有些人說：「他是 以利亞 。」還有些人說：「他是個先知，像古代 先知中的一位。」 But others said, "He's Elijah." Still others said, "He's a prophet-- like one of the prophets."
16. 但 希律 聽了卻說：「是被我砍了頭的 約翰 ！這個人 復活了！」 When Herod heard of it, he said, "John, the one I beheaded, has been raised!"
17. 原來， 希律 為了他弟弟 菲利普 的妻子 希羅迪婭 的緣故，曾經派人去拘捕 約翰，把他捆鎖在監獄裡。 希律 娶了這個女人， For Herod himself had given orders to arrest John and to chain him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, whom he had married.
18. 而 約翰 一直對 希律 說：「你占有自己兄弟的妻子是不可以的。」 John had been telling Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife!"
19. 所以 希羅迪婭 對 約翰 懷恨在心，想要殺他，只是不能。 So Herodias held a grudge against him and wanted to kill him. But she could not,
20. 這是因為 希律 敬畏 約翰，知道他是義人，是聖人，所以保護著他。 希律 聽 約翰 講說的時候，雖然心裡十分困惑，還是樂意聽他的。 because Herod was in awe of John and was protecting him, knowing he was a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard him he would be very disturbed, yet would hear him gladly.
21. 可是時機來了。 希律 在自己生日那天預備宴席，招待他的大臣和軍官們，以及 加利利 的首領們。 Now an opportune time came on his birthday, when Herod gave a banquet for his nobles, military commanders, and the leading men of Galilee.
22. 希羅迪婭 的女兒 進來跳舞，使 希律 和一同坐席的人都非常喜悅。王就對女孩說：「你無論想要什麼，向我求，我就會給你。」 When Herodias' own daughter came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests. The king said to the girl, "Ask me whatever you want, and I'll give it to you."
23. 並且對她鄭重地起誓：「你無論向我求什麼，即使是我國家的一半，我也會給你！」 So he swore oaths to her: "Whatever you ask me I will give you, up to half my kingdom."
24. 於是女孩出去問她母親說：「我應該要什麼呢？」 她母親說：「要施洗者 約翰 的頭！」 Then she went out and said to her mother, "What should I ask for?" "John the Baptist's head!" she said.
25. 女孩隨即趕快進到王那裡，要求說：「我願王立即把施洗者 約翰 的頭放在盤子裡給我。」 Immediately she hurried to the king and said, "I want you to give me John the Baptist's head on a platter-- right now!"
26. 王就變得很憂愁，但因所起的誓，又因坐席的人，就不好拒絕她。 Though the king was deeply distressed, because of his oaths and the guests he did not want to refuse her.
27. 於是王立刻派了劊子手，命令把 約翰 的頭拿來。劊子手就去，在監獄裡砍下了 約翰 的頭， The king immediately sent for an executioner and commanded him to bring John's head. So he went and beheaded him in prison,
28. 把他的頭放在盤子上，端給女孩，女孩就把它交給了母親。 brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl. Then the girl gave it to her mother.
29. 約翰 的門徒們聽到了，就來把他的遺體領去，安放在墳墓裡。 When his disciples heard about it, they came and removed his corpse and placed it in a tomb.
30. 使徒們聚集到耶穌那裡，把他們所做的和教導的一切告訴了他。 The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to Him all that they had done and taught.
31. 耶穌對他們說： 「來，你們自己單獨到一個荒僻的地方休息一會兒吧。」 這是因為來往的人多，他們連吃飯的時間也沒有。 He said to them, "Come away by yourselves to a remote place and rest a while." For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
32. 於是他們悄悄地坐船出發，往一個荒僻的地方去。 So they went away in the boat by themselves to a remote place,
33. 可是眾人 看見他們離開了，並且有許多人認出他們，就從各城鎮一起徒步趕往那裡，而且比他們先到了 。 but many saw them leaving and recognized them. People ran there by land from all the towns and arrived ahead of them.
34. 耶穌下了船，看見一大群人，就對他們動了憐憫之心，因為他們像羊沒有牧人那樣。耶穌就開始教導他們很多事。 So as He stepped ashore, He saw a huge crowd and had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. Then He began to teach them many things.
35. 天已經晚了，他的門徒們來到耶穌面前，說：「這是個荒僻的地方，而且天已經晚了。 When it was already late, His disciples approached Him and said, "This place is a wilderness, and it is already late!
36. 請遣散大家，好讓他們到周圍的田舍和村莊去，為自己買些東西吃 。」 Send them away, so they can go into the surrounding countryside and villages to buy themselves something to eat."
37. 但耶穌回答他們，說： 「你們給他們吃的吧。」 門徒們說：「要我們去買兩百個銀幣 的餅給他們吃嗎？」 "You give them something to eat," He responded. They said to Him, "Should we go and buy 200 denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?"
38. 耶穌問他們： 「你們有多少餅呢？去看看。」 他們察看後，就說：「有五個，還有兩條魚。」 And He asked them, "How many loaves do you have? Go look." When they found out they said, "Five, and two fish."
39. 耶穌吩咐他們，叫眾人一組一組地坐在青草地上。 Then He instructed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.
40. 眾人就一群一群地坐了下來，有的一百人，有的五十人。 So they sat down in ranks of hundreds and fifties.
41. 耶穌拿起這五個餅和兩條魚，抬頭望天，祝福了，然後把餅掰開，不斷遞給他的門徒們，讓他們分給眾人。他把兩條魚也分給大家。 Then He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke the loaves. He kept giving them to His disciples to set before the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.
42. 大家都吃了，並且吃飽了。 Everyone ate and was filled.
43. 他們把餅和魚的碎塊收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。 Then they picked up 12 baskets full of pieces of bread and fish.
44. 吃餅的人，男人就有五千。 Now those who ate the loaves were 5,000 men.
45. 耶穌隨即催促他的門徒們上船，要他們先往對岸的 伯賽達 去；這期間，他自己遣散了人群。 Immediately He made His disciples get into the boat and go ahead of Him to the other side, to Bethsaida, while He dismissed the crowd.
46. 他告別了他們，就上山去禱告。 After He said good-bye to them, He went away to the mountain to pray.
47. 到了晚上，船在湖 中，只有耶穌一個人在岸上。 When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and He was alone on the land.
48. 他看見門徒們由於逆風，划船非常艱苦。天快亮的時候，耶穌在湖面上行走，向他們而去，想要從他們旁邊走過去。 He saw them being battered as they rowed, because the wind was against them. Around three in the morning He came toward them walking on the sea and wanted to pass by them.
49. 門徒們看見耶穌在湖面上行走，以為是幽靈，於是喊叫起來， When they saw Him walking on the sea, they thought it was a ghost and cried out;
50. 因為他們都看見了他，就驚慌不安。耶穌立刻與他們講話，對他們說： 「鼓起勇氣吧！是我，不要怕。」 for they all saw Him and were terrified. Immediately He spoke with them and said, "Have courage! It is I. Don't be afraid."
51. 接著，耶穌上了船和他們在一起。這時候風就停了。門徒們心裡感到極其驚訝， Then He got into the boat with them, and the wind ceased. They were completely astounded,
52. 因為他們不領悟分 餅的事，他們還是硬著心。 because they had not understood about the loaves. Instead, their hearts were hardened.
53. 他們渡過去，到 革尼撒勒 上岸，把船拴好。 When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and beached the boat.
54. 一下船，眾人就認出了耶穌。 As they got out of the boat, people immediately recognized Him.
55. 人們跑遍那整個地區，聽到耶穌在哪裡，就把有病的人用墊子抬到哪裡。 They hurried throughout that vicinity and began to carry the sick on stretchers to wherever they heard He was.
56. 無論耶穌進到哪裡，或村莊、或城鎮、或鄉下，人們就把病人放在街市上，懇求耶穌只要讓他們摸一下他的衣服穗子。凡是摸著的人，都得了救治。 Wherever He would go, into villages, towns, or the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged Him that they might touch just the tassel of His robe. And everyone who touched it was made well.
Mark 7
1. 有些 法利賽 人和一些從 耶路撒冷 來的經文士聚集到耶穌那裡。 The Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Him.
2. 他們看見耶穌的一些門徒用不潔淨的手，就是沒有洗過的手吃飯 。 They observed that some of His disciples were eating their bread with unclean-- that is, unwashed-- hands.
3. 原來， 法利賽 人和所有的 猶太 人都拘守古人的傳統：如果不按規矩 洗手就不吃飯； (For the Pharisees, in fact all the Jews, will not eat unless they wash their hands ritually, keeping the tradition of the elders.
4. 他們從街市上回來，如果不行洗淨禮，也就不吃飯；他們還有很多其他的傳統要拘守，例如洗杯子、瓶子、銅器，甚至床 等。 When they come from the marketplace, they do not eat unless they have washed. And there are many other customs they have received and keep, like the washing of cups, jugs, copper utensils, and dining couches.)
5. 於是， 法利賽 人和經文士就問耶穌：「你的門徒們為什麼不照著古人的傳統行事，用不潔淨的 手吃飯 呢？」 Then the Pharisees and the scribes asked Him, "Why don't Your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders, instead of eating bread with ritually unclean hands?"
6. 耶穌對他們說： 「 以賽亞 指著你們這些偽善的人所說的預言是對的，正如經上所記： 『這子民用嘴唇尊重我， 他們的心卻遠離我。 He answered them, "Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: These people honor Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me.
7. 他們敬拜我也是徒然的， 因為他們把人的規條當做教義教導人 。』 They worship Me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commands of men.
8. 你們離棄了神的命令，而拘守人的傳統 。」 Disregarding the command of God, you keep the tradition of men."
9. 耶穌又對他們說： 「你們為了要守住你們的傳統，竟然棄絕了神的命令！ He also said to them, "You completely invalidate God's command in order to maintain your tradition!
10. 摩西 吩咐過 『你要孝敬你的父母』，又說 『咒罵父親或母親的人，必須處死。』 For Moses said: Honor your father and your mother; and, Whoever speaks evil of father or mother must be put to death.
11. 你們卻說『如果一個人對父親或母親說：我本該給你的，已經做了「各爾板」 ——這意思是「聖殿奉獻」， But you say, 'If a man tells his father or mother: Whatever benefit you might have received from me is Corban ' " (that is, a gift [committed to the temple]),
12. 就准許這個人可以不再為父母做什麼了。』 "you no longer let him do anything for his father or mother.
13. 這樣，你們就藉著所繼承的傳統，廢棄了神的話語 。你們還做很多類似這樣的事。」 You revoke God's word by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many other similar things."
14. 耶穌又 召來眾人，對他們說： 「你們每個人都當聽我說，也當領悟： Summoning the crowd again, He told them, "Listen to Me, all of you, and understand:
15. 從人外面進到他裡面的，沒有一樣能使人 汙穢；相反，從人裡面出來的，才會使人汙穢。 Nothing that goes into a person from outside can defile him, but the things that come out of a person are what defile him.
16. 凡是有耳可聽的，就應當聽！ 」 If anyone has ears to hear, he should listen!"
17. 耶穌離開人群，一進了房子，他的門徒們就問他這比喻的意思。 When He went into the house away from the crowd, the disciples asked Him about the parable.
18. 耶穌說： 「你們也是這樣無知嗎？你們難道不明白一切從外面進到人裡面的，不能使人汙穢嗎？ And He said to them, "Are you also as lacking in understanding? Don't you realize that nothing going into a man from the outside can defile him?
19. 因為這些東西不是進到人的心裡，而是進入肚子，然後排到廁所裡去。」 耶穌這樣就使一切食物都潔淨。 For it doesn't go into his heart but into the stomach and is eliminated." (As a result, He made all foods clean.)
20. 他接著說： 「從人裡面出來的，那才使人汙穢。 Then He said, "What comes out of a person-- that defiles him.
21. 因為從裡面，就是從人心裡發出種種惡念：淫亂、偷竊、殺人、 For from within, out of people's hearts, come evil thoughts, sexual immoralities, thefts, murders,
22. 通姦、貪心、惡意、欺詐、好色、嫉妒、毀謗、驕傲、愚妄， adulteries, greed, evil actions, deceit, lewdness, stinginess, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
23. 這一切邪惡都是從人裡面出來的，而且使人汙穢。」 All these evil things come from within and defile a person."
24. 耶穌起身離開那地方到 提爾 和 西頓 地區。他進了一戶人家，本來不願意任何人知道，卻還是不能避開眾人。 He got up and departed from there to the region of Tyre and Sidon. He entered a house and did not want anyone to know it, but He could not escape notice.
25. 有一個婦人，她的女兒有汙靈附著。這婦人一聽說耶穌的事，就趕來俯伏在他的腳前。 Instead, immediately after hearing about Him, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit came and fell at His feet.
26. 這婦人是 希臘 人，出生在 敘利亞 的 腓尼基 。她請求耶穌把鬼魔從她女兒身上趕出去。 Now the woman was Greek, a Syrophoenician by birth, and she kept asking Him to drive the demon out of her daughter.
27. 耶穌對她說： 「應該先讓兒女吃飽，因為拿兒女的餅扔給小狗，是不合宜的。」 He said to her, "Allow the children to be satisfied first, because it isn't right to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs."
28. 婦人回答說：「主啊 ！連桌子底下的小狗，也吃得到孩子們的碎渣！」 But she replied to Him, "Lord, even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs."
29. 耶穌對她說： 「憑你這句話，你可以回去了。鬼魔已經離開了你的女兒。」 Then He told her, "Because of this reply, you may go. The demon has gone out of your daughter."
30. 婦人回到家，發現孩子 躺在床上，鬼魔已經離去了。 When she went back to her home, she found her child lying on the bed, and the demon was gone.
31. 耶穌離開 提爾 地區，經過 西頓，從 德卡波利斯 境內又來到 加利利 湖 邊。 Again, leaving the region of Tyre, He went by way of Sidon to the Sea of Galilee, through the region of the Decapolis.
32. 有人把一個又聾又啞的人帶到耶穌面前，懇求耶穌按手在他身上。 They brought to Him a deaf man who also had a speech difficulty, and begged Jesus to lay His hand on him.
33. 耶穌把他從人群中單獨帶到一邊去，用指頭伸進他的耳朵，吐唾沫來抹他的舌頭， So He took him away from the crowd privately. After putting His fingers in the man's ears and spitting, He touched his tongue.
34. 然後望天噓了一口氣，對他說： 「以法達 ！」 ——這意思是 「開了吧」。 Then, looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, "Ephphatha!" (that is, "Be opened!").
35. 他的耳朵立刻開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。 Immediately his ears were opened, his speech difficulty was removed, and he began to speak clearly.
36. 耶穌吩咐他們不要告訴任何人。但是，他越是吩咐，他們越是大大傳揚。 Then He ordered them to tell no one, but the more He would order them, the more they would proclaim it.
37. 人們極其驚訝，說：「他所做的一切都好！他甚至使聾子聽見，使啞巴說話。」 They were extremely astonished and said, "He has done everything well! He even makes deaf people hear, and people unable to speak, talk!"
Mark 8
1. 在那些日子裡，又一次，有一大群人，他們沒有什麼東西吃。耶穌召來門徒們，對他們說： In those days there was again a large crowd, and they had nothing to eat. He summoned the disciples and said to them,
2. 「我憐憫這群人，因為他們與我在一起已經三天了，也沒有什麼東西吃。 "I have compassion on the crowd, because they've already stayed with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
3. 如果我讓他們餓著肚子回家，他們會在路上暈倒，因為有些人從遠處而來。」 If I send them home famished, they will collapse on the way, and some of them have come a long distance."
4. 他的門徒們回答：「在這曠野，從哪裡能得食物讓這些人吃飽呢？」 His disciples answered Him, "Where can anyone get enough bread here in this desolate place to fill these people?"
5. 耶穌問他們： 「你們有多少餅呢？」 他們回答說：「七個。」 "How many loaves do you have?" He asked them. "Seven," they said.
6. 耶穌就吩咐眾人坐在地上，於是拿起這七個餅，祝謝以後，掰開，不斷遞給他的門徒們，讓他們分發。門徒們就分給眾人； Then He commanded the crowd to sit down on the ground. Taking the seven loaves, He gave thanks, broke the [loaves], and kept on giving [them] to His disciples to set before [the people]. So they served the [loaves] to the crowd.
7. 他們還有幾條小魚，耶穌祝福了，就吩咐把牠們也分給眾人。 They also had a few small fish, and when He had blessed them, He said these were to be served as well.
8. 他們吃了，並且吃飽了。然後，他們把剩下的碎塊收拾起來，裝滿了 七個筐子。 They ate and were filled. Then they collected seven large baskets of leftover pieces.
9. 當時約有四千人 。耶穌遣散了他們， About 4,000 [men] were there. He dismissed them
10. 隨即與他的門徒們一起上船，來到 達瑪努達 地區。 and immediately got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
11. 有些 法利賽 人出來，開始和耶穌辯論。他們試探耶穌，向他要求一個從天上來的神蹟。 The Pharisees came out and began to argue with Him, demanding of Him a sign from heaven to test Him.
12. 耶穌靈裡深深地嘆息，就說： 「這世代為什麼在尋求神蹟呢？我確實地告訴你們：絕不會有神蹟賜給這世代。」 But sighing deeply in His spirit, He said, "Why does this generation demand a sign? I assure you: No sign will be given to this generation!"
13. 於是他就離開他們，又上船往對岸去。 Then He left them, got on board [the boat] again, and went to the other side.
14. 門徒們忘了帶餅，船上除了一個餅，再沒有別的了。 They had forgotten to take bread and had only one loaf with them in the boat.
15. 耶穌吩咐他們說： 「你們要注意，要當心 法利賽 人的酵母和 希律 的酵母。」 Then he commanded them: "Watch out! Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod."
16. 門徒們因為沒有餅，就彼此討論。 They were discussing among themselves that they did not have any bread.
17. 耶穌知道了，就問他們： 「你們為什麼討論沒有餅的事呢？你們還不明白，還不領悟，還是硬著心嗎？ Aware of this, He said to them, "Why are you discussing that you do not have any bread? Do you not yet understand or comprehend? Is your heart hardened?
18. 你們有眼睛卻看不見，有耳朵卻聽不見嗎？ 難道不記得嗎？ Do you have eyes, and not see, and do you have ears, and not hear? And do you not remember?
19. 當我掰開那五個餅給五千人的時候，你們收拾的碎塊裝滿了幾個籃子呢？」 門徒們回答說：「十二個。」 When I broke the five loaves for the 5,000, how many baskets full of pieces of bread did you collect?" "Twelve," they told Him.
20. 「那七個餅給四千人的時候，你們收拾的碎塊裝滿了幾個筐子呢？」 門徒們回答說：「七個。」 "When I broke the seven loaves for the 4,000, how many large baskets full of pieces of bread did you collect?" "Seven," they said.
21. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們還不領悟嗎？」 And He said to them, "Don't you understand yet?"
22. 他們來到 伯賽達，有人帶來一個瞎眼的，懇求耶穌摸他。 Then they came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to Him and begged Him to touch him.
23. 耶穌牽著瞎眼之人的手，領他到村子外面，吐唾沫在他的眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他： 「你是否看見什麼？」 He took the blind man by the hand and brought him out of the village. Spitting on his eyes and laying His hands on him, He asked him, "Do you see anything?"
24. 他抬頭一看，說：「我看見一些人！看起來好像樹在走路！」 He looked up and said, "I see people-- they look to me like trees walking."
25. 然後耶穌又按手在他的眼睛上，他就看得清清楚楚了。他痊癒了，就清楚地看見了一切。 Again Jesus placed His hands on the man's eyes, and he saw distinctly. He was cured and could see everything clearly.
26. 耶穌叫他回家，並說： 「不要進這村子 。」 Then He sent him home, saying, "Don't even go into the village."
27. 耶穌和他的門徒們往 凱撒里亞菲利彼 的那些村莊去。在路上，耶穌問他的門徒們，說： 「人們說我是誰？」 Jesus went out with His disciples to the villages of Caesarea Philippi. And on the road He asked His disciples, "Who do people say that I am?"
28. 他們回答他，說：「是施洗者 約翰，有的說是 以利亞，也有的說是先知中的一位。」 They answered Him, "John the Baptist; others, Elijah; still others, one of the prophets."
29. 耶穌又問他們： 「那麼你們呢？你們說我是誰？」 彼得 回答說：「你是基督！」 "But you," He asked them again, "who do you say that I am?" Peter answered Him, "You are the Messiah!"
30. 耶穌就告誡他們不要把有關他的事告訴任何人。 And He strictly warned them to tell no one about Him.
31. 耶穌開始教導他們說： 「人子必須受很多苦害，被長老們、祭司長們和經文士們棄絕，並且被殺，然後在第三天要復活。」 Then He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, be killed, and rise after three days.
32. 耶穌公開地講這些事， 彼得 把耶穌拉到一邊，開始勸阻他。 He was openly talking about this. So Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
33. 但耶穌轉過身，看了看他的門徒們，就斥責 彼得，說： 「 撒旦，退到我後面去！因為你不是思想神的事，而是思想人的事。」 But turning around and looking at His disciples, He rebuked Peter and said, "Get behind Me, Satan, because you're not thinking about God's concerns, but man's!"
34. 於是，耶穌把眾人和他的門徒們一起召來，對他們說： 「如果有人想要跟從我，他就當捨棄自己，背起自己的十字架，然後跟從我。 Summoning the crowd along with His disciples, He said to them, "If anyone wants to be My follower, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.
35. 因為凡想要保全 自己生命的，將失去生命；凡為我和福音的緣故失去自己生命的，將保全 生命。 For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of Me and the gospel will save it.
36. 一個人就是賺得了全世界，卻賠上了自己的生命，到底有什麼益處呢？ For what does it benefit a man to gain the whole world yet lose his life?
37. 人到底能拿什麼來換回自己的生命 呢？ What can a man give in exchange for his life?
38. 在這淫亂、罪惡的世代，一個人如果以我和我的話為恥，當人子在他父的榮耀中，與聖天使們一起來臨的時候，也要以這個人為恥。」 For whoever is ashamed of Me and of My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in the glory of His Father with the holy angels."
Mark 9
1. 耶穌又對他們說： 「我確實地告訴你們：站在這裡的有些人，在還沒有嘗到死的滋味之前，必定見到神的國帶著權能來臨。」 Then He said to them, "I assure you: There are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God come in power."
2. 過了六天，耶穌只帶著 彼得 、 雅各 、 約翰，領他們悄悄地上了一座高山。在他們面前，耶穌變了形像。 After six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John and led them up on a high mountain by themselves to be alone. He was transformed in front of them,
3. 他的衣服變得光亮耀眼，極其潔白，地上漂布的人無法漂得那樣白。 and His clothes became dazzling-- extremely white as no launderer on earth could whiten them.
4. 這時候， 以利亞 與 摩西 一起向他們顯現，並且和耶穌談話。 Elijah appeared to them with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.
5. 彼得 對耶穌說：「拉比，我們在這裡真好！讓我們來搭三座帳幕，一座為你，一座為 摩西，一座為 以利亞 。」 Then Peter said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"--
6. 其實 彼得 不知道說什麼才好，因為他們都非常害怕。 because he did not know what he should say, since they were terrified.
7. 這時候，有一朵雲彩出現籠罩他們，並且有聲音從雲中傳來： 「這是我的愛子， 你們當聽從他！」 A cloud appeared, overshadowing them, and a voice came from the cloud: This is My beloved Son; listen to Him!
8. 於是門徒們環視周圍，忽然間，再也看不到別的人，只有耶穌與他們在一起。 Then suddenly, looking around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus alone.
9. 他們下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們，在人子從死人中復活之前，不要把所看到的告訴任何人。 As they were coming down from the mountain, He ordered them to tell no one what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
10. 他們牢記這話，互相談論「從死人中復活」是什麼意思。 They kept this word to themselves, discussing what "rising from the dead" meant.
11. 他們問耶穌，說：「經文士們為什麼說 以利亞 必須先來呢？」 Then they began to question Him, "Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
12. 耶穌告訴他們： 「 以利亞 確實要先來恢復萬事。至於人子，經上怎麼還記載說，他必然受很多苦害，並且被人拒絕呢？ "Elijah does come first and restores everything," He replied. "How then is it written about the Son of Man that He must suffer many things and be treated with contempt?
13. 不過我告訴你們：其實 以利亞 已經來了，人們卻任意對待他，正如經上指著他所寫的。」 But I tell you that Elijah really has come, and they did to him whatever they wanted, just as it is written about him."
14. 他們回到其他的門徒那裡，看見一大群人圍著他們，而且有幾個經文士正在和他們辯論。 When they came to the disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and scribes disputing with them.
15. 眾人一見耶穌，都大吃一驚，就跑過去歡迎他。 All of a sudden, when the whole crowd saw Him, they were amazed and ran to greet Him.
16. 耶穌問 ： 「你們和他們在辯論什麼？」 Then He asked them, "What are you arguing with them about?"
17. 人群中有一個人回答：「老師，我帶了我的兒子到你這裡。他有一個啞巴的邪靈附身。 Out of the crowd, one man answered Him, "Teacher, I brought my son to You. He has a spirit that makes him unable to speak.
18. 無論在哪裡，只要邪靈抓住他，把他摔倒在地，他就口吐白沫，緊咬牙關，全身僵硬。我告訴你的門徒們，要他們驅趕那邪靈，可是他們不能。」 Wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. So I asked Your disciples to drive it out, but they couldn't."
19. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「唉，這個不信的世代！我還要和你們在一起多久呢？我還要容忍你們多久呢？把孩子帶到我這裡來吧！」 He replied to them, "You unbelieving generation! How long will I be with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring him to Me."
20. 他們就把他帶到耶穌面前來。邪靈一見耶穌，立刻使孩子劇烈地抽瘋，倒在地上打滾，口吐白沫。 So they brought him to Him. When the spirit saw Him, it immediately convulsed the boy. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
21. 耶穌問孩子的父親： 「這事發生在他身上有多久了？」 他回答說：「從小就這樣。 "How long has this been happening to him?" Jesus asked his father. "From childhood," he said.
22. 邪靈經常把他扔進火裡或水裡，要害死他。但你如果能做什麼，就求你憐憫我們，幫助我們！」 "And many times it has thrown him into fire or water to destroy him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us."
23. 耶穌對他說： 「『如果你能』？ ——對信的人，一切都能。」 Then Jesus said to him, " 'If You can?' Everything is possible to the one who believes."
24. 那孩子的父親立刻 喊著說：「 我信！但我的不信之處，求你幫助！」 Immediately the father of the boy cried out, "I do believe! Help my unbelief."
25. 耶穌看見眾人都跑上來，就斥責那汙靈，說： 「你這聾啞的邪靈，我命令你：從他裡面出來，不可再進去！」 When Jesus saw that a crowd was rapidly coming together, He rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it, "You mute and deaf spirit, I command you: come out of him and never enter him again!"
26. 邪靈喊叫一聲，使孩子劇烈地抽瘋，就出來了。孩子變得像死人那樣，所以許多人說：「他死了。」 Then it came out, shrieking and convulsing him violently. The boy became like a corpse, so that many said, "He's dead."
27. 但是，耶穌握著他的手，扶他起來，他就站起來了。 But Jesus, taking him by the hand, raised him, and he stood up.
28. 耶穌進了房子，他的門徒們就悄悄地問他：「我們為什麼不能趕出那邪靈呢？」 After He went into a house, His disciples asked Him privately, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"
29. 耶穌對他們說： 「對這一類的邪靈，如果不藉著禱告和禁食，就不能趕出去。」 And He told them, "This kind can come out by nothing but prayer [[and fasting]]."
30. 他們離開那裡，經過 加利利，耶穌不願意讓人知道。 Then they left that place and made their way through Galilee, but He did not want anyone to know it.
31. 那時，他教導自己的門徒們，對他們說： 「人子被交在 人的手中，他們要殺害他。然後被殺之後，在第三天 他要復活。」 For He was teaching His disciples and telling them, "The Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of men. They will kill Him, and after He is killed, He will rise three days later."
32. 可是門徒們不明白這話，又不敢問他。 But they did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask Him.
33. 他們來到了 迦百農，進了屋子，耶穌問門徒們： 「你們在路上討論什麼呢？」 Then they came to Capernaum. When He was in the house, He asked them, "What were you arguing about on the way?"
34. 門徒們卻不做聲，因為他們在路上彼此爭論誰更大。 But they were silent, because on the way they had been arguing with one another about who was the greatest.
35. 耶穌坐下，叫十二使徒 來，對他們說： 「如果有人想做首先的，他就該做眾人當中最後的，做大家的僕人。」 Sitting down, He called the Twelve and said to them, "If anyone wants to be first, he must be last of all and servant of all."
36. 耶穌找來一個小孩子，讓他站在他們當中，又把他摟在懷中，對門徒們說： Then He took a child, had him stand among them, and taking him in His arms, He said to them,
37. 「無論誰奉我的名接受這樣一個小孩子，就是接受我；接受我的，不是接受我，而是接受差派我來的那一位。」 "Whoever welcomes one little child such as this in My name welcomes Me. And whoever welcomes Me does not welcome Me, but Him who sent Me."
38. 約翰 說：「老師，我們看見一個人 奉你的名驅趕鬼魔，我們就去阻止他，因為他不是跟從我們的。」 John said to Him, "Teacher, we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him because he wasn't following us."
39. 耶穌說： 「不要阻止他。因為沒有人奉我的名行了神蹟以後，會立即誹謗我。 "Don't stop him," said Jesus, "because there is no one who will perform a miracle in My name who can soon afterwards speak evil of Me.
40. 不反對我們的，就是支持我們的。 For whoever is not against us is for us.
41. 如果有人因為你們屬於基督，就奉我的 名給你們一杯水喝，我確實地告訴你們：他絕不會失去他的報償。 And whoever gives you a cup of water to drink because of My name, since you belong to the Messiah-- I assure you: He will never lose his reward.
42. 「無論誰使信我的這些卑微人中的一個 絆倒，對那人來說，脖子上拴著大磨石，被丟進海裡反而更好。 "But whoever causes the downfall of one of these little ones who believe in Me-- it would be better for him if a heavy millstone were hung around his neck and he were thrown into the sea.
43. 如果你的一隻手使你絆倒，就把它砍掉！對你來說，缺一隻手進入永生，要比雙手齊全下地獄，到那永不熄滅的火裡好多了。 And if your hand causes your downfall, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than to have two hands and go to hell-- the unquenchable fire,
44. 在那裡 『蟲是不死的， 火是不滅的。』 [[where Their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.]]
45. 如果你的一隻腳使你絆倒，就把它砍掉！對你來說，缺一隻腳進入永生，要比雙腳齊全被丟進地獄，到那永不熄滅的火裡 好多了。 And if your foot causes your downfall, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell-- [[the unquenchable fire,
46. 在那裡 『蟲是不死的， 火是不滅的。』 where Their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.]]
47. 如果你的一隻眼使你絆倒，就把它挖出來！對你來說，缺一隻眼進入神的國，要比雙眼齊全被丟進 地獄好多了。 And if your eye causes your downfall, gouge it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
48. 在那裡 『蟲是不死的， 火是不滅的。』 where Their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.
49. 要知道，每個人都將被火醃成鹹的 。 For everyone will be salted with fire.
50. 鹽是好的，但如果那鹽也不鹹了，還能用什麼來調味呢？你們裡面要有鹽，要彼此和睦。」 Salt is good, but if the salt should lose its flavor, how can you make it salty? Have salt among yourselves and be at peace with one another."
Mark 10
1. 後來，耶穌從那裡起身，來到 猶太 地區和 約旦 河對岸。人群又聚集到他那裡，他又照常教導他們。 He set out from there and went to the region of Judea and across the Jordan. Then crowds converged on Him again and, as He usually did, He began teaching them once more.
2. 有些 法利賽 人前來試探耶穌，問他：「人是否可以休妻呢？」 Some Pharisees approached Him to test Him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce [his] wife?"
3. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「 摩西 是怎麼吩咐你們的？」 He replied to them, "What did Moses command you?"
4. 他們說：「 摩西 准許人寫一份休書就可以休妻。」 They said, "Moses permitted us to write divorce papers and send her away."
5. 耶穌對他們說： 「 摩西 因著你們的心裡剛硬，才給你們定下這條誡命。 But Jesus told them, "He wrote this commandment for you because of the hardness of your hearts.
6. 從創世之初， 『神 把人 造成男的和女的』， But from the beginning of creation God made them male and female.
7. 『為這緣故， 人將離開他的父母， 與妻子結合 For this reason a man will leave his father and mother [[ and be joined to his wife,]]
8. 兩個人就成為一體。』 這樣，夫妻不再是兩個人，而是一體了。 and the two will become one flesh. So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
9. 因此，神所配合的，人不可分開。」 Therefore what God has joined together, man must not separate."
10. 進了屋子，門徒們又向耶穌問起這件事。 Now in the house the disciples questioned Him again about this matter.
11. 耶穌就說： 「如果有人休妻，另娶別人，就是犯通姦罪觸犯妻子。 And He said to them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
12. 女人如果離棄丈夫，另嫁別人，也是犯通姦罪。」 Also, if she divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery."
13. 有些人把小孩子帶到耶穌那裡，好讓耶穌摸他們一下。門徒們卻責備那些人 。 Some people were bringing little children to Him so He might touch them, but His disciples rebuked them.
14. 耶穌看見了就很不滿，對門徒們說： 「讓小孩子到我這裡來，不要阻止他們，因為神的國正屬於這樣的人。 When Jesus saw it, He was indignant and said to them, "Let the little children come to Me. Don't stop them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
15. 我確實地告訴你們：無論誰不像小孩子一樣接受神的國，就絕不能進去。」 I assure you: Whoever does not welcome the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it."
16. 於是，他把孩子們摟在懷中，按手在他們身上，祝福了他們。 After taking them in His arms, He laid His hands on them and blessed them.
17. 耶穌剛出門上路，有一個人跑過去向他跪下，問他：「良善的老師，我該做什麼才能繼承永恆的生命呢？」 As He was setting out on a journey, a man ran up, knelt down before Him, and asked Him, "Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
18. 耶穌對他說： 「你為什麼稱我是良善的呢？除了神一位之外，沒有一個是良善的。 "Why do you call Me good?" Jesus asked him. "No one is good but One-- God.
19. 你是知道這些誡命的： 『不可殺人、 不可通姦、 不可偷竊、 不可做偽證、 不可虧負人、 要孝敬父母。』 」 You know the commandments: Do not murder; do not commit adultery; do not steal; do not bear false witness; do not defraud; honor your father and mother."
20. 那個人對耶穌說：「老師，這一切我從年少就遵守了。」 He said to Him, "Teacher, I have kept all these from my youth."
21. 耶穌注視著他，就愛他，對他說： 「你還缺少一件：去賣掉你所擁有的，分給窮人，這樣你將有財寶在天上；然後你 來跟從我。」 Then, looking at him, Jesus loved him and said to him, "You lack one thing: Go, sell all you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me."
22. 那個人因這話，臉色就變得陰沉，憂憂愁愁地走開了，因為他有很多財產。 But he was stunned at this demand, and he went away grieving, because he had many possessions.
23. 耶穌環視周圍，對他的門徒們說： 「有錢財的人進入神的國，是多麼困難！」 Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, "How hard it is for those who have wealth to enter the kingdom of God!"
24. 門徒們因這些話，就驚訝不已。耶穌又對他們說： 「孩子們， 進入神的國是多麼困難！ But the disciples were astonished at His words. Again Jesus said to them, "Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
25. 駱駝穿過針眼，比富有的人進入神的國更容易呢！」 It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."
26. 門徒們越發驚訝，彼此說：「那麼，誰能得救呢？」 So they were even more astonished, saying to one another, "Then who can be saved?"
27. 耶穌注視著他們，說： 「在人不可能，但在神卻不然；因為在神，凡事都可能。」 Looking at them, Jesus said, "With men it is impossible, but not with God, because all things are possible with God."
28. 彼得 就對耶穌說：「看，我們捨棄一切跟從了你！」 Peter began to tell Him, "Look, we have left everything and followed You."
29. 耶穌說： 「我確實地告訴你們：無論誰為我的緣故、為福音的緣故而捨棄房屋，或兄弟，或姐妹，或母親，或父親， 或兒女，或田產， "I assure you," Jesus said, "there is no one who has left house, brothers or sisters, mother or father, children, or fields because of Me and the gospel,
30. 都必定在今世得到百倍，就是房屋、兄弟、姐妹、母親、兒女和田產，也會有逼迫；但在來世得到永恆的生命。 who will not receive 100 times more, now at this time-- houses, brothers and sisters, mothers and children, and fields, with persecutions-- and eternal life in the age to come.
31. 不過許多在前的，將要在後；許多在後的，將要在前。」 But many who are first will be last, and the last first."
32. 在上 耶路撒冷 的路途中，耶穌一直走在前頭，門徒們驚訝不已，跟著的人也懼怕了。耶穌又把十二使徒 帶到一邊，開始告訴他們將要發生在他身上的事， They were on the road, going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was walking ahead of them. They were astonished, but those who followed Him were afraid. Taking the Twelve aside again, He began to tell them the things that would happen to Him.
33. 說： 「看，我們現在上 耶路撒冷 去，人子將被出賣給祭司長們和經文士們。他們要定他死罪，並且要把他交給外邦人。 "Listen! We are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the scribes, and they will condemn Him to death. Then they will hand Him over to the Gentiles,
34. 他們要戲弄他、向他吐唾沫、鞭打他，並殺害他；然後在第三天，他要復活。」 and they will mock Him, spit on Him, flog Him, and kill Him, and He will rise after three days."
35. 這時候， 西庇太 的兒子 雅各 和 約翰 來到耶穌面前，說：「老師，如果我們向你求什麼，希望你為我們成全。」 Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, approached Him and said, "Teacher, we want You to do something for us if we ask You."
36. 耶穌問他們： 「要我為你們做什麼呢？」 "What do you want Me to do for you?" He asked them.
37. 他們說：「請准許我們在你的榮耀裡，一個坐在你的右邊，一個坐在你的 左邊。」 They answered Him, "Allow us to sit at Your right and at Your left in Your glory."
38. 耶穌就說： 「你們不知道自己在求什麼。我所喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？我所受的洗禮，你們能受嗎？」 But Jesus said to them, "You don't know what you're asking. Are you able to drink the cup I drink or to be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?"
39. 他們回答說：「我們能。」 耶穌就說： 「我所喝的杯你們將要喝，我所受的洗禮你們將要受。 "We are able," they told Him. Jesus said to them, "You will drink the cup I drink, and you will be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with.
40. 但是坐在我的右邊或左邊，不是我所賜的，而是已經預備給誰，就賜給誰。」 But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to give; instead, it is for those it has been prepared for."
41. 其他十個使徒聽了，就開始對 雅各 和 約翰 很不滿。 When the [other] 10 [disciples] heard this, they began to be indignant with James and John.
42. 於是耶穌把他們召來，對他們說： 「你們知道，外邦人有所謂為首的壓制他們，也有為大的管轄他們。 Jesus called them over and said to them, "You know that those who are regarded as rulers of the Gentiles dominate them, and their men of high positions exercise power over them.
43. 但你們當中卻不是這樣；相反，無論誰想在你們當中為大，誰就該做你們的僕人； But it must not be like that among you. On the contrary, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
44. 無論誰想在你們當中為首，誰就該做大家的奴僕。 and whoever wants to be first among you must be a slave to all.
45. 要知道，就是人子來，也不是為了受人的服事，而是為了服事人，並且獻上自己的生命，替許多人做救贖的代價。」 For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life-- a ransom for many."
46. 他們來到了 耶利哥 。當耶穌與他的門徒們和一大群人要離開那裡的時候，有一個瞎眼的乞丐坐在路邊，他是 提邁 的兒子 巴提邁 。 They came to Jericho. And as He was leaving Jericho with His disciples and a large crowd, Bartimaeus (the son of Timaeus), a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
47. 他一聽說是 拿撒勒 人耶穌，就開始呼叫說：「 大衛 的後裔 ——耶穌，可憐我吧！」 When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, "Son of David, Jesus, have mercy on me!"
48. 許多人責備他，叫他不要做聲。可是他更加大聲呼叫：「 大衛 的後裔，可憐我吧！」 Many people told him to keep quiet, but he was crying out all the more, "Have mercy on me, Son of David!"
49. 耶穌就停住，說： 「叫他過來吧。」 他們就叫那瞎眼的說：「鼓起勇氣吧！起來，他叫你呢。」 Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." So they called the blind man and said to him, "Have courage! Get up; He's calling for you."
50. 他就丟下外衣跳起來，來到耶穌面前。 He threw off his coat, jumped up, and came to Jesus.
51. 耶穌問他說： 「你要我為你做什麼呢？」 那瞎眼的說：「拉波尼，我要重見光明！」 Then Jesus answered him, "What do you want Me to do for you?" "Rabbouni," the blind man told Him, "I want to see!"
52. 耶穌對他說： 「你去吧！你的信救了你。」 他立刻重見光明，於是一路跟隨了耶穌。 "Go your way," Jesus told him. "Your faith has healed you." Immediately he could see and began to follow Him on the road.
Mark 11
1. 當耶穌和門徒們臨近 耶路撒冷，到 橄欖山 附近的 伯法其 和 伯大尼 的時候，耶穌派了他的兩個門徒， When they approached Jerusalem, at Bethphage and Bethany near the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples
2. 對他們說： 「你們到對面的村子裡去。你們一進村，就會發現一頭驢駒拴在那裡，是從來沒有人騎過的。你們把牠解開牽過來。 and told them, "Go into the village ahead of you. As soon as you enter it, you will find a young donkey tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
3. 如果有人問你們為什麼這麼做，你們就說『主需要牠，會很快把牠送回這裡來的。』」 If anyone says to you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord needs it and will send it back here right away.'"
4. 兩個門徒去了，果然發現一頭驢駒拴在岔路口一個門外，他們就解開驢駒。 So they went and found a young donkey outside in the street, tied by a door. They untied it,
5. 站在那裡的一些人問：「你們解開驢駒做什麼呢？」 and some of those standing there said to them, "What are you doing, untying the donkey?"
6. 他們就照著耶穌所吩咐的回答，那些人就讓他們牽走 了。 They answered them just as Jesus had said, so they let them go.
7. 他們牽著驢駒到耶穌那裡，把自己的外衣墊在驢駒上，耶穌就騎了上去。 Then they brought the donkey to Jesus and threw their robes on it, and He sat on it.
8. 許多人把自己的外衣鋪在路上，也有人從田野裡 砍來樹枝鋪在路上 。 Many people spread their robes on the road, and others spread leafy branches cut from the fields.
9. 前行後隨的人都呼喊： 「 和散那！ 奉主名而來的那一位——是蒙祝福的！ Then those who went ahead and those who followed kept shouting: Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
10. 那 將要來的，我們先祖 大衛 的國度——是蒙祝福的！ 在至高之處—— 和散那！ 」 Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna in the highest heaven!
11. 耶穌進了 耶路撒冷，來到聖殿，環視周圍的一切。天已經晚了，他就與十二使徒 一同離開，往 伯大尼 去了。 And He went into Jerusalem and into the temple complex. After looking around at everything, since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
12. 第二天，當他們離開 伯大尼 的時候，耶穌餓了。 The next day when they came out from Bethany, He was hungry.
13. 他遠遠地看見一棵長滿葉子的無花果樹，就上前去，要看看樹上是否有什麼。他來到樹下，除了葉子什麼也找不到，因為不是結無花果的季節。 After seeing in the distance a fig tree with leaves, He went to find out if there was anything on it. When He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.
14. 於是他對那棵樹說： 「永遠不再有任何人吃到你的果子了！」 他的門徒都聽見了。 He said to it, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again!" And His disciples heard it.
15. 他們來到 耶路撒冷 。耶穌進了聖殿，開始把那些在聖殿裡做買賣的人趕出去。他推翻了兌換銀幣之人的桌子和賣鴿子之人的凳子， They came to Jerusalem, and He went into the temple complex and began to throw out those buying and selling in the temple. He overturned the money changers' tables and the chairs of those selling doves,
16. 也不准任何人搬運東西穿過聖殿。 and would not permit anyone to carry goods through the temple complex.
17. 耶穌教導他們說： 「經上不是記著 『我的殿將被稱為萬國禱告的殿』 嗎？而你們卻使它成為 賊窩 了！ 」 Then He began to teach them: "Is it not written, My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations? But you have made it a den of thieves!"
18. 祭司長們和經文士們聽了，就圖謀怎樣來除滅耶穌。原來他們怕耶穌，因為眾人都對他的教導驚嘆不已。 Then the chief priests and the scribes heard it and started looking for a way to destroy Him. For they were afraid of Him, because the whole crowd was astonished by His teaching.
19. 到了傍晚的時候，耶穌和門徒們就到城外去。 And whenever evening came, they would go out of the city.
20. 清晨，他們路過那棵無花果樹的時候，看見它連根都枯萎了。 Early in the morning, as they were passing by, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots up.
21. 彼得 想起來就對耶穌說：「拉比，你看！你所詛咒的無花果樹枯萎了！」 Then Peter remembered and said to Him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree that You cursed is withered."
22. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們當對神有信心。 Jesus replied to them, "Have faith in God.
23. 我確實地告訴你們：無論誰對這座山說『願你被挪開，被丟進海裡去！』只要他心裡不疑惑，相信自己所說的會成就，事情 就將為他成就。 I assure you: If anyone says to this mountain, 'Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will happen, it will be done for him.
24. 所以，我告訴你們：凡是你們所禱告和祈求的，當相信已經得著了 。這樣，事情就將為你們成就。 Therefore, I tell you, all the things you pray and ask for-- believe that you have received them, and you will have them.
25. 當你們站著禱告的時候，如果向什麼人懷怨，就要饒恕他。這樣，你們在天上的父也會饒恕你們的過犯。 And whenever you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive him, so that your Father in heaven will also forgive you your wrongdoing.
26. 你們如果不饒恕別人，你們在天上的父也不會饒恕你們的過犯。 」 [[But if you don't forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your wrongdoing."]]
27. 他們又來到 耶路撒冷 。當耶穌在聖殿裡行走的時候，祭司長們、經文士們和長老們來到他那裡。 They came again to Jerusalem. As He was walking in the temple complex, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came and asked Him,
28. 他們問：「你憑什麼權柄做這些事？誰給你這權柄，讓你做這些事？」 "By what authority are You doing these things? Who gave You this authority to do these things?"
29. 耶穌對他們說： 「我要問你們一個問題，你們回答我，我就告訴你們我憑什麼權柄做這些事。 Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one question; then answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
30. 約翰 的洗禮是來自天上，還是來自人間呢？你們回答我！」 Was John's baptism from heaven or from men? Answer Me."
31. 他們就彼此討論，說：「如果我們說『是來自天上』，他就會問『那麼你們為什麼不相信他呢？』 They began to argue among themselves: "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say, 'Then why didn't you believe him?'
32. 可是我們能說『是來自人間』嗎？」原來他們怕民眾，因為大家都認為 約翰 的確是先知。 But if we say, 'From men' "-- they were afraid of the crowd, because everyone thought that John was a genuine prophet.
33. 於是他們回答耶穌，說：「我們不知道。」 耶穌就對他們說： 「我也不告訴你們我憑什麼權柄做這些事。」 So they answered Jesus, "We don't know." And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
Mark 12
1. 耶穌開始用比喻對他們說： 「有一個人栽種了一個葡萄園，四面圍上籬笆，挖了一個榨酒池，蓋了一座守望樓，然後把葡萄園租給一些農夫，就出外旅行。 Then He began to speak to them in parables: "A man planted a vineyard, put a fence around it, dug out a pit for a winepress, and built a watchtower. Then he leased it to tenant farmers and went away.
2. 到了收穫的 季節，他就派了一個奴僕到那些農夫那裡去，好從他們收取葡萄園的果子。 At harvest time he sent a slave to the farmers to collect some of the fruit of the vineyard from the farmers.
3. 但他們抓住那奴僕，打了他，叫他空手回去。 But they took him, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
4. 園主又派另一個奴僕到他們那裡去。那些農夫 打傷了他的頭，並且侮辱他 。 Again he sent another slave to them, and they hit him on the head and treated him shamefully.
5. 園主再派另一個去，他們把他殺了。另派了許多去，有的被打，有的被殺。 Then he sent another, and they killed that one. [He] also [sent] many others; they beat some and they killed some.
6. 「那園主還有一位——是他的愛子。最後他差派兒子到他們那裡，說：『他們一定會尊重我的兒子。』 "He still had one to send, a beloved son. Finally he sent him to them, saying, 'They will respect my son.'
7. 「可是那些農夫彼此說：『這是繼承人。來，我們把他殺了，那繼業就歸我們了。』 "But those tenant farmers said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours!'
8. 於是他們抓住他，把他殺了，並扔出葡萄園外。 So they seized him, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
9. 「那麼，葡萄園的主人會做什麼呢？他會來除滅那些農夫，把葡萄園交給別人。 "Therefore, what will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers and give the vineyard to others.
10. 你們難道也沒有讀過這段經文嗎？ 『工匠所棄絕的石頭， 它已經成了房角的頭塊石頭； Haven't you read this Scripture: The stone that the builders rejected-- this has become the cornerstone.
11. 這是主所成就的， 在我們眼中實在奇妙！』 」 This came from the Lord and is wonderful in our eyes?"
12. 祭司長們、律法師們和長老們知道這比喻是針對他們而說的，就想拘捕耶穌。可是他們怕民眾，於是離開耶穌走了。 Because they knew He had said this parable against them, they were looking for a way to arrest Him, but they were afraid of the crowd. So they left Him and went away.
13. 後來，他們派了一些 法利賽 人和 希律 黨的人到耶穌那裡，要找話柄來陷害他。 Then they sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to Him to trap Him by what He said.
14. 那些人來對耶穌說：「老師，我們知道你是真誠的。你不顧忌任何人，因為你不看人的情面，而是按真理教導神的道 。請問，向凱撒納稅，可以不可以呢？我們該交還是不該交呢？」 When they came, they said to Him, "Teacher, we know You are truthful and defer to no one, for You don't show partiality but teach truthfully the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?
15. 耶穌看出他們的假意，就對他們說： 「你們為什麼試探我呢？拿一個銀幣 來給我看。」 Should we pay, or should we not pay?" But knowing their hypocrisy, He said to them, "Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to look at."
16. 他們就拿來了。耶穌問他們： 「這是誰的像和名號？」 他們回答說：「是凱撒的。」 So they brought one. "Whose image and inscription is this?" He asked them. "Caesar's," they said.
17. 耶穌對他們說： 「凱撒的歸給凱撒；神的歸給神。」 這使他們感到驚奇。 Then Jesus told them, "Give back to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's." And they were amazed at Him.
18. 接著， 撒都該 人來到耶穌那裡，他們一向說沒有復活的事。他們問耶穌，說： Some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him and questioned Him:
19. 「老師， 摩西 為我們寫道： 如果一個人的兄弟死了， 撇下妻子而 沒有留下孩子，他就應該娶這婦人，為兄弟留後裔。 "Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies, leaves his wife behind, and leaves no child, his brother should take the wife and produce offspring for his brother.
20. 曾經有兄弟七人，第一個娶了妻子，死去了，沒有留下後裔。 There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying, left no offspring.
21. 第二個娶了這寡婦，也死了，沒有留下後裔。第三個也一樣。 The second also took her, and he died, leaving no offspring. And the third likewise.
22. 結果，兄弟七個都 沒有留下後裔。到了最後，這婦人也死了。 The seven also left no offspring. Last of all, the woman died too.
23. 既然這七個人都娶過她為妻，在復活的時候，當他們復活了，她將是誰的妻子呢？」 In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be, since the seven had married her?"
24. 耶穌說： 「你們之所以錯了，不就是因為你們不明白經上的話，也不明白神的大能嗎？ Jesus told them, "Are you not deceived because you don't know the Scriptures or the power of God?
25. 當人從死人中復活以後，他們既不娶也不嫁，而是像諸天之上的天使一樣。 For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage but are like angels in heaven.
26. 關於死人復活的事，你們難道沒有讀過 摩西 書『荊棘篇』上，神怎樣對 說的嗎？神說 『我是 Now concerning the dead being raised-- haven't you read in the book of Moses, in the passage about the burning bush, how God spoke to him: I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob?
27. 神不是死人的神，而是活人的神 。你們完全錯了！」 He is not God of the dead but of the living. You are badly deceived."
28. 有一個經文士前來，聽見他們辯論，見耶穌回答得好，就問耶穌：「所有的誡命中，哪一條是最重要的呢？」 One of the scribes approached. When he heard them debating and saw that Jesus answered them well, he asked Him, "Which commandment is the most important of all?"
29. 耶穌回答： 「 最重要的是： 『 "This is the most important," Jesus answered: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God, The Lord is One.
30. 你要以全心、全靈、全意、全力愛主——你的神。 』 Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.
31. 「其次就是 『要愛鄰如己。』 沒有別的誡命比這兩條更大的了。」 "The second is: Love your neighbor as yourself. There is no other commandment greater than these."
32. 那經文士就對耶穌說：「不錯，老師，你真的講了：神只有一位，除他以外沒有別的神。 Then the scribe said to Him, "You are right, Teacher! You have correctly said that He is One, and there is no one else except Him.
33. 以全心、全智、 全力來愛神，並且要愛鄰如己，這是比所有的燔祭和各種祭祀都重要的。」 And to love Him with all your heart, with all your understanding, and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, is far more [important] than all the burnt offerings and sacrifices."
34. 耶穌見他回答得有智慧，就對他說： 「你離神的國不遠了。」 於是，沒有人敢再質問耶穌了。 When Jesus saw that he answered intelligently, He said to him, "You are not far from the kingdom of God." And no one dared to question Him any longer.
35. 耶穌在聖殿裡教導人的時候問： 「經文士們怎麼說基督是 大衛 的後裔呢？ So Jesus asked this question as He taught in the temple complex, "How can the scribes say that the Messiah is the Son of David?
36. 大衛 藉著聖靈，自己說過： 『主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我把你的敵人放在你的腳下 。』 David himself says by the Holy Spirit: The Lord declared to my Lord, 'Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.'
37. 大衛 自己稱基督為『主』，基督又怎麼會是 的後裔呢？」 那一大群人都樂意聽耶穌講說。 David himself calls Him 'Lord'; how then can the Messiah be his Son?" And the large crowd was listening to Him with delight.
38. 耶穌在他的教導中說： 「你們要當心經文士們。他們喜歡穿著長袍走來走去，喜歡街市上的致敬問候， He also said in His teaching, "Beware of the scribes, who want to go around in long robes, and who want greetings in the marketplaces,
39. 又喜歡會堂裡的首位、宴席中的上座。 the front seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
40. 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，又假意做很長的禱告。這些人將受到更重的懲罰 。」 They devour widows' houses and say long prayers just for show. These will receive harsher punishment."
41. 耶穌面對奉獻箱坐著，看眾人怎樣把錢投入奉獻箱裡。許多富有的人投進了很多錢。 Sitting across from the temple treasury, He watched how the crowd dropped money into the treasury. Many rich people were putting in large sums.
42. 有一個窮寡婦來，投進兩個小錢，值一個銅幣 。 And a poor widow came and dropped in two tiny coins worth very little.
43. 耶穌把他的門徒們召來，對他們說： 「我確實地告訴你們：這窮寡婦所投入奉獻箱的，比所有的人投的更多。 Summoning His disciples, He said to them, "I assure you: This poor widow has put in more than all those giving to the temple treasury.
44. 因為大家是從自己的富餘中拿出來投進去；而這寡婦是從自己的缺乏中，把她所擁有的一切，就是她全部的養生費用都投進去了。」 For they all gave out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in everything she possessed-- all she had to live on."
Mark 13
1. 耶穌走出聖殿的時候，他的一個門徒對他說：「老師，你看！多好的石頭，多好的建築啊！」 As He was going out of the temple complex, one of His disciples said to Him, "Teacher, look! What massive stones! What impressive buildings!"
2. 耶穌對他說： 「你在看這些雄偉的建築嗎？這裡將絕不會有一塊石頭留在另一塊石頭上而不被拆下。」 Jesus said to him, "Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left here on another that will not be thrown down!"
3. 耶穌在 橄欖山 上，面對聖殿坐著。 彼得 、 雅各 、 約翰 和 安得烈 悄悄地問他： While He was sitting on the Mount of Olives across from the temple complex, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
4. 「請告訴我們，這些事什麼時候會發生呢？這一切將要成就的時候，會有什麼預兆呢？」 "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign when all these things are about to take place?"
5. 耶穌就開始對他們說： 「你們要當心，免得有人迷惑你們。 Then Jesus began by telling them: "Watch out that no one deceives you.
6. 許多人會以我的名而來，聲稱『我就是那一位 』，並且會迷惑許多人。 Many will come in My name, saying, 'I am He,' and they will deceive many.
7. 當你們聽見戰爭和戰爭消息的時候，不可驚慌。這些事必須發生，不過結局還沒有到。 When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be alarmed; these things must take place, but the end is not yet.
8. 一個民族要起來反對另一個民族，一個國家要起來反對另一個國家；到處都會有地震和饑荒 。這些都像臨產陣痛的開始。 For nation will rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
9. 「你們自己要當心。他們將要把你們送交議會；你們會在會堂裡受鞭打。為我的緣故，你們將站在總督和君王面前，好對他們做見證。 "But you, be on your guard! They will hand you over to sanhedrins, and you will be flogged in the synagogues. You will stand before governors and kings because of Me, as a witness to them.
10. 然而，福音必須先傳給萬國。 And the good news must first be proclaimed to all nations.
11. 當他們把你們交出去、帶走的時候，不要預先憂慮 說什麼。到時候，你們被賜予什麼話，就說什麼話，因為說話的不是你們自己，而是聖靈。 So when they arrest you and hand you over, don't worry beforehand what you will say. On the contrary, whatever is given to you in that hour-- say it. For it isn't you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
12. 兄弟將要把兄弟出賣，置於死地；父親對孩子也會這樣。兒女會起來與父母作對，並且害死他們。 Then brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise up against parents and put them to death.
13. 為了我的名，你們將被所有的人憎恨，但是忍耐到底的，這個人將會得救。 And you will be hated by everyone because of My name. But the one who endures to the end will be delivered.
14. 「當你們看見 『那帶來毀滅的褻瀆者 』 站在不該站的地方時 ——讀者應當思考—— 那時，在 猶太 的人應當逃到山裡； "When you see the abomination that causes desolation standing where it should not" (let the reader understand), "then those in Judea must flee to the mountains!
15. 在屋頂上的人，不要下來，也不要進屋子裡去拿什麼東西； A man on the housetop must not come down or go in to get anything out of his house.
16. 在田裡的人，不要轉回到背後的事上，去拿自己的衣服。 And a man in the field must not go back to get his clothes.
17. 在那些日子裡，孕婦和哺乳的女人有禍了！ Woe to pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days!
18. 你們要禱告，好讓這事 不在冬天發生， Pray it won't happen in winter.
19. 因為在那些日子裡將有患難。這樣的患難從神創世之初直到如今，從來沒有發生過，也絕不再發生。 For those will be days of tribulation, the kind that hasn't been from the beginning of the world, which God created, until now and never will be again!
20. 如果不是主減少了那些日子，就沒有一個人 能得救。然而，為了那些蒙揀選的人，就是他所揀選的，他減少了那些日子。 Unless the Lord limited those days, no one would survive. But He limited those days because of the elect, whom He chose.
21. 「那時候，如果有人對你們說『看哪，基督在這裡！』『看哪，他在那裡！』你們不要相信。 "Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Messiah! Look-- there!' do not believe it!
