22. 因為假基督們和假先知們會出現，行神蹟和奇事，如果有可能，甚至迷惑那些蒙揀選的人。 For false messiahs and false prophets will rise up and will perform signs and wonders to lead astray, if possible, the elect.
23. 所以你們要當心。我已經預先把一切都告訴你們了。 And you must watch! I have told you everything in advance.
24. 「在那些日子裡，隨著那患難， 『太陽就要變黑， 月亮也不發光， "But in those days, after that tribulation: The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not shed its light;
25. 星辰要從天上墜落， 諸天之上的各勢力也將被震動。』 the stars will be falling from the sky, and the celestial powers will be shaken.
26. 那時候，人們將要看見人子帶著極大的權能和榮耀，在雲彩中來臨。 Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
27. 他要差派天使們，並且從四方，從地極到天邊，召集他所揀選的人。 He will send out the angels and gather His elect from the four winds, from the end of the earth to the end of the sky.
28. 「你們要從無花果樹那裡學個比喻：當無花果樹的枝子發嫩長出葉子的時候，你們就知道夏天快到了。 "Learn this parable from the fig tree: As soon as its branch becomes tender and sprouts leaves, you know that summer is near.
29. 照樣，當你們看見這些事發生的時候，你們應當知道：人子 快到了，就在門口了。 In the same way, when you see these things happening, know that He is near-- at the door!
30. 我確實地告訴你們：在這一切事發生之前，這世代絕不會過去。 I assure you: This generation will certainly not pass away until all these things take place.
31. 天和地將要消逝，但是我的話絕不會消逝。 Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
32. 「至於那日子或那時刻，沒有人知道，連天上的天使們也不知道，子也不知道，唯有父知道。 "Now concerning that day or hour no one knows-- neither the angels in heaven nor the Son-- except the Father.
33. 你們要當心，要警醒 ；因為你們不知道那時刻是什麼時候。 Watch! Be alert! For you don't know when the time is [coming].
34. 這就像一個人出外旅行，離開了家，把權柄交給了他的奴僕們，又把工作分給了每個人，他吩咐看門的人要警醒。 It is like a man on a journey, who left his house, gave authority to his slaves, gave each one his work, and commanded the doorkeeper to be alert.
35. 所以你們要警醒，因為你們不知道這家的主人什麼時候回來，或傍晚，或半夜，或雞叫時，或凌晨； Therefore be alert, since you don't know when the master of the house is coming-- whether in the evening or at midnight or at the crowing of the rooster or early in the morning.
36. 免得他忽然回來，看見你們在睡覺。 Otherwise, he might come suddenly and find you sleeping.
37. 我對你們說的，也對所有的人說：你們要警醒！」 And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Be alert!"
Mark 14
1. 過兩天就是逾越節和除酵節了。祭司長們和經文士們在圖謀怎樣用詭計拘捕耶穌，把他殺掉。 After two days it was the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread. The chief priests and the scribes were looking for a treacherous way to arrest and kill Him.
2. 不過他們說：「不可在節日期間，免得民眾發生騷亂。」 "Not during the festival," they said, "or there may be rioting among the people."
3. 耶穌在 伯大尼，在痲瘋病人 西門 家裡坐席的時候，有一個女人拿著一個玉瓶進來。瓶裡盛著 極其貴重的純哪噠香液。她打破玉瓶，把香液澆在耶穌的頭上。 While He was in Bethany at the house of Simon who had a serious skin disease, as He was reclining at the table, a woman came with an alabaster jar of pure and expensive fragrant oil of nard. She broke the jar and poured it on His head.
4. 有些人心裡很不滿，說：「為什麼要這樣浪費香液呢？ But some were expressing indignation to one another: "Why has this fragrant oil been wasted?
5. 這香液本來可以賣三百多個銀幣，分給窮人。」他們就責備那女人。 For this oil might have been sold for more than 300 denarii and given to the poor." And they began to scold her.
6. 耶穌說： 「由她吧！你們為什麼為難她呢？她為我做了一件美好的事。 Then Jesus said, "Leave her alone. Why are you bothering her? She has done a noble thing for Me.
7. 要知道，你們總是有窮人與你們在一起，只要你們願意，隨時可以為他們做好事。但你們不總是有我。 You always have the poor with you, and you can do good for them whenever you want, but you do not always have Me.
8. 她盡她所能的做了。她是為我的安葬，預先膏抹了我的身體。 She has done what she could; she has anointed My body in advance for burial.
9. 我確實地告訴你們：在全世界，福音無論傳到什麼地方，這女人所做的事也將被述說，做為對她的記念。」 I assure you: Wherever the gospel is proclaimed in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be told in memory of her."
10. 那時候， 加略 人 猶大，就是十二使徒 中的一個，到祭司長們那裡去，要把耶穌交給他們。 Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to hand Him over to them.
11. 他們聽了就歡喜，並且許諾給他銀錢。於是 猶大 就圖謀怎樣找機會把耶穌交出去。 And when they heard this, they were glad and promised to give him silver. So he started looking for a good opportunity to betray Him.
12. 除酵節的第一日，就是人們宰殺逾越節羔羊的那一天，耶穌的門徒們問他：「你要我們到哪裡去預備，好讓你吃逾越節的晚餐呢？」 On the first day of Unleavened Bread, when they sacrifice the Passover lamb, His disciples asked Him, "Where do You want us to go and prepare the Passover so You may eat it?"
13. 於是耶穌差派了他的兩個門徒，對他們說： 「你們進城去，會有一個人提著一罐水迎面而來，你們就跟著他。 So He sent two of His disciples and told them, "Go into the city, and a man carrying a water jug will meet you. Follow him.
14. 他進哪一家，你們就對那家的主人說：『老師問：我的客房，就是我與我的門徒們一起吃逾越節晚餐的客房在哪裡呢？』 Wherever he enters, tell the owner of the house, 'The Teacher says, "Where is the guest room for Me to eat the Passover with My disciples?"'
15. 他會給你們看樓上一間預備好的大房間。你們就在那裡為我們預備吧。」 He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make the preparations for us there."
16. 兩個門徒出去，進了城，所看到的正如耶穌對他們所說的。他們就預備了逾越節的晚餐。 So the disciples went out, entered the city, and found it just as He had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
17. 到了晚上，耶穌與十二使徒一起來了。 When evening came, He arrived with the Twelve.
18. 他們坐著吃飯的時候，耶穌說： 「我確實地告訴你們：你們當中有一個人要出賣我，他正與我一起吃飯。」 While they were reclining and eating, Jesus said, "I assure you: One of you will betray Me-- one who is eating with Me!"
19. 他們開始感到憂傷，就一個接一個地問耶穌：「不會是我吧？」 They began to be distressed and to say to Him one by one, "Surely not I?"
20. 耶穌對他們說： 「是你們十二使徒中的一個。他正與我一同在盤子裡蘸餅。 He said to them, "[It is] one of the Twelve-- the one who is dipping [bread] with Me in the bowl.
21. 人子確實要離去，正如經上指著他所寫的，但是出賣人子的那個人有禍了。對他來說，沒有出生倒好。」 For the Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born."
22. 在他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝福了，就掰開，遞給門徒們，說： 「你們領受 吧，這是我的身體。」 As they were eating, He took bread, blessed and broke it, gave it to them, and said, "Take [it]; this is My body."
23. 接著，他拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給門徒們。他們都喝了。 Then He took a cup, and after giving thanks, He gave it to them, and so they all drank from it.
24. 耶穌對他們說： 「這是我的血，是為立約 的，為許多人所流的。 He said to them, "This is My blood [that establishes] the covenant; it is shed for many.
25. 我確實地告訴你們：我絕不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在神的國裡喝新的那一天。」 I assure you: I will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it in a new way in the kingdom of God."
26. 他們唱了讚美詩，就出來，往 橄欖山 去了。 After singing psalms, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
27. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們都將被絆倒，因為經上記著： 『我將擊打牧人， 羊群就被分散。』 Then Jesus said to them, "All of you will run away, because it is written: I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.
28. 但是我復活以後，要在你們之前到 加利利 去。」 But after I have been resurrected, I will go ahead of you to Galilee."
29. 彼得 對耶穌說：「即使所有的人被絆倒，我還是不會。」 Peter told Him, "Even if everyone runs away, I will certainly not!"
30. 可是耶穌對他說： 「我確實地告訴你：今天，就在今夜，雞叫兩遍以前，你會三次不認我。」 "I assure you," Jesus said to him, "today, this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times!"
31. 彼得 卻堅決 地說：「就算我必須與你同死，我也絕不會不認你。」所有的門徒也都這麼說。 But he kept insisting, "If I have to die with You, I will never deny You!" And they all said the same thing.
32. 他們來到一個名叫 客西馬尼 的地方。耶穌對他的門徒們說： 「我禱告的時候，你們坐在這裡。」 Then they came to a place named Gethsemane, and He told His disciples, "Sit here while I pray."
33. 他帶了 彼得 、 雅各 和 約翰 一起去。這時候，他開始憂懼起來，極其難過， He took Peter, James, and John with Him, and He began to be deeply distressed and horrified.
34. 對他們說： 「我的靈魂很憂傷，幾乎要死。你們留在這裡，要警醒。」 Then He said to them, "My soul is swallowed up in sorrow-- to the point of death. Remain here and stay awake."
35. 耶穌稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說，如果有可能，讓那時刻離開他。 Then He went a little farther, fell to the ground, and began to pray that if it were possible, the hour might pass from Him.
36. 他說： 「阿爸！父啊！在你，沒有不可能的事，請把這杯從我這裡拿走吧！但不要照我的意願，而要照你的意願。」 And He said, " Abba, Father! All things are possible for You. Take this cup away from Me. Nevertheless, not what I will, but what You will."
37. 耶穌回來，看見他們睡著了，就對 彼得 說： 「 西門，你睡著了？難道你不能警醒一個小時嗎？ Then He came and found them sleeping. "Simon, are you sleeping?" He asked Peter. "Couldn't you stay awake one hour?
38. 要警醒禱告，免得陷入試探。你們心靈雖然願意，肉體卻是軟弱的。」 Stay awake and pray so that you won't enter into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."
39. 耶穌又去禱告，說了同樣的話。 Once again He went away and prayed, saying the same thing.
40. 他又回來，看見他們在睡覺，因為他們的眼皮發沉，也不知道要回答耶穌什麼。 And He came again and found them sleeping, because they could not keep their eyes open. They did not know what to say to Him.
41. 耶穌第三次回來，對他們說： 「你們還在睡覺、休息嗎？已經夠了，時候到了！看哪，人子被交在 罪人的手裡了。 Then He came a third time and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The time has come. Look, the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
42. 起來，我們走吧！看，那出賣我的人快到了！」 Get up; let's go! See-- My betrayer is near."
43. 耶穌還在說話的時候，忽然十二使徒之一的 猶大 來了。有一群人拿著刀劍和棍棒與他一起來，他們是祭司長們、經文士們和長老們所派來的。 While He was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, suddenly arrived. With him was a mob, with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
44. 那出賣耶穌的人已經和他們定了一個暗號，說：「我如果親吻誰，誰就是那個人。你們把他抓住，小心地帶走。」 His betrayer had given them a signal. "The One I kiss," he said, "He's the One; arrest Him and take Him away under guard."
45. 猶大 一到，就上前對耶穌說：「拉比！」然後親吻了他。 So when he came, he went right up to Him and said, "Rabbi!"-- and kissed Him.
46. 他們就下手拘捕了耶穌。 Then they took hold of Him and arrested Him.
47. 站在旁邊的一個門徒拔出刀來，向大祭司的奴僕砍去，削掉了他的一個耳朵。 And one of those who stood by drew his sword, struck the high priest's slave, and cut off his ear.
48. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們帶著刀劍和棍棒出來抓我，就像對付強盜那樣嗎？ But Jesus said to them, "Have you come out with swords and clubs, as though I were a criminal, to capture Me?
49. 我天天在聖殿裡教導人，和你們在一起，而你們不抓我。不過這是為要應驗那些經文。」 Every day I was among you, teaching in the temple complex, and you didn't arrest Me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled."
50. 這時候，所有的門徒都離開他逃跑了。 Then they all deserted Him and ran away.
51. 有一個年輕人，赤身披上一塊細麻布，跟在耶穌後面。那些人 就抓住他， Now a certain young man, having a linen cloth wrapped around his naked body, was following Him. They caught hold of him,
52. 可是他卻丟下麻布，赤著身子逃跑了。 but he left the linen cloth behind and ran away naked.
53. 他們把耶穌帶到大祭司那裡。所有的祭司長、長老和經文士都聚在一起。 They led Jesus away to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes convened.
54. 彼得 遠遠地跟著耶穌，直到進了大祭司的院子裡。他與差役們一起坐在火邊取暖。 Peter followed Him at a distance, right into the high priest's courtyard. He was sitting with the temple police, warming himself by the fire.
55. 當時，祭司長們和全議會的人為了要處死耶穌，都在尋找證據來控告他。可是他們找不出什麼。 The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, but they could find none.
56. 許多人做偽證誣告他，可是這些證詞互相矛盾。 For many were giving false testimony against Him, but the testimonies did not agree.
57. 有一些人站起來做偽證控告他，說： Some stood up and were giving false testimony against Him, stating,
58. 「我們聽他說過『我要拆毀這座人手所造的聖所，三天內另建一座不是人手所造的。』」 "We heard Him say, 'I will demolish this sanctuary made by [human] hands, and in three days I will build another not made by hands.'"
59. 可是他們這個證詞也是互相矛盾的。 Yet their testimony did not agree even on this.
60. 於是大祭司就起來站到中間問耶穌，說：「對這些人控告你的事，你什麼都不回應嗎？」 Then the high priest stood up before them all and questioned Jesus, "Don't You have an answer to what these men are testifying against You?"
61. 耶穌沉默不語，什麼也不回答。大祭司又問他，說：「你是基督——那當受頌讚者的兒子嗎？」 But He kept silent and did not answer anything. Again the high priest questioned Him, "Are You the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?"
62. 耶穌說： 「我就是。而且你們將看見 人子坐在 全能者的 右邊，在天上的雲彩中來臨。 」 "I am," said Jesus, "and all of you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of the Power and coming with the clouds of heaven."
63. 大祭司就撕裂自己的衣服，說：「難道我們還需要什麼見證人嗎？ Then the high priest tore his robes and said, "Why do we still need witnesses?
64. 你們都聽見了這褻瀆的話。你們怎麼看？」 他們都判定他是該死的。 You have heard the blasphemy! What is your decision?" And they all condemned Him to be deserving of death.
65. 接著，有些人開始向他吐唾沫，蒙住他的臉，用拳頭打他，對他說：「你說預言吧！」差役們也用手掌打他。 Then some began to spit on Him, to blindfold Him, and to beat Him, saying, "Prophesy!" Even the temple police took Him and slapped Him.
66. 彼得 正在下邊院子裡的時候，大祭司的一個女僕過來了。 While Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the high priest's servants came.
67. 她看見 彼得 在取暖，就注視著他，說：「你也與那個 拿撒勒 人耶穌是一夥的。」 When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, "You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus."
68. 彼得 卻否認說：「我既不明白，也不知道你在說什麼。」於是他就出去，到了門廊。這時候，雞叫了 。 But he denied it: "I don't know or understand what you're talking about!" Then he went out to the entryway, and a rooster crowed.
69. 那女僕看見他，又開始對站在旁邊的人說：「這個人是與他們一夥的。」 When the servant saw him again she began to tell those standing nearby, "This man is one of them!"
70. 彼得 再次否認。過了一會兒，站在旁邊的人又對 彼得 說：「你真的是與他們一夥的，因為你也是 加利利 人 。」 But again he denied it. After a little while those standing there said to Peter again, "You certainly are one of them, since you're also a Galilean!"
71. 他就開始賭咒並起誓說：「我不認識你們所講的這個人。」 Then he started to curse and to swear with an oath, "I don't know this man you're talking about!"
72. 立時，雞叫了第二遍。 彼得 想起耶穌對他說過的話： 「雞叫兩遍以前，你會三次不認我」， 他就忍不住痛哭起來。 Immediately a rooster crowed a second time, and Peter remembered when Jesus had spoken the word to him, "Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times." When he thought about it, he began to weep.
Mark 15
1. 一到清晨，祭司長們就與長老們、經文士們以及全議會的人商議對策，然後把耶穌捆起來帶走，交給 彼拉多 。 As soon as it was morning, the chief priests had a meeting with the elders, scribes, and the whole Sanhedrin. After tying Jesus up, they led Him away and handed Him over to Pilate.
2. 彼拉多 問他：「你是 猶太 人的王嗎？」 耶穌回答他，說： 「是你說的。」 So Pilate asked Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered him, "You have said it."
3. 祭司長們控告了耶穌很多事 。 And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.
4. 所以 彼拉多 又問他，說：「你什麼都不回應嗎？你看，他們控告你這麼多的事。」 Then Pilate questioned Him again, "Are You not answering anything? Look how many things they are accusing You of!"
5. 可是，耶穌仍然什麼也不回答，以致 彼拉多 感到驚奇。 But Jesus still did not answer anything, so Pilate was amazed.
6. 每逢這節日， 彼拉多 都會給民眾釋放一個他們所要求的囚犯。 At the festival it was Pilate's custom to release for the people a prisoner they requested.
7. 那時，有一個叫 巴拉巴 的，和一同叛亂的人被關在牢裡，他們在暴亂中殺過人。 There was one named Barabbas, who was in prison with rebels who had committed murder during the rebellion.
8. 眾人就上前去，開始要求 彼拉多 按照他的慣例給他們辦。 The crowd came up and began to ask [Pilate] to do for them as was his custom.
9. 彼拉多 問他們，說：「你們要我給你們釋放這 猶太 人的王嗎？」 So Pilate answered them, "Do you want me to release the King of the Jews for you?"
10. 其實 彼拉多 知道祭司長們是出於嫉妒才把耶穌交給他的。 For he knew it was because of envy that the chief priests had handed Him over.
11. 但是，祭司長們煽動眾人，寧願要 彼拉多 給他們釋放 巴拉巴 。 But the chief priests stirred up the crowd so that he would release Barabbas to them instead.
12. 彼拉多 又問他們，說：「那麼，你們要我怎麼處理你們稱為 猶太 人之王的那一位呢？」 Pilate asked them again, "Then what do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?"
13. 他們再次喊叫：「把他釘上十字架！」 Again they shouted, "Crucify Him!"
14. 彼拉多 對他們說：「他到底做了什麼惡事呢？」 但他們卻越發喊叫：「把他釘上十字架！」 Then Pilate said to them, "Why? What has He done wrong?" But they shouted, "Crucify Him!" all the more.
15. 彼拉多 想要討好眾人，就給他們釋放了 巴拉巴，然後將耶穌鞭打 了，把他交出去釘上十字架。 Then, willing to gratify the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. And after having Jesus flogged, he handed Him over to be crucified.
16. 士兵們把耶穌帶進大院，那裡就是總督府，並召集了全隊士兵。 Then the soldiers led Him away into the courtyard (that is, headquarters) and called the whole company together.
17. 他們給他穿上紫色袍子，套上用荊棘編的冠冕， They dressed Him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns, and put it on Him.
18. 然後開始向他致敬說：「萬歲， 猶太 人的王！」 And they began to salute Him, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
19. 他們用蘆葦打他的頭，向他吐唾沫，又跪下來拜他。 They kept hitting Him on the head with a reed and spitting on Him. Getting down on their knees, they were paying Him homage.
20. 他們戲弄完了，就脫下他紫色袍子，給他穿上他自己的衣服，然後帶他出去，要把他釘上十字架。 When they had mocked Him, they stripped Him of the purple robe, put His clothes on Him, and led Him out to crucify Him.
21. 有一個 古利奈 人 西門，是 亞歷山大 和 魯弗斯 的父親，正從鄉下來，經過那裡。他們就強迫他來背耶穌的十字架。 They forced a man coming in from the country, who was passing by, to carry Jesus' cross. He was Simon, a Cyrenian, the father of Alexander and Rufus.
22. 他們把耶穌帶到一個叫 各各他 的地方——「 各各他 」翻譯出來就是「骷髏地」； And they brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means Skull Place).
23. 然後把調了沒藥的酒給耶穌，但他不接受。 They tried to give Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
24. 於是，他們把耶穌釘上十字架，又分他的衣服，抽籤看誰得什麼。 Then they crucified Him and divided His clothes, casting lots for them to decide what each would get.
25. 在上午九點，他們把耶穌釘上了十字架。 Now it was nine in the morning when they crucified Him.
26. 他的罪狀牌上寫的是：「 猶太 人的王。」 The inscription of the charge written against Him was THE KING OF THE JEWS
27. 同時，他們把兩個強盜與耶穌一起釘上十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。 They crucified two criminals with Him, one on His right and one on His left.
28. 這就應驗了經上所說的： 「他被列在不法之徒當中。」 [[So the Scripture was fulfilled that says: And He was counted among outlaws.]]
29. 那些路過的人辱罵耶穌，搖著頭，說：「咳！你這個要拆毀聖所、三天內又建起來的人哪， Those who passed by were yelling insults at Him, shaking their heads, and saying, "Ha! The One who would demolish the sanctuary and build it in three days,
30. 從十字架上下來，救救你自己吧！」 save Yourself by coming down from the cross!"
31. 同樣，祭司長們也與經文士們一起嘲笑，相互說：「他救了別人，卻不能救自己！ In the same way, the chief priests with the scribes were mocking Him to one another and saying, "He saved others; He cannot save Himself!
32. 這個基督， 以色列 的王，現在讓他從十字架上下來吧，好讓我們看了就相信！」與耶穌一起被釘十字架的人也責罵他。 Let the Messiah, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe." Even those who were crucified with Him were taunting Him.
33. 到了中午十二點，黑暗籠罩了整個大地，一直到下午三點 。 When it was noon, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.
34. 下午三點，耶穌大聲呼喊： 「以羅伊，以羅伊！拉瑪撒巴克達尼？ 」 ——這翻譯出來就是 「我的神，我的神！你為什麼離棄我？」 And at three Jesus cried out with a loud voice, " Eloi, Eloi, lem� sabachth�ni?" which is translated, " My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"
35. 站在旁邊的一些人聽見了，就說：「看，他在呼喚 以利亞 呢！」 When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "Look, He's calling for Elijah!"
36. 有一個人跑過去，用海綿蘸滿了酸酒，套在蘆葦上，要給他喝，然後說：「等著吧，我們看 以利亞 會不會來把他放下來。」 Someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine, fixed it on a reed, offered Him a drink, and said, "Let's see if Elijah comes to take Him down!"
37. 耶穌大叫一聲，就斷了氣。 But Jesus let out a loud cry and breathed His last.
38. 同時，聖所裡的幔子從上到下裂成兩半。 Then the curtain of the sanctuary was split in two from top to bottom.
39. 站在耶穌對面的百夫長，看見他這樣 斷了氣，就說：「這個人真是神的兒子！」 When the centurion, who was standing opposite Him, saw the way He breathed His last, he said, "This man really was God's Son!"
40. 還有一些婦女從遠處觀看，其中有 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 、小 雅各 和 約西 的母親 瑪麗亞，以及 莎羅美 。 There were also women looking on from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome.
41. 她們就是耶穌在 加利利 的時候，跟隨他並服事他的人；還有許多別的跟耶穌一同上 耶路撒冷 的婦女。 When He was in Galilee, they would follow Him and help Him. Many other women had come up with Him to Jerusalem.
42. 因為那天是預備日，也就是安息日的前一天，所以到了傍晚， When it was already evening, because it was preparation day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),
43. 亞利馬太 的 約瑟 來了，鼓起勇氣去向 彼拉多 請求要耶穌的遺體。 約瑟 是 猶太 議會中一位受人尊敬的議員，他也期待著神的國。 Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Sanhedrin who was himself looking forward to the kingdom of God, came and boldly went in to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.
44. 彼拉多 聽見耶穌已經死了就感到驚奇，於是叫來了百夫長，問他耶穌是否已經死了 。 Pilate was surprised that He was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him whether He had already died.
45. 他向百夫長了解情況 後，就把遺體 給了 約瑟 。 When he found out from the centurion, he gave the corpse to Joseph.
46. 於是， 約瑟 買了細麻布，把遺體取下來，用細麻布包好，安放在一座岩石鑿成的墓穴裡，又滾來一塊石頭，堵住墓穴口。 After he bought some fine linen, he took Him down and wrapped Him in the linen. Then he placed Him in a tomb cut out of the rock, and rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.
47. 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 和 約西 的母親 瑪麗亞，都看到了安放耶穌的地方。 Now Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses were watching where He was placed.
Mark 16
1. 安息日一過， 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 、 雅各 的母親 瑪麗亞 和 莎羅美 就買了香料，要去膏抹耶穌。 When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, so they could go and anoint Him.
2. 在一週的頭一天，一大清早，太陽剛出來，她們就來到墓穴那裡。 Very early in the morning, on the first day of the week, they went to the tomb at sunrise.
3. 她們互相說：「誰能替我們滾開墓穴口的石頭呢？」 They were saying to one another, "Who will roll away the stone from the entrance to the tomb for us?"
4. 原來那塊石頭非常大。可是她們抬頭一看，見石頭已經被滾開了。 Looking up, they observed that the stone-- which was very large-- had been rolled away.
5. 她們進了墓穴，看見一個年輕人 身穿白袍坐在右邊，就大吃一驚。 When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a long white robe sitting on the right side; they were amazed and alarmed.
6. 那年輕人對她們說：「不要驚慌！你們是在尋找被釘十字架的 拿撒勒 人耶穌，他已經復活 了，不在這裡。看，這就是他們安放他的地方。 "Don't be alarmed," he told them. "You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has been resurrected! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
7. 你們去，告訴他的門徒們和 彼得 ：『他要在你們之前到 加利利 去。在那裡，你們將見到他，正如他告訴過你們的。』」 But go, tell His disciples and Peter, 'He is going ahead of you to Galilee; you will see Him there just as He told you.'"
8. 她們渾身顫抖、驚慌失措， 從墓穴出來就逃跑了。她們因為感到懼怕，什麼也沒有對任何人說。 So they went out and started running from the tomb, because trembling and astonishment overwhelmed them. And they said nothing to anyone, since they were afraid.
9. 在一週頭一天 的清晨，耶穌復活以後，首先向 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 顯現。耶穌曾經從她身上趕出了七個鬼魔。 [[Early on the first day of the week, after He had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had driven seven demons.
10. 她去告訴那些向來與耶穌在一起的人，他們正在悲傷、哀哭。 She went and reported to those who had been with Him, as they were mourning and weeping.
11. 他們聽見耶穌活了，又被 瑪麗亞 看到了，卻是不相信。 Yet, when they heard that He was alive and had been seen by her, they did not believe it.
12. 這些事以後，門徒中有兩個人往鄉下去。在路上，耶穌以另一種形像向他們顯現。 Then after this, He appeared in a different form to two of them walking on their way into the country.
13. 他們去告訴其他的門徒，那些門徒也不相信他們。 And they went and reported it to the rest, who did not believe them either.
14. 後來那十一個使徒吃飯的時候，耶穌向他們顯現，並斥責他們的不信和心裡剛硬，因為他們不相信那些在他復活後看到他的人。 Later, He appeared to the Eleven themselves as they were reclining at the table. He rebuked their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who saw Him after He had been resurrected.
15. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們要到全世界去，向萬人 傳福音。 Then He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
16. 信而受洗 的人，將會得救；不信的人，將被定罪。 Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
17. 這些神蹟將伴隨著信的人：他們將奉我的名驅趕鬼魔；說各種新的語言 ； And these signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new languages;
18. 對付 蛇類；即使喝了致命的東西也絕不受害；按手在病人身上，病人就將痊癒。」 they will pick up snakes; if they should drink anything deadly, it will never harm them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will get well."
19. 這樣，主耶穌 對他們說完話以後，就被接到天上，坐在神的右邊。 Then after speaking to them, the Lord Jesus was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
20. 門徒們就出去，到處傳道。主與他們一同工作，並且藉著伴隨的神蹟證實這話語。 And they went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the accompanying signs.]]
Luke
Luke 1
1. 提阿費羅 大人哪，既然有許多人著手編錄關於在我們中間所成就的事， Many have undertaken to compile a narrative about the events that have been fulfilled among us,
2. 就是照著從起初以來的目擊者和做福音 僕人的那些人所傳給我們的， just as the original eyewitnesses and servants of the word handed them down to us.
3. 我也已經從頭仔細地追蹤了這一切，我就認為應該按著次序寫給您， It also seemed good to me, since I have carefully investigated everything from the very first, to write to you in orderly sequence, most honorable Theophilus,
4. 好讓您了解到您所領受的話語都是確實的。 so that you may know the certainty of the things about which you have been instructed.
5. 在 猶太 王 希律 的那些日子裡，有一個祭司名叫 撒迦利亞，屬於 亞比雅 班組。他的妻子也是 亞倫 的子孫，名叫 伊莉莎白 。 In the days of King Herod of Judea, there was a priest of Abijah's division named Zechariah. His wife was from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
6. 他們兩個人在神面前都是義人，遵行主的一切誡命和公義規定，無可指責。 Both were righteous in God's sight, living without blame according to all the commandments and requirements of the Lord.
7. 可是他們沒有孩子，因為 伊莉莎白 不能生育，兩個人又都上了年紀。 But they had no children because Elizabeth could not conceive, and both of them were well along in years.
8. 有一次，當 撒迦利亞 的班組輪值的時候， 撒迦利亞 在神面前履行祭司的職務， When his division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
9. 照著祭司職務的規矩，抽中了籤就進入主的聖所燒香。 it happened that he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the sanctuary of the Lord and burn incense.
10. 燒香的時候，全體民眾都在外面禱告。 At the hour of incense the whole assembly of the people was praying outside.
11. 有主的一位天使站在香壇的右邊向他顯現。 An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the altar of incense.
12. 撒迦利亞 看見後，就驚慌不安，恐懼就臨到了他。 When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and overcome with fear.
13. 天使對他說： 「 撒迦利亞，不要怕， 因為你的祈禱已蒙垂聽。 你的妻子 伊莉莎白 要為你生一個兒子， 你要給他起名叫 約翰 。 But the angel said to him: Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you will name him John.
14. 他將使你歡喜、快樂， 許多人也會因他的誕生而歡欣， There will be joy and delight for you, and many will rejoice at his birth.
15. 因為他將要在主面前為大。 淡酒和烈酒他絕不能喝， 還在母腹中的時候， 他就會被聖靈充滿。 For he will be great in the sight of the Lord and will never drink wine or beer. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit while still in his mother's womb.
16. 他將使許多 以色列 子民 歸向主——他們的神。 He will turn many of the sons of Israel to the Lord their God.
17. 他將藉著 以利亞 的靈和能力， 在主的面前先行， 使父親的心 轉向兒女， 使悖逆的人 轉向義人的智慧， 好為主準備一群預備好了的子民。」 And he will go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of fathers to their children, and the disobedient to the understanding of the righteous, to make ready for the Lord a prepared people.
18. 撒迦利亞 對天使說：「我憑著什麼能知道這事呢？我是個老人，我的妻子也上了年紀。」 "How can I know this?" Zechariah asked the angel. "For I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years."
19. 天使回答他，說：「我是站在神面前的 加百列，奉差派來對你說話，向你傳達這些好消息。 The angel answered him, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and I was sent to speak to you and tell you this good news.
20. 看哪，你要成為啞巴，不能說話，一直到這些事成就的日子，因為你不相信我的話！到了時候，我的話就會應驗。」 Now listen! You will become silent and unable to speak until the day these things take place, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time."
21. 民眾等候著 撒迦利亞，對他在聖所裡的遲延不出感到驚奇。 Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah, amazed that he stayed so long in the sanctuary.
22. 當他出來不能和他們說話的時候，他們才了解他在聖所裡看到了異象。 撒迦利亞 一直向他們打手勢，卻始終不能說話。 When he did come out, he could not speak to them. Then they realized that he had seen a vision in the sanctuary. He kept making signs to them and remained speechless.
23. 他服事的日子滿了以後，就回家去了。 When the days of his ministry were completed, he went back home.
24. 這些日子以後，他的妻子 伊莉莎白 懷了孕，隱居了五個月。她說： After these days his wife Elizabeth conceived and kept herself in seclusion for five months. She said,
25. 「為了除去我在人間的恥辱，主在這些眷顧的日子裡，這樣看待了我。」 "The Lord has done this for me. He has looked with favor in these days to take away my disgrace among the people."
26. 在第六個月，天使 加百列 從神那裡奉差派，去 加利利 一個叫 拿撒勒 的城， In the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,
27. 到一個童貞女那裡。這童貞女名叫 瑪麗亞，已經許配給 大衛 家族一個名叫 約瑟 的人。 to a virgin engaged to a man named Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin's name was Mary.
28. 天使 來到她面前，說：「蒙大恩的女子，願你歡喜，主與你同在！ 」 And [the angel] came to her and said, "Rejoice, favored woman! The Lord is with you."
29. 瑪麗亞 因這話就驚慌不安，思索這問候到底是什麼意思。 But she was deeply troubled by this statement, wondering what kind of greeting this could be.
30. 天使對她說： 「 瑪麗亞，不要怕， 因為你在神面前蒙恩了。 Then the angel told her: Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
31. 看哪，你將要懷孕生一個兒子， 你要給他起名叫耶穌。 Now listen: You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you will call His name JESUS.
32. 他將要為大， 被稱為至高者的兒子； 主、神要把他先祖 大衛 的王位賜給他。 He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High, and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David.
33. 他要做王統管 雅各 家，直到永遠， 他的國度沒有窮盡。」 He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and His kingdom will have no end.
34. 瑪麗亞 對天使說：「我既然沒有出嫁，怎麼會有這事呢？」 Mary asked the angel, "How can this be, since I have not been intimate with a man?"
35. 天使回答她，說： 「聖靈將要臨到你， 至高者的大能要蔭庇你， 因此，那要誕生的聖者 將被稱為神的兒子。 The angel replied to her: The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore the holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
36. 你看，你的親戚 伊莉莎白 雖然年老，也懷了男胎；那被稱為不能生育的，現在已有六個月的身孕 了。 And consider your relative Elizabeth-- even she has conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month for her who was called barren.
37. 因為在神沒有什麼事是不可能的。」 For nothing will be impossible with God."
38. 瑪麗亞 說：「看哪，我是主的婢女，願這事照著你的話成就在我身上。」於是天使離開了她。 "I am the Lord's slave," said Mary. "May it be done to me according to your word." Then the angel left her.
39. 就在那些日子裡， 瑪麗亞 起身到山區去，趕往 猶大 的一個城， In those days Mary set out and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah
40. 進了 撒迦利亞 的家，問候 伊莉莎白 。 where she entered Zechariah's house and greeted Elizabeth.
41. 伊莉莎白 一聽到 瑪麗亞 的問候，胎兒就在她的腹中跳動， 伊莉莎白 也被聖靈充滿， When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped inside her, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
42. 大聲呼喊說： 「你在婦女中是蒙祝福的， 你腹中的胎兒 也是蒙祝福的！ Then she exclaimed with a loud cry: You are the most blessed of women, and your child will be blessed!
43. 我主的母親竟然到我這裡來，這事怎麼會臨到我呢？ How could this happen to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
44. 看哪，原來你問候的聲音一傳入我的耳朵，胎兒就在我的腹中歡喜跳躍。 For you see, when the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby leaped for joy inside me!
45. 這相信的女子是蒙福的，因為主對她說的話都會實現。」 She who has believed is blessed because what was spoken to her by the Lord will be fulfilled!"
46. 瑪麗亞 說： 「我的心尊主為大， And Mary said: My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord,
47. 我的靈以神我的救主為樂， and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
48. 因為他看顧他婢女的卑微。 看哪，從今以後， 世世代代都要稱我有福， because He has looked with favor on the humble condition of His slave. Surely, from now on all generations will call me blessed,
49. 因為那全能者 為我行了大事； 他的名是神聖的。 because the Mighty One has done great things for me, and His name is holy.
50. 他的憐憫， 世世代代臨到敬畏他的人。 His mercy is from generation to generation on those who fear Him.
51. 他用膀臂施展大能， 驅散那些心思意念驕傲的人。 He has done a mighty deed with His arm; He has scattered the proud because of the thoughts of their hearts;
52. 他把權能者從高位上拉下， 又把卑微的人 高舉。 He has toppled the mighty from their thrones and exalted the lowly.
53. 他用美物滿足飢餓的人， 讓富有的人空手而去。 He has satisfied the hungry with good things and sent the rich away empty.
54. 他扶助他的僕人 以色列， 不忘憐憫， He has helped His servant Israel, mindful of His mercy,
55. 正如他對我們祖先， 對 亞伯拉罕 和他的後裔所說的，直到永遠。」 just as He spoke to our ancestors, to Abraham and his descendants forever.
56. 瑪麗亞 與 伊莉莎白 一起住了大約三個月，就回家去了。 And Mary stayed with her about three months; then she returned to her home.
57. 伊莉莎白 產期到了，生了一個兒子。 Now the time had come for Elizabeth to give birth, and she had a son.
58. 她的鄰居和親戚聽說主向她大施憐憫，就與她一同歡樂。 Then her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her His great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
59. 到了第八天，他們來給孩子行割禮，要按照他父親的名字叫他 撒迦利亞 。 When they came to circumcise the child on the eighth day, they were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
60. 可是孩子的母親應聲說：「不！他要被稱為 約翰 。」 But his mother responded, "No! He will be called John."
61. 他們對她說：「你的親族中沒有叫這名字的。」 Then they said to her, "None of your relatives has that name."
62. 於是他們向孩子的父親打手勢，到底他願意叫他什麼名字。 So they motioned to his father to find out what he wanted him to be called.
63. 撒迦利亞 要了一塊寫字板，寫上：「他的名字是 約翰 。」大家都感到驚奇。 He asked for a writing tablet and wrote: HIS NAME IS JOHN And they were all amazed.
64. 撒迦利亞 的口立刻開了，舌頭也鬆了，就說出話來，頌讚神。 Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue [set free], and he began to speak, praising God.
65. 於是住在他們周圍的人都感到懼怕，整個 猶太 山區的人也都在談論這一切事。 Fear came on all those who lived around them, and all these things were being talked about throughout the hill country of Judea.
66. 所有聽見的人都把這一切存在心裡，說：「這孩子將來究竟會怎麼樣呢？」因為顯然有主的手與他同在。 All who heard about [him] took [it] to heart, saying, "What then will this child become?" For, indeed, the Lord's hand was with him.
67. 他的父親 撒迦利亞 被聖靈充滿，就預言說： Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:
68. 「主—— 以色列 的神是當受頌讚的， 因為他臨到 了他的子民， 並施行了救贖。 Praise the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and provided redemption for His people.
69. 他在他的僕人 大衛 家中， 為我們興起了一隻救恩的角， He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
70. 正如他自古以來藉著聖先知們的口所說的， just as He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets in ancient times;
71. 拯救我們脫離敵人 、脫離一切恨我們之人的手， salvation from our enemies and from the clutches of those who hate us.
72. 向我們的祖先施憐憫， 不忘他神聖的約， He has dealt mercifully with our fathers and remembered His holy covenant--
73. 就是向我們的先祖 亞伯拉罕 所起的誓， the oath that He swore to our father Abraham. He has given us the privilege,
74. 使我們從敵人 的手中被救出， since we have been rescued from our enemies' clutches, to serve Him without fear
75. 在我們所有的日子裡無所懼怕， 以聖潔和公義事奉他； in holiness and righteousness in His presence all our days.
76. 而你——孩子啊！ 你將被稱為至高者的先知， 因為你將走在主的前面， 預備他的路， And child, you will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the Lord to prepare His ways,
77. 藉著罪得赦免， 賜給他的子民救恩的知識。 to give His people knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins.
78. 因著我們神憐憫的心腸， 黎明的曙光將從高天臨到 我們， Because of our God's merciful compassion, the Dawn from on high will visit us
79. 照亮那些坐在黑暗 和死亡陰影中的人， 引導我們的腳步進入平安 之路。」 to shine on those who live in darkness and the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
80. 那孩子漸漸長大，靈裡剛強。他住在曠野，直到他向 以色列 公開出現的那天。 The child grew up and became spiritually strong, and he was in the wilderness until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
Luke 2
1. 就在那些日子裡，凱撒 奧古斯都 頒布諭令，要普天下的人都登記戶口 。 In those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that the whole empire should be registered.
2. 這是頭一次戶口登記，在 居里尼烏斯 任 敘利亞 總督的時候進行的。 This first registration took place while Quirinius was governing Syria.
3. 於是眾人都各回自己的城鎮去登記。 So everyone went to be registered, each to his own town.
4. 約瑟 也從 加利利 的 拿撒勒 城上 猶太 去，到了那叫做 伯利恆 的 大衛 之城，因為他是 大衛 一家一族的人。 And Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee, to Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family line of David,
5. 他和已經許配給他 、懷有身孕的 瑪麗亞 一起去登記。 to be registered along with Mary, who was engaged to him and was pregnant.
6. 他們在 伯利恆 的時候， 瑪麗亞 的產期到了， While they were there, the time came for her to give birth.
7. 就生了她的頭胎兒子。她用布把他包起來放在馬槽裡，因為客店裡沒有地方給他們。 Then she gave birth to her firstborn Son, and she wrapped Him snugly in cloth and laid Him in a feeding trough-- because there was no room for them at the inn.
8. 當時在同一個地區，有些牧人露宿在野地裡，夜間守更看守羊群。 In the same region, shepherds were staying out in the fields and keeping watch at night over their flock.
9. 這時候，主的一位天使站在他們旁邊，主的榮光四面照射他們，他們就大為驚恐。 Then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
10. 那位天使對他們說：「不要怕！因為看哪，我傳給你們一個大喜的信息，是要給萬民的。 But the angel said to them, "Don't be afraid, for look, I proclaim to you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:
11. 今天，在 大衛 的城裡，為你們誕生了一位救主，他就是主基督。 today a Savior, who is Messiah the Lord, was born for you in the city of David.
12. 你們會看見一個嬰孩，用布包著，躺在馬槽裡；這就是給你們的標記。」 This will be the sign for you: you will find a baby wrapped snugly in cloth and lying in a manger."
13. 忽然有一大隊天軍出現，與那位天使一起讚美神，說： Suddenly there was a multitude of the heavenly host with the angel, praising God and saying:
14. 「在至高之處，榮耀歸於神！ 在地上，平安 臨到他所喜悅的人！」 Glory to God in the highest heaven, and peace on earth to people He favors!
15. 天使們離開他們往天上去了， 牧人就彼此說：「來，我們到 伯利恆 去，看看這件已成就的事，就是主讓我們明白的事！」 When the angels had left them and returned to heaven, the shepherds said to one another, "Let's go straight to Bethlehem and see what has happened, which the Lord has made known to us."
16. 於是他們急忙趕去，找到了 瑪麗亞 、 約瑟 和那躺在馬槽裡的嬰孩。 They hurried off and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby who was lying in the feeding trough.
17. 他們看見以後，就把天使告訴他們有關這孩子的話傳開了。 After seeing [them], they reported the message they were told about this child,
18. 所有聽見的人，對那些牧人告訴他們的事，都感到驚奇。 and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.
19. 瑪麗亞 卻把這一切事存在心裡，反覆思想。 But Mary was treasuring up all these things in her heart and meditating on them.
20. 那些牧人因為所見所聞的一切正如天使向他們所說的，就榮耀、讚美神，於是回去了。 The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had seen and heard, just as they had been told.
21. 滿了八天，為孩子行割禮的時候，他們就給他起名叫耶穌。這名字是他在母 腹成胎以前天使所起的。 When the eight days were completed for His circumcision, He was named JESUS-- the name given by the angel before He was conceived.
22. 按照 摩西 的律法，潔淨的日子滿了以後， 約瑟 和 瑪麗亞 領著孩子上 耶路撒冷 去，要把他獻給主。 And when the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were finished, they brought Him up to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
23. 正如主的律法上所記載的： 「所有頭胎的男孩都將被稱為聖歸給主；」 (just as it is written in the law of the Lord: Every firstborn male will be dedicated to the Lord)
24. 並按照主的律法上所說的，獻上了 「一對斑鳩或兩隻雛鴿」 為祭物。 and to offer a sacrifice (according to what is stated in the law of the Lord: a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons).
25. 看哪，在 耶路撒冷 有一個名叫 西面 的人。這個人又公義又虔誠，一直期待著 以色列 得蒙安慰；聖靈也在他身上。 There was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking forward to Israel's consolation, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
26. 他得了聖靈的啟示：自己在經歷死亡 以前會看見主的基督。 It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he saw the Lord's Messiah.
27. 他受了聖靈的感動，來到聖殿。這時候，耶穌的父母抱著孩子進來，要按照律法的規矩為他辦事。 Guided by the Spirit, he entered the temple complex. When the parents brought in the child Jesus to perform for Him what was customary under the law,
28. 西面 把孩子抱在懷裡，頌讚神說： Simeon took Him up in his arms, praised God, and said:
29. 「主啊， 現在可以照你的話， 讓你的奴僕平平安安地離去， Now, Master, You can dismiss Your slave in peace, according to Your word.
30. 因為我的眼睛已經看見你的救恩， For my eyes have seen Your salvation.
31. 就是你為萬民 所預備的： You have prepared [it] in the presence of all peoples--
32. 他是啟示外邦人的光， 是你子民 以色列 的榮耀。」 a light for revelation to the Gentiles and glory to Your people Israel.
33. 他的父母 對這些關於孩子的話，感到驚奇。 His father and mother were amazed at what was being said about Him.
34. 西面 祝福他們，並對孩子的母親 瑪麗亞 說：「看哪，這孩子註定要使 以色列 中許多人跌倒、許多人興起，並要成為一個遭受反對的標記， Then Simeon blessed them and told His mother Mary: "Indeed, this child is destined to cause the fall and rise of many in Israel and to be a sign that will be opposed--
35. 這樣，許多人的心思意念將被顯露出來；你自己的靈魂也要被劍刺透。」 and a sword will pierce your own soul-- that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed."
36. 有一個女先知 安娜，是 亞設 支派 法努埃 的女兒。她已經上了年紀，是出嫁以後與丈夫生活了七年的， There was also a prophetess, Anna, a daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was well along in years, having lived with her husband seven years after her marriage,
37. 後來守寡了，現在已經 八十四歲。她從不離開聖殿，禁食祈禱，日夜事奉神。 and was a widow for 84 years. She did not leave the temple complex, serving God night and day with fastings and prayers.
38. 就在這時候，她也上前來讚頌神，向所有期待著 耶路撒冷 得救贖的人 講說這孩子的事。 At that very moment, she came up and began to thank God and to speak about Him to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.
39. 約瑟 和 瑪麗亞 按照主的律法辦完了一切事以後，就返回 加利利，到自己的城 拿撒勒 去了。 When they had completed everything according to the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
40. 那孩子漸漸長大，剛強 起來，充滿智慧，並且有神的恩典在他身上。 The boy grew up and became strong, filled with wisdom, and God's grace was on Him.
41. 每年逾越節，耶穌的父母都上 耶路撒冷 去。 Every year His parents traveled to Jerusalem for the Passover Festival.
42. 當耶穌十二歲的時候，他們按照節日的規矩上去 。 When He was 12 years old, they went up according to the custom of the festival.
43. 守完了節期，他們回去的時候，孩童耶穌仍然留在 耶路撒冷，他的父母 卻不知道， After those days were over, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but His parents did not know it.
44. 以為他在同行的人群中。他們走了一天的路，才開始在親戚和熟人中找他。 Assuming He was in the traveling party, they went a day's journey. Then they began looking for Him among their relatives and friends.
45. 他們找不到他，就回到 耶路撒冷 去找。 When they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.
46. 到了第三天，他們發現耶穌在聖殿裡，坐在教師們當中，一邊聽，一邊問。 After three days, they found Him in the temple complex sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
47. 所有聽他講說的人，都對他的悟性和對答十分驚訝。 And all those who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.
48. 他的父母看見他，感到吃驚，他的母親就對他說：「孩子啊，為什麼對我們這樣做呢？你看，你父親和我一直在焦急地找你呢！」 When His parents saw Him, they were astonished, and His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You."
49. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們為什麼找我呢？難道不知道我必須在我父的家裡 嗎？」 "Why were you searching for Me?" He asked them. "Didn't you know that I had to be in my Father's house?"
50. 可是他們沒有領悟他對他們說的話。 But they did not understand what He said to them.
51. 於是耶穌與他們一起下去，回到 拿撒勒，一直服從他們。他的母親把這一切事都珍藏在心裡。 Then He went down with them and came to Nazareth and was obedient to them. His mother kept all these things in her heart.
52. 耶穌的智慧和身量，以及神和人對他的喜愛，都不斷增長。 And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and with people.
Luke 3
1. 凱撒 提比略 在位第十五年， 本丟彼拉多 任 猶太 總督， 希律 做 加利利 的分封王，他的弟弟 菲利普 做 以土利亞 和 特拉克尼 地區的分封王， 盧薩尼亞 做 阿比利尼 的分封王， In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod was tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Iturea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
2. 亞納 和 該亞法 任大祭司——那時，神的話語在曠野臨到 撒迦利亞 的兒子 約翰 。 during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, God's word came to John the son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
3. 他就來到 約旦 河周圍所有的地區宣講為罪得赦免而悔改的洗禮。 He went into all the vicinity of the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,
4. 正如先知 以賽亞 書上所記載的話 ： 「在曠野有聲音呼喊著： 『你們當預備主的道， 當修直 他的路！ as it is written in the book of the words of the prophet Isaiah: A voice of one crying out in the wilderness: "Prepare the way for the Lord; make His paths straight!
5. 一切山谷將被填滿， 山嶺小丘將被削平； 扭曲的道將要修直， 崎嶇的路將要鋪平。 Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be made low; the crooked will become straight, the rough ways smooth,
6. 所有的人 都將看見神的救恩。』」 and everyone will see the salvation of God."
7. 約翰 對那些出來受他洗禮的人群說：「你們這些毒蛇的子孫！誰指示你們逃避那將要來臨的震怒呢？ He then said to the crowds who came out to be baptized by him, "Brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
8. 你們應當結出果子，與悔改的心相稱！你們不要自己裡面一開始就說『我們有 亞伯拉罕 為先祖。』我告訴你們：神能從這些石頭中給 亞伯拉罕 興起兒女來。 Therefore produce fruit consistent with repentance. And don't start saying to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father,' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children for Abraham from these stones!
9. 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，所有不結好果子的樹都要被砍下來，被丟進火裡。」 Even now the ax is ready to strike the root of the trees! Therefore every tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."
10. 眾人問他，說：「那麼，我們該做什麼呢？」 "What then should we do?" the crowds were asking him.
11. 約翰 回答說：「有兩件衣服 的，當分給那沒有的；有食物的，也當如此做。」 He replied to them, "The one who has two shirts must share with someone who has none, and the one who has food must do the same."
12. 一些稅吏也來受洗 。他們問 約翰 ：「老師，我們該做什麼呢？」 Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they asked him, "Teacher, what should we do?"
13. 約翰 對他們說：「除了給你們規定的以外，不要多收。」 He told them, "Don't collect any more than what you have been authorized."
14. 有些當兵的 也問他，說：「那麼我們呢？我們該做什麼呢？」 約翰 說：「不要敲詐任何人，也不要勒索人，當以自己的糧餉為滿足。」 Some soldiers also questioned him: "What should we do?" He said to them, "Don't take money from anyone by force or false accusation; be satisfied with your wages."
15. 當時，民眾都在心裡對 約翰 有期待並猜想，或許他就是基督。 Now the people were waiting expectantly, and all of them were debating in their minds whether John might be the Messiah.
16. 約翰 就回答大家，說：「我用水 給你們施洗，但有一位比我更強有力的要來，我就是為他解鞋帶也不配。他要用聖靈和火 給你們施洗。 John answered them all, "I baptize you with water, but One is coming who is more powerful than I. I am not worthy to untie the strap of His sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
17. 他手裡拿著揚穀的杴，要揚淨他的打穀場，把麥子收進他的倉庫，卻把糠秕用不滅的火燒掉。」 His winnowing shovel is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and gather the wheat into His barn, but the chaff He will burn up with a fire that never goes out."
18. 這樣， 約翰 又用很多別的話勸民眾，向他們傳福音。 Then, along with many other exhortations, he proclaimed good news to the people.
19. 分封王 希律 為了他弟弟 的妻子 希羅迪婭 的事，以及自己所做的一切惡事，受到 約翰 的責備。 But Herod the tetrarch, being rebuked by him about Herodias, his brother's wife, and about all the evil things Herod had done,
20. 希律 在這一切事上又加了一件，就是把 約翰 關在監獄裡。 added this to everything else-- he locked John up in prison.
21. 有一次，當民眾都來受洗的時候，耶穌也受了洗。他正在禱告，天開了， When all the people were baptized, Jesus also was baptized. As He was praying, heaven opened,
22. 聖靈好像鴿子，有形有體地 降臨在他身上，並且有聲音從天上傳來，說： 「你是我的愛子， 我喜悅你。」 and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a physical appearance like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: You are My beloved Son. I take delight in You!
23. 耶穌開始傳道 的時候，大約三十歲。照人看來， 他是 約瑟 的兒子， 約瑟 是 希里 的兒子， As He began [His ministry], Jesus was about 30 years old and was thought to be the son of Joseph, [son] of Heli,
24. 希里 是 瑪塔特 的兒子， 瑪塔特 是 利未 的兒子， 利未 是 麥基 的兒子， 麥基 是 雅拿 的兒子， 雅拿 是 約瑟 的兒子， [son] of Matthat, [son] of Levi, [son] of Melchi, [son] of Jannai, [son] of Joseph,
25. 約瑟 是 瑪塔提亞 的兒子， 瑪塔提亞 是 亞摩斯 的兒子， 亞摩斯 是 拿鴻 的兒子， 拿鴻 是 以斯利 的兒子， 以斯利 是 拿該 的兒子， [son] of Mattathias, [son] of Amos, [son] of Nahum, [son] of Esli, [son] of Naggai,
26. 拿該 是 瑪押 的兒子， 瑪押 是 瑪塔提亞 的兒子， 瑪塔提亞 是 西美 的兒子， 西美 是 約瑟 的兒子， 約瑟 是 猶大 的兒子， [son] of Maath, [son] of Mattathias, [son] of Semein, [son] of Josech, [son] of Joda,
27. 猶大 是 約亞拿 的兒子， 約亞拿 是 利撒 的兒子， 利撒 是 所羅巴伯 的兒子， 所羅巴伯 是 撒拉鐵 的兒子， 撒拉鐵 是 尼利 的兒子， [son] of Joanan, [son] of Rhesa, [son] of Zerubbabel, [son] of Shealtiel, [son] of Neri,
28. 尼利 是 麥基 的兒子， 麥基 是 亞底 的兒子， 亞底 是 哥桑 的兒子， 哥桑 是 以摩當 的兒子， 以摩當 是 珥 的兒子， [son] of Melchi, [son] of Addi, [son] of Cosam, [son] of Elmadam, [son] of Er,
29. 珥 是 約細 的兒子， 約細 是 以利以謝 的兒子， 以利以謝 是 約令 的兒子， 約令 是 瑪塔特 的兒子， 瑪塔特 是 利未 的兒子， [son] of Joshua, [son] of Eliezer, [son] of Jorim, [son] of Matthat, [son] of Levi,
30. 利未 是 西緬 的兒子， 西緬 是 猶大 的兒子， 猶大 是 約瑟 的兒子， 約瑟 是 約南 的兒子， 約南 是 以利亞敬 的兒子， [son] of Simeon, [son] of Judah, [son] of Joseph, [son] of Jonam, [son] of Eliakim,
31. 以利亞敬 是 米利亞 的兒子， 米利亞 是 邁南 的兒子， 邁南 是 瑪塔達 的兒子， 瑪塔達 是 拿單 的兒子， 拿單 是 大衛 的兒子， [son] of Melea, [son] of Menna, [son] of Mattatha, [son] of Nathan, [son] of David,
32. 大衛 是 耶西 的兒子， 耶西 是 俄備得 的兒子， 俄備得 是 波阿斯 的兒子， 波阿斯 是 撒門 的兒子， 撒門 是 拿順 的兒子， [son] of Jesse, [son] of Obed, [son] of Boaz, [son] of Salmon, [son] of Nahshon,
33. 拿順 是 亞米拿達 的兒子， 亞米拿達 是 亞特民 的兒子， 亞特民 是 亞蘭 的兒子， 亞蘭 是 希斯崙 的兒子， 希斯崙 是 法勒斯 的兒子， 法勒斯 是 猶大 的兒子， [son] of Amminadab, [son] of Ram, [son] of Hezron, [son] of Perez, [son] of Judah,
34. 猶大 是 雅各 的兒子， 雅各 是 以撒 的兒子， 以撒 是 亞伯拉罕 的兒子， 亞伯拉罕 是 塔拉 的兒子， 塔拉 是 拿鶴 的兒子， [son] of Jacob, [son] of Isaac, [son] of Abraham, [son] of Terah, [son] of Nahor,
35. 拿鶴 是 西鹿 的兒子， 西鹿 是 拉吳 的兒子， 拉吳 是 法勒 的兒子， 法勒 是 希伯 的兒子， 希伯 是 沙拉 的兒子， [son] of Serug, [son] of Reu, [son] of Peleg, [son] of Eber, [son] of Shelah,
36. 沙拉 是 該南 的兒子， 該南 是 亞法撒 的兒子， 亞法撒 是 閃 的兒子， 閃 是 挪亞 的兒子， 挪亞 是 拉邁 的兒子， [son] of Cainan, [son] of Arphaxad, [son] of Shem, [son] of Noah, [son] of Lamech,
37. 拉邁 是 瑪土撒拉 的兒子， 瑪土撒拉 是 以諾 的兒子， 以諾 是 雅列 的兒子， 雅列 是 瑪勒列 的兒子， 瑪勒列 是 該南 的兒子， [son] of Methuselah, [son] of Enoch, [son] of Jared, [son] of Mahalaleel, [son] of Cainan,
38. 該南 是 以挪士 的兒子， 以挪士 是 塞特 的兒子， 塞特 是 亞當 的兒子， 亞當 是神的兒子。 [son] of Enos, [son] of Seth, [son] of Adam, [son] of God.
Luke 4
1. 耶穌充滿聖靈，從 約旦 河回來，被聖靈帶到曠野， Then Jesus returned from the Jordan, full of the Holy Spirit, and was led by the Spirit in the wilderness
2. 受魔鬼的試探四十天。在那些日子裡，耶穌什麼也沒有吃，四十天結束的時候，他就餓了。 for 40 days to be tempted by the Devil. He ate nothing during those days, and when they were over, He was hungry.
3. 魔鬼對他說：「你如果是神的兒子，就吩咐這石頭變成食物吧！」 The Devil said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread."
4. 耶穌回答： 「經上記著： 『人活著不是單靠食物 。』 」 But Jesus answered him, "It is written: Man must not live on bread alone."
5. 魔鬼 就把耶穌領上高處，在一瞬間給他看天下萬國， So he took Him up and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
6. 對他說 ：「這一切權柄和榮耀我都將給你，因為這已經交給了我，我願意給誰就給誰。 The Devil said to Him, "I will give You their splendor and all this authority, because it has been given over to me, and I can give it to anyone I want.
7. 所以，你如果在我面前下拜，這一切就都是你的了。」 If You, then, will worship me, all will be Yours."
8. 耶穌回答說： 「 經上記著： 『要敬拜主——你的神， 唯獨事奉他。』 」 And Jesus answered him, "It is written: Worship the Lord your God, and Him serve Him only."
9. 魔鬼又帶耶穌到 耶路撒冷，讓他站在聖殿的頂端，對他說：「你如果是神的兒子，就從這裡跳下去吧！ So he took Him to Jerusalem, had Him stand on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here.
10. 因為經上記著： 『他會為你吩咐他的天使保護你； For it is written: He will give His angels orders concerning you, to protect you,
11. 他們會用手托住你， 免得你的腳撞在石頭上。』 」 and they will support you with their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone."
12. 耶穌回答說： 「經上說： 『不可試探主——你的神。』 」 And Jesus answered him, "It is said: Do not test the Lord your God."
13. 魔鬼用盡種種試探以後，就暫時離開了耶穌。 After the Devil had finished every temptation, he departed from Him for a time.
14. 耶穌帶著聖靈的能力 回到 加利利，他的消息傳遍了周圍所有的地區。 Then Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about Him spread throughout the entire vicinity.
15. 他在他們的會堂裡教導人，受到所有人的讚揚。 He was teaching in their synagogues, being acclaimed by everyone.
16. 耶穌來到 拿撒勒，就是他長大的地方。在安息日那天，他照自己的習慣進了會堂，站起來要誦讀經文。 He came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As usual, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath day and stood up to read.
17. 有人就把先知 以賽亞 的書遞給他。他展開書卷，找到一處，那裡寫道： The scroll of the prophet Isaiah was given to Him, and unrolling the scroll, He found the place where it was written:
18. 「主的靈在我身上， 因為他膏立我 去向貧窮的人傳福音， 他差派我 去宣告： 被擄的得釋放 瞎眼的得看見， 讓受欺壓的得自由， The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim freedom to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to set free the oppressed,
19. 宣告主所悅納的禧年 。」 to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.
20. 然後耶穌把書捲好，還給會堂助理，坐了下來。會堂裡，眾人的眼睛都注視著他。 He then rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. And the eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him.
21. 耶穌開始對他們說： 「今天，在你們耳中的這段經文，已經應驗了。」 He began by saying to them, "Today as you listen, this Scripture has been fulfilled."
22. 大家都讚許他，對他口裡所發出的恩典的話語感到驚奇，又說：「這不就是 約瑟 的兒子嗎？」 They were all speaking well of Him and were amazed by the gracious words that came from His mouth, yet they said, "Isn't this Joseph's son?"
23. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們一定會用這句諺語對我說：『醫生啊，使你自己痊癒吧！』，『我們聽見在 迦百農 所發生的事，你在你的家鄉這裡也應該做！』」 Then He said to them, "No doubt you will quote this proverb to Me: 'Doctor, heal yourself.' 'All we've heard that took place in Capernaum, do here in Your hometown also.'"
24. 耶穌又說： 「我確實地告訴你們：沒有一位先知在自己的家鄉是受歡迎的。 He also said, "I assure you: No prophet is accepted in his hometown.
25. 我真的告訴你們：在 以利亞 的那些日子裡，天空閉塞了三年六個月，遍地有大饑荒，那時，在 以色列 有許多寡婦； But I say to you, there were certainly many widows in Israel in Elijah's days, when the sky was shut up for three years and six months while a great famine came over all the land.
26. 可是 以利亞 並沒有被派遣到她們中的任何一個人那裡，只被派遣到 西頓 的 撒勒法 一個寡婦那裡。 Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them-- but to a widow at Zarephath in Sidon.
27. 還有，在先知 以利沙 的時代，在 以色列 有許多痲瘋病人；可是除了 敘利亞 人 奈曼 以外，沒有一個人被潔淨。」 And in the prophet Elisha's time, there were many in Israel who had serious skin diseases, yet not one of them was healed-- only Naaman the Syrian."
28. 會堂裡的人聽了這些話，都滿腔怒火。 When they heard this, everyone in the synagogue was enraged.
29. 他們就起來把耶穌趕出城外，拉到山崖上，要把他推下去。他們的城是建在山上的。 They got up, drove Him out of town, and brought Him to the edge of the hill their town was built on, intending to hurl Him over the cliff.
30. 但耶穌從他們中間穿過去，走開了。 But He passed right through the crowd and went on His way.
31. 耶穌下到 加利利 的一個城 迦百農 去，在安息日教導人。 Then He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and was teaching them on the Sabbath.
32. 眾人對他的教導都驚嘆不已，因為他的話具有權柄。 They were astonished at His teaching because His message had authority.
33. 在會堂裡，有一個被汙穢的鬼魔之靈附身的人。他大聲喊叫： In the synagogue there was a man with an unclean demonic spirit who cried out with a loud voice,
34. 「別管我們！ 拿撒勒 人耶穌，我們與你有什麼關係？你來毀滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，你是神的那位聖者。」 "Leave us alone! What do You have to do with us, Jesus-- Nazarene? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are-- the Holy One of God!"
35. 耶穌斥責汙靈說： 「住口！從他身上出來！」 鬼魔把那個人摔倒在眾人中間，就從他身上出來了，但沒有傷害他。 But Jesus rebuked him and said, "Be quiet and come out of him!" And throwing him down before them, the demon came out of him without hurting him at all.
36. 大家都驚訝不已，彼此談論說：「這是什麼事呢？他帶著權柄和能力命令那些汙靈，它們就出來了！」 They were all struck with amazement and kept saying to one another, "What is this message? For He commands the unclean spirits with authority and power, and they come out!"
37. 於是耶穌的名聲傳遍了那一帶所有的地方。 And news about Him began to go out to every place in the vicinity.
38. 耶穌起身離開會堂，進了 西門 的家。 西門 的岳母正發高燒，他們就為她求耶穌。 After He left the synagogue, He entered Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Him about her.
39. 耶穌就站在她旁邊，斥責那高燒，燒就退了。她立刻起來，服事他們。 So He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up immediately and began to serve them.
40. 日落的時候，眾人把患有各種疾病的人都帶到耶穌那裡。他按手在他們每一個人身上，使他們痊癒。 When the sun was setting, all those who had anyone sick with various diseases brought them to Him. As He laid His hands on each one of them, He would heal them.
41. 也有鬼魔從許多人身上出來，喊叫說：「你是 神的兒子！」耶穌斥責它們，不讓它們說話，因為它們知道他是基督。 Also, demons were coming out of many, shouting and saying, "You are the Son of God!" But He rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Messiah.
42. 天亮的時候，耶穌出去，走到一個荒僻的地方。眾人尋找他，來到他那裡，想留住他，不讓他離開。 When it was day, He went out and made His way to a deserted place. But the crowds were searching for Him. They came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving them.
43. 但是耶穌對他們說： 「我還必須到別的城去傳神國的福音，因為我是為此奉差派的。」 But He said to them, "I must proclaim the good news about the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because I was sent for this purpose."
44. 於是耶穌繼續在 加利利 地區的各會堂裡傳道。 And He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
Luke 5
1. 有一次，當人群擁擠著耶穌，聽神的話語 的時候，他正站在 革尼撒勒 湖 邊。 As the crowd was pressing in on Jesus to hear God's word, He was standing by Lake Gennesaret.
2. 他看見湖邊停著兩條船，漁夫們下了船，正在洗網。 He saw two boats at the edge of the lake; the fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.
3. 有一條船是 西門 的，耶穌上去，請他把船划出去，稍微離岸。耶穌就坐下來，從船上教導眾人。 He got into one of the boats, which belonged to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from the land. Then He sat down and was teaching the crowds from the boat.
4. 講完了以後，他對 西門 說： 「把船划到水深的地方，下網捕魚吧。」 When He had finished speaking, He said to Simon, "Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch."
5. 西門 回答說：「老師，我們勞碌了一整夜，什麼也沒有捕到。不過按照你的話，我就下網吧。」 "Master," Simon replied, "we've worked hard all night long and caught nothing! But at Your word, I'll let down the nets."
6. 他們這樣做了，網住了一大群魚，漁網幾乎要撐破。 When they did this, they caught a great number of fish, and their nets began to tear.
7. 他們就招呼另一條船上的夥伴來幫忙；他們過來，裝滿了兩條船，甚至兩條船都幾乎要沉下去了。 So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them; they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
8. 西門彼得 看見，就俯伏在耶穌腳 前，說：「主啊，離開我吧，因為我是個罪人！」 When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus' knees and said, "Go away from me, because I'm a sinful man, Lord!"
9. 那時，他和所有與他一起的人，都對這一網捕到的魚驚訝不已。 For he and all those with him were amazed at the catch of fish they took,
10. 西門 的夥伴，就是 西庇太 的兒子 雅各 和 約翰，也同樣驚訝。 耶穌對 西門 說： 「不要怕！從今以後，你將得人了 。」 and so were James and John, Zebedee's sons, who were Simon's partners. "Don't be afraid," Jesus told Simon. "From now on you will be catching people!"
11. 他們把兩條船靠了岸，捨棄一切跟從了耶穌。 Then they brought the boats to land, left everything, and followed Him.
12. 有一次，耶穌在一個城裡，忽然有個渾身長滿痲瘋的人，看見耶穌就把臉伏在地上，央求他說：「主啊，如果你願意，你就能潔淨我。」 While He was in one of the towns, a man was there who had a serious skin disease all over him. He saw Jesus, fell facedown, and begged Him: "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."
13. 耶穌伸出手來摸他，說： 「我願意，你潔淨了吧！」 痲瘋病立刻離開了他。 Reaching out His hand, He touched him, saying, "I am willing; be made clean," and immediately the disease left him.
14. 耶穌吩咐他不要告訴任何人，說： 「只要去把自己給祭司看，並且為了你的潔淨，照著 摩西 所吩咐的去獻上祭物，好對他們做見證。」 Then He ordered him to tell no one: "But go and show yourself to the priest, and offer what Moses prescribed for your cleansing as a testimony to them."
15. 耶穌的消息反而越發傳開了。有一大群人聚集而來，聽他傳道，也要他們的病得痊癒。 But the news about Him spread even more, and large crowds would come together to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
16. 耶穌卻常常退到曠野去禱告。 Yet He often withdrew to deserted places and prayed.
17. 就在那些日子裡，有一天耶穌在教導人的時候，也有些 法利賽 人和律法教師坐在那裡，他們是從 加利利 和 猶太 地區的各村莊，以及 耶路撒冷 來的。主的大能與耶穌同在，使他能醫病。 On one of those days while He was teaching, Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there who had come from every village of Galilee and Judea, and also from Jerusalem. And the Lord's power to heal was in Him.
18. 這時候，有幾個人用床榻抬來一個癱瘓的人，想把他帶進去放在耶穌面前。 Just then some men came, carrying on a stretcher a man who was paralyzed. They tried to bring him in and set him down before Him.
19. 但由於人多，他們沒有辦法 把他帶進去，就爬上屋頂，從屋瓦中間把他和床榻一起縋到眾人當中，正在耶穌面前。 Since they could not find a way to bring him in because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on the stretcher through the roof tiles into the middle of the crowd before Jesus.
20. 耶穌看見他們的信心，就對癱瘓的人說： 「朋友，你的罪孽已經被赦免了。」 Seeing their faith He said, "Friend, your sins are forgiven you."
21. 那些經文士和 法利賽 人就開始想：「這個人是誰？竟說褻瀆的話。除了神一位之外，誰能赦免罪呢？」 Then the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason: "Who is this man who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
22. 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對他們說： 「你們心裡為什麼這樣想呢？ But perceiving their thoughts, Jesus replied to them, "Why are you reasoning this in your hearts?
23. 或說『你的罪孽已經被赦免了』，或說『你起來走路』，哪一樣更容易呢？ Which is easier: to say, 'Your sins are forgiven you,' or to say, 'Get up and walk'?
24. 不過為要使你們知道人子在地上有赦免罪的權柄——」 耶穌就對癱瘓的人說： 「我吩咐你：起來，拿起你的床榻，回家去吧！」 But so you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"-- He told the paralyzed man, "I tell you: get up, pick up your stretcher, and go home."
25. 那個人立刻在大家面前站了起來，拿起他所躺的床榻回家去，一路上榮耀神。 Immediately he got up before them, picked up what he had been lying on, and went home glorifying God.
26. 於是大家都驚訝不已，就不住地榮耀神，並且滿懷敬畏之心說：「我們今天看到奇妙的事了！」 Then everyone was astounded, and they were giving glory to God. And they were filled with awe and said, "We have seen incredible things today!"
27. 這些事以後，耶穌出去，看到一個名叫 利未 的稅吏，在稅關坐著。耶穌對他說： 「你跟從我！」 After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and He said to him, "Follow Me!"
28. 利未 就撇下一切，站起來跟從了耶穌。 So, leaving everything behind, he got up and began to follow Him.
29. 利未 在自己家裡為耶穌預備盛大的宴席，有一大群稅吏和其他人與他們一同坐席。 Then Levi hosted a grand banquet for Him at his house. Now there was a large crowd of tax collectors and others who were guests with them.
30. 法利賽 人和他們的經文士就向耶穌的門徒們抱怨，說：「你們為什麼與那些稅吏和罪人一起吃喝呢？」 But the Pharisees and their scribes were complaining to His disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"
31. 耶穌對他們說： 「健康的人不需要醫生，有病的人才需要。 Jesus replied to them, "The healthy don't need a doctor, but the sick do.
32. 我來不是要召喚義人，而是要召喚罪人來悔改。」 I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."
33. 他們對耶穌說：「 約翰 的門徒們經常禁食、祈禱， 法利賽 人的門徒們也是如此，而你的門徒們卻又吃又喝。 」 Then they said to Him, "John's disciples fast often and say prayers, and those of the Pharisees do the same, but Yours eat and drink."
34. 耶穌對他們說： 「新郎與賓客 在一起的時候，難道你們能叫賓客禁食嗎？ Jesus said to them, "You can't make the wedding guests fast while the groom is with them, can you?
35. 可是日子將要來到：當新郎從他們中間被帶走的時候，他們那時——在那些日子裡就要禁食了。」 But the days will come when the groom will be taken away from them-- then they will fast in those days."
36. 耶穌又對他們講了一個比喻： 「沒有人從新衣服上撕下一塊布來縫在舊衣服上，否則，他不但撕破了新衣服，而且來自新衣服的那塊布與舊衣服不相稱。 He also told them a parable: "No one tears a patch from a new garment and puts it on an old garment. Otherwise, not only will he tear the new, but also the piece from the new garment will not match the old.
37. 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裡，否則新酒會脹破舊皮袋，酒會流出來，皮袋也會糟蹋了。 And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins, it will spill, and the skins will be ruined.
38. 因此，新酒必須裝在新皮袋裡。 But new wine should be put into fresh wineskins.
39. 沒有人喝了陳酒以後想喝新酒，因為他總說：『還是陳酒好 。』」 And no one, after drinking old wine, wants new, because he says, 'The old is better.'"
Luke 6
1. 有一次在安息日，耶穌從麥田經過，他的門徒們摘下麥穗，用手搓著吃。 On a Sabbath, He passed through the grainfields. His disciples were picking heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands, and eating them.
2. 有一些 法利賽 人說：「你們為什麼做安息日不可以做 的事呢？」 But some of the Pharisees said, "Why are you doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
3. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「 大衛 和那些與他在一起的人飢餓時所做的事，你們難道這個也沒有讀過嗎？ Jesus answered them, "Haven't you read what David and those who were with him did when he was hungry--
4. 他怎樣進了神的殿，拿了陳設餅吃，還分給與他在一起的人呢？這餅除了祭司一個人之外，誰都不可以吃。」 how he entered the house of God, and took and ate the sacred bread, which is not lawful for any but the priests to eat? He even gave some to those who were with him."
5. 於是耶穌對他們說： 「人子是安息日的主。」 Then He told them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
6. 在另一個安息日的時候，耶穌進了會堂教導人。那裡有一個人，右手枯萎了。 On another Sabbath He entered the synagogue and was teaching. A man was there whose right hand was paralyzed.
7. 經文士們和 法利賽 人就密切注意耶穌會不會在安息日使人痊癒，為要找把柄 控告他。 The scribes and Pharisees were watching Him closely, to see if He would heal on the Sabbath, so that they could find a charge against Him.
8. 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對那手枯萎的人說： 「起來，站到中間來！」 那人就起來，站著。 But He knew their thoughts and told the man with the paralyzed hand, "Get up and stand here." So he got up and stood there.
9. 耶穌對他們說： 「我問你們，在安息日是否可以行善或作惡，救命或害命？」 Then Jesus said to them, "I ask you: is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?"
10. 他環視周圍所有的人，然後對那個人 說： 「伸出你的手！」 那個人一伸，他的手就復原了 。 After looking around at them all, He told him, "Stretch out your hand." He did so, and his hand was restored.
11. 他們就滿腔怒火，彼此商量到底怎麼對付耶穌。 They, however, were filled with rage and started discussing with one another what they might do to Jesus.
12. 就在那些日子裡，耶穌有一次出去到山上禱告；他整夜向神禱告。 During those days He went out to the mountain to pray and spent all night in prayer to God.
13. 一到天亮，他就招呼他的門徒，從他們中間揀選了十二個人，稱他們為使徒： When daylight came, He summoned His disciples, and He chose 12 of them-- He also named them apostles:
14. 西門 ——耶穌又稱他為 彼得， 他的弟弟 安得烈， 又有 雅各 、 約翰 、 腓力 、 巴多羅邁 、 Simon, whom He also named Peter, and Andrew his brother; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew;
15. 馬太 、 多馬， 亞勒腓 的兒子 雅各， 稱為激進派 的 西門， Matthew and Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called the Zealot;
16. 雅各 的兒子 猶大， 還有那成為出賣者的 加略 人 猶大 。 Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
17. 耶穌與他們一起下了山，站在一塊平地上。那裡有他的一大 群門徒，還有來自整個 猶太 地區、 耶路撒冷 以及沿海的 提爾 和 西頓 的一大群人。 After coming down with them, He stood on a level place with a large crowd of His disciples and a great multitude of people from all Judea and Jerusalem and from the seacoast of Tyre and Sidon.
18. 他們來是要聽他講說，要他們的病得痊癒。那些被汙靈折磨的，都得了痊癒。 They came to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases; and those tormented by unclean spirits were made well.
19. 眾人都想要摸到他，因為有能力從他身上發出，使所有的人得痊癒。 The whole crowd was trying to touch Him, because power was coming out from Him and healing them all.
20. 耶穌舉目看著他的門徒們，說： 「貧乏的人是蒙福的， 因為神的國是你們的。 Then looking up at His disciples, He said: Blessed are you who are poor, because the kingdom of God is yours.
21. 如今飢餓的人是蒙福的， 因為你們將得飽足。 如今哭泣的人是蒙福的， 因為你們將要歡笑。 Blessed are you who are hungry now, because you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, because you will laugh.
22. 當人們因人子的緣故憎恨你們， 排斥你們，責罵你們， 把你們當做惡人革除你們的名， 你們就是蒙福的。 Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you, insult you, and slander your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.
23. 「在那一天，你們當歡喜，當歡然跳躍，因為看哪，你們在天上的報償是大的。要知道，那些人的祖先也是同樣對待先知們的。 "Rejoice in that day and leap for joy! Take note-- your reward is great in heaven, because this is the way their ancestors used to treat the prophets.
24. 「不過富有的人，你們有禍了， 因為你們已經得到了你們的安慰。 But woe to you who are rich, because you have received your comfort.
25. 如今 飽足的人，你們有禍了， 因為你們將要飢餓。 如今歡笑的人，你們有禍了， 因為你們將要悲傷、哭泣。 Woe to you who are full now, because you will be hungry. Woe to you who are laughing now, because you will mourn and weep.
26. 當所有的人都說你們好的時候， 你們有禍了， 因為他們的祖先也是同樣對待假先知們的。 Woe to you when all people speak well of you, because this is the way their ancestors used to treat the false prophets.
27. 「然而我告訴你們這些正在聽的人：要愛你們的敵人，善待那些恨你們的人； "But I say to you who listen: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
28. 要祝福那些詛咒你們的人，為那些詆毀你們的人禱告。 bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
29. 有人打你這邊的臉，把另一邊也讓他打；有人拿走你的外衣，連裡衣 也不要阻止他拿； If anyone hits you on the cheek, offer the other also. And if anyone takes away your coat, don't hold back your shirt either.
30. 任何人求你，都要給他；有人拿走你的東西，不要討回來。 Give to everyone who asks from you, and from one who takes away your things, don't ask for them back.
31. 你們希望別人怎樣對待你們，你們也應當怎樣對待別人。 Just as you want others to do for you, do the same for them.
32. 如果你們只愛那些愛你們的人，難道有什麼可稱讚的嗎？其實連罪人也愛那些愛他們的人。 If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.
33. 如果你們只善待那些善待你們的人，難道有什麼可稱讚的嗎？連罪人也這樣做。 If you do [what is] good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do that.
34. 如果你們借東西，只借給那些有指望能從他們收取 的人，那有什麼可稱讚的呢？就是罪人也借給罪人，為要如數收回。 And if you lend to those from whom you expect to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners to be repaid in full.
35. 不過你們要愛你們的敵人，要善待人；借出去，不指望任何償還 。這樣，你們的報償就大了，而且你們將成為至高者的兒女，因為他以仁慈待那些忘恩負義和邪惡的人。 But love your enemies, do [what is] good, and lend, expecting nothing in return. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High. For He is gracious to the ungrateful and evil.
36. 你們要仁慈，正如你們的父是仁慈的。 Be merciful, just as your Father also is merciful.
37. 「不要評斷人，你們就絕不被評斷；不要定人的罪，你們就絕不被定罪；要饒恕人，你們就會被饒恕。 "Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
38. 你們要給與，就會被賜予，而且用十足的量器，連搖帶按、滿滿當當地倒在你們懷裡，因為，你們用什麼量器 來衡量，也會同樣地被衡量。」 Give, and it will be given to you; a good measure-- pressed down, shaken together, and running over-- will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you."
39. 耶穌又對他們講了一個比喻： 「難道瞎子能給瞎子領路嗎？兩個人不都會掉進坑裡嗎？ He also told them a parable: "Can the blind guide the blind? Won't they both fall into a pit?
40. 學生不高於他的老師，但所有學成的人，將會像他的老師一樣。 A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
41. 「你為什麼看見你弟兄眼裡的木屑，卻不想自己眼裡的梁木呢？ "Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye, but don't notice the log in your own eye?
42. 你看不見自己眼裡的梁木，怎麼能對你弟兄說『弟兄啊，讓我除掉你眼裡的木屑』呢？你這偽善的人！先除掉你自己眼裡的梁木，然後你才能看得清楚，好除掉你弟兄眼裡的木屑。 Or how can you say to your brother, 'Brother, let me take out the speck that is in your eye,' when you yourself don't see the log in your eye? Hypocrite! First take the log out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to take out the speck in your brother's eye.
43. 「好樹不結壞果子，壞 樹也不結好果子。 "A good tree doesn't produce bad fruit; on the other hand, a bad tree doesn't produce good fruit.
44. 這樣，每一棵樹都是憑著它的果子被認出來。人不從蒺藜中收無花果，也不從荊棘上摘葡萄。 For each tree is known by its own fruit. Figs aren't gathered from thornbushes, or grapes picked from a bramble bush.
45. 好人從他心裡所存的善，發出善來；壞人從他心裡所存的 惡，發出惡來；因為人心裡所充滿的，口裡就說出來。 A good man produces good out of the good storeroom of his heart. An evil man produces evil out of the evil storeroom, for his mouth speaks from the overflow of the heart.
46. 「你們為什麼稱呼我『主啊，主啊！』卻不遵行我所說的話呢？ "Why do you call Me 'Lord, Lord,' and don't do the things I say?
47. 我要指示你們，凡是到我這裡來聽了我的話而實行的人是什麼樣的人： I will show you what someone is like who comes to Me, hears My words, and acts on them:
48. 他好比一個人建造房子，深深地挖掘，把根基立在磐石上。洪水氾濫，急流沖擊那房子，也不能使它搖動，因為建造得穩固 。 He is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid the foundation on the rock. When the flood came, the river crashed against that house and couldn't shake it, because it was well built.
49. 然而，那聽見而不實行的人，就好比一個人把房子建在地面上，沒有根基。急流一沖，立刻倒塌了，並且那房子毀壞得非常厲害。」 But the one who hears and does not act is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The river crashed against it, and immediately it collapsed. And the destruction of that house was great!"
Luke 7
1. 當耶穌向民眾 說完了這一切話，就進了 迦百農 。 When He had concluded all His sayings in the hearing of the people, He entered Capernaum.
2. 有個百夫長所重視的奴僕病得快要死了。 A centurion's slave, who was highly valued by him, was sick and about to die.
3. 百夫長聽說了耶穌的事，就託幾個 猶太 人的長老到耶穌那裡，求耶穌來救他的奴僕。 When the centurion heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to Him, requesting Him to come and save the life of his slave.
4. 他們來到耶穌那裡，殷切地求他說：「這人配得你的幫助， When they reached Jesus, they pleaded with Him earnestly, saying, "He is worthy for You to grant this,
5. 因為他愛我們的同胞，還為我們建了會堂。」 because he loves our nation and has built us a synagogue."
6. 於是耶穌與他們一起去了。當耶穌離他家不遠的時候，百夫長又託了幾個朋友來對耶穌說：「主啊，不用麻煩了，我實在不配請你進我家， Jesus went with them, and when He was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to tell Him, "Lord, don't trouble Yourself, since I am not worthy to have You come under my roof.
7. 我自己也覺得不配到你那裡去。只要你說一句話，我的僕人就會痊癒的。 That is why I didn't even consider myself worthy to come to You. But say the word, and my servant will be cured.
8. 事實上，我也被放在人的權下，也有士兵在我之下。我對這個說『去』，他就去；對那個說『來』，他就來；對我的奴僕說『做這事』，他就去做。」 For I too am a man placed under authority, having soldiers under my command. I say to this one, 'Go!' and he goes; and to another, 'Come!' and he comes; and to my slave, 'Do this!' and he does it."
9. 耶穌聽了這些話，十分感慨，轉過身來對跟隨他的那群人說： 「我告訴你們：在 以色列 我沒有見過這麼大的信心 。」 Jesus heard this and was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following Him, He said, "I tell you, I have not found so great a faith even in Israel!"
10. 那些受託的人回到家裡時，發現那 奴僕已經痊癒了。 When those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the slave in good health.
11. 第二天，耶穌往一個叫做 拿因 的城去，他的 門徒們和一大群人也與他同行。 Soon afterwards He was on His way to a town called Nain. His disciples and a large crowd were traveling with Him.
12. 當他接近城門口的時候，看哪，有一個死人被抬出來了。這人是獨生兒子，他的母親又是寡婦。一大群城裡的人陪著她。 Just as He neared the gate of the town, a dead man was being carried out. He was his mother's only son, and she was a widow. A large crowd from the city was also with her.
13. 主看見那寡婦，就對她動了憐憫之心，向她說： 「不要哭了！」 When the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said, "Don't cry."
14. 於是耶穌上前去，按著棺架，抬棺架的人就停住了。耶穌說： 「年輕人，我吩咐你起來！」 Then He came up and touched the open coffin, and the pallbearers stopped. And He said, "Young man, I tell you, get up!"
15. 那死人就坐了起來，開始說話。耶穌把他交給他的母親。 The dead man sat up and began to speak, and Jesus gave him to his mother.
16. 每個人敬畏不已，就不住地榮耀神，說：「我們中間興起了一位偉大的先知！」又說：「神臨到 他的子民了！」 Then fear came over everyone, and they glorified God, saying, "A great prophet has risen among us," and "God has visited His people."
17. 於是有關耶穌的這消息傳遍了整個 猶太 和周圍所有的地區。 This report about Him went throughout Judea and all the vicinity.
18. 約翰 的門徒們把這一切事都告訴了 約翰 。他就叫來他的兩個門徒， Then John's disciples told him about all these things. So John summoned two of his disciples
19. 派他們到主 那裡去問：「將要來的那一位就是你嗎？還是我們應該等候另一位呢？」 and sent them to the Lord, asking, "Are You the One who is to come, or should we look for someone else?"
20. 那兩個人來到耶穌那裡，說：「施洗者 約翰 派我們來問你：『將要來的那一位就是你嗎？還是我們應該等候另一位呢？』」 When the men reached Him, they said, "John the Baptist sent us to ask You, 'Are You the One who is to come, or should we look for someone else?'"
21. 就在那 時候，耶穌治癒了許多有疾病的、有苦痛的、被邪靈附著的人，又施恩給許多瞎眼的使他們能看見。 At that time Jesus healed many people of diseases, plagues, and evil spirits, and He granted sight to many blind people.
22. 於是耶穌 回答那兩個人，說： 「你們去把所看見、所聽見的告訴 約翰，就是：瞎眼的得以看見，瘸腿的行走，痲瘋病人被潔淨，耳聾的聽見，死人得以復活，窮人得以聽到福音。 He replied to them, "Go and report to John the things you have seen and heard: The blind receive their sight, the lame walk, those with skin diseases are healed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have the good news preached to them.
23. 凡不因我被絆倒 的人，就蒙福了。」 And anyone who is not offended because of Me is blessed."
24. 約翰 的使者離開了，耶穌就開始對眾人談起 約翰，說： 「你們曾經到曠野去，是要觀看什麼呢？一根被風吹動的蘆葦嗎？ After John's messengers left, He began to speak to the crowds about John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
25. 你們出去，究竟是要看什麼呢？一個身穿細軟衣服的人嗎？看哪，那些穿華麗衣服、生活放蕩的人在王宮裡。 What then did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft robes? Look, those who are splendidly dressed and live in luxury are in royal palaces.
26. 你們出去，究竟是要看什麼呢？一位先知嗎？是的，我告訴你們：他比先知還大。 What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and far more than a prophet.
27. 他就是經上記載的那個人： 『看哪，我要差派我的使者在你前頭， 他要在你之前預備你的道 。』 This is the one it is written about: Look, I am sending My messenger ahead of You; he will prepare Your way before You.
28. 「我告訴你們：在女人所生的人中，沒有一個 比 約翰 更大的；然而在神的國裡，再小的也比 更大。」 I tell you, among those born of women no one is greater than John, but the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."
29. 所有已經受過 約翰 洗禮的民眾和稅吏，聽了這話，都承認神是義的； (And when all the people, including the tax collectors, heard this, they acknowledged God's way of righteousness, because they had been baptized with John's baptism.
30. 而沒有受過他洗禮的 法利賽 人和律法師們，就棄絕了神對他們的計劃。 But since the Pharisees and experts in the law had not been baptized by him, they rejected the plan of God for themselves.)
31. 主又說： 「我要把這世代的人比做什麼呢？他們好比什麼呢？ "To what then should I compare the people of this generation, and what are they like?
32. 他們就好比：孩子們坐在街市上，彼此呼叫，說： 『我們為你們吹笛， 你們卻不跳舞； 我們唱哀歌， 你們也不哭泣。』 They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling to each other: We played the flute for you, but you didn't dance; we sang a lament, but you didn't weep!
33. 「因為施洗者 約翰 來了，不吃餅，也不喝酒，你們就說：『他有鬼魔附身！』 For John the Baptist did not come eating bread or drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon!'
34. 人子來了，也吃也喝，你們就說：『看，這個貪食好酒的人！稅吏和罪人的朋友！』 The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, 'Look, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!'
35. 然而，智慧是憑著智慧的眾兒女被證明為義的。」 Yet wisdom is vindicated by all her children."
36. 有一個 法利賽 人請耶穌與他一起吃飯，耶穌就進到那 法利賽 人的家裡坐席。 Then one of the Pharisees invited Him to eat with him. He entered the Pharisee's house and reclined at the table.
37. 當時，城裡有一個女人，是個罪人，她知道耶穌在那 法利賽 人家裡坐席，就拿著一個盛了香液的玉瓶來。 And a woman in the town who was a sinner found out that Jesus was reclining at the table in the Pharisee's house. She brought an alabaster flask of fragrant oil
38. 她站在耶穌後面，在他的腳邊哭泣，開始用淚水沾濕耶穌的腳，再用自己的頭髮擦乾，又親吻他的腳，用香液膏抹。 and stood behind Him at His feet, weeping, and began to wash His feet with her tears. She wiped His feet with the hair of her head, kissing them and anointing them with the fragrant oil.
39. 那邀請耶穌的 法利賽 人看見了，心裡說：「這個人如果是先知，就會知道摸他的是誰，是個什麼樣的女人，因為她是個罪人。」 When the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he said to himself, "This man, if He were a prophet, would know who and what kind of woman this is who is touching Him-- she's a sinner!"
40. 耶穌對他說： 「 西門，我有話要對你說。」 西門 說：「老師，請說。」 Jesus replied to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." "Teacher," he said, "say it."
41. 「有一個債主有兩個欠債人。一個欠五百個銀幣，另一個欠五十個銀幣。 "A creditor had two debtors. One owed 500 denarii, and the other 50.
42. 他們無力償還，債主就免了他們兩個人的債。那麼，你說 他們哪一個會更愛那債主呢？」 Since they could not pay it back, he graciously forgave them both. So, which of them will love him more?"
43. 西門 回答說：「我想是債主免債更多的那一個。」 耶穌說： 「你判斷得對。」 Simon answered, "I suppose the one he forgave more." "You have judged correctly," He told him.
44. 於是，他轉向那女人，對 西門 說： 「你看見這個女人嗎？我進了你的家，你沒有給我水洗腳，但她卻用淚水沾濕我的腳，又用她的頭髮擦乾。 Turning to the woman, He said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no water for My feet, but she, with her tears, has washed My feet and wiped them with her hair.
45. 你沒有向我行親吻禮，而她從我進來的時候起，就不停地親我的腳。 You gave Me no kiss, but she hasn't stopped kissing My feet since I came in.
46. 你沒有用油來膏抹我的頭，她卻用香液膏抹我的腳。 You didn't anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with fragrant oil.
47. 故此，我告訴你：她的罪孽被赦免得多，所以 她愛得多；而那被赦免少的，就愛得少。」 Therefore I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven; that's why she loved much. But the one who is forgiven little, loves little."
48. 接著，耶穌對那女人說： 「你的罪孽已經被赦免了。」 Then He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."
49. 那些與他一同坐席的人就心裡想：「這個人是誰，竟然赦免罪？」 Those who were at the table with Him began to say among themselves, "Who is this man who even forgives sins?"
50. 但耶穌對那女人說： 「你的信救了你，平平安安地去吧。」 And He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."
Luke 8
1. 不久以後，耶穌走遍各個城鎮鄉村，講道、傳神國的福音。與他在一起的有十二使徒 。 Soon afterwards He was traveling from one town and village to another, preaching and telling the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with Him,
2. 還有一些從邪靈和疾病中被解脫出來 、得了痊癒的婦女，其中有那稱為 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞，從她身上曾經有七個鬼魔被趕出來， and also some women who had been healed of evil spirits and sicknesses: Mary, called Magdalene (seven demons had come out of her);
3. 又有 希律 的管家 苦撒 的妻子 約亞娜，以及 蘇珊娜 和許多別的婦女，她們都用自己所擁有的來服事耶穌和門徒們 。 Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward; Susanna; and many others who were supporting them from their possessions.
4. 那時，有一大群人聚集，又有人從各城鎮來到耶穌那裡，耶穌就用比喻說： As a large crowd was gathering, and people were flocking to Him from every town, He said in a parable:
5. 「有一個撒種的出去撒種。他撒的時候，有的種子落在路邊，被人踐踏，天空的飛鳥也把它吃掉了。 "A sower went out to sow his seed. As he was sowing, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds of the sky ate it up.
6. 有的落在岩石上，一長出來就枯萎了，因為得不到水份。 Other seed fell on the rock; when it sprang up, it withered, since it lacked moisture.
7. 有的落進荊棘叢裡，荊棘與它一起生長，把它擠住了。 Other seed fell among thorns; the thorns sprang up with it and choked it.
8. 但另有落進好土壤裡的，長起來，結出百倍的果實。」 耶穌講完這些話，就大聲說： 「凡是有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」 Still other seed fell on good ground; when it sprang up, it produced a crop: 100 times [what was sown]." As He said this, He called out, "Anyone who has ears to hear should listen!"
9. 耶穌的門徒們問他這比喻到底是什麼意思。 Then His disciples asked Him, "What does this parable mean?"
10. 他說： 「神國的奧祕已經賜下來讓你們知道，但是對其他的人就用比喻。這是為要使 『他們看，卻看不見； 聽，卻不領悟。』 So He said, "The secrets of the kingdom of God have been given for you to know, but to the rest it is in parables, so that Looking they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
11. 「原來，這個比喻是這樣的。那種子就是神的話語 。 "This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
12. 那『路邊之地』，是這樣的人：他們聽了這話語，然後魔鬼就來，從他們心裡把話語奪走，免得他們信而得救。 The seeds along the path are those who have heard. Then the Devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
13. 那『岩石』，是這樣的人：他們一旦聽了，就懷著喜樂的心接受了這話語；可是這些人沒有根，他們暫時相信，而在試煉的時候，就離開信仰 了。 And the seeds on the rock are those who, when they hear, welcome the word with joy. Having no root, these believe for a while and depart in a time of testing.
14. 種子落在其中的那『荊棘叢』，是這樣的人：他們聽了，卻走自己的路，被今生的憂慮、財富和享樂擠住了，結不出成熟的果實。 As for the seed that fell among thorns, these are the ones who, when they have heard, go on their way and are choked with worries, riches, and pleasures of life, and produce no mature fruit.
15. 那『好土壤』，是這樣的人：他們聽了這話語，以誠實美善的心持守它，並且在忍耐中結出果實。 But the seed in the good ground-- these are the ones who, having heard the word with an honest and good heart, hold on to it and by enduring, bear fruit.
16. 「沒有人點上油燈，用器皿蓋住或放在床底下，而是放在燈臺上，好讓進來的人能看見光。 "No one, after lighting a lamp, covers it with a basket or puts it under a bed, but puts it on a lampstand so that those who come in may see the light.
17. 隱祕的事沒有不顯露的，隱藏的事絕沒有不被知道、不顯露出來的。 For nothing is concealed that won't be revealed, and nothing hidden that won't be made known and come to light.
18. 所以，你們要留心怎樣去聽；因為凡是有的，還要賜給他；凡是沒有的，連他自以為有的也將從他那裡被拿走。」 Therefore, take care how you listen. For whoever has, more will be given to him; and whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him."
19. 耶穌的母親和弟弟們 來到他那裡，可是由於人多，不能靠近他。 Then His mother and brothers came to Him, but they could not meet with Him because of the crowd.
20. 有人告訴他：「你母親和弟弟們站在外面，想要見你。」 He was told, "Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You."
21. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「我的母親、我的弟兄，是那些聽神的話語 而遵行的人。」 But He replied to them, "My mother and My brothers are those who hear and do the word of God."
