22. 就在那些日子裡，有一天耶穌和他的門徒們上了船，耶穌對他們說： 「我們渡到湖對岸去吧。」 他們就出發了。 One day He and His disciples got into a boat, and He told them, "Let's cross over to the other side of the lake." So they set out,
23. 船行的時候，耶穌睡著了。這時候，暴風降臨到湖上，他們不斷地被水浸灌，情況危險。 and as they were sailing He fell asleep. Then a fierce windstorm came down on the lake; they were being swamped and were in danger.
24. 門徒們上前來叫醒耶穌，說：「老師，老師，我們沒命了！」耶穌就起來，斥責風和浪，風浪就止息，湖面就變得平靜。 They came and woke Him up, saying, "Master, Master, we're going to die!" Then He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waves. So they ceased, and there was a calm.
25. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們的信仰在哪裡？」 他們又懼怕，又驚奇，彼此說：「這個人究竟是誰？他竟然命令風和水，連風和水也聽從他！」 He said to them, "Where is your faith?" They were fearful and amazed, asking one another, "Who can this be? He commands even the winds and the waves, and they obey Him!"
26. 他們行船到了 格拉森 人的地方，就是 加利利 的對岸。 Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
27. 耶穌剛上岸，那城裡一個有鬼魔附身的人就迎面而來。這個人已經很長時間不穿衣服，不住在家裡，而住在墓地裡。 When He got out on land, a demon-possessed man from the town met Him. For a long time he had worn no clothes and did not stay in a house but in the tombs.
28. 他一看見耶穌，就喊叫起來，俯伏在耶穌面前，大聲說：「至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你有什麼關係？求求你不要折磨我！」 When he saw Jesus, he cried out, fell down before Him, and said in a loud voice, "What do You have to do with me, Jesus, You Son of the Most High God? I beg You, don't torment me!"
29. 這是因為耶穌吩咐汙靈從那個人身上出來。原來汙靈曾多次抓住那個人，雖然他被鐵鏈和腳鐐捆鎖，被看守著，可是他掙斷鎖鏈，被鬼魔驅逐到曠野去。 For He had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and although he was guarded, bound by chains and shackles, he would snap the restraints and be driven by the demon into deserted places.
30. 耶穌問他： 「你叫什麼名字？」 他回答說：「 軍團 。」因為有許多鬼魔進到他裡面。 "What is your name?" Jesus asked him. "Legion," he said-- because many demons had entered him.
31. 那些鬼魔央求耶穌不要命令它們進無底坑去。 And they begged Him not to banish them to the abyss.
32. 當時，那裡有一大群豬正在山上吃食。那些鬼魔就央求耶穌准許它們進入那些豬裡，耶穌准許了它們。 A large herd of pigs was there, feeding on the hillside. The demons begged Him to permit them to enter the pigs, and He gave them permission.
33. 鬼魔就從那個人身上出來，進入豬裡面。於是那群豬從山崖衝到湖裡淹死了。 The demons came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
34. 那些放豬的人看見所發生的事，就逃跑了，去 把這事傳到城裡城外。 When the men who tended them saw what had happened, they ran off and reported it in the town and in the countryside.
35. 人們就出來，要看所發生的事，他們來到耶穌那裡，看見鬼魔所離開的那人，穿著衣服，神志清醒地坐在耶穌腳前，他們就懼怕起來。 Then people went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man the demons had departed from, sitting at Jesus' feet, dressed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.
36. 那些看見的人，就告訴大家被鬼魔附身的人怎樣得到救治。 Meanwhile the eyewitnesses reported to them how the demon-possessed man was delivered.
37. 格拉森 一帶的全體民眾請求耶穌離開他們，因為他們十分懼怕。耶穌就上船回去了。 Then all the people of the Gerasene region asked Him to leave them, because they were gripped by great fear. So getting into the boat, He returned.
38. 鬼魔所離開的那人央求耶穌，要和他在一起，但耶穌 讓他走，說： The man from whom the demons had departed kept begging Him to be with Him. But He sent him away and said,
39. 「你回家去吧，述說神為你做了什麼。」 於是他就離開了，在全城裡傳揚耶穌為他做了什麼樣的事 。 "Go back to your home, and tell all that God has done for you." And off he went, proclaiming throughout the town all that Jesus had done for him.
40. 耶穌回來的時候，一群人來歡迎他，原來大家一直在等候他。 When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they were all expecting Him.
41. 這時候，來了一個名叫 睚魯 的人，他是一個會堂主管。他俯伏在耶穌腳前，懇求耶穌到他家裡去， Just then, a man named Jairus came. He was a leader of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus' feet and pleaded with Him to come to his house,
42. 因為他有一個約十二歲的獨生女兒，快要死了。 耶穌去的時候，人群擁擠著他。 because he had an only daughter about 12 years old, and she was at death's door. While He was going, the crowds were nearly crushing Him.
43. 有一個婦人，患了十二年的血漏病，在醫生那裡花盡了她所有的養生費用， 卻沒有一個人能使她痊癒。 A woman suffering from bleeding for 12 years, who had spent all she had on doctors yet could not be healed by any,
44. 她從耶穌後面過來，摸了一下耶穌的衣服穗子，立刻，她的血漏就止住了。 approached from behind and touched the tassel of His robe. Instantly her bleeding stopped.
45. 耶穌說： 「誰摸了我？」 大家都否認。 彼得 就說：「老師，人群正圍著擁擠你呢！ 」 "Who touched Me?" Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, "Master, the crowds are hemming You in and pressing against You."
46. 但是耶穌說： 「有人摸了我，因為我知道有能力從我身上出去了。」 "Somebody did touch Me," said Jesus. "I know that power has gone out from Me."
47. 那婦人知道瞞不過了，就戰戰兢兢地上前俯伏在耶穌面前，在全體民眾面前說出她是因什麼理由摸了耶穌，以及怎樣立刻得了痊癒。 When the woman saw that she was discovered, she came trembling and fell down before Him. In the presence of all the people, she declared the reason she had touched Him and how she was instantly cured.
48. 耶穌對她說： 「女兒， 你的信救了你，平平安安地去吧。」 "Daughter," He said to her, "your faith has made you well. Go in peace."
49. 耶穌還在說話的時候，有人從會堂主管的家 來，對 睚魯 說：「你的女兒已經死了，不要再麻煩老師了。」 While He was still speaking, someone came from the synagogue leader's [house], saying, "Your daughter is dead. Don't bother the Teacher anymore."
50. 耶穌聽了，就對 睚魯 說： 「不要怕，只要信！她就會得救治。」 When Jesus heard it, He answered him, "Don't be afraid. Only believe, and she will be made well."
51. 耶穌來到他的家，除了 彼得 、 約翰 、 雅各 和孩子的父母以外，不准任何人與他一起進去。 After He came to the house, He let no one enter with Him except Peter, John, James, and the child's father and mother.
52. 大家都在為那女孩捶胸哀哭。耶穌說： 「不要哭！她不是死了，而是睡了。」 Everyone was crying and mourning for her. But He said, "Stop crying, for she is not dead but asleep."
53. 他們知道女孩已經死了，就譏笑耶穌。 They started laughing at Him, because they knew she was dead.
54. 但是耶穌 握著女孩的手，呼喚說： 「孩子，起來！」 So He took her by the hand and called out, "Child, get up!"
55. 於是她的靈魂回來了，她就立刻起來。耶穌吩咐給她吃東西。 Her spirit returned, and she got up at once. Then He gave orders that she be given something to eat.
56. 她的父母十分驚訝，耶穌吩咐他們不要把所發生的事告訴任何人。 Her parents were astounded, but He instructed them to tell no one what had happened.
Luke 9
1. 耶穌召集了十二使徒，賜給他們能力和權柄勝過一切鬼魔，又能治癒各樣疾病， Summoning the Twelve, He gave them power and authority over all the demons, and [power] to heal diseases.
2. 然後差派他們去宣講神的國，並且使病人痊癒。 Then He sent them to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
3. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們在路上什麼都不要帶。不要帶手杖，不要帶行囊，不要帶食物，不要帶銀子，每個人也不要帶兩件衣服 。 "Take nothing for the road," He told them, "no walking stick, no traveling bag, no bread, no money; and don't take an extra shirt.
4. 你們無論進哪一家，就要住在那裡，也要從那裡再出發。 Whatever house you enter, stay there and leave from there.
5. 如果他們不接受你們，你們離開那城的時候，要把腳上的塵土跺掉，做為對他們的見證。」 If they do not welcome you, when you leave that town, shake off the dust from your feet as a testimony against them."
6. 使徒們就出去，走遍各村莊到處傳福音，使人痊癒。 So they went out and traveled from village to village, proclaiming the good news and healing everywhere.
7. 分封王 希律 聽說了所發生的這一切，就感到困惑，因為有些人說：「 約翰 從死人中復活了。」 Herod the tetrarch heard about everything that was going on. He was perplexed, because some said that John had been raised from the dead,
8. 也有些人說：「 以利亞 顯現了。」還有些人說：「古時候的一位先知復活了。」 some that Elijah had appeared, and others that one of the ancient prophets had risen.
9. 但 希律 卻說：「我已經砍了 約翰 的頭，而這個人又是誰呢？我竟聽到關於他這樣的事！」於是 希律 就想要見他。 "I beheaded John," Herod said, "but who is this I hear such things about?" And he wanted to see Him.
10. 使徒們回來，把他們所做的事都告訴了耶穌。耶穌就帶著他們，悄悄地退往一個叫做 伯賽達 的城 去。 When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus all that they had done. He took them along and withdrew privately to a town called Bethsaida.
11. 可是眾人知道了，就跟著他去。耶穌歡迎他們，向他們講說有關神國的事，並且使那些需要醫治的人得痊癒。 When the crowds found out, they followed Him. He welcomed them, spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and cured those who needed healing.
12. 太陽開始平西的時候，十二使徒前來對耶穌說：「請遣散人群，好讓他們到周圍的村莊和田舍去借宿、找食物，因為我們這裡是個荒僻的地方。」 Late in the day, the Twelve approached and said to Him, "Send the crowd away, so they can go into the surrounding villages and countryside to find food and lodging, because we are in a deserted place here."
13. 但耶穌對他們說： 「你們給他們吃的吧。」 他們說：「我們只有五個餅和兩條魚，除非我們去為全體民眾買食物。」 "You give them something to eat," He told them. "We have no more than five loaves and two fish," they said, "unless we go and buy food for all these people."
14. 當時，男人就約有五千。 耶穌對他的門徒們說： 「叫他們分組坐下，每組約五十人。」 (For about 5,000 men were there.) Then He told His disciples, "Have them sit down in groups of about 50 each."
15. 門徒們就如此行，叫大家都坐下。 They did so, and had them all sit down.
16. 耶穌拿起這五個餅和兩條魚，抬頭望天，祝福了，然後掰開，不斷遞給門徒們，讓他們分給眾人。 Then He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke them. He kept giving them to the disciples to set before the crowd.
17. 大家吃了，並且都吃飽了。他們把剩下的碎塊收拾起來，裝滿了 十二個籃子。 Everyone ate and was filled. Then they picked up 12 baskets of leftover pieces.
18. 有一次，耶穌獨自禱告的時候，門徒們和他在一起。耶穌問他們，說： 「眾人說我是誰？」 While He was praying in private and His disciples were with Him, He asked them, "Who do the crowds say that I am?"
19. 他們回答說：「是施洗者 約翰，有的說是 以利亞，也有的說是古時候的一位先知復活了。」 They answered, "John the Baptist; others, Elijah; still others, that one of the ancient prophets has come back."
20. 耶穌問他們： 「那麼你們呢？你們說我是誰？」 彼得 回答說：「是神的基督！」 "But you," He asked them, "who do you say that I am?" Peter answered, "God's Messiah!"
21. 耶穌告誡他們，吩咐他們不要把這事告訴任何人。 But He strictly warned and instructed them to tell this to no one,
22. 又說： 「人子必須受很多苦害，被長老們、祭司長們和經文士們棄絕，並且被殺，然後在第三天復活。」 saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, be killed, and be raised the third day."
23. 耶穌又對大家說： 「如果有人想要來跟從我，他就當否定自己，天天 背起自己的十字架，然後跟從我。 Then He said to [them] all, "If anyone wants to come with Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross daily, and follow Me.
24. 因為凡想要保全 自己生命的，將失去生命；凡為我的緣故失去自己生命的，這個人將保全 生命。 For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of Me will save it.
25. 一個人就是賺得了全世界，卻喪失了自己，或賠上了自己，到底有什麼益處呢？ What is a man benefited if he gains the whole world, yet loses or forfeits himself?
26. 一個人如果以我和我的話為恥，當人子在自己、父，和聖天使們的榮耀中來臨的時候，也要以這個人為恥。 For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and that of the Father and the holy angels.
27. 我確實地告訴你們：站在這裡的有些人，在還沒有嘗到死的滋味之前，必定見到神的國。」 I tell you the truth: there are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God."
28. 說了這些話以後約八天，耶穌帶著 彼得 、 約翰 、 雅各 上山去禱告。 About eight days after these words, He took along Peter, John, and James, and went up on the mountain to pray.
29. 正在禱告的時候，耶穌的相貌改變了，衣服也潔白發光。 As He was praying, the appearance of His face changed, and His clothes became dazzling white.
30. 這時候，忽然有兩個人和耶穌談話——他們是 摩西 和 以利亞 —— Suddenly, two men were talking with Him-- Moses and Elijah.
31. 他們在榮光中顯現，談論耶穌離世的事，就是他將要在 耶路撒冷 成就的事。 They appeared in glory and were speaking of His death, which He was about to accomplish in Jerusalem.
32. 彼得 和他的同伴正在沉睡著。可是他們清醒過來時，看見了耶穌的榮光和同他站著的那兩個人。 Peter and those with him were in a deep sleep, and when they became fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men who were standing with Him.
33. 那兩個人正要離開耶穌的時候， 彼得 對耶穌說：「老師，我們在這裡真好！讓我們來搭三座帳幕，一座為你，一座為 摩西，一座為 以利亞 。」他不知道自己在說什麼。 As the two men were departing from Him, Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it's good for us to be here! Let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"-- not knowing what he said.
34. 他正說這些話，有一朵雲彩出現，籠罩著他們。他們一沒入雲彩中，門徒們就懼怕起來。 While he was saying this, a cloud appeared and overshadowed them. They became afraid as they entered the cloud.
35. 有聲音從雲中傳來，說： 「這是我的兒子，我所揀選的 。 你們當聽從他！」 Then a voice came from the cloud, saying: This is My Son, the Chosen One; listen to Him!
36. 聲音過後，門徒們發現只有耶穌一個人了。在那些日子裡，他們保持沉默，沒有告訴任何人他們所看到的事。 After the voice had spoken, only Jesus was found. They kept silent, and in those days told no one what they had seen.
37. 第二天，他們從山上下來，有一大群人迎著耶穌而來。 The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met Him.
38. 這時候，忽然人群中有一個人呼喊說：「老師，求求你看顧我的兒子吧！因為他是我的獨生兒子。 Just then a man from the crowd cried out, "Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, because he's my only [child].
39. 你看，邪靈抓住他，忽然喊叫起來，又使他抽瘋，口吐白沫；邪靈折磨著他，就是不離開。 Often a spirit seizes him; suddenly he shrieks, and it throws him into convulsions until he foams at the mouth; wounding him, it hardly ever leaves him.
40. 我求過你的門徒們，要他們驅趕那邪靈，可是他們不能。」 I begged Your disciples to drive it out, but they couldn't."
41. 耶穌回答說： 「唉，這個不信、歪曲的世代！我還要和你們在一起多久呢？我還要容忍你們多久呢？把你的兒子帶到這裡來吧！」 Jesus replied, "You unbelieving and rebellious generation! How long will I be with you and put up with you? Bring your son here."
42. 那孩子上前來的時候，鬼魔把他摔倒，使他劇烈地抽瘋。耶穌就斥責那汙靈，使孩子痊癒，把孩子交給他父親。 As the boy was still approaching, the demon knocked him down and threw him into severe convulsions. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, cured the boy, and gave him back to his father.
43. 大家都對神的威榮驚嘆不已。 正當大家對耶穌所做的一切感到驚奇的時候，耶穌對他的門徒們說： And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was amazed at all the things He was doing, He told His disciples,
44. 「你們要把這話存在耳中：人子將要被交在 人的手中。」 "Let these words sink in: the Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men."
45. 可是他們不明白這話，因為這話的意思對他們是隱藏的，使他們不能領悟。他們也不敢問耶穌這話的意思。 But they did not understand this statement; it was concealed from them so that they could not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
46. 門徒之間起了爭論：他們當中到底誰更大。 Then an argument started among them about who would be the greatest of them.
47. 耶穌看出他們心中的意念，就領來一個小孩子，讓他站在自己身旁， But Jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, took a little child and had him stand next to Him.
48. 然後對他們說： 「無論誰奉我的名接受這小孩子，就是接受我；接受我的，就是接受差派我來的那一位。要知道，在你們當中誰更小，他才為大。」 He told them, "Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me. And whoever welcomes Me welcomes Him who sent Me. For whoever is least among you-- this one is great."
49. 約翰 回答說：「老師，我們看見一個人奉你的名驅趕鬼魔，我們就去阻止他，因為他不與我們一起跟從你。」 John responded, "Master, we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him because he does not follow us."
50. 耶穌對他說： 「不要阻止他，因為不反對你們的，就是支持你們的 。」 "Don't stop him," Jesus told him, "because whoever is not against you is for you."
51. 耶穌升天的日子快到了，他就堅定地面向 耶路撒冷 而去。 When the days were coming to a close for Him to be taken up, He determined to journey to Jerusalem.
52. 他派了幾個使者在他前頭。他們就去了，進到 撒馬利亞 人的一個村子，要為他做預備。 He sent messengers ahead of Him, and on the way they entered a village of the Samaritans to make preparations for Him.
53. 但那裡的人不接受他，因為他是往 耶路撒冷 去的。 But they did not welcome Him, because He determined to journey to Jerusalem.
54. 門徒 雅各 和 約翰 看見了，就說：「主啊，你要我們 吩咐火從天上降下來燒滅他們嗎？」 When the disciples James and John saw this, they said, "Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?"
55. 耶穌轉過身來責備他們 。 But He turned and rebuked them,
56. 於是他們往別的村子去了。 and they went to another village.
57. 他們在路上走的時候，有一個人對耶穌說：「 無論你到哪裡去，我都要跟從你。」 As they were traveling on the road someone said to Him, "I will follow You wherever You go!"
58. 耶穌對他說： 「狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。」 Jesus told him, "Foxes have dens, and birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head."
59. 耶穌對另一個人說： 「你跟從我！」 可是他說：「主啊，請准許我先去埋葬我的父親。」 Then He said to another, "Follow Me." "Lord," he said, "first let me go bury my father."
60. 耶穌 對他說： 「讓死人去埋葬他們的死人吧。至於你，你要去宣講神的國。」 But He told him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and spread the news of the kingdom of God."
61. 另有一個人說：「主啊，我要跟從你，但是請准許我先向我家裡的人告別。」 Another also said, "I will follow You, Lord, but first let me go and say good-bye to those at my house."
62. 耶穌對他說： 「手扶著犁又看背後之事的人，不配神的國。」 But Jesus said to him, "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God."
Luke 10
1. 這些事以後，主另外指定了七十 個人，差派他們兩個兩個地在他前頭，到他要去的各城各地去。 After this, the Lord appointed 70 others, and He sent them ahead of Him in pairs to every town and place where He Himself was about to go.
2. 耶穌對他們說： 「收割的工作 多，而工人少。所以你們要祈求收割 的主催促工人參與他的收割工作 。 He told them: "The harvest is abundant, but the workers are few. Therefore, pray to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest.
3. 你們去吧！看哪，我差派你們出去，就像把羊羔送進狼群中。 Now go; I'm sending you out like lambs among wolves.
4. 你們不要帶錢包，不要帶行囊，不要帶鞋子，在路上也不要問候任何人。 Don't carry a money-bag, traveling bag, or sandals; don't greet anyone along the road.
5. 你們無論進哪一家，首先要說『願這一家平安。』 Whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace to this household.'
6. 如果那裡有平安之子，你們的平安就會臨到他；否則，那平安就歸回你們。 If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
7. 你們當住在那一家，吃喝他們所供給的，因為工人配得自己的酬報。不要從這家搬到那家。 Remain in the same house, eating and drinking what they offer, for the worker is worthy of his wages. Don't be moving from house to house.
8. 無論進哪一個城，如果人們接受你們，給你們擺上什麼，你們就吃什麼。 When you enter any town, and they welcome you, eat the things set before you.
9. 你們要使那城裡的病人痊癒，並且要對他們說『神的國臨近你們了。』 Heal the sick who are there, and tell them, 'The kingdom of God has come near you.'
10. 無論進哪一個城，如果人們不接受你們，你們就到大街 上去，說 When you enter any town, and they don't welcome you, go out into its streets and say,
11. 『連那沾在我們腳上 的你們城裡的塵土，我們也要當著你們擦掉，不過你們應當知道：神的國近了 。』 'We are wiping off [as a witness] against you even the dust of your town that clings to our feet. Know this for certain: the kingdom of God has come near.'
12. 我告訴你們：在那日， 所多瑪 所受的，將要比那城還容易受呢！ I tell you, on that day it will be more tolerable for Sodom than for that town.
13. 「 哥拉汛 哪，你有禍了！ 伯賽達 呀，你有禍了！因為在你們當中行過的神蹟，如果行在 提爾 和 西頓，那裡的人早就會披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。 "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes!
14. 不過在審判的時候， 提爾 和 西頓 所受的，將要比你們還容易受呢！ But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
15. 而你—— 迦百農 啊，你將被高舉到天上嗎？不，你將下到陰間。 And you, Capernaum, will you be exalted to heaven? No, you will go down to Hades!
16. 「聽從你們的，就是聽從我；拒絕你們的，就是拒絕我；拒絕我的，就是拒絕差派我來的那一位。」 Whoever listens to you listens to Me. Whoever rejects you rejects Me. And whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me."
17. 那七十 個人懷著喜樂的心回來，說：「主啊，奉你的名，連鬼魔也服從了我們。」 The Seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name."
18. 耶穌對他們說： 「我看見 撒旦 像閃電一樣從天上墜落。 He said to them, "I watched Satan fall from heaven like a lightning flash.
19. 看，我已經給了你們權柄去踐踏蛇和蠍子，又勝過仇敵一切的勢力，絕不會有什麼能傷害你們了。 Look, I have given you the authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy; nothing will ever harm you.
20. 但不要因為邪靈服從了你們就歡喜，要因為你們的名字已經被記錄在天上而歡喜。」 However, don't rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."
21. 那時候，耶穌 受了聖靈的感動就快樂，說： 「父啊，天地的主，我讚美 你，因為你把這些事向有智慧的和有學問的人隱藏起來，而向小孩子們顯明出來。是的，父啊！因為這正是你的美意。」 In that same hour He rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and said, "I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and the learned and have revealed them to infants. Yes, Father, because this was Your good pleasure.
22. 「我父把一切都交給了我。除了父，沒有人知道子是誰；除了子和子所願意啟示的人，也沒有人知道父是誰。」 All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and anyone to whom the Son desires to reveal Him."
23. 耶穌轉過身來，悄悄地對門徒們說： 「看見你們所看見的，那眼睛是蒙福的！ Then turning to His disciples He said privately, "The eyes that see the things you see are blessed!
24. 我告訴你們：曾經有許多先知和君王想要看你們所看見的，卻沒有看到；想要聽你們所聽見的，卻沒有聽到。」 For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see the things you see yet didn't see them; to hear the things you hear yet didn't hear them."
25. 這時候，忽然有一個律法師站起來試探耶穌，說：「老師，我該做什麼才會繼承永恆的生命呢？」 Just then an expert in the law stood up to test Him, saying, "Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
26. 耶穌對他說： 「律法上是怎麼寫的？你是怎麼讀的呢？」 "What is written in the law?" He asked him. "How do you read it?"
27. 他回答說： 「你要以全心、全靈、全力、全意愛主——你的神，並且要愛鄰如己。」 He answered: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.
28. 耶穌說： 「你回答得對。你這樣去做，就將活著。」 "You've answered correctly," He told him. "Do this and you will live."
29. 那個人卻要顯示自己為義，就對耶穌說：「那麼，誰是我的鄰人呢？」 But wanting to justify himself, he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
30. 耶穌回答說： 「有一個人從 耶路撒冷 下到 耶利哥 去，途中 遇到強盜。他們剝去他的衣服，把他打得半死，丟下他走了。 Jesus took up [the question] and said: "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him, beat him up, and fled, leaving him half dead.
31. 恰好有一個祭司從那條路下來，看見他，就從另一邊走了過去。 A priest happened to be going down that road. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
32. 有一個 利未 人也正好來到那地方，看見他，也同樣地從另一邊走了過去。 In the same way, a Levite, when he arrived at the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
33. 可是，有一個 撒馬利亞 人行路來到他那裡，看見他，就動了憐憫之心， But a Samaritan on his journey came up to him, and when he saw [the man], he had compassion.
34. 上前來，在他的傷處倒上油和酒，包紮好，然後把他扶上自己的牲口，帶到旅店裡照顧他。 He went over to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
35. 第二天，他拿出兩個銀幣 交給店家，說『請你照顧他，一切額外的費用，我回來的時候將還給你。』 The next day he took out two denarii, gave them to the innkeeper, and said, 'Take care of him. When I come back I'll reimburse you for whatever extra you spend.'
36. 「你認為，這三個人中，哪一個是落在強盜手中那人的鄰人呢？」 "Which of these three do you think proved to be a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of the robbers?"
37. 律法師說：「是那個憐憫他的人。」 耶穌對他說： 「你去如此做吧。」 "The one who showed mercy to him," he said. Then Jesus told him, "Go and do the same."
38. 他們繼續前行，耶穌進了一個村子，有一個名叫 瑪妲 的女人接待他 。 While they were traveling, He entered a village, and a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.
39. 瑪妲 有個妹妹，稱為 瑪麗亞，坐在主 的腳前聽他的話語。 She had a sister named Mary, who also sat at the Lord's feet and was listening to what He said.
40. 瑪妲 為了很多伺候的事就心裡煩亂，上前來說：「主啊，我妹妹丟下我一個人伺候，你不管嗎？請叫她來幫我的忙吧。」 But Martha was distracted by her many tasks, and she came up and asked, "Lord, don't You care that my sister has left me to serve alone? So tell her to give me a hand."
41. 主 回答她，說： 「 瑪妲，，你為很多事憂慮、煩惱， The Lord answered her, "Martha, Martha, you are worried and upset about many things,
42. 但是有一件事是需要的，而 瑪麗亞 選擇了那美好的一份，是不能從她那裡被拿去的。」 but one thing is necessary. Mary has made the right choice, and it will not be taken away from her."
Luke 11
1. 有一次，耶穌在一個地方禱告。禱告完了，他的一個門徒對他說：「主啊，求你教我們禱告，就像 約翰 教導他的門徒們那樣。」 He was praying in a certain place, and when He finished, one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples."
2. 耶穌就對他們說： 「你們禱告的時候，要說： 『父 啊， 願你的名被尊為聖， 願你的國度來臨 。 He said to them, "Whenever you pray, say: Father, Your name be honored as holy. Your kingdom come.
3. 我們日用的食糧，願你天天賜給我們。 Give us each day our daily bread.
4. 願你饒恕我們的罪， 因為我們也饒恕所有虧欠我們的人。 不要讓我們陷入試探 。』」 And forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone in debt to us. And do not bring us into temptation."
5. 耶穌又對他們說： 「假如你們當中誰有一個朋友，就半夜到朋友那裡去，對他說：『朋友，請借給我三個餅， He also said to them: "Suppose one of you has a friend and goes to him at midnight and says to him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
6. 因為有一個朋友旅途中來到我這裡，我沒有什麼可以招待他。』 because a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I don't have anything to offer him.'
7. 那個人從裡面回答說：『請不要煩擾我。門已經關上了，我與孩子們也已經上了床，不能起來拿給你。』 Then he will answer from inside and say, 'Don't bother me! The door is already locked, and my children and I have gone to bed. I can't get up to give you anything.'
8. 我告訴你們：即使不因著是朋友而起來拿給他，還是會因著他毫無羞愧地求，就起來把他所要的拿給他。 I tell you, even though he won't get up and give him anything because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
9. 「我還告訴你們：不斷祈求吧，就會給你們；不斷尋找吧，就會找到；不斷敲門吧，就會為你們開門。 "So I say to you, keep asking, and it will be given to you. Keep searching, and you will find. Keep knocking, and the door will be opened to you.
10. 因為凡祈求的，就得到；尋找的，就找到；敲門的，就為他開門。 For everyone who asks receives, and the one who searches finds, and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.
11. 你們當中有哪個做父親的，兒子要魚，反而拿蛇當做 魚給他呢 ？ What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead of a fish?
12. 兒子要雞蛋，卻給他蠍子呢 ？ Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
13. 所以，如果你們做為惡人也知道把好的東西給自己的兒女，更何況天上的父要賜聖靈給求他的人呢！」 If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him?"
14. 有一次，耶穌正在驅趕一個使人成為啞巴的鬼魔。鬼魔一出去，啞巴就說出話來，眾人都感到驚奇。 Now He was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon came out, the man who had been mute, spoke, and the crowds were amazed.
15. 但其中有些人卻說：「他是靠鬼魔的王 別西卜 驅趕鬼魔的。」 But some of them said, "He drives out demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons!"
16. 另有些人試探耶穌，向他要求一個從天上來的神蹟。 And others, as a test, were demanding of Him a sign from heaven.
17. 耶穌知道他們的想法，就對他們說： 「任何一個國家，如果自相分裂就成為荒蕪；一個家庭，如果自相分裂也會敗落。 Knowing their thoughts, He told them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is headed for destruction, and a house divided against itself falls.
18. 同樣，如果 撒旦 自相紛爭，它的國怎麼能站立得住呢？儘管這樣，你們竟然說我是靠 別西卜 驅趕鬼魔的。 If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
19. 如果我是靠 別西卜 驅趕鬼魔，那麼，你們的子弟是靠誰驅趕鬼魔呢？為此，你們的子弟就將要成為你們的審判者了。 And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, who is it your sons drive them out by? For this reason they will be your judges.
20. 可是，如果我藉著神的能力 驅趕鬼魔，那麼，神的國就已經臨到你們了。 If I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come to you.
21. 當一個壯士全副武裝地看守自己家園的時候，他所擁有的就平安無事。 When a strong man, fully armed, guards his estate, his possessions are secure.
22. 可是比他更強的人一旦來到，並且勝過了他，就會奪走他所依靠的盔甲兵器，又把掠奪物分給別人。 But when one stronger than he attacks and overpowers him, he takes from him all his weapons he trusted in, and divides up his plunder.
23. 不與我在一起的，就是在反對我；不與我一起收集的，就是在拆散。 Anyone who is not with Me is against Me, and anyone who does not gather with Me scatters.
24. 「有個汙靈從一個人身上出來以後，走遍無水之地，尋找安歇的地方，卻找不到，就說：『我要回到我離開的那屋裡去。』 "When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it roams through waterless places looking for rest, and not finding rest, it then says, 'I'll go back to my house where I came from.'
25. 於是它回去，發現那裡已被打掃乾淨，擺設整齊， And returning, it finds [the house] swept and put in order.
26. 就去帶了另外七個比自己更邪惡的靈，進去住在那裡。那個人最後的情況就比先前更壞了。」 Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and settle down there. As a result, that man's last condition is worse than the first."
27. 耶穌正說這些話的時候，人群中有一個婦人高聲對他說：「那懷你胎又哺育你的是蒙福的！」 As He was saying these things, a woman from the crowd raised her voice and said to Him, "The womb that bore You and the one who nursed You are blessed!"
28. 耶穌說： 「那聽了神的話語 又遵守的人，才真是蒙福的！」 He said, "Even more, those who hear the word of God and keep it are blessed!"
29. 那時，人群越聚越多，耶穌就開始說： 「這世代是個邪惡的世代，它在尋求神蹟；可是除了 約拿 的神蹟以外，不會有神蹟賜給它了。 As the crowds were increasing, He began saying: "This generation is an evil generation. It demands a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.
30. 就是說， 約拿 怎樣成了對 尼尼微 人的一個神蹟，人子也將照樣成為對這世代的一個神蹟。 For just as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so also the Son of Man will be to this generation.
31. 在審判的時候，南方的女王 將要與這世代的人一起復活，並且要定他們的罪，因為她從極遠的地方來，要聽 所羅門 智慧的話語。看，比 更大的就在這裡！ The queen of the south will rise up at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and look-- something greater than Solomon is here!
32. 在審判的時候， 尼尼微 人將要與這世代一起復活，並且要定這世代的罪，因為 人因著 約拿 的傳道就悔改了。看，比 更大的就在這裡！ The men of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at Jonah's proclamation, and look-- something greater than Jonah is here!
33. 「沒有人點上油燈，放在隱藏的地方 或斗 底下，而是放在燈臺上，好讓進來的人能看見光。 "No one lights a lamp and puts it in the cellar or under a basket, but on a lampstand, so that those who come in may see its light.
34. 你的眼睛是身體的燈。當你的眼睛純淨 的時候，你的全身就光明；你的眼睛一旦汙濁，你的全身就黑暗。 Your eye is the lamp of the body. When your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light. But when it is bad, your body is also full of darkness.
35. 所以你要留心，免得你裡面的光成為黑暗。 Take care then, that the light in you is not darkness.
36. 因此，如果你全身光明，沒有任何黑暗的部分，你就全然光明，好像明燈照亮著你。」 If therefore your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, the whole body will be full of light, as when a lamp shines its light on you."
37. 耶穌說話的時候，有一個 法利賽 人請耶穌到他家裡吃飯，於是耶穌進去坐席。 As He was speaking, a Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. So He went in and reclined at the table.
38. 那個 法利賽 人看見耶穌午餐之前不行洗淨禮，感到驚奇。 When the Pharisee saw this, he was amazed that He did not first perform the ritual washing before dinner.
39. 主就對他說： 「如今你們 法利賽 人洗淨杯子、盤子的外面，但你們裡面卻充滿著貪心和惡意。 But the Lord said to him: "Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and evil.
40. 你們這些愚妄的人！那位造了外面的，不也造了裡面嗎？ Fools! Didn't He who made the outside make the inside too?
41. 不過你們當把裡面的施捨給人，看哪，對你們來說一切就都潔淨了。 But give to charity what is within, and then everything is clean for you.
42. 「你們 法利賽 人有禍了！因為你們奉獻薄荷、芸香和各種蔬菜的十分之一，卻廢棄了公義和屬神的愛。這些事是你們應該做的，至於前者也不可忽略。 "But woe to you Pharisees! You give a tenth of mint, rue, and every kind of herb, and you bypass justice and love for God. These things you should have done without neglecting the others.
43. 「你們 法利賽 人有禍了！因為你們喜愛會堂裡的首位，喜愛街市上的致敬問候。 "Woe to you Pharisees! You love the front seat in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.
44. 「你們有禍了 ！因為你們好像沒有標誌的墳墓，人走在上面也不知道。」 "Woe to you! You are like unmarked graves; the people who walk over them don't know it."
45. 有一個律法師對耶穌說：「老師，你說這些話，把我們也侮辱了。」 One of the experts in the law answered Him, "Teacher, when You say these things You insult us too."
46. 耶穌說： 「你們這些律法師也有禍了！因為你們使人背負難挑的重擔，但自己卻連一根指頭也不肯碰它們一下。 Then He said: "Woe also to you experts in the law! You load people with burdens that are hard to carry, yet you yourselves don't touch these burdens with one of your fingers.
47. 「你們有禍了！因為你們建造先知的墳墓，而你們的祖先是殺害他們的。 "Woe to you! You build monuments to the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
48. 因此對你們祖先的行為，你們是見證人，你們也贊同，因為他們殺害了先知們，你們就建造先知的墳墓 。 Therefore you are witnesses that you approve the deeds of your fathers, for they killed them, and you build their monuments.
49. 為此，神的智慧也曾說：『我將要差派先知和使徒到他們那裡去。有些他們要殺害，有些他們要逼迫。』 Because of this, the wisdom of God said, 'I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill and persecute,'
50. 這是為要向這世代追討那從創世以來所流的眾先知的血， so that this generation may be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets shed since the foundation of the world--
51. 就是從 亞伯 的血起，直到在祭壇和聖所 之間被殺的 撒迦利亞 的血為止。 「是的，我告訴你們：這世代將要為此被追討。 from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary. "Yes, I tell you, this generation will be held responsible.
52. 「你們這些律法師有禍了！因為你們拿去了知識的鑰匙，你們自己不進去，還阻止正要進去的人。」 "Woe to you experts in the law! You have taken away the key of knowledge! You didn't go in yourselves, and you hindered those who were going in."
53. 耶穌從那裡出來， 法利賽 人和經文士們就開始激烈地敵視他，還盤問他許多問題， When He left there, the scribes and the Pharisees began to oppose Him fiercely and to cross-examine Him about many things;
54. 暗中等機會，要從他的口中抓住把柄 。 they were lying in wait for Him to trap Him in something He said.
Luke 12
1. 那時有上萬的人群聚集，甚至彼此踐踏。耶穌一開始先對他的門徒們說： 「你們要提防 法利賽 人的酵母，就是偽善。 In these circumstances, a crowd of many thousands came together, so that they were trampling on one another. He began to say to His disciples first: "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
2. 被掩蓋的事沒有將不被顯露出來的，隱祕的事也沒有將不被知道的。 There is nothing covered that won't be uncovered, nothing hidden that won't be made known.
3. 所以你們在暗中所說的，會在明處被聽見；你們在內室裡耳語的，將要在屋頂上被宣揚出去。 Therefore whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have whispered in an ear in private rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
4. 「我的朋友，我告訴你們：不要怕那些殺了身體以後不能再做什麼的人。 "And I say to you, My friends, don't fear those who kill the body, and after that can do nothing more.
5. 我要指示你們該懼怕的是誰：你們當懼怕那殺了身體以後，又有權把人扔進地獄的那一位。是的，我告訴你們：當懼怕這一位。 But I will show you the One to fear: Fear Him who has authority to throw [people] into hell after death. Yes, I say to you, this is the One to fear!
6. 五隻麻雀不是賣兩個小錢 嗎？可是在神面前，一隻也不會被忘記； Aren't five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten in God's sight.
7. 而且，就是你們的每一根頭髮也都被數過了。不要怕！你們比一大群麻雀還重要。 Indeed, the hairs of your head are all counted. Don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows!
8. 「我告訴你們：無論誰在人面前承認我，人子在神的天使們面前也將承認他； "And I say to you, anyone who acknowledges Me before men, the Son of Man will also acknowledge him before the angels of God,
9. 而那在人面前不認我的，在神的天使們面前也將被否認。 but whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
10. 所有說話抵擋人子的，還能被赦免；但那褻瀆聖靈的，不能被赦免。 Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
11. 當他們把你們帶到會堂，或帶到統治者和掌權者面前的時候，不要憂慮怎樣申辯或說什麼。 Whenever they bring you before synagogues and rulers and authorities, don't worry about how you should defend yourselves or what you should say.
12. 因為就在那時候，聖靈會教導你們該說的話。」 For the Holy Spirit will teach you at that very hour what must be said."
13. 人群中有一個人對耶穌說：「老師，請吩咐我的哥哥 與我分繼業吧！」 Someone from the crowd said to Him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
14. 耶穌對他說： 「朋友，誰委任了我做你們的審判官或仲裁者呢？」 "Friend," He said to him, "who appointed Me a judge or arbitrator over you?"
15. 接著耶穌對他們說： 「你們要注意，要提防一切貪心，因為一個人的生命不在於他財產的豐厚。」 He then told them, "Watch out and be on guard against all greed because one's life is not in the abundance of his possessions."
16. 然後對他們講了一個比喻，說： 「有一個富有的人，田地豐收了。 Then He told them a parable: "A rich man's land was very productive.
17. 他就心裡盤算：『我沒有地方儲存我的產物了，做什麼呢？』 He thought to himself, 'What should I do, since I don't have anywhere to store my crops?
18. 他就說：『我要這麼做：拆掉我的這些倉庫，另建更大的，把我所有的麥子 和美物收集在那裡。 I will do this,' he said. 'I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and store all my grain and my goods there.
19. 然後，我要對我的靈魂說：靈魂哪，你擁有了很多好東西，足以享用多年，你就休息、吃喝、慶祝吧。』 Then I'll say to myself, "You have many goods stored up for many years. Take it easy; eat, drink, and enjoy yourself."'
20. 「可是神對他說：『你這愚妄的人哪！今夜，他們就要召回你的靈魂了。那麼，你所預備的要歸誰呢？』 "But God said to him, 'You fool! This very night your life is demanded of you. And the things you have prepared-- whose will they be?'
21. 「那為自己積蓄財富而在神面前不富足的人，也是這樣。」 "That's how it is with the one who stores up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God."
22. 耶穌又對他的門徒們說： 「所以我告訴你們：不要為你們的 生命而憂慮吃什麼，也不要為身體而憂慮穿什麼。 Then He said to His disciples: "Therefore I tell you, don't worry about your life, what you will eat; or about the body, what you will wear.
23. 因為生命比食物更重要，身體比衣服更重要。 For life is more than food and the body more than clothing.
24. 應該想一想烏鴉：牠們不撒種，也不收割，沒有倉也沒有庫，神尚且養活牠們；更何況你們，你們比飛鳥還重要呢！ Consider the ravens: they don't sow or reap; they don't have a storeroom or a barn; yet God feeds them. Aren't you worth much more than the birds?
25. 你們當中誰能因著憂慮使自己的壽命延長一刻 呢？ Can any of you add a cubit to his height by worrying?
26. 因此，你們如果連最小的事也不能做，為什麼還要為其他的事憂慮呢？ If then you're not able to do even a little thing, why worry about the rest?
27. 「應該想一想百合花是怎麼生長的：它不勞動，也不紡織。但是我告訴你們：就連 所羅門 在他最榮耀的時候，所穿戴的也不如這些花中的一朵。 "Consider how the wildflowers grow: they don't labor or spin thread. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was adorned like one of these!
28. 你們這些小信的人哪！野地裡的草今天還在，明天就被丟進火爐裡，神尚且這樣裝扮它，更何況你們呢！ If that's how God clothes the grass, which is in the field today and is thrown into the furnace tomorrow, how much more will He do for you-- you of little faith?
29. 你們不要追求吃什麼、喝什麼，也不要掛慮。 Don't keep striving for what you should eat and what you should drink, and don't be anxious.
30. 因為這一切都是世界外邦人所尋求的，而你們的父已經知道你們需要這些了。 For the Gentile world eagerly seeks all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
31. 「不過你們應當尋求神的 國，這些都 將加給你們了。 "But seek His kingdom, and these things will be provided for you.
32. 你們這一小群哪，不要怕，因為你們的父樂意把國度 賜給你們。 Don't be afraid, little flock, because your Father delights to give you the kingdom.
33. 你們當賣掉自己所擁有的，施捨給人，為自己預備不會破舊的錢包和沒有窮盡的財寶在天上；在那裡盜賊不能靠近，也沒有蟲咬蝕。 Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Make money-bags for yourselves that won't grow old, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.
34. 要知道，你們的財寶在哪裡，你們的心也在哪裡。 For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
35. 「你們要束上腰帶，點亮油燈， "Be ready for service and have your lamps lit.
36. 要像期待著主人從婚宴上回來的人那樣；好在主人回來敲門的時候，能立刻為他開門。 You must be like people waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet so that when he comes and knocks, they can open [the door] for him at once.
37. 主人回來的時候，看見哪些奴僕警醒著，那些奴僕就蒙福了。我確實地告訴你們：主人會束上腰帶，請他們坐席，並來伺候他們。 Those slaves the master will find alert when he comes will be blessed. I assure you: He will get ready, have them recline at the table, then come and serve them.
38. 即使主人在二更天或在三更天才回來，也看見他們仍然警醒著，那些人 就蒙福了。 If he comes in the middle of the night, or even near dawn, and finds them alert, those slaves are blessed.
39. 不過你們應當知道這一點：一家的主人如果知道賊什麼時候來，就 不會讓他的房子被人鑽進。 But know this: if the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
40. 你們也應當做好準備，因為在你們意想不到的時候，人子就來了。」 You also be ready, because the Son of Man is coming at an hour that you do not expect."
41. 彼得 說：「主啊，你這個比喻是對我們說的，還是也對大家說的呢？」 "Lord," Peter asked, "are You telling this parable to us or to everyone?"
42. 主說： 「究竟誰是那又忠心又聰明的管家——受主人委任統管他家人、按時分發糧食的人呢？ The Lord said: "Who then is the faithful and sensible manager his master will put in charge of his household servants to give them their allotted food at the proper time?
43. 主人回來的時候，看見哪個奴僕如此行，那個奴僕就蒙福了。 That slave whose master finds him working when he comes will be rewarded.
44. 我確實地告訴你們：主人會委任他統管自己所擁有的一切。 I tell you the truth: he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
45. 但如果這奴僕心裡說『我的主人會遲延回來』，就動手毆打其他的男僕和女僕，並且吃喝、醉酒， But if that slave says in his heart, 'My master is delaying his coming,' and starts to beat the male and female slaves, and to eat and drink and get drunk,
46. 那麼，這奴僕的主人就要在意想不到的日子、在他不知道的時刻回來，並且會嚴厲懲罰他，使他與那些不信的人有同樣的下場。 that slave's master will come on a day he does not expect him and at an hour he does not know. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
47. 那知道主人的意思，卻沒有預備，也不照著主人的意思去做的奴僕，將會受很多鞭打； And that slave who knew his master's will and didn't prepare himself or do it will be severely beaten.
48. 但那因為不知道而做了該打之事的人，將會受很少鞭打。所以誰被賜予的多，將來向誰索取的也多；託給誰多，將來向誰要求的也更多。 But the one who did not know and did things deserving of blows will be beaten lightly. Much will be required of everyone who has been given much. And even more will be expected of the one who has been entrusted with more.
49. 「我來是要把火投在地上，我多麼希望這火已經點燃了！ "I came to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already set ablaze!
50. 不過我有該受的洗禮，在完成之前，我是多麼困苦！ But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how it consumes Me until it is finished!
51. 你們以為我來了，是給地上帶來和平嗎？不是的！我告訴你們：其實還是分裂 。 Do you think that I came here to give peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but rather division!
52. 從今以後，一家五口將要分裂：三個與兩個，兩個與三個分裂。 From now on, five in one household will be divided: three against two, and two against three.
53. 他們將要分裂：父親反對兒子， 兒子反對父親而分裂； 母親反對女兒， 女兒反對母親而分裂； 婆婆反對媳婦， 媳婦反對婆婆而分裂。 」 They will be divided, father against son, son against father, mother against daughter, daughter against mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."
54. 然後，耶穌又對眾人說： 「你們一旦看見雲彩在西邊升起，就立刻說：『要下大雨了』，果然就如此。 He also said to the crowds: "When you see a cloud rising in the west, right away you say, 'A storm is coming,' and so it does.
55. 南風一吹起，你們就說：『要熱起來了』，果然就如此。 And when the south wind is blowing, you say, 'It's going to be a scorcher!' and it is.
56. 你們這些偽善的人！你們懂得分辨天地的氣象，怎麼不懂得 分辨這個時代呢？ Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but why don't you know how to interpret this time?
57. 「你們為什麼自己不判斷公義的事呢？ "Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right?
58. 你和你的對頭去見官的時候，在路上就當盡力與他和解，免得他把你拉到審判官面前，審判官把你交給獄卒，獄卒就把你投進監獄。 As you are going with your adversary to the ruler, make an effort to settle with him on the way. Then he won't drag you before the judge, the judge hand you over to the bailiff, and the bailiff throw you into prison.
59. 我告訴你：除非你還清了最後的一個小錢，否則你絕不能從那裡出來。」 I tell you, you will never get out of there until you have paid the last cent."
Luke 13
1. 正在那時候，有些人前來告訴耶穌有關 加利利 人的事，就是 彼拉多 把 加利利 人的血與他們的祭物混在一起的事。 At that time, some people came and reported to Him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
2. 耶穌 回答他們，說： 「你們以為這些 加利利 人如此受害，是因為他們比其他 所有 人更有罪嗎？ And He responded to them, "Do you think that these Galileans were more sinful than all Galileans because they suffered these things?
3. 不是的。我告訴你們：你們如果不悔改，都會同樣地滅亡。 No, I tell you; but unless you repent, you will all perish as well!
4. 或者， 西羅亞 樓倒塌壓死的那十八個人，你們以為他們比所有住在 耶路撒冷 的人更有罪嗎？ Or those 18 that the tower in Siloam fell on and killed-- do you think they were more sinful than all the people who live in Jerusalem?
5. 不是的。我告訴你們：你們如果不悔改，都會同樣滅亡。」 No, I tell you; but unless you repent, you will all perish as well!"
6. 於是耶穌講了這個比喻： 「一個人有一棵無花果樹栽在自己的葡萄園裡。當他過來，在那樹上找果子時，卻找不到， And He told this parable: "A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He came looking for fruit on it and found none.
7. 就對園丁說：『你看，一連三年，我在這無花果樹上找果子，都找不到。把它砍了吧！何必讓它白占土地？』 He told the vineyard worker, 'Listen, for three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree and haven't found any. Cut it down! Why should it even waste the soil?'
8. 「但是園丁回答，對他說：『主人，今年再留著它吧。等我在它周圍挖掘，施些糞肥， "But he replied to him, 'Sir, leave it this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
9. 或許它來年真會結出果子，否則，你就砍了它。』」 Perhaps it will bear fruit next year, but if not, you can cut it down.'"
10. 在安息日，耶穌在一個會堂裡教導人， As He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath,
11. 看哪，有一個婦人，被邪靈附身病了十八年，一直彎著腰，完全直不起身來。 a woman was there who had been disabled by a spirit for over 18 years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.
12. 耶穌看見她，就招呼她，對她說： 「婦人，你已經從你的疾病中被釋放了！」 When Jesus saw her, He called out to her, "Woman, you are free of your disability."
13. 然後耶穌按手在她身上，她的腰立刻直了，她就不住地榮耀神。 Then He laid His hands on her, and instantly she was restored and began to glorify God.
14. 因為耶穌在安息日使人痊癒，會堂主管就很生氣，對那群人說：「應該做工的日子有六天，所以你們在那些日子來得痊癒吧！但不要在安息日這一天。」 But the leader of the synagogue, indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, responded by telling the crowd, "There are six days when work should be done; therefore come on those days and be healed and not on the Sabbath day."
15. 主回答他，說： 「你們這些偽善的人！難道你們每個人在安息日，不也是把自己的牛或驢從槽邊解開，牽去飲水嗎？ But the Lord answered him and said, "Hypocrites! Doesn't each one of you untie his ox or donkey from the feeding trough on the Sabbath, and lead it to water?
16. 何況這婦人，做為 亞伯拉罕 的子孫，被 撒旦 所捆綁竟然有十八年，難道不應該在安息日這一天從捆鎖中被釋放嗎？」 Satan has bound this woman, a daughter of Abraham, for 18 years-- shouldn't she be untied from this bondage on the Sabbath day?"
17. 耶穌說了這些話，所有反對他的人都感到蒙羞，可是眾人都因他所行的一切榮耀的事而感到歡喜。 When He had said these things, all His adversaries were humiliated, but the whole crowd was rejoicing over all the glorious things He was doing.
18. 於是耶穌說： 「神的國好比什麼呢？我要把它比做什麼呢？ He said therefore, "What is the kingdom of God like, and what can I compare it to?
19. 它好比一粒芥菜種子，有人拿去種在自己的園子裡，種子長大，成了一棵樹，天空的飛鳥也在它的枝子上搭窩。」 It's like a mustard seed that a man took and sowed in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the sky nested in its branches."
20. 耶穌又說： 「我要把神的國比做什麼呢？ Again He said, "What can I compare the kingdom of God to?
21. 它好比酵母，一個婦人拿去拌在 三斗 麵裡，直到整團麵都發了酵。」 It's like yeast that a woman took and mixed into 50 pounds of flour until it spread through the entire mixture."
22. 耶穌走遍許多城鎮、鄉村教導人，並繼續往 耶路撒冷 前行。 He went through one town and village after another, teaching and making His way to Jerusalem.
23. 有一個人問他：「主啊，得救的人很少嗎？」 耶穌對他們說： "Lord," someone asked Him, "are there few being saved?" He said to them,
24. 「你們要為進窄門而爭戰，因為我告訴你們：將有許多人想要進去，卻是不能。 "Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because I tell you, many will try to enter and won't be able
25. 等到那家的主人起來關了門，你們才開始站在外面敲門，說：『主啊，請給我們開門！』主人就會回答你們，說：『我不知道你們是從哪裡來的。』 once the homeowner gets up and shuts the door. Then you will stand outside and knock on the door, saying, 'Lord, open up for us!' He will answer you, 'I don't know you or where you're from.'
26. 那時你們就開始說：『我們曾經在你面前吃過、喝過，你也曾經在我們的大街 上教導過！』 Then you will say, 'We ate and drank in Your presence, and You taught in our streets!'
27. 他要對你們說：『我不知道你們是從哪裡來的。離開我，你們所有不義的工人！』 But He will say, 'I tell you, I don't know you or where you're from. Get away from Me, all you workers of unrighteousness!'
28. 當你們看見 亞伯拉罕 、 以撒 雅各 和所有的先知在神的國裡，而你們卻被丟在外面的時候，在那裡將有哀哭和切齒。 There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth in that place, when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God but yourselves thrown out.
29. 人們將從東、西、南、北而來，在神的國裡坐席。 They will come from east and west, from north and south, and recline at the table in the kingdom of God.
30. 看哪，有些在後的，將要在前；有些在前的，將要在後。」 Note this: some are last who will be first, and some are first who will be last."
31. 就在這時候，有一些 法利賽 人前來對耶穌說：「你離開吧，從這裡走開！因為 希律 想要殺你。」 At that time some Pharisees came and told Him, "Go, get out of here! Herod wants to kill You!"
32. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們去告訴那狐狸：看哪！今天明天我驅趕鬼魔、治癒疾病，然後在第三天，我的事就得以完成了。 He said to them, "Go tell that fox, 'Look! I'm driving out demons and performing healings today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will complete My work.'
33. 不過今天、明天、後天，我必須往前走，因為先知不能在 耶路撒冷 之外被殺！ Yet I must travel today, tomorrow, and the next day, because it is not possible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem!
34. 「 耶路撒冷 啊， ！這城殺害先知們，又用石頭砸死被差到她這裡的人！我多次想聚集你的兒女，像母雞把自己的小雞聚集在翅膀下，可是你們不願意！ "Jerusalem, Jerusalem! The city who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her. How often I wanted to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing!
35. 看哪，你們的家 要被廢棄 。我 告訴你們：你們絕不會再見到我了，直到那日子來臨，就是你們說 『奉主名而來的那一位是蒙祝福的』 那時候。」 See, your house is abandoned to you. And I tell you, you will not see Me until the time comes when you say, Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!"
Luke 14
1. 有一個安息日，耶穌到一個 法利賽 人的首領家裡去吃飯，他們密切注意著耶穌。 One Sabbath, when He went to eat at the house of one of the leading Pharisees, they were watching Him closely.
2. 當時，有一個患水腫病的人在他面前。 There in front of Him was a man whose body was swollen with fluid.
3. 於是耶穌問律法師們和 法利賽 人，說： 「在安息日使人痊癒，可以不可以？」 In response, Jesus asked the law experts and the Pharisees, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?"
4. 他們都安靜下來。耶穌就扶著那人，使他痊癒，讓他走了。 But they kept silent. He took the man, healed him, and sent him away.
5. 然後耶穌對他們說： 「你們當中誰有兒子 或牛在安息日這一天掉到井裡，而不立刻把他拉上來呢？」 And to them, He said, "Which of you whose son or ox falls into a well, will not immediately pull him out on the Sabbath day?"
6. 他們對這些話不能答辯。 To this they could find no answer.
7. 耶穌留意到被邀請的人怎樣在那裡挑選上座，就對他們講了一個比喻說： He told a parable to those who were invited, when He noticed how they would choose the best places for themselves:
8. 「你被人邀請赴婚宴的時候，不要坐在上座，恐怕有比你更尊貴的人也被邀請， "When you are invited by someone to a wedding banquet, don't recline at the best place, because a more distinguished person than you may have been invited by your host.
9. 那邀請你們 的會來對你說：『請讓座給這一位！』那時候，你就要羞慚地去坐末位了。 The one who invited both of you may come and say to you, 'Give your place to this man,' and then in humiliation, you will proceed to take the lowest place.
10. 「你被邀請的時候，要去坐在末位上，好讓邀請你的人一旦來，就會對你說：『朋友，請來上座。』那時候，你就在所有一同坐席的人面前有光彩了。 "But when you are invited, go and recline in the lowest place, so that when the one who invited you comes, he will say to you, 'Friend, move up higher.' You will then be honored in the presence of all the other guests.
11. 因為每一個自我高舉的都會被降卑；而自我降卑的都會被高舉。」 For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted."
12. 耶穌又對邀請他的人說： 「你預備午餐或晚餐的時候，不要叫你的朋友、兄弟、親戚或富有的鄰居，免得他們也回請你，你就得了你的回報了。 He also said to the one who had invited Him, "When you give a lunch or a dinner, don't invite your friends, your brothers, your relatives, or your rich neighbors, because they might invite you back, and you would be repaid.
13. 相反，你預備宴席的時候，要邀請那些貧窮的、殘疾的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的， On the contrary, when you host a banquet, invite those who are poor, maimed, lame, or blind.
14. 這樣你就蒙福了，因為他們沒有可回報你的，而在義人復活的時候，你將得到回報。」 And you will be blessed, because they cannot repay you; for you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous."
15. 一同坐席的有一個人聽了這些話，就說：「將來能在神的國裡吃飯 的人是蒙福的！」 When one of those who reclined at the table with Him heard these things, he said to Him, "The one who will eat bread in the kingdom of God is blessed!"
16. 耶穌對他說： 「有一個人預備盛大的宴席，邀請了許多人。 Then He told him: "A man was giving a large banquet and invited many.
17. 到了宴席的時刻，他派奴僕去對那些被邀請的人說：『請來吧，一切都已經預備好了！』 At the time of the banquet, he sent his slave to tell those who were invited, 'Come, because everything is now ready.'
18. 「可是他們都開始一致地推辭。第一個說：『我買了一塊地，必須去看看，請你容我推辭吧。』 "But without exception they all began to make excuses. The first one said to him, 'I have bought a field, and I must go out and see it. I ask you to excuse me.'
19. 「另一個說：『我買了五對牛，正要去試試牠們，請你容我推辭吧。』 "Another said, 'I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I'm going to try them out. I ask you to excuse me.'
20. 「另有人說：『我剛娶了妻子，所以不能去。』 "And another said, 'I just got married, and therefore I'm unable to come.'
21. 「奴僕回來把這些事報告給主人。那家的主人就發怒，吩咐奴僕說：『趕快出去，到城裡的大街 小巷，把那些貧窮的、殘疾的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的，都帶到這裡來。』 "So the slave came back and reported these things to his master. Then in anger, the master of the house told his slave, 'Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in here the poor, maimed, blind, and lame!'
22. 「奴僕說：『主人，你所吩咐的已經做了，可是還有位子。』 " 'Master,' the slave said, 'what you ordered has been done, and there's still room.'
23. 「主人就對奴僕說：『出去，到大街和小巷 上去，強求人進來，好坐滿我的房子。 "Then the master told the slave, 'Go out into the highways and lanes and make them come in, so that my house may be filled.
24. 我告訴你們：原本被邀請的那些人，沒有一個能嘗到我的宴席。』」 For I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will enjoy my banquet!'"
25. 有一大群人與耶穌同行。他轉過身來對他們說： Now great crowds were traveling with Him. So He turned and said to them:
26. 「如果有人到我這裡來，而不恨自己的父親、母親、妻子、兒女、兄弟、姐妹，甚至自己的生命，他就不能做我的門徒。 "If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his own father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters-- yes, and even his own life-- he cannot be My disciple.
27. 凡是不背著自己的十字架來跟從我的，也不能做我的門徒。 Whoever does not bear his own cross and come after Me cannot be My disciple.
28. 「你們當中到底有誰想蓋一座樓，不先坐下來計算費用，看自己是否能夠完成呢？ "For which of you, wanting to build a tower, doesn't first sit down and calculate the cost to see if he has enough to complete it?
29. 免得立好了地基，卻不能完工，看見的人都開始嘲笑他， Otherwise, after he has laid the foundation and cannot finish it, all the onlookers will begin to make fun of him,
30. 說：『這個人開始蓋了，卻不能完工！』 saying, 'This man started to build and wasn't able to finish.'
31. 「或者，有哪一個君王要出去和別的君王交戰，不先坐下來考慮是否能夠用一萬兵去迎戰那用兩萬兵來攻打他的呢？ "Or what king, going to war against another king, will not first sit down and decide if he is able with 10,000 to oppose the one who comes against him with 20,000?
32. 否則，就會趁著他還遠的時候，差派特使去求問和平的事宜。 If not, while the other is still far off, he sends a delegation and asks for terms of peace.
33. 同樣，你們當中任何人，如果不向自己所擁有的一切告別，就不能做我的門徒。 In the same way, therefore, every one of you who does not say good-bye to all his possessions cannot be My disciple.
34. 「因此鹽是好的，但如果連鹽也失去了味道，還能用什麼來調味呢？ "Now, salt is good, but if salt should lose its taste, how will it be made salty?
35. 把它用在田地裡或在糞肥裡都不合適，只好把它丟在外面。凡是有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」 It isn't fit for the soil or for the manure pile; they throw it out. Anyone who has ears to hear should listen!"
Luke 15
1. 當時，稅吏和罪人都接近耶穌，聽他講說。 All the tax collectors and sinners were approaching to listen to Him.
2. 法利賽 人和經文士抱怨，說：「這個人歡迎罪人，又與他們一起吃飯。」 And the Pharisees and scribes were complaining, "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them!"
3. 於是耶穌對他們講了這個比喻： So He told them this parable:
4. 「你們當中的哪一個人擁有一百隻羊，而丟失其中的一隻，就不會把九十九隻留在曠野，去找那一隻丟失的，直到找到了牠呢？ "What man among you, who has 100 sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the 99 in the open field and go after the lost one until he finds it?
5. 一旦找到了，他就快快樂樂地扛在自己的肩上， When he has found it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,
6. 回到家裡請朋友和鄰居來，對他們說：『你們與我一同歡樂吧，因為我找到了那隻丟失的羊。』 and coming home, he calls his friends and neighbors together, saying to them, 'Rejoice with me, because I have found my lost sheep!'
7. 我告訴你們：同樣，一個罪人的悔改，比九十九個不需要悔改的義人，會讓天上更有喜樂。 I tell you, in the same way, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over 99 righteous people who don't need repentance.
8. 「或者，如果一個婦人有十個銀幣，丟失了一個，難道她不點上油燈，打掃屋子，仔細尋找，直到找到了它嗎？ "Or what woman who has 10 silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds it?
9. 一旦找到了，她就會請朋友和鄰居來，說：『你們與我一同歡樂吧，因為我找到了那個丟失的銀幣 。』 When she finds it, she calls her women friends and neighbors together, saying, 'Rejoice with me, because I have found the silver coin I lost!'
10. 同樣，我告訴你們：一個罪人的悔改，會讓神的天使們面前有喜樂。」 I tell you, in the same way, there is joy in the presence of God's angels over one sinner who repents."
11. 耶穌又說： 「某人有兩個兒子。 He also said: "A man had two sons.
12. 小兒子對父親說：『父親，請把我應得的那份家產給我。』父親就把財產分給兩個兒子。 The younger of them said to his father, 'Father, give me the share of the estate I have coming to me.' So he distributed the assets to them.
13. 沒過幾天，那小兒子就收拾了一切，往一個遙遠的地方去旅行了。他在那裡過著放蕩的生活，揮霍他的錢財。 Not many days later, the younger son gathered together all he had and traveled to a distant country, where he squandered his estate in foolish living.
14. 當他花盡了自己的一切，那地方又發生了嚴重的饑荒，他就開始窮困起來。 After he had spent everything, a severe famine struck that country, and he had nothing.
15. 於是他去投靠當地的一個居民，那人打發他到自己的田裡去放豬。 Then he went to work for one of the citizens of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
16. 他就是渴望拿豬吃的豆莢來充飢，也沒有人給他。 He longed to eat his fill from the carob pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him any.
17. 可是他醒悟過來的時候，就說：『我父親那麼多的雇工都食物充足，我卻要在這裡餓死 嗎？ When he came to his senses, he said, 'How many of my father's hired hands have more than enough food, and here I am dying of hunger!
18. 我要起來，到我父親那裡去，對他說：『父親，我對天犯了罪，也在你面前犯了罪。 I'll get up, go to my father, and say to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.
19. 我再也不配稱為你的兒子，請把我當做你的一個雇工吧。』 I'm no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired hands.'
20. 於是他起來往自己的父親那裡去。他離得還遠的時候，他父親就看到他，動了憐憫之心，跑上去摟住他的脖子親吻他。 So he got up and went to his father. But while the son was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him.
21. 兒子說：『父親，我對天犯了罪，也在你面前犯了罪。我再也不配稱為你的兒子。』 The son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I'm no longer worthy to be called your son.'
22. 「父親卻對奴僕們說：『趕快 把那最好的袍子拿來給他穿上，把戒指戴在他手上，把鞋子穿在他腳上， "But the father told his slaves, 'Quick! Bring out the best robe and put it on him; put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
23. 把那隻養肥的牛犢牽來宰殺了，讓我們吃喝、慶祝吧！ Then bring the fattened calf and slaughter it, and let's celebrate with a feast,
24. 因為我這個兒子是死而復生、失而復得的。』於是他們開始慶祝。 because this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found!' So they began to celebrate.
25. 「那時，大兒子正在田裡。當他往回走，快到家的時候，聽見音樂和跳舞的聲音， "Now his older son was in the field; as he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.
26. 就叫來一個僕人，問這些到底是什麼事。 So he summoned one of the servants and asked what these things meant.
27. 僕人對他說：『你弟弟 回來了。你父親因他平安無恙地回來，就宰殺了那隻養肥的牛犢。』 'Your brother is here,' he told him, 'and your father has slaughtered the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.'
28. 「大兒子發怒，不肯進去，他父親就出來勸 他。 "Then he became angry and didn't want to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
29. 他回答父親，說：『你看，我服事你這麼多年，從來沒有違背過你的命令，可是你從來沒有給過我一隻小山羊，好讓我與朋友們一同慶祝。 But he replied to his father, 'Look, I have been slaving many years for you, and I have never disobeyed your orders, yet you never gave me a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.
30. 而你這個兒子，這個與妓女們一起吞盡了你財產的，他一來了，你就為他宰殺了養肥的牛犢！』 But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your assets with prostitutes, you slaughtered the fattened calf for him.'
31. 「父親對他說：『孩子啊，你一直與我在一起，我的一切都是你的。 " 'Son,' he said to him, 'you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.
32. 現在，我們應該慶祝、歡喜，因為你這個弟弟是死而復生、失而復得的。』」 But we had to celebrate and rejoice, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.'"
Luke 16
1. 耶穌又對門徒們說： 「某財主有個管家，這個管家被人控告揮霍主人的財產。 He also said to the disciples: "There was a rich man who received an accusation that his manager was squandering his possessions.
2. 財主就把管家叫來，對他說：『我聽到有關你的事，到底是什麼？把你所管理的做出交代，因為你不能再當管家了。』 So he called the manager in and asked, 'What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your management, because you can no longer be [my] manager.'
3. 「那管家心裡說：『主人要把我管家的任務拿去了，我能做什麼呢？挖地沒有力氣，乞討又感到羞恥。 "Then the manager said to himself, 'What should I do, since my master is taking the management away from me? I'm not strong enough to dig; I'm ashamed to beg.
4. 我知道我該做什麼了，好使我被免除管家的任務以後，人們會接我到他們家裡去。』 I know what I'll do so that when I'm removed from management, people will welcome me into their homes.'
5. 「於是他把自己主人的每一個欠債人都叫了來。他問第一個：『你欠我主人多少？』 "So he summoned each one of his master's debtors. 'How much do you owe my master?' he asked the first one.
6. 「他說：『一百桶 油。』 「管家就對他說：『拿你的欠條，趕快坐下來寫成五十。』 " 'A hundred measures of oil,' he said. " 'Take your invoice,' he told him, 'sit down quickly, and write 50.'
7. 「他問另一個說：『你呢，你欠多少？』 「他說：『一百擔 麥子。』 「管家說：『拿你的欠條，寫成八十。』 "Next he asked another, 'How much do you owe?' " 'A hundred measures of wheat,' he said. " 'Take your invoice,' he told him, 'and write 80.'
8. 「於是主人因這個不義的管家做事精明，就稱讚他。這樣看來，今世的兒女在自己的世代裡，比光明的兒女還要聰明。 "The master praised the unrighteous manager because he had acted astutely. For the sons of this age are more astute than the sons of light [in dealing] with their own people.
9. 我告訴你們：要藉著那不義的財富 為自己結交朋友，這樣當財富 無用的時候，你們會被接到永恆的居所 裡。 And I tell you, make friends for yourselves by means of the unrighteous money so that when it fails, they may welcome you into eternal dwellings.
10. 在最小的事上忠心的人，在很多事上也忠心；在最小的事上不義的人，在很多事上也不義。 Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much, and whoever is unrighteous in very little is also unrighteous in much.
11. 因此，你們如果在不義的財富 上不忠心，誰會把真正的財富 委託給你們呢？ So if you have not been faithful with the unrighteous money, who will trust you with what is genuine?
12. 你們如果在別人的東西上不忠心，誰會把屬於你們的交給你們呢？ And if you have not been faithful with what belongs to someone else, who will give you what is your own?
13. 一個僕人不能服事兩個主人。他不是厭惡這個、喜愛那個，就是忠於這個、輕視那個。你們不能既服事神，又服事財富 。」 No household slave can be the slave of two masters, since either he will hate one and love the other, or he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can't be slaves to both God and money."
14. 愛錢財的 法利賽 人聽到這些一切話，就譏笑耶穌。 The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, were listening to all these things and scoffing at Him.
15. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們就是那些在人面前顯示自己為義的，但是神知道你們的心。人看為高貴的，在神面前卻是可憎惡的。 And He told them: "You are the ones who justify yourselves in the sight of others, but God knows your hearts. For what is highly admired by people is revolting in God's sight.
16. 「律法和先知 到 約翰 為止，從此神國的福音被傳揚，人人都在努力爭取進入它。 "The Law and the Prophets were until John; since then, the good news of the kingdom of God has been proclaimed, and everyone is strongly urged to enter it.
17. 天地的消逝，也比律法的一筆一畫 落空更容易呢！ But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one stroke of a letter in the law to drop out.
18. 「凡是休妻另娶的，就是犯通姦罪；凡是娶了被丈夫休的女人的，也是犯通姦罪。 "Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and everyone who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.
19. 「有一個財主，身穿紫色袍子和細麻衣，天天奢華宴樂。 "There was a rich man who would dress in purple and fine linen, feasting lavishly every day.
20. 又有一個窮人，名叫 拉撒路，滿身膿瘡，被放在財主的門口， But a poor man named Lazarus, covered with sores, was left at his gate.
21. 渴望得到財主桌子上掉下來的碎渣 充飢，甚至有狗來舔他的瘡。 He longed to be filled with what fell from the rich man's table, but instead the dogs would come and lick his sores.
22. 後來那窮人死了，被天使們帶到 亞伯拉罕 的懷裡。接著，那財主也死了，並且被埋葬了。 One day the poor man died and was carried away by the angels to Abraham's side. The rich man also died and was buried.
23. 財主在陰間的痛苦中，舉目遠遠地望見 亞伯拉罕，又望見 拉撒路 在他懷裡， And being in torment in Hades, he looked up and saw Abraham a long way off, with Lazarus at his side.
24. 就呼喚說：『我父 亞伯拉罕，可憐我吧！請打發 拉撒路 用指頭蘸點水，涼一下我的舌頭吧，因為我在這火焰裡，極其痛苦！』 'Father Abraham!' he called out, 'Have mercy on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this flame!'
25. 「可是 亞伯拉罕 說：『孩子啊，你當想起，你一生怎樣享了你的福，而 拉撒路 怎樣受了苦；但如今他在這裡受到安慰，你卻在痛苦中。 " 'Son,' Abraham said, 'remember that during your life you received your good things, just as Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here, while you are in agony.
26. 這一切之外，在我們和你們之間，隔著巨大的深淵，所以人想要從這邊過到你們那邊是不可能的，從那邊過到我們這邊也是不可能的。』 Besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that those who want to pass over from here to you cannot; neither can those from there cross over to us.'
27. 「財主就說：『我父啊，那麼求你打發 拉撒路 到我父親家去， " 'Father,' he said, 'then I beg you to send him to my father's house--
28. 因為我有五個兄弟，讓他去鄭重地勸誡他們，免得他們也來到這痛苦的地方。』 because I have five brothers-- to warn them, so they won't also come to this place of torment.'
29. 「但是 亞伯拉罕 說：『你的兄弟們有 摩西 和先知們，讓你的兄弟們聽從他們吧。』 "But Abraham said, 'They have Moses and the prophets; they should listen to them.'
30. 「財主卻說：『不，我父 亞伯拉罕 哪！其實如果有人從死人中復活，到他們那裡去，他們就會悔改。』 " 'No, father Abraham,' he said. 'But if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.'
31. 「可是 亞伯拉罕 對他說：『如果他們不聽從 摩西 和先知們，就算有人從死人中復活，他們也不會被說服的。』 "But he told him, 'If they don't listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be persuaded if someone rises from the dead.'"
Luke 17
1. 耶穌對他的門徒們說： 「那些使人絆腳的事必然出現，不過使它出現的人有禍了。 He said to His disciples, "Offenses will certainly come, but woe to the one they come through!
2. 對他來說，就算脖子上拴著大磨石，被丟到海裡，也比他使這些卑微人中的一個絆倒更好。 It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were thrown into the sea than for him to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
3. 你們要謹慎！如果你的弟兄 犯了罪，就告誡他；如果他悔改，就饒恕他。 Be on your guard. If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him.
4. 如果他一天七次對你犯了罪，又 七次回轉過來，對你說：『我悔改！』你要饒恕他。」 And if he sins against you seven times in a day, and comes back to you seven times, saying, 'I repent,' you must forgive him."
5. 使徒們對主說：「請你加添我們的信心 。」 The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith."
6. 主說： 「如果你們有像一粒芥菜種子那樣的信仰，即使是對這棵桑樹說『願你被連根拔起，栽到海裡去！』它也會聽從你們。 "If you have faith the size of a mustard seed," the Lord said, "you can say to this mulberry tree, 'Be uprooted and planted in the sea,' and it will obey you.
7. 「你們當中誰有奴僕耕田或放羊，從田裡回來的時候，會對奴僕說『立刻過來，坐下吃飯』呢？ "Which one of you having a slave plowing or tending sheep, will say to him when he comes in from the field, 'Come at once and sit down to eat'?
8. 他難道不會對奴僕說『你預備我所要吃的晚餐，束上腰帶伺候我，等我吃喝完了，你才要吃喝』嗎？ Instead, will he not tell him, 'Prepare something for me to eat, get ready, and serve me while I eat and drink; later you can eat and drink'?
9. 奴僕做了所吩咐的事，難道主人要向奴僕懷有感恩的心嗎？ Does he thank that slave because he did what was commanded?
10. 你們也是這樣，當你們做完了所吩咐你們的一切事以後，應該說『我們是無用的奴僕，只是做了自己該做的。』」 In the same way, when you have done all that you were commanded, you should say, 'We are good-for-nothing slaves; we've only done our duty.'"
11. 耶穌往 耶路撒冷 去的時候，經過 撒馬利亞 和 加利利 的中間地帶。 While traveling to Jerusalem, He passed between Samaria and Galilee.
12. 他進了一個村子，有十個痲瘋病人見到他，遠遠地站著， As He entered a village, 10 men with serious skin diseases met Him. They stood at a distance
13. 大聲說：「耶穌啊，老師啊，可憐我們吧！」 and raised their voices, saying, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"
14. 耶穌看見了，就對他們說： 「你們去，讓祭司檢查你們吧！」 結果在他們去的時候，就被潔淨了。 When He saw them, He told them, "Go and show yourselves to the priests." And while they were going, they were healed.
15. 其中有一個人看見自己得了痊癒，就回來大聲地榮耀神， But one of them, seeing that he was healed, returned and, with a loud voice, gave glory to God.
16. 並且把臉伏在耶穌腳前，感謝他。這人是個 撒馬利亞 人。 He fell facedown at His feet, thanking Him. And he was a Samaritan.
17. 耶穌回答說： 「被潔淨的不是有十個人嗎？另外九個在哪裡呢？ Then Jesus said, "Were not 10 cleansed? Where are the nine?
18. 除了這個外邦人，難道沒有人回來把榮耀歸給神嗎？」 Didn't any return to give glory to God except this foreigner?"
19. 然後耶穌對他說： 「起來，走吧！你的信救了你。」 And He told him, "Get up and go on your way. Your faith has made you well."
20. 有一次， 法利賽 人問耶穌：「神的國什麼時候到來呢？」耶穌回答說： 「神國的到來，不是眼所能見的。 Being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God will come, He answered them, "The kingdom of God is not coming with something observable;
21. 沒有人能說『看，在這裡！』或『在那裡！』因為看哪，神的國就在你們中間 。」 no one will say, 'Look here!' or 'There!' For you see, the kingdom of God is among you."
22. 耶穌又對門徒們說： 「日子將要來到，那時候你們會渴望看見人子日子中的一天，可是看不到。 Then He told the disciples: "The days are coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you won't see it.
23. 他們會告訴你們『看，在那裡！』或『看，在這裡！』你們不要出去，也不要追隨他們； They will say to you, 'Look there!' or 'Look here!' Don't follow or run after them.
24. 因為就像閃電一閃，從天這邊照耀到天那邊，人子在他的日子 也將要這樣。 For as the lightning flashes from horizon to horizon and lights up the sky, so the Son of Man will be in His day.
25. 不過他必須先受很多苦害，又被這世代所棄絕。 But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
26. 「在 挪亞 的那些日子裡發生的怎樣，在人子的那些日子裡也將要怎樣： "Just as it was in the days of Noah, so it will be in the days of the Son of Man:
27. 人們繼續吃、喝、嫁、娶，直到 挪亞 進方舟的那一天，洪水到來，把一切都毀滅了。 people went on eating, drinking, marrying and giving in marriage until the day Noah boarded the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
28. 同樣，就像在 羅得 的那些日子裡發生的那樣：人們繼續吃喝、買賣、耕種、建造， It will be the same as it was in the days of Lot: people went on eating, drinking, buying, selling, planting, building.
29. 到了 羅得 離開 所多瑪 的那一天，烈火和硫磺就從天而降，把一切都毀滅了。 But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all.
30. 人子顯現的那一天，也將是同樣的。 It will be like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
31. 在那一天，在屋頂上的人，如果東西在屋子裡，不要下來拿；同樣，在田裡的人，也不要轉回到背後的事上。 On that day, a man on the housetop, whose belongings are in the house, must not come down to get them. Likewise the man who is in the field must not turn back.
32. 你們當記得 羅得 的妻子！ Remember Lot's wife!
33. 凡想要保全 自己生命的，將失去生命；凡失去自己生命的，將保存生命。 Whoever tries to make his life secure will lose it, and whoever loses his life will preserve it.
34. 我告訴你們：在那一夜，兩個人在一張床上，一個會被接去，另一個會被留下； I tell you, on that night two will be in one bed: one will be taken and the other will be left.
35. 兩個女人在一起推磨，一個會被接去，另一個會被留下。」 Two women will be grinding grain together: one will be taken and the other left.
36. 兩個人在田裡，一個會被接去，另一個會被留下。 」 [[Two will be in a field: one will be taken, and the other will be left."]]
37. 門徒們問耶穌，說：「主啊，在哪裡呢？」 耶穌對他們說： 「屍體在哪裡，禿鷹也就聚集在哪裡。」 "Where, Lord?" they asked Him. He said to them, "Where the corpse is, there also the vultures will be gathered."
Luke 18
1. 耶穌對他們講了一個比喻，說他們必須常常禱告，不要喪膽。 He then told them a parable on the need for them to pray always and not become discouraged:
2. 他說： 「某城裡有一個審判官，他既不敬畏神，也不尊重人。 "There was a judge in one town who didn't fear God or respect man.
3. 那城裡有一個寡婦，經常到他那裡去，說：『請為我向我的對頭討個公道。』 And a widow in that town kept coming to him, saying, 'Give me justice against my adversary.'
4. 「法官一直不肯，但是後來心裡說：『即使我不敬畏神，也不尊重人， "For a while he was unwilling, but later he said to himself, 'Even though I don't fear God or respect man,
5. 還是因為這寡婦不斷地煩擾我，我就為她討個公道，免得她一直來，到最後使我疲憊不堪！』」 yet because this widow keeps pestering me, I will give her justice, so she doesn't wear me out by her persistent coming.'"
6. 主接著說： 「你們當聽這個不公義的審判官所說的！ Then the Lord said, "Listen to what the unjust judge says.
7. 難道神絕不會給那些他所揀選、日夜向他呼求的人主持公道嗎？難道神會耽誤幫助 他們嗎？ Will not God grant justice to His elect who cry out to Him day and night? Will He delay [to help] them?
8. 我告訴你們：他會很快地給他們主持公道。不過人子回來的時候，難道在地上能找到這樣的信仰嗎？」 I tell you that He will swiftly grant them justice. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He find that faith on earth?"
9. 耶穌還對某些自以為義而藐視其他人的，講了這個比喻： He also told this parable to some who trusted in themselves that they were righteous and looked down on everyone else:
10. 「有兩個人上聖殿去禱告。一個是 法利賽 人，另一個是稅吏。 "Two men went up to the temple complex to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
11. 那 法利賽 人站著，向自己禱告這些話 ：『神哪，我感謝你，因為我不像其他人那樣：勒索、不義、通姦，也不像這個稅吏。 The Pharisee took his stand and was praying like this: 'God, I thank You that I'm not like other people-- greedy, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
12. 我一週禁食兩次，並奉獻我所有收入的十分之一。』 I fast twice a week; I give a tenth of everything I get.'
13. 「那稅吏卻遠遠地站著，甚至不敢舉目望天，可是捶著胸說：『神哪，你寬恕我這個罪人吧！』 "But the tax collector, standing far off, would not even raise his eyes to heaven but kept striking his chest and saying, 'God, turn Your wrath from me-- a sinner!'
14. 我告訴你們：下去回家時已經被稱為義的是這個稅吏，而不是那個 法利賽 人。因為每一個自我高舉的都會被降卑；而自我降卑的都會被高舉。」 I tell you, this one went down to his house justified rather than the other; because everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted."
15. 有些人把嬰孩也帶到耶穌那裡，好讓耶穌摸他們一下。門徒們看見了卻責備那些人。 Some people were even bringing infants to Him so He might touch them, but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
16. 但耶穌把他們叫過來，說： 「讓小孩子到我這裡來，不要阻止他們，因為神的國正屬於這樣的人。 Jesus, however, invited them: "Let the little children come to Me, and don't stop them, because the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
17. 我確實地告訴你們：無論誰不像小孩子一樣接受神的國，就絕不能進去。」 I assure you: Whoever does not welcome the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it."
18. 有一個首領問耶穌，說：「良善的老師，我該做什麼才會繼承永恆的生命呢？」 A ruler asked Him, "Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
19. 耶穌對他說： 「你為什麼稱我是良善的呢？除了神一位之外，沒有一個是良善的。 "Why do you call Me good?" Jesus asked him. "No one is good but One-- God.
20. 你是知道這些誡命的： 『不可通姦、 不可殺人、 不可偷竊、 不可做偽證、 要孝敬父母。』 」 You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery; do not murder; do not steal; do not bear false witness; honor your father and mother."
21. 那個人說：「這一切我從年少就遵守了。」 "I have kept all these from my youth," he said.
22. 耶穌聽了就對他說： 「你還缺少一件：把你所擁有的一切都賣掉，分給窮人，這樣你將有財寶在天上；然後你來跟從我。」 When Jesus heard this, He told him, "You still lack one thing: sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me."
23. 那個人聽了這些話就變得很憂愁，因為他極其富有。 After he heard this, he became extremely sad, because he was very rich.
24. 耶穌看見他變得很憂愁，就說： 「有錢財的人進入神的國，是多麼困難！ Seeing that he became sad, Jesus said, "How hard it is for those who have wealth to enter the kingdom of God!
25. 駱駝穿過針眼，比富有的人進入神的國更容易呢！」 For it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."
26. 聽見的人就說：「那麼，誰能得救呢？」 Those who heard this asked, "Then who can be saved?"
27. 耶穌說： 「在人不可能的事，在神都是可能的。」 He replied, "What is impossible with men is possible with God."
28. 彼得 說：「看，我們捨棄自己所擁有的，跟從了你！」 Then Peter said, "Look, we have left what we had and followed You."
29. 耶穌對他們說： 「我確實地告訴你們：沒有誰為神國的緣故捨棄房屋，或妻子，或兄弟，或父母，或兒女， So He said to them, "I assure you: There is no one who has left a house, wife or brothers, parents or children because of the kingdom of God,
30. 而不會在今世得到許多倍，在來世得到永恆生命的。」 who will not receive many times more at this time, and eternal life in the age to come."
31. 耶穌把十二使徒 帶到一邊，對他們說： 「看，我們現在上 耶路撒冷 去，那藉著先知們所寫的一切有關人子的事，都要成就。 Then He took the Twelve aside and told them, "Listen! We are going up to Jerusalem. Everything that is written through the prophets about the Son of Man will be accomplished.
32. 要知道，他將被交給外邦人，被戲弄、受凌辱、被人吐唾沫； For He will be handed over to the Gentiles, and He will be mocked, insulted, spit on;
33. 他們要鞭打他，並殺害他；然後在第三天，他要復活。」 and after they flog Him, they will kill Him, and He will rise on the third day."
34. 但門徒們一點也不領悟這些話。這話對他們是隱藏的，他們不知道他在說什麼。 They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they did not grasp what was said.
35. 耶穌快到 耶利哥 的時候，有一個瞎眼的坐在路邊乞討。 As He drew near Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the road begging.
36. 他聽見人群經過那裡，就問到底是什麼事。 Hearing a crowd passing by, he inquired what this meant.
37. 有人告訴他：「 拿撒勒 人耶穌經過這裡。」 "Jesus the Nazarene is passing by," they told him.
38. 他就呼喊說：「耶穌啊， 大衛 的後裔，可憐我吧！」 So he called out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
39. 走在前頭的人就責備他，要他安靜。可是，他卻更加大聲呼叫：「 大衛 的後裔，可憐我吧！」 Then those in front told him to keep quiet, but he kept crying out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
40. 耶穌就停住，吩咐把他帶到他面前來；那人走近了，耶穌就問他： Jesus stopped and commanded that he be brought to Him. When he drew near, He asked him,
41. 「你要我為你做什麼呢？」 他說：「主啊，我要重見光明！」 "What do you want Me to do for you?" "Lord," he said, "I want to see!"
42. 耶穌對他說： 「你重見光明吧！你的信救了你。」 "Receive your sight!" Jesus told him. "Your faith has healed you."
43. 他立刻重見光明，於是跟隨耶穌，一路上榮耀神。民眾都看到了，就讚美神。 Instantly he could see, and he began to follow Him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, gave praise to God.
Luke 19
1. 耶穌進了 耶利哥，從城裡經過， He entered Jericho and was passing through.
2. 看哪，有一個名叫 撒該 的人，是個稅吏長，很富有。 There was a man named Zacchaeus who was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
3. 他很想看看耶穌是什麼樣的人，可是因為他身材矮小，從人群中無法看到耶穌。 He was trying to see who Jesus was, but he was not able because of the crowd, since he was a short man.
4. 於是他跑到前頭，爬上一棵桑樹，要看耶穌，因為耶穌就要從那裡經過。 So running ahead, he climbed up a sycamore tree to see Jesus, since He was about to pass that way.
5. 耶穌來到那地方時，抬頭一看， 對他說： 「 撒該，快下來！因為我今天必須住在你家裡。」 When Jesus came to the place, He looked up and said to him, "Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, because today I must stay at your house."
6. 撒該 就急忙下來，快快樂樂地接待耶穌。 So he quickly came down and welcomed Him joyfully.
7. 大家看見，就抱怨說：「他竟然到一個罪人家裡去借宿。」 All who saw it began to complain, "He's gone to lodge with a sinful man!"
8. 撒該 站著對主說：「主啊，請看，我要把我財產的一半分給窮人。我如果勒索過誰的東西，就償還四倍。」 But Zacchaeus stood there and said to the Lord, "Look, I'll give half of my possessions to the poor, Lord! And if I have extorted anything from anyone, I'll pay back four times as much!"
9. 耶穌對他說： 「今天救恩臨到了這一家，因為他也是 亞伯拉罕 的子孫。 "Today salvation has come to this house," Jesus told him, "because he too is a son of Abraham.
10. 要知道，人子來，是為了尋找並拯救迷失的人。」 For the Son of Man has come to seek and to save the lost."
11. 大家正聽這些話的時候，耶穌再講了一個比喻，因為他已經離 耶路撒冷 不遠，而且他們以為神的國快要顯現了。 As they were listening to this, He went on to tell a parable because He was near Jerusalem, and they thought the kingdom of God was going to appear right away.
12. 他說： 「有一個出身高貴的人，要往遙遠的地方去接受王位，然後再回來。 Therefore He said: "A nobleman traveled to a far country to receive for himself authority to be king and then return.
13. 他叫來自己的十個奴僕，給他們一千銀幣，對他們說：『你們去做生意，直到我回來。』 He called 10 of his slaves, gave them 10 minas, and told them, 'Engage in business until I come back.'
14. 「他本國的人卻憎恨他，就差派特使在他背後去，說：『我們不要這個人做王統治我們。』 "But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him, saying, 'We don't want this man to rule over us!'
15. 「當他接受了王位 回來的時候，就吩咐把這些曾領了銀子的奴僕叫來，要知道他們做生意賺了多少。 "At his return, having received the authority to be king, he summoned those slaves he had given the money to so he could find out how much they had made in business.
16. 第一個前來說：『主啊，你的那一百銀幣，已經賺了一千 。』 The first came forward and said, 'Master, your mina has earned 10 more minas.'
17. 「主人對他說：『做得好，好奴僕！因為你在最小的事上忠心，你就有權掌管十個城。』 " 'Well done, good slave!' he told him. 'Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, have authority over 10 towns.'
18. 「第二個上前來說：『主啊，你的那一百銀幣，已經賺了五百 。』 "The second came and said, 'Master, your mina has made five minas.'
19. 「主人也對這個人說：『你掌管五個城吧！』 "So he said to him, 'You will be over five towns.'
20. 「另一個上前來說：『主啊，請看，你的那一百銀幣，我一直保存在手巾裡。 "And another came and said, 'Master, here is your mina. I have kept it hidden away in a cloth
21. 我怕你，因為你是個嚴厲的人，不是你存放的，你提取；不是你播種的，你收穫。』 because I was afraid of you, for you're a tough man: you collect what you didn't deposit and reap what you didn't sow.'
22. 「主人對他說：『你這惡奴！我要憑你的口定你的罪。你既然知道我是個嚴厲的人，不是我存放的，我提取；不是我播種的，我收穫， "He told him, 'I will judge you by what you have said, you evil slave! [If] you knew I was a tough man, collecting what I didn't deposit and reaping what I didn't sow,
23. 那麼你為什麼沒有把我的銀子交給錢莊呢？這樣我回來的時候，可以連本帶利收回來。』 why didn't you put my money in the bank? And when I returned, I would have collected it with interest!'
24. 於是他對站在旁邊的人說：『把那一百銀幣從他那裡拿走，給那個有一千的。』 So he said to those standing there, 'Take the mina away from him and give it to the one who has 10 minas.'
25. 「他們說：『主啊，他已經有一千銀幣了！』 "But they said to him, 'Master, he has 10 minas.'
26. 「我告訴你們：凡是有的，還要賜給他；那沒有的，連他有的也將從他那裡被拿走。 " 'I tell you, that to everyone who has, more will be given; and from the one who does not have, even what he does have will be taken away.
27. 不過我的這些敵人，就是不要我做王統治他們的人，把他們帶到這裡來，在我面前殺掉！」 But bring here these enemies of mine, who did not want me to rule over them, and slaughter them in my presence.'"
28. 說完這些話，耶穌就繼續往前走，上 耶路撒冷 去。 When He had said these things, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
29. 快到 伯法其 和 伯大尼，那叫做「 橄欖園 」的山，耶穌派了兩個門徒， As He approached Bethphage and Bethany, at the place called the Mount of Olives, He sent two of the disciples
30. 說： 「你們到對面的村子裡去。你們一進村，就會發現一頭驢駒拴在那裡，是從來沒有人騎過的。你們把牠解開牽過來。 and said, "Go into the village ahead of you. As you enter it, you will find a young donkey tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
31. 如果有人問你們為什麼解開牠，你們就這樣說『主需要牠 。』」 If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying it?' say this: 'The Lord needs it.'"
32. 被差派的人去了，發現事情正如耶穌所告訴他們的。 So those who were sent left and found it just as He had told them.
33. 在他們解開驢駒的時候，驢的主人們問他們：「你們為什麼解開這驢駒呢？」 As they were untying the young donkey, its owners said to them, "Why are you untying the donkey?"
34. 他們就說：「主需要牠。」 "The Lord needs it," they said.
35. 他們牽著驢駒到耶穌那裡，把自己的外衣搭在驢駒上，扶著耶穌騎上去。 Then they brought it to Jesus, and after throwing their robes on the donkey, they helped Jesus get on it.
36. 耶穌前行的時候，人們把自己的外衣鋪在路上。 As He was going along, they were spreading their robes on the road.
37. 耶穌已經快到 橄欖山 的下坡附近的時候，全體門徒為了他們所看見的一切神蹟，開始歡樂起來，大聲讚美神， Now He came near the path down the Mount of Olives, and the whole crowd of the disciples began to praise God joyfully with a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen:
38. 說： 「 奉主名而來的那位君王， 是蒙祝福的！ 在天上有和平， 在至高之處有榮耀！」 Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord. Peace in heaven and glory in the highest heaven!
39. 人群中有一些 法利賽 人對耶穌說：「老師，責備你的門徒吧！」 Some of the Pharisees from the crowd told Him, "Teacher, rebuke Your disciples."
40. 耶穌回答說： 「我告訴你們：這些人如果不做聲，石頭都會呼喊起來！」 He answered, "I tell you, if they were to keep silent, the stones would cry out!"
41. 耶穌快到 耶路撒冷 的時候，看見那城，就為她哭泣， As He approached and saw the city, He wept over it,
42. 說： 「巴不得你在這日子裡明白關乎你和平的事，但如今這事在你眼前被隱藏了。 saying, "If you knew this day what [would bring] peace-- but now it is hidden from your eyes.
43. 因為日子將臨到你，你的敵人要築起壁壘包圍你，四面困住你。 For the days will come on you when your enemies will build an embankment against you, surround you, and hem you in on every side.
44. 而且，他們要將你和你裡面的兒女猛摔在地，不容你裡面有一塊石頭留在另一塊石頭上，因為你沒有認出神 臨到 你的時候。」 They will crush you and your children within you to the ground, and they will not leave one stone on another in you, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation."
45. 耶穌進了聖殿，開始把那些 做買賣的人 趕出去， He went into the temple complex and began to throw out those who were selling,
46. 對他們說： 「經上記著： 『我的殿將成為禱告的殿』，而你們卻使它成為 賊窩 了！ 」 and He said, "It is written, My house will be a house of prayer, but you have made it a den of thieves!"
47. 耶穌天天在聖殿裡教導人。祭司長們、經文士們和民間的首領們想要殺害他， Every day He was teaching in the temple complex. The chief priests, the scribes, and the leaders of the people were looking for a way to destroy Him,
48. 可是他們不知道怎樣下手，因為民眾都傾心聽他。 but they could not find a way to do it, because all the people were captivated by what they heard.
Luke 20
1. 就在那些日子裡，有一天耶穌在聖殿裡教導民眾、傳福音的時候，祭司長們、經文士們和長老們一起上前來， One day as He was teaching the people in the temple complex and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests and the scribes, with the elders, came up
2. 對他說：「請告訴我們：你憑什麼權柄做這些事？是誰給你這權柄的？」 and said to Him: "Tell us, by what authority are You doing these things? Who is it who gave You this authority?"
3. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「我也要問你們一個問題，你們告訴我： He answered them, "I will also ask you a question. Tell Me,
4. 約翰 的洗禮是來自天上，還是來自人間呢？」 was the baptism of John from heaven or from men?"
