5. 他們就彼此商量，說：「如果我們說『是來自天上』，他就會問『你們為什麼不相信他呢？』 They discussed it among themselves: "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say, 'Why didn't you believe him?'
6. 但如果說『是來自人間』，那麼民眾都會用石頭砸我們，因為他們深信 約翰 是先知。」 But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, because they are convinced that John was a prophet."
7. 於是他們回答：「不知道是從哪裡來的。」 So they answered that they did not know its origin.
8. 耶穌就對他們說： 「我也不告訴你們我憑什麼權柄做這些事。」 And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
9. 接著，耶穌開始對民眾講這個比喻： 「有一個人栽種了一個葡萄園，把它租給一些農夫，然後就出外旅行，去了許久。 Then He began to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard, leased it to tenant farmers, and went away for a long time.
10. 到了收穫的 季節，他就派了一個奴僕到那些農夫那裡去，好讓他們從葡萄園的果子中把當納的 交給他。但那些農夫打了他，叫他空手回去。 At harvest time he sent a slave to the farmers so that they might give him some fruit from the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
11. 園主又派另一個奴僕去，可是他們把那個人也打了，並且侮辱他，叫他空手回去。 He sent yet another slave, but they beat that one too, treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.
12. 於是，他又派了第三個人去，他們又把這個人打傷，趕了出去。 And he sent yet a third, but they wounded this one too and threw him out.
13. 「葡萄園的主人就說：『我該做什麼呢？我要派遣我的愛子，或許他們 會尊重他。』 "Then the owner of the vineyard said, 'What should I do? I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.'
14. 「可是那些農夫看見他，就彼此討論說：『這是繼承人。 我們把他殺了，那繼業就成為我們的了。』 "But when the tenant farmers saw him, they discussed it among themselves and said, 'This is the heir. Let's kill him, so the inheritance will be ours!'
15. 於是他們把他扔出葡萄園外，殺了。 「那麼，葡萄園的主人會怎麼對待他們呢？ So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. "Therefore, what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
16. 他會來除滅這些農夫，把葡萄園交給別人。」 大家聽了就說：「絕不可有這樣的事！」 He will come and destroy those farmers and give the vineyard to others." But when they heard this they said, "No-- never!"
17. 耶穌注視著他們，說： 「那麼，經上記的 『工匠所棄絕的石頭，它已經成了房角的頭塊石頭』 這話是什麼意思呢？ But He looked at them and said, "Then what is the meaning of this Scripture: The stone that the builders rejected-- this has become the cornerstone?
18. 所有跌落在那石頭上的，就將被破碎；那石頭落在誰的身上，就會把誰砸得稀爛。」 Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, and if it falls on anyone, it will grind him to powder!"
19. 經文士和祭司長們知道這個比喻是針對他們而說的，當時就想下手捉拿耶穌，可是又怕民眾。 Then the scribes and the chief priests looked for a way to get their hands on Him that very hour, because they knew He had told this parable against them, but they feared the people.
20. 於是，他們密切注意，派了一些奸細裝做好人，要抓耶穌的話柄，好把他交在總督的管理和權柄之下。 They watched closely and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, so they could catch Him in what He said, to hand Him over to the governor's rule and authority.
21. 那些奸細問耶穌，說：「老師，我們知道你所說所教導的都是對的，你也不顧人的情面，而是按真理教導神的道 。 They questioned Him, "Teacher, we know that You speak and teach correctly, and You don't show partiality, but teach truthfully the way of God.
22. 請問：我們向凱撒納稅，可以不可以呢？」 Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
23. 耶穌看出他們的詭詐，就對他們說： But detecting their craftiness, He said to them,
24. 「拿一個銀幣 給我看。這上面是誰的像和名號？」 他們說：「是凱撒的。」 "Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?" "Caesar's," they said.
25. 耶穌對他們說： 「因此，凱撒的歸給凱撒；神的歸給神。」 "Well then," He told them, "give back to Caesar the things that are Caesar's and to God the things that are God's."
26. 他們在民眾面前抓不到耶穌的話柄，又對他的答覆感到驚奇，就啞口無言了。 They were not able to catch Him in what He said in public, and being amazed at His answer, they became silent.
27. 撒都該 人來到耶穌那裡，他們一向說沒有復活的事。他們問耶穌， Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came up and questioned Him:
28. 說：「老師， 摩西 為我們寫道： 如果一個人的兄弟死了，留下妻子而沒有孩子，他就應該娶這婦人，為他兄弟留後裔。 "Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother has a wife, and dies childless, his brother should take the wife and produce offspring for his brother.
29. 曾經有兄弟七人，第一個娶了妻子，沒有孩子就死了。 Now there were seven brothers. The first took a wife and died without children.
30. 第二個、 Also the second
31. 第三個也娶了她；七個人都是這樣，沒有留下兒女就死了。 and the third took her. In the same way, all seven died and left no children.
32. 後來這婦人也死了。 Finally, the woman died too.
33. 既然這七個人都娶過她為妻，那麼，在復活的時候，這婦人是誰的妻子呢？」 Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife will the woman be? For all seven had married her."
34. 耶穌對他們說： 「這世代的兒女又娶又嫁； Jesus told them, "The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
35. 但那些算是配得上承受那世代，又配得上從死人中復活的人，既不娶也不嫁。 But those who are counted worthy to take part in that age and in the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
36. 事實上，他們再也不會死，因為就與天使一樣；他們既然是復活的兒女，就是神的兒女了。 For they cannot die anymore, because they are like angels and are sons of God, since they are sons of the resurrection.
37. 至於死人復活的事， 摩西 在『荊棘篇』上也指明了，正如稱主是 『 Moses even indicated [in the passage] about the burning bush that the dead are raised, where he calls the Lord the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob.
38. 所以神不是死人的神，而是活人的神；在神，人都是活著的。」 He is not God of the dead but of the living, because all are living to Him."
39. 有一些經文士應聲說：「老師，你說得好。」 Some of the scribes answered, "Teacher, You have spoken well."
40. 從此他們再也不敢質問他什麼了。 And they no longer dared to ask Him anything.
41. 耶穌對他們說： 「人怎麼說基督是 大衛 的後裔呢？ Then He said to them, "How can they say that the Messiah is the Son of David?
42. 大衛 自己在詩篇裡說： 『主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， For David himself says in the Book of Psalms: The Lord declared to my Lord, 'Sit at My right hand
43. 等我把你的敵人放在你的腳下做腳凳。』 until I make Your enemies Your footstool.'
44. 大衛 既然稱基督為『主』，基督又怎麼會是 的後裔呢？」 David calls Him 'Lord'; how then can the Messiah be his Son?"
45. 全體民眾正在聽的時候，耶穌對他的門徒說： While all the people were listening, He said to His disciples,
46. 「你們要提防經文士。他們喜歡穿著長袍走來走去，喜愛街市上的致敬問候，又喜愛會堂裡的首位、宴席中的上座。 "Beware of the scribes, who want to go around in long robes and who love greetings in the marketplaces, the front seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
47. 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，又假意做很長的禱告。這些人將受到更重的懲罰 。」 They devour widows' houses and say long prayers just for show. These will receive greater punishment."
Luke 21
1. 耶穌抬頭觀看，見富有的人把他們的奉獻投入奉獻箱裡， He looked up and saw the rich dropping their offerings into the temple treasury.
2. 又見一個窮寡婦投進兩個小錢 。 He also saw a poor widow dropping in two tiny coins.
3. 於是他說： 「我確實地告訴你們：這窮寡婦所投的，比所有的人更多。 "I tell you the truth," He said. "This poor widow has put in more than all of them.
4. 因為那些人都是從自己的富餘中拿出來，當做奉獻 來投入；而這寡婦是從自己的缺乏中，把她擁有的養生費用全都投進去了。」 For all these people have put in gifts out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on."
5. 有些人談論到聖殿，說它是用精美的石頭和供奉的禮物裝飾的。耶穌就說： As some were talking about the temple complex, how it was adorned with beautiful stones and gifts dedicated to God, He said,
6. 「你們現在所看見的這些，當那些日子來到的時候，將不會有一塊石頭留在另一塊石頭上而不被拆下。」 "These things that you see-- the days will come when not one stone will be left on another that will not be thrown down!"
7. 他們就問耶穌，說：「老師，那麼，這些事什麼時候會發生呢？這些事將要發生的時候，會有什麼預兆呢？」 "Teacher," they asked Him, "so when will these things be? And what will be the sign when these things are about to take place?"
8. 耶穌說： 「你們要當心，免得被迷惑，因為許多人會以我的名而來，聲稱『我就是那一位 』，又說『時候快到了。』你們不要跟從他們。 Then He said, "Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, saying, 'I am He,' and, 'The time is near.' Don't follow them.
9. 當你們聽見有戰爭和混亂的時候，不可驚慌，因為這些事必須先發生，不過結局不會立刻就到。」 When you hear of wars and rebellions, don't be alarmed. Indeed, these things must take place first, but the end won't come right away."
10. 耶穌接著對他們說： 「一個民族要起來反對另一個民族，一個國家要起來反對另一個國家； Then He told them: "Nation will be raised up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
11. 到處都會有大地震、饑荒和瘟疫；會有恐怖的景象和天上來的大徵兆。 There will be violent earthquakes, and famines and plagues in various places, and there will be terrifying sights and great signs from heaven.
12. 不過在所有這些事以前，他們將對你們下手，逼迫你們，把你們送交會堂，送進監獄；為我名的緣故，你們將被帶到君王和總督面前。 But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you. They will hand you over to the synagogues and prisons, and you will be brought before kings and governors because of My name.
13. 但這卻要成為你們做見證的機會。 It will lead to an opportunity for you to witness.
14. 所以你們應當心裡鎮定，不用預先思慮怎樣申辯。 Therefore make up your minds not to prepare your defense ahead of time,
15. 因為我將賜給你們口才和智慧，是所有反對你們的人都不能抵擋、不能駁倒的。 for I will give you such words and a wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
16. 你們甚至將被父母、兄弟、親戚和朋友出賣，他們還會害死你們當中的一些人。 You will even be betrayed by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will kill some of you.
17. 為了我的名，你們將被所有的人憎恨， You will be hated by everyone because of My name,
18. 可是你們連一根頭髮也絕不會失去。 but not a hair of your head will be lost.
19. 你們當在你們的忍耐中獲得自己的生命 。 By your endurance gain your lives.
20. 「當你們看見 耶路撒冷 被軍隊包圍的時候，你們那時就應當知道它的毀滅近了。 "When you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then recognize that its desolation has come near.
21. 那時，在 猶太 的人應當逃到山裡；在城 裡的人應當出來；在鄉下的人不要進城； Then those in Judea must flee to the mountains! Those inside the city must leave it, and those who are in the country must not enter it,
22. 因為這是報應的日子，為要應驗經上所記載的一切。 because these are days of vengeance to fulfill all the things that are written.
23. 在那些日子裡，孕婦和哺乳的女人有禍了！因為將有大苦難臨到這地，也有震怒臨到這民 。 Woe to pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days, for there will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.
24. 他們將倒在刀口下，被擄到各國去。 耶路撒冷 將要被外邦人踐踏，直到外邦人的日期滿了。 They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations, and Jerusalem will be trampled by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
25. 「在太陽、月亮和星辰中將有徵兆出現 ；在地上，因海洋的咆哮和翻騰，列國的人就驚慌失措，陷入困惑混亂之中； "Then there will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and there will be anguish on the earth among nations bewildered by the roaring sea and waves.
26. 人們預料到將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體；因為諸天的各勢力都將被震動。 People will faint from fear and expectation of the things that are coming on the world, because the celestial powers will be shaken.
27. 那時候，人們將要看見人子帶著極大的權能和榮耀，在雲彩中來臨。 Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
28. 這些事一開始發生，你們就當挺起身、抬起頭，因為你們的救贖近了。」 But when these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near!"
29. 耶穌又給他們講了一個比喻： 「你們看無花果樹和其他 所有的樹， Then He told them a parable: "Look at the fig tree, and all the trees.
30. 當它們長出葉子 的時候，你們一看就知道夏天已經快到了。 As soon as they put out [leaves] you can see for yourselves and recognize that summer is already near.
31. 照樣，當你們看見這些事發生的時候，你們應當知道：神的國快到了。 In the same way, when you see these things happening, recognize that the kingdom of God is near.
32. 我確實地告訴你們：在這一切事發生之前，這世代絕不會過去。 I assure you: This generation will certainly not pass away until all things take place.
33. 天和地將要消逝，但是我的話絕不會消逝。 Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
34. 「你們要謹慎自守，免得你們的心因宴樂 、醉酒和今生的憂慮變得遲鈍，那日子就會像網羅一樣突然臨到你們， "Be on your guard, so that your minds are not dulled from carousing, drunkenness, and worries of life, or that day will come on you unexpectedly
35. 因為那日子將要臨到所有住在全地面上的人。 like a trap. For it will come on all who live on the face of the whole earth.
36. 你們要時刻警醒、禱告，使你們能夠 逃避這一切將要發生的事，好站立在人子面前。」 But be alert at all times, praying that you may have strength to escape all these things that are going to take place and to stand before the Son of Man."
37. 耶穌白天在聖殿裡教導人，夜間出去到那叫做「 橄欖園 」的山裡過夜。 During the day, He was teaching in the temple complex, but in the evening He would go out and spend the night on what is called the Mount of Olives.
38. 全體民眾清早起來上聖殿，到耶穌那裡聽他講說。 Then all the people would come early in the morning to hear Him in the temple complex.
Luke 22
1. 除酵節——又叫逾越節——快到了。 The Festival of Unleavened Bread, which is called Passover, was drawing near.
2. 祭司長們和經文士們在圖謀怎樣能殺掉耶穌，因為他們怕民眾。 The chief priests and the scribes were looking for a way to put Him to death, because they were afraid of the people.
3. 那時， 撒旦 進入了那稱為 加略 人的 猶大 裡面。 猶大 算是十二使徒 中的一個。 Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, who was numbered among the Twelve.
4. 他去跟祭司長們和守衛長們 商量怎樣把耶穌交給他們。 He went away and discussed with the chief priests and temple police how he could hand Him over to them.
5. 他們就歡喜，並且說好要給他銀錢。 They were glad and agreed to give him silver.
6. 猶大 同意了，就開始找機會，要趁眾人不在的時候，把耶穌交給他們。 So he accepted [the offer] and started looking for a good opportunity to betray Him to them when the crowd was not present.
7. 除酵節的第一日到了，在這一天必須宰殺逾越節的羔羊。 Then the Day of Unleavened Bread came when the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
8. 耶穌差派 彼得 和 約翰，說： 「你們去為我們預備逾越節的晚餐，好讓我們能吃上。」 Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover meal for us, so we can eat it."
9. 他們問耶穌：「你要我們在哪裡預備呢？」 "Where do You want us to prepare it?" they asked Him.
10. 耶穌對他們說： 「看哪！你們進了城，會有一個人提著一罐水迎面而來，你們就跟著他，到他所進的那一家去， "Listen," He said to them, "when you've entered the city, a man carrying a water jug will meet you. Follow him into the house he enters.
11. 對那家的主人說：『老師問你：我與我的門徒們一起吃逾越節晚餐的客房在哪裡呢？』 Tell the owner of the house, 'The Teacher asks you, "Where is the guest room where I can eat the Passover with My disciples?"'
12. 他會給你們看樓上一間布置好的大房間，你們就在那裡預備吧。」 Then he will show you a large, furnished room upstairs. Make the preparations there."
13. 他們去了，看到的正如耶穌對他們所說的。他們就預備了逾越節的晚餐。 So they went and found it just as He had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
14. 時候一到，耶穌就坐席，十二 使徒也和他同坐。 When the hour came, He reclined at the table, and the apostles with Him.
15. 耶穌對他們說： 「我一直非常渴望在我受難之前，與你們一起吃這逾越節的晚餐。 Then He said to them, "I have fervently desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
16. 我告訴你們：我絕不 吃這晚餐，直等到逾越節在神的國裡得以成就。」 For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."
17. 耶穌拿起杯來，祝謝了，說： 「你們拿這個，大家分著喝。 Then He took a cup, and after giving thanks, He said, "Take this and share it among yourselves.
18. 我告訴你們：從今以後 我絕不喝這葡萄汁，直到神的國來臨。」 For I tell you, from now on I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
19. 他又拿起餅來，祝謝了，掰開遞給他們，說： 「這是我的身體，為你們獻上的；你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。」 And He took bread, gave thanks, broke it, gave it to them, and said, "This is My body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of Me."
20. 晚餐後，他也照樣拿起杯來，說： 「這杯是用我的血所立的新約，為你們所流的。 In the same way He also took the cup after supper and said, "This cup is the new covenant [established by] My blood; it is shed for you.
21. 不過看哪，那賣我之人的手，與我的手一同在這桌子上， But look, the hand of the one betraying Me is at the table with Me!
22. 因為人子確實要按照所決定的離去。不過出賣人子的那個人有禍了。」 For the Son of Man will go away as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!"
23. 於是他們開始彼此議論，他們當中究竟是誰會做這事。 So they began to argue among themselves which of them it could be who was going to do this thing.
24. 門徒之間也起了爭論：他們當中誰算是更大的。 Then a dispute also arose among them about who should be considered the greatest.
25. 耶穌對他們說： 「外邦人有君王轄制他們，他們的掌權者被稱為恩主。 But He said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles dominate them, and those who have authority over them are called 'Benefactors.'
26. 但你們卻不是這樣；相反，你們當中誰更大，誰就該變得像年幼的那樣；領頭的，該像服事人的。 But it must not be like that among you. On the contrary, whoever is greatest among you must become like the youngest, and whoever leads, like the one serving.
27. 坐席的或服事的，到底哪一個更大呢？難道不是坐席的嗎？然而我在你們中間，是像服事人的。 For who is greater, the one at the table or the one serving? Isn't it the one at the table? But I am among you as the One who serves.
28. 不過我在試煉當中，始終與我在一起的就是你們； You are the ones who stood by Me in My trials.
29. 並且我把國度賜給你們，就像我父賜給了我那樣， I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father bestowed one on Me,
30. 使你們在我的國度裡，在我的筵席上吃喝；並且坐在寶座上審判 以色列 的十二個支派。」 so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom. And you will sit on thrones judging the 12 tribes of Israel.
31. 主又說 ：「 西門，，你看， 撒旦 想要得著你們，要篩你們像篩麥子一樣。 "Simon, Simon, look out! Satan has asked to sift you like wheat.
32. 但是，我已經為你祈求，使你不失去信仰。所以當你回轉過來的時候，要堅固你的弟兄們。」 But I have prayed for you that your faith may not fail. And you, when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."
33. 可是 彼得 對耶穌說：「主啊，我預備好要與你一起去監獄、一起去死！」 "Lord," he told Him, "I'm ready to go with You both to prison and to death!"
34. 耶穌卻說： 「 彼得，我告訴你：今天雞叫以前，你會三次否定認識我。」 "I tell you, Peter," He said, "the rooster will not crow today until you deny three times that you know Me!"
35. 接著耶穌問他們： 「我從前差派你們出去的時候，你們不帶錢包、行囊、鞋子，你們缺少過什麼沒有？」 他們說：「沒有。」 He also said to them, "When I sent you out without money-bag, traveling bag, or sandals, did you lack anything?" "Not a thing," they said.
36. 耶穌卻對他們說： 「但現在，有錢包的應當帶著；同樣，有行囊的也應當帶著；沒有刀的，應當賣掉自己的外衣去買一把。 Then He said to them, "But now, whoever has a money-bag should take it, and also a traveling bag. And whoever doesn't have a sword should sell his robe and buy one.
37. 我告訴你們：經上記著： 『他被列在不法之徒當中』，這話必須在我身上成就，因為那有關我的事就要有個結局了。」 For I tell you, what is written must be fulfilled in Me: And He was counted among the outlaws. Yes, what is written about Me is coming to its fulfillment."
38. 他們說：「主啊，你看，這裡有兩把刀。」 耶穌說： 「實在夠了。」 "Lord," they said, "look, here are two swords." "Enough of that!" He told them.
39. 耶穌出來，照他的習慣往 橄欖山 去，門徒們也跟著他。 He went out and made His way as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.
40. 到了那地方，耶穌對他們說： 「你們要禱告，免得陷入試探。」 When He reached the place, He told them, "Pray that you may not enter into temptation."
41. 然後他抽出身，離他們約有扔一塊石頭的距離，跪下禱告， Then He withdrew from them about a stone's throw, knelt down, and began to pray,
42. 說： 「父啊，如果你願意，請把這杯從我這裡拿走吧！但不要成就我的意思，而要成就你的意思。」 "Father, if You are willing, take this cup away from Me-- nevertheless, not My will, but Yours, be done."
43. 有一位天使從天上向他顯現，加添他的力量。 [[Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him, strengthening Him.
44. 耶穌在極大的痛苦中，禱告更加懇切；他的汗珠變得像大血滴，落在地上。 Being in anguish, He prayed more fervently, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.]]
45. 禱告完了，他起身到門徒那裡，看見他們因為憂傷都睡著了， When He got up from prayer and came to the disciples, He found them sleeping, exhausted from their grief.
46. 就對他們說： 「你們為什麼睡覺呢？起來禱告，免得陷入試探。」 "Why are you sleeping?" He asked them. "Get up and pray, so that you won't enter into temptation."
47. 耶穌還在說話的時候，忽然來了一群人。十二使徒中的一個，就是那稱為 猶大 的，走在他們前頭。他靠近耶穌，要親吻他。 While He was still speaking, suddenly a mob was there, and one of the Twelve named Judas was leading them. He came near Jesus to kiss Him,
48. 耶穌對他說： 「 猶大，你用親吻禮來出賣人子嗎？」 but Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
49. 耶穌周圍的人看到要發生的事，就說：「主啊，我們要用刀砍嗎？」 When those around Him saw what was going to happen, they asked, "Lord, should we strike with the sword?"
50. 其中一個人向大祭司的奴僕砍去，削掉了他的右耳。 Then one of them struck the high priest's slave and cut off his right ear.
51. 耶穌應聲說： 「住手，到此為止！」 然後摸一下那個人的耳朵，使他痊癒了。 But Jesus responded, "No more of this!" And touching his ear, He healed him.
52. 耶穌對前來對付他的祭司長們、聖殿守衛長們和長老們說： 「你們帶著刀劍和棍棒出來，就像對付強盜那樣嗎？ Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple police, and the elders who had come for Him, "Have you come out with swords and clubs as if I were a criminal?
53. 我天天在聖殿裡與你們在一起的時候，你們不向我下手。不過現在是你們的時候了，是黑暗掌權的時候了！」 Every day while I was with you in the temple complex, you never laid a hand on Me. But this is your hour-- and the dominion of darkness."
54. 他們抓住耶穌，把他帶走，押到大祭司的家裡。 彼得 遠遠地跟著。 They seized Him, led Him away, and brought Him into the high priest's house. Meanwhile Peter was following at a distance.
55. 他們在院子當中生了火，一起坐著。 彼得 也坐在他們中間。 They lit a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, and Peter sat among them.
56. 有一個女僕看見 彼得 坐在火光中，就注視著他，說：「這個人也與他是一夥的。」 When a servant saw him sitting in the firelight, and looked closely at him, she said, "This man was with Him too."
57. 彼得 卻否認說：「你這個女人哪，我不認識他！」 But he denied it: "Woman, I don't know Him!"
58. 過了一會兒，另一個人看見他，就說：「你也是與他們一夥的！」 彼得 說：「你這個人哪，我不是！」 After a little while, someone else saw him and said, "You're one of them too!" "Man, I am not!" Peter said.
59. 大約過了一個小時，又有一個人肯定地說：「這個人真的也是與他一夥的，因為他也是 加利利 人。」 About an hour later, another kept insisting, "This man was certainly with Him, since he's also a Galilean."
60. 彼得 說：「你這個人哪，我不知道你在說什麼！」他正說著的時候，雞立時就叫了。 But Peter said, "Man, I don't know what you're talking about!" Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
61. 主轉過身來注視 彼得， 彼得 就想起主對他說過的話： 「今天雞叫以前，你會三次不認我。」 Then the Lord turned and looked at Peter. So Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, "Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times."
62. 他就到外面去，痛哭起來。 And he went outside and wept bitterly.
63. 看守耶穌 的人戲弄他、毆打他， The men who were holding Jesus started mocking and beating Him.
64. 又蒙住他的眼睛問他， 說：「你說預言吧！打你的是誰？」 After blindfolding Him, they kept asking, "Prophesy! Who hit You?"
65. 他們還說了很多別的話辱罵他。 And they were saying many other blasphemous things against Him.
66. 一到天亮，民間的長老議會，包括祭司長們和經文士們，就聚集在一起。他們把耶穌帶到議會裡， When daylight came, the elders of the people, both the chief priests and the scribes, convened and brought Him before their Sanhedrin.
67. 說：「你如果是基督，就告訴我們吧。」 耶穌對他們說： 「就算我告訴你們，你們也絕不會相信； They said, "If You are the Messiah, tell us." But He said to them, "If I do tell you, you will not believe.
68. 就算我問你們，你們也絕不會回答 。 And if I ask you, you will not answer.
69. 但從今以後，人子要坐在全能神的右邊。」 But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the Power of God."
70. 他們都說：「那麼，你是神的兒子嗎？」 耶穌對他們說： 「是你們說的，我就是。」 They all asked, "Are You, then, the Son of God?" And He said to them, "You say that I am."
71. 他們說：「難道我們還需要什麼證據嗎？他親口說的話，我們都親耳聽見了 。」 "Why do we need any more testimony," they said, "since we've heard it ourselves from His mouth?"
Luke 23
1. 於是他們全體民眾就起來，把耶穌帶到 彼拉多 面前， Then their whole assembly rose up and brought Him before Pilate.
2. 開始控告耶穌，說：「我們發現這個人在敗壞我們的同胞，阻止納稅給凱撒，還自稱是基督、是王。」 They began to accuse Him, saying, "We found this man subverting our nation, opposing payment of taxes to Caesar, and saying that He Himself is the Messiah, a King."
3. 彼拉多 問耶穌：「你是 猶太 人的王嗎？」 耶穌回答說： 「是你說的。」 So Pilate asked Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered him, "You have said it."
4. 彼拉多 對祭司長們和眾人說：「我查不出這個人有什麼罪。」 Pilate then told the chief priests and the crowds, "I find no grounds for charging this man."
5. 他們卻更加堅持說：「他在 猶太 全地教導、煽動民眾，從 加利利 開始，一直到這裡。」 But they kept insisting, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, from Galilee where He started even to here."
6. 彼拉多 聽了，就問：「這人是不是 加利利 人？」 When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
7. 當他了解耶穌屬於 希律 管轄，就把他送到 希律 那裡。在那些日子裡， 希律 正好也在 耶路撒冷 。 Finding that He was under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
8. 希律 見到耶穌就極其歡喜，因為他聽說過耶穌的事，早就想要見他，一直希望看他行個神蹟。 Herod was very glad to see Jesus; for a long time he had wanted to see Him, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see some miracle performed by Him.
9. 於是他問了耶穌許多話，但是耶穌什麼都不回答。 So he kept asking Him questions, but Jesus did not answer him.
10. 祭司長們和經文士們都站在那裡，極力控告他。 The chief priests and the scribes stood by, vehemently accusing Him.
11. 希律 和他的軍兵就藐視耶穌，戲弄他，給他披上華麗的衣服，然後把他送回 彼拉多 那裡。 Then Herod, with his soldiers, treated Him with contempt, mocked Him, dressed Him in a brilliant robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.
12. 在這一天， 希律 和 彼拉多 竟互相成了朋友；原來他們兩個人一向是彼此有仇的。 That very day Herod and Pilate became friends. Previously, they had been hostile toward each other.
13. 彼拉多 召集了祭司長們、首領們和民眾， Pilate called together the chief priests, the leaders, and the people,
14. 對他們說：「你們把這個人帶到我這裡來，說他是誤導民眾造反的。看，我已經當著你們的面審問了他，在他身上卻一點也查不出你們所控告的罪。 and said to them, "You have brought me this man as one who subverts the people. But in fact, after examining Him in your presence, I have found no grounds to charge this man with those things you accuse Him of.
15. 其實 希律 也查不出來，所以把他送回給我們。看，他沒有做過什麼該死的事。 Neither has Herod, because he sent Him back to us. Clearly, He has done nothing to deserve death.
16. 因此，懲罰了以後，我要釋放他。」 Therefore I will have Him whipped and [then] release Him."
17. 每逢這節日，總督必須給他們釋放一個囚犯。 [[For according to the festival he had to release someone to them.]]
18. 他們卻一齊喊叫說：「除掉這個人！給我們釋放 巴拉巴 ！」 Then they all cried out together, "Take this man away! Release Barabbas to us!"
19. 這 巴拉巴 是因為在城裡發生的一個暴亂和殺人案，被投進監獄的。 (He had been thrown into prison for a rebellion that had taken place in the city, and for murder.)
20. 彼拉多 想要釋放耶穌，就再次向他們呼籲。 Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, addressed them again,
21. 但他們卻一直喊叫說：「釘上十字架！把他釘上十字架！」 but they kept shouting, "Crucify! Crucify Him!"
22. 彼拉多 第三次對他們說：「這個人到底做了什麼惡事呢？我查不出他有什麼該死的罪。所以，懲罰了以後，我要釋放他！」 A third time he said to them, "Why? What has this man done wrong? I have found in Him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have Him whipped and [then] release Him."
23. 他們催逼 彼拉多，大聲要求把耶穌釘上十字架，他們 的喊聲終於 得勝了。 But they kept up the pressure, demanding with loud voices that He be crucified. And their voices won out.
24. 於是， 彼拉多 決定成全他們所求的， So Pilate decided to grant their demand
25. 釋放了他們所要的那個因暴亂和殺人被投進監獄的人，卻隨他們的意思，把耶穌交出去。 and released the one they were asking for, who had been thrown into prison for rebellion and murder. But he handed Jesus over to their will.
26. 他們把耶穌帶走的時候，抓了一個從鄉下來的 古利奈 人 西門，把十字架放在他身上，要他背著，跟在耶穌後面。 As they led Him away, they seized Simon, a Cyrenian, who was coming in from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
27. 有一大群人跟著耶穌，其中有些婦女為他捶胸哀哭。 A great multitude of the people followed Him, including women who were mourning and lamenting Him.
28. 耶穌轉過身來，對她們說： 「 耶路撒冷 的女兒啊，不要為我哭，而要為你們自己、為你們的兒女哭！ But turning to them, Jesus said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and your children.
29. 看，日子將要來到，那時人們會說：『不能生育、沒有懷過胎和沒有乳養過嬰兒的，是蒙福的！』 Look, the days are coming when they will say, 'Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed!'
30. 那時人們將開始 對山嶺說：『倒在我們身上吧！』對丘陵說：『遮蓋我們吧！』 Then they will begin to say to the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and to the hills, 'Cover us!'
31. 他們在樹木青綠的時候尚且做這些事，那麼在它枯萎的時候，還會發生什麼呢？」 For if they do these things when the wood is green, what will happen when it is dry?"
32. 另有兩個囚犯也和耶穌一起被帶去處死。 Two others-- criminals-- were also led away to be executed with Him.
33. 當他們來到一個地方，叫做「骷髏」，就在那裡把耶穌釘上十字架，又釘了那兩個囚犯，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。 When they arrived at the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on the right and one on the left.
34. 那時，耶穌說： 「父啊，赦免他們！因為他們不知道自己在做什麼。」 士兵們 抽籤分了他的衣服。 [[Then Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, because they do not know what they are doing."]] And they divided His clothes and cast lots.
35. 民眾站著觀看。首領們也譏笑，說：「他救了別人！如果這個人是神的基督，是蒙揀選的那一位，讓他救自己吧！」 The people stood watching, and even the leaders kept scoffing: "He saved others; let Him save Himself if this is God's Messiah, the Chosen One!"
36. 士兵們也上前來戲弄他，給他獻上酸酒， The soldiers also mocked Him. They came offering Him sour wine
37. 說：「你如果是 猶太 人的王，救救你自己吧！」 and said, "If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself!"
38. 在耶穌的上方有一個牌子 ：「這是 猶太 人的王。」 An inscription was above Him: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS
39. 被懸掛的兩個囚犯中，有一個辱罵他說：「你不是基督嗎？救救你自己，也救救我們吧！」 Then one of the criminals hanging there began to yell insults at Him: "Aren't You the Messiah? Save Yourself and us!"
40. 另一個就應聲斥責他，說：「你既然同樣受懲罰，還不怕神嗎？ But the other answered, rebuking him: "Don't you even fear God, since you are undergoing the same punishment?
41. 我們受刑 理所應當，因為我們所受的與我們所做的相稱。但這個人卻沒有做過什麼壞事。」 We are punished justly, because we're getting back what we deserve for the things we did, but this man has done nothing wrong."
42. 他接著說：「耶穌啊， 你進了你國度的時候，求你記念我。」 Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!"
43. 耶穌 對他說： 「我確實地告訴你：今天你要與我一起在樂園裡了。」 And He said to him, "I assure you: Today you will be with Me in paradise."
44. 那時大約是中午十二點，黑暗籠罩了整個大地，一直到下午三點 。 It was now about noon, and darkness came over the whole land until three,
45. 太陽失去了光，同時，聖所裡的幔子裂成兩半。 because the sun's light failed. The curtain of the sanctuary was split down the middle.
46. 耶穌大聲呼喚： 「父啊， 我把我的靈魂交託在你手中。 」 說完這話，就斷了氣。 And Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Father, into Your hands I entrust My spirit. " Saying this, He breathed His last.
47. 百夫長看見所發生的事，就不住地榮耀神，說：「這個人的確是義人。」 When the centurion saw what happened, he began to glorify God, saying, "This man really was righteous!"
48. 所有聚集見這場面的眾人，看到所發生的事，都捶著胸回去了。 All the crowds that had gathered for this spectacle, when they saw what had taken place, went home, striking their chests.
49. 所有熟悉耶穌的人，包括那些從 加利利 一直跟著他來的婦女，都站在遠處看這些事。 But all who knew Him, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
50. 當時，有一個名叫 約瑟 的人，是 猶太 議會中的議員，為人公義良善。 There was a good and righteous man named Joseph, a member of the Sanhedrin,
51. 這個人並沒有贊同他們的計劃和行為；他是 猶太 的 亞利馬太 城的人，一直期待著神的國。 who had not agreed with their plan and action. He was from Arimathea, a Judean town, and was looking forward to the kingdom of God.
52. 他來到 彼拉多 面前，請求要耶穌的遺體。 He approached Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.
53. 他把遺體取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在一座岩石鑿成的墓穴裡，那裡從來沒有安放過人。 Taking it down, he wrapped it in fine linen and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had ever been placed.
54. 那天是預備日，安息日快要到了 。 It was preparation day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
55. 那些從 加利利 陪耶穌一起來的婦女跟在後面。她們看到了那墓穴，也看到了耶穌的遺體怎樣被安放， The women who had come with Him from Galilee followed along and observed the tomb and how His body was placed.
56. 就回去預備香料和香液。不過在安息日，她們還是按照誡命休息了。 Then they returned and prepared spices and perfumes. And they rested on the Sabbath according to the commandment.
Luke 24
1. 在一週的頭一天，一大清早，婦女們 帶著預備好的香料來到墓穴那裡， On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.
2. 發現那石頭已經從墓穴被滾開了。 They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
3. 她們就進去，卻找不到主耶穌的遺體。 They went in but did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
4. 她們正為這件事心裡困惑的時候，忽然有兩個人，身穿閃閃發光的衣服，站在她們旁邊。 While they were perplexed about this, suddenly two men stood by them in dazzling clothes.
5. 婦女們嚇得把臉伏在地上。 那兩個人對她們說：「你們為什麼在死人中尋找活人呢？ So the women were terrified and bowed down to the ground. "Why are you looking for the living among the dead?" asked the men.
6. 他不在這裡，已經復活 了！你們當想起他還在 加利利 的時候怎樣告訴你們， "He is not here, but He has been resurrected! Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,
7. 說 『人子必須被交在 罪人手中，被釘十字架，然後在第三天復活。』」 saying, 'The Son of Man must be betrayed into the hands of sinful men, be crucified, and rise on the third day'?"
8. 她們就想起耶穌的話來。 And they remembered His words.
9. 於是從墓穴回去，把這一切都告訴了那十一個使徒和所有其他的人。 Returning from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the rest.
10. 告訴使徒們這些事的，是 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 、 約亞娜 、 雅各 的母親 瑪麗亞，還有其餘和她們在一起的婦女。 Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them were telling the apostles these things.
11. 可是這些話在使徒們看來似乎是胡說，他們就不相信婦女們。 But these words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
12. 但 彼得 卻起來，跑到了墓穴。他彎腰去看，只看見那細麻布條 。於是他就回去了，對所發生的事感到驚奇。 Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. When he stooped to look in, he saw only the linen cloths. So he went home, amazed at what had happened.
13. 正好在同一天，門徒中有兩個人往一個村子去；這村子名叫 以馬忤斯，離 耶路撒冷 約有十一公里 。 Now that same day two of them were on their way to a village called Emmaus, which was about seven miles from Jerusalem.
14. 他們彼此談論著所發生的這一切事。 Together they were discussing everything that had taken place.
15. 在他們交談討論的時候，耶穌親自走近他們，與他們同行， And while they were discussing and arguing, Jesus Himself came near and began to walk along with them.
16. 但是他們的眼睛被遮蔽了，認不出他來。 But they were prevented from recognizing Him.
17. 耶穌問他們： 「你們一路上彼此談論的這些，到底是什麼事呢？」 他們就停住，面帶愁容。 Then He asked them, "What is this dispute that you're having with each other as you are walking?" And they stopped [walking and looked] discouraged.
18. 其中一個名叫 克利奧帕 的回答耶穌，說：「你在 耶路撒冷 作客，難道只有你還不知道這幾天在那裡所發生的事嗎？」 The one named Cleopas answered Him, "Are You the only visitor in Jerusalem who doesn't know the things that happened there in these days?"
19. 耶穌問他們： 「什麼事呢？」 他們對他說：「就是有關 拿撒勒 人耶穌的事。這個人是一位先知，在神和全體民眾面前說話行事都有能力。 "What things?" He asked them. So they said to Him, "The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a Prophet powerful in action and speech before God and all the people,
20. 我們的祭司長們和首領們竟把他交出去，判了死罪，釘上十字架。 and how our chief priests and leaders handed Him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified Him.
21. 不過我們一直希望他就是要救贖 以色列 的那一位。不但如此，從這些事發生到今天，已經是第三天了。 But we were hoping that He was the One who was about to redeem Israel. Besides all this, it's the third day since these things happened.
22. 還有，我們中間有些婦女也使我們驚訝：她們清早到了墓穴， Moreover, some women from our group astounded us. They arrived early at the tomb,
23. 卻找不到他的遺體，回來還說她們看到了天使的異象，而天使說耶穌還活著。 and when they didn't find His body, they came and reported that they had seen a vision of angels who said He was alive.
24. 後來，與我們在一起的一些人，到墓穴那裡去，發現一切就像婦女們所說的那樣。只是他們沒有看見耶穌。」 Some of those who were with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but they didn't see Him."
25. 耶穌對他們說： 「唉，你們這些無知的人哪！對於信靠先知們所說的一切話，你們的心太遲鈍了！ He said to them, "How unwise and slow you are to believe in your hearts all that the prophets have spoken!
26. 基督不是必須這樣受難，然後才進入他的榮耀嗎？」 Didn't the Messiah have to suffer these things and enter into His glory?"
27. 於是耶穌從 摩西 和所有的先知開始，向他們解釋了經上一切關於自己的話。 Then beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He interpreted for them the things concerning Himself in all the Scriptures.
28. 他們快到要去的村子了，耶穌好像還要往前走。 They came near the village where they were going, and He gave the impression that He was going farther.
29. 他們就極力挽留他，說：「時候晚了，太陽已經平西了，請與我們一起住下吧！」耶穌就進去，與他們一起住下。 But they urged Him: "Stay with us, because it's almost evening, and now the day is almost over." So He went in to stay with them.
30. 當耶穌與他們一同坐席的時候，他拿起餅來，祝福了，然後掰開遞給他們。 It was as He reclined at the table with them that He took the bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.
31. 那時他們的眼睛就開了，這才認出他來，而耶穌從他們眼前消失了。 Then their eyes were opened, and they recognized Him, but He disappeared from their sight.
32. 他們彼此說：「在路上他對我們說話，為我們講解經文的時候，我們心裡不是在燃燒嗎？」 So they said to each other, "Weren't our hearts ablaze within us while He was talking with us on the road and explaining the Scriptures to us?"
33. 他們就立刻起身，回 耶路撒冷 去，見到那十一個使徒和與他們聚集在一起的人， That very hour they got up and returned to Jerusalem. They found the Eleven and those with them gathered together,
34. 大家都在說：「主真的復活了，並且已經向 西門 顯現了！」 who said, "The Lord has certainly been raised, and has appeared to Simon!"
35. 兩個人就把在路上所發生的，以及耶穌掰餅的時候怎樣被他們認出來的事，都述說了一遍。 Then they began to describe what had happened on the road and how He was made known to them in the breaking of the bread.
36. 在他們說這些話的時候，耶穌 親自站在他們當中，對他們說： 「願你們平安！」 And as they were saying these things, He Himself stood among them. He said to them, "Peace to you!"
37. 他們就驚慌，感到害怕，以為看到了幽靈。 But they were startled and terrified and thought they were seeing a ghost.
38. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們為什麼驚慌不安？為什麼心裡起疑惑呢？ "Why are you troubled?" He asked them. "And why do doubts arise in your hearts?
39. 你們看我的手、我的腳，確實是我。摸我看看！幽靈沒有骨，也沒有肉，你們看，我是有的。」 Look at My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself! Touch Me and see, because a ghost does not have flesh and bones as you can see I have."
40. 說了這話，他就把手和腳給他們看。 Having said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
41. 他們又驚又喜，還不敢相信的時候，耶穌對他們說： 「你們這裡有什麼吃的嗎？」 But while they still could not believe because of [their] joy and were amazed, He asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"
42. 他們遞給他一片烤魚， So they gave Him a piece of a broiled fish,
43. 他拿過來，當著他們的面吃了。 and He took it and ate in their presence.
44. 耶穌對他們說： 「這就是我還與你們在一起的時候，對你們說過的話： 摩西 的律法、先知書和詩篇上所記的有關我的一切事，都必須應驗。」 Then He told them, "These are My words that I spoke to you while I was still with you-- that everything written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms must be fulfilled."
45. 於是耶穌開啟他們的理性，使他們能領悟經上的話， Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.
46. 又對他們說： 「經上這樣記著：基督必須 受難，然後在第三天從死人中復活， He also said to them, "This is what is written: the Messiah would suffer and rise from the dead the third day,
47. 並且人要奉他的名宣講為罪得赦免的悔改，從 耶路撒冷 開始，直到萬國。 and repentance for forgiveness of sins would be proclaimed in His name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
48. 你們就是這些事的見證人。 You are witnesses of these things.
49. 看哪！我要將我父所應許的差派到你們那裡 。不過你們要留在城 裡，直到領受 了從上面 來的能力。」 And look, I am sending you what My Father promised. As for you, stay in the city until you are empowered from on high."
50. 耶穌領他們出去，到了 伯大尼 附近，就舉起雙手祝福他們。 Then He led them out as far as Bethany, and lifting up His hands He blessed them.
51. 他在祝福的時候離開他們，被接到天上去了 。 And while He was blessing them, He left them and was carried up into heaven.
52. 他們就敬拜他，懷著極大的喜樂回 耶路撒冷 去， After worshiping Him, they returned to Jerusalem with great joy.
53. 常常在聖殿裡頌讚 神。 And they were continually in the temple complex blessing God.
John
John 1
1. 太初有道， 道與神同在， 道就是神。 In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
2. 這道太初與神同在。 He was with God in the beginning.
3. 萬有是藉著他而成的； 凡所成的， 沒有一樣不是藉著他而成的。 All things were created through Him, and apart from Him not one thing was created that has been created.
4. 生命在他裡面， 這生命就是人的光。 Life was in Him, and that life was the light of men.
5. 這光在黑暗中照耀， 黑暗卻沒有勝過 這光。 That light shines in the darkness, yet the darkness did not overcome it.
6. 有一個人受神的差派而來， 他名叫 約翰 。 There was a man named John who was sent from God.
7. 他為見證而來， 是要為這光做見證， 好讓人都藉著他相信。 He came as a witness to testify about the light, so that all might believe through him.
8. 他不是這光， 而是要為這光做見證。 He was not the light, but he came to testify about the light.
9. 這光是真光， 來到這世界照亮每個人。 The true light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
10. 他在這世界， 世界也是藉著他而成的， 世界卻不認識他。 He was in the world, and the world was created through Him, yet the world did not recognize Him.
11. 他來到自己的地方， 自己的人卻不接受他。 He came to His own, and His own people did not receive Him.
12. 但是所有接受他的， 就是信他名的人， 他就賜給他們權柄成為神的兒女。 But to all who did receive Him, He gave them the right to be children of God, to those who believe in His name,
13. 他們不是由血緣、 或肉體的意願、 或人的意志所生的， 而是由神所生的。 who were born, not of blood, or of the will of the flesh, or of the will of man, but of God.
14. 道成了肉身， 居住在我們中間。 我們看到了他的榮耀， 正是從父而來的獨生子的榮耀， 充滿了恩典和真理。 The Word became flesh and took up residence among us. We observed His glory, the glory as the One and Only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
15. 約翰 為他做見證，呼喊說： 「這一位就是我曾說過的， 『那在我之後來的，已成為在我前面的， 因為他在我之前就已經存在。』」 (John testified concerning Him and exclaimed, "This was the One of whom I said, 'The One coming after me has surpassed me, because He existed before me.' ")
16. 原來從他的豐盛完美中， 我們都領受了恩典，而且恩上加恩。 Indeed, we have all received grace after grace from His fullness,
17. 因為律法是藉著 摩西 賜下的， 恩典和真理是藉著耶穌基督而來的。 for although the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
18. 從來沒有人看見神， 只有在父懷裡的那位獨生子——神， 他將神表明了出來。 No one has ever seen God. The One and Only Son-- the One who is at the Father's side-- He has revealed Him.
19. 以下是 約翰 的見證。那時候， 耶路撒冷 的那些 猶太 人派了一些祭司和 利未 人到 約翰 那裡去問他：「你是誰？」 This is John's testimony when the Jews from Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, "Who are you?"
20. 他就承認，並毫不否認地告白：「我不是基督。」 He did not refuse to answer, but he declared: "I am not the Messiah."
21. 他們又問：「那麼你是誰呢？是 以利亞 嗎？」 他說：「我不是。」 「是那位先知 嗎？」 他回答：「不是。」 "What then?" they asked him. "Are you Elijah?" "I am not," he said. "Are you the Prophet?" "No," he answered.
22. 於是他們問：「你到底是誰？好讓我們給那些派我們來的人一個答覆。你自己說，你是什麼人？」 "Who are you, then?" they asked. "We need to give an answer to those who sent us. What can you tell us about yourself?"
23. 約翰 說：「正如先知 以賽亞 所說的，我就是 在曠野裡呼喊的聲音：『你們當修直 主的道 。』 」 He said, "I am a voice of one crying out in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord-- just as Isaiah the prophet said."
24. 那些被派來的人屬於 法利賽 人， Now they had been sent from the Pharisees.
25. 他們又問 約翰 ：「你既不是基督，又不是 以利亞，也不是那位先知，那麼，你為什麼施洗呢？」 So they asked him, "Why then do you baptize if you aren't the Messiah, or Elijah, or the Prophet?"
26. 約翰 回答說：「我用水 施洗，但有一位站在你們中間，是你們不認識的， "I baptize with water," John answered them. "Someone stands among you, but you don't know [Him].
27. 他是那在我之後來的， 我就是為他解鞋帶也不配。」 He is the One coming after me, whose sandal strap I'm not worthy to untie."
28. 這些事發生在 約旦 河對岸的 伯大尼，就是 約翰 施洗的地方。 All this happened in Bethany across the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
29. 第二天， 約翰 看見耶穌向他走來，就說：「看哪，神的羔羊，除去世人罪孽的！ The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Here is the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
30. 這一位就是我所說的『那在我之後來的人，已成為在我前面的，因為在我之前他就存在了。』 This is the One I told you about: 'After me comes a man who has surpassed me, because He existed before me.'
31. 我以前也不認識他，但為了讓他向 以色列 顯明，所以我來用水施洗。」 I didn't know Him, but I came baptizing with water so He might be revealed to Israel."
32. 約翰 又見證說：「我看到聖靈好像鴿子從天上降臨，停留在他身上。 And John testified, "I watched the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and He rested on Him.
33. 我以前也不認識他，可是那派我用水施洗的對我說：『如果你看見聖靈降臨在誰身上，又停留在誰身上，誰就是用聖靈施洗的那一位。』 I didn't know Him, but He who sent me to baptize with water told me, 'The One you see the Spirit descending and resting on-- He is the One who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.'
34. 我看到了，就見證：這一位就是神的兒子 。」 I have seen and testified that He is the Son of God!"
35. 過了一天， 約翰 和他的兩個門徒又站在那裡。 Again the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples.
36. 約翰 看著耶穌走過，就說：「看哪，神的羔羊！」 When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look! The Lamb of God!"
37. 那兩個門徒聽他說話，就跟從了耶穌。 The two disciples heard him say this and followed Jesus.
38. 耶穌轉過身來，看到他們跟著走，就問： 「你們尋找什麼呢？」 他們對耶穌說：「拉比，你住在哪裡呢？」——「拉比」翻譯出來意思是「老師」。 When Jesus turned and noticed them following Him, He asked them, "What are you looking for?" They said to Him, "Rabbi" (which means "Teacher"), "where are You staying?"
39. 耶穌說： 「你們來看吧！」 他們去了，看見耶穌住的地方，那天就住在他那裡。那時大約是下午四點 。 "Come and you'll see," He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and they stayed with Him that day. It was about 10 in the morning.
40. 聽見了 約翰 的話而跟從耶穌的兩個人中，有一個是 西門彼得 的弟弟 安得烈 。 Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two who heard John and followed Him.
41. 安得烈 先去找自己的哥哥 西門，對他說：「我們找到了彌賽亞。」——「彌賽亞」翻譯出來就是「基督」。 He first found his own brother Simon and told him, "We have found the Messiah!" (which means "Anointed One"),
42. 他就帶 西門 到耶穌那裡。 耶穌注視著他，說： 「你是 約翰 的兒子，你將被稱為 磯法 。」 ——「 磯法 」翻譯出來就是「 彼得 」。 and he brought [Simon] to Jesus. When Jesus saw him, He said, "You are Simon, son of John. You will be called Cephas" (which means "Rock").
43. 又過了一天，耶穌決定前往 加利利 地區。他找到 腓力，對他說： 「你跟從我！」 The next day He decided to leave for Galilee. Jesus found Philip and told him, "Follow Me!"
44. 腓力 來自 伯賽達，與 安得烈 和 彼得 同鄉。 Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the hometown of Andrew and Peter.
45. 腓力 找到 拿旦業，對他說：「我們發現了 摩西 在律法上所寫的，和先知們所記的那一位。他就是 約瑟 的兒子， 拿撒勒 人耶穌。」 Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the One Moses wrote about in the law (and so did the prophets): Jesus the son of Joseph, from Nazareth!"
46. 拿旦業 對他說：「 拿撒勒 還能出什麼好的嗎？」 腓力 說：「你來看吧！」 "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" Nathanael asked him. "Come and see," Philip answered.
47. 耶穌看見 拿旦業 向他走來，就指著他說： 「看，一個真正的 以色列 人！他裡面沒有詭詐。」 Then Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him and said about him, "Here is a true Israelite; no deceit is in him."
48. 拿旦業 對耶穌說：「你怎麼知道我呢？」 耶穌回答說： 「 腓力 叫你以前，你還在無花果樹下，我就看見你了。」 "How do you know me?" Nathanael asked. "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you," Jesus answered.
49. 拿旦業 說：「拉比，你是神的兒子，你是 以色列 的王！」 "Rabbi," Nathanael replied, "You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"
50. 耶穌對他說： 「因為我說『我看見你在無花果樹下』，你就信嗎？你將會看到比這更大的事。」 Jesus responded to him, "Do you believe [only] because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than this."
51. 耶穌又對他說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：你們將會看見天敞開了，神的天使們在人子上頭，上去下來。」 Then He said, "I assure you: You will see heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."
John 2
1. 第三天，在 加利利 的 迦拿 有一個婚宴。耶穌的母親在那裡， On the third day a wedding took place in Cana of Galilee. Jesus' mother was there, and
2. 耶穌和他的門徒們也被邀請赴宴。 Jesus and His disciples were invited to the wedding as well.
3. 酒用盡了，耶穌的母親對他說：「他們沒有酒了。」 When the wine ran out, Jesus' mother told Him, "They don't have any wine."
4. 耶穌對她說： 「母親，這與你我有什麼關係？我的時候還沒有到。」 "What has this concern of yours to do with Me, woman?" Jesus asked. "My hour has not yet come."
5. 他的母親對僕人們說：「他吩咐你們什麼，你們就做什麼。」 "Do whatever He tells you," His mother told the servants.
6. 照 猶太 人潔淨的規矩，有六口石缸擺在那裡。每缸可容兩三桶 水。 Now six stone water jars had been set there for Jewish purification. Each contained 20 or 30 gallons.
7. 耶穌對僕人們說： 「把這些缸裝滿水。」 他們就裝滿了，直到缸沿。 "Fill the jars with water," Jesus told them. So they filled them to the brim.
8. 耶穌又對他們說： 「現在舀出來，送去給管宴席的。」 他們就送去了。 Then He said to them, "Now draw some out and take it to the chief servant." And they did.
9. 當管宴席的嘗了那水變的酒，並不知道這是從哪裡來的，只有舀水的那些僕人知道。管宴席的就叫來新郎， When the chief servant tasted the water (after it had become wine), he did not know where it came from-- though the servants who had drawn the water knew. He called the groom
10. 對他說：「人人都是先擺上好酒，等賓客喝醉了，才擺上次等的。你卻把好酒留到現在！」 and told him, "Everybody sets out the fine wine first, then, after people have drunk freely, the inferior. But you have kept the fine wine until now."
11. 耶穌在 加利利 的 迦拿 行了這頭一件神蹟，顯明了他的榮耀，他的門徒們就信了他。 Jesus performed this first sign in Cana of Galilee. He displayed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
12. 這事以後，耶穌和他的母親、兄弟以及他的門徒們，都下到 迦百農 去，在那裡住了幾天。 After this, He went down to Capernaum, together with His mother, His brothers, and His disciples, and they stayed there only a few days.
13. 猶太 人的逾越節快到了，耶穌上 耶路撒冷 去。 The Jewish Passover was near, so Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
14. 他看見聖殿裡有賣牛、羊、鴿子的，還有兌換銀幣的人坐在那裡。 In the temple complex He found people selling oxen, sheep, and doves, and [He also found] the money changers sitting there.
15. 耶穌就用繩子做了一條鞭子，把所有的牛、羊都從聖殿裡趕出去，倒出兌換銀幣之人的銀幣，並推翻了他們的桌子， After making a whip out of cords, He drove everyone out of the temple complex with their sheep and oxen. He also poured out the money changers' coins and overturned the tables.
16. 又對賣鴿子的人說： 「把這些東西從這裡拿走！不要把我父的殿當成做買賣的地方！」 He told those who were selling doves, "Get these things out of here! Stop turning My Father's house into a marketplace!"
17. 他的門徒們就想起經上記著： 「我為你的殿，心火焚燒。」 And His disciples remembered that it is written: Zeal for Your house will consume Me.
18. 於是那些 猶太 人問耶穌說：「你做這些事，有什麼權柄的 憑據給我們看呢？」 So the Jews replied to Him, "What sign [of authority] will You show us for doing these things?"
19. 耶穌回答說： 「你們把這聖所毀了吧！三天內我要把它建起來。」 Jesus answered, "Destroy this sanctuary, and I will raise it up in three days."
20. 那些 猶太 人說：「這聖所建了四十六年，而你能在三天內把它建起來嗎？」 Therefore the Jews said, "This sanctuary took 46 years to build, and will You raise it up in three days?"
21. 其實耶穌所說的聖所，就是指他自己的身體。 But He was speaking about the sanctuary of His body.
22. 當他從死人中復活以後，他的門徒們才想起他說過這話，就相信了經上的話和耶穌所說的話。 So when He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. And they believed the Scripture and the statement Jesus had made.
23. 當耶穌在 耶路撒冷 過逾越節的時候，許多人看見他所行的這些神蹟，就信了他的名。 While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many trusted in His name when they saw the signs He was doing.
24. 但耶穌自己卻信不過他們，因為他了解所有的人。 Jesus, however, would not entrust Himself to them, since He knew them all
25. 他也不需要誰來見證人的事，因為他知道人裡面是什麼。 and because He did not need anyone to testify about man; for He Himself knew what was in man.
John 3
1. 有一個人，屬於 法利賽 人，名叫 尼克迪莫，是 猶太 人的一位首領。 There was a man from the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
2. 他夜裡來到耶穌那裡，說：「拉比，我們知道你是從神那裡來的老師，因為你所行的這些神蹟，如果沒有神的同在，沒有人能做得到。」 This man came to Him at night and said, "Rabbi, we know that You have come from God as a teacher, for no one could perform these signs You do unless God were with him."
3. 耶穌回答說： 「我確確實實地告訴你：一個人如果不重生，就不能見神的國。」 Jesus replied, "I assure you: Unless someone is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God."
4. 尼克迪莫 問：「人老了，怎麼能出生呢？他難道能再進母腹又出生嗎？」 "But how can anyone be born when he is old?" Nicodemus asked Him. "Can he enter his mother's womb a second time and be born?"
5. 耶穌回答： 「我確確實實地告訴你：一個人如果不是由水和聖靈所生的，就不能進入神的國。 Jesus answered, "I assure you: Unless someone is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
6. 由肉體所生的，就是肉體；由聖靈所生的，就是靈。 Whatever is born of the flesh is flesh, and whatever is born of the Spirit is spirit.
7. 我說『你們必須重生 』，你不要感到驚奇。 Do not be amazed that I told you that you must be born again.
8. 風 隨意而吹，你聽見風聲，卻不知道它從哪裡來，往哪裡去。所有由聖靈所生的，也是這樣。」 The wind blows where it pleases, and you hear its sound, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit."
9. 尼克迪莫 又問：「怎麼能有這些事呢？」 "How can these things be?" asked Nicodemus.
10. 耶穌回答說： 「你是 以色列 的老師，還不明白這些事嗎？ "Are you a teacher of Israel and don't know these things?" Jesus replied.
11. 我確確實實地告訴你：我們講論我們所知道的，我們見證我們所看到的，而你們卻不接受我們的見證。 "I assure you: We speak what We know and We testify to what We have seen, but you do not accept Our testimony.
12. 我告訴你們地上的事，你們尚且不信，如果我告訴你們天上的事，你們怎麼會信呢？ If I have told you about things that happen on earth and you don't believe, how will you believe if I tell you about things of heaven?
13. 除了從天上降下來的人子， 沒有人升過天。 No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven-- the Son of Man.
14. 摩西 在曠野怎樣把銅蛇舉起，人子也必須照樣被舉起來， Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
15. 好使所有相信他的人，都得到永恆的生命。 so that everyone who believes in Him will have eternal life.
16. 「神愛世人，甚至賜下他的獨生子，好讓所有信他的人不至於滅亡，反得永恆的生命， "For God loved the world in this way: He gave His One and Only Son, so that everyone who believes in Him will not perish but have eternal life.
17. 因為神差派他的 兒子來到世上，不是為了定世人的罪，而是為了世人藉著他得救。 For God did not send His Son into the world that He might judge the world, but that the world might be saved through Him.
18. 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，已經被定罪了，因為他不信神獨生子的名。 Anyone who believes in Him is not judged, but anyone who does not believe is already judged, because he has not believed in the name of the One and Only Son of God.
19. 「所定的罪是這樣的：光來到了世界，人們卻因自己的行為邪惡，不喜愛光，反喜愛黑暗。 "This, then, is the judgment: the light has come into the world, and people loved darkness rather than the light because their deeds were evil.
20. 事實上，所有作惡的人，都憎恨光，不來到光那裡，免得自己的行為被揭露出來； For everyone who practices wicked things hates the light and avoids it, so that his deeds may not be exposed.
21. 但行真理的人，卻來到光那裡，為了顯明自己所做的是在神裡面被做成的。」 But anyone who lives by the truth comes to the light, so that his works may be shown to be accomplished by God."
22. 這些事以後，耶穌和他的門徒們來到 猶太 地區，住在那裡，並且給人施洗。 After this, Jesus and His disciples went to the Judean countryside, where He spent time with them and baptized.
23. 約翰 也在 撒令 附近的 艾嫩 施洗，因為那裡水多。眾人紛紛而來受洗。 John also was baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water there. People were coming and being baptized,
24. 原來， 約翰 那時候還沒有被投進監獄。 since John had not yet been thrown into prison.
25. 約翰 的門徒們與一個 猶太 人，為了潔淨禮起了辯論。 Then a dispute arose between John's disciples and a Jew about purification.
26. 他們就到 約翰 那裡，對他說：「拉比，你看，以前與你在 約旦 河對岸的，就是你所見證的那一位，他也在施洗，而且大家都到他那裡去了。」 So they came to John and told him, "Rabbi, the One you testified about, and who was with you across the Jordan, is baptizing-- and everyone is flocking to Him."
27. 約翰 回答說：「如果不是從天上賜下的，人就不能得到什麼。 John responded, "No one can receive a single thing unless it's given to him from heaven.
28. 你們自己可以為我見證：我曾經說過『我不是基督，而是奉差派在他前面的。』 You yourselves can testify that I said, 'I am not the Messiah, but I've been sent ahead of Him.'
29. 迎娶新娘的是新郎。新郎的朋友站在那裡，聽到新郎的聲音，就歡喜快樂。這樣，我這喜樂得以滿足了。 He who has the bride is the groom. But the groom's friend, who stands by and listens for him, rejoices greatly at the groom's voice. So this joy of mine is complete.
30. 他必興旺，我必衰微。」 He must increase, but I must decrease."
31. 那從上面來的，是在萬有之上；那從地而出的，屬於地，而且所說的也屬於地。那從天上來的，是在萬有之上， The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth is earthly and speaks in earthly terms. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
32. 他見證他所看到的、他所聽到的，可是沒有人接受他的見證。 He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
33. 那接受他見證的人，就印證了神是真實的。 The one who has accepted His testimony has affirmed that God is true.
34. 神所差派的那一位，就說神的話語，因為神不靠著量度賜下聖靈。 For God sent Him, and He speaks God's words, since He gives the Spirit without measure.
35. 父愛子，把一切都交在他手裡了。 The Father loves the Son and has given all things into His hands.
36. 信從子的人，就有永恆的生命；但是不肯信從子的人，見不到生命，而且神的震怒也停留在他身上。 The one who believes in the Son has eternal life, but the one who refuses to believe in the Son will not see life; instead, the wrath of God remains on him.
John 4
1. 耶穌 知道， 法利賽 人聽說他收門徒和施洗比 約翰 更多。 When Jesus knew that the Pharisees heard He was making and baptizing more disciples than John
2. 其實不是耶穌親自施洗，而是他的門徒們施洗。 (though Jesus Himself was not baptizing, but His disciples were),
3. 於是耶穌離開 猶太 地區，又前往 加利利 地區。 He left Judea and went again to Galilee.
4. 但他定要經過 撒馬利亞， He had to travel through Samaria,
5. 這樣就來到了 撒馬利亞 的一個城，叫 敘加 。這城靠近 雅各 給他兒子 約瑟 的那塊地， so He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar near the property that Jacob had given his son Joseph.
6. 雅各 井就在那裡。耶穌因旅途勞累，就坐在井邊。那時大約是中午十二點 。 Jacob's well was there, and Jesus, worn out from His journey, sat down at the well. It was about six in the evening.
7. 有一個 撒馬利亞 婦人來打水。耶穌對她說： 「請給我一點水喝。」 A woman of Samaria came to draw water. "Give Me a drink," Jesus said to her,
8. 那時，他的門徒們進城買食物去了。 for His disciples had gone into town to buy food.
9. 撒馬利亞 婦人對他說：「你是 猶太 人，怎麼向我一個 撒馬利亞 婦人要水喝呢？」原來 猶太 人不和 撒馬利亞 人來往。 "How is it that You, a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?" she asked Him. For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.
10. 耶穌回答她，說： 「如果你明白神的恩賜，也知道是誰對你說『給我一點水喝』，你早就求他了，他也把活水給你了。」 Jesus answered, "If you knew the gift of God, and who is saying to you, 'Give Me a drink,' you would ask Him, and He would give you living water."
11. 婦人問：「先生，你沒有打水的器具，井又深，你從哪裡得來那活水呢？ "Sir," said the woman, "You don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. So where do you get this 'living water'?
12. 難道你比我們的先祖 雅各 更大嗎？他給我們留下了這口井。他自己、他的子孫、他的牲畜都喝這井裡的水！」 You aren't greater than our father Jacob, are you? He gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and livestock."
13. 耶穌回答說： 「所有喝這水的人，還會再渴。 Jesus said, "Everyone who drinks from this water will get thirsty again.
14. 但如果有人喝了我給他的水，就絕不乾渴，直到永遠。不但如此，我給他的水將要在他裡面成為泉源，一直湧流到永恆的生命。」 But whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never get thirsty again-- ever! In fact, the water I will give him will become a well of water springing up within him for eternal life."
15. 婦人說：「先生，請給我那水，使我不渴，我也不用到這裡來打水了。」 "Sir," the woman said to Him, "give me this water so I won't get thirsty and come here to draw water."
16. 耶穌說： 「去叫你的丈夫，再回到這裡來。」 "Go call your husband," He told her, "and come back here."
17. 婦人回答說：「我沒有丈夫。」 耶穌說： 「你說你沒有丈夫，這話沒錯。 "I don't have a husband," she answered. "You have correctly said, 'I don't have a husband,' " Jesus said.
18. 其實你已經有過五個丈夫，你現在有的，不是你的丈夫。你說的是真的。」 "For you've had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have said is true."
19. 婦人對他說：「先生，我看出你是先知！ "Sir," the woman replied, "I see that You are a prophet.
20. 我們的祖先在這山上敬拜，而你們卻說敬拜的地方必須在 耶路撒冷 。」 Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, yet you [Jews] say that the place to worship is in Jerusalem."
21. 耶穌說： 「婦人，你當相信我，時候就要到了！那時你們敬拜父，既不在這山上，也不在 耶路撒冷 。 Jesus told her, "Believe Me, woman, an hour is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
22. 你們敬拜你們所不認識的；我們卻敬拜我們所認識的，因為救恩是出自 猶太 人的。 You Samaritans worship what you do not know. We worship what we do know, because salvation is from the Jews.
23. 然而，時候就要到了，現在就是了！那時真正敬拜的人，要在靈裡和真理中敬拜父，因為父就是想要這樣的人來敬拜他。 But an hour is coming, and is now here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth. Yes, the Father wants such people to worship Him.
24. 神是靈，敬拜他的人必須在靈裡和真理中敬拜。」 God is spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth."
25. 婦人說：「我知道那稱為基督的彌賽亞要來。他來的時候，就會把一切都傳講給我們。」 The woman said to Him, "I know that Messiah is coming" (who is called Christ). "When He comes, He will explain everything to us."
26. 耶穌說： 「這和你說話的我，就是那一位。」 "I am [He]," Jesus told her, "the One speaking to you."
27. 正在這時，他的門徒們回來了。他們見耶穌與一個婦人一同說話，就感到驚奇。只是沒有人問「你想要什麼？」或「你為什麼與她說話？」 Just then His disciples arrived, and they were amazed that He was talking with a woman. Yet no one said, "What do You want?" or "Why are You talking with her?"
28. 那婦人放下她的水罐，回到城裡告訴人們說： Then the woman left her water jar, went into town, and told the men,
29. 「你們來看！有個人把我過去所做的一切都說了出來，這個人會不會就是基督呢？」 "Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did! Could this be the Messiah?"
30. 大家就出城，來到耶穌那裡。 They left the town and made their way to Him.
31. 這其間，門徒們勸耶穌說：「拉比，請吃。」 In the meantime the disciples kept urging Him, "Rabbi, eat something."
32. 但耶穌說： 「我有食物吃，是你們所不知道的。」 But He said, "I have food to eat that you don't know about."
33. 門徒彼此問：「難道有人拿東西來給他吃了嗎？」 The disciples said to one another, "Could someone have brought Him something to eat?"
34. 耶穌對他們說： 「我的食物就是遵行那派我來者的旨意，並且完成他的工作。 "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work," Jesus told them.
35. 你們不是說『收割的季節還有四個月才到』嗎？看哪，我告訴你們：舉目向田裡觀望，莊稼已經成熟，可以收割了！ "Don't you say, 'There are still four more months, then comes the harvest'? Listen [to what] I'm telling you: Open your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ready for harvest.
36. 收割的人得酬報，收集果實歸入永恆的生命，好使撒種的和收割的一同快樂。 The reaper is already receiving pay and gathering fruit for eternal life, so the sower and reaper can rejoice together.
37. 實際上，這樣的說法是真實的：『一人撒種，另一個人收割。』 For in this case the saying is true: 'One sows and another reaps.'
38. 我派你們去收你們未曾勞苦的；別人勞苦了，你們也進入了他們的勞苦中。」 I sent you to reap what you didn't labor for; others have labored, and you have benefited from their labor."
39. 當時，那城裡有許多 撒馬利亞 人信了耶穌。這是因為那婦人見證說：「他把我過去所做的一切都說了出來。」 Now many Samaritans from that town believed in Him because of what the woman said when she testified, "He told me everything I ever did."
40. 這樣， 撒馬利亞 人來到耶穌那裡的時候，請求他住在他們那裡。於是耶穌在那裡住了兩天。 Therefore, when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed there two days.
41. 後來，因著耶穌的話，信的人就更多了。 Many more believed because of what He said.
42. 他們告訴那婦人說：「現在我們信，不再是因為你的話，而是因為我們親耳聽到了，並且知道這一位真是世界的救主 。」 And they told the woman, "We no longer believe because of what you said, for we have heard for ourselves and know that this really is the Savior of the world."
43. 兩天後，耶穌離開了那裡，前往 加利利 地區。 After two days He left there for Galilee.
44. 他曾親自見證說，先知在自己的家鄉得不到尊敬。 Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
45. 當耶穌來到 加利利 地區， 加利利 人就接受他，因為他們也曾經上 耶路撒冷 去過節，看到耶穌節日期間在那裡所行的一切事。 When they entered Galilee, the Galileans welcomed Him because they had seen everything He did in Jerusalem during the festival. For they also had gone to the festival.
46. 耶穌又來到 加利利 的 迦拿，就是他把水變成酒的地方。有一個大臣，他的兒子在 迦百農 患了病。 Then He went again to Cana of Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. There was a certain royal official whose son was ill at Capernaum.
47. 這個人聽說耶穌從 猶太 來到 加利利，就到耶穌那裡去，請求他下去治癒他的兒子，因為他的兒子快要死了。 When this man heard that Jesus had come from Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and pleaded with Him to come down and heal his son, for he was about to die.
48. 耶穌對他說： 「你們如果沒有看見神蹟和奇事，你們就絕不會信！」 Jesus told him, "Unless you [people] see signs and wonders, you will not believe."
49. 那大臣對耶穌說：「先生，求你在我的孩子還沒有死之前下來吧！」 "Sir," the official said to Him, "come down before my boy dies!"
50. 耶穌對他說： 「你回去吧，你的兒子活了！」 那人相信耶穌的話，就回去了。 "Go," Jesus told him, "your son will live." The man believed what Jesus said to him and departed.
51. 他正下去的時候，他的奴僕們迎著他來，告訴他孩子活了。 While he was still going down, his slaves met him saying that his boy was alive.
52. 他就問孩子好轉的時間，他們說：「昨天下午一點，燒就退了。」 He asked them at what time he got better. "Yesterday at seven in the morning the fever left him," they answered.
53. 這位父親就知道，那正是耶穌說 「你的兒子活了」 的時間。於是他自己和全家人都信了。 The father realized this was the very hour at which Jesus had told him, "Your son will live." Then he himself believed, along with his whole household.
54. 這是耶穌從 猶太 回到 加利利 以後所行的第二件神蹟。 This therefore was the second sign Jesus performed after He came from Judea to Galilee.
John 5
1. 這些事以後， 猶太 人的一個節日到了，耶穌就上 耶路撒冷 去。 After this, a Jewish festival took place, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
2. 在 耶路撒冷 的 羊門 附近有一個池子， 希伯來 語 叫做「 貝示達 」，那裡有五道柱廊。 By the Sheep Gate in Jerusalem there is a pool, called Bethesda in Hebrew, which has five colonnades.
3. 柱廊裡躺著一群患病的，有瞎眼的、瘸腿的、癱瘓的。他們正等著池水動起來， Within these lay a multitude of the sick-- blind, lame, and paralyzed [[-- waiting for the moving of the water,
4. 因為主的天使按時下到池子裡攪動池水。每次水動起來時，第一個下到池子裡的人，無論患什麼病都會痊癒。 because an angel would go down into the pool from time to time and stir up the water. Then the first one who got in after the water was stirred up recovered from whatever ailment he had]].
5. 那裡有一個人，病了三十八年。 One man was there who had been sick for 38 years.
6. 耶穌見這個人躺在那裡，知道他已經病了很久，就問他： 「你想痊癒嗎？」 When Jesus saw him lying there and knew he had already been there a long time, He said to him, "Do you want to get well?"
7. 那個病人回答：「先生，池水被攪動的時候，沒有人把我放進池子裡；而正當我要下去的時候，別人總比我先下去。」 "Sir," the sick man answered, "I don't have a man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I'm coming, someone goes down ahead of me."
8. 耶穌對他說： 「起來，拿起你的墊子走路吧！」 "Get up," Jesus told him, "pick up your bedroll and walk!"
9. 那個人立刻痊癒了，就拿起他的墊子開始走路。 那天是安息日， Instantly the man got well, picked up his bedroll, and started to walk. Now that day was the Sabbath,
10. 所以那些 猶太 人對那得了痊癒的人說：「今天是安息日，你拿著墊子是不可以的！」 so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, "This is the Sabbath! It's illegal for you to pick up your bedroll."
11. 他就回答：「是那個使我痊癒的人對我說『拿起你的墊子走路吧。』」 He replied, "The man who made me well told me, 'Pick up your bedroll and walk.'"
12. 他們問：「對你說『拿起 墊子走路』的那個人是誰？」 "Who is this man who told you, 'Pick up [your bedroll] and walk?' " they asked.
13. 那得了痊癒的人並不知道他是誰，因為那裡有一群人，而耶穌已經抽身離去了。 But the man who was cured did not know who it was, because Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.
14. 這些事以後，耶穌在聖殿裡找到他，對他說： 「看，你已經痊癒了。不要再犯罪，免得更嚴重的事臨到你。」 After this, Jesus found him in the temple complex and said to him, "See, you are well. Do not sin any more, so that something worse doesn't happen to you."
15. 那個人就去向那些 猶太 人報告說，使他痊癒的是耶穌。 The man went and reported to the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
16. 那些 猶太 人之所以逼迫耶穌， 是因為他在安息日做這些事。 Therefore, the Jews began persecuting Jesus because He was doing these things on the Sabbath.
17. 耶穌卻對他們說： 「直到如今，我父在做工，我也在做工。」 But Jesus responded to them, "My Father is still working, and I am working also."
18. 為此，那些 猶太 人更想要殺他，因為他不僅干犯了安息日，還稱神是他的父，把自己當做與神同等的。 This is why the Jews began trying all the more to kill Him: not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
19. 耶穌對他們說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：子憑著自己什麼也不能做，只有看見父所做的，子才能做，因為父所做的事，子也同樣地做。 Then Jesus replied, "I assure you: The Son is not able to do anything on His own, but only what He sees the Father doing. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does these things in the same way.
20. 原來，父喜愛子，把自己所做的一切都給他看，還要把比這些更大的事給他看，使你們感到驚奇。 For the Father loves the Son and shows Him everything He is doing, and He will show Him greater works than these so that you will be amazed.
21. 因為父怎樣使死人復活，賜他們生命，子也照樣按自己的意願賜人生命。 And just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so the Son also gives life to anyone He wants to.
22. 事實上，父並不審判任何人，而把一切審判的事都交給了子， The Father, in fact, judges no one but has given all judgment to the Son,
23. 好使所有的人都尊重子，就像尊重父那樣。不尊重子的，就是不尊重派他來的父。 so that all people will honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Anyone who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
24. 「我確確實實地告訴你們：誰聽我的話，又相信派我來的那一位，誰就有永恆的生命。他不但不被定罪，而且已經出死入生了。 "I assure you: Anyone who hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment but has passed from death to life.
25. 「我確確實實地告訴你們：時候就要到了，現在就是了！當死人聽見神兒子的聲音時，聽到的人就將活了。 "I assure you: An hour is coming, and is now here, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
26. 原來，父怎樣在自己裡面有生命，也照樣使子在自己裡面有生命； For just as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted to the Son to have life in Himself.
27. 並且把審判的權柄交給了他，因為他是人子。 And He has granted Him the right to pass judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
28. 你們不要為此感到驚奇：時候就要到了！那時所有在墳墓裡的人，都會聽到他的聲音， Do not be amazed at this, because a time is coming when all who are in the graves will hear His voice
29. 並且要出來——行善的人復活得生命，作惡的人復活被定罪。 and come out-- those who have done good things, to the resurrection of life, but those who have done wicked things, to the resurrection of judgment.
30. 「我憑自己什麼也不能做。我怎麼聽見，就怎麼審判，而且我的審判是公義的，因為我不求自己的意思，而求那派我來者 的意思。 "I can do nothing on My own. I judge only as I hear, and My judgment is righteous, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
31. 「如果我為自己做見證，我的見證就無效 。 "If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
32. 為我做見證的另有一位，並且我知道，他為我做的見證是有效 的。 There is Another who testifies about Me, and I know that the testimony He gives about Me is valid.
33. 你們曾經派人到 約翰 那裡，他為真理做了見證。 You have sent [messengers] to John, and he has testified to the truth.
34. 其實我所接受的見證不是從人來的。不過我說這些話，是為了要你們得救。 I don't receive man's testimony, but I say these things so that you may be saved.
35. 約翰 是一盞燃燒發光的燈，你們情願在他的光裡快樂一時。 John was a burning and shining lamp, and for a time you were willing to enjoy his light.
36. 「我有比 約翰 更大的見證，因為父交給我工作要我去完成。我現在做的這些工作正為我見證：就是父差派了我。 "But I have a greater testimony than John's because of the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish. These very works I am doing testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
37. 派我來的父也親自為我做了見證。你們從來沒有聽到他的聲音，也沒有看到他的相貌， The Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have not heard His voice at any time, and you haven't seen His form.
38. 更沒有把他的話語 存在你們裡面，因為你們不信他所派來的那一位。 You don't have His word living in you, because you don't believe the One He sent.
39. 你們查考經文，因你們以為從中可以得到永恆的生命。其實這經文就是為我做見證的。 You pore over the Scriptures because you think you have eternal life in them, yet they testify about Me.
40. 可是你們不肯到我這裡來得生命。 And you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.
41. 「我不接受從人而來的榮耀。 "I do not accept glory from men,
42. 不過我了解你們，你們裡面沒有屬神的愛。 but I know you-- that you have no love for God within you.
43. 我奉我父的名來了，你們卻不接受我；如果有別人奉自己的名而來，你們倒會接受他。 I have come in My Father's name, yet you don't accept Me. If someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.
44. 你們彼此接受榮耀，卻不尋求從獨一的神而來的榮耀，那怎麼能信呢？ How can you believe? While accepting glory from one another, you don't seek the glory that comes from the only God.
45. 不要以為我將要在父面前控告你們，有一位控告你們的，就是你們所仰賴的 摩西 。 Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
46. 事實上，如果你們信 摩西，就會信我，因為他寫了關於我的事； For if you believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
47. 如果你們不相信他所寫的，又怎麼會相信我的話呢？」 But if you don't believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"
John 6
1. 這些事以後，耶穌渡過 加利利 湖，也就是 太巴列 湖，到對岸去。 After this, Jesus crossed the Sea of Galilee (or Tiberias).
2. 有一大群人，因為看到他在病人身上所行的神蹟，就跟隨他。 And a huge crowd was following Him because they saw the signs that He was performing on the sick.
3. 耶穌上了山，與他的門徒們在那裡坐下。 So Jesus went up a mountain and sat down there with His disciples.
4. 那時 猶太 人的逾越節快到了。 Now the Passover, a Jewish festival, was near.
5. 耶穌舉目觀看，見一大群人向他走來，就對 腓力 說： 「我們從哪裡買餅給這些人吃呢？」 Therefore, when Jesus looked up and noticed a huge crowd coming toward Him, He asked Philip, "Where will we buy bread so these people can eat?"
6. 他說這話是要試試 腓力，其實他自己已經知道要做什麼了。 He asked this to test him, for He Himself knew what He was going to do.
7. 腓力 回答：「就是兩百個銀幣 的餅，也不夠每個人吃一小塊！」 Philip answered, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread wouldn't be enough for each of them to have a little."
8. 他的一個門徒，就是 西門彼得 的弟弟 安得烈，對耶穌說： One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to Him,
9. 「這裡有個孩子，帶了五個大麥餅和兩條魚。可是對這麼多人，這些算什麼呢？」 "There's a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish-- but what are they for so many?"
10. 耶穌說： 「讓他們坐下來。」 那地方草多，他們坐了下來；男人的數目約有五千。 Then Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." There was plenty of grass in that place, so they sat down. The men numbered about 5,000.
11. 耶穌就拿起餅來，祝謝以後，分給那些坐著的人，把魚也如此分了，他們要多少就給多少。 Then Jesus took the loaves, and after giving thanks He distributed them to those who were seated-- so also with the fish, as much as they wanted.
12. 大家吃飽了以後，耶穌就對他的門徒們說： 「把剩下的碎塊收拾起來，免得浪費。」 When they were full, He told His disciples, "Collect the leftovers so that nothing is wasted."
13. 他們就把大家吃剩的那五個大麥餅的碎塊收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。 So they collected them and filled 12 baskets with the pieces from the five barley loaves that were left over by those who had eaten.
14. 眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就說：「這個人確實是那位要來到世上的先知！」 When the people saw the sign He had done, they said, "This really is the Prophet who was to come into the world!"
15. 耶穌看出他們要來強迫他做王，就又獨自退到山上去了。 Therefore, when Jesus knew that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, He withdrew again to the mountain by Himself.
16. 到了晚上，他的門徒們下到湖邊。 When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
17. 他們上了船，開始渡過湖往 迦百農 去。原來天色已經黑了，而耶穌還沒有來到他們那裡。 got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. Darkness had already set in, but Jesus had not yet come to them.
18. 當時，大風吹起，湖水翻騰。 Then a high wind arose, and the sea began to churn.
19. 他們已經划了約有四、五公里，看到耶穌在湖面上行走，逐漸向船靠近，他們就感到懼怕。 After they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea. He was coming near the boat, and they were afraid.
20. 耶穌對他們說： 「是我，不要怕！」 But He said to them, "It is I. Don't be afraid!"
21. 門徒們這才願意接他上船。船立刻就到了他們所要去的地方。 Then they were willing to take Him on board, and at once the boat was at the shore where they were heading.
22. 第二天，留在湖對岸的眾人，知道在那裡除了一條小船之外，沒有別的船；而且知道耶穌沒有和他的門徒們一起上船，是門徒們自己去的。 The next day, the crowd that had stayed on the other side of the sea knew there had been only one boat. [They also knew] that Jesus had not boarded the boat with His disciples, but that His disciples had gone off alone.
23. 有幾條別的小船從 太巴列 城來，靠近主祝謝後眾人吃餅的地方。 Some boats from Tiberias came near the place where they ate the bread after the Lord gave thanks.
24. 這樣，眾人一發現耶穌已經不在那裡，連他的門徒們也不在那裡，就上了船，往 迦百農 去找耶穌。 When the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum looking for Jesus.
25. 他們在湖的對岸找到了耶穌，就問他：「拉比，你是什麼時候到這裡來的？」 When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You get here?"
26. 耶穌回答說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：你們找我，並不是因為看見了神蹟，而是因為你們吃餅吃飽了。 Jesus answered, "I assure you: You are looking for Me, not because you saw the signs, but because you ate the loaves and were filled.
27. 不要為那會腐敗的食物做工，而要為那存留到永生的食物做工。這食物就是人子要給你們的，因為人子是父神所印證的。」 Don't work for the food that perishes but for the food that lasts for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you, because God the Father has set His seal of approval on Him."
28. 他們問：「我們應該做什麼，才算做神的工作呢？」 "What can we do to perform the works of God?" they asked.
29. 耶穌回答說： 「信神所派來的那一位，就是做神的工作。」 Jesus replied, "This is the work of God: that you believe in the One He has sent."
30. 他們就問：「那麼，你行個什麼神蹟，好讓我們看了就可以信你呢？你可以做什麼呢？ "What sign then are You going to do so we may see and believe You?" they asked. "What are You going to perform?
31. 我們的祖先在曠野吃了嗎哪，正如經上所記： 『他把從天上來的糧賜給他們吃。』 」 Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, just as it is written: He gave them bread from heaven to eat."
32. 耶穌對他們說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：那從天上來的糧不是 摩西 賜給你們的，而是我父把從天上來的真糧賜給了你們。 Jesus said to them, "I assure you: Moses didn't give you the bread from heaven, but My Father gives you the real bread from heaven.
33. 要知道，神的糧就是從天上降下來、賜生命給世人的那一位。」 For the bread of God is the One who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
34. 他們就對耶穌說：「主啊，請你時常把這糧賜給我們！」 Then they said, "Sir, give us this bread always!"
35. 耶穌對他們說： 「我就是生命的糧。到我這裡來的人，絕不飢餓；信我的人，永不乾渴。 "I am the bread of life," Jesus told them. "No one who comes to Me will ever be hungry, and no one who believes in Me will ever be thirsty again.
36. 但是我告訴過你們，你們雖然看到了我，還是不信。 But as I told you, you've seen Me, and yet you do not believe.
37. 凡是父賜給我的人，都會到我這裡來，而到我這裡來的人，我絕不丟棄， Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never cast out.
38. 因為我從天上降下來，不是要行自己的意思，而是要行那派我來者的意思。 For I have come down from heaven, not to do My will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
39. 那派我來者 的旨意，就是要我不失去他賜給我的任何人，而且要我在末日使他復活。 This is the will of Him who sent Me: that I should lose none of those He has given Me but should raise them up on the last day.
40. 要知道，我父 的旨意正是：所有看見子而信他的人都得到永恆的生命，並且在末日，我將要使他復活。」 For this is the will of My Father: that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him may have eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day."
41. 這時候，一些 猶太 人因為耶穌說 『我是從天上降下來的糧』，就私下議論他， Therefore the Jews started complaining about Him, because He said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."
42. 並說：「這不就是 約瑟 的兒子耶穌嗎？我們不都認識他的父母嗎？現在他怎麼說 『我是從天上降下來的』 呢？」 They were saying, "Isn't this Jesus the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can He now say, 'I have come down from heaven'?"
43. 耶穌就對他們說： 「你們不要彼此議論了。 Jesus answered them, "Stop complaining among yourselves.
44. 如果不是派我來的父引領他，沒有人能到我這裡來；到我這裡來的，在末日我還要使他復活。 No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up on the last day.
45. 先知書上記著： 『他們都將成為神所教導的人。』 任何人聽了並領會了從父而來的教導，就會到我這裡來。 It is written in the Prophets: And they will all be taught by God. Everyone who has listened to and learned from the Father comes to Me--
46. 這並不是說，有誰看到父；只有從神而來的那一位，他才看到父。 not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God. He has seen the Father.
47. 「我確確實實地告訴你們：信我 的人，就有永恆的生命。 "I assure you: Anyone who believes has eternal life.
48. 我就是生命的糧。 I am the bread of life.
49. 你們的祖先在曠野吃了嗎哪，還是死了。 Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
50. 那從天上降下來、讓人吃了而不死的糧，就在這裡。 This is the bread that comes down from heaven so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
51. 我就是從天上降下來的生命的糧。人如果吃了這糧，就將活著，直到永遠。我要賜的糧就是我的肉身，是為了世人的生命所賜的 。」 I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread he will live forever. The bread that I will give for the life of the world is My flesh."
52. 於是那些 猶太 人彼此爭論，說：「這個人怎麼能把自己的肉身給我們吃呢？」 At that, the Jews argued among themselves, "How can this man give us His flesh to eat?"
53. 耶穌說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：如果你們不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，你們裡面就沒有生命。 So Jesus said to them, "I assure you: Unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you do not have life in yourselves.
54. 吃我肉、喝我血的人，就有永恆的生命，在末日我還要使他復活； Anyone who eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day,
55. 因為我的肉是真食物，我的血是真飲物。 because My flesh is real food and My blood is real drink.
56. 吃我肉、喝我血的人，住在我裡面，我也住在他裡面。 The one who eats My flesh and drinks My blood lives in Me, and I in him.
57. 永生的父怎樣差派了我，我又因父而活，照樣，以我為食的人也將因我而活。 Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
58. 這才是從天上降下來的糧，不像嗎哪。你們的 祖先吃過嗎哪還是死了，而吃這糧的人就將活著，直到永遠。」 This is the bread that came down from heaven; it is not like the manna your fathers ate-- and they died. The one who eats this bread will live forever."
59. 這些話是耶穌在 迦百農 教導人的時候，在會堂裡說的。 He said these things while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
60. 他的門徒當中有許多人聽了，就說：「這話實在嚴厲，誰能聽呢？」 Therefore, when many of His disciples heard this, they said, "This teaching is hard! Who can accept it?"
61. 耶穌自己裡面知道他的門徒們為這話私下議論，就對他們說： 「這話絆倒你們 嗎？ Jesus, knowing in Himself that His disciples were complaining about this, asked them, "Does this offend you?
62. 所以，如果你們看見人子升到他原先所在的地方，你們會怎麼樣呢？ Then what if you were to observe the Son of Man ascending to where He was before?
63. 賜人生命的是靈，肉體沒有什麼用。我對你們說的話就是靈，就是生命。 The Spirit is the One who gives life. The flesh doesn't help at all. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and are life.
64. 然而你們當中有一些不信的人。」 原來，耶穌從起初就知道哪些人不 信，也知道哪一個人要出賣他。 But there are some among you who don't believe." (For Jesus knew from the beginning those who would not believe and the one who would betray Him.)
65. 耶穌又說： 「所以我告訴過你們：如果不是蒙父所賜，沒有人能到我這裡來。」 He said, "This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless it is granted to him by the Father."
66. 從此耶穌的門徒中有許多人離開回到背後的事上，不再與他同行。 From that moment many of His disciples turned back and no longer accompanied Him.
67. 耶穌就對十二使徒 說： 「你們也不會想離開吧？」 Therefore Jesus said to the Twelve, "You don't want to go away too, do you?"
68. 西門彼得 回答：「主啊，你有永恆生命的話語，我們還去歸從誰呢？ Simon Peter answered, "Lord, who will we go to? You have the words of eternal life.
69. 我們已經相信，也知道你就是神的那位聖者。 」 We have come to believe and know that You are the Holy One of God!"
70. 耶穌對他們說： 「我不是揀選了你們十二使徒嗎？可是你們當中有一個是魔鬼。」 Jesus replied to them, "Didn't I choose you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is the Devil!"
71. 耶穌說的是 加略 人 西門 的兒子 猶大 ；這個人雖然是十二使徒中的一個，後來卻要出賣耶穌。 He was referring to Judas, Simon Iscariot's son, one of the Twelve, because he was going to betray Him.
John 7
1. 這些事以後，耶穌走遍 加利利 。原來他不願意在 猶太 地區往來，因為那些 猶太 人想要殺害他。 After this, Jesus traveled in Galilee, since He did not want to travel in Judea because the Jews were trying to kill Him.
2. 猶太 人的住棚節快到了， The Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,
3. 耶穌的弟弟們對他說：「你離開這裡到 猶太 去吧，好讓你的門徒們也能看到你所做的事。 so His brothers said to Him, "Leave here and go to Judea so Your disciples can see Your works that You are doing.
4. 因為人不會又想要出名，又在隱祕中做事。你既然要做這些事，就把自己顯明給世人看吧！」 For no one does anything in secret while he's seeking public recognition. If You do these things, show Yourself to the world."
5. 原來連他的弟弟們也不信他。 (For not even His brothers believed in Him.)
6. 耶穌對他們說： 「我的時候還沒有來到，而你們的時候隨時都方便。 Jesus told them, "My time has not yet arrived, but your time is always at hand.
7. 世界不能恨你們，卻是恨我，因為我見證世界的行為是邪惡的。 The world cannot hate you, but it does hate Me because I testify about it-- that its deeds are evil.
8. 你們上去過節吧，我現在不 上去，因為我的時候還沒有到。」 Go up to the festival yourselves. I'm not going up to the festival yet, because My time has not yet fully come."
9. 說了這些話，耶穌仍然留在 加利利 地區。 After He had said these things, He stayed in Galilee.
10. 不過當他的弟弟們上去過節以後，他也上去了，但沒有公開，像是悄悄去的。 After His brothers had gone up to the festival, then He also went up, not openly but secretly.
11. 節日期間，那些 猶太 人搜尋耶穌，說：「那個人在哪裡？」 The Jews were looking for Him at the festival and saying, "Where is He?"
12. 人群中有許多人對他議論紛紛；有的說：「他是好人。」也有的說：「不，他是迷惑民眾的。」 And there was a lot of discussion about Him among the crowds. Some were saying, "He's a good man." Others were saying, "No, on the contrary, He's deceiving the people."
13. 只是沒有人公開地講論他的事，因為怕那些 猶太 人。 Still, nobody was talking publicly about Him because they feared the Jews.
14. 可是住棚節已經過了一半，耶穌上聖殿去，開始教導人。 When the festival was already half over, Jesus went up into the temple complex and began to teach.
15. 那些 猶太 人感到驚奇，說：「這個人沒學過，怎麼懂得經文呢？」 Then the Jews were amazed and said, "How does He know the Scriptures, since He hasn't been trained?"
16. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「我的教導不是我自己的，而是那派我來者的。 Jesus answered them, "My teaching isn't Mine but is from the One who sent Me.
17. 人如果願意遵行神的旨意，就會明白這教導究竟是從神而來的，還是我憑自己而講的。 If anyone wants to do His will, he will understand whether the teaching is from God or if I am speaking on My own.
18. 憑自己講話的人，是尋求自己的榮耀；但是，尋求那派他來者之榮耀的，他才是真實的，在他裡面沒有不義。 The one who speaks for himself seeks his own glory. But He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is true, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
19. 摩西 不是把律法傳給你們了嗎？你們當中卻沒有一個人遵行這律法。你們為什麼想要殺我呢？」 Didn't Moses give you the law? Yet none of you keeps the law! Why do you want to kill Me?"
20. 眾人回答：「你有鬼魔附身！誰想要殺你？」 "You have a demon!" the crowd responded. "Who wants to kill You?"
21. 耶穌對他們說： 「我做了一件事，你們都感到驚奇。 "I did one work, and you are all amazed," Jesus answered.
22. 摩西 把割禮傳給你們，你們就在安息日給人施行割禮——其實割禮不是從 開始的，而是從祖先開始的。 "Consider this: Moses has given you circumcision-- not that it comes from Moses but from the fathers-- and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.
23. 既然人在安息日受割禮，是為了不違犯 摩西 的律法；那麼，因為我在安息日使一個人完全康復，你們就對我生氣嗎？ If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses won't be broken, are you angry at Me because I made a man entirely well on the Sabbath?
24. 不要按著外表做判斷，而要按著公義做判斷。」 Stop judging according to outward appearances; rather judge according to righteous judgment."
25. 有些 耶路撒冷 的人說：「這不是他們想要殺的那個人嗎？ Some of the people of Jerusalem were saying, "Isn't this the man they want to kill?
26. 看，他還在公開講話，他們也沒有對他說什麼。難道首領們真的認為這個人就是 基督嗎？ Yet, look! He's speaking publicly and they're saying nothing to Him. Can it be true that the authorities know He is the Messiah?
27. 可是，基督出現的時候，沒有人會知道他從哪裡來；而這個人，我們卻很清楚他是從哪裡來的。」 But we know where this man is from. When the Messiah comes, nobody will know where He is from."
