28. 耶穌在聖殿裡教導人，呼喊說： 「你們認識我，也知道我是從哪裡來的。其實我不是憑自己而來的；派我來的那一位是真實的，你們卻不認識他； As He was teaching in the temple complex, Jesus cried out, "You know Me and you know where I am from. Yet I have not come on My own, but the One who sent Me is true. You don't know Him;
29. 而我認識他，因為我是從他而來，也是他差派了我。」 I know Him because I am from Him, and He sent Me."
30. 因此他們想要抓耶穌，只是沒有人下手，因為他的時候還沒有到。 Then they tried to seize Him. Yet no one laid a hand on Him because His hour had not yet come.
31. 但是人群中有許多人信了耶穌，他們說：「基督來的時候，難道會比這個人行更多的神蹟嗎？」 However, many from the crowd believed in Him and said, "When the Messiah comes, He won't perform more signs than this man has done, will He?"
32. 法利賽 人聽到了眾人私下議論耶穌的這些事。於是祭司長們和 法利賽 人就派差役們去抓他。 The Pharisees heard the crowd muttering these things about Him, so the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple police to arrest Him.
33. 耶穌說： 「我與你們在一起的時候不多了，我要回到派我來的那一位面前。 Then Jesus said, "I am only with you for a short time. Then I'm going to the One who sent Me.
34. 你們將要尋找我，卻找不到；我所在的地方，你們不能去。」 You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come."
35. 那些 猶太 人彼此問：「這個人要到哪裡去，讓我們找不到他呢？難道他要往散居在 希臘 人中的 猶太 僑民那裡，去教導 希臘 人嗎？ Then the Jews said to one another, "Where does He intend to go so we won't find Him? He doesn't intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks, does He?
36. 他所說的 『你們將要尋找我，卻找不到；我所在的地方，你們不能去』，這話是什麼意思呢？」 What is this remark He made: 'You will look for Me, and you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come'?"
37. 節期的最後一天，也是最盛大的日子，耶穌站起來呼喊說： 「如果有人渴了，就到我這裡 來喝吧！ On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and cried out, "If anyone is thirsty, he should come to Me and drink!
38. 信我的人，就如經上所說的，從他的腹中將要湧流出活水的江河。」 The one who believes in Me, as the Scripture has said, will have streams of living water flow from deep within him."
39. 耶穌這話是指著信他的人所要領受的聖靈而說的。當時，聖靈 還沒有臨到，因為耶穌還沒有得榮耀。 He said this about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were going to receive, for the Spirit had not yet been received, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
40. 眾人聽了這話，有些 人說：「這個人確實是那位先知！」 When some from the crowd heard these words, they said, "This really is the Prophet!"
41. 另有的說：「這個人就是基督。」還有的卻說：「難道基督會出自 加利利 嗎？ Others said, "This is the Messiah!" But some said, "Surely the Messiah doesn't come from Galilee, does He?
42. 經上不是說，基督是 大衛 的後裔，是出自 大衛 的故鄉 伯利恆 嗎？」 Doesn't the Scripture say that the Messiah comes from David's offspring and from the town of Bethlehem, where David once lived?"
43. 於是眾人因耶穌就產生了分裂； So a division occurred among the crowd because of Him.
44. 其中有些人想要抓他，可是沒有人下手。 Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid hands on Him.
45. 差役們回到祭司長們和 法利賽 人那裡。那些人問：「為什麼沒有把他帶來？」 Then the temple police came to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, "Why haven't you brought Him?"
46. 差役們回答：「從來沒有人像這個人 那樣講話！」 The police answered, "No man ever spoke like this!"
47. 法利賽 人說：「難道你們也被迷惑了嗎？ Then the Pharisees responded to them: "Are you fooled too?
48. 難道首領或 法利賽 人中有信他的嗎？ Have any of the rulers believed in Him? Or any of the Pharisees?
49. 這不懂律法的民眾是被詛咒的！」 But this crowd, which doesn't know the law, is accursed!"
50. 他們當中有一個人，就是原先 來到耶穌那裡的 尼克迪莫，對他們說： Nicodemus-- the one who came to Him previously, being one of them-- said to them,
51. 「如果不先聽本人的口供，並且了解他做了什麼，我們的律法就定不了他的罪，難道不是嗎？」 "Our law doesn't judge a man before it hears from him and knows what he's doing, does it?"
52. 他們回答說：「你也不會是 加利利 人吧？你去查一查看，先知是不會從 加利利 興起的！」 "You aren't from Galilee too, are you?" they replied. "Investigate and you will see that no prophet arises from Galilee."
53. 然後他們每個人都回家去了。 [[So each one went to his house.
John 8
1. 耶穌卻往 橄欖山 去。 But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

3. 這時，經文士們和 法利賽 人帶來一個在通姦時被抓住的婦人，叫她站在中間。 Then the scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman caught in adultery, making her stand in the center.
4. 他們對耶穌說：「老師，這婦人是正在通姦的時候被抓住的。 "Teacher," they said to Him, "this woman was caught in the act of committing adultery.
5. 摩西 在律法上吩咐我們用石頭砸死這樣的女人，既然如此，你怎麼說呢？」 In the law Moses commanded us to stone such women. So what do You say?"
6. 他們說這話是要試探耶穌，為要找把柄 來控告他。 耶穌卻彎下腰，開始用指頭在地上寫字。 They asked this to trap Him, in order that they might have evidence to accuse Him. Jesus stooped down and started writing on the ground with His finger.
7. 可是當他們不停地追問耶穌的時候，耶穌就直起身來，對他們說： 「你們當中誰沒有罪，誰就先用石頭砸她吧！」 When they persisted in questioning Him, He stood up and said to them, "The one without sin among you should be the first to throw a stone at her."
8. 然後他又彎下腰去，繼續在地上寫字。 Then He stooped down again and continued writing on the ground.
9. 他們聽了這話， 從年長的開始，一個接一個地走開了。最後，只剩下耶穌和那站在中間的婦人。 When they heard this, they left one by one, starting with the older men. Only He was left, with the woman in the center.
10. 耶穌直起身來 問她： 「婦人，他們 在哪裡？沒有人定你的罪嗎？」 When Jesus stood up, He said to her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"
11. 她說：「主啊，沒有。」 耶穌說： 「我也不定你的罪。你回去吧！從今以後不要再犯罪了。」 "No one, Lord," she answered. "Neither do I condemn you," said Jesus. "Go, and from now on do not sin any more."]]
12. 耶穌又對眾人說： 「我就是世界的光。跟從我的人，絕不會在黑暗裡行走，卻要得到生命的光。」 Then Jesus spoke to them again: "I am the light of the world. Anyone who follows Me will never walk in the darkness but will have the light of life."
13. 法利賽 人對他說：「你為自己做見證，你的見證是無效 的。」 So the Pharisees said to Him, "You are testifying about Yourself. Your testimony is not valid."
14. 耶穌回答： 「即使我為自己做見證，我的見證也是有效 的，因為我知道我從哪裡來，往哪裡去；而你們卻不知道我從哪裡來，往哪裡去。 "Even if I testify about Myself," Jesus replied, "My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I'm going. But you don't know where I come from or where I'm going.
15. 你們是按人 的標準來評斷，我卻不評斷任何人。 You judge by human standards. I judge no one.
16. 不過，就算我評斷，我的評斷也是真實的，因為我不是獨自一人，而是有那派我來的父與我同在。 And if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone, but I and the Father who sent Me [judge together].
17. 連你們的律法上也記載著：兩個人的見證才是有效的。 Even in your law it is written that the witness of two men is valid.
18. 我為自己做見證，派我來的父也為我做見證。」 I am the One who testifies about Myself, and the Father who sent Me testifies about Me."
19. 他們就問耶穌：「你的『父』在哪裡？」 耶穌回答： 「你們既不認識我，也不認識我的父；如果你們認識我，也就認識我的父。」 Then they asked Him, "Where is Your Father?" "You know neither Me nor My Father," Jesus answered. "If you knew Me, you would also know My Father."
20. 這些話是耶穌在聖殿的奉獻箱附近教導人的時候說的。可是沒有人抓他，因為他的時候還沒有到。 He spoke these words by the treasury, while teaching in the temple complex. But no one seized Him, because His hour had not come.
21. 後來，耶穌又對他們說： 「我要去了，你們將要尋找我，並且將死在自己的罪中。我去的地方，你們不能去。」 Then He said to them again, "I'm going away; you will look for Me, and you will die in your sin. Where I'm going, you cannot come."
22. 那些 猶太 人就說：「他說 『我去的地方，你們不能去』，難道他要自殺嗎？」 So the Jews said again, "He won't kill Himself, will He, since He says, 'Where I'm going, you cannot come'?"
23. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們從下面來，我從上面來；你們屬於這世界，我不屬於這世界。 "You are from below," He told them, "I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
24. 所以我對你們說過『你們將死在自己的罪孽中。』事實上，你們如果不信我就是那一位，就將死在自己的罪孽中。」 Therefore I told you that you will die in your sins. For if you do not believe that I am [He], you will die in your sins."
25. 他們問：「你到底是誰？」 耶穌說： 「我從一開始就告訴你們了。 "Who are You?" they questioned. "Precisely what I've been telling you from the very beginning," Jesus told them.

27. 他們不明白耶穌對他們說的是有關父的事。 They did not know He was speaking to them about the Father.

29. 派我來的那一位與我同在；他 沒有撇下我，使我獨自一人，因為我一直做他所喜悅的事。」 The One who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him."
30. 耶穌說這些話的時候，許多人就信了他。 As He was saying these things, many believed in Him.

34. 耶穌回答： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：所有犯罪的，就是罪的奴隸。 Jesus responded, "I assure you: Everyone who commits sin is a slave of sin.
35. 奴隸不會永遠住在家裡，兒子卻會永遠住在家裡。 A slave does not remain in the household forever, but a son does remain forever.
36. 所以，如果子使你們自由，你們就真正自由了。 Therefore if the Son sets you free, you really will be free.
37. 我知道你們是 亞伯拉罕 的後裔。可是你們想要殺我，因為你們裡面容不下我的話語。 I know you are descendants of Abraham, but you are trying to kill Me because My word is not welcome among you.
38. 我所說的，是我從我 父那裡所看到的；而實際上，你們所做的，是從你們的 父那裡所聽到 的。」 I speak what I have seen in the presence of the Father, and therefore you do what you have heard from your father."
39. 他們回答說：「 亞伯拉罕 是我們的父！」 耶穌說： 「如果你們是 的兒女，就會做 所做的事。 "Our father is Abraham!" they replied. "If you were Abraham's children," Jesus told them, "you would do what Abraham did.
40. 但如今，我把從神那裡所聽到的真理告訴了你們，你們就想殺我。 亞伯拉罕 沒有做過這種事。 But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do this!
41. 你們在做你們的父所做的事。」 他們回答說：「我們不是由淫亂所生的，我們只有一位父，就是神。」 You're doing what your father does." "We weren't born of sexual immorality," they said. "We have one Father-- God."
42. 耶穌說： 「如果神是你們的父，你們就會愛我，因為我是出於神，並且從神那裡來。要知道，我並不是憑自己而來的，而是那一位差派了我。 Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love Me, because I came from God and I am here. For I didn't come on My own, but He sent Me.
43. 你們為什麼不明白我的話呢？這是因為你們聽不進我的話語。 Why don't you understand what I say? Because you cannot listen to My word.

He was a murderer from the beginning and has not stood in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he tells a lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of liars.

47. 屬神的人，就聽神的話語；你們之所以不聽，是因為你們不屬於神。」 The one who is from God listens to God's words. This is why you don't listen, because you are not from God."

52. 猶太 人說：「現在我們知道你是有鬼魔附身的。 亞伯拉罕 死了，先知們也死了，你還說 『人如果遵守我的話語，就絕不會嘗到死的滋味，直到永遠。』 Then the Jews said, "Now we know You have a demon. Abraham died and so did the prophets. You say, 'If anyone keeps My word, he will never taste death-- ever!'

55. 你們不認識他，我卻認識他。如果我說我不認識他，我就成了像你們那樣的說謊者。但我認識他，也遵守他的話語。 You've never known Him, but I know Him. If I were to say I don't know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
56. 你們的先祖 亞伯拉罕 因為將要看到我的日子就快樂。他看到了，就歡喜。」 Your father Abraham was overjoyed that he would see My day; he saw it and rejoiced."
57. 猶太 人就對他說：「你還不到五十歲，怎麼會見過 亞伯拉罕 ？ 」 The Jews replied, "You aren't 50 years old yet, and You've seen Abraham?"
58. 耶穌對他們說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們： 亞伯拉罕 存在之前，我就存在了。」 Jesus said to them, "I assure you: Before Abraham was, I am."
59. 他們因此拿起石頭要砸他。耶穌卻被隱藏， 離開了聖殿。 At that, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple complex.
John 9
1. 耶穌往前走，看到一個生來就瞎眼的人。 As He was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth.
2. 他的門徒問他，說：「拉比，這個人生來就瞎眼，是誰犯了罪？是這個人，還是他的父母呢？」 His disciples questioned Him: "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"
3. 耶穌回答： 「既不是這個人犯了罪，也不是他的父母犯了罪，而是要讓神的作為顯明在他身上。 "Neither this man nor his parents sinned," Jesus answered. "[This came about] so that God's works might be displayed in him.
4. 趁著白晝，我們 必須做那派我來者的工作；黑夜就要到了！那時候就沒有人能做工了。 We must do the works of Him who sent Me while it is day. Night is coming when no one can work.
5. 我在世上的時候，就是世界的光。」 As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
6. 耶穌說了這些話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和了一點泥，抹在瞎眼之人的眼睛上， After He said these things He spit on the ground, made some mud from the saliva, and spread the mud on his eyes.
7. 然後對他說： 「到 西羅亞 池去洗一洗。」 ——「 西羅亞 」翻譯出來就是「奉差派」。他去洗了，回來就能看見了。 "Go," He told him, "wash in the pool of Siloam" (which means "Sent"). So he left, washed, and came back seeing.
8. 他的鄰居和原先看見他討飯 的人就說：「這不是那一向坐著討飯的人嗎？」 His neighbors and those who formerly had seen him as a beggar said, "Isn't this the man who sat begging?"
9. 有的說：「是這個人。」有的說：「不是，只是像他。」 那個人自己說：「就是我。」 Some said, "He's the one." "No," others were saying, "but he looks like him." He kept saying, "I'm the one!"
10. 他們問他：「那麼，你的眼睛是怎麼開的呢？」 Therefore they asked him, "Then how were your eyes opened?"
11. 他回答：「那個叫耶穌的人，和了些泥抹在我的眼睛上，吩咐我到 西羅亞 池子 去洗。我去一洗，就得以看見。」 He answered, "The man called Jesus made mud, spread it on my eyes, and told me, 'Go to Siloam and wash.' So when I went and washed I received my sight."
12. 他們問：「那個人在哪裡？」 他說：「我不知道。」 "Where is He?" they asked. "I don't know," he said.
13. 他們把那原來瞎眼的人帶到 法利賽 人那裡。 They brought the man who used to be blind to the Pharisees.
14. 耶穌和泥開他眼睛的那一天，正是安息日。 The day that Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
15. 法利賽 人也再次問他是怎麼得以看見的。 他說：「他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我一洗，就能看見了。」 So again the Pharisees asked him how he received his sight. "He put mud on my eyes," he told them. "I washed and I can see."
16. 法利賽 人中的有些人說：「那個人不是從神那裡來的，因為他不守安息日。」有些人卻說：「一個罪人怎麼能行這樣的神蹟呢？」他們之間就產生了分裂。 Therefore some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, for He doesn't keep the Sabbath!" But others were saying, "How can a sinful man perform such signs?" And there was a division among them.
17. 於是他們又問那瞎眼的：「既然他開了你的眼睛，那麼你說他是什麼人？」 他說：「是一位先知。」 Again they asked the blind man, "What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?" "He's a prophet," he said.
18. 那些 猶太 人不相信他以前瞎眼而後來得以看見，直等到把他的父母叫來， The Jews did not believe this about him-- that he was blind and received sight-- until they summoned the parents of the one who had received his sight.
19. 問他們：「這是你們的兒子嗎？你們說他生來是瞎眼的，現在怎麼能看見呢？」 They asked them, "Is this your son, [the one] you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"
20. 他的父母回答說：「這個人是我們的兒子，而且生來就瞎眼，這些我們知道。 "We know this is our son and that he was born blind," his parents answered.
21. 至於他現在怎麼能看見，我們就不知道了。是誰開了他的眼睛，我們也不知道。你們問他吧，他已經成年了，他自己會說的。」 "But we don't know how he now sees, and we don't know who opened his eyes. Ask him; he's of age. He will speak for himself."
22. 他的父母說這些話，是因為怕那些 猶太 人。原來那些 猶太 人已經說好，如果有人承認耶穌是基督，就要把他趕出會堂。 His parents said these things because they were afraid of the Jews, since the Jews had already agreed that if anyone confessed Him as Messiah, he would be banned from the synagogue.
23. 所以他的父母說：「你們問他吧，他已經成年了。」 This is why his parents said, "He's of age; ask him."
24. 他們再次把那原來瞎眼的人叫來，對他說：「你要把榮耀歸給神！ 我們知道那人是個罪人。」 So a second time they summoned the man who had been blind and told him, "Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner!"
25. 他回答：「他是不是罪人，我不知道。但有一件事我知道：我原來是瞎眼的，現在卻能看見了！」 He answered, "Whether or not He's a sinner, I don't know. One thing I do know: I was blind, and now I can see!"
26. 他們問：「他對你做了什麼？怎麼開了你的眼睛？」 Then they asked him, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"
27. 他回答：「我已經告訴過你們，你們不聽，為什麼現在又想聽呢？難道你們也想成為他的門徒嗎？」 "I already told you," he said, "and you didn't listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don't want to become His disciples too, do you?"
28. 他們就辱罵他，說：「你才是那個人的門徒！我們是 摩西 的門徒！ They ridiculed him: "You're that man's disciple, but we're Moses' disciples.
29. 我們知道神對 摩西 說過話，至於這個人，我們就不知道他是從哪裡來的！」 We know that God has spoken to Moses. But this man-- we don't know where He's from!"
30. 他回答說：「這就奇怪了！他開了我的眼睛，你們竟然不知道他是從哪裡來的！ "This is an amazing thing," the man told them. "You don't know where He is from, yet He opened my eyes!
31. 我們知道神是不聽罪人的，然而，如果有人敬畏神、遵行他的旨意，神就垂聽他。 We know that God doesn't listen to sinners, but if anyone is God-fearing and does His will, He listens to him.
32. 自古以來，沒有人聽說過誰開了生來就瞎眼之人的眼睛。 Throughout history no one has ever heard of someone opening the eyes of a person born blind.
33. 那個人如果不是從神而來的，他什麼也不能做。」 If this man were not from God, He wouldn't be able to do anything."
34. 他們回答他，說：「你完全是生在罪孽中的，還敢教訓我們！」於是把他趕了出去。 "You were born entirely in sin," they replied, "and are you trying to teach us?" Then they threw him out.
35. 耶穌聽說他們把他趕出去了，後來找到他，說： 「你信人子 嗎？」 When Jesus heard that they had thrown the man out, He found him and asked, "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"
36. 他回答說：「先生，人子是誰呢？願我能信他。」 "Who is He, Sir, that I may believe in Him?" he asked.
37. 耶穌說： 「你已經看到他了，現在與你說話的，就是那一位。」 Jesus answered, "You have seen Him; in fact, He is the One speaking with you."
38. 他說：「主啊，我信！」就向耶穌下拜。 "I believe, Lord!" he said, and he worshiped Him.
39. 耶穌說： 「我到這世上來是為了行審判，使看不見的能看見，使看得見的反而瞎了眼。」 Jesus said, "I came into this world for judgment, in order that those who do not see will see and those who do see will become blind."
40. 與耶穌在那裡的一些 法利賽 人聽了這些話，就說：「難道我們也是瞎眼的嗎？」 Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these things and asked Him, "We aren't blind too, are we?"
41. 耶穌對他們說： 「如果你們是瞎眼的，就沒有罪了。但如今你們說『我們能看見』，所以你們的罪仍然存在。 "If you were blind," Jesus told them, "you wouldn't have sin. But now that you say, 'We see'-- your sin remains.
John 10
1. 「我確確實實地告訴你們：那不從門進入羊圈，卻從別處爬進去的人，是賊、是強盜。 "I assure you: Anyone who doesn't enter the sheep pen by the door but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
2. 那從門進去的，才是羊的牧人。 The one who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
3. 看門的就給他開門，羊也聽他的聲音。他一一提名呼喚自己的羊，帶領牠們出去。 The doorkeeper opens it for him, and the sheep hear his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
4. 他把自己所有 的羊 帶出去的時候，走在牠們的前面。羊因為認得他的聲音，就跟著他去。 When he has brought all his own outside, he goes ahead of them. The sheep follow him because they recognize his voice.
5. 羊絕不會跟著陌生人，反而會逃避，因為不認得他的聲音。」 They will never follow a stranger; instead they will run away from him, because they don't recognize the voice of strangers."
6. 耶穌對他們說了這個比喻，他們卻不明白他說的是什麼。 Jesus gave them this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
7. 因此耶穌又說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：我就是羊的門。 So Jesus said again, "I assure you: I am the door of the sheep.
8. 所有在我以前來的，是賊、是強盜，因此羊沒有聽從他們。 All who came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn't listen to them.
9. 我就是門。人如果通過我進來，就將得救，而且進進出出，將找到牧草。 I am the door. If anyone enters by Me, he will be saved and will come in and go out and find pasture.
10. 盜賊來，無非是要偷竊、宰殺、毀滅；而我來是要他們得生命，並且得的更豐盛。 A thief comes only to steal and to kill and to destroy. I have come that they may have life and have it in abundance.
11. 「我就是好牧人。好牧人為羊捨棄自己的生命； "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
12. 那雇來的不是牧人，羊也不是自己的，他看見狼來了，撇下羊就逃。這樣，狼就搶奪羊，把牠們驅散了。 The hired man, since he is not the shepherd and doesn't own the sheep, leaves them and runs away when he sees a wolf coming. The wolf then snatches and scatters them.
13. 這是因為那人是雇來的，並不顧念羊的事。 [This happens] because he is a hired man and doesn't care about the sheep.
14. 「我就是好牧人。我認識那屬於我的，那屬於我的也認識我， "I am the good shepherd. I know My own sheep, and they know Me,
15. 就像父認識我，我也認識父那樣，而且我為羊捨棄自己的生命。 as the Father knows Me, and I know the Father. I lay down My life for the sheep.
16. 我另外有羊，不是這圈裡的。我必須把他們帶來，他們會聽我的聲音，並且合成一群，同歸一個牧人。 But I have other sheep that are not of this fold; I must bring them also, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock, one shepherd.
17. 父之所以愛我，是因為我捨棄自己的生命，好把它再取回來。 This is why the Father loves Me, because I am laying down My life so I may take it up again.
18. 沒有人奪去我的生命，是我自願捨棄的。我有權柄捨棄生命，也有權柄再把它取回來。這命令，我已經從我父領受了。」 No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down on My own. I have the right to lay it down, and I have the right to take it up again. I have received this command from My Father."
19. 因這些話， 猶太 人中又產生了分裂。 Again a division took place among the Jews because of these words.
20. 其中有許多人說：「他有鬼魔附身，發瘋了！何必聽他的呢？」 Many of them were saying, "He has a demon and He's crazy! Why do you listen to Him?"
21. 另有些人說：「這些話不是有鬼魔附身的人說的！鬼魔難道能開瞎子的眼睛嗎？」 Others were saying, "These aren't the words of someone demon-possessed. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
22. 在 耶路撒冷，當時正是獻殿節。那時候是冬天。 Then the Festival of Dedication took place in Jerusalem, and it was winter.
23. 耶穌正在聖殿的 所羅門 柱廊上走著， Jesus was walking in the temple complex in Solomon's Colonnade.
24. 猶太 人圍住了他，說：「你還讓我們猜疑多久呢？如果你是基督，就明確地告訴我們吧！」 Then the Jews surrounded Him and asked, "How long are You going to keep us in suspense? If You are the Messiah, tell us plainly."
25. 耶穌回答： 「我告訴過你們，你們卻不相信。我奉我父的名所行的這些事為我做見證； "I did tell you and you don't believe," Jesus answered them. "The works that I do in My Father's name testify about Me.
26. 可是你們不信，因為 你們不是我的羊。 But you don't believe because you are not My sheep.
27. 我的羊聽我的聲音，我也認識他們，他們也跟著我； My sheep hear My voice, I know them, and they follow Me.
28. 並且我賜給他們永恆的生命，他們絕不會滅亡，直到永遠。誰也不能把他們從我手中奪走。 I give them eternal life, and they will never perish-- ever! No one will snatch them out of My hand.
29. 我父，就是把他們 賜給我的那一位，他比一切更大。誰也不能把他們從我 父的手中奪走。 My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of the Father's hand.
30. 我與父是一體的。」 The Father and I are one."
31. 猶太 人又拿起石頭要砸死他。 Again the Jews picked up rocks to stone Him.
32. 耶穌對他們說： 「我把很多從父而來的美好之事顯給你們看了，你們是為哪一件要用石頭砸死我呢？」 Jesus replied, "I have shown you many good works from the Father. Which of these works are you stoning Me for?"
33. 他們回答：「我們不會為了什麼美好之事用石頭砸死你，而是為了你說褻瀆的話！因為你不過是人，竟然把自己當做神！」 "We aren't stoning You for a good work," the Jews answered, "but for blasphemy, because You-- being a man-- make Yourself God."
34. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們的 律法上不是寫道 『我說你們是神』 嗎？ Jesus answered them, "Isn't it written in your law, I said, you are gods?
35. 而經上的話是不能廢除的。神既然稱那些承受他話語 的人為神， If He called those whom the word of God came to 'gods'-- and the Scripture cannot be broken--
36. 那麼，難道因為我說了『我是神的兒子』，你們就對父所分別為聖、並差派到世上來的那一位說『你說了褻瀆的話』嗎？ do you say, 'You are blaspheming' to the One the Father set apart and sent into the world, because I said: I am the Son of God?
37. 如果我沒有做我父的事，你們就不該相信我； If I am not doing My Father's works, don't believe Me.
38. 但如果我做了，你們即使不相信我，也該相信這些事。這樣，你們就會知道並體會 父在我裡面，我也在父 裡面。」 But if I am doing them and you don't believe Me, believe the works. This way you will know and understand that the Father is in Me and I in the Father."
39. 於是他們又試圖抓耶穌，他卻從他們的手中脫離出來。 Then they were trying again to seize Him, yet He eluded their grasp.
40. 耶穌又前往 約旦 河對岸，到 約翰 當初施洗的地方，住在那裡。 So He departed again across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing earlier, and He remained there.
41. 有許多人來到他那裡，說：「雖然 約翰 沒有行過神蹟，但 約翰 所說的有關這個人的事，都是真的。」 Many came to Him and said, "John never did a sign, but everything John said about this man was true."
42. 於是有許多人在那裡信了耶穌。 And many believed in Him there.
John 11
1. 有一個叫 拉撒路 的病人，住在 伯大尼，就是 瑪麗亞 和她的姐姐 瑪妲 住的村子。 Now a man was sick, Lazarus, from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
2. 這 瑪麗亞 就是用香液膏抹主，又用自己的頭髮擦他腳的那一個。是她的弟弟 拉撒路 患了病。 Mary was the one who anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and wiped His feet with her hair, and it was her brother Lazarus who was sick.
3. 姐妹倆派人到耶穌那裡說：「主啊，你看，你所愛的人患了病。」 So the sisters sent a message to Him: "Lord, the one You love is sick."
4. 耶穌聽了就說： 「這病不至於死，而是為了神的榮耀，好使神的兒子由此得榮耀。」 When Jesus heard it, He said, "This sickness will not end in death but is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it."
5. 耶穌一向愛 瑪妲 和她的妹妹，以及 拉撒路 。 (Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus.)
6. 然而當他聽說 拉撒路 患了病，還繼續在原來的地方住了兩天， So when He heard that he was sick, He stayed two more days in the place where He was.
7. 此後才對門徒說： 「我們再到 猶太 去吧。」 Then after that, He said to the disciples, "Let's go to Judea again."
8. 門徒們說：「拉比，近來 猶太 人想用石頭砸死你，你還再到那裡去嗎？」 "Rabbi," the disciples told Him, "just now the Jews tried to stone You, and You're going there again?"
9. 耶穌回答： 「白天不是有十二個小時嗎？人如果在白天行走，就不會絆倒，因為他看見這世界的光。 "Aren't there 12 hours in a day?" Jesus answered. "If anyone walks during the day, he doesn't stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
10. 但人如果在黑夜裡行走，就會絆倒，因為在他裡面沒有光。」 If anyone walks during the night, he does stumble, because the light is not in him."
11. 耶穌講了這些話，然後對他們說： 「我們的朋友 拉撒路 睡了，我要去叫醒他。」 He said this, and then He told them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I'm on My way to wake him up."
12. 門徒們就對他說：「主啊，他如果是睡著了，就有救了！」 Then the disciples said to Him, "Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will get well."
13. 其實耶穌說的是 拉撒路 的死，他們卻以為他說的是睡覺休息。 Jesus, however, was speaking about his death, but they thought He was speaking about natural sleep.
14. 於是耶穌明確地告訴他們： 「 拉撒路 死了！ So Jesus then told them plainly, "Lazarus has died.
15. 我為你們歡喜，因為我不在那裡，好使你們可以相信。現在我們到他那裡去吧。」 I'm glad for you that I wasn't there so that you may believe. But let's go to him."
16. 那叫 迪杜馬 的 多馬，對其他門徒說：「我們也去吧，讓我們與主 一起死！」 Then Thomas (called "Twin") said to his fellow disciples, "Let's go so that we may die with Him."
17. 耶穌到了，知道 拉撒路 在墳墓裡已經有四天了。 When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
18. 伯大尼 離 耶路撒冷 不遠，約有三公里 。 Bethany was near Jerusalem (about two miles away).
19. 許多 猶太 人到 瑪妲 和 瑪麗亞 那裡去，為了她們弟弟的事安慰她們。 Many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them about their brother.
20. 瑪妲 一聽說耶穌來了，就去迎接他。 瑪麗亞 卻仍然坐在家裡。 As soon as Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet Him. But Mary remained seated in the house.
21. 瑪妲 對耶穌說：「主啊，如果你早在這裡，我弟弟就不會死了。 Then Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother wouldn't have died.
22. 不過我知道，即使是現在，你無論向神求什麼，神都將賜給你的。」 Yet even now I know that whatever You ask from God, God will give You."
23. 耶穌對她說： 「你弟弟會復活的。」 "Your brother will rise again," Jesus told her.
24. 瑪妲 說：「我知道在末日復活的時候，他會復活。」 Martha said, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."
25. 耶穌對她說： 「我就是復活，我就是生命。信我的人，即使死了，也將要活。 Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in Me, even if he dies, will live.
26. 所有活著而信我的人絕不會死，直到永遠。你信這話嗎？」 Everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die-- ever. Do you believe this?"
27. 瑪妲 說：「是的，主啊！我相信你是基督，是神的兒子，就是要到世界上來的那一位。」 "Yes, Lord," she told Him, "I believe You are the Messiah, the Son of God, who was to come into the world."
28. 瑪妲 說了這 話，就回去叫她的妹妹 瑪麗亞，悄悄地說：「老師來到這裡，叫你過去。」 Having said this, she went back and called her sister Mary, saying in private, "The Teacher is here and is calling for you."
29. 瑪麗亞 一聽，就立即起來，往耶穌那裡去。 As soon as she heard this, she got up quickly and went to Him.
30. 當時，耶穌還沒有進村子，仍在 瑪妲 迎接他的地方。 Jesus had not yet come into the village but was still in the place where Martha had met Him.
31. 那些在 瑪麗亞 家裡安慰她的 猶太 人，看見她匆忙起身出去，以為 她要到墳墓那裡去哭，就跟著她。 The Jews who were with her in the house consoling her saw that Mary got up quickly and went out. So they followed her, supposing that she was going to the tomb to cry there.
32. 瑪麗亞 到了耶穌那裡，一看見他，就俯伏在他的腳前，說：「主啊，如果你早在這裡，我弟弟就不會死了。」 When Mary came to where Jesus was and saw Him, she fell at His feet and told Him, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died!"
33. 耶穌看見 瑪麗亞 在哭，陪她一起來的 猶太 人也在哭，就靈裡憤怒，內心煩擾。 When Jesus saw her crying, and the Jews who had come with her crying, He was angry in His spirit and deeply moved.
34. 他問： 「你們把他安放在哪裡？」 他們回答說：「主啊，請來看。」 "Where have you put him?" He asked. "Lord," they told Him, "come and see."
35. 耶穌流淚了。 Jesus wept.
36. 猶太 人就說：「你看，他多麼愛 拉撒路 ！」 So the Jews said, "See how He loved him!"
37. 但是其中有些人說：「這個人既然開了瞎子的眼睛，難道就不能使 拉撒路 不死嗎？」 But some of them said, "Couldn't He who opened the blind man's eyes also have kept this man from dying?"
38. 耶穌自己裡面再次感到憤怒，來到墳墓那裡。那墳墓是個洞穴，有一塊石頭放置在洞口。 Then Jesus, angry in Himself again, came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone was lying against it.
39. 耶穌吩咐： 「把石頭挪開。」 死者的姐姐 瑪妲 說：「主啊，他已經發臭了，因為是第四天了。」 "Remove the stone," Jesus said. Martha, the dead man's sister, told Him, "Lord, he already stinks. It's been four days."
40. 耶穌對她說： 「我不是對你說過，你如果信，就會看見神的榮耀嗎？」 Jesus said to her, "Didn't I tell you that if you believed you would see the glory of God?"
41. 於是他們把 石頭挪開。耶穌向上舉目，說： 「父啊，我感謝你，因為你已經垂聽了我。 So they removed the stone. Then Jesus raised His eyes and said, "Father, I thank You that You heard Me.
42. 我知道你總是在垂聽我，但我這麼說，是為了這些站在周圍的民眾，好讓他們相信是你差派了我。」 I know that You always hear Me, but because of the crowd standing here I said this, so they may believe You sent Me."
43. 耶穌說了這些話，就大聲呼喚： 「 拉撒路，出來！」 After He said this, He shouted with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"
44. 那死了的人就出來了；手腳纏著布條，臉上包著頭巾。耶穌對他們說： 「解開他，讓他走！」 The dead man came out bound hand and foot with linen strips and with his face wrapped in a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Loose him and let him go."
45. 來到 瑪麗亞 那裡的許多 猶太 人，看到耶穌所做的事，就信了耶穌。 Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what He did believed in Him.
46. 然而，其中有些人到 法利賽 人那裡去，向他們報告耶穌所行的事。 But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
47. 於是祭司長們和 法利賽 人召集了議會，說：「這個人行了很多神蹟，我們該做什麼呢？ So the chief priests and the Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, "What are we going to do since this man does many signs?
48. 如果任憑他這樣下去，大家都會信他， 羅馬 人就會來，奪取我們的聖地和國家！」 If we let Him continue in this way, everybody will believe in Him! Then the Romans will come and remove both our place and our nation."
49. 其中有一個人叫 該亞法，是當年的大祭司，對他們說：「你們什麼都不懂！ One of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all!
50. 也不想一想，一個人替民眾死，免得全民族滅亡，這對你們 是有益處的。」 You're not considering that it is to your advantage that one man should die for the people rather than the whole nation perish."
51. 他說這話不是出於自己，只因他是當年的大祭司，就預言了耶穌要替全民族而死； He did not say this on his own, but being high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus was going to die for the nation,
52. 而且不僅是替 猶太 民族死，也是要把神的那些四散的兒女都召集合一。 and not for the nation only, but also to unite the scattered children of God.
53. 從那天起，他們就商議要把耶穌殺掉。 So from that day on they plotted to kill Him.
54. 因此，耶穌不再公開地在 猶太 人當中行事，而是離開那裡，到曠野附近的地方，進了一個叫 以法蓮 的城，在那裡與門徒們住下了。 Therefore Jesus no longer walked openly among the Jews but departed from there to the countryside near the wilderness, to a town called Ephraim. And He stayed there with the disciples.
55. 猶太 人的逾越節快到了。許多人從鄉下上 耶路撒冷 去，要在節日前潔淨自己。 The Jewish Passover was near, and many went up to Jerusalem from the country to purify themselves before the Passover.
56. 他們尋找耶穌，站在聖殿裡彼此談論說：「你們怎麼看，他絕不會來過節吧？」 They were looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple complex: "What do you think? He won't come to the festival, will He?"
57. 原來，祭司長們和 法利賽 人早就下令，如果有人知道耶穌在哪裡，就要報告，好抓住他。 The chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where He was, he should report it so they could arrest Him.
John 12
1. 逾越節前六天，耶穌來到 拉撒路 所在的 伯大尼，就是他使 拉撒路 從死人中復活的地方。 Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany where Lazarus was, the one Jesus had raised from the dead.
2. 有些人在那裡為耶穌預備晚餐， 瑪妲 正伺候著。 拉撒路 也在與耶穌坐席的人當中。 So they gave a dinner for Him there; Martha was serving them, and Lazarus was one of those reclining at the table with Him.
3. 這時候， 瑪麗亞 拿了一斤 極其貴重的純哪噠香液，膏抹耶穌的腳，又用自己的頭髮擦乾，屋子裡就充滿了香液的氣味。 Then Mary took a pound of fragrant oil-- pure and expensive nard-- anointed Jesus' feet, and wiped His feet with her hair. So the house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.
4. 他的一個門徒，就是後來要出賣耶穌的那個 加略 人 猶大 卻說： Then one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot (who was about to betray Him), said,
5. 「為什麼不把這香液賣三百個銀幣 去分給窮人呢？」 "Why wasn't this fragrant oil sold for 300 denarii and given to the poor?"
6. 他說這話，並不是因為顧念窮人，而是因為他是個賊。他管錢包，常常拿走其中所存的。 He didn't say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief. He was in charge of the money-bag and would steal part of what was put in it.
7. 耶穌說： 「由她吧！她是為我安葬的日子而保存的。 Jesus answered, "Leave her alone; she has kept it for the day of My burial.
8. 要知道，你們總是有窮人與你們在一起，但你們不總是有我。」 For you always have the poor with you, but you do not always have Me."
9. 有一大群 猶太 人知道耶穌在那裡，就來了。他們不僅是為了耶穌的緣故，也是為了看 拉撒路，就是耶穌使他從死人中復活的那個人。 Then a large crowd of the Jews learned He was there. They came not only because of Jesus, but also to see Lazarus the one He had raised from the dead.
10. 於是祭司長們就商議，連 拉撒路 也要殺掉， Therefore the chief priests decided to also kill Lazarus,
11. 因為有許多 猶太 人為了 拉撒路 的緣故，離開他們，信了耶穌。 because he was the reason many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus.
12. 第二天，一大群上來過節的人聽說耶穌要來到 耶路撒冷， The next day, when the large crowd that had come to the festival heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
13. 就拿著棕櫚樹枝出去迎接他，歡呼說： 「 和散那！ 奉主名而來的那一位， 以色列 的王啊， 是蒙祝福的！ 」 they took palm branches and went out to meet Him. They kept shouting: " Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord-- the King of Israel!"
14. 耶穌找來一頭驢駒，騎在上面，正如經上所記： Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, just as it is written:
15. 「 錫安 的女兒啊，不要怕！看哪，你的王騎著驢駒來了！」 Fear no more, Daughter Zion; look! your King is coming, sitting on a donkey's colt.
16. 耶穌的門徒們當初不明白這些事，等到耶穌得了榮耀以後，才想起這些話是指著他寫的，人們果然向他做了這些事。 His disciples did not understand these things at first. However, when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things had been written about Him and that they had done these things to Him.
17. 當耶穌呼喚 拉撒路 從墳墓中出來，使他從死人中復活的時候，那些與耶穌在一起的眾人就見證了這件事。 Meanwhile the crowd, which had been with Him when He called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead, continued to testify.
18. 眾人之所以也去迎接他，是因為他們聽說他行了這神蹟。 This is also why the crowd met Him, because they heard He had done this sign.
19. 於是 法利賽 人互相說：「可見你們真沒用！看，這世界都跟隨他去了。」 Then the Pharisees said to one another, "You see? You've accomplished nothing. Look-- the world has gone after Him!"
20. 當時，上來過節敬拜的人中，有一些 希臘 人。 Now some Greeks were among those who went up to worship at the festival.
21. 這些人來到 加利利 的 伯賽達 人 腓力 那裡，求他說：「先生，我們想見耶穌。」 So they came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, "Sir, we want to see Jesus."
22. 腓力 去告訴 安得烈， 安得烈 和 腓力 就去告訴耶穌。 Philip went and told Andrew; then Andrew and Philip went and told Jesus.
23. 耶穌回答他們，說： 「人子得榮耀的時候到了！ Jesus replied to them, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
24. 我確確實實地告訴你們：一粒麥子如果不落在地裡死去，它仍然是一粒；如果死了，就結出很多子粒 來。 "I assure you: Unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains by itself. But if it dies, it produces a large crop.
25. 愛惜自己生命的，就失去生命；在這世上恨惡自己生命的，將保全生命到永生。 The one who loves his life will lose it, and the one who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
26. 一個人如果要服事我，就當跟從我；我在哪裡，我的僕人也將要在哪裡。如果有人服事我，父將尊重他。 If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me. Where I am, there My servant also will be. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
27. 「現在我的靈魂煩擾。我該說什麼呢？說『父啊，救我脫離這時刻』嗎？但我正是為了這時刻而來的。 "Now My soul is troubled. What should I say-- Father, save Me from this hour? But that is why I came to this hour.
28. 父啊，願你榮耀你的名 ！」 這時候，有聲音從天上傳來：「我已經榮耀了我的名，還要再榮耀！」 Father, glorify Your name!" Then a voice came from heaven: "I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again!"
29. 站在那裡的眾人聽見了，就說：「打雷了。」另有人說：「是天使在對他說話。」 The crowd standing there heard it and said it was thunder. Others said, "An angel has spoken to Him!"
30. 耶穌就回答說： 「這聲音不是為我，而是為你們來的。 Jesus responded, "This voice came, not for Me, but for you.
31. 現在，是這世界受審判的時候了；現在，世界的那掌權者要被趕出去了。 Now is the judgment of this world. Now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
32. 至於我，當我從地上被舉起來的時候，就會吸引所有的人歸向我。」 As for Me, if I am lifted up from the earth I will draw all [people] to Myself."
33. 耶穌說這話是指自己將要怎樣死。 He said this to signify what kind of death He was about to die.
34. 眾人回答他：「我們從律法中聽到，基督是永遠長存的。你怎麼說『人子必須被舉起來』呢？這『人子』到底是誰？」 Then the crowd replied to Him, "We have heard from the law that the Messiah will remain forever. So how can You say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up'? Who is this Son of Man?"
35. 耶穌說： 「光在你們當中的時候不多了。要趁著有光的時候行走，免得黑暗抓住你們！因為在黑暗裡行走的人，不知道自己往哪裡去。 Jesus answered, "The light will be with you only a little longer. Walk while you have the light so that darkness doesn't overtake you. The one who walks in darkness doesn't know where he's going.
36. 你們要趁著有光的時候信這光，好使你們成為光明的兒女。」 耶穌說了這些話，就離開他們被隱藏了。 While you have the light, believe in the light so that you may become sons of light." Jesus said this, then went away and hid from them.
37. 耶穌雖然在他們面前行了這麼多神蹟，他們仍然不信他。 Even though He had performed so many signs in their presence, they did not believe in Him.
38. 這是為要應驗先知 以賽亞 所說的話： 「主啊，我們所傳的，有誰相信了？ 主的膀臂，向誰顯示了？」 But this was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet, who said: Lord, who has believed our message? And who has the arm of the Lord been revealed to?
39. 他們之所以不能相信，是因為 以賽亞 又說過： This is why they were unable to believe, because Isaiah also said:
40. 「神使他們瞎了眼， 硬了心， 免得他們眼睛看見， 心裡明白， 回轉過來， 我就使他們痊癒。」 He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they would not see with their eyes or understand with their hearts, and be converted, and I would heal them.
41. 以賽亞 說了這些話，是因為看見了耶穌的榮耀，就講論他的事。 Isaiah said these things because he saw His glory and spoke about Him.
42. 不過甚至是首領當中也有許多信耶穌的。但是為了 法利賽 人的緣故，他們不敢承認，免得被趕出會堂， Nevertheless, many did believe in Him even among the rulers, but because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, so they would not be banned from the synagogue.
43. 這是因為他們喜愛人的榮耀，勝過喜愛神的榮耀。 For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
44. 耶穌喊著說： 「信我的人，不是信我，而是信派我來的那一位。 Then Jesus cried out, "The one who believes in Me believes not in Me, but in Him who sent Me.
45. 誰看見我，就是看見派我來的那一位。 And the one who sees Me sees Him who sent Me.
46. 我就是光。我來到世上，好讓所有信我的人不住在黑暗裡。 I have come as a light into the world, so that everyone who believes in Me would not remain in darkness.
47. 如果有人聽了我的話卻不遵守，我不定他的罪；因為我來，不是為了定世人的罪，而是為了拯救世人。 If anyone hears My words and doesn't keep them, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.
48. 拒絕我，又不接受我話的人，自有定他罪的：我所講的話語，在末日要定他的罪。 The one who rejects Me and doesn't accept My sayings has this as his judge: the word I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
49. 這是因為我沒有憑自己講話，而是派我來的父給了我命令，要我說什麼和講什麼。 For I have not spoken on My own, but the Father Himself who sent Me has given Me a command as to what I should say and what I should speak.
50. 我知道他的命令就是永恆的生命。所以我所講的，正是照著父所告訴我的來講的。」 I know that His command is eternal life. So the things that I speak, I speak just as the Father has told Me."
John 13
1. 逾越節前，耶穌知道他離開這世界回到父那裡去的時候到了。他一直愛世界上那些屬自己的人，並且愛他們到底。 Before the Passover Festival, Jesus knew that His hour had come to depart from this world to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.
2. 晚餐的時候，魔鬼已經把出賣耶穌的念頭放在 加略 人 西門 的兒子 猶大 的心裡。 Now by the time of supper, the Devil had already put it into the heart of Judas, Simon Iscariot's son, to betray Him.
3. 耶穌知道父把一切交在自己手裡，並且知道自己是從神那裡來，又要回到神那裡去。 Jesus knew that the Father had given everything into His hands, that He had come from God, and that He was going back to God.
4. 他從席位上起身，脫了外衣，拿起一條布巾束在自己腰上， So He got up from supper, laid aside His robe, took a towel, and tied it around Himself.
5. 然後把水倒進盆裡，開始洗門徒們的腳，又用束在腰上的布巾擦乾。 Next, He poured water into a basin and began to wash His disciples' feet and to dry them with the towel tied around Him.
6. 他來到 西門彼得 面前， 彼得 對他說：「主啊，你洗我的腳嗎？」 He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, "Lord, are You going to wash my feet?"
7. 耶穌回答說： 「我所做的，你現在不理解，不過事後就會明白。」 Jesus answered him, "What I'm doing you don't understand now, but afterwards you will know."
8. 彼得 說：「你絕不可洗我的腳，永遠不可！」 耶穌說： 「如果我不洗你，你就與我沒有份了。」 "You will never wash my feet-- ever!" Peter said. Jesus replied, "If I don't wash you, you have no part with Me."
9. 西門彼得 說：「主啊！不單我的腳，連我的手、我的頭也要洗！」 Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, not only my feet, but also my hands and my head."
10. 耶穌說： 「洗過澡的人，除了腳以外，沒有需要洗的；他是完全乾淨的。你們是乾淨的，但不是每個人都乾淨。」 "One who has bathed," Jesus told him, "doesn't need to wash anything except his feet, but he is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you."
11. 原來，耶穌知道要出賣他的是誰，所以說 「你們不是每個人都乾淨。」 For He knew who would betray Him. This is why He said, "You are not all clean."
12. 耶穌洗完了他們的腳以後，穿上外衣，又坐下來，對他們說： 「你們明白我為你們做的事嗎？ When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His robe, He reclined again and said to them, "Do you know what I have done for you?
13. 你們叫我『老師』，稱呼我『主』。你們說得對，因為我就是那一位。 You call Me Teacher and Lord. This is well said, for I am.
14. 因此，如果我——你們的主、你們的老師，還洗你們的腳，那麼你們也應該彼此洗腳。 So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.
15. 事實上，我給你們做了榜樣，好讓你們也照著我為你們所做的去做。 For I have given you an example that you also should do just as I have done for you.
16. 「我確確實實地告訴你們：沒有一個奴僕大過他的主人，也沒有一個被派的大過派他的人。 "I assure you: A slave is not greater than his master, and a messenger is not greater than the one who sent him.
17. 你們既然明白這些事，如果去做，就蒙福了。 If you know these things, you are blessed if you do them.
18. 我不是針對你們每個人而說的。我了解我所揀選的每個人，但這是為要應驗經上的話： 『那吃我餅的人，竟抬腳踢 我。』 I'm not speaking about all of you; I know those I have chosen. But the Scripture must be fulfilled: The one who eats My bread has raised his heel against Me.
19. 「如今，在事情發生以前，我先告訴你們，好讓你們在事情發生的時候，能相信我就是那一位。 "I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am [He].
20. 我確確實實地告訴你們：那接受我所派的人，就是接受我；接受我的，就是接受派我來的那一位。」 I assure you: The one who receives whomever I send receives Me, and the one who receives Me receives Him who sent Me."
21. 說完這些話，耶穌靈裡煩擾，就指名說： 「我確確實實地告訴你們：你們當中有一個人要出賣我。」 When Jesus had said this, He was troubled in His spirit and testified, "I assure you: One of you will betray Me!"
22. 門徒彼此相看，不知道耶穌說的是誰。 The disciples started looking at one another-- uncertain which one He was speaking about.
23. 他的門徒當中，有一個挨著耶穌坐著，是耶穌所愛的。 One of His disciples, the one Jesus loved, was reclining close beside Jesus.
24. 西門彼得 就向他點頭示意，要他問耶穌所講的人到底是誰。 Simon Peter motioned to him to find out who it was He was talking about.
25. 於是那門徒貼近耶穌，問他：「主啊，是誰呢？」 So he leaned back against Jesus and asked Him, "Lord, who is it?"
26. 耶穌回答： 「我蘸一塊餅給誰，就是誰。」 接著，他蘸了一塊餅拿給 加略 人 西門 的兒子 猶大 。 Jesus replied, "He's the one I give the piece of bread to after I have dipped it." When He had dipped the bread, He gave it to Judas, Simon Iscariot's son.
27. 猶大 一接那塊餅， 撒旦 就進了他裡面。於是耶穌對他說： 「你要做的，就快一點做吧。」 After [Judas ate] the piece of bread, Satan entered him. Therefore Jesus told him, "What you're doing, do quickly."
28. 在座的人，沒有一個明白耶穌為什麼對他說這話。 None of those reclining at the table knew why He told him this.
29. 因為 猶大 管錢包，有些人以為耶穌對他說，去買我們過節需要的東西，或是要他給窮人什麼東西。 Since Judas kept the money-bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him, "Buy what we need for the festival," or that he should give something to the poor.
30. 猶大 接了那塊餅，就立刻出去。那時候是夜間了。 After receiving the piece of bread, he went out immediately. And it was night.
31. 猶大 出去以後，耶穌就說： 「現在人子得了榮耀，神藉著人子也得了榮耀。 When he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
32. 神既然藉著人子得了榮耀， 神也將藉著自己榮耀人子，而且立刻就要榮耀他。 If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself and will glorify Him at once.
33. 「孩子們哪，我與你們在一起的時候不多了。你們將尋找我，而且就像我曾經告訴過那些 猶太 人一樣，現在我也告訴你們：我去的地方，你們不能去。 "Children, I am with you a little while longer. You will look for Me, and just as I told the Jews, 'Where I am going you cannot come,' so now I tell you.
34. 「我給你們一條新的命令：就是要你們彼此相愛，就如我愛你們，為要使你們也彼此相愛。 "I give you a new commandment: love one another. Just as I have loved you, you must also love one another.
35. 如果你們彼此之間有了愛，眾人從這一點就會知道你們是我的門徒了。」 By this all people will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another."
36. 西門彼得 問：「主啊，你要到哪裡去呢？」 耶穌回答： 「我去的地方，你現在不能跟著去，但以後會跟著去。」 "Lord," Simon Peter said to Him, "where are You going?" Jesus answered, "Where I am going you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later."
37. 彼得 說：「主啊，為什麼我現在就不能跟隨你呢？為了你，我願意捨棄自己的生命！」 "Lord," Peter asked, "why can't I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You!"
38. 耶穌回答： 「你願意為我捨命嗎？我確確實實地告訴你：雞叫以前，你必定三次不認我。 Jesus replied, "Will you lay down your life for Me? I assure you: A rooster will not crow until you have denied Me three times.
John 14
1. 「你們心裡不要愁煩，要信神，也要信我。 "Your heart must not be troubled. Believe in God; believe also in Me.
2. 在我父家裡有很多住處。如果沒有，我怎麼會告訴你們說，我去是要為你們預備地方呢？ In My Father's house are many dwelling places; if not, I would have told you. I am going away to prepare a place for you.
3. 我如果去為你們預備了地方，就會再來，接你們到我那裡，好使我在哪裡，你們也能在哪裡。 If I go away and prepare a place for you, I will come back and receive you to Myself, so that where I am you may be also.
4. 我往哪裡去，你們知道；那條路，你們也知道。」 You know the way where I am going."
5. 多馬 說：「主啊，我們不知道你要到哪裡去，怎麼能知道那條路呢？」 "Lord," Thomas said, "we don't know where You're going. How can we know the way?"
6. 耶穌說： 「我就是道路、真理、生命。要不是藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。 Jesus told him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
7. 「如果你們認識我，也就會認識我的父。從今以後，你們就認識他，並且已經看到他了。」 "If you know Me, you will also know My Father. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him."
8. 腓力 說：「主啊，請給我們看看父，我們就滿足了。」 "Lord," said Philip, "show us the Father, and that's enough for us."
9. 耶穌回答說： 「 腓力，我與你們在一起這麼久了，你還不認識我嗎？一個人看到了我，就是看到了父。你怎麼還說『請給我們看看父』呢？ Jesus said to him, "Have I been among you all this time without your knowing Me, Philip? The one who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, 'Show us the Father'?
10. 難道你不相信我就在父裡面，父也在我裡面嗎？我對你們說的話，不是憑自己說的，而是住在我裡面的父，在做他的工作。 Don't you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I speak to you I do not speak on My own. The Father who lives in Me does His works.
11. 你們當相信我：我在父裡面，父也在我裡面。即使不信，也當因我所做的事而相信 。 Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me. Otherwise, believe because of the works themselves.
12. 「我確確實實地告訴你們：我所做的事，信我的人也要做，而且要做比這些更大的事。這是因為我就要到父那裡去了。 "I assure you: The one who believes in Me will also do the works that I do. And he will do even greater works than these, because I am going to the Father.
13. 你們奉我的名無論求什麼，我將行這事，好使父藉著子得榮耀。 Whatever you ask in My name, I will do it so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
14. 如果你們奉我的名向我 求什麼，我將成就。 If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it.
15. 「你們如果愛我，就會遵守我的命令。 "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
16. 我也要向父祈求，他就將賜給你們另一位慰助者，讓他與你們在 一起，直到永遠。 And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Counselor to be with you forever.
17. 他就是真理的靈，是世界不能接受的，因為世界看不到他，也不認識他。而你們認識他，因為他與你們同在，並且要在你們裡面。 He is the Spirit of truth. The world is unable to receive Him because it doesn't see Him or know Him. But you do know Him, because He remains with you and will be in you.
18. 我不會撇下你們為孤兒，我要回到你們這裡來。 I will not leave you as orphans; I am coming to you.
19. 「再過一會兒，世人不再看到我了，而你們將看到我。因為我活著，你們也將活著。 "In a little while the world will see Me no longer, but you will see Me. Because I live, you will live too.
20. 在那一天，你們就會明白：我在我父裡面，你們在我裡面，我也在你們裡面。 In that day you will know that I am in My Father, you are in Me, and I am in you.
21. 那領受我命令並遵守的人，就是愛我的。愛我的會蒙我父所愛，我也會愛他，並且會向他顯明我自己。」 The one who has My commands and keeps them is the one who loves Me. And the one who loves Me will be loved by My Father. I also will love him and will reveal Myself to him."
22. 不是 加略 人的那個 猶大 問耶穌：「主啊，怎麼會這樣呢？你為什麼要向我們顯明自己，而不向世人顯明呢？」 Judas (not Iscariot) said to Him, "Lord, how is it You're going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?"
23. 耶穌回答說： 「如果有人愛我，他就會遵守我的話語，我父也會愛他，而且我們將要來到他那裡，並且在他那裡安置我們的住處。 Jesus answered, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
24. 不愛我的人，就不遵守我的話語。事實上，你們所聽見的話語，不是我的，而是那派我來的父的話語。 The one who doesn't love Me will not keep My words. The word that you hear is not Mine but is from the Father who sent Me.
25. 「我還與你們在一起的時候，已經把這些事告訴了你們。 "I have spoken these things to you while I remain with you.
26. 但那位慰助者，就是父以我的名所要派遣的聖靈，將要把一切的事教導你們，並且讓你們想起我對你們說過的一切。 But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit-- the Father will send Him in My name-- will teach you all things and remind you of everything I have told you.
27. 「我把平安留給你們，我把我的平安賜給你們。我給你們的，不像世界所給的。你們心裡不要愁煩，也不要膽怯。 "Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Your heart must not be troubled or fearful.
28. 你們聽過我對你們說：『我去了，還要回到你們這裡來。』如果你們愛我，就會為了我到父那裡去而感到歡喜。這是因為父比我更大。 You have heard Me tell you, 'I am going away and I am coming to you.' If you loved Me, you would have rejoiced that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
29. 如今，在事情發生以前我已經告訴你們了，好讓你們在事情發生的時候能相信。 I have told you now before it happens so that when it does happen you may believe.
30. 我不再對你們多說了。要知道，世界的那掌權者就要來了，而他對我毫無作用。 I will not talk with you much longer, because the ruler of the world is coming. He has no power over Me.
31. 不過我照著父的吩咐如此去做，是為要世界知道我愛父。 「起來，我們走吧！ On the contrary, [I am going away] so that the world may know that I love the Father. Just as the Father commanded Me, so I do. "Get up; let's leave this place.
John 15
1. 「我就是真葡萄樹，我父是園丁。 "I am the true vine, and My Father is the vineyard keeper.
2. 所有屬於我 而不結果子的枝條，他就除掉；而所有結果子的，他就修剪乾淨，好讓它結出更多的果子。 Every branch in Me that does not produce fruit He removes, and He prunes every branch that produces fruit so that it will produce more fruit.
3. 藉著我給你們講的話語，你們已經乾淨了。 You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
4. 你們當住在我裡面，我就住在你們裡面。枝條如果不留在葡萄樹上，就不能由自己結出果子；照樣，你們如果不住在我裡面，你們也是如此。 Remain in Me, and I in you. Just as a branch is unable to produce fruit by itself unless it remains on the vine, so neither can you unless you remain in Me.
5. 「我就是葡萄樹，你們是枝條。那住在我裡面、我也在他裡面的，他才結出很多果子，因為沒有我，你們什麼也不能做。 "I am the vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in Me and I in him produces much fruit, because you can do nothing without Me.
6. 一個人如果不住在我裡面，就像枝條被丟在外面枯乾了，然後被收集扔進火裡焚燒。 If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown aside like a branch and he withers. They gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
7. 你們如果住在我裡面，而我的話也住在你們裡面，那麼，凡是你們所願的，當祈求，就將為你們成就。 If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you want and it will be done for you.
8. 你們結出很多果子，就表明是我的門徒了；從這一點我父也就得榮耀。 My Father is glorified by this: that you produce much fruit and prove to be My disciples.
9. 「正如父愛我，我也愛你們。你們當住在我的愛裡。 "As the Father has loved me, I have also loved you. Remain in My love.
10. 如果你們遵守我的命令，就會住在我的愛裡；就像我遵守了我父的命令，住在他的愛裡那樣。 If you keep My commands you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father's commands and remain in His love.
11. 「我把這些事告訴了你們，是要我的喜樂在 你們裡面，並且使你們的喜樂得以滿足。 "I have spoken these things to you so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
12. 這是我的命令：你們要彼此相愛，就像我愛了你們那樣。 This is My command: love one another as I have loved you.
13. 一個人為他的朋友捨棄自己的生命，人的愛沒有比這更大的了。 No one has greater love than this, that someone would lay down his life for his friends.
14. 你們如果遵行我所吩咐的事，你們就是我的朋友了。 You are My friends if you do what I command you.
15. 我不再稱你們為奴僕，因為奴僕不知道主人所做的事。我卻稱你們為朋友，因為我把從我父所聽到的一切，都讓你們明白了。 I do not call you slaves anymore, because a slave doesn't know what his master is doing. I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything I have heard from My Father.
16. 不是你們揀選了我，而是我揀選了你們，並指派了你們，好使你們去，讓你們結出果子，而且使你們的果子長存。這樣，你們奉我的名無論向父求什麼，他就會賜給你們。 You did not choose Me, but I chose you. I appointed you that you should go out and produce fruit and that your fruit should remain, so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
17. 我將這些事吩咐你們，是要讓你們彼此相愛。 This is what I command you: love one another.
18. 「這世界如果恨你們，你們應當知道，世界在恨你們之前已經恨我了。 "If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me before it hated you.
19. 如果你們屬於這世界，世界會把你們做為屬自己的來愛；但是，因為你們不屬於這世界，而是我從世界中揀選了你們，所以世界就恨你們。 If you were of the world, the world would love [you as] its own. However, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of it, the world hates you.
20. 你們當記住我對你們說過的話：「沒有一個奴僕大過他的主人。」他們既然逼迫了我，也會逼迫你們；如果他們遵守了我的話，也就會遵守你們的話。 Remember the word I spoke to you: 'A slave is not greater than his master.' If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you. If they kept My word, they will also keep yours.
21. 但是，因我名的緣故，他們會對你們做這一切事，因為他們不認識派我來的那一位。 But they will do all these things to you on account of My name, because they don't know the One who sent Me.
22. 如果我沒有來，也沒有教導他們，他們就沒有罪；但如今，他們的罪無可推諉了。 If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin. Now they have no excuse for their sin.
23. 恨我的，也恨我的父。 The one who hates Me also hates My Father.
24. 如果我沒有在他們當中做別人從未做過的事，他們就沒有罪；但如今他們雖然看到了，還是恨我和我的父。 If I had not done the works among them that no one else has done, they would not have sin. Now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
25. 不過這是為要應驗他們律法上所記載的話： 『他們無緣無故地恨我。』 But [this happened] so that the statement written in their law might be fulfilled: They hated Me for no reason.
26. 「我將從父那裡派遣慰助者來，他就是從父而來的真理的靈。他來的時候，將為我做見證。 "When the Counselor comes, the One I will send to you from the Father-- the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father-- He will testify about Me.
27. 並且你們也要做見證，因為你們從一開始就與我在一起。 You also will testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
John 16
1. 「我把這些事告訴了你們，免得你們被絆倒 。 "I have told you these things to keep you from stumbling.
2. 他們將要把你們趕出會堂。不但如此，時候就要到了！那殺你們的人，都會以為自己是在事奉神 。 They will ban you from the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering service to God.
3. 他們做這些事，是因為不認識父，也不認識我。 They will do these things because they haven't known the Father or Me.
4. 不過我把這些事告訴了你們，是為了當事情發生的時候，你們會記起我對你們說過了。我當初沒有告訴你們這些事，是因為我一直與你們在一起。 But I have told you these things so that when their time comes you may remember I told them to you. I didn't tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
5. 「現在我要回到派我來的那一位面前，你們當中卻沒有人問我：『你要到哪裡去？』 "But now I am going away to Him who sent Me, and not one of you asks Me, 'Where are You going?'
6. 只因為我對你們說了這些話，你們心裡就充滿了憂傷。 Yet, because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.
7. 但我把真相告訴你們：我離去對你們是有益處的，因為我如果不去，慰助者就不會到你們這裡來；如果我去了，我就會派遣他到你們這裡來。 Nevertheless, I am telling you the truth. It is for your benefit that I go away, because if I don't go away the Counselor will not come to you. If I go, I will send Him to you.
8. 他來了，要在關於罪、關於義、關於審判的事上，使世界知罪。 When He comes, He will convict the world about sin, righteousness, and judgment:
9. 關於罪，是因為世界不信我； about sin, because they do not believe in Me;
10. 關於義，是因為我到父那裡去，而你們不再看到我了； about righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;
11. 關於審判，是因為世界的那掌權者已經被定罪了。 and about judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.
12. 「我還有很多事要告訴你們，可是你們現在擔當不了， "I still have many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.
13. 不過當那位真理的靈來了，他就會引導你們進入一切真理 。那時，他不會憑著自己說話，只把所聽到的說出來，並且把那些就要來的事傳講給你們。 When the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all the truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak whatever He hears. He will also declare to you what is to come.
14. 他將榮耀我，因為他將從我領受，並傳講給你們。 He will glorify Me, because He will take from what is Mine and declare it to you.
15. 父所擁有的一切，都是我的。所以我說，聖靈將從我領受，並傳講給你們。 Everything the Father has is Mine. This is why I told you that He takes from what is Mine and will declare it to you.
16. 「過一會兒，你們就不再看到我了；再過一會兒，你們又將見到我 。」 "A little while and you will no longer see Me; again a little while and you will see Me."
17. 於是他的門徒當中有的彼此問：「他對我們說 『過一會兒，你們就看不到我了；再過一會兒，你們又將見到我』，還說 『是因為我要到父那裡去』，這是什麼意思呢？」 Therefore some of His disciples said to one another, "What is this He tells us: 'A little while and you will not see Me; again a little while and you will see Me'; and, 'because I am going to the Father'?"
18. 他們又說：「他說的 『過一會兒』 是什麼意思呢？我們不明白他在說什麼。」 They said, "What is this He is saying, 'A little while'? We don't know what He's talking about!"
19. 耶穌知道他們想要問他，就對他們說： 「我剛才說『過一會兒，你們就看不到我了；再過一會兒，你們又將見到我』，你們就為了這話彼此議論嗎？ Jesus knew they wanted to question Him, so He said to them, "Are you asking one another about what I said, 'A little while and you will not see Me; again a little while and you will see Me'?
20. 「我確確實實地告訴你們：你們將會痛哭、哀號，這世界反而會喜樂；你們將會憂傷，然而你們的憂傷要變成喜樂。 "I assure you: You will weep and wail, but the world will rejoice. You will become sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn to joy.
21. 婦人生產的時候會有憂慮，因為她的時候到了；但是生了孩子以後，她就因著有人出生到世上的喜樂，而不再記住那痛苦了。 When a woman is in labor she has pain because her time has come. But when she has given birth to a child, she no longer remembers the suffering because of the joy that a person has been born into the world.
22. 這樣，你們現在雖然也有憂慮，但是我會再見到你們，你們心裡將喜樂，並且沒有人能奪去你們的喜樂。 So you also have sorrow now. But I will see you again. Your hearts will rejoice, and no one will rob you of your joy.
23. 在那一天，你們什麼也不會問我了。 「我確確實實地告訴你們：你們奉我的名無論向父求什麼，他都將賜給你們。 In that day you will not ask Me anything. "I assure you: Anything you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
24. 直到如今，你們沒有奉我的名求過什麼。你們祈求吧！就會得到，好使你們的喜樂得以滿足。 Until now you have asked for nothing in My name. Ask and you will receive, that your joy may be complete.
25. 「我用比喻對你們說了這些話。但是時候就要到了！那時我不再用比喻對你們說話，而是要明確地告訴你們有關父的事。 "I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. A time is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures, but I will tell you plainly about the Father.
26. 在那一天，你們會奉我的名祈求，而且我並不是說我要替你們向父祈求。 In that day you will ask in My name. I am not telling you that I will make requests to the Father on your behalf.
27. 要知道，父自己愛你們，因為你們已經愛我，並且相信我是從神 而來的。 For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
28. 我從父而出，來到這世界；又要離開這世界，到父那裡去。」 I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I am leaving the world and going to the Father."
29. 他的門徒們說：「看，如今你說得明明白白，而不說比喻了。 "Ah!" His disciples said. "Now You're speaking plainly and not using any figurative language.
30. 現在我們已經明白你知道一切，也不需要任何人問你，從這一點我們就相信你是從神而來的。」 Now we know that You know everything and don't need anyone to question You. By this we believe that You came from God."
31. 耶穌對他們說： 「你們現在相信嗎？ Jesus responded to them, "Do you now believe?
32. 看哪，時候就要到了，而且已經到了！你們要被驅散，每個人到自己的地方，留下我一個人。其實我不是獨自一人，因為父與我同在。 Look: An hour is coming, and has come, when each of you will be scattered to his own home, and you will leave Me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
33. 我把這些事告訴了你們，好讓你們在我裡面有平安。在世上你們有患難，然而你們要鼓起勇氣！我已經勝過了這世界。」 I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. You will have suffering in this world. Be courageous! I have conquered the world."
John 17
1. 耶穌說完了這些話，就舉目望天，說： 「父啊， 時候到了！ 願你榮耀你的兒子， 好讓兒子也榮耀你， Jesus spoke these things, looked up to heaven, and said: Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son so that the Son may glorify You,
2. 正如你賜給他權柄管轄所有的人， 好讓他把永恆的生命給與一切你所賜給他的人。 for You gave Him authority over all flesh; so He may give eternal life to all You have given Him.
3. 認識你——獨一的真神， 並認識你所差派的耶穌基督， 這就是永恆的生命。 This is eternal life: that they may know You, the only true God, and the One You have sent-- Jesus Christ.
4. 我完成了你交給我該做的事， 因而在地上榮耀了你。 I have glorified You on the earth by completing the work You gave Me to do.
5. 父啊， 現在願你用那榮耀，與你自己一起榮耀我， 那榮耀是世界存在以前我與你一起就有的。 Now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with that glory I had with You before the world existed.
6. 「你從世上所賜給我的人， 我已經把你的名向他們顯明了。 他們是你的， 你把他們賜給了我， 他們也遵守了你的話語。 I have revealed Your name to the men You gave Me from the world. They were Yours, You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
7. 現在他們已經知道， 你所賜給我的一切都是從你而來的， Now they know that all things You have given to Me are from You,
8. 因為你所賜給我的話語， 我已經給了他們。 他們領受了， 也確實知道我是從你而來的， 並且相信是你差派了我。 because the words that You gave Me, I have given them. They have received them and have known for certain that I came from You. They have believed that You sent Me.
9. 我為他們祈求。 我不是為世人， 而是為你所賜給我的人祈求， 因為他們是你的。 I pray for them. I am not praying for the world but for those You have given Me, because they are Yours.
10. 一切屬於我的都是你的， 屬於你的也是我的， 並且我在他們裡面得了榮耀。 All My things are Yours, and Yours are Mine, and I have been glorified in them.
11. 今後我不在這世界上了， 而他們在這世界上， 我卻要到你那裡去。 聖父啊， 願你奉你的名， 就是奉你賜給我的名保守他們， 使他們合而為一， 就像我們那樣。 I am no longer in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name that You have given Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
12. 我 與他們在一起的時候， 我奉你的名， 就是奉你賜給我的名 保守了他們，也護衛了他們。 他們當中除了那滅亡 之子以外， 沒有一個人失落。 這是為要應驗經上的話。 While I was with them, I was protecting them by Your name that You have given Me. I guarded them and not one of them is lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture may be fulfilled.
13. 但如今我就要到你那裡去了。 我在世上說這些話， 是要讓他們裡面充滿我的喜樂。 Now I am coming to You, and I speak these things in the world so that they may have My joy completed in them.
14. 我把你的話語給了他們， 而世界恨他們， 因為他們不屬於這世界， 就像我不屬於這世界那樣。 I have given them Your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, as I am not of the world.
15. 我不是求你帶他們離開這世界， 而是求你保守他們脫離那惡者。 I am not praying that You take them out of the world but that You protect them from the evil one.
16. 他們不屬於這世界， 就像我不屬於這世界那樣。 They are not of the world, as I am not of the world.
17. 願你在真理中使他們分別為聖， 你的話語就是真理。 Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
18. 正如你差派我到世界上來， 我也差派他們到世界上去。 As You sent Me into the world, I also have sent them into the world.
19. 我為了他們，自己分別為聖， 好使他們也能在真理中被分別為聖。 I sanctify Myself for them, so they also may be sanctified by the truth.
20. 「我不僅為他們祈求， 還為那些因他們的話而信我的人祈求， I pray not only for these, but also for those who believe in Me through their message.
21. 願他們都合而為一。 父啊， 正如你在我裡面，我也在你裡面， 願他們也在我們裡面， 好讓世界相信是你差派了我。 May they all be one, as You, Father, are in Me and I am in You. May they also be one in Us, so the world may believe You sent Me.
22. 你賜給我的榮耀， 我已經給了他們， 使他們合而為一， 就像我們是一體的。 I have given them the glory You have given Me. May they be one as We are one.
23. 我在他們裡面，你在我裡面， 願他們能完全合一， 好讓世界知道是你差派了我， 也知道你愛他們， 就像愛我那樣。 I am in them and You are in Me. May they be made completely one, so the world may know You have sent Me and have loved them as You have loved Me.
24. 父啊， 我在哪裡，願你所賜給我的人也能與我在哪裡， 好讓他們能看見你所賜給我的榮耀， 因為你在創世以前就愛我了。 Father, I desire those You have given Me to be with Me where I am. Then they will see My glory, which You have given Me because You loved Me before the world's foundation.
25. 公義的父啊， 雖然世界不認識你，我卻認識你， 這些人也知道是你差派了我。 Righteous Father! The world has not known You. However, I have known You, and these have known that You sent Me.
26. 我將你的名向他們顯明了， 並且還要顯明。 這樣，你愛我的愛就能在他們裡面， 我也能在他們裡面。」 I made Your name known to them and will make it known, so the love You have loved Me with may be in them and I may be in them.
John 18
1. 耶穌說了這些話，就與他的門徒們一起出去，過了 汲淪 溪谷。在那裡有一個園子，耶穌和他的門徒們進去了。 After Jesus had said these things, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where there was a garden, and He and His disciples went into it.
2. 出賣耶穌的 猶大 也知道那地方，因為耶穌經常在那裡與他的門徒們一同聚集。 Judas, who betrayed Him, also knew the place, because Jesus often met there with His disciples.
3. 於是 猶大 領著一隊士兵，還有祭司長們和 法利賽 人的差役們，帶著燈籠、火把、兵器來到那裡。 So Judas took a company of soldiers and some temple police from the chief priests and the Pharisees and came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
4. 耶穌知道就要臨到自己的一切，於是上前對他們說： 「你們找誰？」 Then Jesus, knowing everything that was about to happen to Him, went out and said to them, "Who is it you're looking for?"
5. 他們回答：「 拿撒勒 人耶穌。」 耶穌說： 「我就是。」 出賣他的 猶大 也與他們站在一起。 "Jesus the Nazarene," they answered. "I am He," Jesus told them. Judas, who betrayed Him, was also standing with them.
6. 耶穌一說 「我就是」，他們就往後退，倒在地上。 When He told them, "I am He," they stepped back and fell to the ground.
7. 於是耶穌又問： 「你們找誰？」 他們說：「 拿撒勒 人耶穌。」 Then He asked them again, "Who is it you're looking for?" "Jesus the Nazarene," they said.
8. 耶穌回答： 「我已經告訴你們『我就是』。因此，你們如果找我，就讓這些人走吧！」 "I told you I am [He]," Jesus replied. "So if you're looking for Me, let these men go."
9. 這是為要應驗耶穌說過的話： 「你所賜給我的人，我一個也沒有丟失。」 This was to fulfill the words He had said: "I have not lost one of those You have given Me."
10. 西門彼得 帶著一把刀。他拔出刀來，向大祭司的奴僕砍去，削掉了他的右耳。那奴僕的名字是 馬勒古 。 Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it, struck the high priest's slave, and cut off his right ear. (The slave's name was Malchus.)
11. 耶穌就對 彼得 說： 「把刀收回鞘裡！父所賜給我的杯，我難道能不喝嗎？」 At that, Jesus said to Peter, "Sheathe your sword! Am I not to drink the cup the Father has given Me?"
12. 於是那隊士兵和千夫長，以及 猶太 人的差役們，抓住耶穌，把他捆綁起來， Then the company of soldiers, the commander, and the Jewish temple police arrested Jesus and tied Him up.
13. 先帶 到 亞納 面前，因為 亞納 是當年的大祭司 該亞法 的岳父。 First they led Him to Annas, for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
14. 該亞法 就是曾經向那些 猶太 人建議「一個人替民眾死 是有益處的」那個人。 Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was advantageous that one man should die for the people.
15. 這時， 西門彼得 和另一個門徒跟著耶穌。那門徒是大祭司所認識的，所以跟著耶穌進了大祭司的院子； Meanwhile Simon Peter was following Jesus, as was another disciple. That disciple was an acquaintance of the high priest; so he went with Jesus into the high priest's courtyard.
16. 彼得 卻站在門外。後來，大祭司認識的那個門徒出來，對看門的說了一聲，就把 彼得 帶了進去。 But Peter remained standing outside by the door. So the other disciple, the one known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the girl who was the doorkeeper and brought Peter in.
17. 那看門的女僕問 彼得 ：「你不也是這個人的門徒嗎？」 彼得 說：「我不是。」 Then the slave girl who was the doorkeeper said to Peter, "You aren't one of this man's disciples too, are you?" "I am not!" he said.
18. 因為當時天氣寒冷，奴僕和差役們生了一堆炭火，站著取暖。 彼得 也與他們站在一起取暖。 Now the slaves and the temple police had made a charcoal fire, because it was cold. They were standing there warming themselves, and Peter was standing with them, warming himself.
19. 那時，大祭司盤問耶穌有關他的門徒和他教導的事。 The high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and about His teaching.
20. 耶穌回答他： 「我一向公開地對世人講話。我總是在會堂和聖殿，就是所有 猶太 人聚集的地方教導人。我沒有在隱祕中講過什麼。 "I have spoken openly to the world," Jesus answered him. "I have always taught in the synagogue and in the temple complex, where all the Jews congregate, and I haven't spoken anything in secret.
21. 你為什麼問我呢？你可以去問那些聽見過的人，我對他們講了什麼。你看，我所說的，那些人都知道。」 Why do you question Me? Question those who heard what I told them. Look, they know what I said."
22. 耶穌說了這些話，站在旁邊的一個差役就打了他一巴掌，說：「你這樣回答大祭司嗎？」 When He had said these things, one of the temple police standing by slapped Jesus, saying, "Is this the way you answer the high priest?"
23. 耶穌回答他： 「如果我說得不對，你可以見證哪裡不對；如果說得對，你為什麼打我呢？」 "If I have spoken wrongly," Jesus answered him, "give evidence about the wrong; but if rightly, why do you hit Me?"
24. 那時候耶穌仍然被捆綁， 亞納 把他押送到大祭司 該亞法 那裡去。 Then Annas sent Him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
25. 西門彼得 正站著取暖，有人對他說：「你不也是他的門徒嗎？」 彼得 否認說：「我不是。」 Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said to him, "You aren't one of His disciples too, are you?" He denied it and said, "I am not!"
26. 大祭司的一個奴僕，就是被 彼得 削掉耳朵的那個人的親戚，說：「我不是看見你與他一起在園子裡嗎？」 One of the high priest's slaves, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, said, "Didn't I see you with Him in the garden?"
27. 彼得 再次否認。立時，雞就叫了。 Peter then denied it again. Immediately a rooster crowed.
28. 他們把耶穌從 該亞法 那裡帶到總督府，那時是清晨。他們為了不被汙穢，能吃逾越節的晚餐，就沒有進入總督府。 Then they took Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor's headquarters. It was early morning. They did not enter the headquarters themselves; otherwise they would be defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
29. 於是 彼拉多 出來，到他們那裡，說：「你們提出什麼來控告這個人？」 Then Pilate came out to them and said, "What charge do you bring against this man?"
30. 他們回答說：「這個人如果不是作惡的，我們就不會把他交給你了。」 They answered him, "If this man weren't a criminal, we wouldn't have handed Him over to you."
31. 彼拉多 對他們說：「你們自己把他帶走，按照你們的律法審判他吧。」 那些 猶太 人回答說：「我們不可以處死人。」 So Pilate told them, "Take Him yourselves and judge Him according to your law." "It's not legal for us to put anyone to death," the Jews declared.
32. 這是為要應驗耶穌說過的話，就是他指明自己將要怎樣死的那些話。 They said this so that Jesus' words might be fulfilled signifying what sort of death He was going to die.
33. 彼拉多 又進了總督府，把耶穌叫來，問他：「你是 猶太 人的王嗎？」 Then Pilate went back into the headquarters, summoned Jesus, and said to Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?"
34. 耶穌回答： 「這話是你自己說的，還是別人告訴過你關於我的事呢？」 Jesus answered, "Are you asking this on your own, or have others told you about Me?"
35. 彼拉多 說：「難道我是 猶太 人嗎？是你本國的人和祭司長們把你交給了我。你到底做了什麼？」 "I'm not a Jew, am I?" Pilate replied. "Your own nation and the chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?"
36. 耶穌回答： 「我的國不屬於這個世界。如果我的國屬於這個世界，我的僕人們早就會爭戰，不讓我被交給那些 猶太 人。但如今，我的國不在這裡。」 "My kingdom is not of this world," said Jesus. "If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would fight, so that I wouldn't be handed over to the Jews. As it is, My kingdom does not have its origin here."
37. 於是 彼拉多 問：「那麼，你就是王？」 耶穌回答： 「是你說的，我就是王。我為此而生，也為此而來到這世界，是要為真理做見證。凡是屬於真理的人，都聽我的聲音。」 "You are a king then?" Pilate asked. "You say that I'm a king," Jesus replied. "I was born for this, and I have come into the world for this: to testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to My voice."
38. 彼拉多 說：「什麼是真理？」 說了這話，他又出去對 猶太 人說：「我查不出他有什麼罪。 "What is truth?" said Pilate. After he had said this, he went out to the Jews again and told them, "I find no grounds for charging Him.
39. 不過你們有一個慣例：每逢逾越節，我可以給你們釋放一個囚犯。那麼，你們願意我給你們釋放這 猶太 人的王嗎？」 You have a custom that I release one [prisoner] to you at the Passover. So, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"
40. 他們就再次大聲喊叫說：「不要這個人！要 巴拉巴 ！」這 巴拉巴 其實是個強盜。 They shouted back, "Not this man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a revolutionary.
John 19
1. 於是 彼拉多 吩咐 把耶穌帶走，鞭打了。 Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
2. 士兵們用荊棘編了冠冕，戴在耶穌的頭上，又給他披上紫色袍子。 The soldiers also twisted together a crown of thorns, put it on His head, and threw a purple robe around Him.
3. 他們不斷地來到他面前說：「萬歲， 猶太 人的王！」又不住地用手掌打他。 And they repeatedly came up to Him and said, "Hail, King of the Jews!" and were slapping His face.
4. 彼拉多 再次出來對 猶太 人說：「看！我把他帶出來給你們，是要你們知道，我查不出他有什麼罪。」 Pilate went outside again and said to them, "Look, I'm bringing Him outside to you to let you know I find no grounds for charging Him."
5. 這時候，耶穌出來了，他戴著荊棘冠冕，披著紫色袍子。 彼拉多 對他們說：「看，這個人！」 Then Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said to them, "Here is the man!"
6. 祭司長們和差役們一看見耶穌，就喊叫說：「釘上十字架！釘上十字架！」 彼拉多 對他們說：「你們自己把他帶走釘上十字架！要知道，我查不出他有罪。」 When the chief priests and the temple police saw Him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" Pilate responded, "Take Him and crucify Him yourselves, for I find no grounds for charging Him."
7. 那些 猶太 人回答：「我們有律法，按照這律法，他是應該死的，因為他把自己當做神的兒子。」 "We have a law," the Jews replied to him, "and according to that law He must die, because He made Himself the Son of God."
8. 彼拉多 一聽這話，就更加懼怕了， When Pilate heard this statement, he was more afraid than ever.
9. 又進了總督府，問耶穌：「你到底是從哪裡來的？」耶穌卻沒有回答他。 He went back into the headquarters and asked Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus did not give him an answer.
10. 彼拉多 就說：「你不與我說話嗎？難道你不知道我有權釋放你，也有權把你釘上十字架嗎？」 So Pilate said to Him, "You're not talking to me? Don't You know that I have the authority to release You and the authority to crucify You?"
11. 耶穌回答： 「如果權柄不是從上面賜給你的，你就對我沒有任何權柄。所以，把我交給你的人有更大的罪。」 "You would have no authority over Me at all," Jesus answered him, "if it hadn't been given you from above. This is why the one who handed Me over to you has the greater sin."
12. 由此， 彼拉多 就想要釋放耶穌。可是 猶太 人喊叫說：「你如果釋放這個人，就不是凱撒的朋友了。所有把自己當做王的，就是反對凱撒的！」 From that moment Pilate made every effort to release Him. But the Jews shouted, "If you release this man, you are not Caesar's friend. Anyone who makes himself a king opposes Caesar!"
13. 彼拉多 聽了這話，就把耶穌帶到外面，並在一個叫「 鋪石臺 」的地方坐上了審判席。「 鋪石臺 」 希伯來 語 叫做「 伽巴達 」。 When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus outside. He sat down on the judge's bench in a place called the Stone Pavement (but in Hebrew Gabbatha).
14. 那天是逾越節的預備日，大約在中午十二點， 彼拉多 對 猶太 人說：「看，你們的王！」 It was the preparation day for the Passover, and it was about six in the morning. Then he told the Jews, "Here is your king!"
15. 他們就大聲喊叫：「除掉他！除掉他！把他釘上十字架！」 彼拉多 問：「我可以把你們的王釘上十字架嗎？」 祭司長們回答：「除了凱撒，我們沒有王！」 But they shouted, "Take Him away! Take Him away! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Should I crucify your king?" "We have no king but Caesar!" the chief priests answered.
16. 於是 彼拉多 把耶穌交給他們去釘上十字架。 他們就把耶穌帶走了。 So then, because of them, he handed Him over to be crucified. Therefore they took Jesus away.
17. 耶穌自己背著十字架出來，前往一個叫「骷髏地」的地方， 希伯來 語 叫做「 各各他 」。 Carrying His own cross, He went out to what is called Skull Place, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
18. 在那裡，他們把耶穌釘上十字架，還把另外兩個人與耶穌一起釘上十字架，這邊一個，那邊一個，耶穌在中間。 There they crucified Him and two others with Him, one on either side, with Jesus in the middle.
19. 彼拉多 還寫了一個牌子，掛在十字架上，寫的是：「 拿撒勒 人耶穌， 猶太 人的王。」 Pilate also had a sign lettered and put on the cross. The inscription was: JESUS THE NAZARENE THE KING OF THE JEWS
20. 許多 猶太 人都讀了這牌子，因為耶穌被釘十字架的地方離城不遠，而且牌子是用 希伯來 文 、 拉丁 文、 希臘 文寫的。 Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
21. 猶太 人的祭司長們對 彼拉多 說：「請不要寫『 猶太 人的王』，而要寫『這個人說：我是 猶太 人的王。』」 So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Don't write, 'The King of the Jews,' but that He said, 'I am the King of the Jews.'"
22. 彼拉多 回答：「我所寫的，我已經寫了。」 Pilate replied, "What I have written, I have written."
23. 士兵們將耶穌釘上十字架以後，把他的衣服拿來分成四份，每人一份。他們又拿了裡衣，這件裡衣沒有接縫，從上到下由整片織成。 When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took His clothes and divided them into four parts, a part for each soldier. They also took the tunic, which was seamless, woven in one piece from the top.
24. 他們彼此說：「不要把它撕開，讓我們抽籤，看它是誰的。」這是為要應驗經上的話： 「他們分了我的衣服，又為我的衣裳抽籤。」 士兵們果然做了這些事。 So they said to one another, "Let's not tear it, but toss for it, to see who gets it." [They did this] to fulfill the Scripture that says: They divided My clothes among themselves, and they cast lots for My clothing. And this is what the soldiers did.
25. 在耶穌的十字架旁邊，站著他的母親、他母親的妹妹、 克羅帕 的妻子 瑪麗亞，以及 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 。 Standing by the cross of Jesus were His mother, His mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
26. 耶穌看到母親和他所愛的那門徒站在旁邊，就對母親說： 「母親，看哪，你的兒子！」 When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple He loved standing there, He said to His mother, "Woman, here is your son."
27. 然後對那門徒說： 「看哪，你的母親！」 從那時候起，那門徒就把耶穌的母親接到自己的家裡。 Then He said to the disciple, "Here is your mother." And from that hour the disciple took her into his home.
28. 這事以後，耶穌知道一切都已經完成了，為要應驗經上的話，就說： 「我渴了。」 After this, when Jesus knew that everything was now accomplished that the Scripture might be fulfilled, He said, "I'm thirsty!"
29. 那裡放著一個裝滿酸酒的容器。他們就把蘸滿了酸酒的海綿套在牛膝草上，送到他的嘴邊。 A jar full of sour wine was sitting there; so they fixed a sponge full of sour wine on hyssop and held it up to His mouth.
30. 耶穌嘗了酸酒後，就說： 「成了！」 然後垂下頭，交出了靈魂。 When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished!" Then bowing His head, He gave up His spirit.
31. 因為那天是預備日，又因為那個安息日是個大節日，那些 猶太 人為了不讓屍體在安息日留在十字架上，就向 彼拉多 請求，好把他們的腿打斷，把屍體拿走。 Since it was the preparation day, the Jews did not want the bodies to remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special day). They requested that Pilate have the men's legs broken and that [their bodies] be taken away.
32. 士兵們就來，把與耶穌一起被釘十字架的頭一個人的腿打斷，又把另一個人的也打斷了。 So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man and of the other one who had been crucified with Him.
33. 可是，當他們來到耶穌那裡，看見他已經死了，就沒有打斷他的腿。 When they came to Jesus, they did not break His legs since they saw that He was already dead.
34. 不過有一個士兵用長矛刺入耶穌的肋旁，立刻有血和水流了出來。 But one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out.
35. 看見這事的那人做了見證——他的見證是真實的，並且他知道他所說的是真實的——這是為了要你們也信。 He who saw this has testified so that you also may believe. His testimony is true, and he knows he is telling the truth.
36. 事實上，這些事發生，是為要應驗經上的話： 「他的骨頭，一根也不被折斷。」 For these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: Not one of His bones will be broken.
37. 另有一段經文也說： 「他們將看見自己所刺的那一位。」 Also, another Scripture says: They will look at the One they pierced.
38. 這些事以後， 亞利馬太 的 約瑟 請求 彼拉多，要領取耶穌的遺體。 約瑟 也是耶穌的門徒，不過是暗暗地做門徒，因為他怕那些 猶太 人。 彼拉多 准許了，他就來把耶穌的遺體領去。 After this, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus-- but secretly because of his fear of the Jews-- asked Pilate that he might remove Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and took His body away.
39. 當初在夜裡來到耶穌那裡的 尼克迪莫 也來了。他帶著沒藥和沉香的混合香料，大約三十公斤 。 Nicodemus (who had previously come to Him at night) also came, bringing a mixture of about 75 pounds of myrrh and aloes.
40. 他們領了耶穌的遺體，按 猶太 人預備葬禮的規矩，用細麻布條和香料把遺體纏裹起來。 Then they took Jesus' body and wrapped it in linen cloths with the aromatic spices, according to the burial custom of the Jews.
41. 耶穌被釘十字架的地方有一個園子，園子裡有一座新墓穴，從來沒有安放過人。 There was a garden in the place where He was crucified. A new tomb was in the garden; no one had yet been placed in it.
42. 因為那天是 猶太 人的預備日，那墓穴又在附近，他們就把耶穌安放在那裡。 They place Jesus there because of the Jewish preparation and since the tomb was nearby.
John 20
1. 在一週頭一天 的清晨，天還黑的時候， 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 就來到墓穴那裡，看見那石頭已經從墓穴被挪開了。 On the first day of the week Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early, while it was still dark. She saw that the stone had been removed from the tomb.
2. 她就跑到 西門彼得 和耶穌所愛的那另一個門徒那裡去，對他們說：「他們從墓穴裡把主挪走了，我們不知道他們把他放在哪裡！」 So she ran to Simon Peter and to the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have put Him!"
3. 於是 彼得 和那另一個門徒就出來，往墓穴去。 At that, Peter and the other disciple went out, heading for the tomb.
4. 兩個人一起跑，那另一個門徒跑得比 彼得 快一點，先到了墓穴。 The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and got to the tomb first.
5. 他彎腰去看，見那細麻布條放在那裡，不過他沒有進去。 Stooping down, he saw the linen cloths lying there, yet he did not go in.
6. 西門彼得 跟著他，也到了，並且進了墓穴，看見那細麻布條放在那裡， Then, following him, Simon Peter came also. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
7. 也看見原來在耶穌頭上的那塊頭巾，沒有與那細麻布條放在一起，被捲了起來，分開放在一邊。 The wrapping that had been on His head was not lying with the linen cloths but was folded up in a separate place by itself.
8. 這時候，先來到墓穴的那另一個門徒也進去了。他看見了，就信了。 The other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, then entered the tomb, saw, and believed.
9. 原來，他們從來沒有明白過經上所說「他必須從死人中復活」的那句話。 For they still did not understand the Scripture that He must rise from the dead.
10. 於是那些門徒就離開，回到他們的住處去了。 Then the disciples went home again.
11. 瑪麗亞 卻站在墓穴外面哭。她哭著，彎腰往墓穴裡看， But Mary stood outside facing the tomb, crying. As she was crying, she stooped to look into the tomb.
12. 看見兩位身穿白衣的天使，坐在原來安放耶穌遺體的地方，一位在頭的地方，一位在腳的地方。 She saw two angels in white sitting there, one at the head and one at the feet, where Jesus' body had been lying.
13. 天使們問她：「婦人，你為什麼哭？」 她說：「因為他們把我的主挪走了，我不知道他們把他放在哪裡。」 They said to her, "Woman, why are you crying?" "Because they've taken away my Lord," she told them, "and I don't know where they've put Him."
14. 說了這些話，她轉過身來，看見耶穌站在那裡，卻沒有認出他就是耶穌。 Having said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, though she did not know it was Jesus.
15. 耶穌說： 「婦人，你為什麼哭呢？你在找誰？」 瑪麗亞 以為他是園丁，就對他說：「先生，如果是你把他抬走的，就請告訴我，你把他放在哪裡了，我好把他取回來。」 "Woman," Jesus said to her, "why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?" Supposing He was the gardener, she replied, "Sir, if you've removed Him, tell me where you've put Him, and I will take Him away."
16. 耶穌對她說： 「 瑪麗亞 ！」 她轉過身，用 希伯來 語 對耶穌說：「拉波尼 ！」——這意思是「老師」。 Jesus said, "Mary." Turning around, she said to Him in Hebrew, "Rabbouni!"-- which means "Teacher."
17. 耶穌說： 「不要碰我，因為我還沒有上到父那裡。你到我弟兄們那裡去告訴他們：我要上到我的父那裡，他也是你們的父；我要上到我的神那裡，他也是你們的神。」 "Don't cling to Me," Jesus told her, "for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go to My brothers and tell them that I am ascending to My Father and your Father-- to My God and your God."
18. 茉大拉 的 瑪麗亞 就去告訴門徒們：「我看到主了！」她又把耶穌對她說的這些話告訴他們。 Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, "I have seen the Lord!" And she told them what He had said to her.
19. 那日，也就是一週的頭一天，傍晚的時候，門徒們所在地方的門戶已經關上了，因為他們怕那些 猶太 人。耶穌出現了，站在他們當中，對他們說： 「願你們平安！」 In the evening of that first day of the week, the disciples were [gathered together] with the doors locked because of their fear of the Jews. Then Jesus came, stood among them, and said to them, "Peace to you!"
20. 說了這話，他把手和肋旁給他們看。門徒們看見了主，就歡喜。 Having said this, He showed them His hands and His side. So the disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
21. 耶穌又對他們說： 「願你們平安！正如父差派了我，我也要派遣你們。」 Jesus said to them again, "Peace to you! As the Father has sent Me, I also send you."
22. 說了這話，耶穌向他們吹了一口氣，說： 「領受聖靈吧！ After saying this, He breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
23. 你們赦免誰的罪，誰的罪就已經被赦免了；你們留下誰的罪，誰的罪就已經被留下了。」 If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain [the sins of] any, they are retained."
24. 當耶穌出現的時候，十二使徒 中那叫 迪杜馬 的 多馬 沒有與他們在一起。 But one of the Twelve, Thomas (called "Twin"), was not with them when Jesus came.
25. 後來，其他的門徒就告訴他：「我們看到主了！」 他卻說：「我如果不看到他手上的釘痕，把指頭放進那釘痕，再把手放進他的肋旁，我就絕不相信！」 So the other disciples kept telling him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "If I don't see the mark of the nails in His hands, put my finger into the mark of the nails, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe!"
26. 八天後，耶穌的門徒們又在屋裡， 多馬 也與他們在一起。門戶已經關上了，耶穌卻出現，站在他們當中說： 「願你們平安！」 After eight days His disciples were indoors again, and Thomas was with them. Even though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them. He said, "Peace to you!"
27. 然後他對 多馬 說： 「把你的指頭伸到這裡來，看看我的手吧。伸出你的手來，放進我的肋旁吧。不要不信，而要信！」 Then He said to Thomas, "Put your finger here and observe My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Don't be an unbeliever, but a believer."
28. 多馬 回答耶穌，說：「我的主，我的神！」 Thomas responded to Him, "My Lord and my God!"
29. 耶穌對他說： 「你因為看到了我才信嗎？那沒有看到就信的人，是蒙福的。」 Jesus said, "Because you have seen Me, you have believed. Those who believe without seeing are blessed."
30. 事實上，耶穌在他的門徒們面前還行了很多別的神蹟，沒有記在這部書裡。 Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples that are not written in this book.
