31. 但這些事被記下來，是要你們相信耶穌就是基督、是神的兒子；並且使你們因著信，就奉他的名有生命。 But these are written so that you may believe Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and by believing you may have life in His name.
John 21
1. 這些事以後，耶穌在 太巴列 湖 邊又向門徒們顯明了自己。他是這樣顯明自己的： After this, Jesus revealed Himself again to His disciples by the Sea of Tiberias. He revealed Himself in this way:
2. 當時， 西門彼得 、那叫 迪杜馬 的 多馬 、 加利利 的 迦拿 人 拿旦業 、 西庇太 的兩個兒子、還有他的另外兩位門徒，正在一起。 Simon Peter, Thomas (called "Twin"), Nathanael from Cana of Galilee, Zebedee's sons, and two others of His disciples were together.
3. 西門彼得 對大家說：「我去打魚。」 他們說：「我們也和你一起去。」他們就出去，上了船。可是那一夜，他們什麼也沒有捕到。 "I'm going fishing," Simon Peter said to them. "We're coming with you," they told him. They went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.
4. 天快亮的時候，耶穌站在岸上，只是門徒們沒有認出他就是耶穌。 When daybreak came, Jesus stood on the shore. However, the disciples did not know it was Jesus.
5. 耶穌對他們說： 「孩子們，你們沒有魚吧？」 他們回答：「沒有。」 "Men," Jesus called to them, "you don't have any fish, do you?" "No," they answered.
6. 耶穌說： 「你們把網撒在船的右邊，就會捕到。」 他們就把網撒下，竟拉不上來，因為魚很多。 "Cast the net on the right side of the boat," He told them, "and you'll find some." So they did, and they were unable to haul it in because of the large number of fish.
7. 耶穌所愛的那門徒對 彼得 說：「那是主！」 當時， 西門彼得 赤著身子，一聽說是主，就把外衣繫上，跳進湖裡。 Therefore the disciple, the one Jesus loved, said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he tied his outer garment around him (for he was stripped) and plunged into the sea.
8. 其他在船上的門徒，拖著滿網的魚過來了。他們離岸不遠，約有九十公尺 。 But since they were not far from land (about 100 yards away), the other disciples came in the boat, dragging the net full of fish.
9. 他們一上岸，就看見有一堆炭火，上面放著魚，還有餅。 When they got out on land, they saw a charcoal fire there, with fish lying on it, and bread.
10. 耶穌說： 「把你們剛捕到的魚，拿幾條 過來。」 "Bring some of the fish you've just caught," Jesus told them.
11. 西門彼得 就上去，把網拖到岸上，滿網大魚，共一百五十三條。雖然有這麼多魚，網卻沒有撐破。 So Simon Peter got up and hauled the net ashore, full of large fish-- 153 of them. Even though there were so many, the net was not torn.
12. 耶穌對他們說： 「來吃早飯吧。」 但沒有一個門徒敢問他：「你是誰？」因為他們知道是主。 "Come and have breakfast," Jesus told them. None of the disciples dared ask Him, "Who are You?" because they knew it was the Lord.
13. 耶穌過來，拿起餅分給他們，把魚也如此分了。 Jesus came, took the bread, and gave it to them. He did the same with the fish.
14. 耶穌從死人中復活後，這已經是他第三次向門徒們顯現了。 This was now the third time Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
15. 大家吃完早飯後，耶穌就問 西門彼得 ： 「 約翰 的兒子 西門，你愛我勝過這些嗎？ 」 彼得 說：「是的，主啊！你知道我喜愛你。」 耶穌對他說： 「餵養我的小羊。」 When they had eaten breakfast, Jesus asked Simon Peter, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me more than these?" "Yes, Lord," he said to Him, "You know that I love You." "Feed My lambs," He told him.
16. 耶穌第二次又問他： 「 約翰 的兒子 西門，你愛我嗎？」 彼得 回答說：「是的，主啊！你知道我喜愛你。」 耶穌對他說： 「牧養我的羊。」 A second time He asked him, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me?" "Yes, Lord," he said to Him, "You know that I love You." "Shepherd My sheep," He told him.
17. 耶穌第三次問他： 「 約翰 的兒子 西門，你喜愛我嗎？」 彼得 感到憂傷，因為耶穌第三次是對他說： 「你喜愛我嗎？」 說：「主啊，你知道一切，你知道我喜愛你。」 耶穌對他說： 「餵養我的羊。 He asked him the third time, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me?" Peter was grieved that He asked him the third time, "Do you love Me?" He said, "Lord, You know everything! You know that I love You." "Feed My sheep," Jesus said.
18. 我確確實實地告訴你：你年輕的時候，自己束上腰帶，到你願意去的地方；但你年老的時候，要伸出雙手，別人要把你束上，帶你到不願意去的地方。」 "I assure you: When you were young, you would tie your belt and walk wherever you wanted. But when you grow old, you will stretch out your hands and someone else will tie you and carry you where you don't want to go."
19. 耶穌說這話，是指 彼得 將會以怎樣的死來榮耀神。說了這話，耶穌對他說： 「你跟從我！」 He said this to signify by what kind of death he would glorify God. After saying this, He told him, "Follow Me!"
20. 彼得 轉過身來，看見耶穌所愛的那門徒跟著走。他就是晚餐時貼近耶穌，問「主啊，出賣你的是誰」的那個門徒。 So Peter turned around and saw the disciple Jesus loved following them. [That disciple] was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and asked, "Lord, who is the one that's going to betray You?"
21. 彼得 看見他，就問耶穌：「主啊，那麼，這個人會怎麼樣呢？」 When Peter saw him, he said to Jesus, "Lord-- what about him?"
22. 耶穌說： 「就算我願意他一直留到我來的時候，這與你有什麼關係？你跟從我！」 "If I want him to remain until I come," Jesus answered, "what is that to you? As for you, follow Me."
23. 於是在弟兄中傳出了這樣一種說法：「那門徒不會死。」其實耶穌並沒有說他不會死，而是說： 「就算我願意他一直留到我來的時候，這與你有什麼關係？」 So this report spread to the brothers that this disciple would not die. Yet Jesus did not tell him that he would not die, but, "If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you?"
24. 正是這個門徒，為這些事做見證，並記下了這些事，而且我們知道他的見證是真實的。 This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.
25. 耶穌所行的事，另外還有很多。如果把它們一一記載下來，我想，所寫出來的書，連整個世界也容納不下了。 And there are also many other things that Jesus did, which, if they were written one by one, I suppose not even the world itself could contain the books that would be written.
Acts
Acts 1
1. 提阿費羅 大人 哪，在前一卷書 中，我確實寫了有關耶穌開始做的和教導的一切事， I wrote the first narrative, Theophilus, about all that Jesus began to do and teach
2. 一直到他藉著聖靈吩咐了他所揀選的使徒們之後，被接升天的那一天為止。 until the day He was taken up, after He had given orders through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom He had chosen.
3. 耶穌受難之後，用很多確據向這些人顯明自己是活著的。他在四十天的時間裡向他們顯現，並且講說有關神國的事。 After He had suffered, He also presented Himself alive to them by many convincing proofs, appearing to them during 40 days and speaking about the kingdom of God.
4. 耶穌和他們聚集的時候，吩咐他們說： 「不要離開 耶路撒冷，而要等候父所應許的，就是你們從我聽到的， While He was together with them, He commanded them not to leave Jerusalem, but to wait for the Father's promise. "This," [He said, "is what] you heard from Me;
5. 因為 約翰 是用水 施洗，但過不了多少日子，你們就要受聖靈的洗。」 for John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now."
6. 於是聚集的時候，他們就問耶穌說：「主啊！你復興 以色列 國，是否在這時候呢？」 So when they had come together, they asked Him, "Lord, at this time are You restoring the kingdom to Israel?"
7. 耶穌對他們說： 「父憑著自己的權柄所定的時候和日期，不是你們可以知道的。 He said to them, "It is not for you to know times or periods that the Father has set by His own authority.
8. 不過聖靈臨到你們的時候，你們將得著能力，並且要在 耶路撒冷，在 猶太 和 撒馬利亞 全地，直到地極，做我的見證人。」 But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."
9. 說了這些話，耶穌就在他們的注視中被接升天，有一朵雲彩把他接去，他們就看不見他了。 After He had said this, He was taken up as they were watching, and a cloud received Him out of their sight.
10. 正當耶穌離去，他們注目望天的時候，忽然有兩個身穿白衣的人站在他們旁邊， While He was going, they were gazing into heaven, and suddenly two men in white clothes stood by them.
11. 說：「各位 加利利 人哪，你們為什麼站在這裡 望著天呢？這位從你們中間被接到天上去的耶穌，將來也要這樣回來，就像你們看到他升天那樣。」 They said, "Men of Galilee, why do you stand looking up into heaven? This Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come in the same way that you have seen Him going into heaven."
12. 於是他們從那叫做「 橄欖園 」的山上回到 耶路撒冷 。這山在 耶路撒冷 附近，有安息日允許走 的路程。 Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called Olive Grove, which is near Jerusalem-- a Sabbath day's journey away.
13. 他們一進城，就到他們所住的樓上房間。在那裡有 彼得 、 約翰 、 雅各 、 安得烈， 腓力 和 多馬， 巴多羅邁 和 馬太， 亞勒腓 的兒子 雅各 、 激進派 的 西門 、 雅各 的兒子 猶大 。 When they arrived, they went to the room upstairs where they were staying: Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
14. 這些人與一些婦女以及耶穌的母親 瑪麗亞 、耶穌的兄弟們一起，都同心合意地恆切禱告 。 All these were continually united in prayer, along with the women, including Mary the mother of Jesus, and His brothers.
15. 就在那些日子裡，聚在一起的人約有一百二十名。 彼得 在弟兄 中間站起來，說： During these days Peter stood up among the brothers-- the number of people who were together was about 120-- and said:
16. 「各位弟兄，那段經文是必須應驗的，就是聖靈藉著 大衛 的口所預言有關 猶大 的事。這 猶大，領人抓了耶穌； "Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled that the Holy Spirit through the mouth of David spoke in advance about Judas, who became a guide to those who arrested Jesus.
17. 他本來算是我們中間的一個，也在這服事的工作上領受了一份； For he was one of our number and was allotted a share in this ministry."
18. 後來，竟然用這個人不義的酬報買了一塊地。 猶大 一頭栽倒在那裡，肚腹迸裂，腸子都流出來了。 Now this man acquired a field with his unrighteous wages; and falling headfirst, he burst open in the middle, and all his insides spilled out.
19. 所有住在 耶路撒冷 的人都知道了這件事，因此那塊地按著他們的本地語言被稱為「 哈克達瑪 」——這意思是「血田」。 This became known to all the residents of Jerusalem, so that in their own language that field is called Hakeldama, that is, Field of Blood.
20. 因為詩篇上記著： 『願他的住所變為荒場， 沒有人住在其中。』 又說： 『願別人得到他監督的職份。』 "For it is written in the Book of Psalms: Let his dwelling become desolate; let no one live in it; and Let someone else take his position.
21. 「所以，這些人中必須有一個人和我們同做耶穌復活的見證人；這人是主耶穌在我們中間出入的所有時間裡——就是從 約翰 的洗禮開始，到耶穌被接升天離開我們的那天為止——一直與我們在一起的。」 "Therefore, from among the men who have accompanied us during the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us--
22. beginning from the baptism of John until the day He was taken up from us-- from among these, it is necessary that one become a witness with us of His resurrection."
23. 於是他們推舉了兩個人，就是那叫 巴撒巴，又被稱為 猶斯托 的 約瑟，還有 馬提亞 。 So they proposed two: Joseph, called Barsabbas, who was also known as Justus, and Matthias.
24. 他們就禱告說：「主啊，你洞察每個人的心。求你從這兩個人中，指明你所揀選的是哪一位， Then they prayed, "You, Lord, know the hearts of all; show which of these two You have chosen
25. 使他得到這服事和使徒的職份。 猶大 背棄了這職份，去了自己的地方。」 to take the place in this apostolic service that Judas left to go to his own place."
26. 接著，他們為這兩個人抽籤，抽到了 馬提亞，他就與那十一個使徒同列。 Then they cast lots for them, and the lot fell to Matthias. So he was numbered with the 11 apostles.
Acts 2
1. 到了五旬節那天，他們都聚集 在一起 。 When the day of Pentecost had arrived, they were all together in one place.
2. 突然，有響聲從天上下來，好像狂風吹過，充滿了他們所坐的整個房子， Suddenly a sound like that of a violent rushing wind came from heaven, and it filled the whole house where they were staying.
3. 有舌頭像火焰那樣，向他們顯現，分開留 在他們每一個人身上。 And tongues, like flames of fire that were divided, appeared to them and rested on each one of them.
4. 於是他們都被聖靈充滿，就照著聖靈賜給他們的話，開始說出別種語言 。 Then they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in different languages, as the Spirit gave them ability for speech.
5. 當時，有從天下各國來的虔誠的 猶太 人，住在 耶路撒冷 。 There were Jews living in Jerusalem, devout men from every nation under heaven.
6. 這聲音一響，有一群人就聚集而來，非常慌亂，因為各個人都聽見使徒們 用各個人本地的語言說話。 When this sound occurred, the multitude came together and was confused because each one heard them speaking in his own language.
7. 他們又驚訝又詫異，說 ：「看，這些說話的不都是 加利利 人嗎？ And they were astounded and amazed, saying, "Look, aren't all these who are speaking Galileans?
8. 我們怎麼會聽到我們各自出生地的語言呢？ How is it that we hear, each of us, in our own native language?
9. 我們當中有 帕提亞 人、 米底亞 人、 埃攔 人；也有住在 美索不達米亞 、 猶太 和 卡帕多細亞 、 本都 和 亞細亞 、 Parthians, Medes, Elamites; those who live in Mesopotamia, in Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
10. 弗里吉亞 和 潘菲利亞 、 埃及 和靠近 古利奈 的 利比亞 地區的人；還有從 羅馬 來的旅客， Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
11. 包括 猶太 人和入 猶太 教的人； 克里特 人和 阿拉伯 人。我們都聽見他們用我們的語言述說神偉大的作為！」 Cretans and Arabs-- we hear them speaking in our own languages the magnificent acts of God."
12. 眾人又驚訝又困惑，彼此問：「這是什麼意思呢？」 And they were all astounded and perplexed, saying to one another, "What could this be?"
13. 可是另有些人嘲笑說：「他們被新酒灌醉了！」 But some sneered and said, "They're full of new wine!"
14. 這時， 彼得 和其他十一個使徒一同站起來，高聲對眾人說：「各位 猶太 人和所有住在 耶路撒冷 的人哪，你們應當知道這件事，也應當仔細聽我的話， But Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice, and proclaimed to them: "Jewish men and all you residents of Jerusalem, let this be known to you and pay attention to my words.
15. 因為這些人不是像你們所想的那樣喝醉了，要知道，現在不過是早上九點 。 For these people are not drunk, as you suppose, since it's only nine in the morning.
16. 其實這是先知 約珥 所說的： On the contrary, this is what was spoken through the prophet Joel:
17. 『神說，在末後的那些日子裡 將是 這樣： 我要把我的靈傾注在所有人身 上， 你們的兒女要說預言， 你們的年輕人要見異象， 你們的老年人要做異夢。 And it will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out My Spirit on all humanity; then your sons and your daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams.
18. 是的，在那些日子裡， 我也要將我的靈傾注 在我的奴僕和婢女們身上， 他們就要說預言。 I will even pour out My Spirit on My male and female slaves in those days, and they will prophesy.
19. 在天上我要顯奇事； 在地上我要行神蹟—— 有血、有火、有煙霧。 I will display wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below: blood and fire and a cloud of smoke.
20. 在主那大而顯赫的日子來到之前， 太陽要變為黑暗， 月亮要變為血。 The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the great and remarkable day of the Lord comes;
21. 那時候，無論誰求告主名，都將得救。 』 then whoever calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
22. 「各位 以色列 人哪，請聽這些話： 拿撒勒 人耶穌是神向你們所證實的人；神藉著他在你們中間行了大能、神蹟和奇事，正如你們自己所知道的。 "Men of Israel, listen to these words: This Jesus the Nazarene was a man pointed out to you by God with miracles, wonders, and signs that God did among you through Him, just as you yourselves know.
23. 這一位照著神設定的計劃和先見被交出去；你們就藉著外邦人的手，把他釘上十字架殺了。 Though He was delivered up according to God's determined plan and foreknowledge, you used lawless people to nail Him to a cross and kill Him.
24. 神卻解除了死亡的痛苦，使他復活，因為他本來就不能被死亡轄制。 God raised Him up, ending the pains of death, because it was not possible for Him to be held by it.
25. 事實上， 大衛 指著他說： 『我常常看見主在我面前； 因他在我的右邊， 我就不至於搖動。 For David says of Him: I saw the Lord ever before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
26. 為此我內心歡喜， 口舌快樂， 並且我的肉身也要安居在盼望中。 Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh will rest in hope,
27. 因為你不會把我的靈魂撇棄在陰間， 也不會讓你的聖者經歷腐朽。 because You will not leave my soul in Hades, or allow Your Holy One to see decay.
28. 你讓我明白了生命之道， 使我在你面前充滿喜樂。』 You have revealed the paths of life to me; You will fill me with gladness in Your presence.
29. 「各位兄弟，關於先祖 大衛，我可以明確地告訴你們：他不但死了，也被埋葬了，而且他的墳墓到今天還在我們這裡。 "Brothers, I can confidently speak to you about the patriarch David: he is both dead and buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
30. 既然 大衛 是先知，也知道神曾向他起誓說，要從他的後裔中興起一位 坐在他的寶座上， Since he was a prophet, he knew that God had sworn an oath to him to seat one of his descendants on his throne.
31. 大衛 又預先看見了，就講論基督復活的事，說： 『 他 既沒有被撇棄在陰間， 他的肉身 也沒有經歷腐朽。 』 Seeing this in advance, he spoke concerning the resurrection of the Messiah: He was not left in Hades, and His flesh did not experience decay.
32. 「這位耶穌，神已經使他復活了。我們都是這事的見證人。 "God has resurrected this Jesus. We are all witnesses of this.
33. 他被高舉在神的右邊，從父領受了所應許的聖靈，就將聖靈傾注了下來。這正是你們現在所看見所聽見的。 Therefore, since He has been exalted to the right hand of God and has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit, He has poured out what you both see and hear.
34. 大衛 並沒有升到諸天之上去，可是他說， 『主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， For it was not David who ascended into the heavens, but he himself says: The Lord said to my Lord, 'Sit at My right hand
35. 等我把你的敵人放在你的腳下做腳凳。』 until I make Your enemies Your footstool.'
36. 「因此， 以色列 全家都當確實知道：被你們釘上十字架的這位耶穌，神已經委任他為主、為基督了。」 "Therefore let all the house of Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah!"
37. 眾人聽了這話，覺得扎心，就對 彼得 和其他的使徒說：「各位兄弟，我們該做什麼呢？」 When they heard this, they were pierced to the heart and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles: "Brothers, what must we do?"
38. 彼得 對他們說：「你們應當悔改，每個人都當奉耶穌基督的名受洗，使你們的罪得赦免，就會領受所賜的聖靈。 "Repent," Peter said to them, "and be baptized, each of you, in the name of Jesus the Messiah for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
39. 因為這應許是給你們和你們的兒女，以及所有在遠處的人，就是主我們的神所召來的人。」 For the promise is for you and for your children, and for all who are far off, as many as the Lord our God will call."
40. 彼得 還說許多別的話鄭重地做見證，又勸告他們說：「你們從這扭曲的 世代中得救吧！」 And with many other words he testified and strongly urged them, saying, "Be saved from this corrupt generation!"
41. 於是 領受他話的人就受了洗；那一天大約增加了三千人 。 So those who accepted his message were baptized, and that day about 3,000 people were added to them.
42. 他們在使徒們的教導上，在契合 、掰餅、禱告之事上恆切專心。 And they devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching, to fellowship, to the breaking of bread, and to prayers.
43. 每個人 都起了敬畏之心。使徒們又行了很多奇事和神蹟 。 Then fear came over everyone, and many wonders and signs were being performed through the apostles.
44. 所有信了的人都在一起，凡物共有， Now all the believers were together and had everything in common.
45. 他們變賣財產和產業，按照各人的需要分給大家。 So they sold their possessions and property and distributed the proceeds to all, as anyone had a need.
46. 他們同心合意，不但天天恆切地在聖殿聚集，還在各家各戶掰餅。他們懷著喜樂和誠懇的心用飯， And every day they devoted themselves [to meeting] together in the temple complex, and broke bread from house to house. They ate their food with gladness and simplicity of heart,
47. 讚美神，並且得到全體民眾的喜愛。主就在那裡 使得救的人與日俱增 。 praising God and having favor with all the people. And every day the Lord added to them those who were being saved.
Acts 3
1. 有一次，在下午三點 禱告的時候， 彼得 和 約翰 上聖殿去。 Now Peter and John were going up together to the temple complex at the hour of prayer at three in the afternoon.
2. 一個生來 瘸腿的被人抬來。他天天被放在那叫「 美門 」的聖殿門口，為要向進聖殿的人乞討。 And a man who was lame from his mother's womb was carried there and placed every day at the temple gate called Beautiful, so he could beg from those entering the temple complex.
3. 他看見 彼得 和 約翰 正要進入聖殿，就求他們施捨。 When he saw Peter and John about to enter the temple complex, he asked for help.
4. 彼得 和 約翰 注視著他， 彼得 說：「你看我們！」 Peter, along with John, looked at him intently and said, "Look at us."
5. 那人就留意看他們，期待著從他們那裡得些什麼。 So he turned to them, expecting to get something from them.
6. 彼得 卻說：「金子銀子我都沒有，只把我有的給你：奉 拿撒勒 人耶穌基督的名，起來 走路吧！」 But Peter said, "I have neither silver nor gold, but what I have, I give to you: In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, get up and walk!"
7. 彼得 抓著他的右手，扶他起來。他的腳和踝骨立刻就健壯了。 Then, taking him by the right hand he raised him up, and at once his feet and ankles became strong.
8. 他一跳，站了起來，並且行走，與他們一起進入聖殿，邊走邊跳，讚美神。 So he jumped up, stood, and started to walk, and he entered the temple complex with them-- walking, leaping, and praising God.
9. 全體民眾都看見他邊走邊讚美神， All the people saw him walking and praising God,
10. 認出他是坐在聖殿的 美門 口乞討的那個人，就對發生在他身上的事滿心希奇、驚訝。 and they recognized that he was the one who used to sit and beg at the Beautiful Gate of the temple complex. So they were filled with awe and astonishment at what had happened to him.
11. 那個人 緊拉著 彼得 和 約翰 的時候，全體民眾都一起跑向他們，到叫做「 所羅門 」的柱廊那裡，滿心驚奇。 While he was holding on to Peter and John, all the people, greatly amazed, ran toward them in what is called Solomon's Colonnade.
12. 彼得 看見，就對民眾說：「各位 以色列 人哪！你們為什麼對這事感到驚奇？為什麼注視我們，以為我們是憑著自己的能力或虔誠使這個人走路的呢？ When Peter saw this, he addressed the people: "Men of Israel, why are you amazed at this? Or why do you stare at us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
13. 亞伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各 的神，也就是我們祖先的神，已經榮耀了他的僕人耶穌。你們竟然把他交出去，並且在 彼拉多 判定要釋放他的時候，在 彼拉多 面前拒絕了他。 The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His Servant Jesus, whom you handed over and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had decided to release Him.
14. 你們拒絕了神聖、公義的那一位，而要求釋放一個殺人犯給你們。 But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked to have a murderer given to you.
15. 你們殺害了生命的創始者，神卻使他從死人中復活了！我們就是這事的見證人。 And you killed the source of life, whom God raised from the dead; we are witnesses of this.
16. 現在，基於對他名的信心，他的名就使你們所看見所認識的這個人健壯了；這由耶穌而來的信心，使他在你們眾人面前完全康復了。 By faith in His name, His name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. So the faith that comes through Him has given him this perfect health in front of all of you.
17. 「同胞們，現在我知道，你們所做的是出於愚昧無知，就像你們的首領那樣。 "And now, brothers, I know that you did it in ignorance, just as your leaders also did.
18. 但神藉著眾先知的口所預言的，就是基督要受難的事，就這樣應驗了。 But what God predicted through the mouth of all the prophets-- that His Messiah would suffer-- He has fulfilled in this way.
19. 所以，你們應當悔改，應當回轉，使你們的罪孽被抹去， Therefore repent and turn back, that your sins may be wiped out so that seasons of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord,
20. 這樣，更新的日子 就會從主面前來到；並且他要將耶穌，就是預先指定給你們的那位基督差來。 and He may send Jesus, who has been appointed Messiah for you.
21. 不過天必須留他，直到萬有復興的時候，就是神自古以來藉著聖先知們的口所說的那時候。 Heaven must welcome Him until the times of the restoration of all things, which God spoke about by the mouth of His holy prophets from the beginning.
22. 摩西 確實 說過： 『主——你們的神，將要從你們兄弟中給你們興起一位先知，像興起我一樣。他對你們所說的一切，你們都要聽從。 Moses said: The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He will say to you.
23. 所有不聽從那位先知的人，都要從民中被全然滅絕。』 And it will be that everyone who will not listen to that Prophet will be completely cut off from the people.
24. 「其實從 撒母耳 以來所有的先知，只要說預言，都同樣地預告了這些日子。 "In addition, all the prophets who have spoken, from Samuel and those after him, have also announced these days.
25. 你們是先知們的子孫，也是神與你們 祖先所訂立之約的子孫。那時神對 亞伯拉罕 說： 『藉著你的那位後裔，地上萬族都要蒙祝福。』 You are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant that God made with your forefathers, saying to Abraham, And in your seed all the families of the earth will be blessed.
26. 神興起了他的僕人，差派他先到你們這裡來，要你們每個人轉離自己的罪行，好祝福你們。」 God raised up His Servant and sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your evil ways."
Acts 4
1. 彼得 和 約翰 正向民眾講話的時候，祭司們、聖殿守衛長 和 撒都該 人忽然來了。 Now as they were speaking to the people, the priests, the commander of the temple guard, and the Sadducees confronted them,
2. 這些人非常惱怒，因為使徒們教導民眾，藉著耶穌傳講從死人中復活的事。 because they were provoked that they were teaching the people and proclaiming in the person of Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
3. 於是他們下手捉拿了 彼得 和 約翰 。因為天已經晚了，就把他們關在監裡，直到第二天。 So they seized them and put them in custody until the next day, since it was already evening.
4. 然而聽了這話語的人中，有許多人相信了；男人的數目約有五千。 But many of those who heard the message believed, and the number of the men came to about 5,000.
5. 到了第二天， 猶太 人的 首領、長老和經文士們都聚集在 耶路撒冷 。 The next day, their rulers, elders, and scribes assembled in Jerusalem
6. 大祭司 亞納 、 該亞法 、 約翰 、 亞歷山大，以及大祭司家族的人都在那裡。 with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John and Alexander, and all the members of the high-priestly family.
7. 他們叫 彼得 和 約翰 站在中間，質問他們，說：「你們憑著什麼能力，以誰的名做這事？」 After they had Peter and John stand before them, they asked the question: "By what power or in what name have you done this?"
8. 那時， 彼得 被聖靈充滿，對他們說：「民眾的首領和 長老們， Then Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and said to them, "Rulers of the people and elders:
9. 如果我們今天因在一個殘疾人身上所行的善事，被查問這個人怎樣得到救治， If we are being examined today about a good deed done to a disabled man-- by what means he was healed--
10. 那麼，你們大家和所有 以色列 子民應當知道：這個人健全地站在你們面前，是藉著 拿撒勒 人耶穌基督的名。這位耶穌基督，你們把他釘上十字架，但是神使他從死人中復活了！ let it be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene-- whom you crucified and whom God raised from the dead-- by Him this man is standing here before you healthy.
11. 這一位就是 『被你們工匠所藐視的石頭， 它已經成了房角的頭塊石頭。』 This [Jesus] is The stone despised by you builders, who has become the cornerstone.
12. 除他 以外，沒有救恩 ；因為在天下人間，沒有賜下別的名，我們必須靠著得救。」 There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to people by which we must be saved."
13. 他們看見 彼得 和 約翰 的膽量，又了解他們是沒有學問的普通人，就感到驚奇，並且了解他們是曾經與耶穌在一起的； When they observed the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were uneducated and untrained men, they were amazed and knew that they had been with Jesus.
14. 又看見那得了痊癒的人和他們一同站著，就無話可說了， And since they saw the man who had been healed standing with them, they had nothing to say in response.
15. 於是命令他們到議會外面去，就彼此商議， After they had ordered them to leave the Sanhedrin, they conferred among themselves,
16. 說：「我們該怎麼處理這些人呢？藉著他們，確實發生了一個明顯的神蹟，所有住在 耶路撒冷 的人都清清楚楚；我們也不能否認。 saying, "What should we do with these men? For an obvious sign, evident to all who live in Jerusalem, has been done through them, and we cannot deny it!
17. 不過為了避免這事在民間傳揚更廣，讓我們威嚇他們，不可再奉耶穌的名 對任何人講話。」 But so this does not spread any further among the people, let's threaten them against speaking to anyone in this name again."
18. 於是把他們叫來，吩咐他們絕對不可奉耶穌的名講說或教導人。 So they called for them and ordered them not to preach or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
19. 可是 彼得 和 約翰 回答說：「聽從你們過於聽從神，在神面前是理所當然的嗎？你們自己判斷吧！ But Peter and John answered them, "Whether it's right in the sight of God [for us] to listen to you rather than to God, you decide;
20. 要知道，我們所看見所聽見的，我們不能不說。」 for we are unable to stop speaking about what we have seen and heard."
21. 官長們又威嚇他們一番，為了民眾的緣故把他們釋放了。官長們找不出任何理由來懲罰他們，因為眾人都為所發生的事不住地榮耀神。 After threatening them further, they released them. They found no way to punish them, because the people were all giving glory to God over what had been done;
22. 實際上，因神蹟而痊癒的那個人已經四十多歲了。 for the man was over 40 years old on whom this sign of healing had been performed.
23. 彼得 和 約翰 被釋放了，就回到自己的人那裡，把祭司長們和長老們所說的話都告訴他們。 After they were released, they went to their own fellowship and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
24. 他們聽了，就同心合意地高聲向神說：「主啊，你是造了天、地、海和其中萬有的那一位 。 When they heard this, they raised their voices to God unanimously and said, "Master, You are the One who made the heaven, the earth, and the sea, and everything in them.
25. 你曾經藉著聖靈，用你的僕人——我們先祖 大衛 的口說： 『列國為什麼狂怒騷亂， 眾民為什麼圖謀虛空？ You said through the Holy Spirit, by the mouth of our father David Your servant: Why did the Gentiles rage, and the peoples plot futile things?
26. 地上的眾君王都起來， 首領們也聚集在一起， 抵擋主和他的基督。』 The kings of the earth took their stand, and the rulers assembled together against the Lord and against His Messiah.
27. 「事實上， 希律 和 本丟彼拉多，與外邦人和 以色列 子民果然在這城裡 一同聚集，對付你所膏立的聖僕耶穌， "For, in fact, in this city both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, assembled together against Your holy Servant Jesus, whom You anointed,
28. 做成了你手和你計劃所預定要成就的一切事。 to do whatever Your hand and Your plan had predestined to take place.
29. 主啊，現在求你鑒察 他們的威嚇，使 你的奴僕們能滿有膽量地傳講你的話語。 And now, Lord, consider their threats, and grant that Your slaves may speak Your message with complete boldness,
30. 求你伸出你的手，藉著你聖僕耶穌的名，使疾病痊癒，施行神蹟和奇事。」 while You stretch out Your hand for healing, signs, and wonders to be performed through the name of Your holy Servant Jesus."
31. 他們禱告完了，聚集的地方就被震動，大家都被聖靈充滿，就坦然無懼地傳講神的話語 。 When they had prayed, the place where they were assembled was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak God's message with boldness.
32. 於是那一群信徒都同心合意，沒有一個人說他所擁有的哪樣東西是自己的；相反，他們凡物共有。 Now the multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul, and no one said that any of his possessions was his own, but instead they held everything in common.
33. 使徒們大有能力地為主耶穌的復活做見證，並且在他們每個人身上都有極大的恩典。 And with great power the apostles were giving testimony to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was on all of them.
34. 他們當中沒有一個缺乏的人，因為凡是擁有田產或房屋的人，都賣掉了那些東西，把所賣得的錢拿來， For there was not a needy person among them, because all those who owned lands or houses sold them, brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
35. 放在使徒們的腳前，按照各人的需要分給每個人。 and laid them at the apostles' feet. This was then distributed to each person as anyone had a need.
36. 有一個出生在 塞浦路斯 的 利未 人 約瑟，使徒們稱他為 巴拿巴 ——「 巴拿巴 」翻譯出來就是「安慰之子」； Joseph, a Levite and a Cypriot by birth, whom the apostles named Barnabas, which is translated Son of Encouragement,
37. 他有一塊田地，也賣掉了，把錢拿來放在使徒們的腳前。 sold a field he owned, brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
Acts 5
1. 有一個名叫 阿納尼亞 的人，和他的妻子 薩菲拉 賣掉了財產。 But a man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a piece of property.
2. 但他從價款中私自留下了一部分，把一部分拿來放在使徒們的腳前；他的妻子也知道這事。 However, he kept back part of the proceeds with his wife's knowledge, and brought a portion of it and laid it at the apostles' feet.
3. 彼得 就說：「 阿納尼亞，為什麼 撒旦 充滿了你的心，使你對聖靈說謊，從田產的價款中私自留下一些呢？ Then Peter said, "Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and keep back part of the proceeds from the field?
4. 田產留著沒賣 的時候，難道不屬於你的嗎？賣了以後，價款難道不也是由你做主嗎？你心裡為什麼存有這種念頭呢？你不是對人說謊，而是對神說謊了。」 Wasn't it yours while you possessed it? And after it was sold, wasn't it at your disposal? Why is it that you planned this thing in your heart? You have not lied to men but to God!"
5. 阿納尼亞 聽見這話，就仆倒斷了氣；所有聽到這事的人都大為恐懼。 When he heard these words, Ananias dropped dead, and a great fear came on all who heard.
6. 有幾個年輕人站起來，把他的屍體 裹好，抬出去埋葬了。 The young men got up, wrapped [his body], carried him out, and buried him.
7. 隔了大約三個小時， 阿納尼亞 的妻子進來，還不知道所發生的事。 There was an interval of about three hours; then his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
8. 彼得 問她：「告訴我，你們賣田產的錢，是不是這麼多？」 她說：「是的，就這麼多。」 "Tell me," Peter asked her, "did you sell the field for this price?" "Yes," she said, "for that price."
9. 彼得 就對她說：「你們為什麼同心試探主的靈呢？看，埋葬你丈夫之人的腳，已經到門口了，他們也要把你抬出去。」 Then Peter said to her, "Why did you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look! The feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out!"
10. 她立刻仆倒在 彼得 腳前，斷了氣。那些年輕人進來，看見她死了，也把她抬了出去，埋葬在她丈夫的旁邊。 Instantly she dropped dead at his feet. When the young men came in, they found her dead, carried her out, and buried her beside her husband.
11. 全教會和所有聽到這些事的人都大為恐懼。 Then great fear came on the whole church and on all who heard these things.
12. 主藉著使徒們的手，在民間行了很多神蹟和奇事。 信徒們 都同心合意地聚集 在 所羅門 柱廊裡。 Many signs and wonders were being done among the people through the hands of the apostles. By common consent they would all meet in Solomon's Colonnade.
13. 雖然其他的人沒有一個敢與他們交往，但民眾都尊敬他們。 None of the rest dared to join them, but the people praised them highly.
14. 信主的人越發增加，連男帶女成群結隊。 Believers were added to the Lord in increasing numbers-- crowds of both men and women.
15. 人們甚至把病人抬到大街 上來，放在床榻上或墊子上，為要在 彼得 走過來的時候，至少他的影子可以落在一些人身上。 As a result, they would carry the sick out into the streets and lay them on beds and pallets so that when Peter came by, at least his shadow might fall on some of them.
16. 還有一群人帶著病人和被汙靈折磨的人，從 耶路撒冷 周圍的城鎮聚集而來，這些人都得了痊癒。 In addition, a multitude came together from the towns surrounding Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits, and they were all healed.
17. 於是大祭司就採取行動。他和所有與他在一起的人，就是 撒都該 教派的人，都滿腔嫉妒， Then the high priest took action. He and all his colleagues, those who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.
18. 下手捉拿使徒們，把他們關在公眾拘留所裡。 So they arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
19. 但在夜裡，主的一位天使打開了監門，領他們出來，說： But an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail during the night, brought them out, and said,
20. 「你們去站在聖殿裡，把這生命的話語，都講給民眾聽。」 "Go and stand in the temple complex, and tell the people all about this life."
21. 他們聽從這話，在清晨的時候就進入聖殿教導人。 這時，大祭司和與他在一起的人來了，他們召集了議會，就是 以色列 子民長老的全體議會，然後派人到監獄裡，要把使徒們帶來。 In obedience to this, they entered the temple complex at daybreak and began to teach. When the high priest and those who were with him arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin-- the full Senate of the sons of Israel-- and sent [orders] to the jail to have them brought.
22. 但差役們到了監獄裡，卻找不到他們，就回去報告， But when the temple police got there, they did not find them in the jail, so they returned and reported,
23. 說：「我們看見監獄被關得極其穩妥，衛兵都站在各個門口，可是打開那些門，裡面卻找不到任何人。」 "We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing in front of the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside!"
24. 當 聖殿的守衛長 和祭司長們聽到這些話的時候，就對使徒們的事感到困惑，不知道這事會如何發展。 As the captain of the temple police and the chief priests heard these things, they were baffled about them, as to what could come of this.
25. 這時，有人來向他們報告說：「看，你們關在監獄裡的那些人，正站在聖殿裡教導民眾呢！」 Someone came and reported to them, "Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple complex and teaching the people."
26. 於是守衛長與差役們一起去把使徒們帶來，並沒有用暴力，因為怕民眾用石頭砸他們。 Then the captain went with the temple police and brought them in without force, because they were afraid the people might stone them.
27. 他們把使徒們帶來後，叫他們站在議會當中。大祭司質問他們， When they had brought them in, they had them stand before the Sanhedrin, and the high priest asked,
28. 說：「我們不是嚴厲地吩咐你們，不可奉這個人的名教導人嗎？可是看哪，你們把你們的教導傳遍了 耶路撒冷，又想把這個人的血歸到我們身上。」 "Didn't we strictly order you not to teach in this name? And look, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to bring this man's blood on us!"
29. 彼得 和使徒們回答說：「我們必須順從神過於順從人。 But Peter and the apostles replied, "We must obey God rather than men.
30. 你們掛在木頭上殺害的耶穌，我們祖先的神已經使他復活了。 The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had murdered by hanging Him on a tree.
31. 神把這一位高舉在自己右邊做元首、做救主，為了將悔改的心賜給 以色列，使罪得赦免。 God exalted this man to His right hand as ruler and Savior, to grant repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
32. 我們就是這些事的見證人。神所賜給那些順從他之人的聖靈也一同做見證。」 We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey Him."
33. 議會的人聽了，勃然大怒，就想要殺了他們。 When they heard this, they were enraged and wanted to kill them.
34. 但有一個名叫 迦瑪列 的 法利賽 人，是全體民眾所尊敬的律法教師，在議會中站了起來，下令把使徒們 暫時帶到外面去， A Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law who was respected by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered the men to be taken outside for a little while.
35. 就對大家說：「各位 以色列 人哪，如何處置這些人，你們應當謹慎。 He said to them, "Men of Israel, be careful about what you're going to do to these men.
36. 因為這些日子之前， 提烏達 起來說自己是某某人物，跟從他的人數約有四百。這人被殺了以後，所有信從他的人都四散了，歸於無有。 Not long ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and a group of about 400 men rallied to him. He was killed, and all his partisans were dispersed and came to nothing.
37. 這人以後，在戶口登記期間又有個 加利利 人 猶大 起來，拉攏民眾 跟隨他。他也死了，所有信從他的人也都四散了。 After this man, Judas the Galilean rose up in the days of the census and attracted a following. That man also perished, and all his partisans were scattered.
38. 現在我告訴你們：不要管這些人，由他們去吧！因為這計劃或這行為，如果是出於人，就會被拆毀； And now, I tell you, stay away from these men and leave them alone. For if this plan or this work is of men, it will be overthrown;
39. 但如果是出於神，你們就不能拆毀他們，恐怕你們反而被看做是與神作對了。」於是議會的人被 迦瑪列 說服了， but if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow them. You may even be found fighting against God." So they were persuaded by him.
40. 就叫來使徒們，鞭打了以後，吩咐他們不可再奉耶穌的名講說，然後把他們釋放了。 After they called in the apostles and had them flogged, they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus and released them.
41. 這樣使徒們就快快樂樂地離開了議會，因為算是配得上為這名受凌辱。 Then they went out from the presence of the Sanhedrin, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to be dishonored on behalf of the name.
42. 他們每天在聖殿和各家各戶不住地教導人，傳福音說耶穌是基督。 Every day in the temple complex, and in various homes, they continued teaching and proclaiming the good news that the Messiah is Jesus.
Acts 6
1. 在那些日子裡，門徒增多。說 希臘 語的 猶太 人抱怨那些說 希伯來 語的 猶太 人，因為他們的寡婦在每日的服事 上被忽略了。 In those days, as the number of the disciples was multiplying, there arose a complaint by the Hellenistic Jews against the Hebraic Jews that their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution.
2. 於是十二使徒 召來全體門徒，說：「我們撇下神的話語，去管理飯食，是不妥當的。 Then the Twelve summoned the whole company of the disciples and said, "It would not be right for us to give up preaching about God to wait on tables.
3. 所以弟兄們，要從你們當中挑選七個有好名聲、充滿聖靈和智慧的人；我們就委任他們統管這事務。 Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Spirit and wisdom, whom we can appoint to this duty.
4. 這樣，我們將可專心於禱告和福音 的服事工作。」 But we will devote ourselves to prayer and to the preaching ministry."
5. 這話使全體會眾都喜悅，於是選出了 司提反 ——他是一個充滿信仰和聖靈的人，還有 腓利 、 普羅克羅 、 尼卡諾 、 提門 、 帕米納，以及入 猶太 教的 安提阿 人 尼古拉斯 。 The proposal pleased the whole company. So they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte from Antioch.
6. 他們請這些人站在使徒們面前，使徒們就禱告，按手在他們身上。 They had them stand before the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
7. 這樣，神的話語 不斷擴展，在 耶路撒冷 門徒的人數大大增多，並且有一大群祭司也聽從了這信仰。 So the preaching about God flourished, the number of the disciples in Jerusalem multiplied greatly, and a large group of priests became obedient to the faith.
8. 司提反 滿有恩惠 和能力，在民間行了許多大奇事和神蹟。 Stephen, full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
9. 可是一些來自稱為「自由人」會堂的人，包括一些 古利奈 人、 亞歷山大 人，還有來自 奇里乞亞 省和 亞細亞 省的人，起來與 司提反 辯論， Then some from what is called the Freedmen's Synagogue, composed of both Cyrenians and Alexandrians, and some from Cilicia and Asia, came forward and disputed with Stephen.
10. 但 司提反 以智慧和聖靈說話，他們就抵擋不住。 But they were unable to stand up against the wisdom and the Spirit by whom he spoke.
11. 於是他們暗中唆使人說：「我們聽過這個人針對 摩西 和神說褻瀆的話語。」 Then they induced men to say, "We heard him speaking blasphemous words against Moses and God!"
12. 他們又煽動民眾、長老和經文士們就忽然來抓住 司提反，把他帶到議會， They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes; so they came up, dragged him off, and took him to the Sanhedrin.
13. 並且推出假見證人說：「這個人不斷地說褻瀆神的話語，反對這聖所 和律法 。 They also presented false witnesses who said, "This man does not stop speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
14. 我們曾聽到他說，這個 拿撒勒 人耶穌要拆毀這地方，也要改變 摩西 傳給我們的規矩。」 For we heard him say that Jesus, this Nazarene, will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us."
15. 所有坐在議會裡的人都注視著 司提反，看見他的面容好像天使的面容。 And all who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at him and saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
Acts 7
1. 大祭司問 司提反 ：「真有這些事嗎？」 "Is this true?" the high priest asked.
2. 司提反 說：「各位父老兄弟，請聽！我們的先祖 亞伯拉罕 住 哈蘭 以前，還在 美索不達米亞 的時候，榮耀的神向他顯現， "Brothers and fathers," he said, "listen: The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he settled in Haran,
3. 對他說： 『你要離開你的故土和親族， 到我所要指示你的地方去。』 and said to him: Get out of your country and away from your relatives, and come to the land that I will show you.
4. 「於是 亞伯拉罕 離開 迦勒底 人的地方，住在 哈蘭 。他的父親死了以後，神使他從那裡遷移到你們現在所住的這地方。 "Then he came out of the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. And from there, after his father died, God had him move to this land in which you now live.
5. 在這裡，神並沒有賜給他繼業，連立足的地方也沒有。可是神應許要把這地賜給他和他的後裔為業。當時， 亞伯拉罕 還沒有孩子。 He didn't give him an inheritance in it, not even a foot of ground, but He promised to give it to him as a possession, and to his descendants after him, even though he was childless.
6. 神這樣說： 『他的後裔要在他人之地做寄居的， 那裡的人要奴役、虐待他們四百年。 God spoke in this way: His descendants would be strangers in a foreign country, and they would enslave and oppress them for 400 years.
7. 可是我要懲罰那奴役他們的國家。』 神又說： 『這些事以後，他們將要出來，在這地方事奉我。』 I will judge the nation that they will serve as slaves, God said. After this, they will come out and worship Me in this place.
8. 神又賜給 亞伯拉罕 割禮的約。這樣， 亞伯拉罕 生了 以撒，第八天給他行了割禮。後來 以撒 生了 雅各， 雅各 生了十二位先祖。 Then He gave him the covenant of circumcision. This being so, he fathered Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day; Isaac did the same with Jacob, and Jacob with the 12 patriarchs.
9. 「先祖們嫉妒 約瑟，把他賣到 埃及 去。可是神與他同在， "The patriarchs became jealous of Joseph and sold him into Egypt, but God was with him
10. 救他脫離一切患難，並且使他在 埃及 王法老面前蒙恩寵、有智慧。法老就委任 約瑟 做宰相，統管 埃及 和法老全家。 and rescued him out of all his troubles. He gave him favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who appointed him governor over Egypt and over his whole household.
11. 後來整個 埃及 和 迦南 地區遭遇了饑荒和大災難，我們的祖先找不到糧食。 Then a famine came over all of Egypt and Canaan, with great suffering, and our forefathers could find no food.
12. 雅各 聽說 埃及 有糧食，就派我們的祖先去，這是第一次。 When Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our forefathers the first time.
13. 第二次去的時候， 約瑟 的身世被他的兄弟們知道了，這樣， 約瑟 的家族就被法老知道了。 The second time, Joseph was revealed to his brothers, and Joseph's family became known to Pharaoh.
14. 於是 約瑟 派人把他的父親 雅各 和所有的親屬請來，一共七十五人 。 Joseph then invited his father Jacob and all his relatives, 75 people in all,
15. 雅各 下到 埃及，後來他死了，我們的祖先也死了， and Jacob went down to Egypt. He and our forefathers died there,
16. 遺體被帶回 示劍，安放到 亞伯拉罕 在 示劍 用一筆銀子從 哈莫爾 的子孫買來的墳墓裡。 were carried back to Shechem, and were placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought for a sum of silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
17. 「隨著神向 亞伯拉罕 所宣告 的那應許時期臨近， 以色列 子民在 埃及 興旺、增多， "As the time was drawing near to fulfill the promise that God had made to Abraham, the people flourished and multiplied in Egypt
18. 直到另一個不認識 約瑟 的王起來統治 埃及 。 until a different king ruled over Egypt who did not know Joseph.
19. 這王狡猾地對待我們的同胞，虐待我們的祖先，強迫他們丟棄自己的嬰孩，好使嬰孩活不下去。 He dealt deceitfully with our race and oppressed our forefathers by making them leave their infants outside so they wouldn't survive.
20. 就在那時候， 摩西 出生了。他在神的眼裡 十分俊美，在父親家裡被撫養了三個月。 At this time Moses was born, and he was beautiful before God. He was nursed in his father's home three months,
21. 後來他被丟棄的時候，法老的女兒把他撿去，當做自己的兒子撫養。 and when he was left outside, Pharaoh's daughter adopted and raised him as her own son.
22. 摩西 在 埃及 人的一切智慧上受了教育，說話行事都有能力。 So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was powerful in his speech and actions.
23. 「當他滿四十歲的時候，心裡決定要去探望 自己的同胞 以色列 子民。 "As he was approaching the age of 40, he decided to visit his brothers, the sons of Israel.
24. 他看見一個同胞 受欺負，就去衛護他，為那受壓迫的人報仇，打死了那個 埃及 人。 When he saw one of them being mistreated, he came to his rescue and avenged the oppressed man by striking down the Egyptian.
25. 摩西 以為自己的同胞 會領悟神是藉著他的手拯救他們，但他們卻不領悟。 He assumed his brothers would understand that God would give them deliverance through him, but they did not understand.
26. 第二天，一些同胞在爭鬥， 摩西 就出來，勸他們和睦，說：『各位！你們是同胞，為什麼互相欺負呢？』 The next day he showed up while they were fighting and tried to reconcile them peacefully, saying, 'Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?'
27. 「但那欺負同伴 的人把 摩西 推開，說： 『誰委任你做我們的首領和審判官呢？ "But the one who was mistreating his neighbor pushed him away, saying: Who appointed you a ruler and a judge over us?
28. 難道你想殺了我，像你昨天殺了那個 埃及 人一樣嗎？』 Do you want to kill me, the same way you killed the Egyptian yesterday?
29. 「 摩西 聽了這話就逃跑了，並寄居在 米甸 地，在那裡生了兩個兒子。 "At this disclosure, Moses fled and became an exile in the land of Midian, where he fathered two sons.
30. 過了四十年，在 西奈 山的曠野，一位天使 在荊棘火焰中向 摩西 顯現。 After 40 years had passed, an angel appeared to him in the desert of Mount Sinai, in the flame of a burning bush.
31. 摩西 見了這景象，感到驚奇。正當他上前要觀看的時候，有主的聲音說： When Moses saw it, he was amazed at the sight. As he was approaching to look at it, the voice of the Lord came:
32. 『我是你祖先的神，就是 亞伯拉罕 、 以撒 雅各 的神 。』 摩西 戰戰兢兢，不敢觀看。 I am the God of your forefathers-- the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob. So Moses began to tremble and did not dare to look.
33. 「主對他說： 『脫掉你腳上的鞋，因為你站的地方是聖地。 "Then the Lord said to him: Take the sandals off your feet, because the place where you are standing is holy ground.
34. 我的子民在 埃及 的困苦，我確實看見了；他們的呻吟，我也聽見了；於是我下來要救他們。現在你來！我要差派你到 去。』 I have certainly seen the oppression of My people in Egypt; I have heard their groaning and have come down to rescue them. And now, come, I will send you to Egypt.
35. 「這 摩西 就是他們拒絕說 『誰委任你做首領和審判官』 的那位，神卻藉著那在荊棘中向他顯現的天使的手，差派他做首領、做救贖者。 "This Moses, whom they rejected when they said, Who appointed you a ruler and a judge?-- this one God sent as a ruler and a redeemer by means of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
36. 這個人帶領 以色列 子民出來，在 埃及 地、在 紅海，並且在曠野的四十年間，行了奇事和神蹟。 This man led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and in the desert for 40 years.
37. 「這個人就是 摩西，他曾告訴 以色列 子民： 『神 將要從你們兄弟中給你們興起一位先知，像興起我一樣。 』 "This is the Moses who said to the sons of Israel, God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from among your brothers.
38. 這個人曾在曠野的會眾當中，與那在 西奈 山對他講話的天使在一起，又和我們的祖先在一起。他接受了生命的話語，把它傳給了我們。 He is the one who was in the congregation in the desert together with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our forefathers. He received living oracles to give to us.
39. 我們的祖先不肯順從，反而棄絕了他，甚至在心裡轉回 埃及 去， Our forefathers were unwilling to obey him, but pushed him away, and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
40. 對 亞倫 說： 『為我們造一些神明在我們前面引路吧，因為帶領我們出 埃及 地的那個 摩西，我們不知道他出了什麼事！』 They told Aaron: Make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us out of the land of Egypt, we don't know what's become of him.
41. 在那些日子裡，他們造了一個牛犢的像，又向那偶像獻上祭物，並且為自己手所做的而慶祝。 They even made a calf in those days, offered sacrifice to the idol, and were celebrating what their hands had made.
42. 神就轉身不顧，任憑他們去事奉天上的萬象，正如先知書上所記載的： 『 以色列 家呀！ 你們在曠野的四十年裡獻上的犧牲和祭物， 難道是給我的嗎？ Then God turned away and gave them up to worship the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: Did you bring Me offerings and sacrifices for 40 years in the desert, O house of Israel?
43. 你們抬起了 摩洛 的帳幕和你們 理番 神的星， 就是你們為敬拜而造的像。 因此，我要把你們遷移到 巴比倫 以外去。』 No, you took up the tent of Moloch and the star of your god Rephan, the images that you made to worship. So I will deport you beyond Babylon!
44. 「我們的祖先在曠野有見證的會幕，是照著對 摩西 說話的那一位所吩咐的，並按照 摩西 看到的樣式所做成的。 "Our forefathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the desert, just as He who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern he had seen.
45. 我們的祖先相繼承受了這會幕，並且與 約書亞 一起把它帶進了繼業之地，就是神從我們祖先面前趕出的外邦人的地，直到 大衛 的時代。 Our forefathers in turn received it and with Joshua brought it in when they dispossessed the nations that God drove out before our fathers, until the days of David.
46. 大衛 在神面前蒙了恩典，就祈求為 雅各 的神 預備 一個居所 。 He found favor in God's sight and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
47. 但為神建造殿宇 的卻是 所羅門 。 But it was Solomon who built Him a house.
48. 其實至高者並不住在人手所造的殿宇 裡，正如先知所說： However, the Most High does not dwell in sanctuaries made with hands, as the prophet says:
49. 『主說：「天是我的寶座， 地是我的腳凳。 你們要為我建造什麼樣的殿宇 呢？ 我安息的地方在哪裡呢？ Heaven is My throne, and earth My footstool. What sort of house will you build for Me? says the Lord, or what is My resting place?
50. 這一切難道不都是我手所造的嗎？」』 Did not My hand make all these things?
51. 「你們這些頑固不化、心和耳都未受割禮的人哪，你們總是抗拒聖靈！你們的祖先怎樣，你們也怎樣。 "You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You are always resisting the Holy Spirit; as your forefathers did, so do you.
52. 有哪一位先知，你們的祖先不逼迫呢？他們殺了那些預言那義者要來的先知，現在你們又成為那義者的出賣者和凶手了。 Which of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? They even killed those who announced beforehand the coming of the Righteous One, whose betrayers and murderers you have now become.
53. 你們領受了藉天使所設立的律法，卻不遵守。」 You received the law under the direction of angels and yet have not kept it."
54. 他們聽了這些話就勃然大怒，向 司提反 咬牙切齒。 When they heard these things, they were enraged in their hearts and gnashed their teeth at him.
55. 但是 司提反 充滿聖靈，注目望天，看見了神的榮耀，又看見耶穌站在神的右邊。 But Stephen, filled by the Holy Spirit, gazed into heaven. He saw God's glory, with Jesus standing at the right hand of God, and he said,
56. 他說：「看哪，我看見諸天開了，人子站在神的右邊。」 "Look! I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!"
57. 於是他們大聲喊叫，摀著耳朵，一齊向他衝過去， Then they screamed at the top of their voices, stopped their ears, and rushed together against him.
58. 把他拉到城外，用石頭砸他。那些見證人把自己的外衣放在一個稱為 掃羅 的年輕人腳前。 They threw him out of the city and began to stone him. And the witnesses laid their robes at the feet of a young man named Saul.
59. 他們用石頭砸 司提反 的時候， 司提反 向主 呼求，說：「主耶穌，求你接受我的靈魂！」 They were stoning Stephen as he called out: "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!"
60. 然後他跪下，大聲呼喊：「主啊，不要把這罪歸於他們。」說了這話，他就睡了。 Then he knelt down and cried out with a loud voice, "Lord, do not charge them with this sin!" And saying this, he fell asleep.
Acts 8
1. 掃羅 也贊同殺害 司提反 。 從那一天開始，有大逼迫臨到 耶路撒冷 的教會。除了使徒以外，他們都分散到 猶太 和 撒馬利亞 地區。 Saul agreed with putting him to death. On that day a severe persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout the land of Judea and Samaria.
2. 有些虔誠的人把 司提反 埋葬了，為他大大地悲傷。 But devout men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.
3. 掃羅 卻摧殘教會，闖進各家各戶，無論男女都拉去關進監獄。 Saul, however, was ravaging the church, and he would enter house after house, drag off men and women, and put them in prison.
4. 於是那些分散的人就走遍各地傳講福音 。 So those who were scattered went on their way proclaiming the message of good news.
5. 腓利 下到 撒馬利亞 的一個城，向那裡的人傳講基督。 Philip went down to a city in Samaria and preached the Messiah to them.
6. 當眾人聽見又看見 腓利 所行的神蹟，就同心合意，專心聽他所說的話。 The crowds paid attention with one mind to what Philip said, as they heard and saw the signs he was performing.
7. 那時，有許多人被汙靈附身，那些汙靈大聲喊叫著從他們身上出來了；許多癱瘓的和瘸腿的，也得了痊癒。 For unclean spirits, crying out with a loud voice, came out of many who were possessed, and many who were paralyzed and lame were healed.
8. 所以那城裡，有極大的喜樂。 So there was great joy in that city.
9. 有一個名叫 西門 的人，自稱是個大人物，一向在那城裡行邪術，使 撒馬利亞 的居民十分驚訝。 A man named Simon had previously practiced sorcery in that city and astounded the Samaritan people, while claiming to be somebody great.
10. 所有的人，從卑微的到尊貴的，都聽從他。他們說：「這個人就是那被稱為『神的大能者』的。」 They all paid attention to him, from the least of them to the greatest, and they said, "This man is called the Great Power of God!"
11. 他們聽從 他，因為他長期以來用邪術使他們十分驚訝。 They were attentive to him because he had astounded them with his sorceries for a long time.
12. 可是 腓利 傳講有關神國的福音和耶穌基督之名的時候，他們就相信了，無論男女都受了洗， But when they believed Philip, as he proclaimed the good news about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.
13. 連 西門 自己也信了。他受洗 以後，常常跟著 腓利，看見所行出來的神蹟和大能，就十分驚訝。 Then even Simon himself believed. And after he was baptized, he went around constantly with Philip and was astounded as he observed the signs and great miracles that were being performed.
14. 在 耶路撒冷 的使徒們聽說 撒馬利亞 人接受了神的話語，就派 彼得 和 約翰 到他們那裡去。 When the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had welcomed God's message, they sent Peter and John to them.
15. 兩個人下去，就為他們禱告，好使他們領受聖靈， After they went down there, they prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit.
16. 因為聖靈還沒有降臨到他們任何人身上。他們只是受洗歸入了主耶穌的名 。 For He had not yet come down on any of them; they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
17. 於是 彼得 和 約翰 按手在他們身上，他們就領受了聖靈。 Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
18. 西門 看見因著使徒們的按手，有聖靈 賜下，就拿了錢給他們， When Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles' hands, he offered them money,
19. 說：「請把這權柄也給我，使我按手在誰身上，誰就可以領受聖靈。」 saying, "Give me this power too, so that anyone I lay hands on may receive the Holy Spirit."
20. 彼得 對他說：「你的銀子和你一起滅亡 吧！因為你以為神的恩賜可以用錢買到！ But Peter told him, "May your silver be destroyed with you, because you thought the gift of God could be obtained with money!
21. 你在這件事上無份無關，因為在神面前你的心不正。 You have no part or share in this matter, because your heart is not right before God.
22. 所以你應當為這惡事悔改，向主 祈求，或許你心中的意念因此被赦免。 Therefore repent of this wickedness of yours, and pray to the Lord that the intent of your heart may be forgiven you.
23. 因我看出你在苦毒的膽汁中，被不義所捆綁。」 For I see you are poisoned by bitterness and bound by iniquity."
24. 西門 回答說：「請你們為我向主祈求，使你們所說的，沒有一樣臨到我。」 "Please pray to the Lord for me," Simon replied, "so that nothing you have said may happen to me."
25. 於是 彼得 和 約翰 在那裡鄭重地做見證，傳講了主的福音，又在 撒馬利亞 人的許多村莊傳福音，就回 耶路撒冷 去了。 Then, after they had testified and spoken the message of the Lord, they traveled back to Jerusalem, evangelizing many villages of the Samaritans.
26. 有主的一位天使對 腓利 說：「你起來，順著那條從 耶路撒冷 下到 加沙 的路，往南走。」那裡是曠野。 An angel of the Lord spoke to Philip: "Get up and go south to the road that goes down from Jerusalem to desert Gaza."
27. 腓利 就起身去了。看哪，有一個 埃塞俄比亞 人，是個太監，是 埃塞俄比亞坎蒂絲 女王的大臣，統管她整個國庫。他到 耶路撒冷 去敬拜後， So he got up and went. There was an Ethiopian man, a eunuch and high official of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was in charge of her entire treasury. He had come to worship in Jerusalem
28. 在回去的時候，坐在他的馬車裡誦讀先知 以賽亞 的書。 and was sitting in his chariot on his way home, reading the prophet Isaiah aloud.
29. 聖靈對 腓利 說：「你上前去，貼近那馬車走。」 The Spirit told Philip, "Go and join that chariot."
30. 腓利 跑過去，聽見他正在誦讀先知 以賽亞 的書，就問：「難道你真的明白你所讀的嗎？」 When Philip ran up to it, he heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, "Do you understand what you're reading?"
31. 太監回答說：「如果沒有人指教我，我怎麼能明白呢？」他就請 腓利 上來和他同坐。 "How can I," he said, "unless someone guides me?" So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
32. 太監誦讀的那段經文是這樣的： 「他像羊被牽去宰殺， 又像羊羔在剪毛的人面前默默無聲， 他也這樣不開口。 Now the Scripture passage he was reading was this: He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb is silent before its shearer, so He does not open His mouth.
33. 他在屈辱中，公義被奪走了， 誰能述說他的世代呢 ？ 因為他的生命從地上被奪走了。」 In His humiliation justice was denied Him. Who will describe His generation? For His life is taken from the earth.
34. 太監對 腓利 說：「請問，先知說的這話是關於誰呢？是關於自己，還是關於別人呢？」 The eunuch replied to Philip, "I ask you, who is the prophet saying this about-- himself or another person?"
35. 腓利 就開口，從這一段經文開始，向他傳講耶穌的福音。 So Philip proceeded to tell him the good news about Jesus, beginning from that Scripture.
36. 當他們沿路前行的時候，來到一個有水的地方。太監說：「看哪，有水！有什麼能阻止我受洗呢？」 As they were traveling down the road, they came to some water. The eunuch said, "Look, there's water! What would keep me from being baptized?"
37. 腓利 說：「如果你全心相信就可以受洗。」太監回答說：「我相信耶穌基督是神的兒子。」 [[And Philip said, "If you believe with all your heart you may." And he replied, "I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God."]]
38. 於是他吩咐停下馬車， 腓利 和太監，兩個人下到水裡， 腓利 就給他施洗 。 Then he ordered the chariot to stop, and both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and he baptized him.
39. 他們從水裡上來的時候，主的靈把 腓利 提走，太監再也看不見他了。太監繼續趕路，滿心快樂。 When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him any longer. But he went on his way rejoicing.
40. 後來， 腓利 出現在 阿佐托 。他走遍各個城鎮傳揚福音，直到他來到 凱撒里亞 。 Philip appeared in Azotus, and passing through, he was evangelizing all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
Acts 9
1. 掃羅 仍然向主的門徒們口吐凶殺威嚇的話。他來到大祭司面前， Meanwhile Saul, still breathing threats and murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
2. 求他發一些信函給 大馬士革 各會堂，准許 掃羅 如果發現什麼人屬於這道，無論男女，都捆綁起來，帶到 耶路撒冷 。 and requested letters from him to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any who belonged to the Way, either men or women, he might bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
3. 當 掃羅 趕路，快到 大馬士革 的時候，忽然有光從天上下來，四面照射他。 As he traveled and was nearing Damascus, a light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
4. 他仆倒在地上，聽見有聲音對他說： 「 掃羅， ！你為什麼逼迫我？」 Falling to the ground, he heard a voice saying to him, "Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?"
5. 他問：「主啊，你到底是誰？」 主說： 「我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。 "Who are You, Lord?" he said. "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting," He replied.
6. 你起來，進城去！有人會告訴你應該做什麼。」 "But get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do."
7. 與 掃羅 同行的人都站著，啞口無言，他們雖然聽見聲音，卻看不見任何人。 The men who were traveling with him stood speechless, hearing the sound but seeing no one.
8. 掃羅 從地上爬起來，睜開眼睛，卻什麼也看不見。他們牽著他的手，把他帶進 大馬士革 。 Then Saul got up from the ground, and though his eyes were open, he could see nothing. So they took him by the hand and led him into Damascus.
9. 他三天不能看見，不吃也不喝。 He was unable to see for three days, and did not eat or drink.
10. 在 大馬士革 有一個名叫 阿納尼亞 的門徒。主在異象中對他說： 「 ！」 他回答說：「主啊！看哪，我在這裡。」 Now in Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. And the Lord said to him in a vision, "Ananias!" "Here I am, Lord!" he said.
11. 主就對他說： 「起來，往那叫做『 直 』的街上去，在 猶大 家裡找一個名叫 掃羅 的 塔爾蘇 人。看哪，原來他正在禱告。 "Get up and go to the street called Straight," the Lord said to him, "to the house of Judas, and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, since he is praying there.
12. 他在異象中 看見了一個名叫 阿納尼亞 的人，進來按手在他身上，使他重見光明。」 In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and placing his hands on him so he may regain his sight."
13. 阿納尼亞 卻回答：「主啊，我聽許多人說過有關這個人在 耶路撒冷 對你的聖徒們所做的種種惡事。 "Lord," Ananias answered, "I have heard from many people about this man, how much harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
14. 並且，他得到祭司長們的授權來到這裡，要捆綁所有求告你名的人。」 And he has authority here from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name."
15. 但是主對他說： 「你去吧！因為這個人是我所揀選的器皿，不但要在外邦人和君王面前，還要在 以色列 子民面前宣揚 我的名。 But the Lord said to him, "Go! For this man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before Gentiles, kings, and the sons of Israel.
16. 我要指示他，為了我的名他必須受多大的苦害。」 I will certainly show him how much he must suffer for My name!"
17. 阿納尼亞 就去了。他進了那家，按手在 掃羅 身上，說：「 掃羅 弟兄，在你來的路上向你顯現的主耶穌差派我來，使你重見光明，並且被聖靈充滿。」 So Ananias left and entered the house. Then he placed his hands on him and said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road you were traveling, has sent me so you may regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
18. 立刻有像鱗片一樣的東西從 掃羅 的眼睛上掉了下來，他就重見光明了。於是他起來受了洗； At once something like scales fell from his eyes, and he regained his sight. Then he got up and was baptized.
19. 吃過飯，體力就恢復了。 掃羅 與在 大馬士革 的門徒們住了幾天， And after taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul was with the disciples in Damascus for some days.
20. 就立刻在各會堂裡傳講耶穌，說這一位就是神的兒子。 Immediately he began proclaiming Jesus in the synagogues: "He is the Son of God."
21. 所有聽見的人都十分驚訝，說：「這不就是那個在 耶路撒冷 殘害了那些求告這名的人嗎？而且他來到這裡，不就是為要捆綁他們，帶到祭司長們那裡嗎？」 But all who heard him were astounded and said, "Isn't this the man who, in Jerusalem, was destroying those who called on this name, and then came here for the purpose of taking them as prisoners to the chief priests?"
22. 掃羅 反而更加得以剛強，證明這一位就是基督，使住在 大馬士革 的 猶太 人很狼狽。 But Saul grew more capable, and kept confounding the Jews who lived in Damascus by proving that this One is the Messiah.
23. 過了許多日子以後， 猶太 人商議要殺了 掃羅， After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,
24. 但他們的陰謀卻被 掃羅 知道了。於是他們就日夜嚴守著各城門，要殺掉他。 but their plot became known to Saul. So they were watching the gates day and night intending to kill him,
25. 然而他的門徒們趁夜把他帶去，用筐子把他從城牆上縋了下去。 but his disciples took him by night and lowered him in a large basket through [an opening in] the wall.
26. 掃羅 來到 耶路撒冷，想要和門徒們交往，可是大家都怕他，不相信他成了門徒。 When he arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to associate with the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, since they did not believe he was a disciple.
27. 但是 巴拿巴 接納他，把他帶到使徒們那裡，並且告訴他們 掃羅 怎樣在路上見到主，主怎樣對他說了話，以及他怎樣在 大馬士革 奉耶穌的名放膽傳道。 Barnabas, however, took him and brought him to the apostles and explained to them how, on the road, Saul had seen the Lord, and that He had talked to him, and how in Damascus he had spoken boldly in the name of Jesus.
28. 於是 掃羅 在 耶路撒冷 與他們一起出入，奉主 的名放膽傳道。 Saul was coming and going with them in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
29. 他對那些說 希臘 語的 猶太 人講道，與他們辯論；他們卻圖謀要殺了他。 He conversed and debated with the Hellenistic Jews, but they attempted to kill him.
30. 弟兄們知道了這事，就帶他下到 凱撒里亞，然後送他往 塔爾蘇 去。 When the brothers found out, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
31. 這樣，教會在 猶太 、 加利利 、 撒馬利亞 全地得平安、得造就，並且懷著對主的敬畏之心不斷地前行，在聖靈的安慰 中不斷地增長。 So the church throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace, being built up and walking in the fear of the Lord and in the encouragement of the Holy Spirit, and it increased in numbers.
32. 有一次， 彼得 走遍各地的時候，也下到住在 利達 的聖徒們那裡。 As Peter was traveling from place to place, he also came down to the saints who lived in Lydda.
33. 在那裡，他遇見了一個名叫 艾尼亞 的人。他是個癱瘓的人，躺在墊子上八年了。 There he found a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had been bedridden for eight years.
34. 彼得 對他說：「 艾尼亞，耶穌基督使你痊癒。站起來，為你自己整理墊子吧！」 艾尼亞 立刻就站起來了。 Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your own bed," and immediately he got up.
35. 於是所有住在 利達 和 沙崙 的人看到他，就歸向了主。 So all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
36. 在 約帕 有一個女門徒，名叫 塔比莎 ——「 塔比莎 」翻譯出來意思是「羚羊 」。她盡做美善工作，常行施捨。 In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha, which is translated Dorcas. She was always doing good works and acts of charity.
37. 就在那些日子裡，她患病死了。人們清洗了遺體，就放在樓上的房間。 In those days she became sick and died. After washing her, they placed her in a room upstairs.
38. 利達 離 約帕 不遠，門徒們聽說 彼得 在 利達，就派了兩個人到他那裡，懇求他說：「請你來到我們這裡，不要耽延！」 Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples heard that Peter was there and sent two men to him who begged him, "Don't delay in coming with us."
39. 彼得 就起身陪他們一起去。到了以後，他們把他領到樓上的房間。所有的寡婦都站在 彼得 旁邊哭，把 多卡絲 與她們在一起的時候所縫製的衣服和袍子拿給他看。 So Peter got up and went with them. When he arrived, they led him to the room upstairs. And all the widows approached him, weeping and showing him the robes and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was with them.
40. 彼得 叫大家都出去，然後跪下禱告，接著轉過身對著遺體，說：「 塔比莎，你起來！」那婦人就睜開眼睛，看見 彼得，而且坐了起來。 Then Peter sent them all out of the room. He knelt down, prayed, and turning toward the body said, "Tabitha, get up!" She opened her eyes, saw Peter, and sat up.
41. 彼得 伸手扶她站起來，又叫聖徒們和寡婦們進來，把活過來的 多卡絲 交給他們。 He gave her his hand and helped her stand up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her alive.
42. 這事傳遍了整個 約帕，許多人就信了主。 This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
43. 後來， 彼得 在 約帕 的一個硝皮匠 西門 家裡住了許多日子。 And Peter stayed on many days in Joppa with Simon, a leather tanner.
Acts 10
1. 在 凱撒里亞 有一個名叫 哥尼流 的人，是那叫做「 意大利 」軍團的百夫長， There was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment.
2. 他是個敬虔的人，與全家都敬畏神；他慷慨地賙濟民眾，常常向神禱告。 He was a devout man and feared God along with his whole household. He did many charitable deeds for the [Jewish] people and always prayed to God.
3. 有一天，大約下午三點，他在異象中清楚地看見神的一位天使來到他面前，對他說：「 哥尼流 ！」 At about three in the afternoon he distinctly saw in a vision an angel of God who came in and said to him, "Cornelius!"
4. 哥尼流 注視著他，感到害怕，說：「主啊，有什麼事呢？」 天使說：「你的禱告和你的施捨，已經上達神的面前蒙記念了。 Looking intently at him, he became afraid and said, "What is it, Lord?" And he told him, "Your prayers and your acts of charity have come up as a memorial offering before God.
5. 現在你要派人到 約帕 去，請一位稱為 彼得 的 西門 來。 Now send men to Joppa and call for Simon, who is also named Peter.
6. 他在一個硝皮匠 西門 的家裡作客住宿，房子就在海 邊。 」 He is lodging with Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the sea."
7. 向 哥尼流 說話的天使離開以後， 哥尼流 叫來兩個家僕和常伺候他的一個敬神的士兵， When the angel who spoke to him had gone, he called two of his household slaves and a devout soldier, who was one of those who attended him.
8. 向他們述說這一切以後，就派他們去 約帕 。 After explaining everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
9. 第二天，當他們趕路快到 約帕 的時候，大約中午十二點， 彼得 上屋頂去禱告。 The next day, as they were traveling and nearing the city, Peter went up to pray on the housetop at about noon.
10. 他感到餓了，想吃東西。有人正在給他準備的時候， 彼得 魂遊象外， Then he became hungry and wanted to eat, but while they were preparing something he went into a visionary state.
11. 看見天開了，有一樣東西降下，好像一塊大布，四角捆住，縋到地上。 He saw heaven opened and an object coming down that resembled a large sheet being lowered to the earth by its four corners.
12. 裡面有地上的各種四足動物、野獸 、爬行動物和天空的飛鳥。 In it were all the four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, and the birds of the sky.
13. 接著有聲音對他說： 「 彼得，起來，宰了吃！」 Then a voice said to him, "Get up, Peter; kill and eat!"
14. 彼得 卻說：「主啊，千萬不可！因為我從來沒有吃過任何俗物和不潔淨的東西。」 "No, Lord!" Peter said. "For I have never eaten anything common and unclean!"
15. 那聲音第二次又對他說： 「神所潔淨的，你不可當做汙穢的。」 Again, a second time, a voice said to him, "What God has made clean, you must not call common."
16. 這樣一連有三次，那東西隨即被收回天上去了。 This happened three times, and then the object was taken up into heaven.
17. 當 彼得 心裡困惑，不知道所看見的異象是什麼意思的時候，看哪， 哥尼流 派來的人已經打聽到了 西門 的家，站在門口， While Peter was deeply perplexed about what the vision he had seen might mean, the men who had been sent by Cornelius, having asked directions to Simon's house, stood at the gate.
18. 大聲問：「是否有一位稱為 彼得 的 西門 在這裡作客住宿？」 They called out, asking if Simon, who was also named Peter, was lodging there.
19. 彼得 還在思考那異象的時候，聖靈對他說：「看哪，有三個人來找你！ While Peter was thinking about the vision, the Spirit told him, "Three men are here looking for you.
20. 你起來，下去與他們一起走，不要有任何疑惑，因為是我派他們來的。」 Get up, go downstairs, and accompany them with no doubts at all, because I have sent them."
21. 彼得 就下到 那些人那裡，說：「看，我就是你們要找的人。你們來到這裡是為了什麼緣故呢？」 Then Peter went down to the men and said, "Here I am, the one you're looking for. What is the reason you're here?"
22. 他們說：「百夫長 哥尼流 是個義人，敬畏神，也受到了 猶太 全族的讚許。他受一位聖天使的指示：要請你到他家去，聽你的話語。」 They said, "Cornelius, a centurion, an upright and God-fearing man, who has a good reputation with the whole Jewish nation, was divinely directed by a holy angel to call you to his house and to hear a message from you."
23. 彼得 就請他們進來，招待了他們。 第二天，他起身與他們一同去，還有一些 約帕 的弟兄陪他一起去。 Peter then invited them in and gave them lodging. The next day he got up and set out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa went with him.
24. 又過了一天，他們進了 凱撒里亞 。 哥尼流 已經召集了他的親屬和好友，等候著他們。 The following day he entered Caesarea. Now Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
25. 當 彼得 進去的時候， 哥尼流 就迎上去，俯伏在他的腳前拜他。 When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell at his feet, and worshiped him.
26. 彼得 扶他起來，說：「你起來，我自己也是個人。」 But Peter helped him up and said, "Stand up! I myself am also a man."
27. 彼得 與他說著話進去，看見裡面聚集了許多人， While talking with him, he went on in and found that many had come together there.
28. 就對他們說：「你們知道， 猶太 人和外族人交往或親近是律法所禁止的 。但是神指示我，不要把任何人當做俗的或不潔淨的。 Peter said to them, "You know it's forbidden for a Jewish man to associate with or visit a foreigner. But God has shown me that I must not call any person common or unclean.
29. 所以我一受邀請，沒有推辭就來了。那麼請問，你們請我來有什麼事呢？」 That's why I came without any objection when I was sent for. So I ask, 'Why did you send for me?'"
30. 哥尼流 說：「四天前的這個時候，下午三點，我在家裡禱告 。忽然有一個身穿明亮衣服的人，站在我面前， Cornelius replied, "Four days ago at this hour, at three in the afternoon, I was praying in my house. Just then a man in a dazzling robe stood before me
31. 說『 哥尼流，你的禱告已蒙垂聽，你的施捨已經在神面前蒙記念了。 and said, 'Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your acts of charity have been remembered in God's sight.
32. 所以你當派人到 約帕 去，請一位稱為 彼得 的 西門 來。他在海邊硝皮匠 西門 的家裡作客住宿。 』 Therefore send someone to Joppa and invite Simon here, who is also named Peter. He is lodging in Simon the tanner's house by the sea.'
33. 所以我就立即派人到你那裡。你來了真好！現在我們都來到這裡，在神的面前，聆聽主 所吩咐你的一切話。」 Therefore I immediately sent for you, and you did the right thing in coming. So we are all present before God, to hear everything you have been commanded by the Lord."
34. 於是 彼得 就開口說：「我現在真的了解神是不偏待人的， Then Peter began to speak: "In truth, I understand that God doesn't show favoritism,
35. 原來在各民族中，那敬畏神而行義的人，都是神所悅納的。 but in every nation the person who fears Him and does righteousness is acceptable to Him.
36. 神藉著耶穌基督——這一位就是萬有之主——傳和平 的福音，把這話語賜給了 以色列 子民。 He sent the message to the sons of Israel, proclaiming the good news of peace through Jesus Christ-- He is Lord of all.
37. 你們知道在 約翰 所傳講的洗禮以後，那從 加利利 開始，在 猶太 全地所發生的事， You know the events that took place throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee after the baptism that John preached:
38. 就是神怎樣以聖靈和能力膏立 拿撒勒 人耶穌，他走遍各地行善，使所有受魔鬼壓制的人痊癒，因為神與他同在。 how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how He went about doing good and curing all who were under the tyranny of the Devil, because God was with Him.
39. 我們就是他在 猶太 人之地和 耶路撒冷 所行的一切事的見證人。他們竟然把他掛在木頭上殺了。 We ourselves are witnesses of everything He did in both the Judean country and in Jerusalem; yet they killed Him by hanging Him on a tree.
40. 第三天，神使他復活，並且使他顯現， God raised up this man on the third day and permitted Him to be seen,
41. 不是顯現給全體民眾，而是顯現給神預先選定的見證人，就是我們這些在他從死人中復活以後，與他一起吃、一起喝的人。 not by all the people, but by us, witnesses appointed beforehand by God, who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.
42. 耶穌還吩咐我們要向民眾傳道，鄭重地見證他就是神所設定的那一位，活人和死人的審判者。 He commanded us to preach to the people, and to solemnly testify that He is the One appointed by God to be the Judge of the living and the dead.
43. 所有的先知都為耶穌見證：『所有信他的人，都將藉著他的名，罪得赦免。』」 All the prophets testify about Him that through His name everyone who believes in Him will receive forgiveness of sins."
44. 彼得 還在講這些話的時候，聖靈降臨在每個聽這話語的人身上。 While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came down on all those who heard the message.
45. 所有陪 彼得 一起來的割禮派的 信徒，看見所賜的聖靈 也被傾注在外邦人身上，都十分驚訝， The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astounded, because the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out on the Gentiles also.
46. 因為他們聽見外邦人說著殊言，又尊神為大。 於是 彼得 說： For they heard them speaking in [other] languages and declaring the greatness of God. Then Peter responded,
47. 「這些人就像我們一樣也領受了聖靈，到底誰能阻止用水給他們施洗 呢？」 "Can anyone withhold water and prevent these from being baptized, who have received the Holy Spirit just as we have?"
48. 他就吩咐他們奉耶穌基督 的名受洗 ；然後他們請求 彼得 在那裡多住幾天。 And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay for a few days.
Acts 11
1. 後來，使徒們和在 猶太 各地的弟兄們聽說外邦人也接受了神的話語 。 The apostles and the brothers who were throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles had welcomed God's message also.
2. 可是當 彼得 上到 耶路撒冷 的時候，那些割禮派的人 卻批評他， When Peter went up to Jerusalem, those who stressed circumcision argued with him,
3. 說：「你竟然進到沒有受割禮之人的家裡，又與他們一起吃飯。」 saying, "You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them!"
4. 彼得 就開始按著次序向他們講解，說： Peter began to explain to them in an orderly sequence, saying:
5. 「我在 約帕 城裡禱告的時候，魂遊象外，看見一個異象：有一樣東西 從天上降下，好像一塊大布，四角捆住，縋到我面前來。 "I was in the town of Joppa praying, and I saw, in a visionary state, an object coming down that resembled a large sheet being lowered from heaven by its four corners, and it came to me.
6. 我注目觀看它，看見裡面有 地上的四足動物、野獸、爬行動物和天空的飛鳥； When I looked closely and considered it, I saw the four-footed animals of the earth, the wild beasts, the reptiles, and the birds of the sky.
7. 那時我也聽見有聲音對我說： 『 彼得，起來，宰了吃！』 Then I also heard a voice telling me, 'Get up, Peter; kill and eat!'
8. 我說：『主啊，千萬不可！因為俗物或不潔淨的東西，從來沒有入過我的口。』 " 'No, Lord!' I said. 'For nothing common or unclean has ever entered my mouth!'
9. 那聲音第二次從天上傳來，說： 『神所潔淨的，你不可當做汙穢的。』 But a voice answered from heaven a second time, 'What God has made clean, you must not call common.'
10. 這樣一連有三次，然後所有的東西又被收回天上去了。 "Now this happened three times, and then everything was drawn up again into heaven.
11. 正在這時，忽然有三個人站在我們所住的房子面前，他們是從 凱撒里亞 被派到我這裡的。 At that very moment, three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea arrived at the house where we were.
12. 聖靈吩咐我：要陪他們一起去，不要有任何疑惑。當時與我一起去的，還有這六位弟兄。後來我們就進了那人的家。 Then the Spirit told me to go with them with no doubts at all. These six brothers accompanied me, and we went into the man's house.
13. 他告訴我們，他怎樣看見一位天使站在他家裡說：『你要派人 到 約帕 去，請那稱為 彼得 的 西門 來； He reported to us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying, 'Send to Joppa, and call for Simon, who is also named Peter.
14. 他有話要對你說，藉這話你和你全家將要得救。』 He will speak words to you by which you and all your household will be saved.'
15. 我一開始講話，聖靈就降臨在他們身上，就像當初降臨在我們身上一樣。 "As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came down on them, just as on us at the beginning.
16. 我就想起了主如此說的話， 『 約翰 用水 施洗，但你們將要受聖靈的洗。』 Then I remembered the word of the Lord, how He said, 'John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.'
17. 因此，神如果給了他們這相同的恩賜，就像在我們信靠主耶穌基督的時候也給了我們一樣，那麼，我是誰呢？難道能攔阻神嗎？」 Therefore, if God gave them the same gift that He also gave to us when we believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, how could I possibly hinder God?"
18. 他們聽了這些話就安靜下來，然後就榮耀神，說：「這樣，神把悔改的心也賜給外邦人，使他們得生命。」 When they heard this they became silent. Then they glorified God, saying, "So God has granted repentance resulting in life to even the Gentiles!"
19. 於是那些因 司提反 的事受患難而四散的信徒，就一直走到 腓尼基 地區、 塞浦路斯 島和 安提阿 。他們只向 猶太 人，而不向任何人傳講福音 。 Those who had been scattered as a result of the persecution that started because of Stephen made their way as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message to no one except Jews.
20. 但其中有一些 塞浦路斯 人和 古利奈 人，來到 安提阿，也向 希臘 人講道，傳主耶穌的福音。 But there were some of them, Cypriot and Cyrenian men, who came to Antioch and began speaking to the Hellenists, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.
21. 主的手與他們同在，有許許多多的人就相信、歸向了主。 The Lord's hand was with them, and a large number who believed turned to the Lord.
22. 這消息傳到在 耶路撒冷 的教會，他們就派 巴拿巴 到 安提阿 去。 Then the report about them reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent out Barnabas to travel as far as Antioch.
23. 巴拿巴 到了，看見神的恩典就感到歡喜，鼓勵大家要立定心志，繼續靠 主， When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he was glad, and he encouraged all of them to remain true to the Lord with a firm resolve of the heart--
24. ——這是因為 巴拿巴 是個好人，充滿聖靈和信仰。於是有一大群人歸向 了主。 for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith-- and large numbers of people were added to the Lord.
25. 後來 巴拿巴 到 塔爾蘇 去找 掃羅， Then he went to Tarsus to search for Saul,
26. 找到了，就帶他到 安提阿 來。然後有整整一年，兩個人與會眾聚在一起，教導了一大群人。門徒們第一次被稱為「基督徒」是在 安提阿 。 and when he found him he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they met with the church and taught large numbers, and the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
27. 在那些日子裡，有幾個做先知傳道的 從 耶路撒冷 下到 安提阿 。 In those days some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
28. 其中有一個名叫 阿伽布斯 的站起來，藉著聖靈指明普天下將有大饑荒。這事在凱撒 克勞迪 時期果然發生了。 Then one of them, named Agabus, stood up and predicted by the Spirit that there would be a severe famine throughout the Roman world. This took place during the time of Claudius.
29. 於是門徒們決定，每個人照著自己的能力來捐獻，好送到住在 猶太 的弟兄們那裡。 So each of the disciples, according to his ability, determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea.
30. 他們就這麼做了，由 巴拿巴 和 掃羅 經手，把所捐獻的送到長老們那裡。 This they did, sending it to the elders by means of Barnabas and Saul.
Acts 12
1. 大約在此時， 希律 王下手虐待教會中的一些人， About that time King Herod cruelly attacked some who belonged to the church,
2. 用刀殺了 約翰 的哥哥 雅各 。 and he killed James, John's brother, with the sword.
3. 他見這事使 猶太 人高興，就又去抓 彼得 ；那時正是除酵節期間。 When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to arrest Peter too, during the days of Unleavened Bread.
4. 希律 抓了 彼得，把他關進監獄，交給四班士兵看守，每班四個人，打算在逾越節以後把他提到民眾面前審判 。 After the arrest, he put him in prison and assigned four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
5. 這樣， 彼得 被拘留在監獄裡，教會卻為他熱切地向神禱告。 So Peter was kept in prison, but prayer was being made earnestly to God for him by the church.
6. 希律 要把 彼得 提出來審判 的前一夜， 彼得 被兩條鐵鏈捆鎖，睡在兩個士兵中間，又有一些衛兵在監獄門前看守著。 On the night before Herod was to bring him out [for execution], Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, while the sentries in front of the door guarded the prison.
7. 忽然主的一位天使站在旁邊，牢房裡有光照耀。天使拍拍 彼得 的肋旁，叫醒他，說：「趕快起來！」那些鐵鏈立刻就從 彼得 的手上掉了下來。 Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared, and a light shone in the cell. Striking Peter on the side, he woke him up and said, "Quick, get up!" Then the chains fell off his wrists.
8. 天使對他說：「束上腰帶，穿上鞋子！」他就照著做了。天使又說：「披上外衣，跟著我！」 "Get dressed," the angel told him, "and put on your sandals." And he did so. "Wrap your cloak around you," he told him, "and follow me."
9. 彼得 就出來跟著走，卻不知道天使所做的是真的，以為自己是見了異象。 So he went out and followed, and he did not know that what took place through the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision.
10. 他們經過第一和第二道崗，來到通往城裡的鐵門前，鐵門就自動為他們開了。他們出去，走過一條街，天使立刻離開了他。 After they passed the first and second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went outside and passed one street, and immediately the angel left him.
11. 這時候， 彼得 清醒過來，說：「現在我確實知道主派了他的天使來，救我脫離 希律 的手和 猶太 民眾所期待的一切事。」 Then Peter came to himself and said, "Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod's grasp and from all that the Jewish people expected."
12. 他明白之後，就到 約翰 的母親 瑪麗亞 家去，這 約翰 又叫 馬可 。有許多人聚集在那裡禱告。 When he realized this, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark, where many had assembled and were praying.
13. 彼得 敲了外面的門，一個叫 羅妲 的女僕前來應門。 He knocked at the door in the gateway, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
14. 她一認出是 彼得 的聲音，就高興得顧不上打開門，跑進去告訴大家說， 彼得 站在門外。 She recognized Peter's voice, and because of her joy she did not open the gate, but ran in and announced that Peter was standing at the gateway.
15. 他們對 羅妲 說：「你瘋了！」可是她堅持就是如此。他們不住地說：「那是他的天使。」 "You're crazy!" they told her. But she kept insisting that it was true. Then they said, "It's his angel!"
16. 這時， 彼得 不停地敲門。他們就打開了門，看見是他，都十分驚訝。 Peter, however, kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
17. 彼得 揮一下手叫他們安靜，告訴他們主怎樣領他出了監獄，又說：「你們把這些事告訴 雅各 和弟兄們。」然後他就出發，往別的地方去了。 Motioning to them with his hand to be silent, he explained to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. "Report these things to James and the brothers," he said. Then he departed and went to a different place.
18. 到天亮，士兵們中間起了不小的騷動，不知道 彼得 出了什麼事。 At daylight, there was a great commotion among the soldiers as to what could have become of Peter.
19. 希律 搜尋 彼得，卻沒有找到，就審問衛兵們，下令把他們處決了。後來 希律 離開 猶太，下到 凱撒里亞 去，住在那裡。 After Herod had searched and did not find him, he interrogated the guards and ordered their execution. Then Herod went down from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there.
20. 當時， 希律 一直惱恨 提爾 和 西頓 的人。所以他們聯合起來到王那裡去，先說服了王的內臣 布拉斯托，然後向王求和，因為他們地區的人是從王的領地 得糧食的。 He had been very angry with the Tyrians and Sidonians. Together they presented themselves before him, and having won over Blastus, who was in charge of the king's bedroom, they asked for peace, because their country was supplied with food from the king's country.
21. 在指定的日子， 希律 穿上王袍，坐在審判席上，向他們公開演說。 So on an appointed day, dressed in royal robes and seated on the throne, Herod delivered a public address to them.
22. 民眾一直喊叫：「這是神的聲音，不是人的聲音。」 The populace began to shout, "It's the voice of a god and not of a man!"
23. 主的一位天使立刻擊打 希律，因為他沒有把榮耀歸給神。他被蟲咬蝕，就斷了氣。 At once an angel of the Lord struck him because he did not give the glory to God, and he became infected with worms and died.
24. 於是神的話語 不斷擴展，越發廣傳。 Then God's message flourished and multiplied.
25. 巴拿巴 和 掃羅 完成了那服事的工作，就帶著那稱為 馬可 的 約翰，從 耶路撒冷 回去了 。 And Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem after they had completed their relief mission, on which they took John Mark.
Acts 13
1. 在 安提阿 當地的教會中有一些做先知傳道的 和教師，包括 巴拿巴 、稱為 尼格爾 的 西蒙 、 古利奈 人 盧吉斯 、與分封王 希律 一起長大的 馬納恩，還有 掃羅 。 In the local church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius the Cyrenian, Manaen, a close friend of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
2. 他們在服事主、禁食的時候，聖靈說：「來，你們把 巴拿巴 和 掃羅 為我分別出來，去做我所召喚他們做的工作！」 As they were ministering to the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work that I have called them to."
3. 於是他們禁食、禱告，按手在 巴拿巴 和 掃羅 身上，就送他們走了。 Then, after they had fasted, prayed, and laid hands on them, they sent them off.
4. 這樣，他們兩個人受聖靈的差遣，就下到 塞琉西亞，又從那裡坐船前往 塞浦路斯 島， Being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they came down to Seleucia, and from there they sailed to Cyprus.
5. 到了 薩拉米斯，就在 猶太 人的各會堂裡傳講神的話語 。他們也有 約翰馬可 做助理。 Arriving in Salamis, they proclaimed God's message in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their assistant.
6. 他們走遍全島，直到 帕福斯，遇見了一個名叫 巴耶蘇 的 猶太 人，是個行法術的假先知。 When they had gone through the whole island as far as Paphos, they came across a sorcerer, a Jewish false prophet named Bar-Jesus.
7. 他和省長 瑟吉烏斯保羅 常在一起。省長是一個明智的人，他請了 巴拿巴 和 掃羅 來，要求聽神的話語 。 He was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul and desired to hear God's message.
8. 但那行法術的 以路摩 ——他的名字翻譯出來就是「行法術的」——卻抵擋他們，企圖使省長轉離這信仰。 But Elymas, the sorcerer, which is how his name is translated, opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
9. 可是 掃羅，也就是 保羅，被聖靈充滿，注視著 以路摩， Then Saul-- also called Paul-- filled with the Holy Spirit, stared straight at the sorcerer
10. 說：「哦，你這個充滿一切詭詐、一切奸惡的人哪！魔鬼的兒子，一切公義的仇敵！你歪曲主的正道，還不停止嗎？ and said, "You son of the Devil, full of all deceit and all fraud, enemy of all righteousness! Won't you ever stop perverting the straight paths of the Lord?
11. 看哪，現在主的手臨到你，你要瞎眼，暫時看不見日光。」立刻，迷霧和黑暗籠罩了他，他四處摸索，求人牽手領路。 Now, look! The Lord's hand is against you: you are going to be blind, and will not see the sun for a time." Suddenly a mist and darkness fell on him, and he went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
12. 省長當時看見所發生的事，對主的教導驚嘆不已，就信了。 Then the proconsul, seeing what happened, believed and was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
13. 保羅 一行從 帕福斯 起航，來到 潘菲利亞 省的 佩爾格 。 約翰馬可 卻離開他們，回 耶路撒冷 去了。 Paul and his companions set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John, however, left them and went back to Jerusalem.
14. 他們從 佩爾格 往前行，來到 皮西迪亞 地區的 安提阿，在安息日那天，就進了會堂坐下。 They continued their journey from Perga and reached Antioch in Pisidia. On the Sabbath day they went into the synagogue and sat down.
15. 誦讀了律法和先知書以後，會堂主管們派人來對他們說：「各位兄弟，如果有什麼鼓勵民眾的話，就請說吧。」 After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders of the synagogue sent [word] to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have any message of encouragement for the people, you can speak."
16. 保羅 就站起來，揮一下手，說：「各位 以色列 人和敬畏神的人，請聽！ Then standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and spoke: "Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen!
17. 這 以色列 民族的神揀選了我們的祖先，當他們寄居在 埃及 地的時候，高舉他們，並用大能的膀臂帶領他們從那裡出來。 The God of this people Israel chose our forefathers, exalted the people during their stay in the land of Egypt, and led them out of it with a mighty arm.
