18. 在曠野，神容忍了他們約有四十年之久。 And for about 40 years He put up with them in the desert;
19. 神消滅了 迦南 地的七個民族後，把他們的土地賜給我們的先祖 為繼業， then after destroying seven nations in the land of Canaan, He gave their land to them as an inheritance.
20. 約有四百五十年。這些事以後，神又賜給他們士師，直到先知 撒母耳 為止。 This all took about 450 years. After this, He gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
21. 此後，他們要求立一個王，神就把 便雅憫 支派的一個人， 基士 的兒子 掃羅 給他們為王，共四十年。 Then they asked for a king, so God gave them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for 40 years.
22. 後來神廢除了 掃羅，興起 大衛 做他們的王，並且為他見證說：『 我找到了 耶西 的兒子 大衛，一個合乎我心意的人， 他將遵行我的一切旨意。』 After removing him, He raised up David as their king, of whom He testified: ' I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after My heart, who will carry out all My will.'
23. 「神照著應許，從這人的後裔中給 以色列 帶來了一位救主，就是耶穌。 "From this man's descendants, according to the promise, God brought the Savior, Jesus, to Israel.
24. 在耶穌公開出來之前， 約翰 預先向所有 以色列 子民宣講了悔改的洗禮。 Before He came to public attention, John had previously proclaimed a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
25. 當 約翰 快要跑盡該跑的路程 時，說：『你們認為我是誰？我不是那一位。看哪，他要在我以後來，我就是為他解腳上的鞋帶也不配。』 Then as John was completing his life work, he said, 'Who do you think I am? I am not the One. But look! Someone is coming after me, and I am not worthy to untie the sandals on His feet.'
26. 「各位兄弟， 亞伯拉罕 家的子孫和你們中間敬畏神的人哪，這救恩的福音 是賜給我們 的。 "Brothers, sons of Abraham's race, and those among you who fear God, the message of this salvation has been sent to us.
27. 實際上，住在 耶路撒冷 的人和他們的首領們都不認識這一位，也不明白每逢安息日所誦讀的先知們的話，就把他定罪，從而應驗了這些話。 For the residents of Jerusalem and their rulers, since they did not recognize Him or the voices of the prophets that are read every Sabbath, have fulfilled their words by condemning Him.
28. 他們雖然找不到處死他的任何理由，還是求 彼拉多 殺了他。 Though they found no grounds for the death penalty, they asked Pilate to have Him killed.
29. 當他們做完了經上所記載的一切有關耶穌的事，有些人就把他從木頭上取下來，安放在墓穴裡。 When they had fulfilled all that had been written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and put Him in a tomb.
30. 但是神使他從死人中復活了！ But God raised Him from the dead,
31. 一連好幾天，他向那些與他一起從 加利利 上到 耶路撒冷 的人顯現；這些人如今在民間做了他的見證人， and He appeared for many days to those who came up with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now His witnesses to the people.
32. 而我們也把應許給祖先的這福音傳給你們， And we ourselves proclaim to you the good news of the promise that was made to our forefathers.
33. 因為神使耶穌復活，已經為我們這些做他們兒女 的成全了這應許，正如詩篇第二篇也記著： 『你是我的兒子， 我今天生了你。』 God has fulfilled this to us their children by raising up Jesus, as it is written in the second Psalm: You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
34. 至於神使耶穌從死人中復活、不再歸於腐朽的事，神曾這樣說過： 『我要把給 大衛 的那聖潔、信實的祝福 賜給你們。』 Since He raised Him from the dead, never to return to decay, He has spoken in this way, I will grant you the faithful covenant blessings made to David.
35. 所以在另外一處也說： 『你不會讓你的聖者經歷腐朽。』 Therefore He also says in another passage, You will not allow Your Holy One to see decay.
36. 就是說， 大衛 雖然在自己的世代，遵行了神的計劃之後就睡了，歸到他祖先那裡，並且經歷了腐朽， For David, after serving his own generation in God's plan, fell asleep, was buried with his fathers, and decayed.
37. 但是神使之復活的那一位，沒有經歷腐朽。 But the One whom God raised up did not decay.
38. 所以各位兄弟，你們應當知道：罪得赦免，是因著這一位傳給你們的。在你們藉著 摩西 的律法，不能被稱為義的一切事上， Therefore, let it be known to you, brothers, that through this man forgiveness of sins is being proclaimed to you,
39. 藉著這一位，所有相信的人都被稱為義了。 and everyone who believes in Him is justified from everything, which you could not be justified from through the law of Moses.
40. 所以你們要當心，免得先知們所說的話臨到你們 ： So beware that what is said in the prophets does not happen to you:
41. 『看吧，你們這些好譏誚的人哪！ 驚奇吧，滅亡吧！ 因為在你們的時代裡，我要做一件事， 就算有人向你們詳細說明， 你們也絕不會相信。』 」 Look, you scoffers, marvel and vanish away, because I am doing a work in your days, a work that you will never believe, even if someone were to explain it to you."
42. 保羅 和 巴拿巴 離開會堂 的時候，大家 請求他們在下一個安息日再向他們講這些話。 As they were leaving, they begged that these matters be presented to them the following Sabbath.
43. 散會以後，許多 猶太 人和入 猶太 教的敬神之人，跟從了 保羅 和 巴拿巴 。他們兩個人與這些人談論，勸導他們繼續留在神的恩典中。 After the synagogue had been dismissed, many of the Jews and devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who were speaking with them and persuading them to continue in the grace of God.
44. 到了下一個安息日，全城的人幾乎都聚集，聽主 的福音 。 The following Sabbath almost the whole town assembled to hear the message of the Lord.
45. 但 猶太 人看見這一群人，就滿腔嫉妒，說褻瀆的話來反對 保羅 所講的。 But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and began to oppose what Paul was saying by insulting him.
46. 保羅 和 巴拿巴 就放膽直言，說：「神的話語 先傳給你們是必須的。既然你們棄絕這道，斷定自己不配得永恆的生命，看哪，我們就轉向外邦人， Then Paul and Barnabas boldly said: "It was necessary that God's message be spoken to you first. But since you reject it, and consider yourselves unworthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles!
47. 因為主是這樣吩咐我們的： 『我已經指派你為外邦人的光， 使你把救恩帶到地極。』 」 For this is what the Lord has commanded us: I have appointed you as a light for the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth."
48. 外邦人聽了這話就感到歡喜，不住地榮耀主的福音，凡是被預定進入永恆生命的人都信了。 When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the message of the Lord, and all who had been appointed to eternal life believed.
49. 於是主的福音 傳遍了那整個地區。 So the message of the Lord spread through the whole region.
50. 但 猶太 人煽動一些敬神的尊貴婦女和城裡的顯要人物，慫恿他們逼迫 保羅 和 巴拿巴，並且把他們驅逐出境。 But the Jews incited the religious women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and expelled them from their district.
51. 兩個人對著他們跺掉腳上的塵土，往 以哥念 去了。 But shaking the dust off their feet against them, they proceeded to Iconium.
52. 門徒們都滿心喜樂，又被聖靈充滿。 And the disciples were filled with joy and the Holy Spirit.
Acts 14
1. 有一次在 以哥念， 保羅 和 巴拿巴 同樣進了 猶太 人的會堂講道，結果有一大群 猶太 人和 希臘 人信了。 The same thing happened in Iconium; they entered the Jewish synagogue and spoke in such a way that a great number of both Jews and Greeks believed.
2. 但那些不肯信從的 猶太 人慫恿外邦人，使他們心裡敵視弟兄們。 But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up and poisoned the minds of the Gentiles against the brothers.
3. 於是 保羅 和 巴拿巴 就住了很久，靠著主 放膽傳道。主藉著他們的手行了神蹟和奇事，見證了他恩典的話語。 So they stayed there for some time and spoke boldly, in reliance on the Lord, who testified to the message of His grace by granting that signs and wonders be performed through them.
4. 以哥念 城的民眾就分裂了，有的贊同 猶太 人，有的贊同使徒們。 But the people of the city were divided, some siding with the Jews and some with the apostles.
5. 那時，外邦人和 猶太 人，與他們的首領們一同企圖凌辱 使徒們，要用石頭砸死他們。 When an attempt was made by both the Gentiles and Jews, with their rulers, to assault and stone them,
6. 兩個人知道了，就逃往 利考尼亞 地區的 路司得 和 代爾貝 兩個城以及周圍地區， they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian towns called Lystra and Derbe, and to the surrounding countryside.
7. 在那裡繼續傳福音。 And there they kept evangelizing.
8. 在 路司得 城裡坐著一個雙腳殘廢的人，他生來 就瘸腿，從來沒有走過路； In Lystra a man without strength in his feet, lame from birth, and who had never walked, sat
9. 這個人聽 保羅 講道。 保羅 注視著他，見他存著信可得救治， and heard Paul speaking. After observing him closely and seeing that he had faith to be healed,
10. 就大聲說：「你起來，用你的兩腳站直！」那個人就跳起來，開始走路了。 [Paul] said in a loud voice, "Stand up straight on your feet!" And he jumped up and started to walk around.
11. 眾人看見 保羅 所做的，就用 利考尼亞 話高聲說：「神明像人那樣降臨在我們中間了！」 When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they raised their voices, saying in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in the form of men!"
12. 他們稱 巴拿巴 為 宙斯 神，稱 保羅 為 赫爾墨斯 神，因為 保羅 是領頭說話的人。 And they started to call Barnabas, Zeus, and Paul, Hermes, because he was the main speaker.
13. 於是城外 宙斯 神廟的祭司，牽著幾頭公牛，帶著一些花環，到了城門口，要與眾人一起來獻祭。 Then the priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the town, brought oxen and garlands to the gates. He, with the crowds, intended to offer sacrifice.
14. 巴拿巴 和 保羅 兩位使徒聽見這事，就撕裂自己的衣服，衝進人群裡面， The apostles Barnabas and Paul tore their robes when they heard this and rushed into the crowd, shouting:
15. 喊著說：「各位，你們為什麼做這些事呢？我們和你們同樣是人！我們向你們傳福音，是要你們離棄這些虛妄的事，歸向永生的神， 就是造了天、地、海和其中萬有的神。 "Men! Why are you doing these things? We are men also, with the same nature as you, and we are proclaiming good news to you, that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
16. 在過去的各世代，神容忍萬民各行其道。 In past generations He allowed all the nations to go their own way,
17. 其實神並不是沒有為自己留下證據，因為他常行美善：從天上賜給你們 雨水和豐收的季節，使你們 食物充足，滿心喜樂。」 although He did not leave Himself without a witness, since He did good: giving you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, and satisfying your hearts with food and happiness."
18. 兩個人說了這些話，好不容易才阻止眾人向他們獻祭。 Even though they said these things, they barely stopped the crowds from sacrificing to them.
19. 但有些 猶太 人從 安提阿 和 以哥念 來到，挑唆眾人，用石頭砸了 保羅 。他們以為他已經死了，就把他拖到城外。 Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium, and when they had won over the crowds and stoned Paul, they dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
20. 但門徒們圍繞他的時候，他站了起來，進到城裡。第二天，他與 巴拿巴 一起離開，前往 代爾貝 去。 After the disciples surrounded him, he got up and went into the town. The next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.
21. 保羅 和 巴拿巴 在 代爾貝 城傳了福音，使許多人成為門徒以後，回到 路司得 、 以哥念 、 安提阿， After they had evangelized that town and made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, to Iconium, and to Antioch,
22. 堅固門徒們的心，鼓勵他們持守信仰，說：「我們進入神的國，必須經過很多患難。」 strengthening the hearts of the disciples by encouraging them to continue in the faith, and by telling them, "It is necessary to pass through many troubles on our way into the kingdom of God."
23. 保羅 和 巴拿巴 在各教會為他們選出了長老，禱告和禁食以後，把他們交託給他們所信靠的主。 When they had appointed elders in every church and prayed with fasting, they committed them to the Lord in whom they had believed.
24. 兩個人經過 皮西迪亞 地區，來到 潘菲利亞 省， Then they passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
25. 在 佩爾格 傳了道，就下到 阿塔利亞， After they spoke the message in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
26. 從那裡坐船回 安提阿 。當初，就是在這裡，他們被交託在神的恩典中，去從事如今那已完成的工作。 From there they sailed back to Antioch where they had been entrusted to the grace of God for the work they had completed.
27. 他們到了，就召集教會，傳講了神與他們所做的一切事，以及神怎樣為外邦人打開了信仰之門。 After they arrived and gathered the church together, they reported everything God had done with them, and that He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
28. 兩個人在那裡與門徒們一起住了不少時候。 And they spent a considerable time with the disciples.
Acts 15
1. 有一些人從 猶太 下來，教導弟兄們說：「你們如果不按 摩西 的規矩受割禮，就不能得救。」 Some men came down from Judea and began to teach the brothers: "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom prescribed by Moses, you cannot be saved!"
2. 保羅 、 巴拿巴 與他們發生了不小的爭執和辯論，他們就指定 保羅 、 巴拿巴 和其中的另一些人為這爭議的問題，上 耶路撒冷 到使徒們和長老們那裡去。 But after Paul and Barnabas had engaged them in serious argument and debate, they arranged for Paul and Barnabas and some others of them to go up to the apostles and elders in Jerusalem concerning this controversy.
3. 於是教會送他們上路；他們就走遍 腓尼基 和 撒馬利亞 地區，詳細說明外邦人悔改的事，給所有弟兄們帶來了極大的喜樂。 When they had been sent on their way by the church, they passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, explaining in detail the conversion of the Gentiles, and they created great joy among all the brothers.
4. 來到 耶路撒冷，他們受到教會、使徒們和長老們的歡迎，就向大家傳講了神與他們一起做的事。 When they arrived at Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, the apostles, and the elders, and they reported all that God had done with them.
5. 但 法利賽 教派中的一些信徒站起來，說：「必須給外邦人行割禮，並吩咐他們遵守 摩西 的律法。」 But some of the believers from the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, "It is necessary to circumcise them and to command them to keep the law of Moses!"
6. 使徒們和長老們就聚集探討這件事。 Then the apostles and the elders assembled to consider this matter.
7. 經過了許多辯論， 彼得 站起來對他們說：「各位弟兄，你們知道前些時候神在你們 中間施行揀選，要外邦人藉著我的口聽到福音之道，得以相信。 After there had been much debate, Peter stood up and said to them: "Brothers, you are aware that in the early days God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the Gentiles would hear the gospel message and believe.
8. 於是那洞察人心的神，賜聖靈給他們做了見證，就像為我們做的那樣； And God, who knows the heart, testified to them by giving the Holy Spirit, just as He also did to us.
9. 又藉著信潔淨了他們的心，在我們和他們之間不做什麼區別。 He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
10. 既然如此，你們現在為什麼試探神，把我們的祖先和我們都擔當不了的軛，放在那些門徒的脖子上呢？ Why, then, are you now testing God by putting on the disciples' necks a yoke that neither our forefathers nor we have been able to bear?
11. 相反，我們相信：我們得救是藉著主耶穌 的恩典，外邦人也是一樣。」 On the contrary, we believe we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, in the same way they are."
12. 這時，全體會眾都靜默無聲，聽 巴拿巴 和 保羅 述說神藉著他們在外邦人中所行的神蹟和奇事。 Then the whole assembly fell silent and listened to Barnabas and Paul describing all the signs and wonders God had done through them among the Gentiles.
13. 他們講完以後， 雅各 就回應說：「各位弟兄，請聽我說。 After they stopped speaking, James responded: "Brothers, listen to me!
14. 西門 已經述說了神當初怎樣臨到 外邦人，從他們中間選出子民，歸入自己的名。 Simeon has reported how God first intervened to take from the Gentiles a people for His name.
15. 連先知們的話也與此相符，正如經上所記： And the words of the prophets agree with this, as it is written:
16. 『此後我將要回來， 重建 大衛 倒塌的居所 ； 我要重建它的破損之處，把它重新豎立起來。 After these things I will return and will rebuild David's tent, which has fallen down. I will rebuild its ruins and will set it up again,
17. 這樣，其餘的人， 就是所有被稱為我名下的外邦人， 都會尋求主。 so that those who are left of mankind may seek the Lord-- even all the Gentiles who are called by My name, says the Lord who does these things,
18. 這是自古以來，讓人知道這些事的主說的。』 which have been known from long ago.
19. 因此，我判定不可為難那些歸向神的外邦人， Therefore, in my judgment, we should not cause difficulties for those who turn to God from among the Gentiles,
20. 不過要寫信給他們：要遠避偶像的汙穢，遠避淫亂、勒死的動物和血。 but instead we should write to them to abstain from things polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from eating anything that has been strangled, and from blood.
21. 因為自古以來，在各城裡都有人宣講 摩西，每逢安息日在各會堂裡都有人誦讀他的書 。」 For since ancient times, Moses has had in every city those who proclaim him, and he is read aloud in the synagogues every Sabbath day."
22. 當時，使徒們、長老們和全教會都認為應該從他們當中揀選幾個人，派他們與 保羅 和 巴拿巴 一起到 安提阿 去。被選的是 那稱為 巴撒巴 的 猶大 和 賽拉斯，這兩個人在弟兄中是領頭的。 Then the apostles and the elders, with the whole church, decided to select men from among them and to send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas, called Barsabbas, and Silas, both leading men among the brothers.
23. 他們帶去的信這樣寫著： 「做使徒的和年長的弟兄們，問候 安提阿 、 敘利亞 省和 奇里乞亞 省的外邦弟兄們。 They wrote this letter to be delivered by them: From the apostles and the elders, your brothers, To the brothers from among the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: Greetings.
24. 我們聽說從我們這裡出去 的一些人，用一些話使你們不安，攪擾你們的心靈。 其實我們沒有吩咐他們。 Because we have heard that some to whom we gave no authorization went out from us and troubled you with their words and unsettled your hearts,
25. 我們已達成了一致，認為應該揀選幾個人，派他們與我們親愛的 巴拿巴 和 保羅 一起到你們那裡去。 we have unanimously decided to select men and send them to you along with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
26. 這兩個人都為我們主耶穌基督的名，已經把自己的生命置之度外。 who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
27. 所以我們派了 猶大 和 賽拉斯 去，他們會親口報告同樣的事， Therefore we have sent Judas and Silas, who will personally report the same things by word of mouth.
28. 因為聖靈和我們都認為，除了以下幾件必須遵守的事以外，不該把更多的重擔加給你們： For it was the Holy Spirit's decision-- and ours-- to put no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
29. 就是要遠避祭過偶像的食物，遠避血和勒死的動物，遠避淫亂。你們如果保守自己遠離這些，就做得很好了。 祝你們安康！」 that you abstain from food offered to idols, from blood, from eating anything that has been strangled, and from sexual immorality. If you keep yourselves from these things, you will do well. Farewell.
30. 於是這些人被派遣，下 到 安提阿，召集了會眾，把信函交給他們。 Then, being sent off, they went down to Antioch, and after gathering the assembly, they delivered the letter.
31. 讀完了信，會眾因著那鼓勵的話而感到歡喜。 When they read it, they rejoiced because of its encouragement.
32. 猶大 和 賽拉斯 自己也是做先知傳道的 。他們用很多話鼓勵弟兄們，堅固他們。 Both Judas and Silas, who were also prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers and strengthened them with a long message.
33. 兩個人住了一段時間，弟兄們就打發他們平平安安地回到差派他們的人 那裡去。 After spending some time there, they were sent back in peace by the brothers to those who had sent them.
34. 可是 賽拉斯 認為應該留在那裡。 ***
35. 保羅 和 巴拿巴 也住在 安提阿，與其他許多人一起教導、傳揚主的福音 。 But Paul and Barnabas, along with many others, remained in Antioch teaching and proclaiming the message of the Lord.
36. 過了幾天， 保羅 對 巴拿巴 說：「來，讓我們回到我們傳過主福音 的每一個城，探望 弟兄們，看看他們的情況怎麼樣 。」 After some time had passed, Paul said to Barnabas, "Let's go back and visit the brothers in every town where we have preached the message of the Lord, and see how they're doing."
37. 巴拿巴 一直想要帶那稱為 馬可 的 約翰 一起去。 Barnabas wanted to take along John Mark.
38. 但是 保羅 覺得不該帶他一起去，因為他曾在 潘菲利亞 省離開他們，沒有陪他們一起去工作。 But Paul did not think it appropriate to take along this man who had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not gone on with them to the work.
39. 兩個人起了激烈的爭執，以致彼此分手。 巴拿巴 帶著 馬可，坐船到 塞浦路斯 島去； There was such a sharp disagreement that they parted company, and Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed off to Cyprus.
40. 保羅 卻選了 賽拉斯 。弟兄們把 保羅 交託於主 的恩典之後，他就出發了。 Then Paul chose Silas and departed, after being commended to the grace of the Lord by the brothers.
41. 保羅 走遍 敘利亞 省和 奇里乞亞 省，堅固各教會。 He traveled through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
Acts 16
1. 保羅 到達 代爾貝 城，又到了 路司得 城。當時，那裡有一個名叫 提摩太 的門徒，是一個信主 的 猶太 婦人的兒子，他父親是 希臘 人。 Then he went on to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a disciple named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewish woman, but his father was a Greek.
2. 路司得 和 以哥念 的弟兄們都讚許他。 The brothers at Lystra and Iconium spoke highly of him.
3. 保羅 想要帶他一起去，但為了那些地方的 猶太 人的緣故，就給他行了割禮，因為大家都知道他父親是 希臘 人。 Paul wanted Timothy to go with him, so he took him and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those places, since they all knew that his father was a Greek.
4. 當他們經過那些城鎮的時候，就把 耶路撒冷 的使徒們和長老們所定的規條，傳達給大家遵守。 As they traveled through the towns, they delivered to them the decisions reached by the apostles and elders at Jerusalem.
5. 這樣，各教會在信仰上得了堅固，人數也天天增加。 So the churches were strengthened in the faith and were increased in number daily.
6. 聖靈既然阻止他們在 亞細亞 省傳講福音，他們就走遍 弗里吉亞 和 加拉太 地區。 They went through the region of Phrygia and Galatia and were prevented by the Holy Spirit from speaking the message in the province of Asia.
7. 他們來到 密細亞 地區的邊界，試著要往 比提尼亞 省去，可是耶穌的靈 不允許。 When they came to Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them.
8. 他們就經過 密細亞 地區，下到 特羅阿斯 港。 So, bypassing Mysia, they came down to Troas.
9. 夜裡， 保羅 看見了一個異象：一個 馬其頓 人站著懇求他，說：「請你過來，到 馬其頓 來幫助我們。」 During the night a vision appeared to Paul: a Macedonian man was standing and pleading with him, "Cross over to Macedonia and help us!"
10. 當 保羅 看見這異象之後，我們就認定是神 召喚我們去傳福音給他們，於是立刻設法前往 馬其頓 省。 After he had seen the vision, we immediately made efforts to set out for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to evangelize them.
11. 我們從 特羅阿斯 港開船直航，到 薩莫特拉 島，第二天到了 奈阿波利斯 港， Then, setting sail from Troas, we ran a straight course to Samothrace, the next day to Neapolis,
12. 從那裡來到 腓立比 。那是 馬其頓 省的首要城市，是 羅馬 的 殖民地。我們在這城裡住了幾天。 and from there to Philippi, a Roman colony, which is a leading city of that district of Macedonia. We stayed in that city for a number of days.
13. 安息日那天，我們出了城門，來到河邊，想到那裡有一個禱告的地方。我們就坐下來，對聚集在那裡的婦女們講道。 On the Sabbath day we went outside the city gate by the river, where we thought there was a place of prayer. We sat down and spoke to the women gathered there.
14. 有一個敬拜神的婦人，名叫 莉迪婭，是 錫亞蒂拉 城賣紫色布的商人。她一直在聽，主開啟她的心竅，使她留心 保羅 所講的話。 A woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who worshiped God, was listening. The Lord opened her heart to pay attention to what was spoken by Paul.
15. 當她和她的家人受了洗之後，她請求我們說：「如果你們判斷我是主的信徒，請到我家裡來住。」於是她極力挽留我們。 After she and her household were baptized, she urged us, "If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house." And she persuaded us.
16. 有一次，我們往禱告的地方去，迎面來了一個有占卜邪靈附身的女僕。她用算命為她的主人們帶來大量的生意。 Once, as we were on our way to prayer, a slave girl met us who had a spirit of prediction and made a large profit for her owners by fortune-telling.
17. 她跟著 保羅 和我們，喊叫說：「這些人是至高神的奴僕，向你們 傳講救恩的道 。」 As she followed Paul and us she cried out, "These men are the slaves of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation."
18. 她一連幾天都這樣做。 保羅 厭煩了，就轉過身對那邪靈說：「我奉耶穌基督的名，吩咐你從她身上出來！」那邪靈立刻就出來了。 And she did this for many days. But Paul was greatly aggravated, and turning to the spirit, said, "I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!" And it came out right away.
19. 女僕的主人們看見他們的生意沒有希望了，就揪住 保羅 和 賽拉斯，把他們拖到街市 上去見首領們。 When her owners saw that their hope of profit was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to the authorities.
20. 把兩個人帶到官長們面前，說：「這些人是 猶太 人，在擾亂我們的城市， And bringing them before the chief magistrates, they said, "These men are seriously disturbing our city. They are Jews,
21. 傳講我們 羅馬 人不可以接受、也不能遵守的規矩。」 and are promoting customs that are not legal for us as Romans to adopt or practice."
22. 那群人就一同起來反對 保羅 和 賽拉斯 。官長們就剝了他們的衣服，下令用棍子打， Then the mob joined in the attack against them, and the chief magistrates stripped off their clothes and ordered them to be beaten with rods.
23. 打了很多棍以後，把他們投進監獄，吩咐獄卒好好地看守。 After they had inflicted many blows on them, they threw them in jail, ordering the jailer to keep them securely guarded.
24. 獄卒領了這樣的吩咐，就把他們投進了監獄裡的最裡層，把他們的兩腳銬在木枷上。 Receiving such an order, he put them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
25. 約在半夜， 保羅 和 賽拉斯 禱告、唱詩讚美神，其他的囚犯們都側耳聽著。 About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
26. 突然發生了強烈的地震，結果監獄的地基都被搖動，所有的監門立刻打開了，每個囚犯的鎖鏈也都鬆開了。 Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the jail were shaken, and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone's chains came loose.
27. 獄卒醒來，看見監獄的門都開了，以為囚犯們已經逃跑了，就拔出刀來要自殺。 When the jailer woke up and saw the doors of the prison open, he drew his sword and was going to kill himself, since he thought the prisoners had escaped.
28. 保羅 卻大聲呼喚說：「不要傷害自己，因為我們都在這裡！」 But Paul called out in a loud voice, "Don't harm yourself, because all of us are here!"
29. 獄卒叫人拿了燈來，就衝進去，戰戰兢兢地俯伏在 保羅 和 賽拉斯 面前， Then the jailer called for lights, rushed in, and fell down trembling before Paul and Silas.
30. 然後領他們出來，說：「先生們，我應該做什麼才能得救呢？」 Then he escorted them out and said, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
31. 他們說：「要信靠主耶穌，你和你一家人就將得救。」 So they said, "Believe on the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved-- you and your household."
32. 於是他們把主的福音 講給獄卒和他家裡所有的人聽。 Then they spoke the message of the Lord to him along with everyone in his house.
33. 當夜，就在那時刻，獄卒帶他們去清洗傷口，然後他和所有的家人立刻受了洗。 He took them the same hour of the night and washed their wounds. Right away he and all his family were baptized.
34. 他把 保羅 和 賽拉斯 領到家裡，擺上飯食。他和全家人因為信了神，都歡欣跳躍。 He brought them up into his house, set a meal before them, and rejoiced because he had believed God with his entire household.
35. 天亮的時候，官長們派刑杖官來說：「把那兩個人放了吧！」 When daylight came, the chief magistrates sent the police to say, "Release those men!"
36. 獄卒就把這話告訴 保羅，說：「官長們派人來，要釋放你們。所以現在請你們出來，平平安安地去吧！」 The jailer reported these words to Paul: "The magistrates have sent orders for you to be released. So come out now and go in peace."
37. 可是 保羅 對他們說：「我們是 羅馬 公民，並沒有被定罪，他們卻當眾打我們，把我們投進監獄。現在他們還要悄悄地把我們趕出去嗎？當然不行！讓他們親自來領我們出去！」 But Paul said to them, "They beat us in public without a trial, although we are Roman citizens, and threw us in jail. And now are they going to smuggle us out secretly? Certainly not! On the contrary, let them come themselves and escort us out!"
38. 那些刑杖官把這些話報告給官長們，官長們一聽他們是 羅馬 公民，就懼怕了， Then the police reported these words to the magistrates. And they were afraid when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens.
39. 於是來安撫他們，並且把他們領出來，請求他們離開那城。 So they came and apologized to them, and escorting them out, they urged them to leave town.
40. 保羅 和 賽拉斯 出了監獄，就到 莉迪婭 家裡去，見了弟兄們，鼓勵他們一番，然後離開了。 After leaving the jail, they came to Lydia's house where they saw and encouraged the brothers, and departed.
Acts 17
1. 保羅 和 賽拉斯 經過 安菲波利斯 和 阿波羅尼亞，來到 帖撒羅尼迦 。那裡有一個 猶太 人的會堂。 Then they traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia and came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
2. 保羅 照習慣進了會堂，一連三個安息日，引用經文向他們講論， As usual, Paul went to them, and on three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
3. 講解並說明基督必須受難，然後從死人中復活，並且說：「我傳給你們的這位耶穌，就是基督。」 explaining and showing that the Messiah had to suffer and rise from the dead, and saying: "This is the Messiah, Jesus, whom I am proclaiming to you."
4. 他們當中有些人被說服了，就跟從了 保羅 和 賽拉斯 ；不但有一大群敬神的 希臘 人，還有不少顯要的婦女。 Then some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, including a great number of God-fearing Greeks, as well as a number of the leading women.
5. 但那些不肯信從的 猶太 人嫉妒了，就招聚一些市井無賴，成群結夥，擾亂城市。他們闖進 耶森 的家，搜尋 保羅 和 賽拉斯，要把他們帶到民眾那裡。 But the Jews became jealous, and when they had brought together some scoundrels from the marketplace and formed a mob, they set the city in an uproar. Attacking Jason's house, they searched for them to bring them out to the public assembly.
6. 可是找不到他們，就把 耶森 和幾位弟兄拉到地方官們那裡，喊叫說：「這些攪亂天下的，也來到這裡， When they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some of the brothers before the city officials, shouting, "These men who have turned the world upside down have come here too,
7. 耶森 竟接待了他們！這些人都違背了凱撒的諭令，說另外有一個王，就是耶穌。」 and Jason has received them as guests! They are all acting contrary to Caesar's decrees, saying that there is another king-- Jesus!"
8. 民眾和地方官們聽了這些話就驚慌不安， The Jews stirred up the crowd and the city officials who heard these things.
9. 後來，拿了 耶森 和其他人的保釋金，就把他們釋放了。 So taking a security bond from Jason and the others, they released them.
10. 弟兄們立刻連夜送 保羅 和 賽拉斯 往 庇里亞 城去。兩個人一到，就進了 猶太 人的會堂。 As soon as it was night, the brothers sent Paul and Silas off to Beroea. On arrival, they went into the synagogue of the Jews.
11. 這裡的人比 帖撒羅尼迦 的人開明。他們滿心樂意地接受這福音，天天查考經文，要看這些事是否如此。 The people here were more open-minded than those in Thessalonica, since they welcomed the message with eagerness and examined the Scriptures daily to see if these things were so.
12. 這樣，他們當中有許多人相信了，包括尊貴的 希臘 婦女，以及不少男人。 Consequently, many of them believed, including a number of the prominent Greek women as well as men.
13. 可是當 帖撒羅尼迦 的 猶太 人知道 保羅 又在 庇里亞 城傳揚神的話語 時，就來到那裡煽動、攪擾 民眾。 But when the Jews from Thessalonica found out that God's message had been proclaimed by Paul at Beroea, they came there too, agitating and disturbing the crowds.
14. 於是弟兄們立刻送 保羅 往海 邊去， 賽拉斯 和 提摩太 仍然留在 庇里亞 。 Then the brothers immediately sent Paul away to go to the sea, but Silas and Timothy stayed on there.
15. 護送 保羅 的人一直帶他到了 雅典，然後領受了要 賽拉斯 和 提摩太 盡快到他這裡來的指示，就回去了。 Those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens, and after receiving instructions for Silas and Timothy to come to him as quickly as possible, they departed.
16. 保羅 在 雅典 等候 賽拉斯 和 提摩太 的時候，看見滿城都是偶像，他靈裡被激怒。 While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, his spirit was troubled within him when he saw that the city was full of idols.
17. 於是他在會堂裡向 猶太 人以及那些敬神的人講論，每天又向在街市上遇見的人講論。 So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and with those who worshiped God, and in the marketplace every day with those who happened to be there.
18. 有些 伊壁鳩魯 派和 斯多亞 派的哲學家們也與他辯論。 有的說：「這胡言亂語的人，究竟想說什麼呢？」也有的說：「他看起來是個宣傳外國鬼神的人。」這是因為 保羅 傳講耶穌和復活的福音。 Then also, some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers argued with him. Some said, "What is this pseudo-intellectual trying to say?" Others replied, "He seems to be a preacher of foreign deities"-- because he was telling the good news about Jesus and the resurrection.
19. 他們就拉住 保羅，帶他到 亞略巴古，問他：「你所講論的這新教導，我們可以知道嗎？ They took him and brought him to the Areopagus, and said, "May we learn about this new teaching you're speaking of?
20. 既然你帶來了一些奇怪的事，傳到我們耳中，那麼我們想知道這些事到底是什麼意思。」 For what you say sounds strange to us, and we want to know what these ideas mean."
21. 原來，所有的 雅典 人以及在那裡作客的外國人，不做別的，只花時間說說聽聽某個較為新奇的事。 Now all the Athenians and the foreigners residing there spent their time on nothing else but telling or hearing something new.
22. 於是 保羅 站在 亞略巴古 當中說：「各位 雅典 人哪，我看你們在各方面都非常敬畏鬼神， Then Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said: "Men of Athens! I see that you are extremely religious in every respect.
23. 因為我邊走邊觀察你們所敬拜的，發現一座祭壇上刻著『獻給不認識的神』；那麼，我把你們所不認識而敬拜的這一位，現在傳講給你們。 For as I was passing through and observing the objects of your worship, I even found an altar on which was inscribed: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD Therefore, what you worship in ignorance, this I proclaim to you.
24. 造了宇宙和其中萬有的神，這一位既然是天地的主，就不住在人手所造的殿宇裡， The God who made the world and everything in it-- He is Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in shrines made by hands.
25. 也不受人手的服事，好像缺少什麼似的，因為他自己把生命、氣息和萬有賜給萬人。 Neither is He served by human hands, as though He needed anything, since He Himself gives everyone life and breath and all things.
26. 他從一個人 造出人類萬族，使他們住在整個地面上，預先設定了他們的年限和所住的疆界， From one man He has made every nation of men to live all over the earth and has determined their appointed times and the boundaries of where they live,
27. 好讓他們尋求神，或許因此真能摸索而找到他。其實他離我們每一個人並不遠， so that they might seek God, and perhaps they might reach out and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us.
28. 因為我們活著、行動、生存，都在於他，正如你們中間的一些詩人也曾經說過，『原來我們也是他的後裔。』 For in Him we live and move and exist, as even some of your own poets have said, 'For we are also His offspring.'
29. 所以我們既然是神的後裔，就不應該認為神性是彷彿用人的手藝和心思所雕刻的金、銀、石像。 Being God's offspring, then, we shouldn't think that the divine nature is like gold or silver or stone, an image fashioned by human art and imagination.
30. 「雖然神並不鑒察那愚昧無知的時代，但如今卻吩咐各處所有的人都要悔改， "Therefore, having overlooked the times of ignorance, God now commands all people everywhere to repent,
31. 因為他已經確立了日子，將要藉著他所設定的一個人，以公義來審判天下的人，並且藉著使他從死人中復活，給萬人帶來了確據。」 because He has set a day on which He is going to judge the world in righteousness by the Man He has appointed. He has provided proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead."
32. 他們聽到死人復活的事，雖然有些人嘲笑他，但有些人卻說：「關於此事，我們還要再聽你說！」 When they heard about resurrection of the dead, some began to ridicule him. But others said, "We will hear you about this again."
33. 這樣， 保羅 就從他們中間出去了。 So Paul went out from their presence.
34. 有一些人就跟從了 保羅，信了主 。其中包括 亞略巴古 的議員 迪奧尼修 、一個名叫 達瑪麗斯 的婦人，以及其他與他們在一起的人。 However, some men joined him and believed, among whom were Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
Acts 18
1. 這些事以後， 保羅 離開 雅典，來到 哥林多 。 After this, he left from Athens and went to Corinth,
2. 他遇見一個出生在 本都 省的 猶太 人，名叫 阿奎拉，最近與他的妻子 普茜拉 從 意大利 來，因為 克勞迪 命令所有的 猶太 人都要離開 羅馬 。 保羅 來到他們那裡， where he found a Jewish man named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. Paul came to them,
3. 因為與他們同業，就住在他們那裡做工。原來他們是以製帳篷為業的。 and being of the same occupation, stayed with them and worked, for they were tentmakers by trade.
4. 每逢安息日， 保羅 就在會堂裡講論，勸導 猶太 人和 希臘 人。 He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and tried to persuade both Jews and Greeks.
5. 賽拉斯 和 提摩太 從 馬其頓 省下來的時候， 保羅 被這福音 所催逼，向 猶太 人鄭重地見證耶穌是基督。 When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was occupied with preaching the message and solemnly testified to the Jews that the Messiah is Jesus.
6. 當他們抗拒、說褻瀆話的時候， 保羅 就抖著衣服對他們說：「你們的血，歸在你們自己的頭上；我是清白的。從今以後，我要到外邦人那裡去。」 But when they resisted and blasphemed, he shook out his clothes and told them, "Your blood is on your own heads! I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."
7. 於是他離開那裡，進到一個名叫 提多猶斯托 的人家裡。這個人敬拜神，他的家就在會堂隔壁。 So he left there and went to the house of a man named Titius Justus, a worshiper of God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
8. 會堂主管 克里斯普 和他全家都信了主，還有許多 哥林多 人聽了以後就信了，並且受了洗。 Crispus, the leader of the synagogue, believed the Lord, along with his whole household; and many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
9. 在夜裡，主藉著異象對 保羅 說： 「不要怕，只管講！不要沉默不語， Then the Lord said to Paul in a night vision, "Don't be afraid, but keep on speaking and don't be silent.
10. 因為我與你同在，而且沒有人會下手傷害你；原來在這城裡有許多我的子民。」 For I am with you, and no one will lay a hand on you to hurt you, because I have many people in this city."
11. 保羅 在那裡住了一年零六個月，在他們當中教導神的話語 。 And he stayed there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
12. 伽利奧 任 亞該亞 省長的時候， 猶太 人一致起來攻擊 保羅，把他帶到審判臺前， While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews made a united attack against Paul and brought him to the judge's bench.
13. 說：「他煽動人不按律法敬拜神。」 "This man," they said, "persuades people to worship God contrary to the law!"
14. 保羅 剛要開口， 伽利奧 就對 猶太 人說：「哦，各位 猶太 人哪！如果這真是什麼罪行或邪惡的案情，我理當容忍你們。 And as Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, "If it were a matter of a crime or of moral evil, it would be reasonable for me to put up with you Jews.
15. 但爭議的問題，如果是關於字句、名稱，和有關你們的律法，你們自己看著辦吧！我不願意做這些事的審判者。」 But if these are questions about words, names, and your own law, see to it yourselves. I don't want to be a judge of such things."
16. 於是把他們從審判臺前趕了出去。 So he drove them from the judge's bench.
17. 大家 都抓住會堂主管 索提尼，在審判臺前毆打他。但 伽利奧 一概不管這些事。 Then they all seized Sosthenes, the leader of the synagogue, and beat him in front of the judge's bench. But none of these things concerned Gallio.
18. 保羅 在 哥林多 繼續留了許多日子，然後向弟兄們告別，坐船往 敘利亞 省去； 普茜拉 和 阿奎拉 也與他同去。他因為許過願，就在 堅革里 港剃了頭髮。 So Paul, having stayed on for many days, said good-bye to the brothers and sailed away to Syria. Priscilla and Aquila were with him. He shaved his head at Cenchreae, because he had taken a vow.
19. 他們到達 以弗所 城， 保羅 把他們兩個人留在那裡，自己就進了會堂向 猶太 人講論。 When they reached Ephesus he left them there, but he himself entered the synagogue and engaged in discussion with the Jews.
20. 他們請求 保羅 再多住些時候，他沒有答應， And though they asked him to stay for a longer time, he declined,
21. 向他們告別，說：「 如果神願意，我會再回到你們這裡來。」就從 以弗所 起航了。 but said good-bye and stated, "I'll come back to you again, if God wills." Then he set sail from Ephesus.
22. 保羅 在 凱撒里亞 登陸，上 耶路撒冷 去問候教會，然後下 安提阿 去。 On landing at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the church, and went down to Antioch.
23. 住了一段時間，他又離開那裡，按著次序走遍 加拉太 和 弗里吉亞 地區，堅固所有的門徒。 He set out, traveling through one place after another in the Galatian territory and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
24. 有一個出生在 亞歷山大 的 猶太 人，名叫 阿波羅，到達了 以弗所 。他是個有學問的人，在經文方面很強。 A Jew named Apollos, a native Alexandrian, an eloquent man who was powerful in the Scriptures, arrived in Ephesus.
25. 這個人已經在主的道 上受了教導，靈裡火熱，並仔細地講論和教導有關耶穌 的事，可是他只知道 約翰 的洗禮。 This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught the things about Jesus accurately, although he knew only John's baptism.
26. 阿波羅 開始在會堂裡放膽傳道。 普茜拉 和 阿奎拉 聽了，就接他來，把神的道更詳盡地講解給他聽。 He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. After Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him home and explained the way of God to him more accurately.
27. 後來 阿波羅 想到 亞該亞 省去，弟兄們就鼓勵他，寫信請門徒們歡迎他。他到了以後，對那些蒙恩的信徒大有幫助， When he wanted to cross over to Achaia, the brothers wrote to the disciples urging them to welcome him. After he arrived, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace.
28. 因為他當眾強有力地駁倒 猶太 人，用經文證明耶穌是基督。 For he vigorously refuted the Jews in public, demonstrating through the Scriptures that Jesus is the Messiah.
Acts 19
1. 阿波羅 在 哥林多 的時候， 保羅 經過內陸地區，來到 以弗所 城，在那裡他遇見一些門徒， While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled through the interior regions and came to Ephesus. He found some disciples
2. 問他們：「你們信的時候，是否領受了聖靈？」 他們告訴他：「其實我們也沒有聽說過是否有聖靈。」 and asked them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" "No," they told him, "we haven't even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."
3. 保羅 又問：「那麼，你們受的是什麼洗呢？」 他們說：「是 約翰 的洗禮。」 "Then with what [baptism] were you baptized?" he asked them. "With John's baptism," they replied.
4. 保羅 說：「 約翰 所施的是悔改的洗禮，他告訴民眾當相信在他以後來的那一位，就是相信耶穌 。」 Paul said, "John baptized with a baptism of repentance, telling the people that they should believe in the One who would come after him, that is, in Jesus."
5. 他們聽了，就受洗 歸入了主耶穌的名 。 On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
6. 接著， 保羅 按手在他們身上，聖靈就臨到了他們。他們就說起殊言，又說預言。 And when Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they began to speak with [other] languages and to prophesy.
7. 他們一共約有十二個人。 Now there were about 12 men in all.
8. 保羅 進了會堂，放膽傳道，一連三個月講論並勸導人相信那些有關神國的事。 Then he entered the synagogue and spoke boldly over a period of three months, engaging in discussion and trying to persuade them about the things related to the kingdom of God.
9. 後來，當有些人心裡剛硬、不肯信從，在會眾面前誹謗這道 的時候， 保羅 就離開他們，把門徒們分別出來，天天在 特拉諾斯 講堂裡講論。 But when some became hardened and would not believe, slandering the Way in front of the crowd, he withdrew from them and met separately with the disciples, conducting discussions every day in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
10. 這樣持續了兩年，結果所有住在 亞細亞 省的人，無論是 猶太 人或 希臘 人，都聽到了主 的福音 。 And this went on for two years, so that all the inhabitants of the province of Asia, both Jews and Greeks, heard the word of the Lord.
11. 神藉著 保羅 的手，行了一些不尋常的神蹟， God was performing extraordinary miracles by Paul's hands,
12. 甚至有人把 保羅 身上的手巾和圍裙拿去，放在病人身上，疾病就從他們身上消退了，邪靈也 出去了。 so that even facecloths or work aprons that had touched his skin were brought to the sick, and the diseases left them, and the evil spirits came out of them.
13. 可是有一些四處遊歷的 猶太 驅魔師，向那些有邪靈附身的人，擅自稱呼主耶穌的名，說：「我藉著 保羅 所傳的耶穌，吩咐你們出來 。」 Then some of the itinerant Jewish exorcists attempted to pronounce the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, "I command you by the Jesus whom Paul preaches!"
14. 有一個名叫 斯克瓦 的 猶太 祭司長，他的七個兒子都在做這種事。 Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
15. 邪靈回答他們，說：「耶穌我認識， 保羅 我也知道！但你們呢？你們是誰？」 The evil spirit answered them, "Jesus I know, and Paul I recognize-- but who are you?"
16. 有邪靈附身的那個人就跳到他們身上，壓制了所有的人，勝過了他們，以致他們赤著身帶著傷，從那房子逃了出去。 Then the man who had the evil spirit leaped on them, overpowered them all, and prevailed against them, so that they ran out of that house naked and wounded.
17. 所有住在 以弗所 的 猶太 人和 希臘 人，都知道了這件事，恐懼就臨到了他們每個人，主耶穌的名因此被尊為大。 This became known to everyone who lived in Ephesus, both Jews and Greeks. Then fear fell on all of them, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
18. 而且許多信徒都來，承認並述說自己的所作所為。 And many who had become believers came confessing and disclosing their practices,
19. 又有許多行邪術的人，把他們的書籍拿到一處，當眾燒掉。他們估算了那些書的價值，發現共值 五萬個銀幣 。 while many of those who had practiced magic collected their books and burned them in front of everyone. So they calculated their value, and found it to be 50,000 pieces of silver.
20. 這樣，主的福音 就大有能力地不斷擴展，不斷得勝。 In this way the Lord's message flourished and prevailed.
21. 這些事過了以後， 保羅 受了聖靈的感動決定要經過 馬其頓 省和 亞該亞 省，到 耶路撒冷 去。他說：「我到那裡以後，也必須去 羅馬 看看。」 When these events were over, Paul resolved in the Spirit to pass through Macedonia and Achaia and go to Jerusalem. "After I've been there," he said, "I must see Rome as well!"
22. 於是他派了 提摩太 和 以拉斯托 兩個服事他的人到 馬其頓 省去，自己暫時留在 亞細亞 省。 So after sending two of those who assisted him, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, he himself stayed in the province of Asia for a while.
23. 就在這時候，為了這道發生了不小的騷動。 During that time there was a major disturbance about the Way.
24. 原來，有一個名叫 迪米特斯 的銀匠，是製造 阿蒂米絲 女神 銀龕 的，給工匠們帶來不少的生意。 For a person named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, provided a great deal of business for the craftsmen.
25. 迪米特斯 召集了他們，以及周圍同行的工人，說：「各位，你們知道，我們是由這生意發財的。 When he had assembled them, as well as the workers engaged in this type of business, he said: "Men, you know that our prosperity is derived from this business.
26. 可是你們看見了也聽見了，這個 保羅 不僅在 以弗所 也幾乎在全 亞細亞 省，說服、引誘了一大群人，說『人手所造的不是神』。 You both see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in almost the whole province of Asia, this man Paul has persuaded and misled a considerable number of people by saying that gods made by hand are not gods!
27. 這樣，不僅我們這行業有被輕蔑的危險，連偉大女神 阿蒂米絲 的廟也要被看為什麼都不是，並且這受全 亞細亞 省和普天下敬拜的女神的威榮，也要被毀滅了。」 So not only do we run a risk that our business may be discredited, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis may be despised and her magnificence come to the verge of ruin-- the very one whom the whole province of Asia and the world adore."
28. 眾人聽了，就滿腔怒火，喊叫說：「 以弗所 人偉大的 阿蒂米絲 ！」 When they had heard this, they were filled with rage and began to cry out, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
29. 於是滿城一片混亂。他們抓住與 保羅 同來的 馬其頓 人 蓋尤斯 和 亞里達古，一齊衝進劇場。 So the city was filled with confusion; and they rushed all together into the amphitheater, dragging along Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians who were Paul's traveling companions.
30. 保羅 雖然想要進到民眾當中，但門徒們不讓他去。 Though Paul wanted to go in before the people, the disciples did not let him.
31. 還有一些 亞細亞 省的官員，是 保羅 的朋友，也派人勸他不要自己冒險到劇場去。 Even some of the provincial officials of Asia, who were his friends, sent word to him, pleading with him not to take a chance by going into the amphitheater.
32. 這時候，有人喊這個、有人喊那個，因為集會的人一片混亂，大多數人不知道為了什麼緣故聚集。 Meanwhile, some were shouting one thing and some another, because the assembly was in confusion, and most of them did not know why they had come together.
33. 猶太 人把 亞歷山大 推到前面的時候，人群中有些人要他說話。 亞歷山大 就揮一下手，想要對民眾申辯。 Then some of the crowd gave Alexander advice when the Jews pushed him to the front. So motioning with his hand, Alexander wanted to make his defense to the people.
34. 可是大家一認出他是 猶太 人，就同聲呼喊：「 以弗所 人偉大的 阿蒂米絲 ！」大約喊了兩個小時。 But when they recognized that he was a Jew, a united cry went up from all of them for about two hours: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
35. 後來，城裡的書記官安撫了民眾，說：「各位 以弗所 人哪，到底有什麼人不知道 以弗所 城是偉大 阿蒂米絲 廟和那從天落下的神像的 看守者呢？ However, when the city clerk had calmed the crowd down, he said, "Men of Ephesus! What man is there who doesn't know that the city of the Ephesians is the temple guardian of the great Artemis, and of the image that fell from heaven?
36. 所以這些事既然是不能否認的，你們就必須冷靜下來，不要做任何妄為的事。 Therefore, since these things are undeniable, you must keep calm and not do anything rash.
37. 你們帶來的這些人，既沒有偷取廟裡的東西，也沒有褻瀆我們 的女神。 For you have brought these men here who are not temple robbers or blasphemers of our goddess.
38. 既然如此，如果 迪米特斯 和與他一起的工匠們要控告誰，法庭是開著的，省長也在，讓他們彼此控告吧！ So if Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a case against anyone, the courts are in session, and there are proconsuls. Let them bring charges against one another.
39. 但如果你們有什麼別的要求，要在合法的集會中解決。 But if you want something else, it must be decided in a legal assembly.
40. 關於今天的事，本來沒有正當的理由，我們實際上就有被控告為暴亂的危險。我們無法對這次騷動做出交代。」 In fact, we run a risk of being charged with rioting for what happened today, since there is no justification that we can give as a reason for this disorderly gathering."
41. 說了這些話，他就遣散了集會的人。 After saying this, he dismissed the assembly.
Acts 20
1. 騷亂平息以後， 保羅 請門徒們來，鼓勵一番，然後與他們告別，就出發往 馬其頓 省去了。 After the uproar was over, Paul sent for the disciples, encouraged them, and after saying good-bye, departed to go to Macedonia.
2. 他走遍了那些地區，用很多的話鼓勵門徒們，就來到 希臘， And when he had passed through those areas and exhorted them at length, he came to Greece
3. 在那裡住了三個月。他正要起航往 敘利亞 省去的時候， 猶太 人設計了一個針對他的陰謀，他就決定從 馬其頓 省回去。 and stayed three months. When he was about to set sail for Syria, a plot was devised against him by the Jews, so a decision was made to go back through Macedonia.
4. 與他同行 的，有 庇里亞 人 普羅斯 的兒子 索巴特， 帖撒羅尼迦 人 亞里達古 和 西肯多，也有 代爾貝 人 蓋尤斯 和 提摩太，還有 亞細亞 省人 特其庫斯 和 特羅費摩 。 He was accompanied by Sopater, son of Pyrrhus, from Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus from Asia.
5. 這些人先走，在 特羅阿斯 港等我們。 These men went on ahead and waited for us in Troas,
6. 過了除酵節的日子，我們從 腓立比 起航，五天後到了 特羅阿斯 港見他們，在那裡住了七天。 but we sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread. In five days we reached them at Troas, where we spent seven days.
7. 在一週的頭一天，門徒們 聚集掰餅的時候， 保羅 向他們講論，因第二天就要離開，於是一直講到半夜。 On the first day of the week, we assembled to break bread. Paul spoke to them, and since he was about to depart the next day, he extended his message until midnight.
8. 我們聚集的樓上房間，有許多燈火。 There were many lamps in the room upstairs where we were assembled,
9. 有一個名叫 猶圖克斯 的年輕人坐在窗臺上，陷入了沉睡。 保羅 又講論了很久， 猶圖克斯 在沉睡中從三樓掉了下去，被扶起來的時候，已經死了。 and a young man named Eutychus was sitting on a window sill and sank into a deep sleep as Paul kept on speaking. When he was overcome by sleep he fell down from the third story, and was picked up dead.
10. 保羅 下去，伏在他身上，抱著他說：「不要慌亂，他的靈魂還在身上！」 But Paul went down, threw himself on him, embraced him, and said, "Don't be alarmed, for his life is in him!"
11. 保羅 再上去，掰餅吃了，又交談了許久，直到天亮才出發。 After going upstairs, breaking the bread, and eating, he conversed a considerable time until dawn. Then he left.
12. 他們把那活生生的年輕人帶走，並且受到了不少的安慰。 They brought the boy home alive and were greatly comforted.
13. 我們先上船開往 阿索，要在那裡接 保羅 ；原來他這樣安排，是因為自己要走陸路。 Then we went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, from there intending to take Paul on board. For these were his instructions, since he himself was going by land.
14. 當他在 阿索 與我們會合的時候，我們接他上船，來到了 米蒂利尼 。 When he met us at Assos, we took him on board and came to Mitylene.
15. 我們從那裡開船，第二天到達了 希俄斯 島的海域，過了一天在 薩莫斯 島靠岸， 再過一天來到 米利都 。 Sailing from there, the next day we arrived off Chios. The following day we crossed over to Samos, and the day after, we came to Miletus.
16. 原來 保羅 已經決定駛過 以弗所 城，免得在 亞細亞 省耽延時間，因為他急著趕路，如果有可能，但願五旬節那一天已經在 耶路撒冷 了。 For Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus so he would not have to spend time in the province of Asia, because he was hurrying to be in Jerusalem, if possible, for the day of Pentecost.
17. 保羅 從 米利都 派人到 以弗所 去，請教會的長老們來。 Now from Miletus, he sent to Ephesus and called for the elders of the church.
18. 他們來了以後， 保羅 對他們說：「你們知道，自從我踏進 亞細亞 省的第一天起，我一直怎樣與你們共處—— And when they came to him, he said to them: "You know, from the first day I set foot in Asia, how I was with you the whole time--
19. 我在完全的謙卑中、淚水中、以及因 猶太 人的陰謀而帶來的許多試煉中服事主； serving the Lord with all humility, with tears, and with the trials that came to me through the plots of the Jews--
20. 對你們有益的事，在公眾場所和各家各戶，沒有一件我因畏縮而不傳講、不教導給你們； and that I did not shrink back from proclaiming to you anything that was profitable, or from teaching it to you in public and from house to house.
21. 無論對 猶太 人或 希臘 人，我都鄭重地勸誡他們要向神悔改，相信我們的主耶穌 。 I testified to both Jews and Greeks about repentance toward God and faith in our Lord Jesus.
22. 「看，現在我靈裡受到催逼，要去 耶路撒冷 。我不知道在那裡將會遇到什麼事， "And now I am on my way to Jerusalem, bound in my spirit, not knowing what I will encounter there,
23. 只知道在各城裡聖靈向我鄭重地做見證說，有捆鎖和患難等著我。 except that in town after town the Holy Spirit testifies to me that chains and afflictions are waiting for me.
24. 但是我不把自己的生命看為寶貴，為要 跑盡我該跑的路程，完成從主耶穌所領受的服事工作，為神恩典的福音鄭重地做見證。 But I count my life of no value to myself, so that I may finish my course and the ministry I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of God's grace.
25. 「我曾在你們中間走遍各地，宣講神的 國，但現在，看哪，我知道你們都不會再見到我的面了！ "And now I know that none of you, among whom I went about preaching the kingdom, will ever see my face again.
26. 所以我今天向你們見證：對於任何人的滅亡，我都是清白的！ Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of everyone's blood,
27. 因為神的整個計劃，我沒有一樣因畏縮而不傳講給你們。 for I did not shrink back from declaring to you the whole plan of God.
28. 你們當為自己謹慎，也當為全體羊群謹慎。聖靈把你們放在這羊群裡做監督，為要牧養神的 教會，就是他用自己的血所贖來的。 Be on guard for yourselves and for all the flock, among whom the Holy Spirit has appointed you as overseers, to shepherd the church of God, which He purchased with His own blood.
29. 我知道在我離開以後，凶惡的豺狼將進入你們中間，不會顧惜羊群。 I know that after my departure savage wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock.
30. 你們自己當中也會有人起來，講說一些歪曲的道理，要拉攏門徒跟隨他們。 And men from among yourselves will rise up with deviant doctrines to lure the disciples into following them.
31. 所以你們要警醒，記住這三年來，我日夜不住地流著淚水勸誡你們每一個人。 Therefore be on the alert, remembering that night and day for three years I did not stop warning each one of you with tears.
32. 「 現在我把你們交託給神和他恩典的話語。這話語能造就你們，並且在所有被分別為聖的人中間賜給你們那繼業。 "And now I commit you to God and to the message of His grace, which is able to build you up and to give you an inheritance among all who are sanctified.
33. 我沒有渴望過任何人的金子、銀子或衣服。 I have not coveted anyone's silver or gold or clothing.
34. 你們自己也知道，我這雙手供應了我和與我在一起之人的需要。 You yourselves know that these hands have provided for my needs, and for those who were with me.
35. 在一切事上，我都給你們做了榜樣：必須這樣地勞苦做工來扶助軟弱的人，並且要記住主耶穌自己說過的話： 『施比受更加蒙福。』 」 In every way I've shown you that by laboring like this, it is necessary to help the weak and to keep in mind the words of the Lord Jesus, for He said, 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'"
36. 保羅 說了這些話，就跪下來與大家一起禱告。 After he said this, he knelt down and prayed with all of them.
37. 大家都痛哭起來，摟住 保羅 的脖子親吻他。 There was a great deal of weeping by everyone. And embracing Paul, they kissed him,
38. 尤其使他們傷心的，就是他說他們不會再看到他面的那句話。然後他們送他上了船。 grieving most of all over his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they escorted him to the ship.
Acts 21
1. 我們與他們惜別以後就開船直航，來到 科斯 島。第二天到了 羅得 島，又從那裡到 帕塔拉， After we tore ourselves away from them and set sail, we came by a direct route to Cos, the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
2. 找到了一條開往 腓尼基 的船，就上船起航。 Finding a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we boarded and set sail.
3. 我們望見 塞浦路斯 島，駛過的時候它在左邊。我們繼續向 敘利亞 省航行，在 提爾 登陸，因為船要在那裡卸貨。 After we sighted Cyprus, leaving it on the left, we sailed on to Syria and arrived at Tyre, because the ship was to unload its cargo there.
4. 我們找到了一些門徒，就在那裡住了七天。他們藉著聖靈，一直告訴 保羅 不要上 耶路撒冷 去。 So we found some disciples and stayed there seven days. They said to Paul through the Spirit not to go to Jerusalem.
5. 那些日子過了以後，我們出發前行，大家與妻子和兒女一起送我們到城外。我們都跪在岸上禱告， When our days there were over, we left to continue our journey, while all of them, with their wives and children, escorted us out of the city. After kneeling down on the beach to pray,
6. 彼此告別。我們上了船，他們就回自己的家去了。 we said good-bye to one another. Then we boarded the ship, and they returned home.
7. 我們結束了從 提爾 開始的航程，到達 托勒密，就去問候弟兄們，在他們那裡住了一天。 When we completed our voyage from Tyre, we reached Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
8. 第二天我們 離開那裡，來到 凱撒里亞，進了傳福音者 腓利 的家，住在他那裡，他是那七位執事 中的一位。 The next day we left and came to Caesarea, where we entered the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the Seven, and stayed with him.
9. 他有四個女兒，都是童貞女，是做先知傳道 的。 This man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
10. 我們住了好幾天，有一個名叫 阿伽布斯 的先知從 猶太 下來了。 While we were staying there many days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
11. 他來到我們這裡，拿起 保羅 的腰帶，把自己的手腳捆起來，說：「聖靈這樣說， 猶太 人在 耶路撒冷 要如此捆綁這腰帶的主人，把他交在外邦人的手中。」 He came to us, took Paul's belt, tied his own feet and hands, and said, "This is what the Holy Spirit says: 'In this way the Jews in Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and deliver him into Gentile hands.'"
12. 我們一聽這些話，就和當地的人懇求 保羅 不要上 耶路撒冷 去。 When we heard this, both we and the local people begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
13. 這時候 保羅 說：「你們為什麼哭，使我心碎呢？我為了主耶穌的名，不僅被捆綁，即使死在 耶路撒冷，也都預備好了。」 Then Paul replied, "What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."
14. 我們既然不能說服 保羅，就都安靜下來，只說：「願主的旨意成就。」 Since he would not be persuaded, we stopped talking and simply said, "The Lord's will be done!"
15. 過了幾天，我們收拾行李，上 耶路撒冷 去。 After these days we got ready and went up to Jerusalem.
16. 凱撒里亞 的一些門徒也陪我們一起去，帶我們到一個 塞浦路斯 人 納森 家裡去作客住宿。他做門徒已經很久了。 Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us and brought us to Mnason, a Cypriot and an early disciple, with whom we were to stay.
17. 我們到了 耶路撒冷，弟兄們很高興地歡迎我們。 When we reached Jerusalem, the brothers welcomed us gladly.
18. 第二天， 保羅 與我們一起去探望 雅各，所有的長老也都來了。 The following day Paul went in with us to James, and all the elders were present.
19. 保羅 問候他們後，一一述說神藉著他的服事，在外邦人中所做的事。 After greeting them, he related one by one what God did among the Gentiles through his ministry.
20. 他們聽了就不住地榮耀神，又對 保羅 說：「弟兄，你看 猶太 人中信主 的人有多少萬，而且他們都是對律法熱心的人。 When they heard it, they glorified God and said, "You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
21. 他們聽到有關你的事，說你教導所有在外邦人中的 猶太 人離道反教、背棄 摩西，叫他們不要給孩子行割禮，也不要按規矩行事。 But they have been told about you that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to abandon Moses, by telling them not to circumcise their children or to walk in our customs.
22. 他們一定會聽到你來這裡了 。那麼該怎麼辦呢？ So what is to be done? They will certainly hear that you've come.
23. 你就照我們告訴你的去做吧。我們這裡有四個人，他們都許過願。 Therefore do what we tell you: We have four men who have obligated themselves with a vow.
24. 你帶他們去，與他們一起行潔淨禮，並且替他們付錢，好讓他們剃掉頭髮。這樣，大家就會知道有關你的傳聞不是真的，而且你自己也是照著規矩行事、遵守律法的。 Take these men, purify yourself along with them, and pay for them to get their heads shaved. Then everyone will know that what they were told about you amounts to nothing, but that you yourself are also careful about observing the law.
25. 至於已經相信的外邦人，我們照著決定寫了信，要他們遠避祭過偶像的食物，遠避血和勒死的動物，遠避淫亂。 」 With regard to the Gentiles who have believed, we have written a letter containing our decision that they should keep themselves from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from what is strangled, and from sexual immorality."
26. 於是，第二天 保羅 帶了那四個人，與他們一起行了潔淨禮，進了聖殿，宣告潔淨期滿的日子，直到為他們每一個人的供物都被獻上為止。 Then the next day, Paul took the men, having purified himself along with them, and entered the temple, announcing the completion of the purification days when the offering for each of them would be made.
27. 那七天快要結束的時候，從 亞細亞 省來的一些 猶太 人看到 保羅 在聖殿裡，就煽動整個人群，下手捉拿他， As the seven days were about to end, the Jews from the province of Asia saw him in the temple complex, stirred up the whole crowd, and seized him,
28. 喊叫：「各位 以色列 人哪，請幫忙！這個人就是那到處教導大家反對我們的民族、律法，反對這地方的！他甚至把 希臘 人帶進聖殿，玷汙了這聖地。」 shouting, "Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people, our law, and this place. What's more, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has profaned this holy place."
29. 原來他們曾經看見 以弗所 人 特羅費摩 與 保羅 一起在城裡，就以為 保羅 帶他進了聖殿。 For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with him, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple complex.
30. 於是全城的人都被煽動了，民眾一起跑來，抓住 保羅，把他拖出聖殿，殿門立刻關上了。 The whole city was stirred up, and the people rushed together. They seized Paul, dragged him out of the temple complex, and at once the gates were shut.
31. 在他們想殺 保羅 的時候，有消息上報到軍團的千夫長，說全 耶路撒冷 都混亂了。 As they were trying to kill him, word went up to the commander of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in chaos.
32. 千夫長立即帶著士兵和幾個百夫長跑下去，到了他們那裡。他們一看見千夫長和士兵們，就停止毆打 保羅 。 Taking along soldiers and centurions, he immediately ran down to them. Seeing the commander and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
33. 於是千夫長上前抓住 保羅，下令用兩條鐵鏈把他捆起來，然後查問他到底是什麼人，做了什麼事。 Then the commander came up, took him into custody, and ordered him to be bound with two chains. He asked who he was and what he had done.
34. 人群當中，有的喊這個，有的喊那個；千夫長因為騷亂，無法知道真相，就下令把 保羅 帶到營樓裡去。 Some in the mob were shouting one thing and some another. Since he was not able to get reliable information because of the uproar, he ordered him to be taken into the barracks.
35. 保羅 到了臺階上的時候，由於人群凶猛，士兵們只好把他抬起來走。 When Paul got to the steps, he had to be carried by the soldiers because of the mob's violence,
36. 那一群人跟在後面，喊叫：「除掉他！」 for the mass of people were following and yelling, "Kill him!"
37. 保羅 快要被押進營樓的時候，就對千夫長說：「我是否可以對你說句話？」 千夫長說：「你懂 希臘 語嗎？ As he was about to be brought into the barracks, Paul said to the commander, "Am I allowed to say something to you?" He replied, "Do you know Greek?
38. 你究竟是不是那個前些日子作亂、帶領四千個凶徒進入曠野的 埃及 人呢？」 Aren't you the Egyptian who raised a rebellion some time ago and led 4,000 Assassins into the desert?"
39. 保羅 回答說：「我是 猶太 人，是 奇里乞亞 省的 塔爾蘇 人，並不是無名之城的公民，請求你准許我向民眾說話。」 Paul said, "I am a Jewish man from Tarsus of Cilicia, a citizen of an important city. Now I ask you, let me speak to the people."
40. 千夫長准許了， 保羅 就站在臺階上，向民眾揮一下手，大家都寂靜無聲， 保羅 就用 希伯來 語呼籲，說： After he had given permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned with his hand to the people. When there was a great hush, he addressed them in the Hebrew language:
Acts 22
1. 「各位父老兄弟，現在請聽我的申辯。」 "Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense before you."
2. 眾人聽見他用 希伯來 語向他們呼籲，就更加安靜了。 保羅 說： When they heard that he was addressing them in the Hebrew language, they became even quieter.
3. 「我是 猶太 人，出生在 奇里乞亞 省的 塔爾蘇，在這城裡長大；在 迦瑪列 門下，按照我們先祖的律法受了嚴格的教育；我對神是熱心的人，就像今天你們大家一樣。 He continued, "I am a Jewish man, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and educated according to the strict view of our patriarchal law. Being zealous for God, just as all of you are today,
4. 我曾經逼迫這道的信徒 置於死地，無論男女都捆綁起來，關進監獄。 I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and putting both men and women in jail,
5. 這是大祭司和全長老議會的人都可以為我做見證的。我還從他們那裡拿到了給同胞們 的一些信函往 大馬士革 去，要把那裡被捆綁的信徒們，帶到 耶路撒冷 來受刑。 as both the high priest and the whole council of elders can testify about me. Having received letters from them to the brothers, I was traveling to Damascus to bring those who were prisoners there to be punished in Jerusalem.
6. 「當我趕路快到 大馬士革 的時候，大約中午，忽然有強烈的光從天上下來，在我周圍四面照射。 "As I was traveling and near Damascus, about noon an intense light from heaven suddenly flashed around me.
7. 我就仆倒在地上，聽見有聲音對我說： 『 掃羅， ！你為什麼逼迫我？』 I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?'
8. 「我回答：『主啊！你到底是誰？』 「他說： 『我就是你所逼迫的 拿撒勒 人耶穌。』 "I answered, 'Who are You, Lord?' "He said to me, 'I am Jesus the Nazarene, whom you are persecuting!'
9. 與我在一起的人雖然看到了那光， 卻聽不懂那對我說話的聲音。 Now those who were with me saw the light, but they did not hear the voice of the One who was speaking to me.
10. 「我說：『主啊！我該做什麼呢？』 「主對我說： 『起來，進 大馬士革 城去，在那裡你將被告知所指定你做的一切事。』 "Then I said, 'What should I do, Lord?' "And the Lord told me, 'Get up and go into Damascus, and there you will be told about everything that is assigned for you to do.'
11. 「我因那光的榮耀，什麼都看不見了，就被同行的人牽著手，進了 大馬士革 。 "Since I couldn't see because of the brightness of that light, I was led by the hand by those who were with me, and came into Damascus.
12. 有一個名叫 阿納尼亞 的人，按照律法，是一個虔誠的人，受到所有住在那裡的 猶太 人讚許。 Someone named Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good reputation with all the Jews residing there,
13. 他來到我那裡，站在旁邊對我說：『 掃羅 弟兄，你重見光明吧！』就在那一刻，我抬頭看見他了。 came to me, stood by me, and said, 'Brother Saul, regain your sight.' And in that very hour I looked up and saw him.
14. 他又說：『我們祖先的神預先指定了你，使你明白他的旨意，看見那位義者，聽見他口中傳來的聲音， Then he said, 'The God of our fathers has appointed you to know His will, to see the Righteous One, and to hear the sound of His voice.
15. 因為你將要做他的見證人，向所有的人見證你所看到的、你所聽到的。 For you will be a witness for Him to all people of what you have seen and heard.
16. 現在你還等什麼呢？起來，當受洗 ！求告他 的名，當洗去你的罪孽！』 And now, why delay? Get up and be baptized, and wash away your sins by calling on His name.'
17. 「後來，我回到 耶路撒冷，在聖殿裡禱告的時候，魂遊象外， "After I came back to Jerusalem and was praying in the temple complex, I went into a visionary state
18. 看見主對我說： 『快！趕快離開 耶路撒冷，因為他們不會接受你為我做的見證。』 and saw Him telling me, 'Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not accept your testimony about Me!'
19. 「我就說：『主啊，他們知道我曾經到各會堂，把信靠你的人關進監獄，還鞭打他們。 "But I said, 'Lord, they know that in synagogue after synagogue I had those who believed in You imprisoned and beaten.
20. 並且當你的見證人 司提反 受害 流血的時候，我自己也站在旁邊贊同，還為那些殺害他的人看守衣服。』 And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was being shed, I myself was standing by and approving, and I guarded the clothes of those who killed him.'
21. 「主對我說： 『去吧！我要派你到遙遠的外邦人那裡去。』 」 "Then He said to me, 'Go, because I will send you far away to the Gentiles.'"
22. 眾人聽 保羅 講到這句話，就高聲說：「這樣的人，把他從地上除掉，因為他不該活著！」 They listened to him up to this word. Then they raised their voices, shouting, "Wipe this person off the earth-- it's a disgrace for him to live!"
23. 他們喊叫，拋著衣服，向空中揚起塵土。 As they were yelling and flinging aside their robes and throwing dust into the air,
24. 千夫長下令把 保羅 押進營樓，吩咐鞭打拷問他，要了解民眾是因什麼理由向他這樣一直喊叫。 the commander ordered him to be brought into the barracks, directing that he be examined with the scourge, so he could discover the reason they were shouting against him like this.
25. 當士兵們用皮條捆上 保羅 的時候，他對站在旁邊的百夫長說：「你們鞭打一個沒有被定罪的 羅馬 公民，可以嗎？」 As they stretched him out for the lash, Paul said to the centurion standing by, "Is it legal for you to scourge a man who is a Roman citizen and is uncondemned?"
26. 百夫長聽了，就來到千夫長面前，報告說：「你要做什麼呢？ 要知道，這個人是 羅馬 公民。」 When the centurion heard this, he went and reported to the commander, saying, "What are you going to do? For this man is a Roman citizen."
27. 千夫長就前來問 保羅 ：「告訴我，你是 羅馬 公民嗎？」 保羅 說：「是的。」 The commander came and said to him, "Tell me-- are you a Roman citizen?" "Yes," he said.
28. 千夫長說：「我花了一大筆錢，才買到了 羅馬 公民權。」 保羅 說：「我生下來就是。」 The commander replied, "I bought this citizenship for a large amount of money." "But I myself was born a citizen," Paul said.
29. 於是那些要拷問他的人，立刻退下了。千夫長既知道他是 羅馬 公民，又因為捆綁了他，就懼怕起來。 Therefore, those who were about to examine him withdrew from him at once. The commander too was alarmed when he realized Paul was a Roman citizen and he had bound him.
30. 第二天，千夫長想確切知道 保羅 為什麼被 猶太 人控告，就 解開他，下令召集祭司長們和全議會的人，然後把 保羅 帶來，叫他站在他們面前。 The next day, since he wanted to find out exactly why Paul was being accused by the Jews, he released him and instructed the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin to convene. Then he brought Paul down and placed him before them.
Acts 23
1. 保羅 注視著議會的人，說：「各位兄弟，直到今天，我在神面前，行事為人一向都憑著無愧的良心。」 Paul looked intently at the Sanhedrin and said, "Brothers, I have lived my life before God in all good conscience until this day."
2. 大祭司 阿納尼亞 就命令站在 保羅 旁邊的人，打他的嘴巴。 But the high priest Ananias ordered those who were standing next to him to strike him on the mouth.
3. 保羅 就對他說：「你這粉飾的牆啊，神將要打你！你坐在那裡應按照律法審判我，而你卻違背律法，下令打我嗎？」 Then Paul said to him, "God is going to strike you, you whitewashed wall! You are sitting there judging me according to the law, and in violation of the law are you ordering me to be struck?"
4. 站在旁邊的人說：「你竟敢辱罵神的大祭司？」 And those standing nearby said, "Do you dare revile God's high priest?"
5. 保羅 就說：「同胞們，我不知道他是大祭司。的確，經上記著： 不可說你民中掌權者的壞話。 」 "I did not know, brothers," Paul said, "that it was the high priest. For it is written, You must not speak evil of a ruler of your people."
6. 保羅 知道有一部分人是 撒都該 人，另一部分是 法利賽 人，就在議會中喊著：「各位兄弟，我是 法利賽 人，也是 法利賽 人的兒子。我現在受審，是與死人復活的盼望有關。」 When Paul realized that one part of them were Sadducees and the other part were Pharisees, he cried out in the Sanhedrin, "Brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees! I am being judged because of the hope of the resurrection of the dead!"
7. 他說了這話， 法利賽 人和 撒都該 人就起了爭執，會眾也分裂了。 When he said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
8. 原來 撒都該 人說沒有復活，沒有天使，也沒有靈，但 法利賽 人卻承認這一切 。 For the Sadducees say there is no resurrection, and no angel or spirit, but the Pharisees affirm them all.
9. 於是他們大大地喧嚷起來。有些 法利賽 派的經文士們站起來激烈地爭辯，說：「我們查不出這個人有什麼錯 。也許有靈或天使對他說過話呢！ 」 The shouting grew loud, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees' party got up and argued vehemently: "We find nothing evil in this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?"
10. 爭執越來越激烈，千夫長擔心 保羅 會被他們撕碎，就命令軍隊下去，把 保羅 從他們當中搶出來，帶回營樓裡。 When the dispute became violent, the commander feared that Paul might be torn apart by them and ordered the troops to go down, rescue him from them, and bring him into the barracks.
11. 當夜，主站在 保羅 旁邊，說： 「 你要鼓起勇氣！你怎樣在 耶路撒冷 鄭重地見證有關我的事，也必須照樣在 羅馬 做見證。」 The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, "Have courage! For as you have testified about Me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome."
12. 天亮了， 猶太 人就策劃了一起陰謀，並且賭咒起誓說，殺掉 保羅 以前，就不吃不喝。 When it was day, the Jews formed a conspiracy and bound themselves under a curse: neither to eat nor to drink until they had killed Paul.
13. 策劃這同謀起誓的有四十多人。 There were more than 40 who had formed this plot.
14. 他們來到祭司長們和長老們那裡，說：「我們已經賭咒起誓，殺掉 保羅 以前，就什麼都不吃。 These men went to the chief priests and elders and said, "We have bound ourselves under a solemn curse that we won't eat anything until we have killed Paul.
15. 所以你們和議會現在就要告訴千夫長， 把 保羅 帶到你們這裡來，假裝要更詳盡地審查他的事；我們預備好了，要在他到達以前就殺了他。」 So now you, along with the Sanhedrin, make a request to the commander that he bring him down to you as if you were going to investigate his case more thoroughly. However, before he gets near, we are ready to kill him."
16. 保羅 的外甥聽見了這埋伏的事，就過來進了營樓告訴 保羅 。 But the son of Paul's sister, hearing about their ambush, came and entered the barracks and reported it to Paul.
17. 保羅 請來了一個百夫長，說：「請帶這年輕人到千夫長那裡，因為他有事要向他報告。」 Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, "Take this young man to the commander, because he has something to report to him."
18. 於是百夫長就帶 保羅 的外甥到千夫長那裡去，說：「囚犯 保羅 請了我去，求我把這個年輕人帶到你這裡來，他有事要告訴你。」 So he took him, brought him to the commander, and said, "The prisoner Paul called me and asked me to bring this young man to you, because he has something to tell you."
19. 千夫長拉著年輕人的手，退到一邊，悄悄地問他：「你有什麼事要告訴我？」 Then the commander took him by the hand, led him aside, and inquired privately, "What is it you have to report to me?"
20. 他說：「 猶太 人已經說好，要請求你明天把 保羅 帶到議會去，假裝要更詳盡地查問他的事。 "The Jews," he said, "have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the Sanhedrin tomorrow, as though they are going to hold a somewhat more careful inquiry about him.
21. 所以請你不要被他們說服，因為他們中的四十多人正埋伏等著他。他們已經賭咒起誓說，殺掉 保羅 以前，就不吃不喝。現在他們預備好了，正期望你答應。」 Don't let them persuade you, because there are more than 40 of them arranging to ambush him, men who have bound themselves under a curse not to eat or drink until they kill him. Now they are ready, waiting for a commitment from you."
22. 千夫長吩咐那年輕人說：「不要對任何人說，你把這些事告訴了我。」於是，就讓他走了。 So the commander dismissed the young man and instructed him, "Don't tell anyone that you have informed me about this."
23. 然後千夫長叫來兩個百夫長，說：「預備兩百名步兵、七十名騎兵、兩百名長槍手，晚上九點 出發往 凱撒里亞 去。 He summoned two of his centurions and said, "Get 200 soldiers ready with 70 cavalry and 200 spearmen to go to Caesarea at nine tonight.
24. 也要預備牲口，讓 保羅 騎上，護送到總督 菲利克斯 那裡去。」 Also provide mounts so they can put Paul on them and bring him safely to Felix the governor."
25. 他寫了一封信函，有這樣的內容： He wrote a letter of this kind:
26. 「 克勞迪呂西亞 問候總督 菲利克斯 大人。 Claudius Lysias, To the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
27. 這個人被 猶太 人抓住，正要被他們殺害的時候，我帶軍隊到場，得知他是 羅馬 公民，就把他救了出來。 When this man had been seized by the Jews and was about to be killed by them, I arrived with my troops and rescued him because I learned that he is a Roman citizen.
28. 我想了解 猶太 人控告他的理由，就帶他到他們的議會去。 Wanting to know the charge for which they were accusing him, I brought him down before their Sanhedrin.
29. 我發現他被控告，與他們律法上的爭議問題有關，並沒有任何該死或該被捆鎖的罪行。 I found out that the accusations were about disputed matters in their law, and that there was no charge that merited death or chains.
30. 後來我被告知 將有一個針對這個人的陰謀，就立即把他解送到您那裡去，又吩咐原告們到您面前去告他。 」 When I was informed that there was a plot against the man, I sent him to you right away. I also ordered his accusers to state their case against him in your presence.
31. 於是士兵們按照命令，把 保羅 接走，連夜送到 安提帕底 。 Therefore, during the night, the soldiers took Paul and brought him to Antipatris as they were ordered.
32. 第二天，他們讓騎兵帶著 保羅 前行，就回到營樓。 The next day, they returned to the barracks, allowing the cavalry to go on with him.
33. 騎兵進了 凱撒里亞，把信函呈給總督，又把 保羅 帶到他面前。 When these men entered Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
34. 總督 讀了信，問 保羅 是哪一個省的人，知道他是 奇里乞亞 省的人， After he read it, he asked what province he was from. So when he learned he was from Cilicia,
35. 就說：「等你的原告們也到了，我會詳細地聽你的事。」他下令把 保羅 看守在 希律 的王府裡。 he said, "I will give you a hearing whenever your accusers get here too." And he ordered that he be kept under guard in Herod's palace.
Acts 24
1. 過了五天，大祭司 阿納尼亞 帶著一些長老和一個名叫 特圖羅斯 的律師下來，向總督指控 保羅 。 After five days Ananias the high priest came down with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus. These men presented their case against Paul to the governor.
2. 保羅 被叫進來， 特圖羅斯 就開始控告，說：「 菲利克斯 大人！因著您，我們大享和平；因著您的遠見，本國也進行了許多改革； When he was called in, Tertullus began to accuse him and said: "Since we enjoy great peace because of you, and reforms are taking place for the benefit of this nation by your foresight,
3. 我們事事處處滿懷感謝地領受。 we gratefully receive them always and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
4. 但為了不過多地煩擾您，我懇求您，以您的仁慈聽我們簡短地說。 However, so that I will not burden you any further, I beg you in your graciousness to give us a brief hearing.
5. 我們發現這個人像瘟疫一樣，煽動普天下 猶太 人暴亂；他又是 拿撒勒 人教派的一個頭目。 For we have found this man to be a plague, an agitator among all the Jews throughout the Roman world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes!
6. 他甚至試圖玷汙聖殿，我們就把他拘捕了。我們本來想按照我們的律法審判他， He even tried to desecrate the temple, so we apprehended him [[and wanted to judge him according to our law.
7. 可是千夫長 呂西亞 過來，把他從我們手中強行帶走，又吩咐原告到您這裡來。 But Lysias the commander came and took him from our hands, commanding his accusers to come to you.]]
8. 您親自審問他，就能了解我們控告他的這一切事了。」 By examining him yourself you will be able to discern all these things of which we accuse him."
9. 猶太 人也都附和，聲稱這些事就是如此。 The Jews also joined in the attack, alleging that these things were so.
10. 總督點頭示意要 保羅 講話， 保羅 就說：「我知道您在本國多年做審判官，所以我樂意為自己申辯。 When the governor motioned to him to speak, Paul replied: "Because I know you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I am glad to offer my defense in what concerns me.
11. 您可以了解，自從我上 耶路撒冷 去敬拜，到現在不超過十二天。 You are able to determine that it is no more than 12 days since I went up to worship in Jerusalem.
12. 無論在聖殿裡，或在會堂裡，或在城裡，他們都沒有看見我和任何人爭論，或煽動民眾。 And they didn't find me disputing with anyone or causing a disturbance among the crowd, either in the temple complex or in the synagogues, or anywhere in the city.
13. 他們現在也不能向您證實所控告我的事。 Neither can they provide evidence to you of what they now bring against me.
14. 不過這一點我向您承認：我是按照他們稱為『異端 』的這道，如此事奉我先祖的神，因為我相信一切合乎律法書和先知書上所記載的事； But I confess this to you: that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I worship my fathers' God, believing all the things that are written in the Law and in the Prophets.
15. 我對神所懷有的盼望也是這些人自己所期望的，就是義人和不義的人 將來都要復活。 And I have a hope in God, which these men themselves also accept, that there is going to be a resurrection, both of the righteous and the unrighteous.
16. 因此，在神和人面前，我總是盡力存著無愧的良心。 I always do my best to have a clear conscience toward God and men.
17. 過了好幾年，我回來了，帶著給我同胞的施捨，以及供物； After many years, I came to bring charitable gifts and offerings to my nation,
18. 正獻上供物的時候，他們在聖殿裡發現了我，那時我已經行完了潔淨禮，既沒有人群，也沒有騷亂， and while I was doing this, some Jews from the province of Asia found me ritually purified in the temple, without a crowd and without any uproar.
19. 只有一些從 亞細亞 省來的 猶太 人——如果對我有什麼控告，應該是他們到您面前來控告。 It is they who ought to be here before you to bring charges, if they have anything against me.
20. 還是讓這些人自己說說，我站在議會前的時候，他們到底查出了我有什麼罪行—— Either let these men here state what wrongdoing they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin,
21. 或者，是為了我站在他們中間喊過這樣一句話：『我今天在你們面前受審，是因為死人復活的事！』」 or about this one statement I cried out while standing among them, 'Today I am being judged before you concerning the resurrection of the dead.'"
22. 因為 菲利克斯 比較詳盡地了解這道， 就推託他們，說：「等千夫長 呂西亞 下來，我再審斷有關你們的事。」 Since Felix was accurately informed about the Way, he adjourned the hearing, saying, "When Lysias the commander comes down, I will decide your case."
23. 他吩咐百夫長看守 保羅，要寬待他，不要阻止他自己的人來供應他 。 He ordered that the centurion keep Paul under guard, though he could have some freedom, and that he should not prevent any of his friends from serving him.
24. 過了幾天， 菲利克斯 與他的 猶太 人妻子 杜茜拉 一起來了。他把 保羅 叫來，聽他講說對基督耶穌 的信仰。 After some days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, who was Jewish, he sent for Paul and listened to him on the subject of faith in Christ Jesus.
25. 當 保羅 講論關於公義、自制和將來的審判時， 菲利克斯 感到害怕，就說：「你現在可以回去，我有了時間，就會叫你。」 Now as he spoke about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix became afraid and replied, "Leave for now, but when I find time I'll call for you."
26. 同時他也希望 保羅 送他錢， 所以經常把他叫來，和他交談。 At the same time he was also hoping that money would be given to him by Paul. For this reason he sent for him quite often and conversed with him.
27. 過了兩年， 波奇烏菲斯特斯 接替 菲利克斯 。 菲利克斯 想要討好 猶太 人，就把 保羅 留在監獄裡。 After two years had passed, Felix received a successor, Porcius Festus, and because he wished to do a favor for the Jews, Felix left Paul in prison.
Acts 25
1. 菲斯特斯 到省裡上任第三天，就從 凱撒里亞 上 耶路撒冷 去。 Three days after Festus arrived in the province, he went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
2. 祭司長們和 猶太 人的首領們向 菲斯特斯 指控 保羅，並且懇求 菲斯特斯， Then the chief priests and the leaders of the Jews presented their case against Paul to him; and they appealed,
3. 請他恩准，把 保羅 叫到 耶路撒冷 來。他們策劃要在路上埋伏殺了 保羅 。 asking him to do them a favor against Paul, that he might summon him to Jerusalem. They were preparing an ambush along the road to kill him.
4. 於是 菲斯特斯 說：「 保羅 正被拘留在 凱撒里亞，我自己也很快就要回去。」 However, Festus answered that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to go there shortly.
5. 他又說：「所以你們中間有權的人都與我一起下去；如果這個人有什麼過錯，就當控告他。」 "Therefore," he said, "let the men of authority among you go down with me and accuse him, if there is any wrong in this man."
6. 菲斯特斯 在他們那裡住了不超過十天八天，就下到 凱撒里亞 去了。第二天，他坐在審判席上，下令把 保羅 帶上來。 When he had spent not more than eight or 10 days among them, he went down to Caesarea. The next day, seated at the judge's bench, he commanded Paul to be brought in.
7. 保羅 一到，從 耶路撒冷 下來的那些 猶太 人就站在他周圍，用很多嚴重的罪狀來控告他，可是都不能證實。 When he arrived, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him and brought many serious charges that they were not able to prove,
8. 保羅 申辯說：「無論是對 猶太 人的律法，或是對聖殿，或是對凱撒，我都沒有犯過罪。」 while Paul made the defense that, "Neither against the Jewish law, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar have I sinned at all."
9. 但 菲斯特斯 想要討好 猶太 人，就問 保羅 說：「你願意上 耶路撒冷，讓我在那裡審判這些事嗎？」 Then Festus, wanting to do a favor for the Jews, replied to Paul, "Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem, there to be tried before me on these charges?"
10. 保羅 就說：「我已經站在凱撒的審判臺前，這裡就是我應該受審的地方。我沒有虧負過 猶太 人，就像您也很清楚地了解那樣。 But Paul said: "I am standing at Caesar's tribunal, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as even you can see very well.
11. 既然如此，如果我行了什麼不義的事，犯了什麼該死的罪，就是死我也不拒絕；但如果這些人對我的控告不是真的，那麼誰也不能把我交給他們。我向凱撒上訴！」 If then I am doing wrong, or have done anything deserving of death, I do not refuse to die, but if there is nothing to what these men accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!"
12. 菲斯特斯 與參議會商量以後，就回答：「你已經向凱撒上訴了，你就將到凱撒那裡去！」 After Festus conferred with his council, he replied, "You have appealed to Caesar; to Caesar you will go!"
13. 過了幾天， 阿格里帕 王 和 百妮基 到達 凱撒里亞，問候 菲斯特斯 。 After some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived in Caesarea and paid a courtesy call on Festus.
14. 他們在那裡住了好幾天， 菲斯特斯 就向 阿格里帕 王陳述了有關 保羅 的事，說：「這裡有一個人，是 菲利克斯 留下的囚犯。 Since they stayed there many days, Festus presented Paul's case to the king, saying, "There's a man who was left as a prisoner by Felix.
15. 我到 耶路撒冷 去的時候， 猶太 人的祭司長們和長老們指控他，要求我定他的罪。 When I was in Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews presented their case and asked for a judgment against him.
16. 我回答他們：在被告還沒有與原告當面對質，並且對被控罪名還沒有獲得申辯機會以前，就把被告 交出去， 這不符合 羅馬 人的規矩。 I answered them that it's not the Romans' custom to give any man up before the accused confronts the accusers face to face and has an opportunity to give a defense concerning the charge.
17. 因此，當他們聚集在這裡的時候，我沒有耽擱，第二天就坐在審判席上，下令把那個人帶來。 Therefore, when they had assembled here, I did not delay. The next day I sat at the judge's bench and ordered the man to be brought in.
18. 那些原告站起來圍著他提出來的罪狀，並不是我所認為的惡事 。 Concerning him, the accusers stood up and brought no charge of the sort I was expecting.
19. 不過他們與他有一些爭議的問題，是關於自己宗教的事，以及關於一個叫耶穌的人——這個人已經死了， 保羅 卻聲稱他還活著。 Instead they had some disagreements with him about their own religion and about a certain Jesus, a dead man whom Paul claimed to be alive.
20. 我對這些辯論也心裡困惑，就問 保羅 是否願意上 耶路撒冷 去，在那裡為這些事受審。 Since I was at a loss in a dispute over such things, I asked him if he wished to go to Jerusalem and be tried there concerning these matters.
21. 可是 保羅 請求把他留給皇帝審斷，我就下令把他留下，等著我送他到凱撒那裡去。」 But when Paul appealed to be held for trial by the Emperor, I ordered him to be kept in custody until I could send him to Caesar."
22. 阿格里帕 對 菲斯特斯 說：「我本來也想親自聽這個人講說。」 菲斯特斯 說：「明天你就可以聽他講說。」 Then Agrippa said to Festus, "I would like to hear the man myself." "Tomorrow," he said, "you will hear him."
23. 第二天， 阿格里帕 和 百妮基 大張聲勢而來，當他們與幾個軍官和城裡的顯要人物一起進了大廳， 菲斯特斯 一聲下令， 保羅 就被帶上來。 So the next day, Agrippa and Bernice came with great pomp and entered the auditorium with the commanders and prominent men of the city. When Festus gave the command, Paul was brought in.
24. 菲斯特斯 說：「 阿格里帕 王和所有在場的各位，你們所看見的這個人， 猶太 的全體民眾為了他，在 耶路撒冷 和這裡向我陳情，喊著說他不應該再活下去。 Then Festus said: "King Agrippa and all men present with us, you see this man about whom the whole Jewish community has appealed to me, both in Jerusalem and here, shouting that he should not live any longer.
25. 但是我了解他並沒有犯過什麼該死的罪，不過他自己既然向皇帝上訴了，我就決定把他解送去。 Now I realized that he had not done anything deserving of death, but when he himself appealed to the Emperor, I decided to send him.
26. 關於這個人，我沒有任何確切的事可以陳奏皇帝。因此我把他帶到你們面前，尤其在您 阿格里帕 王面前，好使審查結束時，我可以有所陳奏， I have nothing definite to write to the Emperor about him. Therefore, I have brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that after this examination is over, I may have something to write.
27. 因為我認為，解送囚犯而不指明對他的罪狀，是沒有道理的。」 For it seems unreasonable to me to send a prisoner and not to indicate the charges against him."
Acts 26
1. 阿格里帕 對 保羅 說：「你獲准為自己說話。」 於是 保羅 伸手開始申辯： Agrippa said to Paul, "It is permitted for you to speak for yourself." Then Paul stretched out his hand and began his defense:
2. 「 阿格里帕 王啊，關於 猶太 人控告我的一切事，今天要在您面前申辯，我認為自己是蒙福的， "I consider myself fortunate, King Agrippa, that today I am going to make a defense before you about everything I am accused of by the Jews,
3. 尤其因為您熟悉 猶太 人一切的規矩和爭議的問題，所以我請求您耐心聽我說。 especially since you are an expert in all the Jewish customs and controversies. Therefore I beg you to listen to me patiently.
4. 「事實上，我自幼的為人，從起初在自己的同胞中間，以及在 耶路撒冷，所有的 猶太 人都知道。 "All the Jews know my way of life from my youth, which was spent from the beginning among my own nation and in Jerusalem.
5. 他們從一開始就已經認識我，如果他們願意就可以見證：我是按著我們宗教中最嚴格的教派，過著 法利賽 人的生活。 They had previously known me for quite some time, if they were willing to testify, that according to the strictest party of our religion I lived as a Pharisee.
6. 現在我站在這裡受審，是因為盼望神已經賜給我們祖先的那應許。 And now I stand on trial for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,
7. 為了那應許，我們十二個支派日夜熱切地事奉神，盼望得到它。王 啊，我被 猶太 人控告，就是為了這盼望。 [the promise] our 12 tribes hope to attain as they earnestly serve Him night and day. Because of this hope I am being accused by the Jews, O king!
8. 你們為什麼判斷神使死人復活的事為不可信的呢？ Why is it considered incredible by any of you that God raises the dead?
9. 事實上，我自己曾經認為必須多做反對 拿撒勒 人耶穌之名的事， In fact, I myself supposed it was necessary to do many things in opposition to the name of Jesus the Nazarene.
10. 我在 耶路撒冷 也是這樣做的。我不但從祭司長們得了權柄把許多聖徒關進監獄，而且當他們被殺的時候，我也投了一票。 This I actually did in Jerusalem, and I locked up many of the saints in prison, since I had received authority for that from the chief priests. When they were put to death, I cast my vote against them.
11. 我在各會堂裡，經常用刑逼他們說褻瀆的話，又越發惱恨他們，甚至到國外的城市去逼迫他們。 In all the synagogues I often tried to make them blaspheme by punishing them. Being greatly enraged at them, I even pursued them to foreign cities.
12. 「那時我得到祭司長們的授權和委任往 大馬士革 去。 "Under these circumstances I was traveling to Damascus with authority and a commission from the chief priests.
13. 王啊，約在正午，我在路上的時候，看見一道光，比太陽更明亮，從天上四面照射我和與我同行的人。 At midday, while on the road, O king, I saw a light from heaven brighter than the sun, shining around me and those traveling with me.
14. 我們都仆倒在地。我聽見有聲音用 希伯來 語對我說 ： 『 掃羅， ！你為什麼逼迫我？你腳踢刺棒，是狂妄的。』 When we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice speaking to me in the Hebrew language, 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.'
15. 「我問：『主啊，你到底是誰？』 「主 說： 『我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。 "But I said, 'Who are You, Lord?' "And the Lord replied: 'I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
16. 你起來，用你的兩腳站好！要知道，我向你顯現是為這樣一個目的 ：預先指定你做僕人和見證人，就是為你所看見的事，以及我將要顯明給你的事做見證人。 But get up and stand on your feet. For I have appeared to you for this purpose, to appoint you as a servant and a witness of things you have seen, and of things in which I will appear to you.
17. 我要從 以色列 子民和外邦人當中把你救出來。 我差派你到他們那裡去， I will rescue you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I now send you,
