2. 請你們在主裡以聖徒配得的方式來歡迎她。無論她在什麼事上需要你們，都請你們幫助她，因為她實在幫助了許多人，也幫助了我。 So you should welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her in whatever matter she may require your help. For indeed she has been a benefactor of many-- and of me also.
3. 請問候 普茜拉 和 阿奎拉 ；他們是我在基督耶穌裡的同工。 Give my greetings to Prisca and Aquila, my co-workers in Christ Jesus,
4. 為我的生命，他們將自己的生死置之度外 。不單我感激他們，就是外邦的各教會也都感激他們。 who risked their own necks for my life. Not only do I thank them, but so do all the Gentile churches.
5. 請問候在他們家裡的教會。 請問候我親愛的 以佩尼托，他是 亞細亞 省歸入基督的初熟果子。 Greet also the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who is the first convert to Christ from Asia.
6. 請問候 瑪麗亞，她為你們 多多勞苦。 Greet Mary, who has worked very hard for you.
7. 請問候與我一起坐過牢的同胞 安德羅尼克 和 猶尼亞，他們在使徒中有名望，也比我先成為在基督裡的。 Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were also in Christ before me.
8. 請問候在主裡我親愛的 安普利亞托 。 Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.
9. 請問候 歐巴諾，他是我們在基督裡的同工，也問候我親愛的 斯塔庫斯 。 Greet Urbanus, our co-worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.
10. 請問候 阿比利斯，他在基督裡經過了考驗。 請問候 亞利多布 家裡的人。 Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
11. 請問候我的同胞 希羅迪恩 。 請問候 納吉蘇 家中在主裡的人。 Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those who belong to the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
12. 請問候在主裡勞苦的 特魯菲娜 和 特魯弗薩 。 請問候親愛的 佩西絲，她在主裡多多勞苦。 Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who have worked hard in the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis, who has worked very hard in the Lord.
13. 請問候在主裡蒙揀選的 魯弗斯 和他的母親，對我來說他的母親就是我的母親。 Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord; also his mother-- and mine.
14. 請問候 阿森克里托 、 弗勒貢 、 赫米斯 、 帕特羅巴 、 赫馬斯，以及與他們在一起的弟兄們。 Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
15. 請問候 非羅羅古 和 猶莉婭， 尼利亞 和他的妹妹，以及 奧林帕斯，還有與他們在一起的所有聖徒。 Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
16. 你們要用聖潔的親吻禮彼此問候。 基督的各教會都問候你們。 Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send you greetings.
17. 弟兄們，我勸你們，要留心那些針對你們所受的教導而製造分裂和絆腳石的人。你們要遠離他們。 Now I implore you, brothers, watch out for those who cause dissensions and pitfalls contrary to the doctrine you have learned. Avoid them;
18. 因為這樣的人不是服事我們的主基督，而是服事自己的私欲 。他們用花言巧語，欺騙單純人的心。 for such people do not serve our Lord Christ but their own appetites, and by smooth talk and flattering words they deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.
19. 你們的順從，大家都知道了，所以我為你們而歡喜。但我希望你們在善事上有智慧，在惡事上無知 。 The report of your obedience has reached everyone. Therefore I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good, yet innocent about what is evil.
20. 賜平安的神，很快要把 撒旦 壓碎在你們的腳下。願我們主耶穌 的恩典與你們同在！ The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.
21. 我的同工 提摩太 和我的同胞 盧吉斯 、 耶森 、 索西巴特 都問候你們。 Timothy, my co-worker, and Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen, greet you.
22. 代筆寫這書信的我—— 特提烏斯，在主裡問候你們。 I Tertius, who penned this epistle in the Lord, greet you.
23. 那接待我，也接待全教會的 蓋尤斯 問候你們。本城的財務官 以拉斯托 和弟兄 庫爾托斯 問候你們。 Gaius, who is host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our brother Quartus greet you.
24. 願我們主耶穌基督的恩典與你們大家同在！阿們。 [[The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.]]
25. 願榮耀歸於神——他能藉著我的福音和有關耶穌基督的傳道，藉著奧祕的啟示堅固你們。這奧祕亙古以來是隱藏的， Now to Him who has power to strengthen you according to my gospel and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the sacred secret kept silent for long ages,
26. 然而如今已經得以顯現；並且按照永恆神的命令，藉著先知們的經文顯明了出來。這是為要在萬民中帶來信仰上的順從—— but now revealed and made known through the prophetic Scriptures, according to the command of the eternal God, to advance the obedience of faith among all nations--
27. 願榮耀，藉著耶穌基督，歸於這位獨一全智的神，直到永遠！阿們。 to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ-- to Him be the glory forever! Amen.
1 Corinthians
1 Corinthians 1
1. 照著神的旨意蒙召做基督耶穌使徒的 保羅，以及弟兄 索提尼， Paul, called as an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, and our brother Sosthenes:
2. 致那在 哥林多 屬神的教會，就是在基督耶穌裡被分別為聖、蒙召成為聖徒的人，以及所有在各地求告我們主耶穌基督之名的人。基督是他們的主，也是我們的主。 To God's church at Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus and called as saints, with all those in every place who call on the name of Jesus Christ our Lord-- theirs and ours.
3. 願恩典與平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督臨到你們！ Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
4. 我常常為你們感謝我的 神，因你們在基督耶穌裡被賜予了神的恩典， I always thank my God for you because of God's grace given to you in Christ Jesus,
5. 使你們在基督裡凡事都得以富足——在一切話語上、一切知識上—— that by Him you were made rich in everything-- in all speaking and all knowledge--
6. 正如有關基督的見證在你們中間得以確立， as the testimony about Christ was confirmed among you,
7. 以致你們在任何恩賜上都不缺乏，熱切等待著我們主耶穌基督的顯現。 so that you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
8. 他也將使你們堅定到底，使你們在我們主耶穌基督的日子 無可指責。 He will also confirm you to the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
9. 神是信實的；你們已經被他召喚，進到與他的兒子——我們主耶穌基督的契合裡。 God is faithful; by Him you were called into fellowship with His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
10. 弟兄們，我藉著我們主耶穌基督的名，懇求你們大家言語一致；你們中間不要分裂，而要在同一個心思、同一個目的上得以完備。 Now I urge you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all say the same thing, that there be no divisions among you, and that you be united with the same understanding and the same conviction.
11. 我的弟兄們，事實上， 克洛伊 家的一些人告訴了我有關你們的事，說你們中間有紛爭。 For it has been reported to me about you, my brothers, by members of Chloe's household, that there are quarrels among you.
12. 這就是說：你們各自聲稱「我是屬 保羅 的」，或「我是屬 阿波羅 的」，或「我是屬 磯法 的」，或「我是屬基督的」。 What I am saying is this: each of you says, "I'm with Paul," or "I'm with Apollos," or "I'm with Cephas," or "I'm with Christ."
13. 難道基督是被分割的嗎？ 難道 保羅 為你們被釘十字架了嗎？或者你們受洗 是歸入 保羅 的名 嗎？ Is Christ divided? Was it Paul who was crucified for you? Or were you baptized in Paul's name?
14. 我感謝神，除了 克里斯普 和 蓋尤斯 以外，我沒有給你們任何人施過洗， I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
15. 免得有人說，你們是奉我的名受洗。 so that no one can say you had been baptized in my name.
16. 我雖然也給 司提法納 的一家人施過洗，此外我卻不記得是否給其他人施過洗。 I did, in fact, baptize the household of Stephanas; beyond that, I don't know if I baptized anyone else.
17. 要知道，基督差派我，不是為了施洗，而是為了傳福音——並不用智慧的話語，免得基督的十字架落了空。 For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel-- not with clever words, so that the cross of Christ will not be emptied [of its effect].
18. 原來，十字架的福音 對那些正在滅亡的人來說，是愚拙的；但是對我們這些正在被拯救的人來說，卻是神的大能。 For to those who are perishing the message of the cross is foolishness, but to us who are being saved it is God's power.
19. 因為經上記著： 「我將要毀滅智慧人的智慧， 廢棄聰明人的聰明。」 For it is written: I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will set aside the understanding of the experts.
20. 智慧人在哪裡？經文士在哪裡？這世代的雄辯家在哪裡？神難道不使這世界的智慧成了愚拙嗎？ Where is the philosopher? Where is the scholar? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn't God made the world's wisdom foolish?
21. 實際上，在神的智慧中，世界既然憑智慧不認識神，神就樂意藉著傳道的愚拙，拯救那些相信的人。 For since, in God's wisdom, the world did not know God through wisdom, God was pleased to save those who believe through the foolishness of the message preached.
22. 雖然 猶太 人求神蹟， 希臘 人尋智慧， For the Jews ask for signs and the Greeks seek wisdom,
23. 但我們卻傳揚被釘十字架的基督——對 猶太 人來說是絆腳石，對外邦人 來說是愚拙的； but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to the Jews and foolishness to the Gentiles.
24. 不過對那些蒙召的人，無論是 猶太 人、或是 希臘 人，基督總是神的大能、神的智慧。 Yet to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is God's power and God's wisdom,
25. 因為神的愚拙比人更智慧，神的軟弱比人更強壯。 because God's foolishness is wiser than human wisdom, and God's weakness is stronger than human strength.
26. 弟兄們，想一想你們所蒙的召喚：按人的標準，你們當中 有智慧的不多，有權勢的不多，出身高貴的也不多。 Brothers, consider your calling: not many are wise from a human perspective, not many powerful, not many of noble birth.
27. 然而神卻揀選了世上愚拙的，為了使那些有智慧的羞愧；神又揀選了世上軟弱的，為了使那些強壯的羞愧； Instead, God has chosen the world's foolish things to shame the wise, and God has chosen the world's weak things to shame the strong.
28. 神也揀選了世上出身低微的、被人藐視的，就是那些不是什麼的，為了要廢除那些是個什麼的， God has chosen the world's insignificant and despised things-- the things viewed as nothing-- so He might bring to nothing the things that are viewed as something,
29. 好使所有的人 在神面前都不能自誇， so that no one can boast in His presence.
30. 但本於神，你們卻是在基督耶穌裡的。基督耶穌為我們成了從神而來的智慧、公義、聖潔和救贖， But from Him you are in Christ Jesus, who for us became wisdom from God, as well as righteousness, sanctification, and redemption,
31. 為要像經上所記的： 「誇耀的當在主裡誇耀。」 in order that, as it is written: The one who boasts must boast in the Lord.
1 Corinthians 2
1. 弟兄們，我以前到你們那裡去的時候，並沒有用高言大智對你們傳講神的奧祕， When I came to you, brothers, announcing the testimony of God to you, I did not come with brilliance of speech or wisdom.
2. 因為我曾下定決心，在你們中間不知道別的，只知道耶穌基督，就是被釘了十字架的這一位。 For I determined to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
3. 並且我在你們那裡的時候，又軟弱又懼怕，甚至極其戰兢。 And I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
4. 我說話、我傳道，不是藉著 有智慧的說服性的話語，而是藉著聖靈和大能的明證， My speech and my proclamation were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit and power,
5. 好讓你們的信仰不靠人的智慧，而靠神的大能。 so that your faith might not be based on men's wisdom but on God's power.
6. 然而，在成熟的人 中間，我們也講智慧，但不是這世代的智慧，也不是這世代中將要被廢除的那些統治者的智慧。 However, among the mature we do speak a wisdom, but not a wisdom of this age, or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.
7. 我們所講的是那從前被隱藏在奧祕中屬神的智慧，就是神在萬世以前為了我們的榮耀所預定的智慧； On the contrary, we speak God's hidden wisdom in a mystery, which God predestined before the ages for our glory.
8. 這世代的那些統治者沒有一個知道這智慧，因為他們如果知道，就不會把榮耀的主釘上十字架了。 None of the rulers of this age knew it, for if they had known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
9. 然而正如經上所記： 「神為愛他的人所預備的， 是眼睛沒有見過，耳朵沒有聽過， 人心也沒有想過的。」 But as it is written: What no eye has seen and no ear has heard, and what has never come into a man's heart, is what God has prepared for those who love Him.
10. 但是神卻藉著 聖靈向我們啟示了，因為聖靈洞察一切，甚至洞察神深奧的事。 Now God has revealed them to us by the Spirit, for the Spirit searches everything, even the deep things of God.
11. 除了人裡面的靈，到底誰知道人的事呢？照樣，除了神的靈，也沒有人知道神的事。 For who among men knows the concerns of a man except the spirit of the man that is in him? In the same way, no one knows the concerns of God except the Spirit of God.
12. 我們所領受的，不是這世界的靈，而是從神而來的靈，好讓我們能知道神所賜給我們的這些事； Now we have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, in order to know what has been freely given to us by God.
13. 並且我們傳講這些事，不是用人的智慧所教導的話語，而是用聖靈所教導的話語，用屬靈的來對比屬靈的。 We also speak these things, not in words taught by human wisdom, but in those taught by the Spirit, explaining spiritual things to spiritual people.
14. 不過一個屬血氣的人不接受屬神的靈的這些事，因為對他來說，這些是愚拙的；他也不能明白，因為這些事要用屬靈的方式才能洞察。 But the natural man does not welcome what comes from God's Spirit, because it is foolishness to him; he is not able to know it since it is evaluated spiritually.
15. 屬靈的人能洞察一切，但是沒有人能洞察他。 The spiritual person, however, can evaluate everything, yet he himself cannot be evaluated by anyone.
16. 「到底誰曾知道主的心意？ 到底誰將教導他呢？」 但是我們有基督的心意了。 For: who has known the Lord's mind, that he may instruct Him? But we have the mind of Christ.
1 Corinthians 3
1. 弟兄們，以往我對你們說話，不能把你們當做屬靈的，只能當做屬肉體的，當做在基督裡的小孩子。 Brothers, I was not able to speak to you as spiritual people but as people of the flesh, as babies in Christ.
2. 我餵給你們吃的是奶，不是飯，原來你們那時還不能吃飯——其實現在也還是不能， I fed you milk, not solid food, because you were not yet able to receive it. In fact, you are still not able,
3. 因為你們仍然是屬肉體的。既然你們中間有嫉妒、紛爭和分裂，難道你們不就是屬肉體的，按人的意思來行事的嗎？ because you are still fleshly. For since there is envy and strife among you, are you not fleshly and living like ordinary people?
4. 當有人說：「我是屬 保羅 的」，另有人說：「我是屬 阿波羅 的」時候，難道你們不就是屬肉體的 嗎？ For whenever someone says, "I'm with Paul," and another, "I'm with Apollos," are you not [typical] men?
5. 其實 阿波羅 算什麼？ 保羅 算什麼？都是僕人 ；藉著他們，你們信了，是照著主所賜給每個人的。 So, what is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, and each has the role the Lord has given.
6. 我栽種了， 阿波羅 澆灌了，然而使之生長的還是神。 I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth.
7. 所以，除了使之生長的神，那栽種的和那澆灌的都算不得什麼。 So then neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but only God who gives the growth.
8. 栽種的和澆灌的都一樣，只是將來每個人要照著自己的勞苦得自己的報償。 Now the one who plants and the one who waters are equal, and each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
9. 實際上，我們是神的同工；你們是神的田地，是神的建築物。 For we are God's co-workers. You are God's field, God's building.
10. 我照著神賜給我的恩典，像一個有智慧的建築師，立好了根基，然後別人在上面建造；只是每個人應該當心怎樣在上面建造， According to God's grace that was given to me, as a skilled master builder I have laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But each one must be careful how he builds on it,
11. 因為除了那已經立好的根基以外，沒有人能立別的；那根基就是耶穌基督。 because no one can lay any other foundation than what has been laid-- that is, Jesus Christ.
12. 如果有人用金、銀、寶石，木、草、禾秸在那根基上建造， If anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,
13. 每個人的工程將來要顯露，因為那日子 要把它顯明；原來它要被火顯現出來，這火要考驗每個人的工程是怎樣的。 each one's work will become obvious, for the day will disclose it, because it will be revealed by fire; the fire will test the quality of each one's work.
14. 如果有人在那根基 上面所建造的工程能存留得住，這個人就將得到報償； If anyone's work that he has built survives, he will receive a reward.
15. 如果有人的工程被燒掉，他就將受到損失，而他自己卻將得救，但是會像從火裡經過的那樣。 If anyone's work is burned up, it will be lost, but he will be saved; yet it will be like an escape through fire.
16. 你們難道不知道自己就是神的聖所，而且神的靈住在你們裡面嗎？ Don't you know that you are God's sanctuary and that the Spirit of God lives in you?
17. 如果有人毀壞 神的聖所，神就要毀壞 這個人，因為神的聖所是聖潔的，這聖所就是你們。 If anyone ruins God's sanctuary, God will ruin him; for God's sanctuary is holy, and that is what you are.
18. 誰都不可自欺！如果你們中間有人自以為在這個世代中是有智慧的，他就應該變為愚拙，好成為有智慧的， No one should deceive himself. If anyone among you thinks he is wise in this age, he must become foolish so that he can become wise.
19. 因為在神看來，這世界的智慧就是愚拙；原來經上記著： 「神使智慧人落入自己的詭計中」 ； For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God, since it is written: He catches the wise in their craftiness--
20. 又說： 「主知道智慧人的思想是虛妄的。」 and again, The Lord knows the reasonings of the wise, that they are futile.
21. 所以誰都不要以人誇耀；要知道，一切都屬於你們： So no one should boast in men, for all things are yours:
22. 無論是 保羅 、是 阿波羅 、是 磯法 、是世界、是生、是死、是現在的事、是將來的事，全都屬於你們； whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or things present or things to come-- all are yours,
23. 而你們屬於基督，基督屬於神。 and you belong to Christ, and Christ to God.
1 Corinthians 4
1. 這樣，人應該把我們看做是基督的僕人、神奧祕之事的管家。 A person should consider us in this way: as servants of Christ and managers of God's mysteries.
2. 在這裡，進一步要求管家們的是，各人都要被看做是忠心的。 In this regard, it is expected of managers that each one be found faithful.
3. 至於我被你們評斷，或被人審判，對我都是極小的事。其實連我自己也不評斷自己。 It is of little importance that I should be evaluated by you or by a human court. In fact, I don't even evaluate myself.
4. 我誠然問心無愧，但也並不因此被稱為義，原來評斷我的是主。 For I am not conscious of anything against myself, but I am not justified by this. The One who evaluates me is the Lord.
5. 所以時候沒有到，在主來臨之前，不要評斷任何事；主將照亮黑暗中隱祕的事，顯明人心裡的計劃。那時候，稱讚將從神那裡臨到各人。 Therefore don't judge anything prematurely, before the Lord comes, who will both bring to light what is hidden in darkness and reveal the intentions of the hearts. And then praise will come to each one from God.
6. 弟兄們，我把這些事應用到我和 阿波羅 身上，是為了你們的緣故，好讓你們從我們學到「不要超越經上所記的」，免得你們自我膨脹，抬高這個人，貶低那個人。 Now, brothers, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us the saying: "Nothing beyond what is written." The purpose is that none of you will be inflated with pride in favor of one person over another.
7. 使你與別人 不同的到底是誰呢？你有什麼不是領受的呢？如果真是領受的，你為什麼還自誇，好像不是領受的呢？ For who makes you so superior? What do you have that you didn't receive? If, in fact, you did receive it, why do you boast as if you hadn't received it?
8. 你們已經飽足了，已經富有了，沒有我們，自己就做王了！我真希望你們真做王，好讓我們也與你們一同做王！ Already you are full! Already you are rich! You have begun to reign as kings without us-- and I wish you did reign, so that we also could reign with you!
9. 其實我在想，神把我們做使徒的列在最後，好像被定死罪的人；原來我們成了給宇宙 、天使、世人的一臺戲。 For I think God has displayed us, the apostles, in last place, like men condemned to die: we have become a spectacle to the world and to angels and to men.
10. 我們為基督的緣故是愚拙的，你們在基督裡倒是聰明的；我們軟弱，你們倒強壯；你們有榮耀，我們倒不受尊重。 We are fools for Christ, but you are wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are distinguished, but we are dishonored!
11. 直到現在這時刻，我們還是又飢又渴，衣不蔽體，被人毆打，居無定所， Up to the present hour we are both hungry and thirsty; we are poorly clothed, roughly treated, homeless;
12. 並且親手勞苦做工。被人辱罵，我們就祝福；被人逼迫，我們就容忍； we labor, working with our own hands. When we are reviled, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;
13. 受到毀謗，我們就勸導。我們被當做世界的垃圾、萬人的渣滓，直到如今。 when we are slandered, we entreat. We are, even now, like the world's garbage, like the filth of all things.
14. 我寫這些，不是要你們感到羞愧，而是把你們當做我親愛的兒女來勸誡。 I'm not writing this to shame you, but to warn you as my dear children.
15. 其實就算你們在基督裡有上萬的導師，卻沒有很多的父親，因為是我在基督耶穌裡藉著福音生了你們。 For you can have 10,000 instructors in Christ, but you can't have many fathers. Now I have fathered you in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
16. 所以我勸你們：當效法我。 Therefore I urge you, be imitators of me.
17. 為了這緣故，我派 提摩太 到你們那裡去。他是我在主裡又親愛又忠心的兒子，他會使你們想起我在基督耶穌裡的行事為人，正如我在各處、各教會中所教導的。 This is why I have sent to you Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you about my ways in Christ Jesus, just as I teach everywhere in every church.
18. 有些人以為我不會到你們那裡去，他們就自我膨脹。 Now some are inflated with pride, as though I were not coming to you.
19. 但如果主願意，我不久就會到你們那裡去；那時候，我所要知道的不是那些自我膨脹之人的話語，而是他們的權能， But I will come to you soon, if the Lord wills, and I will know not the talk but the power of those who are inflated with pride.
20. 因為神的國不在於話語，而在於權能。 For the kingdom of God is not in talk but in power.
21. 你們要什麼呢？要我帶著權杖，還是要我帶著愛和溫柔的心靈到你們那裡去呢？ What do you want? Should I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
1 Corinthians 5
1. 到處都有消息說你們中間有淫亂，並且這樣的淫亂連外邦人中也沒有——竟然有人與他的繼母同居 。 It is widely reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and the kind of sexual immorality that is not even condoned among the Gentiles-- a man is living with his father's wife.
2. 你們卻還自我膨脹！難道你們不更應該悲傷，讓做這事的人從你們裡面被除去嗎？ And you are inflated with pride, instead of filled with grief so that he who has committed this act might be removed from among you.
3. 要知道，我雖然身體不在你們那裡，但靈裡卻在你們那裡；我已經像在你們那裡一樣審判了做這事的人。 For though absent in body but present in spirit, I have already decided about him who has done this thing as though I were present.
4. 當你們聚集，與我的靈和我們主耶穌 的權能同在的時候，你們要奉我們主耶穌的名， In the name of our Lord Jesus, when you are assembled, along with my spirit and with the power of our Lord Jesus,
5. 把這樣的人交給 撒旦，使他的肉體毀滅，好讓他的靈魂在主 的日子 可以得救。 turn that one over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved in the Day of the Lord.
6. 你們誇耀是不好的。難道你們不知道，一點點酵母能使整個麵團發酵嗎？ Your boasting is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast permeates the whole batch of dough?
7. 你們應當把那舊的酵母除淨，好使你們成為新的麵團，就像你們是無酵的那樣；因為實際上，我們逾越節的羔羊——基督已經 被獻上 了。 Clean out the old yeast so that you may be a new batch, since you are unleavened. For Christ our Passover has been sacrificed.
8. 所以讓我們來守這節，不可用舊的酵母，也不可用惡毒、惡意的酵母，而要用真誠、真實的無酵餅。 Therefore, let us observe the feast, not with old yeast, or with the yeast of malice and evil, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
9. 我以前在書信上給你們寫過：不可與淫亂的人交往。 I wrote to you in a letter not to associate with sexually immoral people--
10. 我當然不是指這世上淫亂的、或貪心的、或勒索人的、或拜偶像的，否則，你們就必須離開這個世界了。 by no means referring to this world's immoral people, or to the greedy and swindlers, or to idolaters; otherwise you would have to leave the world.
11. 但如今我寫給你們的是：如果有人被稱為弟兄，卻是淫亂的、或貪心的、或拜偶像的、或誹謗人的、或酗酒的、或勒索人的，你們不可與他交往，連與這樣的人一起吃飯都不可。 But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who bears the name of brother who is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a reviler, a drunkard or a swindler. Do not even eat with such a person.
12. 其實審判外面的人，到底與我有什麼關係呢？你們難道不該審判裡面的人嗎？ For what is it to me to judge outsiders? Do you not judge those who are inside?
13. 至於外面的人，神會審判他們；而 「你們應當把那邪惡的人從你們裡面除去。」 But God judges outsiders. Put away the evil person from among yourselves.
1 Corinthians 6
1. 你們中間，當一個與另一個有了問題，怎麼敢告到不義的人面前，而不告到聖徒面前呢？ Does any of you who has a complaint against someone dare go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
2. 難道你們不知道，聖徒將要審判這世界嗎？如果連世界都要被你們審判，難道你們還不配審理這些最小的事嗎？ Or do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest cases?
3. 難道你們不知道，我們將要審判天使嗎？更何況今生的事呢！ Do you not know that we will judge angels-- not to speak of things pertaining to this life?
4. 因此，你們如果真有今生的事要審理，難道讓被教會所藐視的這些人來審嗎？ So if you have cases pertaining to this life, do you select those who have no standing in the church to judge?
5. 我說這話，是為了使你們羞愧。難道你們中間沒有一個智慧人，能在他的弟兄之間分辨是非嗎？ I say this to your shame! Can it be that there is not one wise person among you who will be able to arbitrate between his brothers?
6. 你們竟然弟兄控告弟兄，而且告到了不信的人面前！ Instead, brother goes to law against brother, and that before unbelievers!
7. 所以，你們彼此告狀，對你們已經是一個全然的失敗。你們為什麼不情願受委屈呢？為什麼不情願受虧負呢？ Therefore, it is already a total defeat for you that you have lawsuits against one another. Why not rather put up with injustice? Why not rather be cheated?
8. 然而你們卻委屈人、虧負人，況且這是對你們的弟兄！ Instead, you act unjustly and cheat-- and this to brothers!
9. 難道你們不知道，不義的人不會繼承神的國嗎？不要被迷惑了！無論是淫亂的、拜偶像的、通姦的、做孌童的、同性戀的、 Do you not know that the unjust will not inherit God's kingdom? Do not be deceived: no sexually immoral people, idolaters, adulterers, male prostitutes, homosexuals,
10. 偷竊的、貪心的、酗酒的、誹謗人的、勒索人的，都不會繼承神的國。 thieves, greedy people, drunkards, revilers, or swindlers will inherit God's kingdom.
11. 你們有些人過去是這樣，但是藉著主耶穌基督的名，藉著我們神的靈，你們已經被洗淨了，被分別為聖了，被稱為義了。 Some of you were like this; but you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
12. 「什麼事我都可以做」，但不都有益處；「什麼事我都可以做」，但我卻不受任何事的轄制。 "Everything is permissible for me," but not everything is helpful. "Everything is permissible for me," but I will not be brought under the control of anything.
13. 「食物是為了肚子，肚子是為了食物」，但神將要把這兩樣都廢除。身體不是為了淫亂，而是為了主；主也是為了身體。 "Foods for the stomach and the stomach for foods," but God will do away with both of them. The body is not for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
14. 神不但使主復活了，也將藉著自己的大能使我們復活。 God raised up the Lord and will also raise us up by His power.
15. 難道你們不知道，你們的身體就是基督的肢體嗎？因此，我可以拿基督的肢體當做妓女的肢體嗎？絕對不可！ Do you not know that your bodies are the members of Christ? So should I take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? Absolutely not!
16. 難道你們不知道，那與妓女結合的，就是與她成為一體了嗎？因為經上說： 「兩個人就成為一體。」 Do you not know that anyone joined to a prostitute is one body with her? For it says, The two will become one flesh.
17. 然而，那與主聯合的，就是與主成為一靈。 But anyone joined to the Lord is one spirit with Him.
18. 你們要逃避淫亂。「人所犯的各樣罪都在身體以外」，只有那行淫亂的是對自己的身體犯罪。 Flee from sexual immorality! "Every sin a person can commit is outside the body," but the person who is sexually immoral sins against his own body.
19. 難道你們不知道，你們的身體就是聖靈的聖所嗎？這聖靈住在你們裡面，是你們從神領受的。你們不屬於自己， Do you not know that your body is a sanctuary of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
20. 因為你們是被重價贖回來的。所以，你們應當用自己的身體榮耀神 。 for you were bought at a price; therefore glorify God in your body.
1 Corinthians 7
1. 關於你們所寫 的事，你們說 「男人不碰女人是好事 」； About the things you wrote: "It is good for a man not to have relations with a woman."
2. 不過為了避免 淫亂的事，每個男人都應當有自己的妻子，每個女人也應當有自己的丈夫。 But because of sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman should have her own husband.
3. 丈夫對妻子應當盡自己的本分，妻子對丈夫也應當如此。 A husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise a wife to her husband.
4. 妻子對自己的身體沒有主權，這主權在丈夫；同樣，丈夫對自己的身體也沒有主權，這主權在妻子。 A wife does not have authority over her own body, but her husband does. Equally, a husband does not have authority over his own body, but his wife does.
5. 夫妻同房 不可拒絕對方，除非為了有一段時間專心 禱告；然後仍要在一起，免得 撒旦 趁著你們不能自制而試探你們。 Do not deprive one another-- except when you agree, for a time, to devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again; otherwise, Satan may tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
6. 不過我說這話是出於容忍，而不是出於命令。 I say this as a concession, not as a command.
7. 我希望所有的人也都像我一樣，但是每個人自己都有從神而來的恩賜：有人是這樣，有人是那樣。 I wish that all people were just like me. But each has his own gift from God, one this and another that.
8. 我對沒有結婚的人和寡婦說，如果他們能像我一樣保持現狀，對他們來說是好事。 I say to the unmarried and to widows: It is good for them if they remain as I am.
9. 但如果他們不能自制，就應該結婚，因為結婚總比心如火燒更好。 But if they do not have self-control, they should marry, for it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
10. 至於對那些已經結婚的人，我吩咐——其實不是我，而是主吩咐：妻子不可離開丈夫； I command the married-- not I, but the Lord-- a wife is not to leave her husband.
11. 但如果還是離開了，就應當守身不嫁，或者與丈夫和好。丈夫也不可離棄妻子。 But if she does leave, she must remain unmarried or be reconciled to her husband-- and a husband is not to leave his wife.
12. 對其餘的人，我說——不是主說：如果某個弟兄有不信的妻子，而妻子情願與他一起生活，他就不可離棄妻子； But to the rest I, not the Lord, say: If any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is willing to live with him, he must not leave her.
13. 同樣，如果妻子有不信的丈夫，而丈夫情願與她一起生活，她也不可離棄丈夫， Also, if any woman has an unbelieving husband, and he is willing to live with her, she must not leave her husband.
14. 因為那不信的丈夫因著妻子就得以聖潔了；而那不信的妻子也因著丈夫得以聖潔了；否則，你們的兒女就是不潔淨的；但如今他們是聖潔的。 For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the Christian husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
15. 可是如果那不信的一方要離開，就讓他離開吧。在這樣的事上，那弟兄或姐妹就不受束縛了。不過神召喚了我們，是要我們和睦。 But if the unbeliever leaves, let him leave. A brother or a sister is not bound in such cases. God has called you to peace.
16. 做妻子的啊，你到底怎麼知道將來是否救你的丈夫呢？做丈夫的啊，你怎麼知道將來是否救你的妻子呢？ For you, wife, how do you know whether you will save your husband? Or you, husband, how do you know whether you will save your wife?
17. 只是當照著主 所分給每個人的，以及神 所召喚每個人的去行事。我在各教會中也是這樣吩咐的。 However, each one must live his life in the situation the Lord assigned when God called him. This is what I command in all the churches.
18. 如果一個人蒙召的時候已經受了割禮，就不應該取消割禮的記號；如果一個人蒙召的時候沒有受割禮，就不應該受割禮。 Was anyone already circumcised when he was called? He should not undo his circumcision. Was anyone called while uncircumcised? He should not get circumcised.
19. 受割禮不重要，不受割禮也不重要，重要的是遵守神的命令。 Circumcision does not matter and uncircumcision does not matter, but keeping God's commandments does.
20. 每個人在蒙了召喚的時候怎樣，他就應當保持怎樣。 Each person should remain in the life situation in which he was called.
21. 你蒙召的時候是做奴僕的嗎？你不要介意。但如果你真的能成為自由人，還是要把握機會。 Were you called while a slave? It should not be a concern to you. But if you can become free, by all means take the opportunity.
22. 要知道，做奴僕時在主裡蒙召的，就是主的自由人；同樣，做自由人時蒙召的，就是基督的奴僕。 For he who is called by the Lord as a slave is the Lord's freedman. Likewise he who is called as a free man is Christ's slave.
23. 你們是被重價贖回來的，不要成為人的奴僕。 You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.
24. 弟兄們，你們每個人蒙召的時候怎樣，在神面前就應當保持怎樣。 Brothers, each person should remain with God in whatever situation he was called.
25. 關於童貞的女子，我沒有從主而來的命令，但是我既然蒙主的憐憫成為忠心的人，我就提供意見。 About virgins: I have no command from the Lord, but I do give an opinion as one who by the Lord's mercy is trustworthy.
26. 實際上，由於現今的艱難，我認為一個人保持現狀是合宜的，這才是好的。 Therefore I consider this to be good because of the present distress: it is fine for a man to stay as he is.
27. 你已經有妻子約束著，就不要尋求擺脫；你沒有妻子束縛著，就不要尋求妻子。 Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be loosed. Are you loosed from a wife? Do not seek a wife.
28. 不過你如果還是要結婚，並不是犯罪；童貞女子如果結婚，也不是犯罪。不過這樣的人在今生 將要受患難，而我顧惜你們。 However, if you do get married, you have not sinned, and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But such people will have trouble in this life, and I am trying to spare you.
29. 弟兄們，我要說這一點：時候不多了 ！從此有妻子的，要像沒有妻子的； And I say this, brothers: the time is limited, so from now on those who have wives should be as though they had none,
30. 哭泣的，要像沒有哭泣的；快樂的，要像沒有快樂的；買了東西的，要像沒有什麼的； those who weep as though they did not weep, those who rejoice as though they did not rejoice, those who buy as though they did not possess,
31. 利用世界的，要像沒有充分利用世界的；因為這世界的形態正在消逝。 and those who use the world as though they did not make full use of it. For this world in its current form is passing away.
32. 我希望你們一無掛慮。沒有結婚的男人所掛慮的是主的事，是要怎樣討主的喜悅； I want you to be without concerns. An unmarried man is concerned about the things of the Lord-- how he may please the Lord.
33. 而結了婚的男人所掛慮的是世界的事，是要怎樣討妻子的喜悅， But a married man is concerned about the things of the world-- how he may please his wife--
34. 這樣他就分心了。未婚女子和童貞女子掛慮主的事，以致身體和心靈都得以聖潔；而結了婚的婦女掛慮世界的事，是要怎樣討丈夫的喜悅。 and he is divided. An unmarried woman or a virgin is concerned about the things of the Lord, so that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But a married woman is concerned about the things of the world-- how she may please her husband.
35. 我說這話是為了你們自己的益處，不是要給你們套上牢籠，而是要你們行事合宜，毫無分心地殷勤服事主。 Now I am saying this for your own benefit, not to put a restraint on you, but because of what is proper, and so that you may be devoted to the Lord without distraction.
36. 但如果有人認為他對待自己的童貞女兒不合宜，而且女兒也過了花期，事情又該如此行，就當按著自己所願的去做——他並不是犯罪，應當讓兩個人結婚。 But if any man thinks he is acting improperly toward his virgin, if she is past marriageable age, and so it must be, he can do what he wants. He is not sinning; they can get married.
37. 但如果一個人自己心裡堅定不移，也不出於勉強，又對自己的意願有主權，並且自己心裡已經決定留下自己的童貞女兒，那麼他就做得好。 But he who stands firm in his heart (who is under no compulsion, but has control over his own will) and has decided in his heart to keep his own virgin, will do well.
38. 所以，那讓自己的童貞女兒結婚的，做得好；那沒有讓她結婚的，做得更好。 So then he who marries his virgin does well, but he who does not marry will do better.
39. 丈夫活著的時候，妻子是受約束的 ；丈夫如果死了，妻子就可以自由地嫁給她所願意的人，只是要嫁給主裡的人。 A wife is bound as long as her husband is living. But if her husband dies, she is free to be married to anyone she wants-- only in the Lord.
40. 但是照我的意見，如果她能保持現狀，就更蒙福了。我想我也有神的靈。 But she is happier if she remains as she is, in my opinion. And I think that I also have the Spirit of God.
1 Corinthians 8
1. 關於祭過偶像的食物，我們知道「我們都有知識。」知識使人自我膨脹，但是愛能造就人。 About food offered to idols: We know that "we all have knowledge." Knowledge inflates with pride, but love builds up.
2. 如果有人自以為知道了什麼，照著應該知道的，他還是不知道。 If anyone thinks he knows anything, he does not yet know it as he ought to know it.
3. 但如果有人愛神，這個人就是神所知道的。 But if anyone loves God, he is known by Him.
4. 關於吃祭過偶像的食物，我們知道「世界上的偶像是虛無的」，也知道「除了神一位之外，沒有別的神。」 About eating food offered to idols, then, we know that "an idol is nothing in the world," and that "there is no God but one."
5. 因為，就算真有所謂的神明——無論在天上或在地上，好像有許多的「神」和許多的「主」—— For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth-- as there are many "gods" and many "lords"--
6. 但對我們來說， 只有一位神，就是父， 萬有都出於他，我們也歸於他； 並且只有一位主，就是耶穌基督， 萬有都藉著他而有，我們也藉著他而有。 yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things, and we for Him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we through Him.
7. 然而，不是所有的人都有這知識。有些人因習慣了偶像，至今還以為所吃的是祭過偶像的食物。他們的良心因為軟弱，就被玷汙了。 However, not everyone has this knowledge. In fact, some have been so used to idolatry up until now, that when they eat food offered to an idol, their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
8. 其實食物不能使我們接近神；我們如果不吃也不會缺少什麼，吃了也不會增加什麼。 Food will not make us acceptable to God. We are not inferior if we don't eat, and we are not better if we do eat.
9. 不過要當心，免得你們的這權利成了軟弱之人的絆跌物。 But be careful that this right of yours in no way becomes a stumbling block to the weak.
10. 因為，如果有人看見你這有知識的人在偶像的廟裡坐席，難道不就鼓勵了他軟弱的良心，使他也去吃那祭過偶像的食物嗎？ For if somebody sees you, the one who has this knowledge, dining in an idol's temple, won't his weak conscience be encouraged to eat food offered to idols?
11. 這樣，那軟弱的人，就是基督為他而死的那弟兄，就會因你的知識被毀了。 Then the weak person, the brother for whom Christ died, is ruined by your knowledge.
12. 當你們這樣對弟兄犯罪，打擊他們軟弱良心的時候，就是對基督犯罪。 Now when you sin like this against the brothers and wound their weak conscience, you are sinning against Christ.
13. 所以，如果食物使我的弟兄絆倒，我就絕不吃肉 直到永遠，免得使我的弟兄絆倒。 Therefore, if food causes my brother to fall, I will never again eat meat, so that I won't cause my brother to fall.
1 Corinthians 9
1. 我不是自由的嗎？我不是使徒嗎？我不是看到我們的主耶穌 嗎？你們不是我在主裡的工作嗎？ Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
2. 即使我對別人不是使徒，但至少對你們還是使徒，因為你們是我在主裡做使徒的印證。 If I am not an apostle to others, at least I am to you, for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
3. 對那些評斷我的人，我的辯護是這樣的： My defense to those who examine me is this:
4. 難道我們沒有權利吃喝嗎？ Don't we have the right to eat and drink?
5. 難道我們沒有權利像其他的使徒，像主的弟弟們，像 磯法 那樣，也帶著信主的妻子 一同往來嗎？ Don't we have the right to be accompanied by a Christian wife, like the other apostles, the Lord's brothers, and Cephas?
6. 難道只有我和 巴拿巴 沒有不做工的權利嗎？ Or is it only Barnabas and I who have no right to refrain from working?
7. 曾經有誰當兵自備糧餉呢？有誰栽種葡萄園不吃園中的果子呢？有誰牧養羊群不喝羊群的奶呢？ Who ever goes to war at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat its fruit? Or who shepherds a flock and does not drink the milk from the flock?
8. 我說這些話，難道是按人的意思嗎？律法不也是說這些話嗎？ Am I saying this from a human perspective? Doesn't the law also say the same thing?
9. 事實上， 摩西 的律法上記著： 「牛踹穀的時候，不可籠住牠的嘴。」 難道神顧念的是牛嗎？ For it is written in the law of Moses, Do not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain. Is God really concerned with oxen?
10. 還是特別為我們說的呢？這樣寫下來，當然是為我們的緣故！因為耕田的應該懷著希望去耕田，打場的應該懷著一同分享糧食 的希望去打場。 Or isn't He really saying it for us? Yes, this is written for us, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes should do so in hope of sharing the crop.
11. 既然我們為你們播下了屬靈的種子，那麼，如果我們從你們收取物質上的東西，這算過份嗎？ If we have sown spiritual things for you, is it too much if we reap material things from you?
12. 如果別人能從你們那裡分享這權利，我們不是更能分享嗎？ 然而，我們並沒有用過這權利，反而凡事包容，免得給基督的福音帶來阻礙。 If others share this authority over you, don't we even more? However, we have not used this authority; instead we endure everything so that we will not hinder the gospel of Christ.
13. 難道你們不知道，在聖殿供職的人，都吃聖殿中的食物；侍候祭壇的人，都一同享用祭壇上的供物嗎？ Do you not know that those who perform the temple services eat the food from the temple, and those who serve at the altar share in the offerings of the altar?
14. 照樣，主也吩咐那些傳福音的人，靠福音生活。 In the same way, the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should earn their living by the gospel.
15. 但是，這些權利我一個也沒有用過。我寫這些並不是要人這樣對待我，因為我寧願死，也不願意任何人使我所誇耀的落了空。 But I have used none of these rights, and I have not written this to make it happen that way for me. For it would be better for me to die than for anyone to deprive me of my boast!
16. 原來，就算我傳福音，也沒有可誇耀的，因為傳福音的需要催逼著我；我如果不傳福音，我就有禍了； For if I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because an obligation is placed on me. And woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
17. 如果我自願做這事，就有報償；如果我不自願，這任務 也已經委託給我了。 For if I do this willingly, I have a reward; but if unwillingly, I am entrusted with a stewardship.
18. 那麼，我的報償到底是什麼呢？就是：我傳福音的時候，能免費地提供福音，好使我不會充分利用在福音工作上屬自己的權利。 What then is my reward? To preach the gospel and offer it free of charge, and not make full use of my authority in the gospel.
19. 我誠然是自由的，不屬於任何人，但我使自己成為所有人的奴僕，為了贏得更多的人。 For although I am free from all people, I have made myself a slave to all, in order to win more people.
20. 對 猶太 人，我就成為一個像 猶太 人那樣的人，為了贏得 猶太 人；對律法之下的人，雖然我自己不在律法之下， 我卻成為一個像是在律法之下的人，為了贏得在律法之下的人； To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win Jews; to those under the law, like one under the law-- though I myself am not under the law-- to win those under the law.
21. 對沒有律法的人，我就成為一個像是沒有律法的人那樣，為了贏得沒有律法的人——對神，我不是沒有律法的，而是在基督的律法之下。 To those who are outside the law, like one outside the law-- not being outside God's law, but under the law of Christ-- to win those outside the law.
22. 對軟弱的人，我就成為軟弱的人，為了贏得軟弱的人。對什麼樣的人，我就成為什麼樣的人，一定要拯救一些人。 To the weak I became weak, in order to win the weak. I have become all things to all people, so that I may by all means save some.
23. 並且我做這一切，都是為了福音的緣故，好使我能成為在福音上一同有份的人。 Now I do all this because of the gospel, that I may become a partner in its benefits.
24. 難道你們不知道，賽場上奔跑的人雖然都在跑，但是得獎的只有一個嗎？你們也應當這樣奔跑，好使你們得著獎賞。 Do you not know that the runners in a stadium all race, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may win.
25. 每一個參加比賽的人，都要在一切事上自制；不過他們這樣做是為了得到會朽壞的冠冕，而我們是為了得到不會朽壞的冠冕。 Now everyone who competes exercises self-control in everything. However, they do it to receive a perishable crown, but we an imperishable one.
26. 因此，我奔跑不像沒有目標的；我鬥拳不像打空氣的； Therefore I do not run like one who runs aimlessly, or box like one who beats the air.
27. 然而我不斷克制 自己的身體，使它服從我，免得我傳道給別人，自己反而經不起考驗了。 Instead, I discipline my body and bring it under strict control, so that after preaching to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
1 Corinthians 10
1. 弟兄們，我不願意你們不明白：我們的祖先曾經都在那雲彩之下，都從那海中經過， Now I want you to know, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, all passed through the sea,
2. 並且都在那雲裡和海裡受洗歸於 摩西 。 and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
3. 他們都吃了同樣的屬靈食物， They all ate the same spiritual food,
4. 也都喝了同樣的屬靈之水。原來他們所喝的是出於那隨著他們的屬靈磐石；那磐石就是基督。 and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from a spiritual rock that followed them, and that rock was Christ.
5. 但是神不喜悅他們中的大多數人，所以他們倒斃在曠野。 But God was not pleased with most of them, for they were struck down in the desert.
6. 這些事的發生，是為了我們的鑒戒，好使我們不像他們成為貪戀惡事的人。 Now these things became examples for us, so that we will not desire evil as they did.
7. 你們也不可像他們中的有些人那樣，成為拜偶像的，正如經上所記： 「民眾坐下吃喝，起來玩樂。」 Don't become idolaters as some of them were; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and got up to play.
8. 我們也不可行淫亂，像他們中的有些人行淫亂，結果一天就倒斃了兩萬三千人。 Let us not commit sexual immorality as some of them did, and in a single day 23,000 people fell dead.
9. 我們也不可試探基督，像他們中的有些人試探了，結果就被蛇所滅。 Let us not tempt Christ as some of them did, and were destroyed by snakes.
10. 你們也不可抱怨，像他們中的有些人抱怨了，結果就被那毀滅者所滅。 Nor should we complain as some of them did, and were killed by the destroyer.
11. 這些事發生在他們身上，做為鑒戒；並且被記載下來，是為了警戒我們這些面臨萬世結局的人。 Now these things happened to them as examples, and they were written as a warning to us, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
12. 所以，那自以為站得住的，應該當心，免得跌倒。 Therefore, whoever thinks he stands must be careful not to fall!
13. 你們所遭受的試探，無非是人所遭受的。神是信實的，他不會讓你們受試探過於你們所能受的；而且在你們受試探的時候，他會給你們開一條出路，使你們能忍受得住。 No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to humanity. God is faithful and He will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation He will also provide a way of escape, so that you are able to bear it.
14. 所以，我親愛的各位，你們要逃避拜偶像的事。 Therefore, my dear friends, flee from idolatry.
15. 我就像對聰明人在說話；我所說的，你們應當自己判斷。 I am speaking as to wise people. Judge for yourselves what I say.
16. 我們所祝謝的福杯，難道不是在基督之血裡的一種契合嗎？我們所掰的餅，難道不是在基督身體裡的一種契合嗎？ The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a sharing in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a sharing in the body of Christ?
17. 這是因為餅只有一個，而我們這許多人是一個身體——就是說，我們全都共享這一個餅。 Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for all of us share that one bread.
18. 你們看世上的 以色列 人吧，難道那些吃祭物的人不是與祭壇有份的人嗎？ Look at the people of Israel. Are not those who eat the sacrifices partners in the altar?
19. 那麼，我怎麼說呢？難道說祭過偶像的食物算得了什麼嗎？或說，偶像算得了什麼嗎？ What am I saying then? That food offered to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
20. 不，我是說，外邦人 所獻的祭是獻給鬼魔的，不是獻給神的；而我不願意你們成為與鬼魔有份的人。 No, but I do say that what they sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God. I do not want you to be partners with demons!
21. 你們不能既喝主的杯，又喝鬼魔的杯；不能既吃主的筵席，又吃鬼魔的筵席。 You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You cannot share in the Lord's table and the table of demons.
22. 難道我們要激起主的嫉恨嗎？難道我們比他更強嗎？ Or are we provoking the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
23. 「什麼事都可以做」，但不都有益處；「什麼事都可以做」，但不都造就人。 "Everything is permissible," but not everything is helpful. "Everything is permissible," but not everything builds up.
24. 誰都不應當求自己的益處，而應當求別人的益處。 No one should seek his own [good], but [the good] of the other person.
25. 肉市上所賣的一切，你們都可以吃；不要為了良心的緣故而問什麼， Eat everything that is sold in the meat market, asking no questions for conscience' sake, for
26. 因為 「大地和其中的一切都屬於主。」 the earth is the Lord's, and all that is in it.
27. 如果有不信的人請你們吃飯，而你們也願意去，那麼，凡是擺在你們面前的都可以吃，不要為了良心的緣故而問什麼。 If one of the unbelievers invites you over and you want to go, eat everything that is set before you, without raising questions of conscience.
28. 但如果有人對你們說：「這是祭過偶像的食物」，那麼，為了那指明這事的人和良心的緣故，你們就不要吃 —— But if someone says to you, "This is food offered to an idol," do not eat it, out of consideration for the one who told you, and for conscience' sake.
29. 我說的良心不是你自己的，而是那個人的，因為我的自由何必被別人的良心評斷呢？ I do not mean your own conscience, but the other person's. For why is my freedom judged by another person's conscience?
30. 如果我懷著感恩的心領受，難道有什麼能使我為所感謝的東西而受到毀謗嗎？ If I partake with thanks, why am I slandered because of something for which I give thanks?
31. 因此，你們無論或吃、或喝、或做什麼，一切都要為神的榮耀而做。 Therefore, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do everything for God's glory.
32. 無論對 猶太 人、對外邦人，或對神的教會，你們都不可成為絆跌物； Give no offense to the Jews or the Greeks or the church of God,
33. 要像我那樣，也在一切事上使所有的人喜悅——不求自己的益處，而求多人的益處，好讓他們都能得救。 just as I also try to please all people in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
1 Corinthians 11
1. 你們要效法我，就像我效法基督一樣。 Be imitators of me, as I also am of Christ.
2. 我稱讚你們， 因為你們在一切事上都記念我，並且照著我所傳給你們的來持守傳統。 Now I praise you because you remember me in all things and keep the traditions just as I delivered them to you.
3. 但是我願你們知道：基督是每一個男人的頭，男人是女人的頭，而神是基督的頭。 But I want you to know that Christ is the head of every man, and the man is the head of the woman, and God is the head of Christ.
4. 凡是男人在禱告或做先知傳道 的時候，如果蒙著頭，就是羞辱自己的頭； Every man who prays or prophesies with something on his head dishonors his head.
5. 凡是女人在禱告或做先知傳道的時候，如果不蒙著頭，就是羞辱自己的頭，因為這與頭髮被剃掉了是同樣一件事。 But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, since that is one and the same as having her head shaved.
6. 要知道，女人如果不遮蓋自己，她就應該連頭髮也剪掉；但既然女人剪掉頭髮或剃掉頭髮是可恥的，她就應該遮蓋自己 。 So if a woman's head is not covered, her hair should be cut off. But if it is disgraceful for a woman to have her hair cut off or her head shaved, she should be covered.
7. 男人本來不應該遮蓋著頭，因為他是神的形像和榮耀，而女人是男人的榮耀。 A man, in fact, should not cover his head, because he is God's image and glory, but woman is man's glory.
8. 原來男人不是由女人而出，女人卻是由男人而出； For man did not come from woman, but woman came from man;
9. 並且男人不是為女人而造，女人卻是為男人而造。 and man was not created for woman, but woman for man.
10. 因此，為了天使的緣故，應該有權柄 在女人的頭之上。 This is why a woman should have [a symbol of] authority on her head: because of the angels.
11. 不過在主裡，沒有女人就沒有男人，沒有男人也就沒有女人。 However, in the Lord, woman is not independent of man, and man is not independent of woman.
12. 因為就像女人出於男人，照樣，男人也來自女人，而一切都是出於神。 For just as woman came from man, so man comes through woman, and all things come from God.
13. 你們自己判斷吧：女人不蒙著頭向神禱告是合宜的嗎？ Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
14. 人的本性不也教導你們：男人如果留長髮就是他的羞恥， Does not even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair it is a disgrace to him,
15. 而女人如果留長髮就是她的榮耀嗎？因為頭髮是賜給女人當做蓋頭的。 but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For her hair is given to her as a covering.
16. 但如果有人想爭辯，我們卻沒有這樣的慣例；神的各教會也沒有。 But if anyone wants to argue about this, we have no other custom, nor do the churches of God.
17. 現在我吩咐以下的事，並不是在稱讚你們，因為你們聚集所導致的不是更好，而是更糟。 Now in giving the following instruction I do not praise you, since you come together not for the better but for the worse.
18. 首先，我聽說你們做為一個教會聚集的時候，在你們中間有分裂，我也部分地相信這話。 For, to begin with, I hear that when you come together as a church there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
19. 實際上，你們當中必定也會有結派的事，好讓那些經過考驗的人在你們中間能顯露出來。 There must, indeed, be factions among you, so that the approved among you may be recognized.
20. 這樣說來，你們聚集在一起，所吃的並不是主的晚餐， Therefore when you come together in one place, it is not really to eat the Lord's Supper.
21. 因為你們吃的時候，每個人都爭先吃自己的晚餐，甚至有人餓著，有人醉了。 For in eating, each one takes his own supper ahead of others, and one person is hungry while another is drunk!
22. 難道你們沒有家，可以在那裡吃喝嗎？還是你們輕視神的教會，羞辱那些沒有什麼的人呢？我要對你們怎麼說呢？要稱讚你們嗎？在這事上，我不稱讚你們。 Don't you have houses to eat and drink in? Or do you look down on the church of God and embarrass those who have nothing? What should I say to you? Should I praise you? I do not praise you for this!
23. 我當時傳授給你們的是我從主所領受的：主耶穌在被出賣的那一夜，拿起餅來， For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: on the night when He was betrayed, the Lord Jesus took bread,
24. 祝謝了，就掰開，說： 「 這是我的身體，為了你們的緣故 ；你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。」 gave thanks, broke it, and said, "This is My body, which is for you. Do this in remembrance of Me."
25. 晚餐後，他也照樣拿起杯來，說： 「這杯是用我的血所立的新約。你們每逢喝的時候，應當如此行，為的是記念我。」 In the same way [He] also [took] the cup, after supper, and said, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood. Do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me."
26. 你們每逢吃這餅、喝這杯，就是傳揚主的死，直到主來。 For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until He comes.
27. 因此無論誰，不合宜地吃主的餅、喝主的杯，就是干犯主的身體、主的血。 Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy way will be guilty of sin against the body and blood of the Lord.
28. 這樣，一個人應當省察自己，然後才吃這餅、喝這杯。 So a man should examine himself; in this way he should eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
29. 因為那吃喝的人，如果不分辨主的 身體，就是吃喝對自己的懲罰了。 For whoever eats and drinks without recognizing the body, eats and drinks judgment on himself.
30. 為此，你們中間有很多人是軟弱的、患病的，甚至有許多人睡著了。 This is why many are sick and ill among you, and many have fallen asleep.
31. 但如果我們省察自己，就不會受懲罰； If we were properly evaluating ourselves, we would not be judged,
32. 即使我們受懲罰，也是在受主的管教，免得我們和這世界一同被定罪。 but when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, so that we may not be condemned with the world.
33. 所以我的弟兄們，你們聚集吃的時候，應當彼此等候。 Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
34. 如果有人餓了，就應當在家裡吃，免得你們聚集，反導致懲罰。至於其他的事，當我來的時候才吩咐。 If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that you can come together and not cause judgment. And I will give instructions about the other matters whenever I come.
1 Corinthians 12
1. 弟兄們，我不願意你們不明白有關屬靈的事。 About matters of the spirit: brothers, I do not want you to be unaware.
2. 你們知道，當你們還是外邦人的時候，是怎樣被引誘、被帶到那些不能說話的偶像那裡的。 You know how, when you were pagans, you were led to dumb idols-- being led astray.
3. 因此我要你們明白：藉著神的靈說話的，沒有一個人會說「耶穌該受詛咒」；同樣，如果不藉著聖靈，也沒有一個人能說：「耶穌是主。」 Therefore I am informing you that no one speaking by the Spirit of God says, "Jesus is cursed," and no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," except by the Holy Spirit.
4. 恩賜雖然有所不同，但聖靈卻是同一位； Now there are different gifts, but the same Spirit.
5. 服事工作雖然有所不同，但主卻是同一位； There are different ministries, but the same Lord.
6. 功用雖然有所不同，但在每個人裡面運作萬事的神卻是同一位。 And there are different activities, but the same God is active in everyone and everything.
7. 不過聖靈顯明在每個人的身上，是為了共同的益處，因為： A manifestation of the Spirit is given to each person to produce what is beneficial:
8. 有人藉著聖靈被賜予了智慧的話語， 又有人藉著同一位聖靈被賜予了知識的話語， to one is given a message of wisdom through the Spirit, to another, a message of knowledge by the same Spirit,
9. 另有人藉著同一位聖靈被賜予了信仰， 又有人藉著這獨一的 聖靈被賜予了使人痊癒的恩賜， to another, faith by the same Spirit, to another, gifts of healing by the one Spirit,
10. 又有人被賜予了大能的功用， 又有人被賜予了做先知傳道 的恩賜， 又有人被賜予了對不同靈的分辨力， 另有人被賜予了各種殊言， 又有人被賜予了翻譯殊言的恩賜 。 to another, the performing of miracles, to another, prophecy, to another, distinguishing between spirits, to another, different kinds of languages, to another, interpretation of languages.
11. 然而，這一切都是這同一位聖靈，就是獨一的聖靈所運作的；他照著自己的旨意，個別地分給每個人。 But one and the same Spirit is active in all these, distributing to each one as He wills.
12. 要知道，正如身體雖然是一個，卻有很多部分，而身體 的各部分雖然有很多，卻是一個身體；基督也是如此。 For as the body is one and has many parts, and all the parts of that body, though many, are one body-- so also is Christ.
13. 實際上，我們受洗也都是藉著一位聖靈成為一個身體——無論是 猶太 人或外邦人，無論是奴隸或自由人——並且我們都是受了一位聖靈的澆灌 。 For we were all baptized by one Spirit into one body-- whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free-- and we were all made to drink of one Spirit.
14. 這樣，身體也不是只有一個部分，而是有很多部分。 So the body is not one part but many.
15. 如果腳說：「因為我不是手，我就不屬於身體」，難道它因此就不屬於身體嗎？ If the foot should say, "Because I'm not a hand, I don't belong to the body," in spite of this it still belongs to the body.
16. 如果耳朵說：「因為我不是眼睛，我就不屬於身體」，難道它因此就不屬於身體嗎？ And if the ear should say, "Because I'm not an eye, I don't belong to the body," in spite of this it still belongs to the body.
17. 如果整個身體是個眼睛，那麼聽覺在哪裡呢？如果整個身體是個耳朵，那麼嗅覺在哪裡呢？ If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were an ear, where would be the sense of smell?
18. 所以現在神照著自己的意願，把各部分一一安置在身體上了。 But now God has placed the parts, each one of them, in the body just as He wanted.
19. 如果全都是一個部分，那麼身體在哪裡呢？ And if they were all the same part, where would the body be?
20. 但如今，身體的各部分雖然很多，身體卻是一個。 Now there are many parts, yet one body.
21. 所以眼睛不能對手說：「我不需要你！」頭也不能對兩腳說：「我不需要你們！」 So the eye cannot say to the hand, "I don't need you!" nor again the head to the feet, "I don't need you!"
22. 相反，身體上那些所謂比較軟弱的部分，難道不更是必要的嗎？ On the contrary, all the more, those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are necessary.
23. 並且身體上那些我們認為不太受尊重的部分，我們加添給它們格外的尊重；這樣我們不俊美的部分，就有了格外的俊美。 And those parts of the body that we think to be less honorable, we clothe these with greater honor, and our unpresentable parts have a better presentation.
24. 至於我們那些俊美的部分，就不需要加添什麼 了；而神搭配了身體，把格外的尊重賜給那有缺乏的， But our presentable parts have no need [of clothing]. Instead, God has put the body together, giving greater honor to the less honorable,
25. 免得身體中有分爭，好讓各部分彼此之間都有同樣的關顧。 so that there would be no division in the body, but that the members would have the same concern for each other.
26. 如果一個部分受苦，所有的部分就一同受苦；如果一個部分得榮耀，所有的部分就一同歡樂。 So if one member suffers, all the members suffer with it; if one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
27. 你們就是基督的身體，而且是各個部分中的一個。 Now you are the body of Christ, and individual members of it.
28. 在教會中，神所安排的： 首先是使徒，第二是做先知傳道的，第三是教師，然後是有大能的 ； 隨後是使人痊癒的恩賜、幫助的恩賜、管理的恩賜、各種殊言的恩賜。 And God has placed these in the church: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, next, miracles, then gifts of healing, helping, managing, various kinds of languages.
29. 難道都是使徒嗎？都是做先知傳道的嗎？ 都是教師嗎？都是有大能的 嗎？ Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all do miracles?
30. 都有使人痊癒的恩賜嗎？都說殊言嗎？ 都翻譯殊言嗎？ Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in languages? Do all interpret?
31. 其實你們要渴慕那些更大的恩賜；而我還要把極其高超的道 指示給你們。 But desire the greater gifts. And I will show you an even better way.
1 Corinthians 13
1. 如果我能說人間和天使的各種殊言，卻沒有愛， 我就成了嘈雜的鑼、鳴響的鈸； If I speak the languages of men and of angels, but do not have love, I am a sounding gong or a clanging cymbal.
2. 如果我有做先知傳道 的恩賜， 也明白一切奧祕、一切知識， 並有全備的信，以致能移山， 卻沒有愛，我就一無所是； If I have [the gift of] prophecy, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so that I can move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
3. 即使我把自己所擁有的一切分給窮人， 又捨棄自己的身體被人焚燒， 卻沒有愛，對我也毫無益處。 And if I donate all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but do not have love, I gain nothing.
4. 愛是恆久忍耐，又是仁慈； 愛是不嫉妒； 愛是不自誇、不自大； Love is patient; love is kind. Love does not envy; is not boastful; is not conceited;
5. 不做不合宜的事，不求自己的益處， 不輕易動怒，不計算人的惡， does not act improperly; is not selfish; is not provoked; does not keep a record of wrongs;
6. 不為不義歡喜，而與真理同樂； finds no joy in unrighteousness, but rejoices in the truth;
7. 凡事包容，凡事相信， 凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。 bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
8. 愛是永不止息； 而做先知傳道 的恩賜 將被廢除， 殊言也將會停止， 知識也將被廢除， Love never ends. But as for prophecies, they will come to an end; as for languages, they will cease; as for knowledge, it will come to an end.
9. 因為我們所知道的有限， 我們做先知所傳的 也有限； For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
10. 但那完全的來到時， 這有限的 就將被廢除。 But when the perfect comes, the partial will come to an end.
11. 當我做孩子的時候，說話像孩子， 心思像孩子，想法像孩子； 當我成人以後，就把那些屬孩子的事都廢除了； When I was a child, I spoke like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put aside childish things.
12. 如今我們對著鏡子觀看，模糊不清， 但那時候就要面對面了； 如今我所知道的有限， 但那時候就要完全知道了，就像我已經被完全知道那樣； For now we see indistinctly, as in a mirror, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, as I am fully known.
13. 所以現在常存的有信、望、愛這三樣； 而其中更大的是愛。 Now these three remain: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest of these is love.
1 Corinthians 14
1. 你們要追求愛，也要渴慕屬靈的事，但更要渴慕做先知傳道 。 Pursue love and desire spiritual gifts, and above all that you may prophesy.
2. 原來那說殊言 的，不是對人說，而是對神說，因為沒有人聽得懂；他是在靈裡講說各樣的奧祕。 For the person who speaks in [another] language is not speaking to men but to God, since no one understands him; however, he speaks mysteries in the Spirit.
3. 可是那做先知傳道的是對人說，為要造就、鼓勵和安慰人。 But the person who prophesies speaks to people for edification, encouragement, and consolation.
4. 那說殊言的是造就自己，但那做先知傳道的是造就教會。 The person who speaks in [another] language builds himself up, but he who prophesies builds up the church.
5. 我雖然希望你們都說殊言，但更希望你們都做先知傳道。因為，除非說殊言的能把殊言翻譯出來使教會得到造就，否則那做先知傳道的就比說殊言的更大了。 I wish all of you spoke in other languages, but even more that you prophesied. The person who prophesies is greater than the person who speaks in languages, unless he interprets so that the church may be built up.
6. 所以弟兄們，就算我現在到你們那裡去，用殊言說話，但如果不用啟示、知識、預言 、或教導來對你們說話，那麼我對你們有什麼益處呢？ But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in [other] languages, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you with a revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
7. 甚至是那些沒有生命卻能發出聲音的東西，例如笛子或豎琴，如果發出的音調沒有分別，怎麼能使人知道所吹所彈的是什麼呢？ Even inanimate things producing sounds-- whether flute or harp-- if they don't make a distinction in the notes, how will what is played on the flute or harp be recognized?
8. 實際上，如果號角發出的聲音真的不清楚，誰會準備好出戰呢？ In fact, if the trumpet makes an unclear sound, who will prepare for battle?
9. 照樣，如果你們用舌頭說出不可理解的話，那麼所說的怎麼能使人明白呢？這樣，你們就是向空氣說話了。 In the same way, unless you use your tongue for intelligible speech, how will what is spoken be known? For you will be speaking into the air.
10. 世界上也許有好多種語言，但沒有一種是沒有意思的。 There are doubtless many different kinds of languages in the world, and all have meaning.
11. 所以，如果我不明白那語言的意思，那麼，對於說話的人，我就是個外族人；對於我，那說話的人也是個外族人。 Therefore, if I do not know the meaning of the language, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker will be a foreigner to me.
12. 你們也是這樣：既然你們對屬靈的事 是熱心人，就應當追求造就教會的事，好讓你們能豐足有餘。 So also you-- since you are zealous in matters of the spirit, seek to excel in building up the church.
13. 所以，說殊言的人應當禱告，好讓自己能翻譯出來。 Therefore the person who speaks in [another] language should pray that he can interpret.
14. 如果我用殊言禱告，是我的靈在禱告，但我的理性卻是結不出果子的。 For if I pray in [another] language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
15. 那麼該怎麼辦呢？我要用靈禱告，也要用理性禱告；我要用靈歌頌，也要用理性歌頌。 What then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will also pray with my understanding. I will sing with the spirit, and I will also sing with my understanding.
16. 否則，如果你用靈祝謝，在場的那些不明白的人，既然不知道你在說什麼，怎麼能在你感謝的時候說「阿們」呢？ Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will the uninformed person say "Amen" at your giving of thanks, since he does not know what you are saying?
17. 因為你感謝的固然是好，但別人卻沒有得造就。 For you may very well be giving thanks, but the other person is not being built up.
18. 我感謝神，我說殊言比你們所有人都多； I thank God that I speak in [other] languages more than all of you;
19. 但是在教會裡，為了要教導別人，我寧願用我的理性說五句話，也不願用殊言說萬句話。 yet in the church I would rather speak five words with my understanding, in order to teach others also, than 10,000 words in [another] language.
20. 弟兄們，你們在思想上不要做小孩子，但是在惡事上要做嬰孩，在思想上要做成熟的人 。 Brothers, don't be childish in your thinking, but be infants in evil and adult in your thinking.
21. 律法書上記著：「主說： 『我要藉著說別種語言的人， 藉著別人的嘴唇對這子民說話。 即使這樣，他們也不會聽我的。』 」 It is written in the law: By people of other languages and by the lips of foreigners, I will speak to this people; and even then, they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.
22. 這樣，說殊言不是給信的人做為標記，而是給不信的人；但做先知傳道 不是給不信的人做為標記，而是給信的人。 It follows that speaking in other languages is intended as a sign, not to believers but to unbelievers. But prophecy is not for unbelievers but for believers.
23. 所以，如果全教會聚集在一起，大家都說殊言，有不明白殊言的，或不信的人進來，他們難道不會說你們都瘋了嗎？ Therefore if the whole church assembles together, and all are speaking in [other] languages, and people who are uninformed or unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
24. 但如果大家都做先知傳道，有一個不信的或不明白的人進來，他就會因這一切而知罪、受到責問， But if all are prophesying, and some unbeliever or uninformed person comes in, he is convicted by all and is judged by all.
25. 他心中隱祕的事就會顯露出來。這樣，他就會把臉伏在地上敬拜神，承認說：「神真的是在你們中間！」 The secrets of his heart will be revealed, and as a result he will fall down on his face and worship God, proclaiming, "God is really among you."
26. 弟兄們，那麼該怎麼辦呢？你們聚集的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教導，或有啟示，或有殊言，或有翻譯出來的話語——一切都要為了造就人。 How is it then, brothers? Whenever you come together, each one has a psalm, a teaching, a revelation, [another] language, or an interpretation. All things must be done for edification.
27. 如果有人說殊言，就應該只有兩個人，或最多三個人，而且要輪流說，也要有一個人翻譯。 If any person speaks in [another] language, there should be only two, or at the most three, each in turn, and someone must interpret.
28. 如果沒有翻譯的人，他就應當在教會裡保持沉默，只對自己和神說話。 But if there is no interpreter, that person should keep silent in the church and speak to himself and to God.
29. 做先知傳道的 也應該兩個人或三個人講，其他的人應當分辨。 Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should evaluate.
30. 如果在坐的人中另有人得了啟示，那先講的就應當保持沉默。 But if something has been revealed to another person sitting there, the first prophet should be silent.
31. 因為你們都可以一個一個地做先知傳道，好讓大家都能學，都得到鼓勵。 For you can all prophesy one by one, so that everyone may learn and everyone may be encouraged.
32. 先知的靈是服從先知的， And the prophets' spirits are under the control of the prophets,
33. 因為神不是混亂的神，而是和平的神。 正如在聖徒的各教會那樣， since God is not a God of disorder but of peace. As in all the churches of the saints,
34. 婦女在教會應當保持沉默，因為她們沒有獲准講話；就像律法上所說的那樣，她們要服從。 the women should be silent in the churches, for they are not permitted to speak, but should be submissive, as the law also says.
35. 如果她們想請教什麼，就應該在家裡問自己的丈夫，因為婦女在教會裡講話是可恥的。 And if they want to learn something, they should ask their own husbands at home, for it is disgraceful for a woman to speak in the church meeting.
36. 難道神的話語 是從你們出來的嗎？難道只是臨到你們嗎？ Did the word of God originate from you, or did it come to you only?
37. 如果有人自以為是做先知傳道的，或是屬靈的，就應該承認：我寫給你們的是主的命令； If anyone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual, he should recognize that what I write to you is the Lord's command.
38. 但如果有人不承認，他也不會被承認。 But if anyone ignores this, he will be ignored.
39. 所以，我的弟兄們，你們要渴慕做先知傳道，也不要禁止說殊言。 Therefore, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in [other] languages.
40. 然而，一切事都要行得端正，並且要按著秩序行。 But everything must be done decently and in order.
1 Corinthians 15
1. 弟兄們，我要你們明白我先前所傳給你們的福音；你們也領受了這福音，並且在這福音上站立得住。 Now brothers, I want to clarify for you the gospel I proclaimed to you; you received it and have taken your stand on it.
2. 如果你們不是毫無理由地相信，而是持守我所傳給你們的話語，你們也就會藉著它得救。 You are also saved by it, if you hold to the message I proclaimed to you-- unless you believed to no purpose.
3. 因為我所傳給你們的，其中最重要的，也是我所領受的，就是 基督照著經上所記的，為我們的罪孽死了， For I passed on to you as most important what I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
4. 而且被埋葬了， 又照著經上所記的，在第三天復活了， that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
5. 並且向 磯法 顯現，然後向十二使徒 顯現， and that He appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve.
6. 後來一次性地向五百多個弟兄顯現， 其中大多數人至今還在，雖然也有些已經睡了； Then He appeared to over 500 brothers at one time, most of whom remain to the present, but some have fallen asleep.
7. 後來他向 雅各 顯現，再向所有的使徒顯現， Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
8. 最後也顯現給我——這個像是早產嬰兒一樣的人。 Last of all, as to one abnormally born, He also appeared to me.
9. 原來我是使徒中最小的，不配被稱為使徒，因為我曾經逼迫神的教會。 For I am the least of the apostles, unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
10. 但藉著神的恩典，我成了現在的我，並且神賜給我的恩典沒有落空。不但如此，我比任何使徒更加勞苦做工；其實不是我，而是與我同在的神的恩典。 But by God's grace I am what I am, and His grace toward me was not ineffective. However, I worked more than any of them, yet not I, but God's grace that was with me.
11. 因此無論是我，或是他們，我們都如此傳，你們也就如此信了。 Therefore, whether it is I or they, so we preach and so you have believed.
12. 既然宣講基督已經從死人中復活了，你們中間怎麼還有些人說沒有死人復活的事呢？ Now if Christ is preached as raised from the dead, how can some of you say, "There is no resurrection of the dead"?
13. 如果沒有死人復活的事，基督也就沒有復活了。 But if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ has not been raised;
14. 如果基督沒有復活，我們傳道就是虛空，你們相信也是虛空。 and if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is without foundation, and so is your faith.
15. 這樣，我們就被看做是神的假見證人，因為我們見證了有關神的事，說神使基督復活了，如果死人真不會復活，神就沒有使基督復活； In addition, we are found to be false witnesses about God, because we have testified about God that He raised up Christ-- whom He did not raise up if in fact the dead are not raised.
16. 就是說，如果死人不會復活，基督也就沒有復活了。 For if the dead are not raised, Christ has not been raised.
17. 如果基督沒有復活，你們的信仰就是虛妄的，你們也仍然在自己的罪孽中； And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is worthless; you are still in your sins.
18. 因此在基督裡那些睡了的人也就滅亡了。 Therefore those who have fallen asleep in Christ have also perished.
19. 如果我們在基督裡的盼望只在於今生，我們就比所有的人更可憐。 If we have placed our hope in Christ for this life only, we should be pitied more than anyone.
20. 但如今，基督已經從死人中復活，成為睡了之人初熟的果子， But now Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
21. 因為死亡既然是由一個人而來，死人的復活也是由一個人而來。 For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead also comes through a man.
22. 原來，就像在 亞當 裡所有的人都死了，照樣，在基督裡所有的人也都將得以復活， For just as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
23. 不過每個人要按著自己的次序：初熟的果子是基督；然後他來臨的時候，是那些屬於基督的人； But each in his own order: Christ, the firstfruits; afterward, at His coming, the people of Christ.
24. 再後才是結局。那時候，基督要把國度交給父神；同時，基督要廢除一切統治的、掌權的、有勢力的， Then comes the end, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father, when He abolishes all rule and all authority and power.
25. 因為基督必須做王，直到神 把所有的敵人都放在他的腳下。 For He must reign until He puts all His enemies under His feet.
26. 最後被廢除的仇敵就是死亡， The last enemy to be abolished is death.
27. 因為 「神 使萬有都服從在基督 的腳下。」 當經上 說「萬有」都已經服從了他的時候，明顯地，使萬有服從基督 的那一位是不包括在內的。 For He has put everything under His feet. But when it says "everything" is put under Him, it is obvious that He who puts everything under Him is the exception.
28. 當萬有都服從他的時候，子自己也要服從那位使萬有都服從他的，這樣神就是萬有中的萬有。 And when everything is subject to Him, then the Son Himself will also be subject to Him who subjected everything to Him, so that God may be all in all.
29. 如果不是這樣，那些替死人受洗的，將怎麼辦呢？如果死人根本不會復活，人們為什麼還替死人 受洗呢？ Otherwise what will they do who are being baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, then why are people baptized for them?
30. 我們又為什麼要時時刻刻面臨危險呢？ Why are we in danger every hour?
31. 弟兄們，藉著我在我們的主基督耶穌裡所擁有的，就是我對你們的誇耀，我肯定地說：我天天都在死！ I affirm by the pride in you that I have in Christ Jesus our Lord: I die every day!
32. 我在 以弗所 與野獸搏鬥，如果按人的意思來說，對我有什麼好處呢？如果死人不會復活，就 「讓我們吃吃喝喝吧，因為明天我們就要死了。」 If I fought wild animals in Ephesus with only human hope, what good does that do me? If the dead are not raised, Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.
33. 你們不要被迷惑了！「結交惡友，敗壞善德。」 Do not be deceived: "Bad company corrupts good morals."
34. 你們應當醒悟過來，不繼續犯罪；實際上，有些人不認識神。我說這話，是為了使你們羞愧。 Become right-minded and stop sinning, because some people are ignorant about God. I say this to your shame.
35. 但是有人會說：「死人怎樣復活呢？他們以什麼樣的身體出現呢？」 But someone will say, "How are the dead raised? What kind of body will they have when they come?"
36. 你這愚妄的人哪！你所種的如果不死，就得不到生命； Foolish one! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
37. 你所種的也不是那將要長成的形體；你所種的不過是一粒赤裸的種子，也許是麥子，或是其他什麼。 And as for what you sow-- you are not sowing the future body, but only a seed, perhaps of wheat or another grain.
38. 但神照著自己的意願，給那種子一個形體，並且使每一粒種子各有自己的形體。 But God gives it a body as He wants, and to each of the seeds its own body.
39. 並不是所有的身體都是同樣的：人是一個樣子，牲畜的身體是另一個樣子，鳥的身體又是一個樣子，魚又是另一個樣子。 Not all flesh is the same flesh; there is one flesh for humans, another for animals, another for birds, and another for fish.
40. 還有天上的形體，也有地上的形體；但天上形體的光輝是一個樣子，地上形體的光輝是另一個樣子。 There are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, but the splendor of the heavenly bodies is different from that of the earthly ones.
41. 太陽的光輝是一個樣子，月亮的光輝是另一個樣子，星辰的光輝又是一個樣子；這星與那星的光輝當然有區別。 There is a splendor of the sun, another of the moon, and another of the stars; for star differs from star in splendor.
42. 死人的復活也是這樣： 在衰朽 中被種下，在不朽中復活； So it is with the resurrection of the dead: Sown in corruption, raised in incorruption;
43. 在卑賤中被種下，在榮耀中復活； 在軟弱中被種下，在強壯中復活； sown in dishonor, raised in glory; sown in weakness, raised in power;
44. 被種下的是屬血氣的身體，復活的是屬靈的身體。 既然有屬血氣的身體，也就有屬靈的身體。 sown a natural body, raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
45. 經上也這樣記著：「 第一個人 亞當 成了有生命的人， 最後的 亞當 成了賜生命的靈。」 So it is written: The first man Adam became a living being; the last Adam became a life-giving Spirit.
46. 不過在先的不是屬靈的，而是屬血氣的；在後的才是屬靈的。 However, the spiritual is not first, but the natural; then the spiritual.
47. 第一個人是出於地，是屬塵土的 ； 第二個人 是出於天。 The first man was from the earth and made of dust; the second man is from heaven.
48. 屬塵土的 那個人怎樣，那些屬塵土的也就怎樣； 屬天的那一位怎樣，那些屬天的也就怎樣。 Like the man made of dust, so are those who are made of dust; like the heavenly man, so are those who are heavenly.
49. 就像我們帶有了屬塵土的 那個人的形像， 我們也將帶有屬天的那一位的形像。 And just as we have borne the image of the man made of dust, we will also bear the image of the heavenly man.
50. 弟兄們，我要說這一點：血肉之體不能繼承神的國，衰朽 的也不能繼承不朽的。 Brothers, I tell you this: flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, and corruption cannot inherit incorruption.
51. 看哪，我告訴你們一個奧祕： 我們並不是都要睡了，而是都要被改變， Listen! I am telling you a mystery: We will not all fall asleep, but we will all be changed,
52. 就在一刹那，眨眼之間，在那最後的號角聲中。 的確，號角要吹響，死人要復活成為不朽壞的，我們也要被改變； in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
53. 因為這會朽壞的，必須穿上不朽壞的； 這會死的，必須穿上不死的。 Because this corruptible must be clothed with incorruptibility, and this mortal must be clothed with immortality.
54. 一旦這會朽壞的穿上那不朽壞的， 這會死的穿上那不死的， 經上所記的話就會應驗了： 「死亡被勝利吞滅了！」 Now when this corruptible is clothed with incorruptibility, and this mortal is clothed with immortality, then the saying that is written will take place: Death has been swallowed up in victory.
55. 「死亡啊！你的勝利 在哪裡？ 死亡啊！你的毒刺在哪裡？ 」 O Death, where is your victory? O Death, where is your sting?
56. 死亡的毒刺就是罪，而罪的權勢就是律法。 Now the sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
57. 但感謝神，他藉著我們的主耶穌基督， 賜給我們勝利！ But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
58. 因此，我親愛的弟兄們，你們要堅定，不可動搖，常常在主的工作中豐足有餘，因為你們知道，你們的勞苦在主裡不是虛空。 Therefore, my dear brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always excelling in the Lord's work, knowing that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
1 Corinthians 16
1. 關於為聖徒收集的事，我從前怎樣吩咐 加拉太 的各教會，你們也當照樣做： Now about the collection for the saints: you should do the same as I instructed the Galatian churches.
2. 每週的頭一天，你們每個人如果充裕，就應當從中拿出一些積蓄起來，免得我來的時候才開始收集。 On the first day of the week, each of you is to set something aside and save to the extent that he prospers, so that no collections will need to be made when I come.
3. 等我來了，我會派你們所認可的那些人，帶著書信，把你們的惠贈送到 耶路撒冷 。 And when I arrive, I will send those whom you recommend by letter to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
4. 但如果我也該去，他們就要與我一同去。 If it is also suitable for me to go, they will travel with me.
5. 我經過 馬其頓 省以後，就會到你們那裡去——因為我要經過 馬其頓 省—— I will come to you after I pass through Macedonia-- for I will be traveling through Macedonia--
6. 我也許會在你們那裡停留一些時候，甚至過冬。這樣，無論我往哪裡去，你們都可以送我上路。 and perhaps I will remain with you, or even spend the winter, that you may send me on my way wherever I go.
7. 實際上，我現在並不願意在趕路的時候見你們；主如果准許，我希望在你們那裡住一段時間。 I don't want to see you now just in passing, for I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord allows.
8. 只是我會留在 以弗所，一直到五旬節。 But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
9. 原來，為了有功效的工作，一個大門向我敞開了，不過反對的人也很多。 because a wide door for effective ministry has opened for me-- yet many oppose me.
10. 如果 提摩太 來了，你們要關心，好讓他在你們那裡無所懼怕，因為他和我一樣在做主的工作。 If Timothy comes, see that he has nothing to fear from you, because he is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
11. 所以任何人都不要藐視他。你們要送他平平安安地上路，好讓他到我這裡來，因為我在等候他與弟兄們一起來 。 Therefore no one should look down on him; but you should send him on his way in peace so he can come to me, for I am expecting him with the brothers.
12. 至於 阿波羅 弟兄，我曾多次勸他要與弟兄們一起到你們那裡去，只是他目前實在不願意去；但有機會的時候，他會去的。 About our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but he was not at all willing to come now. However, when he has time, he will come.
13. 你們要警醒，在信仰上當站立得穩，要做大丈夫，要剛強； Be alert, stand firm in the faith, be brave and strong.
14. 你們所做的一切，都要在愛中。 Your every [action] must be done with love.
15. 弟兄們，你們知道 司提法納 一家人是 亞該亞 初熟的果子，而且他們獻上了自己去服事聖徒們。我勸你們， Brothers, you know the household of Stephanas: they are the firstfruits of Achaia and have devoted themselves to serving the saints. I urge you
16. 要服從這樣的人，以及所有和他們一同工作、一同勞苦的人。 also to submit to such people, and to everyone who works and labors with them.
17. 我為 司提法納 、 福特納托 和 阿卡伊庫 的到來感到歡喜，因為他們彌補了你們的空缺 ； I am delighted over the presence of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, because these men have made up for your absence.
18. 他們使我和你們的心靈得到安寧，因此你們要認可這樣的人。 For they have refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore recognize such people.
19. 亞細亞 省的各教會問候你們。 阿奎拉 和 普茜拉，以及他們家裡的教會，在主裡熱誠地問候你們。 The churches of the Asian province greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you heartily in the Lord, along with the church that meets in their home.
20. 所有的弟兄都問候你們。你們要用聖潔的親吻禮彼此問候。 All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
21. 我 保羅 親筆問候。 This greeting is in my own hand-- Paul.
22. 如果有人不愛主，他就該受詛咒。願主快來！ If anyone does not love the Lord, a curse be on him. Maranatha!
23. 願主耶穌 的恩典與你們同在！ The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.
24. 願我的愛在基督耶穌裡與你們大家同在！ My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus.
2 Corinthians
2 Corinthians 1
1. 照著神的旨意做基督耶穌使徒的 保羅，以及弟兄 提摩太， 致那在 哥林多 屬神的教會，以及在全 亞該亞 省所有的聖徒： Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, and Timothy our brother: To God's church at Corinth, with all the saints who are throughout Achaia.
2. 願恩典與平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督臨到你們！ Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
3. 願頌讚歸於神——我們主耶穌基督的父！他是各樣憐憫的父、一切安慰的神。 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort.
4. 在我們一切的患難中，他安慰我們，使我們自己能用從神所受的安慰去安慰那些在各樣患難中的人， He comforts us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to comfort those who are in any kind of affliction, through the comfort we ourselves receive from God.
5. 因為基督的苦難怎樣充充滿滿臨到我們，藉著基督，我們的安慰也照樣充充滿滿。 For as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so our comfort overflows through Christ.
6. 我們如果受患難，是為了你們的安慰和救恩；我們如果受安慰，也是為了你們的安慰 ；這安慰有功效，使你們能忍耐與我們所受的同樣苦難。 If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which is experienced in the endurance of the same sufferings that we suffer.
7. 而且我們對你們的盼望是確定的，因為知道你們怎樣在苦難中與我們有份，也怎樣在安慰中與我們有份。 And our hope for you is firm, because we know that as you share in the sufferings, so you will share in the comfort.
8. 弟兄們，我們不願意你們不明白我們在 亞細亞 省所遭受的患難：我們所受的壓力遠遠過於我們的承受能力，甚至連活下去的希望也沒有了。 For we don't want you to be unaware, brothers, of our affliction that took place in the province of Asia: we were completely overwhelmed-- beyond our strength-- so that we even despaired of life.
9. 然而我們在自己裡面已經承受了死亡的判決，好讓我們不依靠自己，而依靠那使死人復活的神。 However, we personally had a death sentence within ourselves so that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead.
10. 他救我們脫離了如此致命的危險，並且將來要救我們——我們盼望他將來還要救我們。 He has delivered us from such a terrible death, and He will deliver us; we have placed our hope in Him that He will deliver us again.
11. 你們也能通過祈禱一同幫助我們，好讓許多人因著那臨到我們的恩惠 為我們獻上感謝；這恩惠是通過許多人臨到我們的。 And you can join in helping with prayer for us, so that thanks may be given by many on our behalf for the gift that came to us through [the prayers of] many.
12. 我們所誇耀的是這一點：我們的良心見證了我們在世上行事為人帶著屬神的忠實 和真誠，不是靠屬肉體的智慧，而是靠神的恩典；對你們更是如此。 For our boast is this: the testimony of our conscience that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially toward you, with God-given sincerity and purity, not by fleshly wisdom but by God's grace.
13. 其實我們寫給你們的，無非是你們能讀、能了解的，而且我希望你們能徹底地了解， Now we are writing you nothing other than what you can read and also understand. I hope you will understand completely--
14. 就像你們對我們已經有一些了解那樣，因為在我們 主耶穌的日子，我們是你們的誇耀，正如你們是我們的誇耀。 as you have partially understood us-- that we are your reason for pride, as you are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
15. 藉著這樣的確信，我早就打算先到你們那裡去，使你們能得到兩次的恩典 ： In this confidence, I planned to come to you first, so you could have a double benefit,
16. 就是經過你們那裡往 馬其頓 省去，再從 馬其頓 省回到你們那裡，然後由你們送我上路去 猶太 。 and to go on to Macedonia with your help, then come to you again from Macedonia and be given a start by you on my journey to Judea.
17. 那麼，我這樣打算，難道就是輕率行事嗎？難道我所計劃的，是順著肉體的計劃，以致在我忽是忽非嗎？ So when I planned this, was I irresponsible? Or what I plan, do I plan in a purely human way so that I say "Yes, yes" and "No, no" [simultaneously]?
18. 神是信實的，我們向你們傳的話語，並沒有「是」而又「非」。 As God is faithful, our message to you is not "Yes and no."
19. 要知道，藉著我們，就是我、 賽拉斯 和 提摩太，在你們中間所傳揚的神兒子耶穌基督，並沒有「是」而又「非」；相反，在他只有「是」， For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us-- by me and Silvanus and Timothy-- did not become "Yes and no"; on the contrary, "Yes" has come about in Him.
20. 因為神的一切應許，在基督 裡都成為「是」。所以，說「阿們」也是藉著基督，使榮耀藉著我們歸於神。 For every one of God's promises is "Yes" in Him. Therefore the "Amen" is also through Him for God's glory through us.
21. 原來將我們與你們在基督裡一起確立，並且膏立了我們大家的那一位，就是神。 Now the One who confirms us with you in Christ, and has anointed us, is God;
22. 他又在我們身上蓋了印，並且賜聖靈在我們心裡做為預付憑據 。 He has also sealed us and given us the Spirit as a down payment in our hearts.
23. 我求告神為我的靈魂見證：我沒有再往 哥林多 去，是因為顧惜你們。 I call on God as a witness against me: it was to spare you that I did not come to Corinth.
24. 我們並不是要轄制你們的信仰，而是要做你們的同工，使你們喜樂；因為你們已經因信站立得住了。 Not that we have control of your faith, but we are workers with you for your joy, because you stand by faith.
2 Corinthians 2
1. 所以，我自己這樣決定：不再帶著憂傷到你們那裡去。 In fact, I made up my mind about this: not to come to you on another painful visit.
2. 因為如果我使你們憂傷，那麼，除了我使他憂傷的那個人，誰能使我歡喜呢？ For if I cause you pain, then who will cheer me other than the one hurt?
3. 我寫了那封信，免得我來的時候，那些本應該使我喜樂的人使我憂傷，因為我深信你們大家以我的喜樂為你們大家的喜樂。 I wrote this very thing so that when I came I wouldn't have pain from those who ought to give me joy, because I am confident about all of you that my joy is yours.
4. 我在極大的患難和內心的痛苦中，流了許多淚水寫給你們，並不是要使你們憂傷，而是要你們知道我對你們懷有更多的愛。 For out of an extremely troubled and anguished heart I wrote to you with many tears-- not that you should be hurt, but that you should know the abundant love I have for you.
5. 如果有人使人憂傷，他不是使我憂傷，而是在某種程度上使你們大家憂傷——我這樣說，免得說得太嚴重。 If anyone has caused pain, he has not caused pain to me, but in some degree-- not to exaggerate-- to all of you.
6. 這樣的人，受了大多數人的那懲罰已經夠了。 The punishment by the majority is sufficient for such a person,
7. 所以，你們反而更要饒恕他、安慰他，免得他被過度的憂傷吞沒了。 so now you should forgive and comfort him instead; otherwise, this one may be overwhelmed by excessive grief.
8. 因此，我懇求你們向他證實你們的愛。 Therefore I urge you to confirm your love to him.
9. 其實我也為此寫了信，就是要知道你們經過考驗的品德：你們是否在一切事上都順從。 It was for this purpose I wrote: so I may know your proven character, if you are obedient in everything.
10. 你們在任何事上饒恕了誰，我也饒恕誰；實際上，我如果饒恕了什麼，我所饒恕的，就是在基督面前為了你們的緣故而饒恕的， Now to whom you forgive anything, I do too. For what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, it is for you in the presence of Christ,
11. 免得被 撒旦 占了上風，因為我們不是不明白它的意圖。 so that we may not be taken advantage of by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his intentions.
12. 我為了基督的福音來到 特羅阿斯 的時候，雖然主為我開了門， When I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, a door was opened to me by the Lord.
13. 我還是靈裡不安，因為我沒有見到我的弟兄 提多 。因此我向那裡的人告別，往 馬其頓 省去了。 I had no rest in my spirit because I did not find my brother Titus, but I said good-bye to them and left for Macedonia.
14. 但是感謝神！他總是率領我們在基督裡誇勝，並且藉著我們，在各地傳揚因認識基督 而有的香氣。 But thanks be to God, who always puts us on display in Christ, and spreads through us in every place the scent of knowing Him.
15. 因為在神面前，無論在得救的人中間，還是在滅亡的人中間，我們都是基督的馨香： For to God we are the fragrance of Christ among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing.
16. 對滅亡的人，我們是死亡的香氣以至於死亡；對得救的人，我們是生命的香氣以至於生命。對這些事，到底誰配得上呢？ To some we are a scent of death leading to death, but to others, a scent of life leading to life. And who is competent for this?
17. 實際上，我們不像許多人那樣，用神的話語 來做生意；相反，我們是出於真誠、出於神，在神面前、在基督裡講話。 For we are not like the many who make a trade in God's message [for profit], but as those with sincerity, we speak in Christ, as from God and before God.
2 Corinthians 3
1. 我們又開始推薦自己嗎？難道我們像有些人那樣，需要給你們推薦信，或向你們要推薦信嗎？ Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or like some, do we need letters of recommendation to you or from you?
2. 你們就是我們的推薦信，寫在我們的 心裡，被人人所知道、所誦讀； You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, recognized and read by everyone,
3. 因為很明顯，你們是基督的書信，由我們所經手；不是用墨寫的，而是用永生神的靈寫的；不是刻在石版上，而是刻在人的 心版上。 since it is plain that you are Christ's letter, produced by us, not written with ink but with the Spirit of the living God; not on stone tablets but on tablets that are hearts of flesh.
4. 我們藉著基督，對神有這樣的確信， We have this kind of confidence toward God through Christ:
5. 並不是說，我們憑自己配得上把什麼算做出於自己；而是說，我們之所以配得上是出於神。 not that we are competent in ourselves to consider anything as coming from ourselves, but our competence is from God.
6. 他也使我們能夠做新約的僕人 ——不屬於律法條文，而屬於聖靈；因為律法條文帶來死亡，而聖靈卻賜予生命。 He has made us competent to be ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter, but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit produces life.
7. 如果，那以條文刻在石版上、屬死亡的服事工作尚且帶有榮光——以致 以色列 子民因為 摩西 臉上那漸漸消失的榮光，不能注視他的臉—— Now if the ministry of death, chiseled in letters on stones, came with glory, so that the sons of Israel were not able to look directly at Moses' face because of the glory from his face-- a fading [glory]--
8. 何況那屬聖靈的服事工作，難道不更帶有榮光嗎？ how will the ministry of the Spirit not be more glorious?
9. 因為那帶來 定罪的服事工作尚且有榮光，何況那帶來 稱義的服事工作，難道不更充滿了榮光嗎？ For if the ministry of condemnation had glory, the ministry of righteousness overflows with even more glory.
10. 事實上，在這種情況下，那先前有榮光的，因這無限的榮光，就成了沒有榮光的。 In fact, what had been glorious is not glorious in this case because of the glory that surpasses it.
11. 這樣，那漸漸消失的尚且帶有榮光，何況這長存的，難道不更帶有榮光嗎？ For if what was fading away was glorious, what endures will be even more glorious.
12. 因此，我們既然懷有這樣的盼望，就大有膽量地行事。 Therefore having such a hope, we use great boldness--
13. 我們不像 摩西 那樣，他把帕子蒙在臉上，使 以色列 子民不能注視那漸漸消失的榮光的結局。 not like Moses, who used to put a veil over his face so that the sons of Israel could not look at the end of what was fading away.
14. 可是，他們的心思剛硬；事實上，直到今天誦讀舊約的時候，同樣的帕子仍然存在，沒有被揭去，因為那帕子只有 在基督裡才被除去。 But their minds were closed. For to this day, at the reading of the old covenant, the same veil remains; it is not lifted, because it is set aside [only] in Christ.
15. 的確，直到今天， 摩西 書無論什麼時候被誦讀，那帕子仍然蓋在他們的心上。 However, to this day, whenever Moses is read, a veil lies over their hearts,
16. 可是一個人什麼時候歸向主，那帕子就被除掉了。 but whenever a person turns to the Lord, the veil is removed.
17. 主就是聖靈，主的靈在哪裡，哪裡就有自由； Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
