18. 而且臉上的帕子既然被揭去了，我們大家就像鏡子返照出 主的榮光，正在被改變成與主同樣的形像，從榮耀歸入榮耀，這正是出於主——聖靈。 We all, with unveiled faces, are reflecting the glory of the Lord and are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory; this is from the Lord who is the Spirit.
2 Corinthians 4
1. 所以，我們既然得了這服事的工作，正如我們蒙了憐憫，我們就不喪膽； Therefore, since we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we do not give up.
2. 相反，把那些可恥的隱祕之事棄絕了；不以詭詐行事，也不歪曲神的話語 ；反而藉著顯明真理，在神面前把自己推薦給每個人的良心。 Instead, we have renounced shameful secret things, not walking in deceit or distorting God's message, but in God's sight we commend ourselves to every person's conscience by an open display of the truth.
3. 但如果我們的福音真的被遮蓋了，也是在那些正滅亡的人中被遮蓋的。 But if, in fact, our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
4. 對於他們，這世代的神把這些不信之人的心眼弄瞎了，使他們不能洞察基督榮耀的福音之光。基督就是神的形像。 Regarding them: the god of this age has blinded the minds of the unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
5. 實際上，我們不是傳揚自己，而是傳揚主耶穌基督，並且為了耶穌的緣故，我們自己做了你們的奴僕； For we are not proclaiming ourselves but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your slaves because of Jesus.
6. 因為那吩咐「要有光從黑暗裡照耀出來」的神，已經照耀了我們的心，為要發出神榮耀的知識之光——這光就在耶穌基督的臉上。 For God, who said, "Light shall shine out of darkness"-- He has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of God's glory in the face of Jesus Christ.
7. 不過我們有這寶物在瓦器裡，為要顯明這極大的能力是出於神，不是出於我們。 Now we have this treasure in clay jars, so that this extraordinary power may be from God and not from us.
8. 我們處處受患難，卻不被壓碎；心裡困惑，卻沒有絕望； We are pressured in every way but not crushed; we are perplexed but not in despair;
9. 受逼迫，卻不被撇棄；被打倒，卻沒有滅亡。 we are persecuted but not abandoned; we are struck down but not destroyed.
10. 我們身上總是帶著耶穌的死，好讓耶穌的生命也在我們身上顯明出來。 We always carry the death of Jesus in our body, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
11. 的確，我們這些活著的人，為了耶穌的緣故，總是被置於死地，好讓耶穌的生命也顯明在我們這會死的肉體上。 For we who live are always given over to death because of Jesus, so that Jesus' life may also be revealed in our mortal flesh.
12. 這樣，死亡在我們裡面做工，而生命卻在你們裡面做工。 So death works in us, but life in you.
13. 照著經上所記的： 「我信，故我說」，我們既然有同一個信仰的靈，我們也就信，所以也就說， And since we have the same spirit of faith in accordance with what is written, I believed, therefore I spoke, we also believe, and therefore speak,
14. 因為我們知道：使主耶穌復活的那一位，也要使我們與耶穌一同復活，並且使我們和你們一起站在他面前。 knowing that the One who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and present us with you.
15. 的確，這一切都是為了你們的緣故，好讓恩典藉著更多的人而增多，使感謝充實滿溢，歸於神的榮耀。 For all this is because of you, so that grace, extended through more and more people, may cause thanksgiving to overflow to God's glory.
16. 因此我們不喪膽。即使我們外在的人漸漸衰朽，我們內在的人還是日日被更新。 Therefore we do not give up; even though our outer person is being destroyed, our inner person is being renewed day by day.
17. 原來我們這暫時、輕微的患難，正為我們帶來極重無比、永恆的榮耀。 For our momentary light affliction is producing for us an absolutely incomparable eternal weight of glory.
18. 我們所注重的不是看得見的，而是看不見的；因為看得見的是暫時的，看不見的卻是永恆的。 So we do not focus on what is seen, but on what is unseen; for what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
2 Corinthians 5
1. 我們知道，當我們屬地的家——這帳篷被拆毀的時候，我們就有從神而來的殿宇，不是人手所造的，而是在天上的永恆的家。 For we know that if our earthly house, a tent, is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
2. 實際上，我們就是在這帳篷裡呻吟嘆息，切切地想穿上我們那從天上而來的居所。 And, in fact, we groan in this one, longing to put on our house from heaven,
3. 如果真的穿上，我們將來被看見時，就不是赤身的。 since, when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
4. 原來我們在這帳篷裡的人，承受著壓力，甚至呻吟嘆息；不是因為想要脫下，而是想要穿上，好讓這會死的被生命所吞沒。 Indeed, we who are in this tent groan, burdened as we are, because we do not want to be unclothed but clothed, so that mortality may be swallowed up by life.
5. 為此而預備我們的就是神；他賜給我們聖靈做為預付憑據 。 And the One who prepared us for this very thing is God, who gave us the Spirit as a down payment.
6. 因此我們總是滿懷勇氣，儘管知道我們還住在這身體裡的時候，是與主相離的； Therefore, though we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord--
7. 原來我們行事是藉著信，不是藉著眼見。 for we walk by faith, not by sight--
8. 是的，我們滿懷勇氣，更樂意離開這身體，與主同住。 yet we are confident and satisfied to be out of the body and at home with the Lord.
9. 所以我們立定心志，無論是住在身體裡，還是離開身體，都要得主的喜悅， Therefore, whether we are at home or away, we make it our aim to be pleasing to Him.
10. 因為我們大家都必須站 在基督的審判臺前，好使每個人都為自己藉著身體所做的，或善或惡，領受回報。 For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each may be repaid for what he has done in the body, whether good or bad.
11. 既然如此，我們因為知道敬畏主，就勸導人。我們在神面前是顯明的，但我希望在你們的良心裡，也是顯明的。 Knowing, then, the fear of the Lord, we persuade people. We are completely open before God, and I hope we are completely open to your consciences as well.
12. 我們不是再次向你們推薦自己，而是給你們一個誇耀我們的機會，好讓你們可以應對那些只憑外貌、不憑內心誇耀的人， We are not commending ourselves to you again, but giving you an opportunity to be proud of us, so that you may have a reply for those who take pride in the outward appearance rather than in the heart.
13. 因為我們如果癲狂，是為了神；如果清醒，是為了你們。 For if we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we have a sound mind, it is for you.
14. 實際上，基督的愛催逼著我們，因為我們如此判定：既然一個人 替所有的人死了，所有的人就都死了； For Christ's love compels us, since we have reached this conclusion: if One died for all, then all died.
15. 基督替所有的人死了，好讓那些活著的人不再為自己活，卻為替他們死而復活的基督而活。 And He died for all so that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for the One who died for them and was raised.
16. 所以，從今以後，我們不按人的標準 看任何人了。雖然我們曾經按人的標準 認識基督，但現在我們不再這樣認識他了。 From now on, then, we do not know anyone in a purely human way. Even if we have known Christ in a purely human way, yet now we no longer know Him like that.
17. 因此，如果有人在基督裡，他就是新造的人 ；舊的已經過去，看哪，新的已經來臨 。 Therefore if anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation; old things have passed away, and look, new things have come.
18. 這一切都是出於神，他藉著基督 使我們與他自己和好，並且把這勸人與他 和好的服事工作賜給了我們。 Now everything is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
19. 這就是說，在基督裡，神使世人與自己和好，不把他們的過犯算在他們的身上，又把這和好的福音 託付了我們。 that is, in Christ, God was reconciling the world to Himself, not counting their trespasses against them, and He has committed the message of reconciliation to us.
20. 因此我們是基督的特使，就像神藉著我們在勸告人——我們代替基督請求說：「與神和好吧！」 Therefore, we are ambassadors for Christ; certain that God is appealing through us, we plead on Christ's behalf, "Be reconciled to God."
21. 神使那位沒有罪 的替我們成為罪，好使我們在他裡面成為神的義。 He made the One who did not know sin to be sin for us, so that we might become the righteousness of God in Him.
2 Corinthians 6
1. 我們做為神的 同工，也懇求你們：不可白受神的恩典。 Working together with Him, we also appeal to you: "Don't receive God's grace in vain."
2. 因為他說： 「在悅納的時候，我垂聽了你； 在拯救的日子，我幫助了你。」 看哪！現在就是悅納的時候；看哪！現在就是拯救的日子。 For He says: In an acceptable time, I heard you, and in the day of salvation, I helped you. Look, now is the acceptable time; look, now is the day of salvation.
3. 我們不在任何事上給任何人跌倒的藉口，免得這服事的工作被人挑剔； We give no opportunity for stumbling to anyone, so that the ministry will not be blamed.
4. 反而在一切事上都證明自己是神的僕人 ： 在極大的忍耐中，在各種患難、艱難、困苦中， But in everything, as God's ministers, we commend ourselves: by great endurance, by afflictions, by hardship, by pressures,
5. 在鞭打、監禁、混亂中， 在勞苦、失眠、飢餓中， by beatings, by imprisonments, by riots, by labors, by sleepless nights, by times of hunger,
6. 在純潔、知識、耐心、仁慈中， 藉著聖靈，在不虛假的愛中， by purity, by knowledge, by patience, by kindness, by the Holy Spirit, by sincere love,
7. 在真理的話語中，在神的大能中， 藉著右手左手的公義兵器， by the message of truth, by the power of God; through weapons of righteousness on the right hand and the left,
8. 藉著榮耀和羞辱，藉著壞名聲和好名聲； 像是迷惑人的，卻是真誠的； through glory and dishonor, through slander and good report; as deceivers yet true;
9. 像是人所不知的，卻是人所共知的； 像是快要死的，可是看哪，我們是活著的； 像是受懲罰的，卻是不被治死； as unknown yet recognized; as dying and look-- we live; as being chastened yet not killed;
10. 像是憂傷的，卻總是快樂； 像是貧窮的，卻使許多人富足； 像是一無所有，卻是樣樣都有。 as grieving yet always rejoicing; as poor yet enriching many; as having nothing yet possessing everything.
11. 哥林多 人哪，我們對你們，口是坦率的，心是敞開的。 We have spoken openly to you, Corinthians; our heart has been opened wide.
12. 你們並不是被我們壓制了，而是被自己的情感壓制了。 You are not limited by us, but you are limited by your own affections.
13. 所以你們要同樣回報我們——我如同對兒女說——你們也當敞開！ Now in like response-- I speak as to children-- you also should be open to us.
14. 你們不可與不信的人同負一軛。公義和罪惡 到底有什麼相通呢？光明與黑暗有什麼相合呢？ Do not be mismatched with unbelievers. For what partnership is there between righteousness and lawlessness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
15. 基督與 彼列 有什麼相融呢？信的與不信的有什麼關係呢？ What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
16. 神的聖所與偶像有什麼相同呢？要知道，我們 是永生神的聖所，正如神所說： 「我將要在他們中間居住，在他們中間往來； 我將要做他們的神，他們將要做我的子民。」 And what agreement does God's sanctuary have with idols? For we are the sanctuary of the living God, as God said: I will dwell among them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.
17. 「所以主說： 你們要從他們中間出來， 要被分別出來； 不要碰不潔淨的東西， 我就接納你們」， Therefore, come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord; do not touch any unclean thing, and I will welcome you.
18. 「我將要做你們的父親， 你們將要做我的兒女。 這是主、全能者說的。」 I will be a Father to you, and you will be sons and daughters to Me, says the Lord Almighty.
2 Corinthians 7
1. 所以各位蒙愛的人哪，我們既然擁有這些應許，就讓我們潔淨自己，除去肉體和靈魂的一切汙穢，懷著敬畏神的心來達成聖潔。 Therefore dear friends, since we have such promises, we should wash ourselves clean from every impurity of the flesh and spirit, making our sanctification complete in the fear of God.
2. 請你們接受我們。我們沒有虧負過誰，沒有敗壞過誰，也沒有對不起誰。 Take us into your hearts. We have wronged no one, corrupted no one, defrauded no one.
3. 我這樣說，不是為定你們的罪，因為我先前說過：你們常在我們心中，我們甚至可以與你們同生共死。 I don't say this to condemn you, for I have already said that you are in our hearts, to die together and to live together.
4. 我對你們大有確信，為你們大大誇耀；我充滿了安慰，在我們一切的患難中，喜樂格外增多。 I have great confidence in you; I have great pride in you. I am filled with encouragement; I am overcome with joy in all our afflictions.
5. 實際上，我們以前到 馬其頓 省的時候，不但身體得不到安寧，也處處受患難，外有爭戰，內有懼怕。 In fact, when we came into Macedonia, we had no rest. Instead, we were afflicted in every way: struggles on the outside, fears inside.
6. 然而那安慰卑微 之人的神，藉著 提多 的到來安慰了我們； But God, who comforts the humble, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
7. 不僅藉著他的到來，也藉著他從你們所受的安慰，安慰了我們，因他向我們報告了你們的渴望、你們的傷痛、你們對我的熱心，以致使我更加歡喜。 and not only by his coming, but also by the comfort he received from you. He announced to us your deep longing, your sorrow, your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced even more.
8. 即使我在那封信中使你們憂傷，我也不後悔了；因為就算我後悔過——我知道那封信使你們憂傷，雖然只是暫時的—— For although I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it-- even though I did regret it since I saw that the letter grieved you, though only for a little while.
9. 現在我還是感到歡喜。這並不是因為你們憂傷，而是因為你們憂傷以至於悔改。實際上，你們按神的意思 憂傷，使你們在任何事上都不會因我們而受到損失； Now I am rejoicing, not because you were grieved, but because your grief led to repentance. For you were grieved as God willed, so that you didn't experience any loss from us.
10. 因為按神的意思 憂傷，就生出悔改通向救恩，是不懊悔的；可是屬世界的憂傷，卻帶來死亡。 For godly grief produces a repentance not to be regretted and leading to salvation, but worldly grief produces death.
11. 看哪，原來正是這件事——你們按神的意思 憂傷——在你們裡面帶來了何等的殷勤、分辯、義憤、敬畏、渴望、熱心和懲罰。你們在各方面都證明了自己在那件事上是純潔的。 For consider how much diligence this very thing-- this grieving as God wills-- has produced in you: what a desire to clear yourselves, what indignation, what fear, what deep longing, what zeal, what justice! In every way you have commended yourselves to be pure in this matter.
12. 因此我雖然給你們寫了信，但不是為了那虧負人的，也不是為了那受虧負的，而是為了在神面前把你們對我們的殷勤，向你們顯明出來。 So even though I wrote to you, it was not because of the one who did wrong, or because of the one who was wronged, but in order that your diligence for us might be made plain to you in the sight of God.
13. 為此，我們受到了安慰。 在這安慰之外，我們又因著 提多 的喜樂更是格外喜樂，因為他的心靈被你們大家所安撫。 For this reason we have been comforted. In addition to our comfort, we were made to rejoice even more over the joy Titus had, because his spirit was refreshed by all of you.
14. 原來，即使我向 提多 誇耀過你們什麼，我也不至於蒙羞；其實就像我們對你們所講的一切都是真實的，照樣我們向 提多 所誇耀你們的也是真實的； For if I have made any boast to him about you, I have not been embarrassed; but as I have spoken everything to you in truth, so our boasting to Titus has also turned out to be the truth.
15. 而且當 提多 想起你們大家的順從，想起你們怎樣懷著敬畏和戰兢的心接受他，他對你們的情感就越發增多了。 And his affection toward you is even greater as he remembers the obedience of all of you, and how you received him with fear and trembling.
16. 我如今歡喜的是，在一切事上我都因你們滿懷勇氣。 I rejoice that I have complete confidence in you.
2 Corinthians 8
1. 弟兄們，我們要你們明白神在 馬其頓 省各教會中所賜的恩典： We want you to know, brothers, about the grace of God granted to the churches of Macedonia:
2. 在患難的極大考驗中，他們的喜樂之滿和貧窮之深都流露出來，歸入他們慷慨之心的財富。 during a severe testing by affliction, their abundance of joy and their deep poverty overflowed into the wealth of their generosity.
3. 因為我可以見證他們是按著自己的能力，甚至超過了自己的能力，甘心樂意， I testify that, on their own, according to their ability and beyond their ability,
4. 用許多乞求的話，懇請我們在對聖徒的服事 上給與他們恩准和分享的機會 ； they begged us insistently for the privilege of sharing in the ministry to the saints,
5. 他們不但照我們所盼望的，而且照著神的旨意，首先把自己獻給了主，又獻給了我們。 and not just as we had hoped. Instead, they gave themselves especially to the Lord, then to us by God's will.
6. 我們於是勸 提多，他怎樣開始了這恩惠之事，就當照樣在你們那裡把它完成； So we urged Titus that, just as he had begun, so he should also complete this grace to you.
7. 而且你們怎樣在信仰、言語、知識、殷勤和你們對我們的愛心 上都豐足有餘，你們也當怎樣在這恩惠之事上豐足有餘。 Now as you excel in everything-- in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all diligence, and in your love for us-- excel also in this grace.
8. 我說這話不是出於命令，而是要藉著別人的殷勤來考驗你們愛的真誠， I am not saying this as a command. Rather, by means of the diligence of others, I am testing the genuineness of your love.
9. 因為你們知道我們主耶穌基督的恩典：他雖然富足，卻為你們成了貧窮，好使你們藉著他的貧窮可以成為富足。 For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ: although He was rich, for your sake He became poor, so that by His poverty you might become rich.
10. 我在這件事上提供意見，因為這對你們是有益處的。從去年開始，你們不僅做了這件事，而且願意去做， Now I am giving an opinion on this because it is profitable for you, who a year ago began not only to do something but also to desire it.
11. 所以現在你們就當完成這事，好使你們怎樣有願做的樂意之心，就怎樣以你們所擁有的完成它； But now finish the task as well, that just as there was eagerness to desire it, so there may also be a completion from what you have.
12. 因為人如果有樂意之心，就會照著他所擁有的蒙悅納，並不是照著他所沒有的蒙悅納。 For if the eagerness is there, it is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
13. 其實我這樣說 不是為了讓別人輕鬆、你們為難，而是為了公平—— It is not that there may be relief for others and hardship for you, but it is a question of equality--
14. 在現今的時刻，你們的富餘可以補他們的缺乏，好使將來 他們的富餘也可以補你們的缺乏，這樣就公平了。 at the present time your surplus is [available] for their need, so that their abundance may also become [available] for your need, that there may be equality.
15. 正如經上所記： 「多收的沒有增多， 少收的也沒有缺少。」 As it has been written: The person who gathered much did not have too much, and the person who gathered little did not have too little.
16. 感謝神，他為了你們，把同樣的殷勤放在 提多 的心裡。 Thanks be to God who put the same diligence for you into the heart of Titus.
17. 提多 一方面接受了我們的鼓勵，另一方面自己更是殷勤，自願到你們那裡去。 For he accepted our urging and, being very diligent, went out to you by his own choice.
18. 我們也打發了一位弟兄與他一起去。這位弟兄在福音工作上受到各教會的稱讚； With him we have sent the brother who is praised throughout the churches for his gospel ministry.
19. 不僅如此，他也被各教會選出，與我們一起帶著惠贈 同行。我們這服事為的是主自己的榮耀，也為了表明 我們的樂意之心。 And not only that, but he was also appointed by the churches to accompany us with this gift that is being administered by us for the glory of the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness [to help].
20. 我們這樣謹慎，免得有人在我們所經手的這豐厚之事 上挑剔我們， We are taking this precaution so no one can find fault with us concerning this large sum administered by us.
21. 因為我們不僅要敬重主看為美善的事，也要敬重人看為美善的事。 For we are making provision for what is honorable, not only before the Lord but also before men.
22. 我們還打發了另一位弟兄和他們一起去。我們在很多事上多次驗證過這位弟兄是殷勤的，而現在他因為深深地信任你們，就更加殷勤了。 We have also sent with them our brother whom we have often tested, in many circumstances, and found diligent-- and now even more diligent because of his great confidence in you.
23. 論到 提多，他是我的同伴，也是為著你們 的同工。至於那兩位弟兄，他們是各教會的使者，是基督的榮耀。 As for Titus, he is my partner and co-worker serving you; as for our brothers, they are the messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
24. 所以，你們要在各教會面前，向他們顯出你們愛心的憑證，以及我們所誇耀你們的憑據。 Therefore, before the churches, show them the proof of your love and of our boasting about you.
2 Corinthians 9
1. 關於服事 聖徒的事，其實我不必給你們寫什麼， Now concerning the ministry to the saints, it is unnecessary for me to write to you.
2. 因為我知道你們的樂意之心。為此，我向 馬其頓 人誇耀你們，說：「 亞該亞 人從去年就已經準備好了。」你們的熱心激勵了他們中的大多數人。 For I know your eagerness, and I brag about you to the Macedonians: "Achaia has been prepared since last year," and your zeal has stirred up most of them.
3. 不過我派這些弟兄去，是為了我們在這方面對你們的誇耀不至於落空，好讓你們能照著我所說的準備好； But I sent the brothers so our boasting about you in the matter would not prove empty, and so you would be prepared just as I said.
4. 免得萬一有些 馬其頓 人和我一起來，發現你們並沒有預備好，我們就會因著對你們的確信而蒙羞，更不用說你們了。 For if any Macedonians should come with me and find you unprepared, we, not to mention you, would be embarrassed in that situation.
5. 所以，我認為必須鼓勵這些弟兄先到你們那裡去，把你們已經許諾的惠贈 提前安排好，這樣就表明你們所預備好的就是惠贈，而不是被強取的。 Therefore I considered it necessary to urge the brothers to go on ahead to you and arrange in advance the generous gift you promised, so that it will be ready as a gift and not an extortion.
6. 又有這話：播撒吝嗇的人，也收穫吝嗇；播撒祝福的人，也收穫祝福。 Remember this: the person who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the person who sows generously will also reap generously.
7. 每個人要照著心裡預先定好的，不要為難，也不要勉強，因為神喜愛那樂意給與的人。 Each person should do as he has decided in his heart-- not out of regret or out of necessity, for God loves a cheerful giver.
8. 神能使一切的恩典豐豐富富地臨到你們，使你們總是在一切事上都能知足，在一切美善的工作上充實滿溢。 And God is able to make every grace overflow to you, so that in every way, always having everything you need, you may excel in every good work.
9. 正如經上所記： 「他施捨，賜予窮人； 他的義行永遠常存。」 As it is written: He has scattered; He has given to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.
10. 供應種子給撒種的，又供應糧食給人吃的那一位，將要供給並增加你們的種子，而且增多你們義行的果子， Now the One who provides seed for the sower and bread for food will provide and multiply your seed and increase the harvest of your righteousness,
11. 使你們在一切事上都得以富足，以致十分慷慨，就藉著我們生出對神的感謝之心。 as you are enriched in every way for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
12. 因為這服事的工作，不僅補足了聖徒們的缺乏，並且能藉著對神的許多感謝而充實滿溢。 For the ministry of this service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many acts of thanksgiving to God.
13. 他們藉著這次服事 的憑證，因你們順服了那為基督福音所做的告白，也因你們給他們和眾人的慷慨分享，他們就會榮耀神； Through the proof of this service, they will glorify God for your obedience to the confession of the gospel of Christ, and for your generosity in sharing with them and with others.
14. 並且他們因著神賜給你們這無限的恩典，就切切地想念你們，為你們祈禱。 And in their prayers for you they will have deep affection for you because of the surpassing grace of God on you.
15. 感謝神，因他有無法描述的恩賜 ！ Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift.
2 Corinthians 10
1. 我 保羅 與你們面對面的時候是卑微 的，不在你們那裡的時候向你們卻是大膽的。現在我親自以基督的溫柔與謙和懇求你們： Now I, Paul, make a personal appeal to you by the gentleness and graciousness of Christ-- I who am humble among you in person, but bold toward you when absent.
2. 我請求，當我在你們那裡的時候，我不需要大膽自信；我本來打算用這樣的勇氣來對付那些人——他們把我們看做是順著肉體行事的。 I beg you that when I am present I will not need to be bold with the confidence by which I plan to challenge certain people who think we are walking in a fleshly way.
3. 我們誠然在肉體中行事，但不憑著肉體爭戰， For although we are walking in the flesh, we do not wage war in a fleshly way,
4. 因為我們爭戰所用的兵器不是屬肉體的，而是有屬神的能力，可以拆毀堡壘——拆毀各樣的心思， since the weapons of our warfare are not fleshly, but are powerful through God for the demolition of strongholds. We demolish arguments
5. 拆毀所有為抵擋神的知識而樹立起來的高牆；又虜獲各樣的心意，達到屬基督的順從； and every high-minded thing that is raised up against the knowledge of God, taking every thought captive to the obedience of Christ.
6. 而且我們預備好了，要在你們完全順從以後，懲罰所有的悖逆行為。 And we are ready to punish any disobedience, once your obedience is complete.
7. 你們是根據外表看事物。如果有人深信自己是屬於基督的，他自己就應該再想一想：他怎樣屬於基督，我們也怎樣屬於基督。 Look at what is obvious. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself of this: just as he belongs to Christ, so do we.
8. 主所賜給我們的權柄是為了造就你們，不是為了拆毀你們。其實，就算我為這權柄有些過度的誇耀，我也不至於蒙羞。 For if I boast some more about our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for tearing you down, I am not ashamed.
9. 我不願看起來像是在用書信恐嚇你們。 I don't want to seem as though I am trying to terrify you with my letters.
10. 因為有人說：「 保羅 的書信又嚴厲又強硬，但他親身在的時候卻是軟弱的人，他的言語也被藐視。」 For it is said, "His letters are weighty and powerful, but his physical presence is weak, and his public speaking is despicable."
11. 說這樣話的人應該想一想：我們不在你們那裡的時候，書信上的話語怎樣；我們在的時候，我們的行為也會怎樣。 Such a person should consider this: what we are in the words of our letters when absent, we will be in actions when present.
12. 其實我們不敢把自己與某些自我推薦的人同列或比較。當他們以自己來衡量自己，以自己來比較自己的時候，他們是不領悟的。 For we don't dare classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. But in measuring themselves by themselves and comparing themselves to themselves, they lack understanding.
13. 但我們不會在界限以外誇耀，而是在神分給我們的界限範圍內誇耀，這界限甚至一直達到你們那裡。 We, however, will not boast beyond measure, but according to the measure of the area [of ministry] that God has assigned to us, [which] reaches even to you.
14. 的確，我們沒有過於擴張自己，好像達不到你們那裡，實際上我們帶著基督的福音已經來了，甚至遠到你們那裡。 For we are not overextending ourselves, as if we had not reached you, since we have come to you with the gospel of Christ.
15. 我們並沒有在界限以外，以別人的勞苦誇耀。我們只是希望，隨著你們信仰的增長，我們的範圍就會因著你們而更加擴大， We are not bragging beyond measure about other people's labors. But we have the hope that as your faith increases, our area [of ministry] will be greatly enlarged,
16. 以致把福音傳到你們以外的地方；我們不是在別人的範圍之內，為那些現成的事來誇耀。 so that we may preach the gospel to the regions beyond you, not boasting about what has already been done in someone else's area [of ministry].
17. 不過 「誇耀的當在主裡誇耀。」 So the one who boasts must boast in the Lord.
18. 因為那經過考驗的人，不是自我推薦的，而是主所推薦的。 For it is not the one commending himself who is approved, but the one the Lord commends.
2 Corinthians 11
1. 我真希望你們能容忍我這一點點的愚妄！的確，你們是容忍我的。 I wish you would put up with a little foolishness from me. Yes, do put up with me.
2. 我以神的熱心熱愛你們，因為我已經把你們許配給一位丈夫，做為貞潔的童女獻給基督。 For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy, because I have promised you in marriage to one husband-- to present a pure virgin to Christ.
3. 可是我擔心，恐怕你們的思想受到敗壞，離開對基督的忠實和貞潔，就像蛇用牠的詭計欺騙了 夏娃 那樣。 But I fear that, as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your minds may be corrupted from a complete and pure devotion to Christ.
4. 實際上，如果有人真的來傳另一個耶穌，不是我們所傳過的；或者你們領受另外一個靈，不是你們所領受過的；或者接受另外一個福音，不是你們所接受過的——你們竟然容忍他！ For if a person comes and preaches another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or you receive a different spirit, which you had not received, or a different gospel, which you had not accepted, you put up with it splendidly!
5. 實際上，我認為自己沒有一點趕不上那些「超級使徒 」。 Now I consider myself in no way inferior to the "super-apostles."
6. 即使我在言語上沒有技巧，但在知識上並不是這樣。其實我們在各個方面、在所有的事上都已經向你們顯明了這一點。 Though untrained in public speaking, I am certainly not [untrained] in knowledge. Indeed, we have always made that clear to you in everything.
7. 我降卑自己，好使你們被高舉，因為我把神的福音無償地傳給你們，難道我這樣就犯了罪嗎？ Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?
8. 我「掠奪了」別的教會，拿了他們的工價來服事你們。 I robbed other churches by taking pay [from them] to minister to you.
9. 我在你們那裡有缺乏的時候，也沒有成為任何人的負擔，因為從 馬其頓 省來的弟兄們補足了我的缺乏。在一切事上我都留意，不讓自己成為你們的負擔，將來也會留意。 When I was present with you and in need, I did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have kept myself, and will keep myself, from burdening you in any way.
10. 我指著 在我裡面基督的真理說，在 亞該亞 地區，誰也不能阻止我如此誇耀。 As the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be stopped in the regions of Achaia.
11. 為什麼呢？難道因為我不愛你們嗎？神是知道的！ Why? Because I don't love you? God knows I do!
12. 我現在所做的，將來還要做，為要斷絕那些人的機會——他們想找一個機會，好讓別人以為他們所誇耀的與我們一樣， But I will continue to do what I am doing, in order to cut off the opportunity of those who want an opportunity to be regarded just as we are in what they are boasting about.
13. 因為這樣的人是假使徒，是詭詐的工人，他們裝做基督的使徒。 For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
14. 這並不足為奇，原來 撒旦 自己也裝做光明的天使； And no wonder! For Satan himself is disguised as an angel of light.
15. 所以，即使他的僕人 把自己裝做義的僕人，也不足為怪；他們的結局必然照著他們的行為。 So it is no great thing if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their destiny will be according to their works.
16. 我再說：誰都不要以為我是愚妄的人！否則，至少該接受我這個像是愚妄的人，好讓我也可以稍微自誇。 I repeat: no one should consider me a fool. But if [you do], at least accept me as a fool, so I too may boast a little.
17. 我現在所說的，不是按照主說的，而是像一個愚妄人那樣自信誇耀。 What I say in this matter of boasting, I don't speak as the Lord would, but foolishly.
18. 既然有許多人按人的標準 自誇，我也要自誇了， Since many boast from a human perspective, I will also boast.
19. 因為你們做為聰明人，樂意容忍愚妄的人！ For you gladly put up with fools since you are so smart!
20. 實際上，就算有人奴役你們，或侵吞你們，或榨取你們，或壓制你們，或打你們的臉，你們也能容忍。 In fact, you put up with it if someone enslaves you, if someone devours you, if someone captures you, if someone dominates you, or if someone hits you in the face.
21. 說來慚愧，我們倒好像是軟弱的。 但如果有人在什麼事上大膽——我說句愚妄的話——我也大膽！ I say this to [our] shame: we have been weak. But in whatever anyone dares [to boast]-- I am talking foolishly-- I also dare:
22. 他們是 希伯來 人嗎？我也是。 他們是 以色列 人嗎？我也是。 他們是 亞伯拉罕 的後裔嗎？我也是。 Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? So am I.
23. 他們是基督的僕人 嗎？ 我狂妄地說：我更是！ 我受了更多的勞苦，更多的監禁， 更多的鞭打，經常面臨死亡， Are they servants of Christ? I'm talking like a madman-- I'm a better one: with far more labors, many more imprisonments, far worse beatings, near death many times.
24. 我在 猶太 人的手中，遭受了五次「四十減一」的鞭打， Five times I received from the Jews 40 lashes minus one.
25. 被棍子打過三次， 被石頭砸過一次， 遭遇海難 三次， 在深海裡度過了一晝一夜； Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked. I have spent a night and a day in the depths of the sea.
26. 我經常行遠路， 遭遇江河的危險、強盜的危險、 來自同胞的危險、來自外邦人的危險、 在城裡的危險、在曠野中的危險、 在海上的危險、在假弟兄中的危險； On frequent journeys, [I faced] dangers from rivers, dangers from robbers, dangers from my own people, dangers from the Gentiles, dangers in the city, dangers in the open country, dangers on the sea, and dangers among false brothers;
27. 我辛苦勞碌，經常失眠， 又飢又渴，經常缺食， 遭受寒冷，衣不蔽體。 labor and hardship, many sleepless nights, hunger and thirst, often without food, cold, and lacking clothing.
28. 除了這些外在的事，還有對各教會的掛慮，天天壓在我身上。 Not to mention other things, there is the daily pressure on me: my care for all the churches.
29. 有誰軟弱，我不軟弱呢？有誰被絆倒，我不心如火燒呢？ Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is made to stumble, and I do not burn with indignation?
30. 如果必須誇耀，我就誇耀自己的那些軟弱。 If boasting is necessary, I will boast about my weaknesses.
31. 主耶穌的神與父——永遠當受頌讚的那一位，知道我不是在說謊。 The eternally blessed One, the God and Father of the Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying.
32. 在 大馬士革， 阿瑞塔斯 王的總督看守了 大馬士革 城，要抓 我， In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas guarded the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me,
33. 可是我被人用筐子從城牆的窗口縋下來，逃脫了他的手。 so I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his hands.
2 Corinthians 12
1. 誇耀雖然沒有益處，但是必須的；我要說到主的異象和啟示： It is necessary to boast; it is not helpful, but I will move on to visions and revelations of the Lord.
2. 我知道一個在基督裡的人，他十四年前被提到第三層天上。他是否在身體裡，我不知道；是否在身體外，我也不知道；只有神知道。 I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven 14 years ago. Whether he was in the body or out of the body, I don't know; God knows.
3. 不過我知道這樣一個人——他是否在身體裡，還是在身體外，我都不知道，只有神知道—— I know that this man-- whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows--
4. 他被提到樂園裡去，聽見了無法描述的話語，是人不可以說出來的。 was caught up into paradise. He heard inexpressible words, which a man is not allowed to speak.
5. 為這樣一個人，我要誇耀，但為我自己，除了有關那些軟弱的事以外，我不誇耀。 I will boast about this person, but not about myself, except of my weaknesses.
6. 其實就算我願意誇耀，也不算是愚妄的人，因為我會講真理。可是我要克制，免得有人把我看高了，過於他在我身上所看到的，或是從我所聽到的。 For if I want to boast, I will not be a fool, because I will be telling the truth. But I will spare you, so that no one can credit me with something beyond what he sees in me or hears from me,
7. 並且為了不讓我因這些極大的啟示而高抬自己，有一根刺加在我的肉體上，就是 撒旦 的使者來擊打我，免得我高抬自己。 especially because of the extraordinary revelations. Therefore, so that I would not exalt myself, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan to torment me so I would not exalt myself.
8. 為了這事，我三次求主使這根刺 離開我。 Concerning this, I pleaded with the Lord three times to take it away from me.
9. 但他對我說： 「我的恩典是夠你用的，因為我的 大能在軟弱中得以完全。」 因此，我反而極其樂意地誇耀我的那些軟弱，好讓基督的能力遮蓋在我身上。 But He said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for power is perfected in weakness." Therefore, I will most gladly boast all the more about my weaknesses, so that Christ's power may reside in me.
10. 所以，為了基督的緣故，我在那些軟弱中、凌辱中、艱難中、在逼迫和困苦中，都感到喜悅；因為我什麼時候軟弱，什麼時候就剛強了。 So because of Christ, I am pleased in weaknesses, in insults, in catastrophes, in persecutions, and in pressures. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
11. 我 成了愚妄的人，是你們逼我的。其實我應該受到你們的推薦，因為即使我一無所是，我也沒有一點趕不上那些「超級使徒」。 I have become a fool; you forced it on me. I ought to have been recommended by you, since I am in no way inferior to the "super-apostles," even though I am nothing.
12. 我在你們中間以極大的忍耐，用神蹟、奇事和大能，確實顯出了使徒的標記。 The signs of an apostle were performed among you in all endurance-- not only signs but also wonders and miracles.
13. 除了我自己沒有成為你們的負擔以外，你們所受的對待，到底有什麼不如其他教會呢？請你們饒恕我這點不公平吧！ So in what way were you treated worse than the other churches, except that I personally did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong!
14. 看哪，這是我第三次預備好到你們那裡去，而且我不會成為你們的負擔，因為我想要的不是你們的東西，而是你們自己。本來，不應該是兒女為父母積蓄財富，而是父母為兒女積蓄財富。 Look! I am ready to come to you this third time. I will not burden you, for I am not seeking what is yours, but you. For children are not obligated to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
15. 所以為了你們的靈魂，我會極其樂意地付出，甚至完全付出。難道我愛你們越多，就越少得到你們的愛嗎？ I will most gladly spend and be spent for you. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?
16. 不過就算如此，我也沒有成為你們的負擔——難道我是狡猾的人，用詭計牢籠了你們嗎？ Now granted, I have not burdened you; yet sly as I am, I took you in by deceit!
17. 難道我曾經藉著派到你們那裡去的人，對不起你們嗎？ Did I take advantage of you by anyone I sent you?
18. 我鼓勵 提多 去，又打發那位弟兄與他一起去。難道 提多 對不起你們嗎？我們行事，難道不是同一個心靈嗎？難道不是同一個步調嗎？ I urged Titus [to come], and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? Didn't we walk in the same spirit and in the same footsteps?
19. 你們一直以為我們是在向你們申辯嗎？我們是在基督裡，在神面前說話。各位蒙愛的人哪，這一切都是為了造就你們。 You have thought all along that we were defending ourselves to you. [No], in the sight of God we are speaking in Christ, and everything, dear friends, is for building you up.
20. 其實我擔心，恐怕我來到的時候會發現你們不像我所希望的那樣，而你們發現我也不像你們所希望的那樣；又恐怕有紛爭、嫉妒、暴怒、爭競 、誹謗、讒言、自大和混亂； For I fear that perhaps when I come I will not find you to be what I want, and I may not be found by you to be what you want; there may be quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambitions, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.
21. 恐怕我來的時候，我的神會使我在你們面前再一次蒙羞，而且因為許多人從前犯了罪，又不肯為他們所行的汙穢、淫亂和好色的事而悔改，我就會悲傷。 I fear that when I come my God will again humiliate me in your presence, and I will grieve for many who sinned before and have not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and promiscuity they practiced.
2 Corinthians 13
1. 這是我第三次到你們那裡去。 「任何事，憑兩個或三個見證人的口，才能成立。」 This is the third time I am coming to you. On the testimony of two or three witnesses every word will be confirmed.
2. 我先前說過了，現在雖然我不在你們那裡，還要像第二次在你們那裡的時候一樣，預先警告那些從前犯了罪的人和所有其餘的人：我如果再來，不會顧惜！ I gave warning, and I give warning-- as when I was present the second time, so now while I am absent-- to those who sinned before and to all the rest: if I come again, I will not be lenient,
3. 這是因為你們尋找基督在我裡面說話的憑證。基督對你們並不是軟弱的；相反，他在你們中間是有大能的。 since you seek proof of Christ speaking in me. He is not weak toward you, but powerful among you.
4. 實際上，基督雖然在軟弱中被釘十字架，但他卻在神的大能中活著。的確，我們雖然在基督裡也軟弱，但為了你們，我們卻在神的大能中，將要與基督一同活著。 In fact, He was crucified in weakness, but He lives by God's power. For we also are weak in Him, yet toward you we will live with Him by God's power.
5. 你們要察驗自己是否在信仰中，要考驗自己。難道你們不了解耶穌基督在你們裡面嗎？除非你們是經不起考驗的。 Test yourselves [to see] if you are in the faith. Examine yourselves. Or do you not recognize for yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you?-- unless you fail the test.
6. 但是我希望你們明白，我們不是經不起考驗的。 And I hope you will recognize that we are not failing the test.
7. 我們祈求神，使你們不做任何惡事。這不是要顯明我們是經過考驗的，而是要你們行美善的事，就算我們可能像是經不起考驗的。 Now we pray to God that you do nothing wrong, not that we may appear to pass the test, but that you may do what is right, even though we [may appear] to fail.
8. 因為我們做任何事都不能抵擋真理，只能擁護真理。 For we are not able to do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
9. 實際上，當我們軟弱而你們剛強的時候，我們就歡喜；我們還祈求這一點：就是你們得以完全。 In fact, we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your maturity.
10. 為此，我不在你們那裡的時候寫了這些事，好讓我來到的時候，不必用主所賜給我的權柄嚴厲地對待你們。這權柄是為了造就人，並不是為了拆毀人。 This is why I am writing these things while absent, that when I am there I will not use severity, in keeping with the authority the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
11. 最後，弟兄們，你們要歡喜！願你們得以完全，願你們得到安慰！你們要同心合意，要彼此和睦。這樣，慈愛與平安的神就會與你們同在。 Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be restored, be encouraged, be of the same mind, be at peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
12. 你們要用聖潔的親吻禮彼此問候。所有的聖徒都問候你們。 Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the saints greet you.
13. 願主耶穌基督的恩典、神的慈愛、聖靈的契合 與你們大家同在！ The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
Galatians
Galatians 1
1. 我 保羅 做使徒，既不是出於人，也不是藉著人，而是藉著耶穌基督和使他從死人中復活的父神； Paul, an apostle-- not from men or by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised Him from the dead--
2. 我和所有與我在一起的弟兄致 加拉太 的各教會： and all the brothers who are with me: To the churches of Galatia.
3. 願恩典與平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督 臨到你們！ Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
4. 基督照著神我們父的旨意，已經為我們的罪孽獻上了自己，為要把我們從現今這邪惡的世代救出來。 who gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
5. 願榮耀歸於他，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
6. 我感到驚奇，你們這麼輕易地離棄了藉著基督的恩典召喚你們的那一位，轉向了別的福音。 I am amazed that you are so quickly turning away from Him who called you by the grace of Christ, [and are turning] to a different gospel--
7. 其實那並不是另一個福音，而是有些人在攪擾你們，想要篡改基督的福音。 not that there is another [gospel], but there are some who are troubling you and want to change the gospel of Christ.
8. 然而，就算是我們，或是天上來的使者，如果向你們傳講的福音，與我們先前所傳給你們的不同，他就該受詛咒。 But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel other than what we have preached to you, a curse be on him!
9. 我們先前說過，現在我再說：如果有人向你們傳講的福音，與你們先前所領受的不同，他就該受詛咒。 As we have said before, I now say again: if anyone preaches to you a gospel contrary to what you received, a curse be on him!
10. 我現在到底是要得人的信任，還是要得神的信任呢？難道我是想討人的喜悅嗎？如果我仍然討人的喜悅，我就不是基督的奴僕了。 For am I now trying to win the favor of people, or God? Or am I striving to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a slave of Christ.
11. 弟兄們，我要你們明白，我所傳的福音不是按人的意思， Now I want you to know, brothers, that the gospel preached by me is not based on a human point of view.
12. 因為我既不是從人領受的，也不是受人教導的，而是藉著耶穌基督的啟示領受的。 For I did not receive it from a human source and I was not taught it, but it came by a revelation from Jesus Christ.
13. 你們聽說過我以前在 猶太 教中的行事為人：我曾極力地逼迫神的教會，殘害她。 For you have heard about my former way of life in Judaism: I persecuted God's church to an extreme degree and tried to destroy it;
14. 我在 猶太 教中，比我本族的許多同輩更進一步，是一個對我祖先的傳統格外熱心的人。 and I advanced in Judaism beyond many contemporaries among my people, because I was extremely zealous for the traditions of my ancestors.
15. 然而神，就是當我在母腹裡時就把我分別出來、又藉著他的恩典召喚我的那一位，樂意 But when God, who from my mother's womb set me apart and called me by His grace, was pleased
16. 將他的兒子啟示在我裡面，好使我在外邦人中傳揚他。我沒有立刻與人 商量， to reveal His Son in me, so that I could preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult with anyone.
17. 也沒有上 耶路撒冷 去見那些比我先做使徒的，而是往 阿拉伯 去，然後再回到 大馬士革 。 I did not go up to Jerusalem to those who had become apostles before me; instead I went to Arabia and came back to Damascus.
18. 三年以後，我才上 耶路撒冷 去見 磯法，在他那裡住了十五天。 Then after three years I did go up to Jerusalem to get to know Cephas, and I stayed with him 15 days.
19. 至於其他的使徒，除了主的弟弟 雅各，我都沒有見過。 But I didn't see any of the other apostles except James, the Lord's brother.
20. 我現在所寫給你們的，看哪，是在神面前寫的，我不是在說謊。 Now in what I write to you, I'm not lying. God is my witness.
21. 後來，我到了 敘利亞 和 奇里乞亞 地區。 Afterwards, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
22. 那時，在基督裡的 猶太 各教會，還沒有見過我的面。 I remained personally unknown to the Judean churches in Christ;
23. 他們只是聽說：「以前逼迫我們的那個人，現在卻在傳揚他曾經殘害過的信仰。」 they simply kept hearing: "He who formerly persecuted us now preaches the faith he once tried to destroy."
24. 他們就因我的緣故不住地榮耀神。 And they glorified God because of me.
Galatians 2
1. 過了十四年，我與 巴拿巴 一起再次上 耶路撒冷，並且帶著 提多 一起去。 Then after 14 years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along also.
2. 我是照著啟示上去的，向他們陳述了我在外邦人中所傳的福音，不過是單獨地向那些公認是人物的做了陳述，免得我過去或是現在所奔跑的都落了空 。 I went up because of a revelation and presented to them the gospel I preach among the Gentiles-- but privately to those recognized [as leaders]-- so that I might not be running, or have run, in vain.
3. 與我在一起的 提多，雖然是 希臘 人，也沒有被迫受割禮。 But not even Titus who was with me, though he was a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
4. 其實提到這件事，是因著一些偷偷進來的假弟兄的緣故；他們混進來窺視我們在基督耶穌裡所擁有的自由，為了要奴役我們。 [This issue arose] because of false brothers smuggled in, who came in secretly to spy on our freedom that we have in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.
5. 我們對這些人，一刻也沒有屈服妥協，好使福音的真理在你們中間繼續存留。 But we did not yield in submission to these people for even an hour, so that the truth of the gospel would remain for you.
6. 至於那些公認是人物的——無論他們從前什麼樣，都對我沒有區別；神不以外貌取人。那些公認是人物的並沒有給我增添什麼； But from those recognized as important (what they really were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism)-- those recognized as important added nothing to me.
7. 不過他們反而看出來：我受了委託去傳福音給沒有受割禮的人，正如 彼得 受了委託去傳福音給受割禮的人， On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted with the gospel for the uncircumcised, just as Peter was for the circumcised.
8. 因為在 彼得 裡面做工、使他做受割禮之人使徒的那一位，也在我裡面做工、使我做外邦人的使徒。 For He who was at work with Peter in the apostleship to the circumcised was also at work with me among the Gentiles.
9. 公認是柱石的 雅各 、 磯法 和 約翰，既然明白了神所賜給我的恩典，就向 巴拿巴 和我伸出右手行契合之禮，要我們往外邦人那裡去，而他們往受割禮的人那裡去； When James, Cephas, and John, recognized as pillars, acknowledged the grace that had been given to me, they gave the right hand of fellowship to me and Barnabas, [agreeing] that we should go to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised.
10. 只是要我們記得窮人，而這一點也正是我一向努力做的。 [They asked] only that we would remember the poor, which I made every effort to do.
11. 不過 磯法 來到 安提阿 的時候，我曾當面抵擋他，因為他有該責備的地方。 But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face because he stood condemned.
12. 原來，從 雅各 那裡來的一些人到達之前， 磯法 與外邦人一起吃飯；可是那些人一到，他因為怕那些割禮派的人，就退縮，與外邦人分開了。 For he used to eat with the Gentiles before certain men came from James. However, when they came, he withdrew and separated himself, because he feared those from the circumcision party.
13. 其餘的 猶太 人也跟著他裝假，以致連 巴拿巴 也被他們的偽善引入歧途。 Then the rest of the Jews joined his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away by their hypocrisy.
14. 但我一看見他們的行為不符合福音的真理，就在大家面前對 磯法 說：「你身為 猶太 人，如果像外邦人而不像 猶太 人那樣生活，怎麼還要強求外邦人像 猶太 人一樣呢？」 But when I saw that they were deviating from the truth of the gospel, I told Cephas in front of everyone, "If you, who are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel Gentiles to live like Jews?"
15. 我們生來是 猶太 人，不是「外邦中的罪人」， We are Jews by birth and not "Gentile sinners";
16. 不過我們知道：人被稱為義不是本於律法上的行為，而是藉著信耶穌基督。於是我們信了基督耶穌，為要因信基督稱義，而不是本於律法上的行為，因為沒有一個人 本於律法上的行為會被稱為義。 yet we know that no one is justified by the works of the law but by faith in Jesus Christ. And we have believed in Christ Jesus, so that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because by the works of the law no human being will be justified.
17. 但如果我們自己尋求在基督裡被稱為義，卻被發現還是罪人，那麼，難道基督就成了罪的僕人嗎？絕對不是！ But if, while seeking to be justified by Christ, we ourselves are also found to be sinners, is Christ then a promoter of sin? Absolutely not!
18. 因為我如果重建自己以前所拆毀的，就證明我是違犯律法的人。 If I rebuild those things that I tore down, I show myself to be a lawbreaker.
19. 原來藉著律法，我已經向律法死了，使我能向神活著。我已經和基督一起被釘十字架， For through the law I have died to the law, that I might live to God. I have been crucified with Christ;
20. 所以現在活著的不再是我，而是基督在我裡面活著；並且如今我在肉體中活著，是因信神的兒子而活；他愛我，甚至為我捨棄了自己。 and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself for me.
21. 我不棄絕神的恩典，因為義如果是藉著律法而來的，那麼，基督就白白地死了。 I do not set aside the grace of God; for if righteousness comes through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
Galatians 3
1. 唉，無知的 加拉太 人哪！是誰迷惑了你們 呢？被釘十字架的耶穌基督，難道不是先前被描繪在你們眼前的嗎？ You foolish Galatians! Who has hypnotized you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was vividly portrayed as crucified?
2. 我只想請教你們這一點：你們領受了聖靈，是本於律法上的行為，還是本於信而聽從呢？ I only want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law or by hearing with faith?
3. 你們是這樣的無知嗎？你們以聖靈開始，現在卻要以肉體完成嗎？ Are you so foolish? After beginning with the Spirit, are you now going to be made complete by the flesh?
4. 你們受了這麼多的苦，都沒有意義嗎？會不會真的沒有意義呢！ Did you suffer so much for nothing-- if in fact it was for nothing?
5. 那麼，神賜給你們聖靈，又在你們中間行神蹟，是本於你們在律法上的行為，還是本於你們信而聽從呢？ So then, does God supply you with the Spirit and work miracles among you by the works of the law or by hearing with faith?
6. 正如「 亞伯拉罕 信神，這就被算為他的義 」， Just as Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him for righteousness,
7. 因此你們應當知道：那些本於信的，他們才是 亞伯拉罕 的子孫。 so understand that those who have faith are Abraham's sons.
8. 既然經文預先看見神要使外邦人因信稱義，就預先把福音傳給了 亞伯拉罕，說： 「萬國都要藉著你蒙祝福。」 Now the Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith and foretold the good news to Abraham, saying, All the nations will be blessed in you.
9. 這樣，那些有信仰的人，與有信仰的 亞伯拉罕 一同蒙祝福。 So those who have faith are blessed with Abraham, who had faith.
10. 凡是本於律法上行為的人，都在詛咒之下，因為經上記著： 「任何人不持守、不遵行律法書上所記載的一切，都是被詛咒的。」 For all who [rely on] the works of the law are under a curse, because it is written: Cursed is everyone who does not continue doing everything written in the book of the law.
11. 所以，明顯地沒有人能藉著律法在神面前被稱為義，因為經上說： 「義人將因信而活。」 Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because the righteous will live by faith.
12. 律法不是本於信，但是 「遵行這些事的人，將因此而活。」 But the law is not based on faith; instead, the one who does these things will live by them.
13. 基督替我們成了詛咒，從律法的詛咒中救贖了我們，因為經上記著： 「凡是被掛在木頭上的，都是被詛咒的。」 Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, because it is written: Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.
14. 這是為了讓 亞伯拉罕 所蒙的祝福，能在基督耶穌裡臨到外邦人，好使我們能藉著信領受所應許的聖靈。 The purpose was that the blessing of Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that we could receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
15. 弟兄們，我按人的意思說話：甚至是人的約，一旦證實了，也沒有人能廢棄或加添。 Brothers, I'm using a human illustration. No one sets aside even a human covenant that has been ratified, or makes additions to it.
16. 神的各樣應許，原是對 亞伯拉罕 和他的一個後裔說的。神並沒有說「後裔們」，像是指著許多人；而是說 「你的一個後裔」，像是指著一個人，這一位就是基督。 Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He does not say "and to seeds," as though referring to many, but and to your seed, referring to one, who is Christ.
17. 我說的這話是：四百三十年以後出現的律法，不能廢棄神 預先立好的約，使那應許無效。 And I say this: the law, which came 430 years later, does not revoke a covenant that was previously ratified by God, so as to cancel the promise.
18. 如果繼業是本於律法，就不再是本於應許了；但是神把繼業 賜給 亞伯拉罕 是藉著應許。 For if the inheritance is from the law, it is no longer from the promise; but God granted it to Abraham through the promise.
19. 那麼，為什麼要有律法呢？律法是為了過犯的緣故被加上的，直到那蒙應許的後裔 來臨；律法是藉著天使，通過中保的手所規定的。 Why the law then? It was added because of transgressions until the Seed to whom the promise was made would come. [The law] was ordered through angels by means of a mediator.
20. 不過中保沒有為一方的，神卻是一位。 Now a mediator is not for just one person, but God is one.
21. 那麼，律法和神的各樣應許是對立的嗎？絕對不是！如果一個能使人得生命的律法被賜下，義就真是本於律法了。 Is the law therefore contrary to God's promises? Absolutely not! For if a law had been given that was able to give life, then righteousness would certainly be by the law.
22. 然而，經上的話把萬物 都圈在罪孽之下，為要使這因信耶穌基督而來的應許，賜給那些相信的人。 But the Scripture has imprisoned everything under sin's power, so that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
23. 只是在這信仰臨到之前，我們都被圈在律法之下受看守，直到這將要來臨的信仰被啟示出來。 Before this faith came, we were confined under the law, imprisoned until the coming faith was revealed.
24. 這樣，律法一向是我們的導師，直到基督，好使我們能因信稱義。 The law, then, was our guardian until Christ, so that we could be justified by faith.
25. 不過，這信仰既然已經臨到，我們就不在導師 之下了， But since that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian,
26. 因為你們藉著信，在基督耶穌裡，都是神的兒女。 for you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
27. 實際上，你們所有受洗 歸入基督的，就穿上了基督， For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
28. 其中沒有 猶太 人或 希臘 人，沒有為奴的或自由的，沒有男的或女的，因為你們在基督耶穌裡都合而為一了。 There is no Jew or Greek, slave or free, male or female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
29. 而且，如果你們屬於基督，你們就是 亞伯拉罕 的後裔，是照著應許的繼承人。 And if you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed, heirs according to the promise.
Galatians 4
1. 我說：繼承人雖然是一切的主人，但是當他還是小孩子的時候，與奴僕沒有區別； Now I say that as long as the heir is a child, he differs in no way from a slave, though he is the owner of everything.
2. 他是在監護人和管家之下，直到父親所預定的時候來到。 Instead, he is under guardians and stewards until the time set by his father.
3. 我們也是這樣：我們還是小孩子的時候，在世界的原則下受奴役。 In the same way we also, when we were children, were in slavery under the elemental forces of the world.
4. 但是等到時候一滿足，神就派遣他的兒子，由女人所生，生在律法之下， But when the completion of the time came, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
5. 為要救贖律法之下的人，好使我們得到兒子的名份。 to redeem those under the law, so that we might receive adoption as sons.
6. 而且因你們是兒子，神就派遣他兒子的靈進入你們 的心，呼叫：「阿爸！父啊！」 And because you are sons, God has sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying, "Abba, Father!"
7. 這樣，你不再是奴僕，卻是兒子了；既然是兒子，就藉著神，也是繼承人 。 So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and if a son, then an heir through God.
8. 從前，你們不認識神的時候，固然給那些本性上不是神的做了奴僕， But in the past, when you didn't know God, you were enslaved to things that by nature are not gods.
9. 但如今，你們認識了神——不過更要說，被神所認識——怎麼能再回到那無能、無用的原則裡去呢？你們願意再重新做它們的奴僕嗎？ But now, since you know God, or rather have become known by God, how can you turn back again to the weak and bankrupt elemental forces? Do you want to be enslaved to them all over again?
10. 你們竟嚴守著某些日子、月份、節期、年份！ You observe [special] days, months, seasons, and years.
11. 我替你們擔心，恐怕我為你們的勞苦毫無意義了。 I am fearful for you, that perhaps my labor for you has been wasted.
12. 弟兄們，我請求你們要像我一樣，因為我也像你們一樣。你們一點也沒有虧負過我。 I beg you, brothers: become like me, for I also became like you. You have not wronged me;
13. 你們知道，我原先傳福音給你們，是身體有病的時候。 you know that previously I preached the gospel to you in physical weakness,
14. 雖然我的身體對你們 是個試煉，但你們並沒有藐視我，也沒有唾棄我，反而接受我如同接受神的使者、如同接受基督耶穌。 and though my physical condition was a trial for you, you did not despise or reject me. On the contrary, you received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus [Himself].
15. 你們當時的福份到哪裡去了 呢？我可以給你們做見證：那時如果有可能，你們連自己的眼睛都會挖出來給我！ What happened to this blessedness of yours? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
16. 我對你們說真話，結果就成了你們的敵人 嗎？ Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
17. 那些人 對你們熱心，並不是出於好意，而是想要離間你們，好讓你們對他們熱心。 They are enthusiastic about you, but not for any good. Instead, they want to isolate you so you will be enthusiastic about them.
18. 不過在善事上常有熱心，卻是好的，但不要僅僅是我與你們在一起的時候才這樣。 Now it is always good to be enthusiastic about good-- and not just when I am with you.
19. 我的孩子們哪，為了你們，我再次經受臨產的陣痛，直到基督在你們裡面成形！ My children, again I am in the pains of childbirth for you until Christ is formed in you.
20. 我現在想要與你們在一起，也要改變我的語氣，因為我為你們的緣故心裡困惑。 I'd like to be with you right now and change my tone of voice, because I don't know what to do about you.
21. 你們這些願意在律法之下的人哪，請告訴我，難道你們沒有聽過律法嗎？ Tell me, you who want to be under the law, don't you hear the law?
22. 因為經上記著： 亞伯拉罕 有兩個兒子，一個出於女僕，一個出於自由女人 。 For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by a slave and the other by a free woman.
23. 那出於女僕的是由肉體生的，那出於自由女人的是藉著應許生的。 But the one by the slave was born according to the flesh, while the one by the free woman was born as the result of a promise.
24. 這些都是有寓意的。就是說，這兩個女人是兩個約。一個出於 西奈 山，生子為奴，她就是 夏甲 。 These things are illustrations, for the women represent the two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery-- this is Hagar.
25. 這 夏甲 是指著 阿拉伯 的 西奈 山，相當於現在的 耶路撒冷，因為 耶路撒冷 和她的兒女都是為奴的。 Now Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for she is in slavery with her children.
26. 但那在上面的 耶路撒冷 是自由女人；她是我們 的母親。 But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
27. 因為經上記著： 「不能生育、沒有生產的女子啊， 你要歡喜！ 沒有經歷臨產陣痛的女子啊， 你要放聲呼喊！ 因為沒有丈夫的女子， 比有丈夫的女子有更多的兒女。」 For it is written: Rejoice, O barren woman who does not give birth. Break forth and shout, you who are not in labor, for the children of the desolate are many, more numerous than those of the woman who has a husband.
28. 不過弟兄們，你們 就像 以撒 一樣，是應許的兒女。 Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
29. 但正如那由肉體生的 當時逼迫了那由聖靈生的，現在也是這樣。 But just as then the child born according to the flesh persecuted the one born according to the Spirit, so also now.
30. 然而經上是怎麼說的呢？ 「把女僕和她的兒子趕出去！因為女僕的兒子，絕不可以與自由女人的兒子一同做繼承人。」 But what does the Scripture say? Throw out the slave and her son, for the son of the slave will never inherit with the son of the free woman.
31. 因此，弟兄們，我們不是女僕的兒女，而是自由女人的兒女。 Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave but of the free woman.
Galatians 5
1. 基督釋放了我們，使我們得自由。所以你們當站立得穩，不要再被奴役的軛所束縛。 Christ has liberated us into freedom. Therefore stand firm and don't submit again to a yoke of slavery.
2. 看，我 保羅 告訴你們：如果你們要受割禮，基督就對你們毫無益處了。 Take note! I, Paul, tell you that if you get circumcised, Christ will not benefit you at all.
3. 我再次忠告每一個受割禮的人：他有責任遵行全部律法 。 Again I testify to every man who gets circumcised that he is obligated to keep the entire law.
4. 你們這些藉著律法被稱為義的人，你們是與基督隔絕，從恩典中墮落了。 You who are trying to be justified by the law are alienated from Christ; you have fallen from grace!
5. 要知道，我們藉著聖靈，本於信，滿懷著 稱義的盼望； For by the Spirit we eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness from faith.
6. 因為在基督耶穌裡，受割禮或不受割禮都沒有用處，只有藉著愛行出來的信仰才有用處。 For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision accomplishes anything; what matters is faith working through love.
7. 你們一向跑得很好，到底是誰攔阻了你們，使你們不信從真理呢？ You were running well. Who prevented you from obeying the truth?
8. 這種勸誘不是出於召喚你們的那一位。 This persuasion did not come from Him who called you.
9. 一點點酵母能使整個麵團發酵。 A little yeast leavens the whole lump of dough.
10. 我在主裡深信你們不會有別的思想；不過那攪擾你們的，無論他是誰，都將受到懲罰。 In the Lord I have confidence in you that you will not accept any other view. But whoever it is who is troubling you will pay the penalty.
11. 弟兄們，如果我仍然傳講割禮，我為什麼還受逼迫呢？如果我這樣做，十字架使人絆腳的地方早就沒有了。 Now brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
12. 我真希望那些攪亂你們的人把自己閹割了！ I wish those who are disturbing you might also get themselves castrated!
13. 弟兄們，你們蒙召是為了得自由，只是不可用這自由給肉體一個機會，而是要藉著愛彼此服事， For you are called to freedom, brothers; only don't use this freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but serve one another through love.
14. 因為全部律法都在 「要愛鄰如己」 這一句話裡得以滿足了。 For the entire law is fulfilled in one statement: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
15. 你們要當心！如果你們繼續相咬相吞，恐怕就要彼此毀滅了。 But if you bite and devour one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
16. 所以我說：你們應當順著聖靈行走，這樣就絕不會去滿足肉體的欲望了； I say then, walk by the Spirit and you will not carry out the desire of the flesh.
17. 因為肉體的欲望與聖靈對立，聖靈也與肉體對立。這兩者彼此反對，使你們不能做自己所願意做的。 For the flesh desires what is against the Spirit, and the Spirit desires what is against the flesh; these are opposed to each other, so that you don't do what you want.
18. 但如果你們被聖靈帶領，就不在律法之下了。 But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
19. 肉體的行為是清清楚楚的，它們就是：通姦 、淫亂、汙穢、好色、 Now the works of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, moral impurity, promiscuity,
20. 拜偶像、行邪術 、仇恨、紛爭、嫉恨、暴怒、爭競 、分裂、結派、 idolatry, sorcery, hatreds, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambitions, dissensions, factions,
21. 嫉妒、凶殺 、醉酒、荒宴以及類似這樣的事。對這些事，我現在要預先告訴你們，就像我以前告訴過你們的那樣：行這些事的人不會繼承神的國。 envy, drunkenness, carousing, and anything similar, about which I tell you in advance-- as I told you before-- that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
22. 然而，聖靈的果子是：愛心、喜樂、和平、忍耐、仁慈、良善、忠信、 But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
23. 溫柔、自制。這樣的事，沒有律法反對。 gentleness, self-control. Against such things there is no law.
24. 那些屬於基督耶穌的人，已經把肉體與肉體的 渴望和情欲一同釘上十字架了。 Now those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
25. 我們既然藉著聖靈而活，就讓我們靠著聖靈行走。 If we live by the Spirit, we must also follow the Spirit.
26. 我們不可貪圖虛榮，彼此惹氣，互相嫉妒。 We must not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.
Galatians 6
1. 弟兄們，一個人無論被任何過犯所勝，你們屬靈的人都要以溫柔的心靈把這樣的人挽回過來；但是你自己要留心，免得你也受試探。 Brothers, if someone is caught in any wrongdoing, you who are spiritual should restore such a person with a gentle spirit, watching out for yourselves so you won't be tempted also.
2. 你們各人的重擔要互相擔當，如此，就將成全基督的律法。 Carry one another's burdens; in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
3. 人本來算不得什麼；如果自以為是什麼，就是在欺騙自己。 For if anyone considers himself to be something when he is nothing, he is deceiving himself.
4. 每個人都當省察自己的工作；這樣，他就只在自我比較的時候，將有可誇耀的，而不與別人比較了， But each person should examine his own work, and then he will have a reason for boasting in himself alone, and not in respect to someone else.
5. 因為每個人都要擔當自己的擔子。 For each person will have to carry his own load.
6. 在這話語上受教導的，就應該將一切美物與教導他的人分享。 The one who is taught the message must share his goods with the teacher.
7. 你們不要被迷惑了！神是輕慢不得的。要知道，一個人種什麼，就收什麼。 Don't be deceived: God is not mocked. For whatever a man sows he will also reap,
8. 因為順著自己肉體撒種的，就會從肉體收衰朽 ；順著聖靈撒種的，就會從聖靈收永恆的生命。 because the one who sows to his flesh will reap corruption from the flesh, but the one who sows to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
9. 我們行美善的事不要喪膽；如果不放棄，到了所定的時候 就會有收穫。 So we must not get tired of doing good, for we will reap at the proper time if we don't give up.
10. 由此可見，我們一有機會，就要向眾人做美善的事，尤其要對信徒家裡的人。 Therefore, as we have opportunity, we must work for the good of all, especially for those who belong to the household of faith.
11. 你們看，我親手寫給你們的字，是多麼地大。 Look at what large letters I have written to you in my own handwriting.
12. 那些想在肉體上體面的，他們才強求你們受割禮，他們只是要避免為基督的十字架受逼迫。 Those who want to make a good showing in the flesh are the ones who would compel you to be circumcised-- but only to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Christ.
13. 事實上，那些受割禮的人自己也不遵守律法。他們要你們受割禮，是為了以你們的肉體誇耀。 For even the circumcised don't keep the law themselves; however, they want you to be circumcised in order to boast about your flesh.
14. 至於我，除了我們主耶穌基督的十字架以外，我絕不以別的誇耀。因這十字架，對我來說，世界已經被釘十字架了；對世界來說，我也已經被釘十字架了。 But as for me, I will never boast about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
15. 因為 受割禮或不受割禮，都算不了什麼 ；重要的是 成為新造的人。 For both circumcision and uncircumcision mean nothing; [what matters] instead is a new creation.
16. 凡是照著這原則行走的人，願平安和憐憫臨到他們，也臨到神的 以色列 民！ May peace be on all those who follow this standard, and mercy also be on the Israel of God!
17. 從今以後，誰都不要煩擾我，因為我身上帶著耶穌 的印記。 From now on, let no one cause me trouble, because I carry the marks of Jesus on my body.
18. 弟兄們，願我們主耶穌基督的恩典與你們的靈同在！阿們。 Brothers, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
Ephesians
Ephesians 1
1. 照著神的旨意做基督耶穌使徒的 保羅， 致住在 以弗所 的 聖徒，就是在基督耶穌裡的信徒們 ： Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will: To the saints and believers in Christ Jesus at Ephesus.
2. 願恩典與平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督臨到你們！ Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
3. 願頌讚歸於神——我們主耶穌基督的父！他在基督裡，以天上各樣屬靈的福氣祝福了我們， Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavens, in Christ;
4. 就如他從創世以前，在基督裡揀選了我們，使我們在他面前成為聖潔、毫無瑕疵。他在愛中， for He chose us in Him, before the foundation of the world, to be holy and blameless in His sight. In love
5. 照著自己心願的美意，預定我們藉著耶穌基督得著兒子的名份，歸於他自己， He predestined us to be adopted through Jesus Christ for Himself, according to His favor and will,
6. 歸於 他恩典榮耀的稱讚，這恩典是他在愛子裡特別賜給我們的。 to the praise of His glorious grace that He favored us with in the Beloved.
7. 在他裡面，我們藉著他的血，得蒙救贖、過犯得到赦免，都是出於神恩典的豐盛。 In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
8. 神以一切的智慧和聰明，使這恩典豐豐富富地臨到我們， that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
9. 照著他在基督裡預先定下的美意，讓我們明白了他旨意的奧祕， He made known to us the mystery of His will, according to His good pleasure that He planned in Him
10. 到了那計劃 日期滿足的時候，就使天上和地上的萬有，都包含在基督裡。 for the administration of the days of fulfillment-- to bring everything together in the Messiah, both things in heaven and things on earth in Him.
11. 在基督裡，我們也得了繼業，是照著那一位的心意而預先定下的，他按著自己旨意的計劃來運作萬事， In Him we were also made His inheritance, predestined according to the purpose of the One who works out everything in agreement with the decision of His will,
12. 以致我們這些早已在基督裡有盼望的人，能歸於 他榮耀的稱讚 。 so that we who had already put our hope in the Messiah might bring praise to His glory.
13. 在基督 裡，你們也聽從了真理的話語，就是那使你們得救的福音，並且信了基督，就蒙了所應許的聖靈為印記。 In Him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation-- in Him when you believed-- were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit.
14. 聖靈是我們得繼業的預付憑據，直到屬神的子民 得贖，歸於 他榮耀的稱讚 。 He is the down payment of our inheritance, for the redemption of the possession, to the praise of His glory.
15. 為此，我既然也聽說了有關你們對主耶穌的信仰，以及對所有聖徒的愛心， This is why, since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
16. 就不斷地為你們獻上感謝，在禱告中提到你們， I never stop giving thanks for you as I remember you in my prayers.
17. 願我們主耶穌基督的神——榮耀的父，賜給你們智慧和啟示的靈，使你們能真正地認識他。 [I pray] that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, would give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Him.
18. 我也求神照亮你們心 中的 眼睛，使你們知道：屬他召喚的盼望到底是什麼；在聖徒中間，他繼業榮耀的豐盛到底是什麼； [I pray] that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened so you may know what is the hope of His calling, what are the glorious riches of His inheritance among the saints,
19. 並且在我們這些相信之人的身上，照著他力量的權能作為，他能力的無限偉大到底是什麼。 and what is the immeasurable greatness of His power to us who believe, according to the working of His vast strength.
20. 神曾將這能力運作在基督的身上，使基督從死人中復活，並且使他在天上坐在自己的右邊， He demonstrated [this power] in the Messiah by raising Him from the dead and seating Him at His right hand in the heavens--
21. 遠遠高過一切統治的、掌權的、有勢力的、有主權的，和一切被稱的名號，不僅在這世代，而且也在那將要來臨的世代。 far above every ruler and authority, power and dominion, and every title given, not only in this age but also in the one to come.
22. 神 又 使萬有都服從在基督的腳下， 使基督為教會做了超越萬有的元首 。 And He put everything under His feet and appointed Him as head over everything for the church,
23. 教會是他的身體，是在萬有中充滿 萬有的那一位的豐盛完美。 which is His body, the fullness of the One who fills all things in every way.
Ephesians 2
1. 你們因著自己的過犯和罪孽，原是死的； And you were dead in your trespasses and sins
2. 在其中，你們從前行事為人，是順著這世界的潮流，順著那空中勢力的掌權者，就是現今在那些不信從的兒女裡面做工的靈。 in which you previously walked according to this worldly age, according to the ruler of the atmospheric domain, the spirit now working in the disobedient.
3. 我們從前也都生活在他們中間，生活在自己肉體的欲望裡，行肉體和意念所願的事。我們正如其他人，生來也是震怒之下的兒女。 We too all previously lived among them in our fleshly desires, carrying out the inclinations of our flesh and thoughts, and by nature we were children under wrath, as the others were also.
4. 不過神有豐富的憐憫，因著他愛我們的大愛， But God, who is abundant in mercy, because of His great love that He had for us,
5. 甚至當我們還死在過犯中的時候，就使我們與基督一同活過來——你們得救是藉著恩典！ made us alive with the Messiah even though we were dead in trespasses. By grace you are saved!
6. 神又使我們在基督耶穌裡，與基督一同復活、一同坐在天上， He also raised us up with Him and seated us with Him in the heavens, in Christ Jesus,
7. 為了在將來的各世代中，在基督耶穌裡，藉著對我們的仁慈，可以顯出他那無限恩典的豐盛。 so that in the coming ages He might display the immeasurable riches of His grace in [His] kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
8. 你們得救確實是藉著恩典、藉著信，這不是出於你們自己，而是神的恩賜； For by grace you are saved through faith, and this is not from yourselves; it is God's gift--
9. 也不是本於行為，免得有人自誇。 not from works, so that no one can boast.
10. 實際上，我們是神的創作，是為了美善的工作在基督耶穌裡被造成的；神早已預備好了美善工作，要我們在其中行事 。 For we are His creation-- created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared ahead of time so that we should walk in them.
11. 所以你們當記住：從前，你們照著肉體說是外邦人，被那些所謂「受割禮的」稱為「沒受割禮的」；割禮是人手在肉體上所行的。 So then, remember that at one time you were Gentiles in the flesh-- called "the uncircumcised" by those called "the circumcised," done by hand in the flesh.
12. 那時候，你們與基督無關；被排除在 以色列 國民之外；在那些所應許的諸約上是外人；在這世界上沒有盼望、沒有神。 At that time you were without the Messiah, excluded from the citizenship of Israel, and foreigners to the covenants of the promise, with no hope and without God in the world.
13. 但如今，在基督耶穌裡，你們這些從前在遠處的人，藉著基督的血，已經被帶到近處了。 But now in Christ Jesus, you who were far away have been brought near by the blood of the Messiah.
14. 因為他自己是我們的和平，他使兩者合而為一，廢除了那隔在中間仇恨的牆；以自己的身體， For He is our peace, who made both groups one and tore down the dividing wall of hostility. In His flesh,
15. 廢除了諭令中誡命的律法，為了把兩者在他自己裡面造成一個新人，締造和平。 He did away with the law of the commandments in regulations, so that He might create in Himself one new man from the two, resulting in peace.
16. 他在十字架上既然消除了仇恨，就藉著十字架使兩者得以在一個身體裡，與神和好； [He did this so] that He might reconcile both to God in one body through the cross and put the hostility to death by it.
17. 並且來傳和平 的福音給你們在遠處的人，也給那些在近處的人。 When [Christ] came, He proclaimed the good news of peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
18. 因為藉著基督，我們兩者能夠在同一位聖靈裡，來到父面前。 For through Him we both have access by one Spirit to the Father.
19. 由此可見，你們不再是外人，或寄居的；你們是聖徒的同國之民，是神家裡的人， So then you are no longer foreigners and strangers, but fellow citizens with the saints, and members of God's household,
20. 並且被建造在使徒和先知的根基上，有基督耶穌自己為房角石。 built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
21. 在基督耶穌裡，全部建築互相連接，漸漸成為在主裡的聖殿； The whole building is being fitted together in Him and is growing into a holy sanctuary in the Lord,
22. 在他裡面，你們也一同被建造，藉著聖靈成為神居住的地方。 in whom you also are being built together for God's dwelling in the Spirit.
Ephesians 3
1. 因此，我 保羅 為你們外邦人做了基督耶穌的囚犯。 For this reason, I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles--
2. 你們一定聽說過，為了你們的緣故，神那恩典的任務已經賜給我了； you have heard, haven't you, about the administration of God's grace that He gave to me for you?
3. 也就是說，藉著啟示，那奧祕已經顯明給我，就像我先前簡略寫過的那樣。 The mystery was made known to me by revelation, as I have briefly written above.
4. 你們讀了，就能明白我在基督奧祕上的悟性。 By reading this you are able to understand my insight about the mystery of the Messiah.
5. 這奧祕在別的各世代並不顯明給人類，不像如今藉著聖靈啟示給了他的聖使徒和先知們。 This was not made known to people in other generations as it is now revealed to His holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit:
6. 這奧祕就是：外邦人在基督耶穌 裡，藉著福音，成為共同的繼承人，同屬一體、同蒙應許。 the Gentiles are co-heirs, members of the same body, and partners of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
7. 我成了這福音的僕人，是照著神恩典的賞賜；這賞賜是照著他大能的作為賜給我的。 I was made a servant of this [gospel] by the gift of God's grace that was given to me by the working of His power.
8. 我在所有聖徒中，比最小的還小，但被賜予了這恩典，是為了把基督那無法測度的豐盛傳給外邦人； This grace was given to me-- the least of all the saints!-- to proclaim to the Gentiles the incalculable riches of the Messiah,
9. 並且使所有的人都明白這奧祕的計劃 到底是什麼，這奧祕自古以來被隱藏在 創造萬有的神裡面， and to shed light for all about the administration of the mystery hidden for ages in God who created all things.
10. 為要使天上的統治者和掌權者，如今藉著教會能明白神各種各樣的智慧。 This is so that God's multi-faceted wisdom may now be made known through the church to the rulers and authorities in the heavens.
11. 這都是照著他在我們主基督耶穌裡所成就的永恆心意。 This is according to the purpose of the ages, which He made in the Messiah, Jesus our Lord,
12. 在基督裡，藉著信基督，我們能坦然無懼、確信無疑地來到神面前 。 in whom we have boldness, access, and confidence through faith in Him.
13. 所以，我請求你們，不要因我為你們所受的患難而喪膽 ；這患難是你們的榮耀。 So then I ask you not to be discouraged over my afflictions on your behalf, for they are your glory.
14. 因此，我屈膝在 父面前—— For this reason I bow my knees before the Father
15. 天上地上的萬族都是從他得名的， from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named.
16. 願他按照他那榮耀的豐盛，藉著他的靈，以大能使你們內在的人剛強起來； [I pray] that He may grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with power through His Spirit in the inner man,
17. 使基督藉著你們的信仰，住在你們心裡；使你們在愛中扎根，根基穩固， and that the Messiah may dwell in your hearts through faith. [I pray that] you, being rooted and firmly established in love,
18. 好讓你們有能力與所有聖徒一起了解基督的愛 是多麼長、闊、高、深—— may be able to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and width, height and depth,
19. 明白那超越了人所能 理解的基督之愛，好讓你們得以滿足，達到神一切的豐盛完美。 and to know the Messiah's love that surpasses knowledge, so you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
20. 神能照著在我們裡面做工的大能，成就那遠超過我們所求所想的一切事—— Now to Him who is able to do above and beyond all that we ask or think-- according to the power that works in you--
21. 願榮耀在教會裡、在基督耶穌裡歸於神，直到世世代代，永永遠遠！阿們。 to Him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
Ephesians 4
1. 所以，我這個在主裡的囚犯勸你們：行事為人要配得上你們所蒙的召喚， I, therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, urge you to walk worthy of the calling you have received,
2. 要以完全的謙卑和溫柔，以耐心，在愛中彼此容忍； with all humility and gentleness, with patience, accepting one another in love,
3. 以和平的聯結，努力保持屬聖靈的合一： diligently keeping the unity of the Spirit with the peace that binds [us].
4. 一個身體、一位聖靈，就像你們蒙召時也被召入一個盼望， There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope at your calling;
5. 一位主、一個信仰、一個洗禮、 one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
6. 一位神——就是萬有之父，他超越萬有，貫通萬有，在萬有之中。 one God and Father of all, who is above all and through all and in all.
7. 然而，我們每一個人都按照基督恩賜的尺度被賜予了恩典。 Now grace was given to each one of us according to the measure of the Messiah's gift.
8. 所以經上說： 他升上高天的時候，擄掠了俘虜， 把各樣的恩惠賜給了人。 For it says: When He ascended on high, He took prisoners into captivity; He gave gifts to people.
9. 那麼「他升上」這話是什麼意思呢？難道不也是說 他曾降到地的低層 嗎？ But what does "He ascended" mean except that He descended to the lower parts of the earth?
10. 降下來的那一位，也就是為要充滿 萬有而升到諸天之上的那一位。 The One who descended is the same as the One who ascended far above all the heavens, that He might fill all things.
11. 他賜下一些人做使徒，一些人做先知傳道，一些人做傳福音者，一些人做牧人或教師， And He personally gave some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, some pastors and teachers,
12. 為了要裝備聖徒去做服事的工作，以建立基督的身體； for the training of the saints in the work of ministry, to build up the body of Christ,
13. 直到我們大家達到在信仰上以及對神兒子真正認識上的合一，達到成熟人 的地步，達到基督那豐盛完美的身量。 until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of God's Son, [growing] into a mature man with a stature measured by Christ's fullness.
14. 這樣，我們就不再是小孩子，在人的狡詐和詭計中陷入那迷惑人的騙局，被各種教義之風搖動，飄來飄去。 Then we will no longer be little children, tossed by the waves and blown around by every wind of teaching, by human cunning with cleverness in the techniques of deceit.
15. 我們卻要在愛中說真話，在一切事上向著他長進；他就是頭，是基督。 But speaking the truth in love, let us grow in every way into Him who is the head-- Christ.
16. 本於他，全身藉著每一個關節的支持，照著每一個部分 適當的功用，互相連接，結合在一起，使身體漸漸成長，以致在愛中建立自己。 From Him the whole body, fitted and knit together by every supporting ligament, promotes the growth of the body for building up itself in love by the proper working of each individual part.
17. 所以，我這樣說，並且在主裡忠告：你們行事不要再像 外邦人那樣，在自己虛妄的理性中行事 ； Therefore, I say this and testify in the Lord: You should no longer walk as the Gentiles walk, in the futility of their thoughts.
18. 他們的意念變為黑暗，因著那在自己裡面的愚昧無知和心裡的剛硬，就與神的生命隔絕了； They are darkened in their understanding, excluded from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them and because of the hardness of their hearts.
19. 他們麻木不仁，任憑自己好色，以致貪婪地行出各樣汙穢的事。 They became callous and gave themselves over to promiscuity for the practice of every kind of impurity with a desire for more and more.
20. 但你們學了基督，就不是這樣—— But that is not how you learned about the Messiah,
21. 如果你們真的聽從了他，又照著在耶穌裡的真理，在他裡面受了教導， assuming you heard Him and were taught by Him, because the truth is in Jesus:
22. 為了你們脫去在過去行為上的舊人。這舊人順著迷惑人的私欲受敗壞， you took off your former way of life, the old man that is corrupted by deceitful desires;
23. 而你們在自己的心靈裡得以更新， you are being renewed in the spirit of your minds;
24. 並且穿上新人；這新人是照著神的形像，在真理的公義和聖潔中被造成的。 you put on the new man, the one created according to God's [likeness] in righteousness and purity of the truth.
25. 所以，你們既然脫去虛假， 每個人就要與自己鄰人說真話， 因為我們都是身體的一部分，彼此相屬。 Since you put away lying, Speak the truth, each one to his neighbor, because we are members of one another.
26. 你們發怒卻不可繼續犯罪， 不可生氣到日落， Be angry and do not sin. Don't let the sun go down on your anger,
27. 也不可給魔鬼留地步。 and don't give the Devil an opportunity.
28. 偷竊的，不可再偷，反而要勞苦做工，親手做有益處的事，好使自己能有所得，分給有需要的人。 The thief must no longer steal. Instead, he must do honest work with his own hands, so that he has something to share with anyone in need.
29. 任何壞話都不可出口，而是按著需要說造就人的好話，使聽的人得到益處。 No rotten talk should come from your mouth, but only what is good for the building up of someone in need, in order to give grace to those who hear.
30. 不要讓神的聖靈憂傷；你們蒙了他的印記，直到得贖的日子 。 And don't grieve God's Holy Spirit, who sealed you for the day of redemption.
31. 你們要除掉一切苦毒、暴怒、憤怒、喧嚷、毀謗，以及一切的惡毒； All bitterness, anger and wrath, insult and slander must be removed from you, along with all wickedness.
32. 要以仁慈彼此相待，心存憐憫，互相饒恕，就像神在基督裡饒恕了你們 那樣。 And be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving one another, just as God also forgave you in Christ.
Ephesians 5
1. 所以，做為蒙愛的兒女，你們要效法神； Therefore, be imitators of God, as dearly loved children.
2. 要在愛中行事，就像基督也愛了我們，為我們捨棄了自己，做供物和祭物獻給神，成為馨香的氣味。 And walk in love, as the Messiah also loved us and gave Himself for us, a sacrificial and fragrant offering to God.
3. 至於淫亂和一切汙穢，或是貪心，在你們中間連提都不可提，這樣才與聖徒相宜。 But sexual immorality and any impurity or greed should not even be heard of among you, as is proper for saints.
4. 汙穢的言行、愚妄的話語、下流的笑話，這些都不合宜；反而倒要說感謝的話。 And coarse and foolish talking or crude joking are not suitable, but rather giving thanks.
5. 實際上你們應當清楚知道這一點：所有淫亂的、汙穢的，或貪心的——就是拜偶像的——在基督和神的國度裡都得不到繼業。 For know and recognize this: no sexually immoral or impure or greedy person, who is an idolater, has an inheritance in the kingdom of the Messiah and of God.
6. 不要讓任何人用虛空的話把你們欺騙了；正是為了這些，神的震怒就臨到那些不信從的兒女 身上。 Let no one deceive you with empty arguments, for because of these things God's wrath is coming on the disobedient.
7. 所以，不要與他們同夥。 Therefore, do not become their partners.
8. 你們從前原是黑暗，但如今在主裡就是光；你們要像屬於光的兒女行走， For you were once darkness, but now [you are] light in the Lord. Walk as children of light--
9. 原來屬於光的果子，就是一切良善、公義、真理； for the fruit of the light [results] in all goodness, righteousness, and truth--
10. 要分辨什麼是主所喜悅的事。 discerning what is pleasing to the Lord.
11. 你們不要參與那些屬黑暗結不出果子的事，反而要把那些事揭露出來， Don't participate in the fruitless works of darkness, but instead, expose them.
12. 因為他們暗中所做的，連說出來也是可恥的。 For it is shameful even to mention what is done by them in secret.
13. 然而，一切被光所揭露的事，都要成為明顯的， Everything exposed by the light is made clear,
14. 因為使一切成為明顯的，就是光。所以有話說： 「醒過來！睡著的人哪，從死人中起來吧！ 基督就要光照你了！」 for what makes everything clear is light. Therefore it is said: Get up, sleeper, and rise up from the dead, and the Messiah will shine on you.
15. 所以，你們要仔細察看怎樣行事為人，不要像沒有智慧的人，而要像有智慧的人； Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk-- not as unwise people but as wise--
16. 要把握機會，因為這時代是邪惡的。 making the most of the time, because the days are evil.
17. 為此，不要做愚妄的人，而要領悟主的旨意是什麼。 So don't be foolish, but understand what the Lord's will is.
18. 不要醉酒，醉酒帶來 放蕩，而要被聖靈充滿： And don't get drunk with wine, which [leads to] reckless actions, but be filled with the Spirit:
19. 用詩篇、聖詩、屬靈的詩歌彼此對說， 從你們的心裡，歌頌讚美主； speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing and making music to the Lord in your heart,
20. 奉我們主耶穌基督的名， 為一切常常感謝父神； giving thanks always for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
21. 懷著敬畏基督 的心，彼此服從。 submitting to one another in the fear of Christ.
22. 你們做妻子的，要服從 自己的丈夫，如同服從主， Wives, submit to your own husbands as to the Lord,
23. 因為丈夫是妻子的頭，正如基督是教會的頭；他也是這身體的救主。 for the husband is head of the wife as also Christ is head of the church. He is the Savior of the body.
24. 而且教會怎樣服從基督，妻子也照樣要在一切事上服從 丈夫。 Now as the church submits to Christ, so wives should [submit] to their husbands in everything.
25. 你們做丈夫的，要愛自己的妻子，就像基督也愛了教會，為她捨棄了自己。 Husbands, love your wives, just as also Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her,
26. 基督這麼做，是要藉著話語，用水 的洗滌而潔淨教會，使她分別為聖， to make her holy, cleansing her in the washing of water by the word.
27. 為要給自己預備一個榮耀的教會，沒有汙漬、皺紋或任何這類的事，卻要她成為聖潔、毫無瑕疵。 He did this to present the church to Himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but holy and blameless.
28. 照樣，丈夫也應該愛自己的妻子，就像愛自己的身體一樣；那愛自己妻子的，就是愛自己。 In the same way, husbands should love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
29. 從來沒有人恨惡自己的身體，總是保養、顧惜它，就像基督 對待教會那樣， For no one ever hates his own flesh, but provides and cares for it, just as Christ does for the church,
30. 因為我們是基督身體的各個部分 。 since we are members of His body.
31. 「為這緣故，人將離開父母， 與妻子結合， 兩個人就成為一體。」 For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.
32. 這是極大的奧祕，但我是指著基督和教會說的。 This mystery is profound, but I am talking about Christ and the church.
33. 不過，你們每一個人也要愛自己的妻子，就像愛自己一樣；而妻子要敬重 丈夫。 To sum up, each one of you is to love his wife as himself, and the wife is to respect her husband.
Ephesians 6
1. 你們做兒女的，要在主裡順從自己的父母，因為這是理所當然的。 Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
2. 「要孝敬父母，使你得福，在地上長壽。」 這是第一條 帶著應許的誡命。 Honor your father and mother-- which is the first commandment with a promise--
3. that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life in the land.
4. 你們做父親的，不要惹自己兒女生氣，而要照著主的訓練和警戒養育他們。 And fathers, don't stir up anger in your children, but bring them up in the training and instruction of the Lord.
5. 你們做奴僕的，要懷著敬畏和戰兢，以忠實的心順從自己在世上的 主人，就像聽從基督一樣。 Slaves, obey your human masters with fear and trembling, in the sincerity of your heart, as to Christ.
6. 不要只在人眼前服事，像是討人的歡心，而要像基督的奴僕，從心裡遵行神的旨意。 Don't [work only] while being watched, in order to please men, but as slaves of Christ, do God's will from your heart.
7. 要甘心樂意地服事，如同服事主，不是服事人， Render service with a good attitude, as to the Lord and not to men,
8. 因為你們知道：每個人，無論是奴隸或是自由人，如果做了什麼美善的事，就將從主那裡領受這事的回報。 knowing that whatever good each one does, slave or free, he will receive this back from the Lord.
9. 你們做主人的，對奴僕也要這樣做，不要威嚇他們，因為你們知道，他們和你們同樣有一位主人在天上，而且他是不偏待人的。 And masters, treat them the same way, without threatening them, because you know that both their and your Master is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
10. 最後， 你們要在主裡藉著他力量的權能得以剛強。 Finally, be strengthened by the Lord and by His vast strength.
11. 你們要配上神的全副武裝，使你們得以站立，對付魔鬼的騙局， Put on the full armor of God so that you can stand against the tactics of the Devil.
12. 因為我們不是與血肉之體搏鬥，而是與那些統治的、掌權的、管轄這黑暗世界的，以及天上邪惡的屬靈勢力搏鬥。 For our battle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the world powers of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavens.
13. 為此，要拿起神的全副武裝，好使你們在邪惡的日子能夠抵擋，並且在完成一切以後，還站立得住。 This is why you must take up the full armor of God, so that you may be able to resist in the evil day, and having prepared everything, to take your stand.
14. 所以，你們要站立得住： 用真理束上腰，穿上公義的護胸甲； Stand, therefore, with truth like a belt around your waist, righteousness like armor on your chest,
15. 把所預備好的和平 福音，穿在腳上； and your feet sandaled with readiness for the gospel of peace.
16. 在任何情況下，要拿起信仰的盾牌； 你們藉著它就能消滅那惡者一切燃燒的飛箭； In every situation take the shield of faith, and with it you will be able to extinguish the flaming arrows of the evil one.
17. 並且要接受救恩的頭盔和聖靈的寶劍——就是神的話語。 Take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is God's word.
18. 你們要以各樣的禱告和祈求，藉著聖靈時刻祈禱；而且為此警醒，以極大的忍耐，為所有聖徒祈求， With every prayer and request, pray at all times in the Spirit, and stay alert in this, with all perseverance and intercession for all the saints.
19. 也為我祈求，好使我在開口的時候被賜予話語，能坦然無懼地讓人明白福音的奧祕—— Pray also for me, that the message may be given to me when I open my mouth to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel.
20. 為此，我成了帶鎖鏈的特使。請為我祈求，使我能照著應該說的，放膽傳道。 For this I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I might be bold enough in Him to speak as I should.
21. 在主裡蒙愛的弟兄、忠心的僕人 特其庫斯，會讓你們明白一切，好讓你們也知道有關我的事和我現在所做的事。 Tychicus, our dearly loved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything so that you also may know how I am and what I'm doing.
22. 我正是為此派他到你們那裡去，好讓你們知道有關我們的事，並且讓他安慰你們的心。 I am sending him to you for this very reason, to let you know how we are and to encourage your hearts.
23. 願平安以及隨著信仰的愛，從父神和主耶穌基督臨到弟兄們！ Peace to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
24. 願恩典與所有愛我們主耶穌基督的人同在——直到永遠 ！ Grace be with all who have undying love for our Lord Jesus Christ.
Philippians
Philippians 1
1. 基督耶穌的奴僕 保羅 和 提摩太， 致住在 腓立比，在基督耶穌裡的所有聖徒，包括各位監督和執事 ： Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus: To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, including the overseers and deacons.
2. 願恩典與平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督臨到你們！ Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
3. 每當想到你們，我就感謝我的神； I give thanks to my God for every remembrance of you,
4. 每次為你們大家祈禱的時候，我總是懷著喜樂的心祈禱， always praying with joy for all of you in my every prayer,
5. 因你們從第一天到如今，一直在福音工作上相契合 。 because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now.
6. 我正是深信這一點：就是在你們裡面開始了美善工作的那一位，將會完成這工作，直到基督耶穌的日子 。 I am sure of this, that He who started a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
7. 我理當這樣思念你們大家，因為你們常把我放在心上 ；無論我是在捆鎖當中，還是在為福音辯護或做見證的時候，你們都是在恩典上與我一同有份。 It is right for me to think this way about all of you, because I have you in my heart, and you are all partners with me in grace, both in my imprisonment and in the defense and establishment of the gospel.
8. 實際上，神可以為我見證：我是怎樣以基督耶穌的情感，切切地想念你們大家的。 For God is my witness, how I deeply miss all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
9. 我是這樣禱告的：願你們的愛心能在真正的知識和一切分辨力上，越來越豐足有餘， And I pray this: that your love will keep on growing in knowledge and every kind of discernment,
10. 使你們能分辨是非，好在基督的日子裡是純潔、無可指責的， so that you can determine what really matters and can be pure and blameless in the day of Christ,
11. 並且充滿了那藉著耶穌基督而來的義行果子，歸於神的榮耀和稱讚。 filled with the fruit of righteousness that [comes] through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
12. 弟兄們，我願你們知道，我的遭遇反而促進了福音的進展， Now I want you to know, brothers, that what has happened to me has actually resulted in the advancement of the gospel,
13. 以致整個王宮衛隊 和所有其餘的人，都清楚我是為基督的緣故被捆鎖的； so that it has become known throughout the whole imperial guard, and to everyone else, that my imprisonment is for Christ.
14. 並且大多數的弟兄因著我所受的捆鎖，就在主裡深信不疑、無所懼怕，更加大膽地傳講這話語 。 Most of the brothers in the Lord have gained confidence from my imprisonment and dare even more to speak the message fearlessly.
