15. 有些人傳揚基督固然是出於嫉妒和紛爭，但也有些人是出於好意。 Some, to be sure, preach Christ out of envy and strife, but others out of good will.
16. 後者是出於愛，知道我是為辯護福音而受委派的； These do so out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel;
17. 前者傳講基督是出於爭競，不是出於真誠，想要在我的捆鎖中，增加 我的患難。 the others proclaim Christ out of rivalry, not sincerely, seeking to cause [me] trouble in my imprisonment.
18. 這到底有什麼關係呢？只是在各種方法中，無論是假意還是真心，基督都被傳開了；我為此就歡喜，並且還要歡喜， What does it matter? Just that in every way, whether out of false motives or true, Christ is proclaimed. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will rejoice
19. 因為我知道，藉著你們的祈禱和耶穌基督之靈的幫助，事情將為我轉變以致我獲救。 because I know this will lead to my deliverance through your prayers and help from the Spirit of Jesus Christ.
20. 我的熱切盼望和期待是：我在任何事上都將不至於蒙羞；而現在也能像往常一樣，無論藉著生，還是藉著死，總要滿有膽量地讓基督在我身上被尊為大。 My eager expectation and hope is that I will not be ashamed about anything, but that now as always, with all boldness, Christ will be highly honored in my body, whether by life or by death.
21. 因為對我來說，活著就是基督，死去就有益處。 For me, living is Christ and dying is gain.
22. 但如果我繼續活在世上，這就使我有工作的成果，於是我不明白該怎樣選擇了。 Now if I live on in the flesh, this means fruitful work for me; and I don't know which one I should choose.
23. 我正處在兩難之間：我渴望離世與基督在一起，因為這是好得無比的； I am pressured by both. I have the desire to depart and be with Christ-- which is far better--
24. 可是為了你們的緣故，我更需要留在世上 。 but to remain in the flesh is more necessary for you.
25. 既然我深信這一點，就知道我會活下去，並且將繼續和你們大家在一起，好使你們在信仰上有長進、有喜樂。 Since I am persuaded of this, I know that I will remain and continue with all of you for your advancement and joy in the faith,
26. 以致因著我再次到你們那裡去，你們在基督耶穌裡，對我的誇耀能充實滿溢。 so that, because of me, your confidence may grow in Christ Jesus when I come to you again.
27. 只是你們行事為人 要配得上基督的福音，好讓我無論是來見你們，還是不在你們那裡的時候，都可以聽到有關你們的事，就是你們懷有一個心志站立得穩，同心合意地為福音的信仰一起奮戰； Just one thing: live your life in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or am absent, I will hear about you that you are standing firm in one spirit, with one mind, working side by side for the faith of the gospel,
28. 在任何事上都不被反對你們的人嚇倒——這對他們是滅亡 的證明，而對你們卻是得救的證明，並且這是出於神。 not being frightened in any way by your opponents. This is evidence of their destruction, but of your deliverance-- and this is from God.
29. 原來你們為基督所蒙的恩是：不僅要信基督，而且還要為他受苦， For it has been given to you on Christ's behalf not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
30. 去經歷你們在我身上所看到、現在又聽到的那同樣的爭戰。 having the same struggle that you saw I had and now hear about me.
Philippians 2
1. 所以，你們如果在基督裡有任何鼓勵、任何愛的安慰、任何聖靈裡的契合 、任何情感和憐憫， If then there is any encouragement in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and mercy,
2. 你們就要同心合意——愛心一致、靈裡一致、意念一致，好使我的喜樂得以滿足。 fulfill my joy by thinking the same way, having the same love, sharing the same feelings, focusing on one goal.
3. 做任何事都不要出於爭競，也不可出於虛榮，而要以謙卑的心，各人看別人比自己強； Do nothing out of rivalry or conceit, but in humility consider others as more important than yourselves.
4. 每個人不要只注重自己的事，也要注重別人的事。 Everyone should look out not [only] for his own interests, but also for the interests of others.
5. 你們應當有這樣的意念，這也是基督耶穌的意念。 Make your own attitude that of Christ Jesus,
6. 雖然他就是神本體的存在， 卻不把與神同等看做是一件要強抓不放的事， who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God as something to be used for His own advantage.
7. 反而倒空自己， 取了奴僕的形像，成為人的樣式， 以人的形態出現， Instead He emptied Himself by assuming the form of a slave, taking on the likeness of men. And when He had come as a man in His external form,
8. 降卑自己，順從至死， 甚至死在十字架上！ He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to the point of death-- even to death on a cross.
9. 因此神使他升為至高， 賜給他那超越萬名之上的名， For this reason God also highly exalted Him and gave Him the name that is above every name,
10. 好使天上、地上和地底下的一切， 因耶穌的名都屈膝， so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow-- of those who are in heaven and on earth and under the earth--
11. 萬口為了父神的榮耀 要承認耶穌基督是主。 and every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
12. 因此，我親愛的各位，既然你們一直是順從的——不僅我在的時候如此，現今我不在的時候更加順從——就當懷著敬畏和戰兢的心，把你們的救恩行出來， So then, my dear friends, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
13. 因為是神在你們裡面運作，使你們願意並且能行出他的美意。 For it is God who is working in you, [enabling you] both to will and to act for His good purpose.
14. 做任何事都不要抱怨或爭論， Do everything without grumbling and arguing,
15. 好使你們成為無可指責、純潔無偽的人，在這扭曲、敗壞的世代中，做神毫無瑕疵的兒女；在這世代中，要像星星的光輝一樣照耀在世上。 so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God who are faultless in a crooked and perverted generation, among whom you shine like stars in the world.
16. 你們要持守生命的話語，好讓我在基督的日子 裡可以誇耀我所奔跑的沒有落空，我所勞苦的也沒有落空。 Hold firmly the message of life. Then I can boast in the day of Christ that I didn't run in vain or labor for nothing.
17. 然而，即使我被做為奠祭，澆在你們信仰的祭物和服事上，我也歡喜，並且和你們大家一同歡喜； But even if I am poured out as a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
18. 你們也應該照樣歡喜，並且與我一同歡喜。 In the same way you also should rejoice and share your joy with me.
19. 我在主耶穌裡，希望不久能派 提摩太 到你們那裡去，好讓我也知道有關你們的事，可以心情愉快。 Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon so that I also may be encouraged when I hear news about you.
20. 實際上，我沒有別的人與我同心，真正地掛慮你們的事； For I have no one else like-minded who will genuinely care about your interests;
21. 因為大家都尋求自己的事，不尋求耶穌基督的事。 all seek their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
22. 但是，你們是知道 提摩太 那經過考驗的品德。因為他在福音工作上與我一起服事，就像兒子與父親那樣。 But you know his proven character, because he has served with me in the gospel ministry like a son with a father.
23. 所以我希望，一旦知道我的事有什麼結局，就立即派他去。 Therefore, I hope to send him as soon as I see how things go with me.
24. 不過我在主裡深信，我自己不久也會去的。 And I am convinced in the Lord that I myself will also come quickly.
25. 然而，我認為必須派 以帕弗迪托 到你們那裡去；他是我的弟兄、同工、戰友，也是你們的使者，是為我的需要而來的服事者， But I considered it necessary to send you Epaphroditus-- my brother, co-worker, and fellow soldier, as well as your messenger and minister to my need--
26. 因為他一直切切地想念你們大家，並且因你們聽說他患了病，他就極其難過。 since he has been longing for all of you and was distressed because you heard that he was sick.
27. 事實上，他雖然患了病幾乎死去，可是神憐憫了他；不僅憐憫他，也憐憫了我，免得我憂上加憂。 Indeed, he was so sick that he nearly died. However, God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have one grief on top of another.
28. 所以，我就更迫切地派他去，好讓你們見到他，能夠再次歡喜，而我也可以少些掛慮。 For this reason, I am very eager to send him so that you may rejoice when you see him again and I may be less anxious.
29. 因此，你們要在主裡滿懷喜樂地歡迎他，也要敬重這樣的人， Therefore, welcome him in the Lord with all joy and hold men like him in honor,
30. 因為他為了基督的工作，幾乎至死，冒了生命的危險，為要彌補你們服事我的缺乏。 because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up what was lacking in your ministry to me.
Philippians 3
1. 此外，我的弟兄們，你們要在主裡歡喜。 我把同樣的話寫給你們，一方面對我不是麻煩，另一方面對你們是一種保護。 Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write to you again about this is no trouble for me and is a protection for you.
2. 你們要當心那些犬類，當心那些作惡的工人，當心那些妄割身體的人。 Watch out for "dogs," watch out for evil workers, watch out for those who mutilate the flesh.
3. 實際上，我們才是受過割禮的人，就是藉著神的靈事奉，在基督耶穌裡誇耀，不依靠肉體的人。 For we are the circumcision, the ones who serve by the Spirit of God, boast in Christ Jesus, and do not put confidence in the flesh--
4. 其實我也可以依靠肉體；如果另外有人自以為可以依靠肉體，我就更可以了。 although I once had confidence in the flesh too. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
5. 我出生 第八天受了割禮；我屬於 以色列 族、 便雅憫 支派，是 希伯來 人所生的 希伯來 人；按照律法說，我是 法利賽 人； circumcised the eighth day; of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew born of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
6. 按照熱心說，我曾經逼迫教會；按照律法上的義說，我是無可指責的。 as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to the righteousness that is in the law, blameless.
7. 然而，以前對我有益的事，現在因基督的緣故，我已經把這些事看做是損失。 But everything that was a gain to me, I have considered to be a loss because of Christ.
8. 不但如此，我甚至把一切都看做是損失，因為我把認識我主基督耶穌看為是至高無上的。我為基督耶穌損失了一切，而且把一切都看做是糞土，為要贏得基督， More than that, I also consider everything to be a loss in view of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. Because of Him I have suffered the loss of all things and consider them filth, so that I may gain Christ
9. 並且要被認定在他裡面——不是擁有那本於律法的自己的義，而是擁有那藉著信基督而來的義，就是來自神、基於信的義； and be found in Him, not having a righteousness of my own from the law, but one that is through faith in Christ-- the righteousness from God based on faith.
10. 並且為要認識基督和他復活的大能，要在他的苦難裡相契合，效法他的死， [My goal] is to know Him and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to His death,
11. 或許我能得以從死人中復活。 assuming that I will somehow reach the resurrection from among the dead.
12. 這並不是說我已經得到了，或已經得以完全了，而是說我在竭力追求，或許我真的可以得著 ；為此我也被基督耶穌得著 了。 Not that I have already reached [the goal] or am already fully mature, but I make every effort to take hold of it because I also have been taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
13. 弟兄們，我不認為自己已經得著 了；但是我有一件事：就是忘記背後，爭取前面的， Brothers, I do not consider myself to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: forgetting what is behind and reaching forward to what is ahead,
14. 向著目標竭力追求，為了得到 那在基督耶穌裡、神至高召喚的獎賞。 I pursue as my goal the prize promised by God's heavenly call in Christ Jesus.
15. 因此，讓我們所有成熟的人 都這樣思想。如果你們有什麼不同的思想，神也會把這事啟示給你們。 Therefore, all who are mature should think this way. And if you think differently about anything, God will reveal this to you also.
16. 不過我們達到了什麼標準，就讓我們照著什麼標準行走 。 In any case, we should live up to whatever [truth] we have attained.
17. 弟兄們，你們要一同效法我，也要留心看那些像你們一樣，以我們為榜樣行事的人。 Join in imitating me, brothers, and observe those who live according to the example you have in us.
18. 其實我過去再三地告訴你們，而現在又流著眼淚告訴你們：有許多人的行事為人，是基督十字架的仇敵。 For I have often told you, and now say again with tears, that many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
19. 他們的結局就是滅亡 ；他們的神就是自己的私欲 ；他們的榮耀在自己的羞恥之中；他們所思想的都是地上的事。 Their end is destruction; their god is their stomach; their glory is in their shame. They are focused on earthly things,
20. 然而，我們的國籍在天上；我們也熱切等待著救主——主耶穌基督從那裡降臨。 but our citizenship is in heaven, from which we also eagerly wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
21. 他將照著那能使萬有都服從他的力量，改變我們這卑賤的身體，要 與他那榮耀的身體相似。 He will transform the body of our humble condition into the likeness of His glorious body, by the power that enables Him to subject everything to Himself.
Philippians 4
1. 因此，我所愛的、所想念的弟兄們，我的喜樂、我的冠冕哪！各位蒙愛的人，你們當如此在主裡站立得穩！ So then, in this way, my dearly loved brothers, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord, dear friends.
2. 我懇求 猶迪婭，也懇求 辛圖柯，要在主裡同心合意。 I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to agree in the Lord.
3. 是的，我真誠的同伴 哪！我也請求你幫助她們兩位 。她們在福音工作上曾經與我、 克萊門斯，和我的其他同工們一起奮戰，這些人的名字都在生命冊上。 Yes, I also ask you, true partner, to help these women who have contended for the gospel at my side, along with Clement and the rest of my co-workers whose names are in the book of life.
4. 你們要在主裡常常歡喜。我再說，你們要歡喜！ Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
5. 要讓所有人知道你們的謙和。主快到了！ Let your graciousness be known to everyone. The Lord is near.
6. 在任何事上都不要憂慮；然而要在一切事上，藉著禱告和祈求，以感謝的心把你們所求的告訴神。 Don't worry about anything, but in everything, through prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
7. 這樣，神的平安——那高過一切理性的平安，就會在基督耶穌裡保守你們的心、你們的意念。 And the peace of God, which surpasses every thought, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
8. 最後，弟兄們，凡是真實的、莊重的、公義的、純潔的、可羨慕的、高尚的，如果有什麼美德，如果有什麼可稱讚的，這些事你們就當思想； Finally brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is just, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is commendable-- if there is any moral excellence and if there is any praise-- dwell on these things.
9. 凡是你們在我身上所學到的、所領受的、所聽到的、所看到的，這些事你們就當實行。這樣，賜平安的神就會與你們同在。 Do what you have learned and received and heard and seen in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
10. 我在主裡極其歡喜，因為現在你們終於又萌發了思念我的心。其實你們一直在思念我，只是沒有機會表達 。 I rejoiced in the Lord greatly that now at last you have renewed your care for me. You were, in fact, concerned about me, but lacked the opportunity [to show it].
11. 我這樣說，並不是因為我缺少什麼；事實上，我已經學會了在任何情況下都知足。 I don't say this out of need, for I have learned to be content in whatever circumstances I am.
12. 我知道怎樣處卑賤，也知道怎樣處豐富；在一切事上，在一切情況下，或飽足、或飢餓，或豐富、或缺乏，我都得了祕訣。 I know both how to have a little, and I know how to have a lot. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret [of being content]-- whether well-fed or hungry, whether in abundance or in need.
13. 藉著使我剛強的那一位，我一切都能。 I am able to do all things through Him who strengthens me.
14. 不過你們分擔了我的患難，做得很好。 Still, you did well by sharing with me in my hardship.
15. 腓立比 人哪，你們也知道，在福音工作的開始，我離開 馬其頓 省的時候，在供給和領受的事上，除了你們以外，沒有別的教會與我分享。 And you, Philippians, know that in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving except you alone.
16. 就是我在 帖撒羅尼迦 的時候，你們甚至也一再地把我所需要的送來。 For even in Thessalonica you sent [gifts] for my need several times.
17. 我並不是求什麼供應，而是求你們的果子增多，歸在你們的帳上。 Not that I seek the gift, but I seek the fruit that is increasing to your account.
18. 如今我一切都得到了，並且豐足有餘。我已經得以滿足了，因為我從 以帕弗迪托 接受了來自你們的東西；那是馨香的氣味，是神所悅納、所喜悅的祭物。 But I have received everything in full, and I have an abundance. I am fully supplied, having received from Epaphroditus what you provided-- a fragrant offering, a welcome sacrifice, pleasing to God.
19. 我的神將按照他榮耀的豐盛，在基督耶穌裡滿足你們一切的需要。 And my God will supply all your needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
20. 願榮耀歸於神我們的父，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 Now to our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
21. 請問候在基督耶穌裡的每一位聖徒。與我在一起的弟兄們都問候你們； Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. Those brothers who are with me greet you.
22. 所有的聖徒，尤其是來自凱撒宮裡的人，也都問候你們。 All the saints greet you, but especially those from Caesar's household.
23. 願主耶穌基督的恩典與你們的靈 同在！ The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
Colossians
Colossians 1
1. 照著神的旨意做基督耶穌使徒的 保羅，以及弟兄 提摩太， Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, and Timothy our brother:
2. 致 歌羅西 的聖徒們，就是在基督裡忠心的弟兄： 願恩典與平安從神我們的父 臨到你們！ To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ in Colossae. Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
3. 我們為你們禱告的時候，總是感謝神我們主耶穌基督的父， We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
4. 因為我們聽說了你們在基督耶穌裡的信仰，以及對所有聖徒所懷的愛—— for we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love you have for all the saints
5. 這信心和愛是藉著那為你們存留在天上的盼望，這盼望是你們在傳到你們那裡的福音真理之話語中所聽過的， because of the hope reserved for you in heaven. You have already heard about [this hope] in the message of truth,
6. 正如它在全世界，不斷地結果子和擴展 ；自從你們在真理中聽見並了解神恩典的那一天起，在你們中間也像這一樣， the gospel that has come to you. It is bearing fruit and growing all over the world, just as it has among you since the day you heard it and recognized God's grace in the truth.
7. 正如你們從蒙愛的人，就是與我們同做奴僕的 以帕弗拉 那裡所學到的；他為你們 做了基督忠心的僕人， You learned this from Epaphras, our much loved fellow slave. He is a faithful minister of the Messiah on your behalf,
8. 也把你們在聖靈裡的愛告訴了我們。 and he has told us about your love in the Spirit.
9. 為此，我們自從聽到這事的那一天起，就不斷地為你們禱告和祈求：願你們藉著一切屬靈的智慧和悟性，能被神旨意的真正知識所充滿； For this reason also, since the day we heard this, we haven't stopped praying for you. We are asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding,
10. 好讓你們行事為人配得上主，凡事蒙他喜悅，在一切美善的工作中結出果子，在神的真正知識上不斷長進。 so that you may walk worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing [to Him], bearing fruit in every good work and growing in the knowledge of God.
11. 願你們按照他榮耀的權能，藉著一切能力得以剛強，好讓你們凡事忍耐寬容，懷著喜樂的心 May you be strengthened with all power, according to His glorious might, for all endurance and patience, with joy
12. 感謝父——他使你們 能夠分享聖徒們在光明中的繼業； giving thanks to the Father, who has enabled you to share in the saints' inheritance in the light.
13. 他救我們脫離了黑暗的權勢，把我們遷入他愛子的國度； He has rescued us from the domain of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of the Son He loves,
14. 在他裡面， 我們得蒙救贖，罪得赦免。 in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
15. 愛子是那不可見之神的形像， 是一切被造之物的長子， He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation;
16. 因為萬有都是藉著他造的： 天上和地上的，看得見和看不見的， 無論王位或主權，統治的或掌權的， 一切都是藉著他造的，也是為他而造的， because by Him everything was created, in heaven and on earth, the visible and the invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities-- all things have been created through Him and for Him.
17. 他在萬有之先，萬有也藉著他而存在， He is before all things, and by Him all things hold together.
18. 他是身體的頭，就是教會的頭， 他是元始，是從死人中首先復活的， 為要使他能在萬有中居首位， He is also the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, so that He might come to have first place in everything.
19. 因為父 樂意使一切的豐盛完美都住在他裡面， For God was pleased [to have] all His fullness dwell in Him,
20. 又藉著他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平， 就是藉著他使萬有——無論地上的或天上的—— 都與他自己和好了。 and through Him to reconcile everything to Himself by making peace through the blood of His cross-- whether things on earth or things in heaven.
21. 從前，你們在邪惡的行為中與神 隔絕，在意念中與他為敵； And you were once alienated and hostile in mind because of your evil actions.
22. 但如今，神在基督的血肉之軀上，藉著死使你們與他自己和好了，並且使你們站在他面前，是聖潔、毫無瑕疵、無可指責的。 But now He has reconciled you by His physical body through His death, to present you holy, faultless, and blameless before Him--
23. 可是你們要持守信仰，立定根基，堅定不移，不要從你們所聽到的福音盼望上被挪去。這福音是傳給天下萬人 的，我 保羅 也成了這福音的僕人 。 if indeed you remain grounded and steadfast in the faith, and are not shifted away from the hope of the gospel that you heard. [This gospel] has been proclaimed in all creation under heaven, and I, Paul, have become a minister of it.
24. 如今我為你們受苦難，感到歡喜；並且我為基督的身體，就是教會，要在我的肉體上補滿基督患難的缺欠。 Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I am completing in my flesh what is lacking in Christ's afflictions for His body, that is, the church.
25. 神為了你們的緣故賜給了我任務，我按照這任務成為教會的僕人，為要使神的話語 完全傳開 。 I have become its minister, according to God's administration that was given to me for you, to make God's message fully known,
26. 這話語就是歷世歷代被隱藏的奧祕，但如今已經顯明給他的聖徒們。 the mystery hidden for ages and generations but now revealed to His saints.
27. 神願意在外邦人中，讓他們明白什麼是這奧祕的榮耀的豐盛；那就是：基督在你們裡面，他是榮耀的盼望！ God wanted to make known to those among the Gentiles the glorious wealth of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
28. 我們傳揚基督，用一切的智慧勸誡所有人，教導所有人，好讓我們使所有的人在基督 裡成熟，能夠獻給神 。 We proclaim Him, warning and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone mature in Christ.
29. 我也為此勞苦，藉著他在我裡面的大能作為而爭戰。 I labor for this, striving with His strength that works powerfully in me.
Colossians 2
1. 我希望你們知道，我為你們和那些在 勞迪西亞 的人，以及一切沒有親自 看到我面的人，有多麼大的爭戰， For I want you to know how great a struggle I have for you, for those in Laodicea, and for all who have not seen me in person.
2. 好讓他們的心受到安慰，在愛中結合在一起，以致得到 由悟性的確信不疑而來的一切豐盛，直到真正認識神的奧祕，就是基督 —— [I want] their hearts to be encouraged and joined together in love, so that they may have all the riches of assured understanding, and have the knowledge of God's mystery-- Christ.
3. 在他裡面隱藏著一切智慧和知識的財寶。 In Him all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
4. 我說這話，是免得有人用花言巧語欺騙你們。 I am saying this so that no one will deceive you with persuasive arguments.
5. 因為，我雖然身體不在你們那裡，心靈卻與你們同在，而且看見你們有秩序，對基督的信仰也堅定不移，我就感到快樂。 For I may be absent in body, but I am with you in spirit, rejoicing to see your good order and the strength of your faith in Christ.
6. 所以，你們怎樣接受了主基督耶穌，就應當怎樣在他裡面行事， Therefore as you have received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in Him,
7. 照著你們所受的教導，在他裡面得以扎根、建造，在信仰上得以確立，在感謝中豐足有餘。 rooted and built up in Him and established in the faith, just as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
8. 你們要當心，免得有人用哲學和虛空的妄言把你們擄去；那些是出於人的傳統，出於世界的原則，而不是出於基督。 Be careful that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deceit based on human tradition, based on the elemental forces of the world, and not based on Christ.
9. 這是因為神本性的一切豐盛完美都有形有體地居住在基督裡面； For in Him the entire fullness of God's nature dwells bodily,
10. 你們在他裡面已經得以滿足，他是一切統治者和掌權者的元首 ； and you have been filled by Him, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
11. 在他裡面，你們也受了割禮，不是藉著人的手，而是藉著脫去那血肉之軀，藉著基督的割禮。 In Him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not done with hands, by putting off the body of flesh, in the circumcision of the Messiah.
12. 你們既然在洗禮中與基督一同被埋葬，也就在洗禮中 與基督一同復活了，這是藉著相信使基督從死人中復活之神的作為。 Having been buried with Him in baptism, you were also raised with Him through faith in the working of God, who raised Him from the dead.
13. 你們從前在自己的過犯和沒有受割禮的肉體中是死的，神卻使你們與基督一同活過來了。神已經赦免了我們 的一切過犯， And when you were dead in trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, He made you alive with Him and forgave us all our trespasses.
14. 抹去了在敵對我們的那些規條中反對我們的債務記錄，並且把它從中除掉，釘在十字架上。 He erased the certificate of debt, with its obligations, that was against us and opposed to us, and has taken it out of the way by nailing it to the cross.
15. 神既然剝奪了那些統治者和掌權者的權勢，就公開羞辱 他們；藉著基督 向他們誇勝 了。 He disarmed the rulers and authorities and disgraced them publicly; He triumphed over them by Him.
16. 所以，在吃喝的事上，或在有關節日、月朔或安息日的事上，不要讓人評斷你們。 Therefore don't let anyone judge you in regard to food and drink or in the matter of a festival or a new moon or a sabbath day.
17. 這些不過是將來之事的影子，而實體卻屬於基督。 These are a shadow of what was to come; the substance is the Messiah.
18. 不要讓任何人藉著故意謙卑和敬拜天使來奪去你們的獎賞；他們沉迷在自己所看到的幻象 中，在自己肉體的理性之下，毫無理由地自我膨脹， Let no one disqualify you, insisting on ascetic practices and the worship of angels, claiming access to a visionary realm and inflated without cause by his fleshly mind.
19. 不與元首 緊密相連。本於他，全身得到供應，藉著關節和筋絡結合在一起，在屬神的成長中長大。 He doesn't hold on to the head, from whom the whole body, nourished and held together by its ligaments and tendons, develops with growth from God.
20. 你們如果已經和基督一同死了，脫離了世界的原則，為什麼還像活在這世俗中一樣，拘守那些 If you died with Christ to the elemental forces of this world, why do you live as if you still belonged to the world? Why do you submit to regulations:
21. 「不可碰，不可嘗，不可摸」之類的條例呢？ "Don't handle, don't taste, don't touch"?
22. 這些東西都是一經使用就要衰朽 的，是出於人的規條和教義； All these [regulations] refer to what is destroyed by being used up; they are human commands and doctrines.
23. 它們雖然藉著自造宗教、謙卑低微、苦待身體，外表有智慧，但在對付放任肉體的事上，沒有任何價值。 Although these have a reputation of wisdom by promoting ascetic practices, humility, and severe treatment of the body, they are not of any value against fleshly indulgence.
Colossians 3
1. 所以，你們如果已經與基督一同復活了，就應當尋求上面的事；在那裡，基督坐在神的右邊。 So if you have been raised with the Messiah, seek what is above, where the Messiah is, seated at the right hand of God.
2. 你們要思想上面的事，不要思想地上的事， Set your minds on what is above, not on what is on the earth.
3. 因為你們已經死了，你們的生命與基督一同藏在神裡面。 For you have died, and your life is hidden with the Messiah in God.
4. 基督是你們 的生命，當他顯現的時候，你們那時也就和他一同在榮耀裡顯現。 When the Messiah, who is your life, is revealed, then you also will be revealed with Him in glory.
5. 所以，當把你們屬世的 各個部分看為死了的，就如淫亂、汙穢、邪情、惡欲和貪心，貪心就是拜偶像。 Therefore, put to death whatever in you is worldly: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desire, and greed, which is idolatry.
6. 為了這些事，神的震怒就臨到那些不信從的兒女身上 ； Because of these, God's wrath comes on the disobedient,
7. 當你們從前生活在這些事中的時候，也在其中生活 。 and you once walked in these things when you were living in them.
8. 但如今，你們也要脫去一切暴怒、憤恨、惡毒、毀謗，以及從你們口中所出的汙穢的話； But now you must also put away all the following: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and filthy language from your mouth.
9. 不要彼此說謊，因你們已經脫去了舊人和舊人的所作所為， Do not lie to one another, since you have put off the old man with his practices
10. 並且穿上了新人。這新人照著創造他那一位的形像不斷地被更新，以致真正認識他。 and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge according to the image of his Creator.
11. 在這裡沒有 希臘 人和 猶太 人，受割禮的和不受割禮的，外族人、 塞西亞 人 、奴隸、自由人；而基督就是一切，也在一切之中。 Here there is not Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, slave and free; but Christ is all and in all.
12. 因此，你們身為蒙神揀選、聖潔和蒙愛的人，就應當穿上憐憫的心腸，以及仁慈、謙卑、溫柔、耐心。 Therefore, God's chosen ones, holy and loved, put on heartfelt compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience,
13. 如果一個人對另一個人懷有不滿，總要彼此容忍，互相饒恕。正如主 饒恕了你們，你們也當如此。 accepting one another and forgiving one another if anyone has a complaint against another. Just as the Lord has forgiven you, so also you must [forgive].
14. 在這一切之上，還要穿上愛——愛就是成熟境界的聯結。 Above all, [put on] love-- the perfect bond of unity.
15. 又要讓基督 的和平在你們心裡做主；你們也為此蒙召歸於一體。你們要有感謝的心。 And let the peace of the Messiah, to which you were also called in one body, control your hearts. Be thankful.
16. 你們要讓基督的話語豐豐富富地住在你們裡面，要用一切的智慧彼此教導、勸誡，懷著感恩的心，以詩篇、聖詩、屬靈的詩歌來歌頌神 。 Let the message about the Messiah dwell richly among you, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom, and singing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, with gratitude in your hearts to God.
17. 你們無論做什麼，或在言語上或在行為上，都要奉主耶穌的名，藉著他感謝父神。 And whatever you do, in word or in deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
18. 你們做妻子的，要服從丈夫，這在主裡是合宜的； Wives, be submissive to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
19. 你們做丈夫的，要愛妻子，不可對她們懷有苦毒； Husbands, love your wives and don't become bitter against them.
20. 你們做兒女的，要凡事順從父母，因為這在主裡是蒙喜悅的； Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing in the Lord.
21. 你們做父親的，不要惹自己兒女生氣，免得他們灰心喪志； Fathers, do not exasperate your children, so they won't become discouraged.
22. 你們做奴僕的，凡事都要順從自己在世上的 主人，不要只在人眼前服事，像是討人的歡心，而要以忠實的心敬畏主 。 Slaves, obey your human masters in everything; don't work only while being watched, in order to please men, but [work] wholeheartedly, fearing the Lord.
23. 你們無論做什麼，都要從心裡去做，像是為主做的，不是為人做的； Whatever you do, do it enthusiastically, as something done for the Lord and not for men,
24. 因為你們知道，你們將要從主那裡得到繼業為報償；你們當服事主基督 。 knowing that you will receive the reward of an inheritance from the Lord-- you serve the Lord Christ.
25. 要知道，那行不義的，將要照著他所行的不義來領受回報；主是不偏待人的。 For the wrongdoer will be paid back for whatever wrong he has done, and there is no favoritism.
Colossians 4
1. 你們做主人的，要公正、公平地對待奴僕，因為你們知道，你們也有一位主人在天上。 Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you too have a Master in heaven.
2. 你們要恆切禱告，禱告中要保持警醒，懷著感謝的心。 Devote yourselves to prayer; stay alert in it with thanksgiving.
3. 同時也要為我們禱告：願神給我們開福音 的門，使我們能傳講基督的奧祕——我也是為此被捆鎖的， At the same time, pray also for us that God may open a door to us for the message, to speak the mystery of the Messiah-- for which I am in prison--
4. 願我能照著所當說的，把這奧祕顯明出來。 so that I may reveal it as I am required to speak.
5. 你們要把握機會，對外面的人靠智慧行事。 Walk in wisdom toward outsiders, making the most of the time.
6. 你們的話語總要帶著恩惠，像用鹽調和過的，好使你們知道該怎樣回答每一個人。 Your speech should always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how you should answer each person.
7. 有關我的一切事， 特其庫斯 會讓你們明白。他是蒙愛的弟兄、忠心的僕人，是在主裡同做奴僕 的。 Tychicus, a loved brother, a faithful servant, and a fellow slave in the Lord, will tell you all the news about me.
8. 我正是為此派他到你們那裡去，好讓你們知道有關我們的事，並且讓他安慰你們的心。 I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may know how we are, and so that he may encourage your hearts.
9. 與他一起去的 奧尼斯莫，是一位忠心、蒙愛的弟兄，是你們那裡的人。他們會把這裡的一切情況都讓你們明白。 He is with Onesimus, a faithful and loved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
10. 與我一起坐牢的 亞里達古 問候你們。 巴拿巴 的表弟 馬可 也問候你們。關於 馬可，你們已經領受了指示：如果他到你們那裡去，你們要接受他。 Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, as does Mark, Barnabas' cousin (concerning whom you have received instructions: if he comes to you, welcome him),
11. 稱為 猶斯托 的 耶數 也問候你們。在割禮派的人 中，只有這幾個人是為了神的國與我同工的；他們也成了我的安慰。 and so does Jesus who is called Justus. These alone of the circumcision are my co-workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
12. 以帕弗拉 問候你們；他來自你們那裡，是基督耶穌的奴僕；他在禱告中，總是為你們竭力祈求 ：願你們成熟、站立得住，在神的一切旨意中確信不疑 ； Epaphras, who is one of you, a slave of Christ Jesus, greets you. He is always contending for you in his prayers, so that you can stand mature and fully assured in everything God wills.
13. 其實我可以為他見證：他為了你們和那些在 勞迪西亞 和 希拉波利斯 的人，多受勞苦 。 For I testify about him that he works hard for you, for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
14. 蒙愛的醫生 路加 和 迪馬斯 問候你們。 Luke, the loved physician, and Demas greet you.
15. 請問候在 勞迪西亞 的弟兄們，還有 寧法 以及在她 家裡的教會。 Give my greetings to the brothers in Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.
16. 這封書信在你們那裡宣讀了以後，也一定要在 勞迪西亞 的教會中宣讀；你們也要宣讀從 勞迪西亞 轉來的書信。 And when this letter has been read among you, have it read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and see that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
17. 請你們告訴 阿其波斯 ：「在主裡所領受的服事工作，要留心把它完成。」 And tell Archippus, "Pay attention to the ministry you have received in the Lord, so that you can accomplish it."
18. 我 保羅 親筆問候：請你們記住我所受的捆鎖。願恩典與你們同在！ This greeting is in my own hand-- Paul. Remember my imprisonment. Grace be with you.
1 Thessalonians
1 Thessalonians 1
1. 保羅 、 賽拉斯 、 提摩太， 致那在父神和主耶穌基督裡的 帖撒羅尼迦 人的教會： 願恩典與平安 臨到你們！ Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy: To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace to you and peace.
2. 我們為你們大家常常感謝神，在禱告中提到你們； We always thank God for all of you, remembering you constantly in our prayers.
3. 在神我們的父面前，不住地記念你們在我們主耶穌基督裡的信仰的行為、愛心的勞苦，以及對盼望的忍耐。 We recall, in the presence of our God and Father, your work of faith, labor of love, and endurance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ,
4. 蒙神所愛的弟兄們，我們知道你們是蒙揀選的， knowing your election, brothers loved by God.
5. 因為我們的福音傳到你們那裡，不僅是藉著話語，也是藉著能力、聖靈和充分的確信。你們知道，為了你們的緣故，我們在你們中間是怎樣為人的。 For our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we were among you for your benefit,
6. 你們效法了我們，也效法了主，在大患難中，懷著聖靈所賜的喜樂接受了這話語。 and you became imitators of us and of the Lord when, in spite of severe persecution, you welcomed the message with the joy from the Holy Spirit.
7. 因此，你們成了 馬其頓 和 亞該亞 省所有信徒的榜樣。 As a result, you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
8. 事實上，主的福音 已經從你們那裡傳揚出去，不僅在 馬其頓 和 亞該亞 省，也在你們對神的信仰所傳開的各個地方；所以我們不需要再說什麼了。 For the Lord's message rang out from you, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place that your faith in God has gone out, so we don't need to say anything.
9. 其實他們自己在宣揚有關我們的事，說我們是怎樣進到你們那裡，你們是怎樣離棄偶像歸向神、服事又活又真的神， For they themselves report about us what kind of reception we had from you: how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,
10. 並且等候他那從天降臨的兒子，就是神使他從死人中復活的耶穌——他拯救我們脫離那將要來臨的震怒。 and to wait for His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead-- Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.
1 Thessalonians 2
1. 弟兄們，你們自己知道，我們進到你們那裡並不是空無果效的； For you yourselves know, brothers, that our visit with you was not without result.
2. 相反，正如你們知道，雖然我們以前在 腓立比 受了苦、受了凌辱，但是靠著我們的神，我們還是放膽直言，在大爭戰中把神的福音傳給了你們。 On the contrary, after we had previously suffered and been outrageously treated in Philippi, as you know, we were emboldened by our God to speak the gospel of God to you in spite of great opposition.
3. 我們的勸勉不是出於迷惑，不是出於汙穢，也不是用詭詐； For our exhortation didn't come from error or impurity or an intent to deceive.
4. 相反，我們怎樣被神考驗而受了福音的委託，我們就照樣傳講；不是要討人的喜悅，而是要討神的喜悅——神是考驗我們內心的。 Instead, just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not to please men, but rather God, who examines our hearts.
5. 實際上，我們從來沒有用過諂媚的話，這是你們知道的；也沒有懷著貪婪的居心，這是神可以見證的 。 For we never used flattering speech, as you know, or had greedy motives-- God is our witness--
6. 無論向你們或向其他人，我們也都沒有尋求從人來的榮耀。 and we didn't seek glory from people, either from you or from others.
7. 我們身為基督的使徒，雖然可以加給你們重擔，但是我們在你們當中成了溫柔的，就像哺乳的母親顧惜自己的兒女那樣。 Although we could have been a burden as Christ's apostles, instead we were gentle among you, as a nursing mother nurtures her own children.
8. 我們這樣眷愛你們，不僅樂意把神的福音分享給你們，連自己的生命 也樂意分享給你們，因為你們成了我們所愛的人。 We cared so much for you that we were pleased to share with you not only the gospel of God but also our own lives, because you had become dear to us.
9. 弟兄們，你們記得我們的辛苦和勞碌：我們把神的福音傳給你們的時候，我們日夜做工，免得成為你們任何人的負擔。 For you remember our labor and hardship, brothers. Working night and day so that we would not burden any of you, we preached God's gospel to you.
10. 你們和神可以見證：我們對你們這些信的人是多麼聖潔、公義、無可指責的。 You are witnesses, and so is God, of how devoutly, righteously, and blamelessly we conducted ourselves with you believers.
11. 正如你們知道我們怎樣待你們每一個人，就像父親待自己的兒女那樣； As you know, like a father with his own children,
12. 我們鼓勵你們，安慰你們，忠告你們，為要你們行事為人配得上那召喚你們進入他國度和榮耀的神。 we encouraged, comforted, and implored each one of you to walk worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
13. 我們之所以也不住地感謝神，是因為你們接受了從我們所聽的神的話語，沒有把它看做人的話語，而是把它看做神的話語接受了；這確實是神的話語，而且它也正在你們這些信的人裡面做工。 Also, this is why we constantly thank God, because when you received the message about God that you heard from us, you welcomed it not as a human message, but as it truly is, the message of God, which also works effectively in you believers.
14. 弟兄們，你們效法了 猶太 地區在基督耶穌裡屬神的各教會，因為你們也受了自己同胞的苦害，就像他們受了 猶太 人的苦害那樣。 For you, brothers, became imitators of God's churches in Christ Jesus that are in Judea, since you have also suffered the same things from people of your own country, just as they did from the Jews.
15. 這些 猶太 人不但殺了主耶穌和 先知們，也驅逐了我們，並且不討神的喜悅，又與所有的人作對， They killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and persecuted us; they displease God, and are hostile to everyone,
16. 阻止我們向外邦人傳道使外邦人得救。這樣，他們常常積滿自己的罪孽，而神的 震怒在最後臨到了他們身上！ hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. As a result, they are always adding to the number of their sins, and wrath has overtaken them completely.
17. 弟兄們，我們被迫暫時與你們分離——身體分離，心卻沒有；我們非常渴望並且更加努力要見你們的面， But as for us, brothers, after we were forced to leave you for a short time (in person, not in heart), we greatly desired and made every effort to return and see you face to face.
18. 所以我們想要到你們那裡去。我 保羅 確實一再地要去，只是 撒旦 攔阻了我們。 So we wanted to come to you-- even I, Paul, time and again-- but Satan hindered us.
19. 我們主耶穌 來臨的時候，在主 面前，到底誰是我們的盼望、喜樂和所誇耀的冠冕呢？難道不也是你們嗎？ For who is our hope, or joy, or crown of boasting in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming? Is it not you?
20. 的確，你們就是我們的榮耀和喜樂。 For you are our glory and joy!
1 Thessalonians 3
1. 所以，我們既然不能再等了，就決意單獨留在 雅典， Therefore, when we could no longer stand it, we thought it was better to be left alone in Athens.
2. 並派了我們的弟兄——在基督的福音工作上的神的同工 提摩太，好在信仰上堅固你們、鼓勵你們， And we sent Timothy, our brother and God's co-worker in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you concerning your faith,
3. 免得有人在這些患難中動搖。因為你們自己知道，我們要受患難是註定的。 so that no one will be shaken by these persecutions. For you yourselves know that we are appointed to this.
4. 事實上，我們還在你們那裡的時候，早就不斷地告訴你們，我們將要受患難，這果然應驗了，就像你們所知道的那樣。 In fact, when we were with you, we told you previously that we were going to suffer persecution, and as you know, it happened.
5. 為此，我既然不能再等了，就派 提摩太 去，要知道你們的信仰怎樣，恐怕那試探者誘惑了你們，我們所勞苦的落了空。 For this reason, when I could no longer stand it, I also sent to find out about your faith, fearing that the tempter had tempted you and that our labor might be for nothing.
6. 但是，現在 提摩太 從你們那裡來到我們這裡，帶來了你們信仰和愛心的好消息，並且說你們總是對我們懷著美好的記憶，切切地想見到我們，就像我們也渴望見到你們那樣。 But now Timothy has come to us from you and brought us good news about your faith and love, and that you always have good memories of us, wanting to see us, as we also want to see you.
7. 所以弟兄們，在我們的一切困苦和患難中，由於你們的緣故，藉著你們的信心，我們就受到安慰， Therefore, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we were encouraged about you through your faith.
8. 因為，你們如果在主裡站立得穩，我們如今就真的 活了。 For now we live, if you stand firm in the Lord.
9. 我們因著你們，在我們的神面前就喜樂；為這一切的喜樂，我們到底能用什麼樣的感謝為你們回報神呢？ How can we thank God for you in return for all the joy we experience because of you before our God,
10. 我們日夜迫切祈求，要見你們的面，並且要補全你們在信仰上的缺欠。 as we pray earnestly night and day to see you face to face and to complete what is lacking in your faith?
11. 願神我們的父和我們的主耶穌，親自引導我們的道路到你們那裡去。 Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
12. 願主使你們彼此之間的愛，以及對眾人的愛都能增加、充實滿溢，就像我們對你們的愛那樣； And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone, just as we also do for you.
13. 但願他這樣堅固你們的心，使你們在我們主耶穌 與他所有的聖徒一起來臨的時候，在神我們的父面前，在聖潔中是無可指責的！阿們。 May He make your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
1 Thessalonians 4
1. 此外，弟兄們，我們在主耶穌裡請求你們、勸勉你們：既然從我們學到了該怎樣行事為人，怎樣討神的喜悅——就像你們也在行的——你們就要更加努力， Finally then, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus, that as you have received from us how you must walk and please God-- as you are doing-- do so even more.
2. 因為你們知道，我們藉著主耶穌所傳給你們的是什麼吩咐。 For you know what commands we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
3. 神的旨意正是要你們分別為聖：要你們遠避淫亂， For this is God's will, your sanctification: that you abstain from sexual immorality,
4. 要你們每個人知道怎樣在聖潔、尊貴中持守自己的身體， so that each of you knows how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
5. 而不要像那些不認識神的外邦人那樣，放縱邪情私欲； not with lustful desires, like the Gentiles who don't know God.
6. 不可有人在這事上越軌，對不起他的弟兄，因為關於這一切事，主是報應者，正如我們以前也告訴過、鄭重地勸誡過你們。 This means one must not transgress against and defraud his brother in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger of all these offenses, as we also previously told and warned you.
7. 要知道，神召喚我們，不是要我們沾染汙穢，而是要我們分別為聖。 For God has not called us to impurity, but to sanctification.
8. 因此，那拒絕這吩咐 的，不是拒絕人，而是拒絕神——就是將他的聖靈賜給你們 的那一位。 Therefore, the person who rejects this does not reject man, but God, who also gives you His Holy Spirit.
9. 關於弟兄之愛，你們不需要我 寫什麼給你們，因為你們自己蒙了神的教導，要彼此相愛。 About brotherly love: you don't need me to write you because you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.
10. 實際上，你們對整個 馬其頓 省的所有弟兄就是這樣做的。不過弟兄們，我們勸你們要更加努力。 In fact, you are doing this toward all the brothers in the entire region of Macedonia. But we encourage you, brothers, to do so even more,
11. 你們要立定心志安靜下來、做自己的事、親手做工，正如我們曾經吩咐過你們的， to seek to lead a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,
12. 好使你們在外人面前能夠行事端正，不會有什麼缺乏 。 so that you may walk properly in the presence of outsiders and not be dependent on anyone.
13. 弟兄們，關於睡了的人，我們不願意你們不明白，免得你們憂傷，就像其他那些沒有盼望的人一樣。 We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers, concerning those who are asleep, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
14. 我們既然相信耶穌死而復活了，照樣也相信，那些藉著耶穌已經睡了的人，神將要把他們與耶穌一同帶來 。 Since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, in the same way God will bring with Him those who have fallen asleep through Jesus.
15. 的確，我們現在照著主的話告訴你們這一點：我們這些活著存留到主來臨的人，絕不會在那些已經睡了的人之先， For we say this to you by a revelation from the Lord: We who are still alive at the Lord's coming will certainly have no advantage over those who have fallen asleep.
16. 因為在發令的呼喊聲中，在天使長的聲音和神的號角聲中，主要親自從天降臨，而且那些在基督裡死去的人要先復活， For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the archangel's voice, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
17. 然後我們這些還活著存留的人，要與他們一同被提到雲裡，在空中與主相會。這樣，我們就要永遠與主在一起了。 Then we who are still alive will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air; and so we will always be with the Lord.
18. 所以，你們當用這些話彼此鼓勵。 Therefore encourage one another with these words.
1 Thessalonians 5
1. 弟兄們，關於這些時候和日期，你們不需要我寫什麼給你們了。 About the times and the seasons: brothers, you do not need anything to be written to you.
2. 因為你們自己明確地知道，主的日子 來臨，就像夜裡的賊來臨那樣。 For you yourselves know very well that the Day of the Lord will come just like a thief in the night.
3. 當人們正說「和平」、「安全」的時候，毀滅那時就突然臨到他們，就像孕婦的臨產陣痛那樣，他們絕不能逃脫。 When they say, "Peace and security," then sudden destruction comes on them, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
4. 不過弟兄們，你們不是在黑暗裡，以致那日子像賊一樣抓住你們。 But you, brothers, are not in the dark, so that this day would overtake you like a thief.
5. 因為你們都是光明的兒女，白晝的兒女。我們不屬於黑夜，也不屬於黑暗。 For you are all sons of light and sons of the day. We're not of the night or of darkness.
6. 由此可見，我們不要像其他人那樣睡著了，而要警醒、謹慎。 So then, we must not sleep, like the rest, but we must stay awake and be sober.
7. 因為睡覺的人是在夜裡睡，醉酒的人是在夜裡醉。 For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk are drunk at night.
8. 但我們既然屬於白晝，就讓我們謹慎，以信與愛做為護胸甲穿上，以救恩的盼望做為頭盔戴上。 But since we are of the day, we must be sober and put the armor of faith and love on our chests, and put on a helmet of the hope of salvation.
9. 因為神不是預定我們到震怒裡面，而是預定我們藉著我們的主耶穌基督獲得救恩。 For God did not appoint us to wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
10. 基督替我們死，為要使我們無論是醒著還是睡著，都與他一同活著。 who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep, we will live together with Him.
11. 因此，你們要彼此鼓勵，互相造就，就像你們現在所做的那樣。 Therefore encourage one another and build each other up as you are already doing.
12. 弟兄們，我們請求你們：要敬重那些在你們中間勞苦做工、在主裡帶領 你們、勸誡你們的人， Now we ask you, brothers, to give recognition to those who labor among you and lead you in the Lord and admonish you,
13. 因著他們的工作，要在愛中格外地看重他們。你們要彼此和睦。 and to esteem them very highly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
14. 弟兄們，我們勸你們：要勸誡懶散的人，安慰膽怯的人，扶助軟弱的人，對所有的人都要恆久忍耐。 And we exhort you, brothers: warn those who are lazy, comfort the discouraged, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
15. 你們要注意，誰都不要以惡報惡；相反，無論是彼此之間，還是對待眾人，總要追求美善。 See to it that no one repays evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue what is good for one another and for all.
16. 要常常歡喜， Rejoice always!
17. 不住地禱告， Pray constantly.
18. 凡事感謝； 因為這是神在基督耶穌裡對你們的旨意。 Give thanks in everything, for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
19. 不要消滅聖靈 的感動， Don't stifle the Spirit.
20. 不要輕視做先知傳道， Don't despise prophecies,
21. 卻要凡事分辨， 要持守美善， but test all things. Hold on to what is good.
22. 連一切惡的樣式都要遠避。 Stay away from every form of evil.
23. 願賜平安的神親自使你們完全分別為聖。願你們的靈、魂、體，在我們的主耶穌基督來臨的時候，全然得蒙保守、無可指責。 Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept sound and blameless for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
24. 召喚你們的那一位是信實的，他將成就這事。 He who calls you is faithful, who also will do it.
25. 弟兄們，請為我們禱告。 Brothers, pray for us also.
26. 你們要用聖潔的親吻禮問候所有的弟兄。 Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
27. 我藉著主吩咐你們，要把這封信讀給所有 的弟兄聽。 I charge you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the brothers.
28. 願我們主耶穌基督的恩典與你們同在！ May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you!
2 Thessalonians
2 Thessalonians 1
1. 保羅 、 賽拉斯 、 提摩太， 致那在神我們的父和主耶穌基督裡的 帖撒羅尼迦 人的教會： Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy: To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2. 願恩典與平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督臨到你們！ Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
3. 弟兄們，我們應該為你們常常感謝神，這樣做是合宜的，因為你們的信仰格外增長，你們大家每一個人彼此的愛也在增加。 We must always thank God for you, brothers, which is fitting, since your faith is flourishing, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing.
4. 所以，我們自己在神的各教會中以你們誇耀，因為你們在一切的逼迫和患難中保持著你們的忍耐和信仰。 Therefore we ourselves boast about you among God's churches-- about your endurance and faith in all the persecutions and afflictions you endure.
5. 這正是神公義審判的證據，好使你們算是配得上神的國；你們也正是為此而受苦害的。 It is a clear evidence of God's righteous judgment that you will be counted worthy of God's kingdom, for which you also are suffering,
6. 神既然真是公義的，當主耶穌與他有大能的天使們一起從天上顯現的時候，他就要以患難回報那些加患難給你們的人， since it is righteous for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
7. 也要使你們這些受患難的人與我們一同得到安息 。 and [to reward] with rest you who are afflicted, along with us. [This will take place] at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with His powerful angels,
8. 神要在烈火中報應那些不認識神的人，以及那些不順從我們主耶穌 福音的人； taking vengeance with flaming fire on those who don't know God and on those who don't obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
9. 他們將受到刑罰，就是永遠的滅亡，從主面前被隔絕，離開他權能的榮耀。 These will pay the penalty of everlasting destruction, away from the Lord's presence and from His glorious strength,
10. 在那日，主來臨的時候，要藉著他的聖徒得著榮耀，又藉著所有的信徒令人驚奇——因為你們相信了我們對你們所做的見證。 in that day when He comes to be glorified by His saints and to be admired by all those who have believed, because our testimony among you was believed.
11. 為此，我們也常常為你們禱告：願我們的神把你們看為配得他的召喚，並且以他的大能成全你們一切美好的心願和一切信仰的行為， And in view of this, we always pray for you that our God will consider you worthy of His calling, and will, by His power, fulfill every desire for goodness and the work of faith,
12. 好使我們主耶穌 的名，照著我們的神和主耶穌基督的恩典，因你們得著榮耀，你們也因他得著榮耀。 so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified by you, and you by Him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2 Thessalonians 2
1. 弟兄們，論到我們主耶穌基督的來臨，以及我們聚集歸於他的事，我們請求你們： Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to Him: we ask you, brothers,
2. 無論是藉著靈，還是藉著話語，或藉著一封好像是來自我們的書信，說主 的日子 已經來到了，你們都不要輕易被搖動而失去理性，也不要驚慌； not to be easily upset in mind or troubled, either by a spirit or by a message or by a letter as if from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has come.
3. 不要讓任何人用任何方法把你們欺騙了；因為那日子來臨以前，必定先有離道反教之事來到，並且那不法之人，就是那滅亡 之子也會被顯露出來。 Don't let anyone deceive you in any way. For [that day] will not come unless the apostasy comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction.
4. 他反對一切被稱為神的，或受人敬拜的，他又高抬自己在這一切之上，甚至坐在神的聖所裡宣稱自己是神。 He opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he sits in God's sanctuary, publicizing that he himself is God.
5. 我還在你們那裡的時候，一直告訴你們這些事，你們不記得嗎？ Don't you remember that when I was still with you I told you about this?
6. 你們也知道，現在什麼攔阻了他，好使他在所定的時候 被顯露出來。 And you know what currently restrains [him], so that he will be revealed in his time.
7. 其實這不法的奧祕已經在做工，只是要等到那現在攔阻他的不在其中， For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; but the one now restraining will do so until he is out of the way,
8. 然後這不法之人要被顯露出來。主耶穌要以自己口中的氣殺掉 他，藉著自己來臨的顯現除去他。 and then the lawless one will be revealed. The Lord Jesus will destroy him with the breath of His mouth and will bring him to nothing with the brightness of His coming.
9. 這不法之人的到來，是出於 撒旦 的作為，對那些正在滅亡的人，使用一切能力、虛假的神蹟和奇事， The coming [of the lawless one] is based on Satan's working, with all kinds of false miracles, signs, and wonders,
10. 並且使用一切不義的詭計，因為他們不接受那能使他們得救的真理之愛。 and with every unrighteous deception among those who are perishing. [They perish] because they did not accept the love of the truth in order to be saved.
11. 為此，神就把一種迷惑人的力量送進他們裡面，使他們相信虛假之事， For this reason God sends them a strong delusion so that they will believe what is false,
12. 好使所有不相信真理而喜悅不義的人，都被定罪。 so that all will be condemned-- those who did not believe the truth but enjoyed unrighteousness.
13. 蒙主所愛的弟兄們，我們應該為你們常常感謝神，因為神為了救恩的緣故，就藉著在聖靈裡的分別為聖，以及真理的信仰，揀選了你們做為初熟的果子 。 But we must always thank God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because from the beginning God has chosen you for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and through belief in the truth.
14. 為此，神也藉著我們的福音召喚了你們，使你們獲得我們主耶穌基督的榮耀。 He called you to this through our gospel, so that you might obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
15. 弟兄們，由此可見，你們當站立得穩；你們所領受的傳統，無論是藉著我們的話語，還是藉著我們的書信，你們都要持守。 Therefore, brothers, stand firm and hold to the traditions you were taught, either by our message or by our letter.
16. 願我們的主耶穌基督自己和神我們的父，就是愛我們又在恩典中把永恆的安慰和美好的盼望賜給我們的那一位， May our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who has loved us and given us eternal encouragement and good hope by grace,
17. 安慰你們的心，並且在一切美善的工作和言語上堅固你們。 encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good work and word.
2 Thessalonians 3
1. 最後，弟兄們，請為我們禱告：願主的福音 能迅速傳開，並且得著榮耀，就像在你們那裡一樣； Finally, pray for us, brothers, that the Lord's message may spread rapidly and be honored, just as it was with you,
2. 願神 救我們脫離那些無理和邪惡的人，因為不是每個人都有這信仰。 and that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men, for not all have faith.
3. 不過主是信實的，他會堅固你們、保守你們脫離那惡者。 But the Lord is faithful; He will strengthen and guard you from the evil one.
4. 至於你們，我們在主裡深信，你們正在遵行，並且也將繼續遵行我們所吩咐的。 We have confidence in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do what we command.
5. 願主引導你們的心歸於神的慈愛，又歸於基督的忍耐。 May the Lord direct your hearts to God's love and Christ's endurance.
6. 弟兄們，我們奉我們主耶穌基督的名吩咐你們，要避開所有過著懶散生活，以及不照著你們從我們領受的傳統而生活的弟兄。 Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from every brother who walks irresponsibly and not according to the tradition received from us.
7. 其實你們自己知道應該怎樣效法我們，因為我們在你們那裡的時候並沒有懶散， For you yourselves know how you must imitate us: we were not irresponsible among you;
8. 也沒有白吃過誰的飯 。相反，我們辛苦勞碌、日夜做工，免得成為你們任何人的負擔。 we did not eat anyone's bread free of charge; instead, we labored and toiled, working night and day, so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
9. 這並不是因為我們沒有這權利，而是要親自給你們做榜樣，好讓你們效法我們。 It is not that we don't have the right [to support], but we did it to make ourselves an example to you so that you would imitate us.
10. 事實上，我們還在你們那裡的時候，一直吩咐你們這一點：如果有人不肯做工，就不應當吃飯。 In fact, when we were with you, this is what we commanded you: "If anyone isn't willing to work, he should not eat."
11. 因為我們聽說你們中間有些人生活懶散，什麼工都不做，卻好管閒事。 For we hear that there are some among you who walk irresponsibly, not working at all, but interfering with the work [of others].
12. 我們在主耶穌基督裡吩咐並勸勉這樣的人：要安靜做工，吃自己的飯 。 Now we command and exhort such people, by the Lord Jesus Christ, that quietly working, they may eat their own bread.
13. 不過弟兄們，你們行美善的事不要喪膽。 Brothers, do not grow weary in doing good.
14. 如果有人不順從我們這信上的話語，你們就要記住這個人，不可與他交往，好讓他感到羞愧； And if anyone does not obey our instruction in this letter, take note of that person; don't associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
15. 可是不要把他看為敵人，而要勸誡他，如同弟兄那樣。 Yet don't treat him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.
16. 願賜平安的主，常常以各種方法親自賜給你們平安！願主與你們大家同在！ May the Lord of peace Himself give you peace always in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
17. 我 保羅 親筆問候，這是我每一封信中的標記，我都是這樣寫的。 This greeting is in my own hand-- Paul. This is a sign in every letter; this is how I write.
18. 願我們主耶穌基督的恩典與你們大家同在！ The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
1 Timothy
1 Timothy 1
1. 照著我們的救主神、我們的盼望基督耶穌 的命令，做基督耶穌使徒的 保羅， Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus, our hope:
2. 致我 在信仰上的真兒子 提摩太 ： 願恩典、憐憫、平安從父神和我們的主基督耶穌臨到你！ To Timothy, my true child in the faith. Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
3. 我往 馬其頓 省去的時候，曾經勸你繼續留在 以弗所，好讓你吩咐某些人不可傳講別的教義， As I urged you when I went to Macedonia, remain in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach other doctrine
4. 也不可關注那些編造的故事和無窮的家譜：這些事只帶來疑惑，而無助於神所賜的 信仰上的任務。 or to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies. These promote empty speculations rather than God's plan, which operates by faith.
5. 這樣吩咐的目的是愛。愛是發自潔淨的心、無愧的良心，以及不虛假的信仰。 Now the goal of our instruction is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and a sincere faith.
6. 有些人偏離了這些，轉向了虛妄的話， Some have deviated from these and turned aside to fruitless discussion.
7. 想要做律法教師，卻不明白自己所講的，或所強調的是為了什麼。 They want to be teachers of the law, although they don't understand what they are saying or what they are insisting on.
8. 我們知道，律法是好的，只要人按著規矩去用它。 Now we know that the law is good, provided one uses it legitimately.
9. 我們也知道，律法的設立不是為義人，而是為那些不法的和不服的、不敬神的和犯罪的、不聖潔的和褻瀆神的、毆打父母的、殺人的、 We know that the law is not meant for a righteous person, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and irreverent, for those who kill their fathers and mothers, for murderers,
10. 淫亂的、同性戀的、拐賣人口的 、說謊的、起假誓的，以及其他任何反對健全教義的人 。 for the sexually immoral and homosexuals, for kidnappers, liars, perjurers, and for whatever else is contrary to the sound teaching
11. 這教義是照著當受稱頌之神的榮耀福音，就是所委託給我的福音。 based on the glorious gospel of the blessed God that was entrusted to me.
12. 我感謝使我剛強的那一位——我們的主基督耶穌，因為他認為我是忠心的，指派我做這服事的工作。 I give thanks to Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, because He considered me faithful, appointing me to the ministry--
13. 雖然我原先是褻瀆神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的，但是我卻蒙了憐憫，因為我是在不信、不明白的時候做的； one who was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and an arrogant man. Since it was out of ignorance that I had acted in unbelief, I received mercy,
14. 而且我們主的恩典，隨著在基督耶穌裡的信心和愛心，格外增多。 and the grace of our Lord overflowed, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
15. 「基督耶穌來到這世界，為要拯救罪人。」這話是信實的，值得完全接受。在罪人中我是首惡， This saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance: "Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners"-- and I am the worst of them.
16. 但我之所以蒙了憐憫，是因為基督耶穌要在我這首惡身上顯出他一切的耐心，為那些將要信靠他而進入永恆生命的人做榜樣。 But I received mercy because of this, so that in me, the worst [of them], Christ Jesus might demonstrate the utmost patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
17. 願尊貴和榮耀歸於那萬世之王，就是那不朽壞的、不可見的、獨一 的神，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
18. 我 兒 提摩太 啊，我按照以前指著你的那些預言，把這樣的吩咐交託給你，為的是要你憑著這些去打那美好的仗， Timothy, my child, I am giving you this instruction in keeping with the prophecies previously made about you, so that by them you may strongly engage in battle,
19. 持守信仰和無愧的良心。有些人棄絕了這樣的良心，就在信仰上遭到了毀滅， having faith and a good conscience. Some have rejected these and have suffered the shipwreck of their faith.
20. 其中有 希米奈奧 和 亞歷山大 。我已經把他們交給了 撒旦，這是為要他們受懲罰不再說褻瀆的話。 Hymenaeus and Alexander are among them, and I have delivered them to Satan, so that they may be taught not to blaspheme.
1 Timothy 2
1. 所以我勸你，首要的是為所有的人，為眾君王和所有在上的獻上祈求、禱告、代求和感謝， First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for everyone,
2. 好使我們能完全敬神、莊重地過平靜安穩的生活。 for kings and all those who are in authority, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.
3. 這在神我們救主的面前是美好的，是蒙悅納的； This is good, and it pleases God our Savior,
4. 他願意所有的人都得救，來到真理的知識當中。 who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
5. 要知道，神只有一位， 在神和人之間的中保也只有一位， 就是成為人的基督耶穌； For there is one God and one mediator between God and man, a man, Christ Jesus,
6. 他獻上自己，替所有的人做救贖的代價； 在所定的時候，這事要被見證出來。 who gave Himself-- a ransom for all, a testimony at the proper time.
7. 為此，我受指派做傳道者和使徒，在信仰和真理上做外邦人的教師。我 說的是真話，沒有說謊。 For this I was appointed a herald, an apostle (I am telling the truth; I am not lying), and a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
8. 所以，我希望在各個地方的男人都舉起聖潔的手禱告，不動怒、不爭論； Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or argument.
9. 照樣，我也希望女人衣著端莊，以廉恥和自制來裝飾自己；不以編髮、金飾、珍珠或極其貴重的衣裳來裝飾自己， Also, the women are to dress themselves in modest clothing, with decency and good sense; not with elaborate hairstyles, gold, pearls, or expensive apparel,
10. 反而要用美善的行為，與稱為敬神的女人相宜。 but with good works, as is proper for women who affirm that they worship God.
11. 女人要以完全的順服，安靜地領受教導。 A woman should learn in silence with full submission.
12. 我不准許女人教導或管轄男人；相反，女人要安靜， I do not allow a woman to teach or to have authority over a man; instead, she is to be silent.
13. 因為 亞當 是先被造的，然後才是 夏娃 ； For Adam was created first, then Eve.
14. 並且不是 亞當 受騙，而是那女人受騙、陷在過犯裡。 And Adam was not deceived, but the woman was deceived and transgressed.
15. 不過女人如果在自制中持守信仰、愛心、聖潔，就會在生養兒女中 得以保全 。 But she will be saved through childbearing, if she continues in faith, love, and holiness, with good sense.
1 Timothy 3
1. 「如果有人嚮往監督的職份，他就是在渴望一份美好的工作。」這話是信實的。 This saying is trustworthy: "If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble work."
2. 所以做監督的必須無可指責，只做一個婦人的丈夫，節制、自律、端莊，樂意款待客旅，善於教導， An overseer, therefore, must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, self-controlled, sensible, respectable, hospitable, an able teacher,
3. 不酗酒、不好鬥； 反要謙和，不爭吵、不貪財， not addicted to wine, not a bully but gentle, not quarrelsome, not greedy--
4. 好好帶領 自己的家，在一切的事上莊重，使兒女順服。 one who manages his own household competently, having his children under control with all dignity.
5. 但如果有人不知道怎麼帶領 自己的家，他怎麼能照顧神的教會呢？ (If anyone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he take care of God's church?)
6. 做監督的不可以是新信徒，免得他自以為是，就落在魔鬼所受的懲罰裡； He must not be a new convert, or he might become conceited and fall into the condemnation of the Devil.
7. 同時，做監督的在外人中也必須有好名聲，免得受人責罵，落在魔鬼的網羅裡。 Furthermore, he must have a good reputation among outsiders, so that he does not fall into disgrace and the Devil's trap.
8. 做執事 的也一樣，必須莊重，不一口兩舌，不酗酒，不貪圖不正當的利益， Deacons, likewise, should be worthy of respect, not hypocritical, not drinking a lot of wine, not greedy for money,
9. 以清白的良心持守信仰的奧祕； holding the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
10. 並且這些人也當先受考驗，如果是無可指責的，才可以做執事。 And they must also be tested first; if they prove blameless, then they can serve as deacons.
11. 照樣，他們的妻子 也必須莊重，不惡意控告人，有節制，在一切事上都忠心。 Wives, too, must be worthy of respect, not slanderers, self-controlled, faithful in everything.
12. 做執事的只可做一個婦人的丈夫，好好帶領 兒女和自己的家。 Deacons must be husbands of one wife, managing their children and their own households competently.
13. 因為那好好服事的，就讓自己達到 美好的境地，並且在基督耶穌裡的信仰上大有膽量。 For those who have served well as deacons acquire a good standing for themselves, and great boldness in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
14. 我把這些事寫給你，希望很快到你那裡去。 I write these things to you, hoping to come to you soon.
15. 就算我耽延了，你也可以知道在神的家裡應該怎樣行事。這家是永生神的教會，是真理的柱石和根基。 But if I should be delayed, [I have written] so that you will know how people ought to act in God's household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
16. 正如大家所承認的，敬神的奧祕是極大的： 神 以肉身顯現， 被聖靈證實， 被天使觀看， 被傳於萬邦， 被世人信仰， 被接在榮耀裡。 And most certainly, the mystery of godliness is great: He was manifested in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen by angels, preached among the Gentiles, believed on in the world, taken up in glory.
1 Timothy 4
1. 不過聖靈明確地說，在末後的時代有些人會離開這信仰，聽從迷惑人的邪靈和鬼魔的教義。 Now the Spirit explicitly says that in the latter times some will depart from the faith, paying attention to deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,
2. 這些教義出於說謊之人的偽善，這些人的良心已經麻木了 。 through the hypocrisy of liars whose consciences are seared.
3. 他們禁止結婚，要求 遠避某些食物，就是神所創造的，好讓信徒和了解真理的人以感謝的心享用。 They forbid marriage and demand abstinence from foods that God created to be received with gratitude by those who believe and know the truth.
4. 原來神所造的一切都是美好的；如果以感謝的心領受，就什麼也不用丟棄， For everything created by God is good, and nothing should be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
5. 因為藉著神的話語、藉著代求，這些都被分別為聖了。 since it is sanctified by the word of God and by prayer.
6. 如果你把這些事向弟兄們指出來，你就是基督耶穌的好僕人，藉著信仰的話語，以及你所跟從的美善教導得著培養。 If you point these things out to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of the faith and of the good teaching that you have followed.
7. 至於那些不敬神的、像老婦人所編造的故事，你要拒絕。為了敬神，要操練自己， But have nothing to do with irreverent and silly myths. Rather, train yourself in godliness,
8. 因為 操練身體，益處還少； 但是敬神，對一切的事都有益處， 有今生和來生的應許。 for, the training of the body has a limited benefit, but godliness is beneficial in every way, since it holds promise for the present life and also for the life to come.
9. 這話是信實的，值得完全接受。 This saying is trustworthy and deserves full acceptance.
10. 事實上，我們勞苦、爭戰 正是為此，因為我們把盼望寄託於永生的神——他是所有人的救主，尤其是信徒的救主。 In fact, we labor and strive for this, because we have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, especially of those who believe.
11. 你當吩咐並教導這些事。 Command and teach these things.
12. 不要讓任何人輕看你年少，反要在言語、行為、愛心、信仰、純潔的事上，都做信徒的榜樣。 No one should despise your youth; instead, you should be an example to the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
13. 你要專心誦讀經文 、鼓勵和教導人，直到我來。 Until I come, give your attention to public reading, exhortation, and teaching.
14. 不要忽視在你裡面的恩賜；這恩賜是藉著預言，隨著長老們的按手賜給你的。 Do not neglect the gift that is in you; it was given to you through prophecy, with the laying on of hands by the council of elders.
15. 你要思想 這些事，投身其中，使你的長進在大家面前清清楚楚。 Practice these things; be committed to them, so that your progress may be evident to all.
16. 你要留意自己和自己的教導，在這些事上要有恆心，因為這樣做，不但能救你自己，也能救那些聽從你的人。 Be conscientious about yourself and your teaching; persevere in these things, for by doing this you will save both yourself and your hearers.
1 Timothy 5
1. 不要嚴厲責備年長的人，而要勸他像勸父親那樣；對年輕的人要像對兄弟那樣； Do not rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father, younger men as brothers,
2. 對年長的婦女要像對母親那樣，對年輕的婦女要像對姐妹那樣，要懷著完全純潔的心。 older women as mothers, and with all propriety, the younger women as sisters.
3. 要尊重那些真正的寡婦。 Support widows who are genuinely widows.
4. 不過一個寡婦如果有兒女或孫兒女，就應當讓他們先學會孝敬自己的家人，報答親恩，因為這在神面前是 蒙悅納的。 But if any widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to practice their religion toward their own family first and to repay their parents, for this pleases God.
5. 那真正的寡婦，無依無靠，已經把盼望寄託於神，日夜不住地祈求禱告； The real widow, left all alone, has put her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers;
6. 而那享樂度日的寡婦，雖然活著，卻是死的。 however, she who is self-indulgent is dead even while she lives.
7. 你當吩咐這些事，好使她們無可指責。 Command this, so that they won't be blamed.
8. 如果有人不敬重屬自己的人，尤其是家裡的人，他就否定了信仰，比不信的人更壞。 Now if anyone does not provide for his own relatives, and especially for his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
9. 應當算入寡婦之列的，不可小於六十歲；只做過一個男人的妻子； No widow should be placed on the official support list unless she is at least 60 years old, has been the wife of one husband,
10. 並且必須有美好行為的名聲，就如養育孩子、接待客旅、洗聖徒的腳、幫助受患難的人、追隨一切美善的工作。 and is well known for good works-- that is, if she has brought up children, shown hospitality, washed the saints' feet, helped the afflicted, and devoted herself to every good work.
11. 至於年輕的寡婦，你要拒絕她們入列 ；要知道，當她們情欲衝動而違背基督的時候，就想要結婚； But refuse to enroll younger widows; for when they are drawn away from Christ by desire, they want to marry,
12. 她們被定罪，是因為她們棄絕了最初的誓言， and will therefore receive condemnation because they have renounced their original pledge.
13. 同時她們又學會了懶惰，四處串門；不僅懶惰，還好說閒話，好管閒事，說不該說的話。 At the same time, they also learn to be idle, going from house to house; they are not only idle, but are also gossips and busybodies, saying things they shouldn't say.
14. 所以，我希望年輕的寡婦結婚，生養兒女，料理家務，不給反對的人辱罵的機會。 Therefore, I want younger women to marry, have children, manage their households, and give the adversary no opportunity to accuse us.
15. 實際上，已經有一些人轉去隨從 撒旦 了。 For some have already turned away to follow Satan.
16. 如果一個 女信徒，在親屬中 有寡婦，她就應該幫助她們，不要讓教會承受壓力，好使教會能夠幫助那些真正的寡婦。 If any believing woman has widows, she should help them, and the church should not be burdened, so that it can help those who are genuinely widows.
17. 那些好好帶領 了信徒 的長老，尤其是在傳道和教導上勞苦做工的，應該被看為配得加倍的尊重。 The elders who are good leaders should be considered worthy of an ample honorarium, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
18. 原來經上說： 「牛踹穀的時候，不可籠住牠的嘴。」 又說： 「工人配得自己的酬報。」 For the Scripture says: You must not muzzle an ox that is threshing grain, and, The laborer is worthy of his wages.
19. 除非有兩三個見證人，否則你不可受理對長老的控告。 Don't accept an accusation against an elder unless it is supported by two or three witnesses.
20. 對那些繼續犯罪的，你要當眾責備他們，好使其他的人也有所懼怕。 Publicly rebuke those who sin, so that the rest will also be afraid.
21. 我在神、基督耶穌，和蒙揀選的天使面前鄭重地勸誡你：遵守這些話要毫無成見，做任何事都不要偏心。 I solemnly charge you, before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels, to observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing out of favoritism.
22. 不要輕易給人按手，也不要在別人的罪孽上有份，要保守自己純潔。 Don't be too quick to lay hands on anyone, and don't share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
23. 由於你胃的問題和常患的那些疾病，你今後不要只喝水，要用一點酒 。 Don't continue drinking only water, but use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.
24. 有些人的罪孽是明顯的，要先面對審判；而有些人的 罪卻是隨後跟著的。 Some people's sins are evident, going before them to judgment, but [the sins] of others follow them.
25. 照樣，美好行為也是明顯的，即使是那些不明顯的，也不能一直隱藏下去。 Likewise, good works are obvious, and those that are not [obvious] cannot remain hidden.
1 Timothy 6
1. 凡是負軛做奴僕的，應該看自己的主人配受十分尊重，免得神的名和神的教導受到褻瀆。 All who are under the yoke as slaves must regard their own masters to be worthy of all respect, so that God's name and His teaching will not be blasphemed.
2. 如果奴僕的主人是信徒，不可因為主人是弟兄就輕看他們；反而倒要服事他們，因為從這樣的美事而得益處的，是信徒、是蒙愛的人。 你要教導、勸勉這些事。 And those who have believing masters should not be disrespectful to them because they are brothers, but should serve them better, since those who benefit from their service are believers and dearly loved. Teach and encourage these things.
3. 如果有人傳講別的教義，不符合我們主耶穌基督的健全話語以及那合乎敬神的教導， If anyone teaches other doctrine and does not agree with the sound teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ and with the teaching that promotes godliness,
4. 那麼他就成了自以為是的人，什麼都不知道，只對辯論和言詞上的爭執有病態的嗜好，由此引發嫉妒、紛爭、毀謗、惡意的猜疑； he is conceited, understanding nothing, but having a sick interest in disputes and arguments over words. From these come envy, quarreling, slanders, evil suspicions,
5. 他在那些理性敗壞、喪失真理、以為敬神是得利之道的人中，引發無休止的爭吵。 and constant disagreement among men whose minds are depraved and deprived of the truth, who imagine that godliness is a way to material gain.
6. 其實敬神加上知足，才是極大的得利之道。 But godliness with contentment is a great gain.
7. 實際上，我們沒有帶什麼到世上來， 也不能帶什麼去。 For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out.
8. 不過有了吃的、穿的，我們將以此為滿足。 But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
9. 至於那些想發財的人就會陷入試探、網羅以及很多無知有害的欲望裡；這些欲望使人沉溺在敗壞和滅亡 中。 But those who want to be rich fall into temptation, a trap, and many foolish and harmful desires, which plunge people into ruin and destruction.
10. 要知道，貪愛金錢是萬惡之根；有些人戀慕金錢，就被迷惑而離開了信仰，用很多苦痛把自己刺透了。 For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and by craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.
11. 至於你，哦，屬神的人哪，你要逃避這些事！ 你要追求公義、敬神、信仰、 愛心、忍耐、溫柔， Now you, man of God, run from these things; but pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness.
12. 要為信仰打那美好的仗， 要抓住永恆的生命。 你正是為此蒙召的， 並且在許多見證人面前 做了美好的告白。 Fight the good fight for the faith; take hold of eternal life, to which you were called and have made a good confession before many witnesses.
13. 我在那賜生命給萬物的神面前，並在那曾經向 本丟彼拉多 見證了美好告白的基督耶穌面前吩咐你： In the presence of God, who gives life to all, and before Christ Jesus, who gave a good confession before Pontius Pilate, I charge you
14. 要毫無玷汙、無可指責地遵守這命令，直到我們主耶穌基督的顯現。 to keep the commandment without spot or blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
15. 在所定的時候，他將要顯明出來他就是 那當受稱頌的、獨一的全能者， 萬王之王、萬主之主， which God will bring about in His own time. [He is] the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings, and the Lord of lords,
16. 就是那獨一不朽的、 住在人所不能靠近的光裡， 沒有人見過、也沒有人能看見的那一位。 願尊貴和永恆的權能都歸於他！ 阿們。 the only One who has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom none of mankind has seen or can see, to whom be honor and eternal might. Amen.
17. 對那些今世富有的人，你當吩咐他們不可高傲自大，也不可把盼望寄託在靠不住的財富上，而要寄託在神 身上，神把萬物豐豐富富地賜給我們享受。 Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be arrogant or to set their hope on the uncertainty of wealth, but on God, who richly provides us with all things to enjoy.
18. 你要吩咐他們常行美善，在美好行為上富足，慷慨施捨，樂意分享； [Instruct them] to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous, willing to share,
19. 為著那將要來臨的，給自己積存美好的基礎，使他們抓住那真正的 生命。 storing up for themselves a good foundation for the age to come, so that they may take hold of life that is real.
20. 哦， 提摩太 呀！你要保守那所受的託付，避開那些不敬神的空談和假冒知識之名的反對論。 Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you, avoiding irreverent, empty speech and contradictions from the "knowledge" that falsely bears that name.
21. 有些人自稱有這些「知識」，就在信仰上偏離了。 願恩典與你們 同在！ By professing it, some people have deviated from the faith. Grace be with all of you.
2 Timothy
2 Timothy 1
1. 照著神的旨意，按著在基督耶穌裡的生命應許，做基督耶穌使徒的 保羅， Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, for the promise of life in Christ Jesus:
2. 致親愛的兒子 提摩太 ： 願恩典、憐憫、平安從父神和我們的主基督耶穌臨到你！ To Timothy, my dearly loved child. Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
3. 我在日夜的祈禱中時常想到你，我感謝神，就是我像先祖那樣以清白的良心所事奉的那一位。 I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as my forefathers did, when I constantly remember you in my prayers night and day.
4. 每當想起你的淚水，我就切切地想去見你，好讓我的喜樂得以滿足。 Remembering your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy,
5. 我想起你裡面那不虛假的信仰，這信仰先是在你外祖母 羅伊絲 和你母親 猶妮絲 裡面，我深信也在你裡面。 clearly recalling your sincere faith that first lived in your grandmother Lois, then in your mother Eunice, and that I am convinced is in you also.
6. 因這理由，我提醒你：要把神的恩賜再如火挑旺起來；這恩賜是藉著我的按手，在你裡面的。 Therefore, I remind you to keep ablaze the gift of God that is in you through the laying on of my hands.
7. 實際上，神所賜給我們的，不是膽怯的靈，而是大能、慈愛、自制的靈。 For God has not given us a spirit of fearfulness, but one of power, love, and sound judgment.
8. 所以你不要以有關我們主的見證為恥，也不要以我——這主的囚犯為恥，而要藉著神的大能，為福音與我 同受苦難。 So don't be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord, or of me His prisoner. Instead, share in suffering for the gospel, relying on the power of God,
9. 神拯救了我們，以神聖的呼喚召了我們， 不是照著我們的行為，而是照著他自己的心意和恩典； 這恩典是在亙古以前，在基督耶穌裡賜給我們的， who has saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before time began.
10. 而現在，藉著我們的救主基督耶穌的顯現，已經表明出來； 基督一方面廢除了死亡，另一方面藉著福音彰顯了生命和不朽。 This has now been made evident through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.
11. 為了這福音，我受指派做傳道者、使徒和 教師。 For this [gospel] I was appointed a herald, apostle, and teacher,
12. 因這理由，我也正在經受這些苦；然而我並不以為恥，因為我知道我信的是誰，也深信他能保守我所受的託付，直到那日 。 and that is why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able to guard what has been entrusted to me until that day.
13. 你要藉著在基督耶穌裡的信和愛，把你從我所聽到的健全話語，做為規範好好持守。 Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching that you have heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
14. 你要藉著住在我們裡面的聖靈，保守那所受的美好託付。 Guard, through the Holy Spirit who lives in us, that good thing entrusted to you.
15. 你知道，所有在 亞細亞 省的人都背棄了我，其中有 弗格洛斯 和 赫莫杰尼 。 This you know: all those in Asia have turned away from me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
16. 願主施憐憫給 奧尼斯弗羅 的家人，因為他多次使我神清氣爽，也沒有以我的鎖鏈為恥； May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.
17. 相反，他一到 羅馬，就殷切地尋找我，並且找到了。 On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he diligently searched for me and found me.
18. 願主使他在那日子得到主的憐憫！至於他在 以弗所 的一切服事工作，你知道得更清楚。 May the Lord grant that he obtain mercy from the Lord on that day. And you know how much he ministered at Ephesus.
2 Timothy 2
1. 所以我的兒子啊，你要藉著在基督耶穌裡的恩典得以剛強。 You, therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
2. 你要把那些在許多見證人面前 從我所聽見的，交託給那些忠心可靠、又有能力教導別人的人。 And what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses, commit to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
3. 做為基督耶穌 的好士兵，你要與我 同受苦難。 Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
4. 凡是當兵的，沒有一個會讓日常事務糾纏自己，這是為要使那招兵的人喜悅。 To please the recruiter, no one serving as a soldier gets entangled in the concerns of everyday life.
5. 同樣，如果有人要參加競賽，除非按著規矩去競賽，否則就不能得冠冕。 Also, if anyone competes as an athlete, he is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.
6. 勞苦做工的農夫，應該先享受果實。 It is the hardworking farmer who ought to be the first to get a share of the crops.
7. 你要思考我所說的話，主會在一切事上賜給你悟性。 Consider what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
8. 你當記住那從死人中復活的耶穌基督，照著我的福音，他出自 大衛 的後裔。 Keep in mind Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, descended from David, according to my gospel.
9. 我為這福音受苦，甚至像罪犯一樣被捆綁；然而神的話語 是不受捆綁的。 For this I suffer, to the point of being bound like a criminal; but God's message is not bound.
10. 所以，我為了那些蒙揀選的人忍受一切，好讓他們也能得到那在基督耶穌裡的救恩和永恆的榮耀。 This is why I endure all things for the elect: so that they also may obtain salvation, which is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
11. 以下的話是信實的： 我們如果與基督一同死了，就將與他一同活著； This saying is trustworthy: For if we have died with Him, we will also live with Him;
12. 我們如果忍耐，就將與他一同做王； 我們如果不認他，他也將不認我們。 if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
13. 我們如果不信實，他仍然是信實的， 因為他不能否定自己。 if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.
14. 你要提醒他們這些事，在神 面前鄭重地勸誡他們：不可在言詞上爭執，那是毫無益處的，只會敗壞聽見的人。 Remind them of these things, charging them before God not to fight about words; this is in no way profitable and leads to the ruin of the hearers.
15. 你要努力地向神顯明自己是經過考驗的，是無愧的工人，能正確分解真理的話語。 Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed, correctly teaching the word of truth.
16. 至於那些不敬神的空談，你們要避免，因為說這些話的人 將導致更多不敬神的事； But avoid irreverent, empty speech, for this will produce an even greater measure of godlessness.
17. 他們的話像毒瘤那樣將會擴散。這些人中間有 希米奈奧 和 菲利特斯， And their word will spread like gangrene, among whom are Hymenaeus and Philetus.
18. 他們偏離了那有關真理的事，稱復活為已經過去的事，結果推翻了一些人的信仰。 They have deviated from the truth, saying that the resurrection has already taken place, and are overturning the faith of some.
19. 不過神堅固的根基始終確立，上面有這樣的印記： 「主認識那些屬於自己的人」 還有 「所有稱呼主 名的人都要離開不義」。 Nevertheless, God's solid foundation stands firm, having this inscription: The Lord knows those who are His, and Everyone who names the name of the Lord must turn away from unrighteousness.
20. 在大戶人家，不僅有金器、銀器，也有木器、瓦器；雖然有的為了貴重的用處，但有的卻為了卑賤的用處 。 Now in a large house there are not only gold and silver bowls, but also those of wood and earthenware, some for special use, some for ordinary.
21. 所以，如果有人潔淨自己脫離卑賤的事，他就會成為貴重的器皿，被分別為聖，對主人有用，而且是為著一切美善的工作所預備好的。 So if anyone purifies himself from these things, he will be a special instrument, set apart, useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.
22. 所以你要逃避年輕人的欲望；要與那些以潔淨的心求告主的人一同追求公義、信仰、愛心、和平； Flee from youthful passions, and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
23. 要拒絕愚拙無知的辯論，因為你知道這些只會引起爭鬥， But reject foolish and ignorant disputes, knowing that they breed quarrels.
24. 而主的奴僕不應該爭鬥；相反，要溫和地對待所有的人，善於教導，忍受惡待， The Lord's slave must not quarrel, but must be gentle to everyone, able to teach, and patient,
25. 溫柔地管教那些反對的人；或許神會賜給這些人悔改的心，到真理的知識當中。 instructing his opponents with gentleness. Perhaps God will grant them repentance to know the truth.
26. 這樣，那些被魔鬼擄去、隨從魔鬼意思的人，就能醒悟過來，脫離魔鬼的網羅。 Then they may come to their senses and escape the Devil's trap, having been captured by him to do his will.
2 Timothy 3
1. 你應當知道這一點：在末後的日子裡，將有艱難的時候來到； But know this: difficult times will come in the last days.
2. 因為人們將會愛自己、愛錢財，又自誇、又驕傲，褻瀆神、悖逆父母、忘恩負義、毫不聖潔、 For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,
3. 沒有親情、不肯和解、惡意控告、不能自制、殘忍凶暴、不愛良善、 unloving, irreconcilable, slanderers, without self-control, brutal, without love for what is good,
4. 背叛出賣、任意妄為、自以為是，愛享樂過於愛神， traitors, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
5. 有敬神的外表，卻否定敬神的實質 ；這樣的人你要避開。 holding to the form of religion but denying its power. Avoid these people!
6. 他們當中有些人溜進別人家裡，虜獲無知的婦女。這些婦女被罪孽壓制，被各種欲望牽引， For among them are those who worm their way into households and capture idle women burdened down with sins, led along by a variety of passions,
7. 雖然一直學習，卻始終不能達到到真理的知識當中。 always learning and never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
8. 揚尼 和 揚布列 怎樣抵擋 摩西，這些人也照樣抵擋真理；他們理性敗壞，在信仰上經不起考驗。 Just as Jannes and Jambres resisted Moses, so these also resist the truth, men who are corrupt in mind, worthless in regard to the faith.
9. 然而，他們不能再進一步了，因為他們的無知會在眾人面前顯露出來，就像那兩個人一樣。 But they will not make further progress, for their lack of understanding will be clear to all, as theirs was also.
10. 至於你，你跟從了我的教導、品行、心意、信仰、寬容、愛心、忍耐， But you have followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, and endurance,
11. 以及我在 安提阿 、 以哥念 、 路司得 所遭受的逼迫和苦難——我忍受了何等的逼迫啊！可是主救我脫離了這一切。 along with the persecutions and sufferings that came to me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from them all.
12. 其實，所有想要在基督耶穌裡過敬神生活的，也都會受到逼迫； In fact, all those who want to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
13. 而惡人和迷惑人的會越來越壞，他們迷惑人，自己也被迷惑。 Evil people and imposters will become worse, deceiving and being deceived.
14. 至於你，你當持守所學到、所確信的，因為你知道是從哪些人學的； But as for you, continue in what you have learned and firmly believed, knowing those from whom you learned,
15. 並且你從年幼就知道了聖經，這聖經能使你有智慧，藉著在基督耶穌裡的信仰，以至於救恩。 and that from childhood you have known the sacred Scriptures, which are able to instruct you for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
16. 聖經都是神所默示的，對於教導、責備、規正、在義中的訓練都是有益處的， All Scripture is inspired by God and is profitable for teaching, for rebuking, for correcting, for training in righteousness,
17. 要使屬神的人完備，為一切美善的工作，裝備齊全。 so that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
2 Timothy 4
1. 我在神、基督耶穌 面前，就是將要審判活人、死人的那一位面前，藉著他的顯現和他的國度鄭重地勸誡你： Before God and Christ Jesus, who is going to judge the living and the dead, and by His appearing and His kingdom, I solemnly charge you:
2. 你要傳福音，無論得時不得時，總要堅持；要以極大的耐心和各樣的教導責備人、告誡人、鼓勵人， proclaim the message; persist in it whether convenient or not; rebuke, correct, and encourage with great patience and teaching.
3. 因為時候將到，人們容忍不了健全的教義，反要順著自己的欲望，為自己的耳朵能被呵癢得舒服，去召聚許多教師。 For the time will come when they will not tolerate sound doctrine, but according to their own desires, will accumulate teachers for themselves because they have an itch to hear something new.
4. 他們將掩耳不聽真理，卻轉向編造的故事。 They will turn away from hearing the truth and will turn aside to myths.
5. 至於你，要在一切事上謹慎，忍受苦難，做傳福音者的工作，完成你的服事。 But as for you, keep a clear head about everything, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
6. 事實上，我已經在被澆奠了；我離開世界 的時候已經臨到了。 For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time for my departure is close.
7. 那美好的仗，我已經打過了；該跑的路程，我已經跑盡了 ；當守的 信仰，我已經持守了。 I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
8. 此後，有那公義的冠冕為我存留，就是主——公義的審判者要在那一天回報給我的；不僅給我，也要給所有愛慕他顯現的人。 In the future, there is reserved for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give me on that day, and not only to me, but to all those who have loved His appearing.
9. 你要盡快到我這裡來， Make every effort to come to me soon,
10. 因為 迪馬斯 愛上了現今的世代，就離棄我到 帖撒羅尼迦 去了； 克勒斯克 到 加拉太 去， 提多 到 達爾馬提亞 去了， for Demas has deserted me, because he loved this present world, and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
11. 只有 路加 與我在一起。你要接上 馬可，帶他一起來，因為他在服事工作上對我很有幫助。 Only Luke is with me. Bring Mark with you, for he is useful to me in the ministry.
12. 我派 特其庫斯 到 以弗所 去了。 I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
13. 你來的時候，要把我在 特羅阿斯 時留在 卡爾坡 家裡的那件外衣帶來，還有那些書卷，尤其是那些羊皮卷，也要帶來。 When you come, bring the cloak I left in Troas with Carpus, as well as the scrolls, especially the parchments.
14. 銅匠 亞歷山大 對我做了很多惡事；主將照著他的行為回報他。 Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his works.
15. 你也要提防他，因為他極力抵擋我們的話。 Watch out for him yourself, because he strongly opposed our words.
16. 我第一次為自己辯護的時候，沒有一個人來支持我，大家都離棄了我；願這事不算在他們身上。 At my first defense, no one came to my assistance, but everyone deserted me. May it not be counted against them.
17. 但是主站在我身邊，使我剛強，為要藉著我使傳道得以完成，讓所有外邦人都能聽見；我也從獅子口裡被救了出來。 But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that the proclamation might be fully made through me, and all the Gentiles might hear. So I was rescued from the lion's mouth.
18. 主將會救我脫離一切凶惡之事，並且救我進入他屬天的國度。願榮耀歸於他，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 The Lord will rescue me from every evil work and will bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
19. 請問候 普茜拉 和 阿奎拉，還有 奧尼斯弗羅 的家人。 Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
20. 以拉斯托 在 哥林多 住下了； 特羅費摩 患了病，我就留他在 米利都 。 Erastus has remained at Corinth; Trophimus I left sick at Miletus.
21. 你要在冬天以前盡快趕來。 猶布羅斯 、 普迪斯 、 利諾斯 、 克勞迪婭，以及所有的弟兄都問候你。 Make every effort to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
22. 願主 與你的靈同在。願恩典與你們同在！ The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you!
Titus
Titus 1
1. 我 保羅 做神的奴僕、耶穌基督的使徒，是為了神所揀選之人的信仰，以及那帶來敬神的真理知識； Paul, a slave of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God's elect and the knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
2. 這是基於那永恆生命的盼望，而這盼望是那不撒謊的神在亙古以前所應許的。 in the hope of eternal life that God, who cannot lie, promised before time began,
3. 神在所定的時候，藉著傳道把他的話顯明了出來；我就是照著神我們救主的命令受了委託。 and has in His own time revealed His message in the proclamation that I was entrusted with by the command of God our Savior:
4. 致共同信仰上的真兒子 提多 ： 願恩典、 平安從父神和我們的救主基督耶穌 臨到你！ To Titus, my true child in our common faith. Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
