5. 我曾把你留在 克里特 島，為的是這樣的緣故：要你處理那些還沒有辦完的事，並且照著我所吩咐你的，在各城委任長老。 The reason I left you in Crete was to set right what was left undone and, as I directed you, to appoint elders in every town:
6. 如果有人是無可指責的；只 做一個婦人的丈夫；兒女是信徒，沒有被控告為放蕩或不服從，你就可以委任 。 someone who is blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of wildness or rebellion.
7. 因為，身為神的管家，做監督的必須無可指責、不任性、不暴躁、不酗酒、不好鬥、不貪圖不正當的利益； For an overseer, as God's manager, must be blameless, not arrogant, not quick tempered, not addicted to wine, not a bully, not greedy for money,
8. 反而樂意款待客旅、喜愛良善、清醒自制、公正、聖潔、節制， but hospitable, loving what is good, sensible, righteous, holy, self-controlled,
9. 堅守那合乎教導的信實話語；這是為了要他不但能用健全的教義勸勉人，而且能使那些反對的人知罪。 holding to the faithful message as taught, so that he will be able both to encourage with sound teaching and to refute those who contradict it.
10. 因為實在有許多不服從的、講虛妄話的、欺騙人的，尤其是那些屬於割禮派的人 ； For there are also many rebellious people, idle talkers and deceivers, especially those from Judaism.
11. 必須堵住這些人的口。他們為了不正當的利益，教導不該教導的事，把許多人的整個家庭都破壞了。 It is necessary to silence them; they overthrow whole households by teaching for dishonest gain what they should not.
12. 克里特 人中有一位，是他們自己的先知，曾經說過：「 克里特 人總是說謊的，是惡獸，好吃懶做。」 One of their very own prophets said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.
13. 這見證是真實的。因這理由，你要嚴厲地責備他們，好使他們在信仰上健全， This testimony is true. So, rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith
14. 不去聽從 猶太 人編造的故事，以及背棄真理之人的命令。 and may not pay attention to Jewish myths and the commandments of men who reject the truth.
15. 對潔淨的人，一切都是潔淨的；對汙穢和不信的人，沒有一樣是潔淨的，就是他們的理性和良心也都被汙穢了。 To the pure, everything is pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; in fact, both their mind and conscience are defiled.
16. 他們聲稱認識神，卻在行為上否認他。他們是可憎惡的、悖逆的，在任何美善的工作上都經不起考驗。 They profess to know God, but they deny Him by their works. They are detestable, disobedient, and disqualified for any good work.
Titus 2
1. 至於你，你所講的要與健全的教義相宜： But you must speak what is consistent with sound teaching.
2. 年長的男人要節制、莊重、自律，在信仰、愛心和忍耐上要健全； Older men are to be self-controlled, worthy of respect, sensible, and sound in faith, love, and endurance.
3. 同樣，年長的婦女在舉止行為上要合乎聖潔、不惡意控告、不成為酒的奴隸，要教導美好的事； In the same way, older women are to be reverent in behavior, not slanderers, not addicted to much wine. [They are] to teach what is good,
4. 這樣，她們可以訓導年輕的婦女愛丈夫、愛兒女、 so that they may encourage the young women to love their husbands and children,
5. 自律、貞潔、善理家務、良善、服從自己的丈夫，免得神的話語 受到褻瀆。 to be sensible, pure, good homemakers, and submissive to their husbands, so that God's message will not be slandered.
6. 同樣，你要鼓勵年輕的男人清醒自制； Likewise, encourage the young men to be sensible
7. 你自己要在一切事上做出美好工作的榜樣；教導的時候要正直 、莊重， about everything. Set an example of good works yourself, with integrity and dignity in your teaching.
8. 要用無可指責的健全話語，使反對的人在我們 的事上因沒有壞話可說，就感到羞愧。 Your message is to be sound beyond reproach, so that the opponent will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
9. 奴僕要在一切事上服從自己的主人、討主人喜悅，不可頂嘴、 Slaves are to be submissive to their masters in everything, and to be well-pleasing, not talking back
10. 不可私拿東西，反要顯出所有美好的忠信，好在一切事上為神我們救主的教導增添光彩。 or stealing, but demonstrating utter faithfulness, so that they may adorn the teaching of God our Savior in everything.
11. 事實上，神拯救萬民的恩典已經顯明出來了。 For the grace of God has appeared, with salvation for all people,
12. 這恩典管教我們，使我們拒絕不敬神的事和地上的欲望，在今世能過自制、公義、敬神的生活， instructing us to deny godlessness and worldly lusts and to live in a sensible, righteous, and godly way in the present age,
13. 期待那蒙福的盼望，以及我們那偉大的神、救主耶穌基督 榮耀的顯現。 while we wait for the blessed hope and the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ.
14. 他為我們獻上自己，是為了救贖我們脫離一切罪惡，並且潔淨我們做他自己特選的子民，做美好工作的熱心人。 He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to cleanse for Himself a special people, eager to do good works.
15. 你要講說這些，充分地使用權威來勸勉、責備；不要讓任何人輕看你。 Say these things, and encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one disregard you.
Titus 3
1. 你提醒他們要服從統治者和掌權者，要順從，並要為一切美善的工作做好準備； Remind them to be submissive to rulers and authorities, to obey, to be ready for every good work,
2. 不要毀謗人、不要爭吵；要謙和，在一切事上對所有的人都要顯出溫柔。 to slander no one, to avoid fighting, and to be kind, always showing gentleness to all people.
3. 其實，我們從前也是無知、悖逆、被迷惑的，做各種欲望和享樂的奴僕，活在惡毒和嫉妒中，是可憎惡的，又彼此相恨。 For we too were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, captives of various passions and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, detesting one another.
4. 但是，當神我們救主的仁慈和他對人的愛顯明的時候， But when the goodness and love for man appeared from God our Savior,
5. 他拯救了我們； 這不是本於我們所做的義行， 而是照著他的憐憫， 藉著重生的洗滌和聖靈的更新。 He saved us-- not by works of righteousness that we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of regeneration and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
6. 神藉著我們的救主耶穌基督， 將聖靈豐豐富富地傾注在我們身上， This [Spirit] He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
7. 使我們藉著他的恩典被稱為義， 可以照著永恆生命的盼望成為繼承人。 so that having been justified by His grace, we may become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
8. 這話是信實的。我希望你強調這些事，好讓那些信了神的人專心投入美好的工作；這些事對人是好事，是有益處的。 This saying is trustworthy. I want you to insist on these things, so that those who have believed God might be careful to devote themselves to good works. These are good and profitable for everyone.
9. 至於愚拙的辯論、家譜、紛爭和律法上的爭執，你都要避免；因為這些都是無用的，是虛妄的。 But avoid foolish debates, genealogies, quarrels, and disputes about the law, for they are unprofitable and worthless.
10. 對那製造分裂的人，在第一次、第二次的警戒以後，就要棄絕他， Reject a divisive person after a first and second warning,
11. 因為你知道，這樣的人已經背道，一直犯罪，定了自己的罪。 knowing that such a person is perverted and sins, being self-condemned.
12. 我派 阿特馬斯 或 特其庫斯 到你那裡以後，你要盡快到 尼科波利斯 來見我，因為我已經決定在那裡過冬。 When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, make every effort to come to me in Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.
13. 你要盡快送 齊納斯 律師和 阿波羅 上路，好讓他們一無所缺。 Diligently help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey, so that they will lack nothing.
14. 我們自己的人，為了緊要的需用也應該學會投入美好的工作，免得成為不結果子的人。 And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works for cases of urgent need, so that they will not be unfruitful.
15. 所有與我在一起的人都問候你。請問候那些在信仰上愛我們的人。願恩典與你們大家同在！ All those who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
Philemon
Philemon 1
1. 基督耶穌的囚犯 保羅，以及弟兄 提摩太， 致我們親愛的弟兄和同工 腓利門， Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy, our brother: To Philemon, our dear friend and co-worker,
2. 還有姐妹 阿菲婭 和我們的戰友 阿其波斯，以及在你家裡的教會： to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets in your house.
3. 願恩典與平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督臨到你們！ Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
4. 我在禱告中提到你的時候，總是感謝我的神， I always thank my God when I mention you in my prayers,
5. 因為我聽說了你對主耶穌和所有聖徒所懷的愛心和信仰。 because I hear of your love and faith toward the Lord Jesus and for all the saints.
6. 藉著認識在我們 中間為基督 所做的 一切美善之事，願你在信仰上的契合 能發揮功效。 [I pray] that your participation in the faith may become effective through knowing every good thing that is in us for [the glory of] Christ.
7. 實際上，我由於你的愛得了極大的喜樂 和鼓勵，因為弟兄啊，聖徒們的情感藉著你得了安寧。 For I have great joy and encouragement from your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
8. 所以，雖然我在基督裡大有膽量，可以吩咐你去做 合宜的事， For this reason, although I have great boldness in Christ to command you to do what is right,
9. 但為了愛的緣故，我寧願懇求你。我 保羅 ——像我這樣一個老人，而現在又是基督耶穌的囚犯—— I appeal, instead, on the basis of love. I, Paul, as an elderly man and now also as a prisoner of Christ Jesus,
10. 為我在捆鎖中所生的孩子 奧尼斯莫，懇求你。 appeal to you for my child, whom I fathered while in chains-- Onesimus.
11. 他從前對你沒有益處，但如今對你、對我都有益處了。 Once he was useless to you, but now he is useful to both you and me.
12. 我把他本人送回你那裡，就是說，把我的情感送回你那裡。 I am sending him-- a part of myself-- back to you.
13. 我本來想把他留在自己身邊，好讓他在我為福音被捆鎖的期間，能替你服事我。 I wanted to keep him with me, so that in my imprisonment for the gospel he might serve me in your place.
14. 但是沒有你的同意，我就不願意做什麼，好讓你的美善之事不是出於勉強，而是出於自願。 But I didn't want to do anything without your consent, so that your good deed might not be out of obligation, but of your own free will.
15. 其實，他暫時離開你，或許正是為了使你可以永遠得著他—— For perhaps this is why he was separated [from you] for a brief time, so that you might get him back permanently,
16. 不再像一個奴僕，而是高於奴僕，是一位蒙愛的弟兄。他對我尤其是這樣，更何況對你呢！無論是在肉體上或在主裡面都是這樣。 no longer as a slave, but more than a slave-- as a dearly loved brother. This is especially so to me, but even more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
17. 因此，你如果把我當做同伴，就請接納他，像接納我一樣。 So if you consider me a partner, accept him as you would me.
18. 如果他虧負過你什麼，或現在欠了你什麼，請把它算在我的帳上。 And if he has wronged you in any way, or owes you anything, charge that to my account.
19. 我 保羅 親手寫下：我必償還——免得我對你說，連你自己也是欠我的呢！ I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it-- not to mention to you that you owe me even your own self.
20. 是的，弟兄！願我在主裡從你得到喜樂，請你使我的情感在基督 裡得到安寧。 Yes, brother, may I have joy from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.
21. 我深信你會順從，就寫了信給你，因為我知道你所做的甚至會超過我所求的。 Since I am confident of your obedience, I am writing to you, knowing that you will do even more than I say.
22. 同時還請你為我預備住處，因為我希望藉著你們的禱告，能回到你們那裡去。 But meanwhile, also prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
23. 在基督耶穌裡與我一起坐牢的 以帕弗拉 問候你。 Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you, and so do
24. 我的同工 馬可 、 亞里達古 、 迪馬斯 、 路加 也都問候你。 Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my co-workers.
25. 願我們主耶穌基督的恩典與你們的靈同在！ The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
Hebrews
Hebrews 1
1. 過去，神在不同的時代，用不同的方式，藉著先知們對祖先說話， Long ago God spoke to the fathers by the prophets at different times and in different ways.
2. 但在末後的這些日子裡，神藉著他的 兒子向我們說話。神預定了他為萬有的繼承人，也藉著他造了宇宙 。 In these last days, He has spoken to us by [His] Son, whom He has appointed heir of all things and through whom He made the universe.
3. 他是神榮耀的光輝，是神本體的真像，以自己大能的話語托住萬有。他成就了潔淨罪孽的事，就坐在高天至尊者的右邊。 He is the radiance of His glory, the exact expression of His nature, and He sustains all things by His powerful word. After making purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
4. 他遠比天使更美好，就像他所繼承的名比天使的名更尊貴。 So He became higher in rank than the angels, just as the name He inherited is superior to theirs.
5. 從前神到底對哪一位天使說過 「你是我的兒子，我今天生了你」，又說 「我將成為他的父親，他成為我的兒子」 呢？ For to which of the angels did He ever say, You are My Son; today I have become Your Father, or again, I will be His Father, and He will be My Son?
6. 不過當神再次帶領長子 進入世界的時候卻說： 「神所有的天使都當敬拜他。」 When He again brings His firstborn into the world, He says, And all God's angels must worship Him.
7. 關於天使，他確實說： 「神使他的天使為風， 使他的僕役為烈火。」 And about the angels He says: He makes His angels winds, and His servants a fiery flame;
8. 但是關於兒子，他卻說： 「神哪，你的寶座是永永遠遠的； 你國度的權杖是正義的權杖。 but about the Son: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, and the scepter of Your kingdom is a scepter of justice.
9. 你愛公義，恨罪惡， 為此，神——你的神用喜樂的油來膏立你， 而不膏立你的同伴。」 You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; this is why God, Your God, has anointed You, rather than Your companions, with the oil of joy.
10. 他又說： 「主啊，你在起初立定了大地的根基， 諸天也是你手所造的。 And: In the beginning, Lord, You established the earth, and the heavens are the works of Your hands;
11. 天地 將要毀滅，你卻繼續存留； 天地都要像衣服那樣漸漸破舊。 they will perish, but You remain. They will all wear out like clothing;
12. 你將要把天地像外衣那樣捲起來， 天地也要像衣服那樣 被更換； 你卻永不改變， 你的歲月沒有窮盡。」 You will roll them up like a cloak, and they will be changed like a robe. But You are the same, and Your years will never end.
13. 從前神到底對哪一位天使說過： 「你坐在我的右邊， 等我把你的敵人放在你的腳下做腳凳」 呢？ Now to which of the angels has He ever said: Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies Your footstool?
14. 難道所有的天使不都是服事的靈、奉差派服事那些將要繼承救恩的人嗎？ Are they not all ministering spirits sent out to serve those who are going to inherit salvation?
Hebrews 2
1. 因此，我們必須更加留心所聽過的事，免得隨流漂去。 We must therefore pay even more attention to what we have heard, so that we will not drift away.
2. 要知道，那藉著天使所說的話既然是確定的，連一切過犯和悖逆都受到了應得的報應， For if the message spoken through angels was legally binding, and every transgression and disobedience received a just punishment,
3. 那麼，如果我們忽視了如此偉大的救恩，又怎麼能逃脫報應呢？這救恩起初由主傳講，後來由那些聽見的人向我們證實。 how will we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? It was first spoken by the Lord and was confirmed to us by those who heard Him.
4. 神又照著自己的旨意，用神蹟、奇事和各種大能，以及聖靈的各種恩賜，與他們一同見證。 At the same time, God also testified by signs and wonders, various miracles, and distributions [of gifts] from the Holy Spirit according to His will.
5. 事實上，我們所說的那「將要來的世界」，神並沒有使它服從天使， For He has not subjected to angels the world to come that we are talking about.
6. 但是有人在經上 某處鄭重地見證說： 「人算什麼，你竟然顧念他？ 人之子算什麼，你竟然照顧他？ But one has somewhere testified: What is man, that You remember him, or the son of man, that You care for him?
7. 你使他暫時比天使低微 ； 你賜他榮耀和尊貴為冠冕； You made him lower than the angels for a short time; You crowned him with glory and honor
8. 你使萬有都服從在他的腳下。」 既然神使 萬有都服從 他，就沒有留下一樣不服從他；但如今，我們還沒有看見 萬有都服從 他。 and subjected everything under his feet. For in subjecting everything to him, He left nothing not subject to him. As it is, we do not yet see everything subjected to him.
9. 不過我們看見的是： 那暫時比天使低微的 耶穌，因著死亡的痛苦被賜予榮耀和尊貴為冠冕，好使他藉著神的恩典，替所有的人嘗了死的滋味。 But we do see Jesus-- made lower than the angels for a short time so that by God's grace He might taste death for everyone-- crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death.
10. 萬有因他而有、萬有藉他而成的那一位，既然要帶領許多兒女歸於榮耀，就藉著苦難使他們救恩的元首 得以成全，這是合宜的， For it was fitting, in bringing many sons to glory, that He, for whom and through whom all things exist, should make the source of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
11. 因為那使人分別為聖的，和那些被分別為聖的，都是出於同一位。因這理由，他稱他們為弟兄，並不以為恥。 For the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified all have one Father. That is why He is not ashamed to call them brothers,
12. 他說： 「我要向我的弟兄們宣揚你的名， 我要在會眾面前歌頌你。」 saying: I will proclaim Your name to My brothers; I will sing hymns to You in the congregation.
13. 他又說： 「我要依靠他。」 還說： 「看哪，我和神所賜給我的孩子們都在這裡 ！」 Again, I will trust in Him. And again, Here I am with the children God gave Me.
14. 所以，孩子們既然同屬血肉之體，他也照樣同有一樣的血肉之體，為要藉著死亡來廢除那掌握死亡權勢的——就是魔鬼， Now since the children have flesh and blood in common, He also shared in these, so that through His death He might destroy the one holding the power of death-- that is, the Devil--
15. 並且釋放那些因怕死而終生被束縛為奴役的人。 and free those who were held in slavery all their lives by the fear of death.
16. 顯然，他並不是要救拔天使，而是救拔 亞伯拉罕 的後裔。 For it is clear that He does not reach out to help angels, but to help Abraham's offspring.
17. 故此，他必須在各方面都像他的弟兄們那樣，為要在屬神的事上成為憐憫人的、忠心 的大祭司，好為子民的罪孽獻上平息祭 。 Therefore He had to be like His brothers in every way, so that He could become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.
18. 既然他自己在被試探的時候受了苦，他就能幫助那些受試探的人。 For since He Himself was tested and has suffered, He is able to help those who are tested.
Hebrews 3
1. 故此，蒙了屬天召喚的同伴們，聖潔的弟兄們！你們應該思想我們信仰 告白中的使者和大祭司——耶穌 。 Therefore, holy brothers and companions in a heavenly calling, consider Jesus, the apostle and high priest of our confession;
2. 他對委任他的那一位是忠心的，正如 摩西 在神的全家也是忠心的。 He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was in all God's household.
3. 事實上，這個人被看為比 摩西 配得更大的榮耀，就像建造房屋的人比房屋本身更有尊榮那樣， For Jesus is considered worthy of more glory than Moses, just as the builder has more honor than the house.
4. 因為每一座房屋都是由人建造的，而建造萬有的就是神。 Now every house is built by someone, but the One who built everything is God.
5. 摩西 是做為僕人，對神的全家忠心，為將被述說的事做見證； Moses was faithful as a servant in all God's household, as a testimony to what would be said [in the future].
6. 但基督是做為兒子，忠心管理神的家。如果我們持守所確信的和所誇耀的盼望， 我們就是神的家。 But Christ was faithful as a Son over His household, whose household we are if we hold on to the courage and the confidence of our hope.
7. 因此，就像聖靈所說的： 「今天，你們如果聽見他的聲音， Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: Today, if you hear His voice,
8. 就不可硬著你們的心， 如同在那悖逆的時候，也像在那曠野試探的日子。 do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, on the day of testing in the desert,
9. 在那裡，你們的祖先考驗我、試探我， 並且看了我的作為四十年之久。 where your fathers tested Me, tried [ Me], and saw My works
10. 所以，我向那世代發怒，說： 『他們的心總是被迷惑， 他們不認識我的道路』， for 40 years. Therefore I was provoked with this generation and said, "They always go astray in their hearts, and they have not known My ways."
11. 所以，我在自己的震怒中起誓說： 『他們絕不能進入我的安息。』」 So I swore in My anger, "They will not enter My rest."
12. 弟兄們，你們要當心，免得你們中間有人存著不信的邪惡之心，以致離開永生的神。 Watch out, brothers, so that there won't be in any of you an evil, unbelieving heart that departs from the living God.
13. 只要日子還被稱為 「今天」，你們就要天天互相鼓勵，免得你們當中有人被罪迷惑，心裡剛硬。 But encourage each other daily, while it is still called today, so that none of you is hardened by sin's deception.
14. 因為我們如果把那起初的確信，堅定地持守到底，我們就成為基督的同伴了。 For we have become companions of the Messiah if we hold firmly until the end the reality that we had at the start.
15. 經上說： 「今天，你們如果聽見他的聲音， 就不可硬著你們的心，如同在那悖逆的時候。」 As it is said: Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion.
16. 到底是誰聽見卻悖逆了呢？難道不是被 摩西 從 埃及 帶領 出來的那一切人嗎？ For who heard and rebelled? Wasn't it really all who came out of Egypt under Moses?
17. 神又向誰發怒了四十年之久呢？難道不是那些犯了罪、屍首倒在曠野的人嗎？ And with whom was He "provoked for 40 years"? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the desert?
18. 他又向誰起誓說，他們絕不能進入他的安息呢？難道不是向那些不肯信從的人嗎？ And to whom did He "swear that they would not enter His rest," if not those who disobeyed?
19. 這樣我們就看出來：他們不能進入，是因不信的緣故。 So we see that they were unable to enter because of unbelief.
Hebrews 4
1. 所以，既然那進入神 安息的應許還存留，我們就該懼怕，免得我們 當中有人看來達不到了。 Therefore, while the promise remains of entering His rest, let us fear so that none of you should miss it.
2. 實際上，我們也是得以聽到福音的，就像他們那樣；但是他們所聽的話語對他們沒有益處，因為他們沒有因著信，與所聽的相配合。 For we also have received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard did not benefit them, since they were not united with those who heard it in faith
3. 其實，我們這些相信的才能進入那安息，正如神所說： 「所以我在自己的震怒中起誓： 『他們絕不能進入我的安息。』」 事實上，神的工作從創世以來，就已經完成了。 (for we who have believed enter the rest), in keeping with what He has said: So I swore in My anger, they will not enter My rest. And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world,
4. 原來關於第七日，他在經上某處這樣說： 「神在第七日， 歇了他所有的工作。」 for somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this way: And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.
5. 在這裡他又說： 「他們絕不能進入我的安息。」 Again, in that passage [He says], They will never enter My rest.
6. 所以，既然這安息為了一些進入它的人被保留下來，可是由於那些原先得以聽到福音的人，因著不信從而沒有進去， Since it remains for some to enter it, and those who formerly received the good news did not enter because of disobedience,
7. 神就再次設定了一個日子—— 「今天」，就是在很久以後藉著 大衛 所說的，像預先說過 的那樣： 「今天，你們如果聽見他的聲音， 就不可硬著你們的心。」 again, He specifies a certain day-- today-- speaking through David after such a long time, as previously stated: Today if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.
8. 如果 約書亞 已經使他們得了安息，神後來就不會再說到另一個日子了。 For if Joshua had given them rest, He would not have spoken later about another day.
9. 這樣，就有一個「安息日的安息」為了神的子民被保留下來。 A Sabbath rest remains, therefore, for God's people.
10. 原來，那進了神 安息的人，也歇了自己的工作，就像神歇了自己的工作那樣。 For the person who has entered His rest has rested from his own works, just as God did from His.
11. 所以，我們要努力進入那安息，免得有人照著那同樣不信從的樣式跌落了。 Let us then make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall into the same pattern of disobedience.
12. 神的話語 是有生命的，是有功效的；比任何雙刃的劍更鋒利，能刺透到魂和靈的分界，以及骨節和骨髓的分界，也能辨明心中的思想和意念； For the word of God is living and effective and sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating as far as to divide soul, spirit, joints, and marrow; it is a judge of the ideas and thoughts of the heart.
13. 並且被造之物在神面前，沒有一樣不是顯明的；萬有在他眼前，都是赤裸敞開的；我們都要向他交代。 No creature is hidden from Him, but all things are naked and exposed to the eyes of Him to whom we must give an account.
14. 所以，我們既然有一位已經越過了諸天的、尊貴的大祭司——神的兒子耶穌，我們就要持守信仰 告白； Therefore since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens-- Jesus the Son of God-- let us hold fast to the confession.
15. 因為我們的大祭司不是不能同情我們的種種軟弱，而是在各方面照著與我們相同的樣式受過試探，只是沒有犯罪。 For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but One who has been tested in every way as we are, yet without sin.
16. 因此，讓我們坦然無懼地來到恩典的寶座前，為要得著憐憫，尋見恩典，做為及時的幫助。 Therefore let us approach the throne of grace with boldness, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us at the proper time.
Hebrews 5
1. 每一個從人間選出來的大祭司，都是受委任替人辦理屬神的事，要為罪孽獻上禮物和祭物。 For every high priest taken from men is appointed in service to God for the people, to offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
2. 他能體諒那些不明白而被迷惑的人，因為他自己也被軟弱所困。 He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and are going astray, since he himself is also subject to weakness.
3. 因此，他怎樣替子民為罪獻祭，也必須照樣替自己為罪獻祭。 Because of this, he must make a sin offering for himself as well as for the people.
4. 沒有任何人能為自己取得這尊榮，除非蒙神召喚，就像 亞倫 那樣。 No one takes this honor on himself; instead, a person is called by God, just as Aaron was.
5. 同樣，也不是基督榮耀了自己成為大祭司，而是曾經對他說 「你是我的兒子，我今天生了你」 的那一位榮耀了他； In the same way, the Messiah did not exalt Himself to become a high priest, but the One who said to Him, You are My Son; today I have become Your Father,
6. 正如在另外一處也說： 「你是照著 麥基洗德 的等級 做祭司，直到永遠。」 also said in another passage, You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
7. 基督在他肉身的日子裡，曾經用強烈的呼號和淚水，向能救他脫離死亡的那一位獻上了祈禱和懇求，就因著他的虔誠蒙了垂聽。 During His earthly life, He offered prayers and appeals, with loud cries and tears, to the One who was able to save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
8. 他雖然是兒子，還是從他所受的苦難中，學了順從。 Though a Son, He learned obedience through what He suffered.
9. 他既然得以完全，就為所有順從他的人成了永恆救恩的本源， After He was perfected, He became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him,
10. 並且被神稱為「照著 麥基洗德 之等級 的大祭司」。 and He was declared by God a high priest "in the order of Melchizedek."
11. 關於這事，我們還有很多話要說，可是很難解釋，因為你們聽不進去了。 We have a great deal to say about this, and it's difficult to explain, since you have become slow to understand.
12. 其實從時間來說，你們早就應該做教師了，卻還需要有人把神話語的基本原則重新教導你們；你們成了那需要吃奶、而不能吃乾糧的人。 For though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you again the basic principles of God's revelation. You need milk, not solid food.
13. 要知道，凡是吃奶的人，都對稱義的道理不熟悉，因為他是個小孩子； Now everyone who lives on milk is inexperienced with the message about righteousness, because he is an infant.
14. 不過乾糧是給成熟之人 吃的——他們經過實踐，識別能力得到操練，以致能分辨善惡。 But solid food is for the mature-- for those whose senses have been trained to distinguish between good and evil.
Hebrews 6
1. 所以，讓我們從基督話語的基本原則出發，被神 帶到那成熟的境界；而不用重新打基礎，就如悔改那些致死的行為、對神的信仰、 Therefore, leaving the elementary message about the Messiah, let us go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, faith in God,
2. 各樣的洗淨禮、按手禮、死人復活、永遠的懲罰等教導上。 teaching about ritual washings, laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
3. 神如果准許，我們就這麼做。 And we will do this if God permits.
4. 原來，如果有人蒙過一次光照、嘗過屬天恩賜的滋味、曾經與聖靈有份、 For it is impossible to renew to repentance those who were once enlightened, who tasted the heavenly gift, became companions with the Holy Spirit,
5. 嘗過神美善的話語和將要來臨之世代的權能， tasted God's good word and the powers of the coming age,
6. 卻背棄了真理，就不可能再次更新以至於悔改了。因為他們親自把神的兒子再次釘上十字架，公然羞辱他。 and who have fallen away, because, to their own harm, they are recrucifying the Son of God and holding Him up to contempt.
7. 要知道，當一塊田地吸收了常常降在它上面的雨水，並且為種地的人長出有用菜蔬時，它就享受從神而來的祝福； For ground that has drunk the rain that has often fallen on it, and that produces vegetation useful to those it is cultivated for, receives a blessing from God.
8. 但如果它長出荊棘和蒺藜，就沒有用處了，很快就要被詛咒，它的結局就是被焚燒。 But if it produces thorns and thistles, it is worthless and about to be cursed, and will be burned at the end.
9. 各位蒙愛的人哪，我們即使這樣說，還是深信那關於你們的更好之事，並且是有關救恩的， Even though we are speaking this way, dear friends, in your case we are confident of the better things connected with salvation.
10. 因為神不是不公正的，以致忘記你們的工作和你們為他的名所顯出的愛，就是你們先前和如今服事聖徒時所顯出的愛 。 For God is not unjust; He will not forget your work and the love you showed for His name when you served the saints-- and you continue to serve them.
11. 我們渴望你們每個人都顯出同樣的殷勤，使你們對所盼望的有完全的確信，一直到底； Now we want each of you to demonstrate the same diligence for the final realization of your hope,
12. 這樣，你們就不會變得懈怠，反而會效法那些藉著信仰和耐心去繼承各樣應許的人。 so that you won't become lazy, but imitators of those who inherit the promises through faith and perseverance.
13. 神向 亞伯拉罕 應許的時候，因為沒有比自己 更大的可以指著起誓，就指著自己起誓， For when God made a promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself:
14. 說： 「我必定大大賜福給你， 多多地增加你的子孫 。」 I will most certainly bless you, and I will greatly multiply you.
15. 這樣， 亞伯拉罕 恆久忍耐，就獲得了神所應許的。 And so, after waiting patiently, Abraham obtained the promise.
16. 人本來指著比自己 更大的起誓；對他們，所起的誓就是了結一切爭執的確據； For men swear by something greater than themselves, and for them a confirming oath ends every dispute.
17. 為此，神想要對那些繼承應許的人格外表明他的計劃是不能更改的，就用所起的誓來保證。 Because God wanted to show His unchangeable purpose even more clearly to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath,
18. 藉著這兩件不能更改的事——在這些事上，神不可能說謊——使我們這些逃往避難所、抓住那擺在前面盼望的人，可以得到極大的鼓勵。 so that through two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to seize the hope set before us.
19. 我們所擁有的這盼望，像靈魂 的錨，又可靠又堅固，並且進到幔子最裡層的那至聖所 。 We have this [hope]-- like a sure and firm anchor of the soul-- that enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain.
20. 耶穌已經為我們做先鋒進入了那裡，照著 麥基洗德 的等級 做大祭司，直到永遠。 Jesus has entered there on our behalf as a forerunner, because He has become a "high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."
Hebrews 7
1. 原來這 麥基洗德 —— 撒冷 之王，至高神的祭司， 在 亞伯拉罕 殺敗眾王回來的時候，去迎接他、祝福他， For this Melchizedek-- King of Salem, priest of the Most High God, who met Abraham and blessed him as he returned from defeating the kings,
2. 亞伯拉罕 就從所得來的一切中，把十分之一獻給 他。 「 麥基洗德 」翻譯出來，首先是「公義之王」， 然後又是「 撒冷 之王」——這意思是「和平之王」。 and Abraham gave him a tenth of everything; first, his name means "king of righteousness," then also, "king of Salem," meaning "king of peace";
3. 他沒有父親，沒有母親，沒有族譜， 沒有年歲的開始，也沒有生命的終結， 與神的兒子相似，持久做祭司，直到永遠。 without father, mother, or genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but resembling the Son of God-- remains a priest forever.
4. 你們當想一想，這個人多麼偉大！連先祖 亞伯拉罕 也從最好的戰利品中把十分之一獻給他。 Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth of the plunder!
5. 雖然 利未 子孫中那些領受祭司職務的，從 亞伯拉罕 的後裔 中出來，他們還是奉命按照律法向子民，就是自己的同胞，收取十分之一。 The sons of Levi who receive the priestly office have a commandment according to the law to collect a tenth from the people-- that is, from their brothers-- though they have [also] descended from Abraham.
6. 可是，不出於 利未 世系的那一位，卻從 亞伯拉罕 收取了十分之一，並且祝福了那擁有各樣應許的 亞伯拉罕 。 But one without this lineage collected tithes from Abraham and blessed the one who had the promises.
7. 原來，位分小的從位分大的接受祝福，是毫無爭議的事。 Without a doubt, the inferior is blessed by the superior.
8. 在這裡，收取十分之一的人們固然都會死去；但在那裡，他卻被見證說是永生的。 In the one case, men who will die receive tithes; but in the other case, [Scripture] testifies that he lives.
9. 甚至從某種意義上可以說：連那收取十分之一的 利未，也藉著 亞伯拉罕 交納了十分之一， And in a sense Levi himself, who receives tithes, has paid tithes through Abraham,
10. 因為 麥基洗德 迎接 亞伯拉罕 的時候， 利未 還在他先祖的身體 裡面。 for he was still within his forefather when Melchizedek met him.
11. 既然如此，如果藉著 利未 人的祭司職份能達到完全——子民本來在這職份下領受了律法——那麼，為什麼還需要照著 麥基洗德 的等級，而不照著所謂「 亞倫 的等級」興起另一位祭司呢？ If, then, perfection came through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise in the order of Melchizedek, and not to be described as being in the order of Aaron?
12. 祭司職份被更換，律法也必須有所更換。 For when there is a change of the priesthood, there must be a change of law as well.
13. 其實這些話所論到的那一位是屬於別的支派，這支派中從來沒有人在祭壇供過職； For the One about whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has served at the altar.
14. 就是說，我們的主明顯是從 猶大 支派 興起的，而對於這個支派， 摩西 從來沒有提到有關祭司 的事。 Now it is evident that our Lord came from Judah, and about that tribe Moses said nothing concerning priests.
15. 如果照著 麥基洗德 的相同樣式另有一位祭司興起來，那麼，這件事就更加明顯了。 And this becomes clearer if another priest like Melchizedek arises,
16. 他成為祭司，不是照著有關肉體條例的法則，而是照著那不能毀滅的生命大能， who doesn't become a [priest] based on a legal command concerning physical descent but based on the power of an indestructible life.
17. 因為他被見證說： 「你是照著 麥基洗德 的等級 做祭司，直到永遠。」 For it has been testified: You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
18. 原來，一方面，先前的條例因著本身的軟弱和無用，就被廢棄了， So the previous commandment is annulled because it was weak and unprofitable
19. 因為律法沒有使任何事物完全；另一方面，一個更美好的盼望卻被帶來了；藉著這個盼望，我們可以親近神。 (for the law perfected nothing), but a better hope is introduced, through which we draw near to God.
20. 再者，所發生的事並不是沒有神的 誓言保證。就是說，其他人成為祭司是沒有誓言保證的， None of this [happened] without an oath. For others became priests without an oath,
21. 可是耶穌 藉著對他說話的那一位是有誓言保證的： 「主起了誓，不會後悔： 『你是 祭司，直到永遠。』」 but He with an oath made by the One who said to Him: The Lord has sworn, and He will not change His mind, You are a priest forever.
22. 既然如此，耶穌也就成了更美好之約的保證人。 So Jesus has also become the guarantee of a better covenant.
23. 那些以前成為祭司的固然人數眾多，因為死亡阻止了他們繼續留任， Now many have become [Levitical] priests, since they are prevented by death from remaining in office.
24. 但由於耶穌永遠長存，就擁有永恆不變的祭司職份； But because He remains forever, He holds His priesthood permanently.
25. 故此，他也能徹底 拯救那些藉著他來到神面前的人；因為他一直活著，為他們代求。 Therefore He is always able to save those who come to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
26. 這樣一位聖潔、沒有邪惡、毫無玷汙、與罪人分開、高過諸天的大祭司，對我們實在是合宜的。 For this is the kind of high priest we need: holy, innocent, undefiled, separated from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
27. 他不需要像其他大祭司那樣天天獻祭：先為自己的罪孽，然後為子民；因為當他把自己獻上的時候，就一次性地把這事完成了。 He doesn't need to offer sacrifices every day, as high priests do-- first for their own sins, then for those of the people. He did this once for all when He offered Himself.
28. 律法委任的大祭司都有軟弱，但在律法以後，誓言保證的話語所委任的兒子，卻永遠完全。 For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak, but the promise of the oath, which came after the law, [appoints] a Son, who has been perfected forever.
Hebrews 8
1. 以上所說的要點是：我們有這樣的一位大祭司，已經坐在諸天之上至尊者的寶座右邊， Now the main point of what is being said is this: we have this kind of high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
2. 他是聖所和真會幕的服事者。這會幕是主所搭建的，不是人所搭建的。 a minister of the sanctuary and the true tabernacle, which the Lord set up, and not man.
3. 每一位大祭司受委任，都是為了獻上禮物和祭物；故此，這一位也必須有所獻上。 For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices; therefore it was necessary for this [priest] also to have something to offer.
4. 既然如此，如果他在地上，就不會做祭司，因為地上已經有照著律法獻祭物的祭司 。 Now if He were on earth, He wouldn't be a priest, since there are those offering the gifts prescribed by the law.
5. 那些祭司所事奉的，是天上事物的模型和影子，就如 摩西 將要完成會幕的時候，得了神的指示，說： 「你要注意，一切都要按照在山上指示你的樣式去造。」 These serve as a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, as Moses was warned when he was about to complete the tabernacle. For He said, Be careful that you make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.
6. 但如今，耶穌得了更尊貴的服事工作，就像他也是更美好之約的中保那樣；這約建立在各樣更美好的應許之上。 But Jesus has now obtained a superior ministry, and to that degree He is the mediator of a better covenant, which has been legally enacted on better promises.
7. 原來，如果那第一個約 是無可指責的，就沒有尋求第二個約的必要了， For if that first [covenant] had been faultless, no opportunity would have been sought for a second one.
8. 因為神 指責說： 「看哪，時候就要到了！ 主說，我要與 以色列 家 和 猶大 家訂立新約。 But finding fault with His people, He says: "Look, the days are coming," says the Lord, "when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah--
9. 這約 不像從前我拉著他們祖先的手， 在領他們出 埃及 地的日子裡 與他們所立的約。 因為他們沒有持守我的約， 我就不理他們——這是主說的。 not like the covenant that I made with their fathers on the day I took them by their hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt. Because they did not continue in My covenant, I disregarded them," says the Lord.
10. 主又說，在那些日子以後， 我要與 以色列 家訂立這樣的約： 我要把我的法則放在他們的意念中， 刻在他們的心上； 我將要做他們的神， 他們將要做我的子民。 "But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days," says the Lord: "I will put My laws into their minds, and I will write them on their hearts, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.
11. 他們絕不需要教導各自的同胞 、各自的兄弟，說： 『你要認識主』—— 因為他們所有的人， 從卑微的到尊貴的， 都將認識我； And each person will not teach his fellow citizen, and each his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' because they will all know Me, from the least to the greatest of them.
12. 又因為我要寬恕他們的不義， 絕不再想起他們的罪孽 。」 For I will be merciful to their wrongdoing, and I will never again remember their sins."
13. 當神 說到 「新約 」，就已經把第一個當做舊的；而那漸漸變舊、漸漸變老的，很快就要消逝了。 By saying, a new [ covenant], He has declared that the first is old. And what is old and aging is about to disappear.
Hebrews 9
1. 這樣，第一個約 也包括了事奉禮的規定和地上的聖所， Now the first [covenant] also had regulations for ministry and an earthly sanctuary.
2. 因為有預備好的會幕：第一間裡有燈臺、桌子和陳設餅，這叫做聖所； For a tabernacle was set up; and in the first room, which is called "the holy place," were the lampstand, the table, and the presentation loaves.
3. 會幕第二層幔子後面，叫做至聖所， Behind the second curtain, the tabernacle was called "the holy of holies."
4. 裡面有金香壇和四周包金的約櫃；櫃裡有盛著嗎哪的金罐、 亞倫 那根發過芽的杖和兩塊約版； It contained the gold altar of incense and the ark of the covenant, covered with gold on all sides, in which there was a gold jar containing the manna, Aaron's rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant.
5. 約櫃上方有榮耀的基路伯，遮蔽著施恩座 。關於這些，現在就不一一細說了。 The cherubim of glory were above it overshadowing the mercy seat. It is not possible to speak about these things in detail right now.
6. 既然這些東西都這樣預備好了，祭司們就常常進入第一間會幕行事奉禮。 These things having been set up this way, the priests enter the first room repeatedly, performing their ministry.
7. 至於第二間會幕，只有大祭司一年進去一次，沒有不帶著血的；這血是為自己和子民無意中犯的罪所獻上的。 But the high priest alone enters the second room, and that only once a year, and never without blood, which he offers for himself and for the sins of the people committed in ignorance.
8. 聖靈指明這一點：只要第一間會幕還存在，進入至聖所的道路就還沒有顯明出來。 The Holy Spirit was making it clear that the way into the holy of holies had not yet been disclosed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
9. 這會幕是現今時代的一個象徵，在這裡所獻上的禮物和祭物，並不能使事奉者的良心得以完全， This is a symbol for the present time, during which gifts and sacrifices are offered that cannot perfect the worshiper's conscience.
10. 因為這些只是關於飲食和各種洗淨禮，是屬肉體的規定，一直實施到更新的時候為止。 They are physical regulations and only deal with food, drink, and various washings imposed until the time of restoration.
11. 不過基督已經來到，做了那些已經發生的 美善之事的大祭司，經過了那更大、更完美的會幕。那會幕不是人手所造的；就是說，不屬於這被造的世界。 Now the Messiah has appeared, high priest of the good things that have come. In the greater and more perfect tabernacle not made with hands (that is, not of this creation),
12. 他也沒有藉著山羊和牛犢的血，而是藉著他自己的血，一次性地進入聖所，成就了永恆的救贖。 He entered the holy of holies once for all, not by the blood of goats and calves, but by His own blood, having obtained eternal redemption.
13. 實際上，如果山羊和公牛的血，以及母牛犢的灰，灑在那些汙穢的人身上，能使他們分別為聖、肉身潔淨， For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who are defiled, sanctify for the purification of the flesh,
14. 更何況基督的血呢！基督藉著永恆的聖靈，將自己毫無瑕疵地獻給神，他的血難道不能潔淨我們 的良心脫離致死的行為，使我們事奉永生的神嗎？ how much more will the blood of the Messiah, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself without blemish to God, cleanse our consciences from dead works to serve the living God?
15. 為此，基督做了新約的中保，藉著死贖清了人在第一個約之下的過犯，好使那些蒙召的人可以得到所應許的永恆繼業。 Therefore He is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called might receive the promise of the eternal inheritance, because a death has taken place for redemption from the transgressions [committed] under the first covenant.
16. 要知道，遺囑 在哪裡生效，立遺囑之人的死亡就必須得到證實。 Where a will exists, the death of the testator must be established.
17. 事實上，人死了，遺囑 才能確立，因為立遺囑之人活著的時候，遺囑絕對不能生效。 For a will is valid only when people die, since it is never in force while the testator is living.
18. 原來不用血，第一個約也不能成立， That is why even the first covenant was inaugurated with blood.
19. 就是說， 摩西 按照律法向全體民眾宣講了所有的誡命之後，拿了牛犢和山羊 的血，摻上水，用深紅色的羊毛和牛膝草，灑在那書卷上和全體民眾身上， For when every commandment had been proclaimed by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll itself and all the people,
20. 說： 「這是立約的血，是神吩咐給你們的。」 saying, This is the blood of the covenant that God has commanded for you.
21. 然後，他又同樣地把血灑在會幕和服事用的所有器皿上。 In the same way, he sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of worship with blood.
22. 按照律法，幾乎一切都是用血潔淨的；沒有流血，就沒有赦免。 According to the law almost everything is purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
23. 既然那些諸天之上事物的模型，必須用這些祭物 來潔淨，那天上事物的本體就必須用比這些更好的祭物來潔淨， Therefore it was necessary for the copies of the things in the heavens to be purified with these [sacrifices], but the heavenly things themselves [to be purified] with better sacrifices than these.
24. 因為基督不是進入了人手所造的聖所——那不過是真聖所的象徵——而是進入了上天本身，如今替我們顯現在神的面前。 For the Messiah did not enter a sanctuary made with hands (only a model of the true one) but into heaven itself, that He might now appear in the presence of God for us.
25. 他也不用再三地將自己獻上，像大祭司年年帶著牛羊的 血進入聖所那樣， He did not do this to offer Himself many times, as the high priest enters the sanctuary yearly with the blood of another.
26. 否則，從創世以來，他就必須再三地受難了。但如今，他在萬世的末期顯現了一次，好藉著獻上自己為祭，把罪除掉。 Otherwise, He would have had to suffer many times since the foundation of the world. But now He has appeared one time, at the end of the ages, for the removal of sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
27. 就如人人註定都有一死，而且死後有審判， And just as it is appointed for people to die once-- and after this, judgment--
28. 照樣，基督為了擔當眾人的罪孽，也被獻上一次；將來還要再一次顯現，不是為了罪，而是為了使那些熱切等待他的人得到救恩。 so also the Messiah, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for Him.
Hebrews 10
1. 既然律法帶有那將要來的美好事物的影子，它不是那些事物的本像，就絕不能藉著年年不斷地獻上同樣的祭物，使近前來的人得以完全。 Since the law has [only] a shadow of the good things to come, and not the actual form of those realities, it can never perfect the worshipers by the same sacrifices they continually offer year after year.
2. 否則，事奉的人因為一次性地被潔淨，不再覺得有罪孽，難道不早就停止獻祭了嗎？ Otherwise, wouldn't they have stopped being offered, since the worshipers, once purified, would no longer have any consciousness of sins?
3. 然而這些祭物使人年年都想起罪孽來， But in the sacrifices there is a reminder of sins every year.
4. 因為公牛和山羊的血，不可能把罪孽除去。 For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
5. 所以，基督進入世界的時候，他說： 「神哪，祭物和供物不是你所希望的； 你為我預備了一個身體。 Therefore, as He was coming into the world, He said: You did not want sacrifice and offering, but You prepared a body for Me.
6. 燔祭和贖罪祭不是你所喜悅的； You did not delight in whole burnt offerings and sin offerings.
7. 於是我說：『看哪，我來了！ 關於我的事， 經卷上已經記載了。 神哪，我來是要遵行你的旨意！』」 Then I said, "See, I have come-- it is written about Me in the volume of the scroll-- to do Your will, O God!"
8. 上文說： 祭物、供物、燔祭和贖罪祭不是你所希望的，也不是你所喜悅的， 儘管這些都是照著律法獻上的； After He says above, You did not desire or delight in sacrifices and offerings, whole burnt offerings and sin offerings, (which are offered according to the law),
9. 接著又說： 「看哪，我來了！是要遵行你的旨意！」 神廢除前者，是為了確立後者。 He then says, See, I have come to do Your will. He takes away the first to establish the second.
10. 我們憑著這旨意，藉著耶穌基督身體做供物，就已經一次性地被分別為聖了。 By this will, we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once and for all.
11. 所有的祭司天天都站著服事，再三地獻上同樣的祭物，但這些祭物絕不能把罪孽除掉， Now every priest stands day after day ministering and offering time after time the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
12. 而這一位為贖罪孽獻上了一個永遠的祭物，就在神的右邊坐下了， But this man, after offering one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down at the right hand of God.
13. 此後一直等候他的敵人被放在他的腳下做腳凳。 He is now waiting until His enemies are made His footstool.
14. 事實上，他藉著一個供物，使那些被分別為聖的人永遠得以完全。 For by one offering He has perfected forever those who are sanctified.
15. 聖靈也向我們做見證，因為他說過 ： The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. For after He had said:
16. 「主說：『在那些日子以後， 我要與他們訂立這樣的約： 我要把我的法則放在他們的心上， 刻在他們的意念中。』」 This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws on their hearts, and I will write them on their minds,
17. 然後又說： 「我絕不再想起他們的罪孽和他們的罪惡 。」 [He adds]: I will never again remember their sins and their lawless acts.
18. 所以在哪裡這些罪得了赦免，在哪裡就不再有贖罪的供物了。 Now where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer an offering for sin.
19. 因此，弟兄們，我們藉著耶穌的血，可以坦然無懼地進入至聖所。 Therefore, brothers, since we have boldness to enter the sanctuary through the blood of Jesus,
20. 他為我們開闢了一條又新又活的道路，從幔子經過；這幔子就是他的身體。 by the new and living way that He has inaugurated for us, through the curtain (that is, His flesh);
21. 既然我們有一位偉大的祭司管理神的家， and since we have a great high priest over the house of God,
22. 既然我們的心被血 灑過，脫離了罪惡感，身體也被清水洗淨了，就讓我們懷著真誠的心，以確信不移的信仰近前來； let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, our hearts sprinkled [clean] from an evil conscience and our bodies washed in pure water.
23. 讓我們毫不動搖地持守所告白的盼望，因為向我們應許的那一位是信實的； Let us hold on to the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.
24. 讓我們彼此看顧，好激勵愛心和美好的工作。 And let us be concerned about one another in order to promote love and good works,
25. 你們不要放棄自己的聚會，像某些人所習慣的那樣，而要彼此鼓勵；你們既然看見那日子 臨近，就更應該這樣。 not staying away from our meetings, as some habitually do, but encouraging each other, and all the more as you see the day drawing near.
26. 要知道，我們領受了真理的知識以後，如果還故意犯罪，就不再有贖罪的祭物被保留下來； For if we deliberately sin after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
27. 只保留了對審判的可怕等待，和那將要吞滅敵對者的嫉恨之火。 but a terrifying expectation of judgment, and the fury of a fire about to consume the adversaries.
28. 任何拒絕 摩西 律法的人，憑兩個或三個見證人的見證，就得不到憐憫而死， If anyone disregards Moses' law, he dies without mercy, based on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
29. 何況一個人踐踏了神的兒子，把那使自己成聖的立約之血看做是俗物，又侮辱了恩典的聖靈，你們想想，這個人難道不該受更厲害的懲罰嗎？ How much worse punishment, do you think one will deserve who has trampled on the Son of God, regarded as profane the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
30. 因為我們認識曾說過 「報應在我，我將回報 」 的那一位，他又說過 「主要審判自己的子民。」 For we know the One who has said, Vengeance belongs to Me, I will repay, and again, The Lord will judge His people.
31. 落在永生神的手中實在可怕。 It is a terrifying thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
32. 你們要回想原先的日子：當你們蒙了光照以後，忍受了許多痛苦掙扎； Remember the earlier days when, after you had been enlightened, you endured a hard struggle with sufferings.
33. 有時候當眾受責罵、受患難；有時候陪伴那些受到同樣遭遇的人。 Sometimes you were publicly exposed to taunts and afflictions, and at other times you were companions of those who were treated that way.
34. 的確，你們不但同情了那些被囚禁的人，而且當自己所擁有的被奪去時，你們也甘心接受了，因為知道你們在天上 有更好的、長存的產業。 For you sympathized with the prisoners and accepted with joy the confiscation of your possessions, knowing that you yourselves have a better and enduring possession.
35. 所以，不要丟棄你們的確信，這確信帶來極大的報償。 So don't throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
36. 其實，你們需要忍耐，好在你們行完神的旨意以後，可以領受所應許的。 For you need endurance, so that after you have done God's will, you may receive what was promised.
37. 要知道，還有一點點時候， 「要來的那一位就要來臨，他不會遲延。 For in yet a very little while, the Coming One will come and not delay.
38. 我的義人將因信而活； 如果他退縮， 我的心就不喜悅他。」 But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he draws back, My soul has no pleasure in him.
39. 然而，我們不是退縮以致滅亡 的人，而是有信仰以致保全靈魂 的人。 But we are not those who draw back and are destroyed, but those who have faith and obtain life.
Hebrews 11
1. 信，是對所盼望的事有把握，對看不見的事有確據。 Now faith is the reality of what is hoped for, the proof of what is not seen.
2. 古人因著這信曾受到了讚許。 For by it our ancestors were approved.
3. 因著信，我們明白宇宙 是藉著神的話語形成的，從而明白那看得見的事是從看不見的事造出來的。 By faith we understand that the universe was created by the word of God, so that what is seen has been made from things that are not visible.
4. 因著信， 亞伯 向神獻上的祭物比 該隱 所獻的更好，就藉著信受到了讚許成為義人，因為神讚許他的禮物。他雖然死了，但藉著信仍然說話。 By faith Abel offered to God a better sacrifice than Cain [did]. By this he was approved as a righteous man, because God approved his gifts, and even though he is dead, he still speaks through this.
5. 因著信， 以諾 被接去而沒有經歷死亡， 人也找不到他，因為神把他接去了。 原來他被接去以前，已經蒙神喜悅而受到讚許。 By faith, Enoch was taken away so that he did not experience death, and he was not to be found because God took him away. For prior to his transformation he was approved, having pleased God.
6. 沒有信，就不可能蒙神喜悅，因為來到神面前的人，必須相信神存在，並且相信他報償那些尋求他的人。 Now without faith it is impossible to please God, for the one who draws near to Him must believe that He exists and rewards those who seek Him.
7. 因著信， 挪亞 在那還看不見的事上得了神的指示，就動了敬畏的心，建造了一隻方舟，以至於他的家人獲救。藉著信，他定了世界的罪，自己也繼承了從信而來的義。 By faith Noah, after being warned about what was not yet seen, in reverence built an ark to deliver his family. By this he condemned the world and became an heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.
8. 因著信， 亞伯拉罕 蒙召的時候，就順從出發，往他將要得為繼業的地方去。他出發的時候，還不知道往哪裡去。 By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed and went out to a place he was going to receive as an inheritance; he went out, not knowing where he was going.
9. 因著信，他做為外人客居在應許之地，住在帳幕裡，與同一個應許的共同繼承人 以撒 、 雅各 一樣， By faith he stayed as a foreigner in the land of promise, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, co-heirs of the same promise.
10. 因為他等待著那座有根基的城；那城是神所設計、所建造的。 For he was looking forward to the city that has foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
11. 同樣因著信，不能生育的 撒拉，自己雖然過了年齡，還是領受了懷孕生子的能力，原來她認為向她應許的那一位 是信實的。 By faith even Sarah herself, when she was barren, received power to conceive offspring, even though she was past the age, since she considered that the One who had promised was faithful.
12. 所以從一個如同已經死了的人，就生出了許多人，像天空的星那樣眾多，像海邊的沙那樣無法數算。 And therefore from one man-- in fact, from one as good as dead-- came offspring as numerous as the stars of heaven and as innumerable as the grains of sand by the seashore.
13. 這些人都懷著信仰死去，沒有得到那些所應許的，卻遠遠地看見 並且歡迎它們，又承認自己在地上是異鄉人，是寄居的。 These all died in faith without having received the promises, but they saw them from a distance, greeted them, and confessed that they were foreigners and temporary residents on the earth.
14. 實際上，說這樣話的人，是表明他們在尋求一個家鄉。 Now those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a homeland.
15. 如果他們真是想念自己所離開的地方，他們還有機會回去； If they had been remembering that land they came from, they would have had opportunity to return.
16. 但如今，他們所嚮往的是一個更美好的，就是在天上的家鄉。因此，神被稱為「他們的神」並不以為恥；原來他已經為他們預備了一座城。 But they now aspire to a better land-- a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
17. 因著信， 亞伯拉罕 在受考驗的時候，獻上了 以撒 ；這位領受了各樣應許的人，獻上了自己的獨生兒子—— By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac; he who had received the promises was offering up his unique son,
18. 關於這兒子，神曾經說過： 「從 以撒 生的，將被稱為你的後裔。」 about whom it had been said, In Isaac your seed will be called.
19. 亞伯拉罕 認為，神真的能使人從死人中復活。故此，用比喻來說，他真的從死人中得回了 以撒 。 He considered God to be able even to raise someone from the dead, from which he also got him back as an illustration.
20. 同樣因著信， 以撒 指著將來的事祝福了 雅各 和 以掃 。 By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
21. 因著信， 雅各 臨死的時候，祝福了 約瑟 的每個兒子，又 倚著自己的杖頭敬拜神 。 By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and, he worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
22. 因著信， 約瑟 臨終的時候，提到 以色列 子民出 埃及 的事，也為自己的骸骨留下了遺言。 By faith Joseph, as he was nearing the end of his life, mentioned the exodus of the sons of Israel and gave instructions concerning his bones.
23. 因著信， 摩西 出生以後，被父母藏了三個月，原來他們看見孩子俊美；他們不怕王的命令。 By faith Moses, after he was born, was hidden by his parents for three months, because they saw that the child was beautiful, and they didn't fear the king's edict.
24. 因著信， 摩西 長大以後，拒絕被稱為法老女兒的兒子。 By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter
25. 他寧願選擇與神的子民同受虐待，也不願享受暫時的罪中之樂。 and chose to suffer with the people of God rather than to enjoy the short-lived pleasure of sin.
26. 他把為基督受的責罵看做是比 埃及 的財寶更大的財富，因為他注目那將來的報償。 For he considered reproach for the sake of the Messiah to be greater wealth than the treasures of Egypt, since his attention was on the reward.
27. 因著信，他不怕王的憤怒，離開了 埃及，因為他恆心忍耐，如同看見了不可見的那一位。 By faith he left Egypt behind, not being afraid of the king's anger, for he persevered, as one who sees Him who is invisible.
28. 因著信，他立 了逾越節和灑血的禮，免得那毀滅長子 的碰 以色列 人 。 By faith he instituted the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn might not touch them.
29. 因著信，他們走過了 紅海，像走過乾地那樣； 埃及 人試著這樣做，就被吞滅了。 By faith they crossed the Red Sea as though they were on dry land. When the Egyptians attempted to do this, they were drowned.
30. 因著信，他們圍繞 耶利哥 城七天，城牆就倒塌了。 By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after being encircled for seven days.
31. 因著信，妓女 瑞荷 在平安中接納了偵察的人，沒有和那些不肯信從的人一同滅亡。 By faith Rahab the prostitute received the spies in peace and didn't perish with those who disobeyed.
32. 我還要再說什麼呢？如果我一一述說 基甸 、 巴拉克 、 參孫 、 耶弗達 、 大衛 、 撒母耳 和先知們的事，時間就不夠了。 And what more can I say? Time is too short for me to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets,
33. 他們藉著信，征服了列國，行了公義，獲得了那些應許；他們堵住了獅子的口， who by faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, obtained promises, shut the mouths of lions,
34. 滅了烈火的威力，逃脫了刀劍的鋒刃，從軟弱中得以剛強，在戰爭中得以強大，擊敗了外國的軍隊。 quenched the raging of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, gained strength after being weak, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.
35. 有些婦女得回了那些從死人中復活的親人；有些人受酷刑至死也不肯接受釋放，為要得到更美好的復活； Women received their dead raised to life again. Some men were tortured, not accepting release, so that they might gain a better resurrection,
36. 另有些人經受了戲弄、鞭打的試煉；還有些人受了捆鎖、監禁的試煉； and others experienced mockings and scourgings, as well as bonds and imprisonment.
37. 他們被石頭砸死，被鋸成兩截， 被刀劍殺死，披著綿羊、山羊的皮四處漂泊，遭受窮困、患難和虐待。 They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they died by the sword, they wandered about in sheepskins, in goatskins, destitute, afflicted, and mistreated.
38. 他們是這世界不配有的。他們在曠野、山嶺、岩穴、地洞中漂流無定。 The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts, mountains, caves, and holes in the ground.
39. 這些人雖然都藉著信受到了讚許，還是沒有領受到所應許的， All these were approved through their faith, but they did not receive what was promised,
40. 因為神為我們預備了更美好的事，使他們沒有我們，就不能得以完全。 since God had provided something better for us, so that they would not be made perfect without us.
Hebrews 12
1. 因此，我們既然有這麼一大群見證人，如同雲彩圍繞著我們，就讓我們脫去各樣的重擔和容易纏累我們的罪，藉著忍耐去跑那擺在我們前面的賽程， Therefore since we also have such a large cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let us lay aside every weight and the sin that so easily ensnares us, and run with endurance the race that lies before us,
2. 仰望信仰的創始者和成終者耶穌。他為了 那擺在他前面的喜樂，就輕看羞辱，忍受了十字架，如今坐在神寶座的右邊。 keeping our eyes on Jesus, the source and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that lay before Him endured a cross and despised the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of God's throne.
3. 其實，你們應當仔細地思想耶穌如何忍受了罪人的頂撞，這樣你們心裡 就不會因喪氣而疲倦。 For consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners against Himself, so that you won't grow weary and lose heart.
4. 你們與罪爭戰，還沒有抵抗到流血的地步。 In struggling against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
5. 難道你們已經忘記那安慰的話嗎？就是他對你們如同對兒女那樣講論的話： 「我兒，你不可輕看主的管教； 被他責備的時候，也不可喪氣。 And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: My son, do not take the Lord's discipline lightly, or faint when you are reproved by Him;
6. 因為主所愛的人，主都管教； 他所接納的每一個兒子，他都鞭打。」 for the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and punishes every son whom He receives.
7. 對管教的事，你們要忍受；神對待你們，就像對待兒女那樣。到底哪一個兒子不受父親的管教呢？ Endure it as discipline: God is dealing with you as sons. For what son is there whom a father does not discipline?
8. 大家都有份受管教；你們如果沒有受管教，那麼，你們就是私生子，不是兒子了。 But if you are without discipline-- which all receive-- then you are illegitimate children and not sons.
9. 再者，我們有肉身的父親來管教我們，我們尚且敬重他們，何況對這位萬靈之父，我們難道不更要服從他而活著嗎？ Furthermore, we had natural fathers discipline us, and we respected them. Shouldn't we submit even more to the Father of spirits and live?
10. 肉身的父親在短暫的日子裡，固然照著自己的意思來管教我們；但萬靈之父是為了我們的益處管教我們，好使我們在他的聖潔上有份。 For they disciplined us for a short time based on what seemed good to them, but He does it for our benefit, so that we can share His holiness.
11. 不過所有的管教，當時雖然不覺得是愉快的事，反覺得是憂傷的事，而後來卻為那些由此受到操練的人，結出平安和義行的果子。 No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields the fruit of peace and righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
12. 因此，你們要把發軟的手、發痠的腿伸直吧！ Therefore strengthen your tired hands and weakened knees,
13. 也要為你們的腳把道路修直，好使瘸腿的不至扭腳，反得痊癒。 and make straight paths for your feet, so that what is lame may not be dislocated, but healed instead.
14. 你們要追求與眾人和睦，要追求聖潔。任何不聖潔的人，都不能見到主。 Pursue peace with everyone, and holiness-- without it no one will see the Lord.
15. 你們要謹慎，免得有人虧缺了神的恩典；免得有苦毒的根長起來攪擾你們，使許多人因此被汙穢了； See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God and that no root of bitterness springs up, causing trouble and by it, defiling many.
16. 又免得有淫亂的，或像 以掃 那樣不敬神的。 以掃 為了 一點食物，就把自己長子的名份賣了； And see that there isn't any immoral or irreverent person like Esau, who sold his birthright in exchange for one meal.
17. 你們知道，後來他想繼承祝福，卻被棄絕了，雖然他流著淚水尋求，還是找不到悔改的機會。 For you know that later, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected because he didn't find any opportunity for repentance, though he sought it with tears.
18. 你們並不是來到了摸得著的山 、燃燒著的火、陰雲、幽暗、風暴、 For you have not come to what could be touched, to a blazing fire, to darkness, gloom, and storm,
19. 號角的響聲和說話的聲音面前——那些聽見這聲音的人，都懇求不要再向他們說話了， to the blast of a trumpet, and the sound of words. (Those who heard it begged that not another word be spoken to them,
20. 因為他們擔當不了那吩咐他們的話： 「即使是野獸觸摸這山，也要用石頭砸死 。」 for they could not bear what was commanded: And if even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned!
21. 那景象實在可怕，連 摩西 也說： 「我非常害怕戰兢。」 And the appearance was so terrifying that Moses said, I am terrified and trembling.)
22. 相反，你們卻是來到了 錫安 山、永生神的城、天上的 耶路撒冷 面前；來到了千萬天使的盛會面前； Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God (the heavenly Jerusalem), to myriads of angels in festive gathering,
23. 來到了長子們 的教會面前——他們的名字 已經登記在天上；來到了神面前——他是萬人的審判者；來到了義人的靈魂面前——他們得以完全； to the assembly of the firstborn whose names have been written in heaven, to God who is the judge of all, to the spirits of righteous people made perfect,
24. 來到了耶穌面前——他是新約的中保；來到了所灑的血面前——這血比 亞伯 的血所述說的更美好。 to Jesus (mediator of a new covenant), and to the sprinkled blood, which says better things than the [blood] of Abel.
25. 你們要當心，不要拒絕向你們 說話的那一位。要知道，那些拒絕了在地上警告他們的，尚且無法逃脫懲罰，更何況我們背棄從天上警告我們的那一位呢！ See that you do not reject the One who speaks; for if they did not escape when they rejected Him who warned them on earth, even less will we if we turn away from Him who warns us from heaven.
26. 那時候，他的聲音震動了大地，但如今他應許說： 「我不僅要再一次震動地，而且還要震動天。」 His voice shook the earth at that time, but now He has promised, Yet once more I will shake not only the earth but also heaven.
27. 「再一次」這句話表明了那些能夠被震動的，就如被造之物，都要被挪去，好使那些不能被震動的可以存留。 Now this expression, "Yet once more," indicates the removal of what can be shaken-- that is, created things-- so that what is not shaken might remain.
28. 因此，我們既然在領受一個不能被震動的國度，就讓我們懷有感恩的心，藉此以虔誠和敬畏，照著神所喜悅的 來事奉他。 Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us hold on to grace. By it, we may serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe;
29. 要知道，我們的神實在是吞噬的烈火。 for our God is a consuming fire.
Hebrews 13
1. 你們當常存弟兄之愛。 Let brotherly love continue.
2. 不要忘記款待客旅，因為曾經有些人這樣做，在無意中就招待了天使。 Don't neglect to show hospitality, for by doing this some have welcomed angels as guests without knowing it.
3. 你們要顧念那些被囚禁的人，好像與他們一同被囚禁；要記念那些受虐待的人，好像你們自己也是在肉體中受虐待。 Remember the prisoners, as though you were in prison with them, and the mistreated, as though you yourselves were suffering bodily.
4. 婚姻當受所有人尊重，床也不可玷汙，因為神將要審判淫亂和通姦的人。 Marriage must be respected by all, and the marriage bed kept undefiled, because God will judge immoral people and adulterers.
5. 你們行事為人不要愛錢財，要以現有的為滿足，因為神自己說過： 「我絕不撇下你，也絕不離棄你。」 Your life should be free from the love of money. Be satisfied with what you have, for He Himself has said, I will never leave you or forsake you.
6. 所以，我們可以滿懷勇氣地說： 「主是我的幫助， 我就不懼怕， 人能把我怎麼樣呢？」 Therefore, we may boldly say: The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
7. 你們當記住那些帶領你們、把神的話語 傳給你們的人；要仔細觀察他們行事為人的結果，效法他們的信仰。 Remember your leaders who have spoken God's word to you. As you carefully observe the outcome of their lives, imitate their faith.
8. 耶穌基督昨天、今天、直到永遠，都是一樣的。 Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
9. 你們不要被各種怪異的教導引入歧途，因為人的心靠恩典，不靠食物規定得以確立才是好的；那靠食物規定 而行事的人，從來沒有得到什麼益處。 Don't be led astray by various kinds of strange teachings; for it is good for the heart to be established by grace and not by foods, since those involved in them have not benefited.
10. 我們有一個祭壇，這壇上的祭物，是那些在會幕中事奉的人沒有權利吃的。 We have an altar from which those who serve the tabernacle do not have a right to eat.
11. 原來動物的血由大祭司帶進聖所，是為了贖罪，而動物的身體卻在營地外面被燒掉； For the bodies of those animals whose blood is brought into the holy of holies by the high priest as a sin offering are burned outside the camp.
12. 所以耶穌為了藉著自己的血使子民分別為聖，也在城門外受難。 Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate, so that He might sanctify the people by His own blood.
13. 因此，讓我們到營地外面他那裡去，擔當他所受的責罵。 Let us then go to Him outside the camp, bearing His disgrace.
14. 因為在這裡，我們沒有長存的城；相反，我們是在尋求那將要來臨的城。 For here we do not have an enduring city; instead, we seek the one to come.
15. 這樣，讓我們藉著耶穌，常常以頌讚為祭物獻給神，這祭物就是承認他名的嘴唇所結的 果子。 Therefore, through Him let us continually offer up to God a sacrifice of praise, that is, the fruit of our lips that confess His name.
16. 你們不可忘記行善和分享，因為這樣的祭物是蒙神喜悅的。 Don't neglect to do good and to share, for God is pleased with such sacrifices.
17. 你們要信任那些帶領你們的人，要服從他們，因為他們做為要交帳的人，要為你們的靈魂時刻警醒。你們要讓他們能懷著喜樂的心做這事，而不至嘆息，因為讓他們嘆息，對你們並沒有益處。 Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they keep watch over your souls as those who will give an account, so that they can do this with joy and not with grief, for that would be unprofitable for you.
18. 請為我們禱告；因為我們深信自己有無愧的良心，願意在一切事上行事正直。 Pray for us; for we are convinced that we have a clear conscience, wanting to conduct ourselves honorably in everything.
19. 我特別請求你們禱告，好讓我能快一點回到你們那裡。 And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you very soon.
20. 願賜平安的神，就是藉著永恆之約的血，把群羊的大牧人我們的主耶穌從死人中領上來的那一位， Now may the God of peace, who brought up from the dead our Lord Jesus-- the great Shepherd of the sheep-- with the blood of the everlasting covenant,
21. 在一切美善之事上使你們完備，好遵行他的旨意。願神藉著耶穌基督，在我們裡面行他看為喜悅的事。願榮耀歸於他，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 equip you with all that is good to do His will, working in us what is pleasing in His sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
22. 弟兄們，我懇求你們容忍我這勸勉的話，因為我只是簡略地寫信給你們。 Brothers, I urge you to receive this word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
23. 你們要知道，我們的弟兄 提摩太 已經被釋放了。如果他能快一點來，我就與他一起去看你們。 Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he comes soon enough, he will be with me when I see you.
24. 請問候所有帶領你們的人和所有的聖徒。從 意大利 來的那些人也問候你們。 Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those who are from Italy greet you.
25. 願恩典與你們大家同在！ Grace be with all of you.
James
James 1
1. 神和主耶穌基督的奴僕 雅各， 問候散居在各地的十二個支派。 James, a slave of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ: To the 12 tribes in the Dispersion. Greetings.
2. 我的弟兄們，你們遇到各種試煉的時候，應當看做是極大的喜樂， Consider it a great joy, my brothers, whenever you experience various trials,
3. 因為你們知道，你們的信仰經過考驗就生出忍耐； knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
4. 但要讓忍耐發揮完全的功效，好使你們成熟、完備，在任何事上都沒有缺欠。 But endurance must do its complete work, so that you may be mature and complete, lacking nothing.
5. 如果你們中間有人缺乏智慧，他就應當向那慷慨賜予萬人又不責罵人的神祈求；神就會賜予他。 Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives to all generously and without criticizing, and it will be given to him.
6. 不過他要憑著信仰祈求，不要有任何疑惑，因為疑惑的人就像海中的波浪，被風吹動翻騰。 But let him ask in faith without doubting. For the doubter is like the surging sea, driven and tossed by the wind.
7. 這樣的人不要想從主那裡得到什麼， That person should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
8. 他是心懷二意的人，在他所有的道路上都搖擺不定。 An indecisive man is unstable in all his ways.
9. 卑微 的弟兄應當以自己被高舉而誇耀； The brother of humble circumstances should boast in his exaltation;
10. 富有的應當以自己被降卑而誇耀，因為他將要像草上的花那樣消逝。 but the one who is rich [should boast] in his humiliation, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
11. 太陽帶著熱氣升起，草地枯萎，草上的花也凋謝，它表面的美麗也就消逝了；照樣，富有的人在他的追求中，也將衰殘。 For the sun rises with its scorching heat and dries up the grass; its flower falls off, and its beautiful appearance is destroyed. In the same way, the rich man will wither away while pursuing his activities.
12. 忍受試煉的人是蒙福的；因為他經過考驗以後，就要得到生命的冠冕，就是主 應許給那些愛他之人的。 Blessed is a man who endures trials, because when he passes the test he will receive the crown of life that He has promised to those who love Him.
13. 人受誘惑的時候，不可說：「我被神誘惑」，因為神是不能被邪惡誘惑的，神也不誘惑任何人。 No one undergoing a trial should say, "I am being tempted by God." For God is not tempted by evil, and He Himself doesn't tempt anyone.
14. 而每個人受誘惑，都是被自己的欲望所牽扯、所引誘的； But each person is tempted when he is drawn away and enticed by his own evil desires.
15. 一旦欲望懷了胎，就生下罪來；罪長成了，就生出死亡。 Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin, and when sin is fully grown, it gives birth to death.
16. 我親愛的弟兄們，你們不要被迷惑了！ Don't be deceived, my dearly loved brothers.
17. 一切美好的賞賜和各樣完美的恩賜，都是從上面、從眾光之父降下來的；在他沒有改變，也沒有轉動的影子。 Every generous act and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights; with Him there is no variation or shadow cast by turning.
18. 他照著自己的旨意，藉著真理的話語生了我們，要使我們在他所造的萬物中成為一種初熟的果子。 By His own choice, He gave us a new birth by the message of truth so that we would be the firstfruits of His creatures.
19. 我親愛的弟兄們，你們應當知道： 每個人都該快快地聽，不急於發言、不急於動怒， My dearly loved brothers, understand this: everyone must be quick to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
20. 因為人的憤怒不能成就神的義。 for man's anger does not accomplish God's righteousness.
21. 因此，你們要脫去一切的汙穢和滿盈的惡毒，要以溫柔的心接受那栽種在你們裡面的話語，就是能拯救你們靈魂 的話語。 Therefore, ridding yourselves of all moral filth and evil excess, humbly receive the implanted word, which is able to save you.
22. 你們要成為這話語的實行者，不要只成為聽者而欺騙自己。 But be doers of the word and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
23. 因為，如果有人是這話語的聽者，而不是實行者，這個人就像人對著鏡子觀看自己生來的面貌， Because if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his own face in a mirror;
24. 看了就走開，立刻忘了自己是什麼樣子； for he looks at himself, goes away, and right away forgets what kind of man he was.
25. 但是詳細察看那使人得自由的完美律法，並且繼續持守的人，因他不是健忘的聽者，而是行為的實行者，這個人就將要在他所行的事上蒙祝福。 But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom and perseveres in it, and is not a forgetful hearer but a doer who acts-- this person will be blessed in what he does.
26. 如果 有人自以為是虔誠的，卻不克制自己的舌頭，反而欺騙自己的心，這個人的虔誠 就是虛妄的。 If anyone thinks he is religious, without controlling his tongue but deceiving his heart, his religion is useless.
27. 在父神看來，純潔而沒有玷汙的虔誠 是這樣的：照顧患難中的孤兒寡婦，並且保守自己不受世界的玷汙。 Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
James 2
1. 我的弟兄們，你們應當持守對我們榮耀的主耶穌基督的信仰，不要懷著偏待人的心。 My brothers, hold your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ without showing favoritism.
2. 如果有一個戴著金戒指、穿著華麗衣服的人進了你們的會堂，又有一個穿著骯髒衣服的窮人也進來了， For suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring, dressed in fine clothes, and a poor man dressed in dirty clothes also comes in.
3. 你們卻看重那穿華麗衣服的人，對他說「請你坐在這好位子上」，而對那窮人說「你站在那裡」，或說「坐在我的腳凳下邊」； If you look with favor on the man wearing the fine clothes so that you say, "Sit here in a good place," and yet you say to the poor man, "Stand over there," or, "Sit here on the floor by my footstool,"
4. 難道你們中間不就有了歧視，而你們也成了心懷惡念的審判官嗎？ haven't you discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
5. 我親愛的弟兄們，請聽！神難道不是揀選了世上的那些貧窮人，使他們在信仰上富有，並且做他 國度的繼承人嗎？這國度是他應許給愛他之人的。 Listen, my dear brothers: Didn't God choose the poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom that He has promised to those who love Him?
6. 但你們卻侮辱了這貧窮人！那欺壓你們、把你們拉上法庭的，難道不是那些富有的人嗎？ Yet you dishonored that poor man. Don't the rich oppress you and drag you into the courts?
7. 那褻瀆你們所敬奉的美好之名的，難道不是他們嗎？ Don't they blaspheme the noble name that you bear?
8. 不過，你們如果照著經上那條至尊的 律法 「要愛鄰如己」 完全實行，你們就做得很好了。 If you really carry out the royal law prescribed in Scripture, You shall love your neighbor as yourself, you are doing well.
9. 但如果你們偏待人，就是犯罪，並被律法指證是違犯律法的人。 But if you show favoritism, you commit sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
10. 因為那遵守整個律法的人，只在一條上跌倒，就成了干犯所有律法的了。 For whoever keeps the entire law, yet fails in one point, is guilty of [breaking it] all.
11. 原來那位說過 「不可通姦」 的，也說過 「不可殺人」 。你即使不通姦，卻殺人，你還是成了違犯律法的人。 For He who said, Do not commit adultery, also said, Do not murder. So if you do not commit adultery, but you do murder, you are a lawbreaker.
12. 既然你們將要照著那使人得自由的律法受審判，就應當照此說話、行事。 Speak and act as those who will be judged by the law of freedom.
13. 要知道，那不施憐憫的人，要受毫無憐憫的審判；憐憫勝過審判。 For judgment is without mercy to the one who hasn't shown mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
14. 我的弟兄們，如果有人說自己有信仰，但卻沒有行為，這有什麼好處呢？難道這種信仰能救他嗎？ What good is it, my brothers, if someone says he has faith, but does not have works? Can his faith save him?
15. 如果有弟兄或姐妹衣不蔽體，又缺乏日用的食物， If a brother or sister is without clothes and lacks daily food,
16. 而你們當中有人對他們說：「平平安安地去吧！願你們穿得暖、吃得飽！」，卻不給他們身體所需要的，這有什麼好處呢？ and one of you says to them, "Go in peace, keep warm, and eat well," but you don't give them what the body needs, what good is it?
17. 信仰也是這樣：如果沒有行為，這信仰就是死的。 In the same way faith, if it doesn't have works, is dead by itself.
18. 不過有人會說：「你有信仰；我有行為。」請給我看看你沒有行為的信仰，我也本於自己的行為給你看看我的信仰。 But someone will say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me your faith without works, and I will show you faith from my works.
19. 你相信神只有一位，你就做得很好！連鬼魔也相信，並且恐懼戰兢。 You believe that God is one; you do well. The demons also believe-- and they shudder.
20. 唉，你這虛空的人哪！你想知道沒有行為的信仰是無用的 嗎？ Foolish man! Are you willing to learn that faith without works is useless?
21. 我們的先祖 亞伯拉罕 把他的兒子 以撒 獻在祭壇上，難道不是本於行為被稱為義嗎？ Wasn't Abraham our father justified by works when he offered Isaac his son on the altar?
22. 你看，信仰和他的行為相輔相成，而且信仰是本於行為得以完全的。 You see that faith was active together with his works, and by works, faith was perfected.
23. 這就應驗了經上所說的： 「 亞伯拉罕 信神，這就被算為他的義。」 他又被稱為「神的朋友」。 So the Scripture was fulfilled that says, Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him for righteousness, and he was called God's friend.
24. 可見人被稱為義是本於行為，不僅是本於信仰。 You see that a man is justified by works and not by faith alone.
25. 同樣，妓女 瑞荷 接待了那些使者，又從另一條路把他們送走，難道不也是本於行為被稱為義嗎？ And in the same way, wasn't Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out by a different route?
26. 要知道，就像身體沒有靈魂是死的，照樣，信仰沒有行為也是死的。 For just as the body without the spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.
James 3
1. 我的弟兄們，你們不應該有很多人做教師，因為你們知道，我們做教師的 將受更嚴厲的審判。 Not many should become teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive a stricter judgment;
2. 實際上，我們每一個人在很多事上都會跌倒。如果有人在言語上不跌倒，這個人就是一個成熟的人，也能夠克制全身。 for we all stumble in many ways. If anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a mature man who is also able to control his whole body.
3. 我們如果 把嚼子放在馬嘴裡，使牠們服從，就可以駕馭牠們的全身。 Now when we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we also guide the whole animal.
4. 再看船隻，雖然它那麼大，又被狂風吹逐，但是無論舵手的意圖想去哪裡，它都能被小小的舵來駕馭。 And consider ships: though very large and driven by fierce winds, they are guided by a very small rudder wherever the will of the pilot directs.
5. 照樣，舌頭雖然是身體上一個小小的部分，卻能大大地自誇。看哪，那麼小的火，能點燃那麼大的森林！ So too, though the tongue is a small part [of the body], it boasts great things. Consider how large a forest a small fire ignites.
6. 舌頭是火，它在我們身體的各部分中，是個不公義的世界；它玷汙全身，焚燒人生的路程，而且自己卻被地獄焚燒。 And the tongue is a fire. The tongue, a world of unrighteousness, is placed among the parts of our [bodies]; it pollutes the whole body, sets the course of life on fire, and is set on fire by hell.
7. 原來，各類野獸、飛禽、爬行動物和水族都能被制伏，也已經被人類制伏了， For every creature-- animal or bird, reptile or fish-- is tamed and has been tamed by man,
8. 可是沒有人能制伏舌頭；它是不止息的邪惡，充滿著致死的毒。 but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
9. 我們用這舌頭頌讚我們的 主 ——我們的 父，又用這舌頭來詛咒照著神的形像被造的人。 With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in God's likeness.
10. 頌讚和詛咒從同一張嘴裡出來！我的弟兄們，這些事不應該如此！ Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things should not be this way.
11. 難道從同一個洞裡湧出來的泉源，能又甜又苦嗎？ Does a spring pour out sweet and bitter water from the same opening?
12. 我的弟兄們，難道無花果樹能結出橄欖，葡萄樹能結出無花果嗎？鹹水也不能產生甜水 。 Can a fig tree produce olives, my brothers, or a grapevine [produce] figs? Neither can a saltwater spring yield fresh water.
13. 到底你們中間誰是有智慧、有見識的呢？他就應當藉著良好的品行，以智慧的溫柔，使自己的行為顯明出來； Who is wise and understanding among you? He should show his works by good conduct with wisdom's gentleness.
14. 但如果你們心裡懷著苦毒的嫉妒和爭競，就不要自誇、說謊而抵擋真理。 But if you have bitter envy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't brag and lie in defiance of the truth.
15. 這種智慧不是從上面下來的，而是屬地的，屬血氣的，屬鬼魔的。 Such wisdom does not come down from above, but is earthly, sensual, demonic.
16. 要知道，哪裡有嫉妒和爭競，哪裡就有混亂和各樣的惡事。 For where envy and selfish ambition exist, there is disorder and every kind of evil.
17. 至於從上面來的智慧，首先是純潔的，然後是和平的、謙和的、溫順的，滿有憐憫和美好的果子的，是不偏私、不虛假的； But the wisdom from above is first pure, then peace-loving, gentle, compliant, full of mercy and good fruits, without favoritism and hypocrisy.
18. 並且義行的果子，是由那些締造和平的人，在和平中被種下的。 And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
James 4
1. 你們中間的衝突是從哪裡來的？爭執是從哪裡來的？難道不是從你們身體各部分中交戰的私欲而來的嗎？ What is the source of the wars and the fights among you? Don't they come from the cravings that are at war within you?
2. 你們渴望而不能擁有，就殺人；你們嫉妒而不能獲得，就爭鬥、作戰。你們不能擁有，是因為你們不求； You desire and do not have. You murder and covet and cannot obtain. You fight and war. You do not have because you do not ask.
3. 你們求也不能得到，是因為你們求的動機 不對，為了要花費在自己的私欲上。 You ask and don't receive because you ask wrongly, so that you may spend it on your desires for pleasure.
4. 你們這些淫亂的人 哪！難道你們不知道，與世界為友，就是與神為敵嗎？所以，如果有人想要和世界做朋友，他就成了神的仇敵！ Adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? So whoever wants to be the world's friend becomes God's enemy.
5. 或者，你們以為經上所說的「神 使聖靈住在我們裡面，他愛我們 到嫉妒的地步」是空話嗎？ Or do you think it's without reason the Scripture says that the Spirit He has caused to live in us yearns jealously?
6. 不過他賜下更大的恩典，所以經上說： 「神抵擋驕傲的人， 賜恩典給謙卑的人。」 But He gives greater grace. Therefore He says: God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.
7. 因此，你們要服從神，要抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就會逃避你們。 Therefore, submit to God. But resist the Devil, and he will flee from you.
8. 你們要親近神，神就會親近你們。你們這些罪人哪，當使你們的手潔淨！心懷二意的人哪，當使你們的心純潔！ Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, sinners, and purify your hearts, double-minded people!
9. 你們應當難過、悲傷、痛哭；把你們的歡笑變為悲傷，快樂變為憂悶。 Be miserable and mourn and weep. Your laughter must change to mourning and your joy to sorrow.
10. 你們當在主面前降卑，他就會高舉你們。 Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
11. 弟兄們，你們不可彼此誹謗。誹謗弟兄或評斷自己弟兄的，就是誹謗律法、評斷律法。如果你評斷律法，你就不是實行律法的人，而是個審判者了。 Don't criticize one another, brothers. He who criticizes a brother or judges his brother criticizes the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
12. 那設立律法的和審判者，只有一位；他就是既能拯救又能毀滅的那一位。而你到底是誰，竟然評斷鄰人呢？ There is one lawgiver and judge who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
13. 現在來吧！你們這些人哪，你們說「今天或明天，我們要到某某城去，要在那裡住上一年，做生意賺錢。」 Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will travel to such and such a city and spend a year there and do business and make a profit."
14. 你們不知道明天是什麼、生命是什麼！你們不過是一陣雲霧，出現片刻，隨後就消失了。 You don't even know what tomorrow will bring-- what your life will be! For you are a bit of smoke that appears for a little while, then vanishes.
15. 你們倒應該說：「主如果願意，我們就將活著，做這事或做那事。」 Instead, you should say, "If the Lord wills, we will live and do this or that."
16. 但如今，你們在自己的驕傲中誇耀。凡是這樣的誇耀，都是邪惡的。 But as it is, you boast in your arrogance. All such boasting is evil.
17. 所以，那知道該行美善的事而不去行的，對他來說，這就是罪了。 So, for the person who knows to do good and doesn't do it, it is a sin.
James 5
1. 現在來吧，你們這些富有的人哪！應當為那些將要臨到你們的慘禍而痛哭、哀號！ Come now, you rich people! Weep and wail over the miseries that are coming on you.
2. 你們的財富腐爛了；你們的衣服被蟲蛀了； Your wealth is ruined: your clothes are moth-eaten;
3. 你們的金銀也生鏽了，這鏽將成為控告你們的見證，又要像火那樣吃你們的肉。在這末後的日子裡，你們竟然積蓄財富！ your silver and gold are corroded, and their corrosion will be a witness against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You stored up treasure in the last days!
4. 看哪！工人收割你們的田地，你們所剋扣他們的工錢正在呼叫，收割者的冤聲也已經達到萬軍之主的耳中了。 Look! The pay that you withheld from the workers who reaped your fields cries out, and the outcry of the harvesters has reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
5. 你們在地上奢侈生活、享樂度日，為宰殺的日子養肥了自己的心！ You have lived luxuriously on the land and have indulged yourselves. You have fattened your hearts for the day of slaughter.
6. 你們把義人定了罪、把他殺害了，他沒有抗拒你們。 You have condemned-- you have murdered-- the righteous man; he does not resist you.
7. 所以弟兄們，你們當恆久忍耐，直到主的來臨。看哪，農夫等待著田地裡寶貴的果實，為此恆久忍耐，直到果實得著秋雨春雨。 Therefore, brothers, be patient until the Lord's coming. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth and is patient with it until it receives the early and the late rains.
8. 你們也當恆久忍耐，堅固你們的心，因為主的來臨已經近了。 You also must be patient. Strengthen your hearts, because the Lord's coming is near.
9. 弟兄們，不要彼此埋怨，免得你們受審判。看哪，審判者已經站在門口了！ Brothers, do not complain about one another, so that you will not be judged. Look, the judge stands at the door!
10. 弟兄們，你們要把那些奉主名講話的先知當做受苦和忍耐的榜樣。 Brothers, take the prophets who spoke in the Lord's name as an example of suffering and patience.
11. 看哪，那些忍耐過的人，我們稱他們有福！你們聽說過 約伯 的忍耐，也看見了主所賜給他 的結局，知道主是充滿憐憫和仁慈的。 See, we count as blessed those who have endured. You have heard of Job's endurance and have seen the outcome from the Lord: the Lord is very compassionate and merciful.
12. 我的弟兄們，最要緊的是：不可起誓。不可指著天起誓，不可指著地起誓，也不可用任何別的誓言起誓。你們說話，是，就說是；不是，就說不是；免得落在審判之下 。 Now above all, my brothers, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or with any other oath. Your "yes" must be "yes," and your "no" must be "no," so that you won't fall under judgment.
13. 你們中間誰受苦，就應該禱告；誰歡喜，就應該歌頌。 Is anyone among you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
14. 你們中間誰患病，就應該請教會的長老們來，讓他們奉主的名用油來膏抹他、為他禱告。 Is anyone among you sick? He should call for the elders of the church, and they should pray over him after anointing him with olive oil in the name of the Lord.
15. 出於信的祈求，將會救那病人 ；主將使他起來；即使他犯了罪，也將被赦免。 The prayer of faith will save the sick person, and the Lord will raise him up; and if he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
16. 所以你們當彼此認罪，彼此代求，好使你們得痊癒。義人所做的 祈禱是大有力量的。 Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The intense prayer of the righteous is very powerful.
17. 以利亞 和我們同樣是人，但他用禱告來祈求不要降雨，果然地上三年零六個月沒有降雨。 Elijah was a man with a nature like ours; yet he prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and for three years and six months it did not rain on the land.
18. 後來他又禱告，天就降下雨水，地也產出果實來。 Then he prayed again, and the sky gave rain and the land produced its fruit.
19. 我的弟兄們，如果你們中間有人被迷惑離開了真理，而有人使他回轉過來， My brothers, if any among you strays from the truth, and someone turns him back,
20. 這人應當知道：那使一個罪人從他的迷途中回轉過來的，將拯救他的靈魂脫離死亡，並且遮蓋眾多的罪孽。 he should know that whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his life from death and cover a multitude of sins.
1 Peter
1 Peter 1
1. 耶穌基督的使徒 彼得， 致那些蒙揀選，分散在 本都 、 加拉太 、 卡帕多細亞 、 亞細亞 、 比提尼亞 寄居的人， Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ: To the temporary residents of the Dispersion in the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
2. 就是按照父神的預知，藉著聖靈分別為聖，以致順從耶穌基督，又蒙他寶血所灑的人： 願恩典與平安多多地加給你們！ according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and set apart by the Spirit for obedience and [for the] sprinkling with the blood of Jesus Christ. May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
3. 願頌讚歸於神——我們主耶穌基督的父！他照著自己極大的憐憫，藉著耶穌基督從死人中的復活，使我們重生，得著永生的盼望， Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. According to His great mercy, He has given us a new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
4. 得著不會朽壞、不會玷汙、不會衰殘、保存 在天上的繼業； and into an inheritance that is imperishable, uncorrupted, and unfading, kept in heaven for you,
5. 你們藉著信，在神的大能中蒙保守，以至於那預備好要在末世顯現的救恩。 who are being protected by God's power through faith for a salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
6. 為此，你們歡欣跳躍，但如今必須在種種試煉中暫時憂傷， You rejoice in this, though now for a short time you have had to be distressed by various trials
7. 好讓你們的信仰經過考驗，就比那被火煉過仍然會朽壞的金子更加寶貴，能在耶穌基督顯現的時候，被看為是可以得著稱讚、榮耀和尊貴的。 so that the genuineness of your faith-- more valuable than gold, which perishes though refined by fire-- may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
8. 你們雖然沒有見過他，卻愛他；雖然如今看不到他，卻信他，並且懷著無法描述、充滿榮耀的喜樂而歡欣跳躍， You love Him, though you have not seen Him. And though not seeing Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with inexpressible and glorious joy,
9. 因為你們正在領受你們信仰的結果，就是靈魂的救恩。 because you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
10. 關於這救恩，那些預言你們要得著這恩典的先知，曾經尋求過，詳細查考過。 Concerning this salvation, the prophets who prophesied about the grace that would come to you searched and carefully investigated.
11. 他們查考了自己裡面基督之靈，當他預言有關基督的苦難和此後的榮耀時，究竟指明的是什麼時候、或什麼樣的情況。 They inquired into what time or what circumstances the Spirit of Christ within them was indicating when He testified in advance to the messianic sufferings and the glories that would follow.
12. 他們蒙了啟示，知道所服事的這一切，不是為自己，而是為你們。如今，這些事藉著從天上派來的聖靈，通過那些向你們傳福音的人，傳講給了你們；對於這些事，天使們也渴望能詳細察看。 It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you concerning things that have now been announced to you through those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Angels desire to look into these things.
13. 因此，你們要約束自己的意念，要謹慎，要把盼望完全寄託在耶穌基督顯現時帶給你們的恩典上。 Therefore, get your minds ready for action, being self-disciplined, and set your hope completely on the grace to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
14. 做為順從的兒女，不可效法你們原先愚昧無知時的那些欲望； As obedient children, do not be conformed to the desires of your former ignorance
15. 相反，正如召喚你們的那一位是聖潔的，你們在一切行為上也當成為聖潔的， but, as the One who called you is holy, you also are to be holy in all your conduct;
16. 因為經上記著： 「你們當成為聖潔的，因為我是聖潔的。」 for it is written, Be holy, because I am holy.
17. 你們既然稱不偏待人、只按每個人的行為施行審判的那一位為父，就應當懷著敬畏的心，過你們寄居的日子， And if you address as Father the One who judges impartially based on each one's work, you are to conduct yourselves in reverence during this time of temporary residence.
18. 因為你們知道，你們被救贖，脫離祖先所傳下來的虛妄行為，不是憑著會朽壞的東西，如銀子或金子， For you know that you were redeemed from your empty way of life inherited from the fathers, not with perishable things, like silver or gold,
19. 而是憑著那像羔羊一樣毫無瑕疵、毫無玷汙的基督寶血。 but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without defect or blemish.
20. 基督在創世以前就已經被神 預先知道，又在這末後的時代為你們的緣故顯明出來。 He was destined before the foundation of the world, but was revealed at the end of the times for you
21. 藉著基督，你們信靠那使他從死人中復活、又賜他榮耀的神，以致你們的信仰和盼望也都在於神。 who through Him are believers in God, who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
22. 你們既然藉著順從真理， 使自己的靈魂 純潔，以致有了不虛假的弟兄之愛，就應當以潔淨的心，彼此熱切地相愛。 By obedience to the truth, having purified yourselves for sincere love of the brothers, love one another earnestly from a pure heart,
