23. 你們得以重生，不是出於會朽壞的種子，而是出於不朽壞的種子，是藉著神永活長存的話語， since you have been born again-- not of perishable seed but of imperishable-- through the living and enduring word of God.
24. 因為， 「所有的人 都像草一樣， 他們的一切榮耀就像草上的花； 草會枯乾，花會凋謝， For All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like a flower of the grass. The grass withers, and the flower drops off,
25. 但主的話卻永遠長存。」 所傳給你們的福音就是這話。 but the word of the Lord endures forever. And this is the word that was preached as the gospel to you.
1 Peter 2
1. 所以，你們要脫去一切惡毒、一切詭詐、偽善、嫉妒，以及一切的誹謗， So rid yourselves of all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and all slander.
2. 要像剛出生的嬰孩一樣，愛慕那純淨的話語之奶，好使你們藉著它成長，以至於救恩， Like newborn infants, desire the unadulterated spiritual milk, so that you may grow by it in [your] salvation,
3. 因為 你們嘗過主仁慈的滋味。 since you have tasted that the Lord is good.
4. 你們來到那活石面前——他雖然被人棄絕，卻是神所揀選、所珍貴的—— Coming to Him, a living stone-- rejected by men but chosen and valuable to God--
5. 你們也就像活石，被建造成一座屬靈的殿宇，進入聖潔的祭司體系，好藉著耶穌基督獻上蒙神悅納的屬靈祭物， you yourselves, as living stones, are being built into a spiritual house for a holy priesthood to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
6. 因為經上記著： 「看哪，我在 錫安 放一塊 蒙揀選的、珍貴的房角石， 信靠他的人絕不至於蒙羞。」 For it stands in Scripture: Look! I lay a stone in Zion, a chosen and valuable cornerstone, and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame!
7. 這樣，對你們信的人來說，他是尊貴的；但是對那些不信的人來說，卻是 「工匠所棄絕的石頭， 它已經成了房角的頭塊石頭。」 So the honor is for you who believe; but for the unbelieving, The stone that the builders rejected-- this One has become the cornerstone, and
8. 並且是 「一塊絆腳的石頭， 使人絆倒的磐石。」 他們絆倒是因為不肯信從這話語，而這也是被預定的。 A stone that causes men to stumble, and a rock that trips them up. They stumble by disobeying the message; they were destined for this.
9. 但你們屬於 蒙揀選的族類 、君王的祭司 體系、 聖潔的國度，是屬神的 子民 ； 為要使你們宣揚 曾召喚你們的那一位的 美德 —— 他召喚你們出黑暗，入他奇妙的光明。 But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for His possession, so that you may proclaim the praises of the One who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
10. 你們從前不是子民， 但如今卻是神的子民； 從前沒有蒙憐憫， 但如今卻蒙了憐憫。 Once you were not a people, but now you are God's people; you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
11. 各位蒙愛的人哪，我勸你們：做為過客和寄居的，要遠避那與你們靈魂爭戰的肉體欲望。 Dear friends, I urge you as aliens and temporary residents to abstain from fleshly desires that war against you.
12. 你們在外邦人中，要有良好的品行；這樣，當他們誹謗你們是作惡之人的時候，因看到你們美好的行為，就在神 臨到 的日子榮耀神。 Conduct yourselves honorably among the Gentiles, so that in a case where they speak against you as those who do evil, they may, by observing your good works, glorify God in a day of visitation.
13. 為了主的緣故，你們要服從人的一切制度；無論是在上的君王， Submit to every human institution because of the Lord, whether to the Emperor as the supreme authority,
14. 或是他所委派來懲惡賞善的那些官員 ； or to governors as those sent out by him to punish those who do evil and to praise those who do good.
15. 因為神的旨意就是要你們藉著行善，堵住那些愚妄人無知的口。 For it is God's will that you, by doing good, silence the ignorance of foolish people.
16. 做為自由人，你們不可拿自由當做惡事的藉口，卻要做神的奴僕。 As God's slaves, [live] as free people, but don't use your freedom as a way to conceal evil.
17. 你們應當尊重所有的人，愛弟兄姐妹，敬畏神，尊重君王。 Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the Emperor.
18. 你們做家僕的，應當以完全敬畏的心服從主人；不僅要服從善良溫和的，就是乖僻的，也要服從。 Household slaves, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the cruel.
19. 因為人如果為了在神面前良心的緣故，在不公正的苦害中忍受憂患，這是可稱讚的； For it [brings] favor if, because of conscience toward God, someone endures grief from suffering unjustly.
20. 就是說，如果你們因犯罪受責打而忍耐，有什麼可稱讚的呢？但如果你們因行善受苦害而忍耐，這在神看來是可稱讚的。 For what credit is there if you endure when you sin and are beaten? But when you do good and suffer, if you endure, it brings favor with God.
21. 原來你們是為此蒙召的， 因為基督也為你們受了苦害， 給你們留下了榜樣， 好讓你們追隨他的腳蹤。 For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you should follow in His steps.
22. 他 沒有犯過罪， 在他口中也找不出詭詐； He did not commit sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth;
23. 他被辱罵的時候，不還口； 受苦害的時候，不說威嚇的話， 而是把自己交託給以公義施行審判的那一位。 when reviled, He did not revile in return; when suffering, He did not threaten, but committed Himself to the One who judges justly.
24. 他在木頭上，以自己的身體親自擔當了我們的罪孽， 好使我們既然向罪而死， 就能向義而活； 因 他受的鞭傷，你們得了痊癒。 He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that, having died to sins, we might live for righteousness; by His wounding you have been healed.
25. 要知道，你們 從前像是迷失的羊， 但現在卻回到了 你們靈魂 的牧人和監督的身旁。 For you were like sheep going astray, but you have now returned to the shepherd and guardian of your souls.
1 Peter 3
1. 同樣，你們做妻子的，要服從自己的丈夫。這樣，即使有不肯信從這話語的丈夫，他們也會被感化 過來，不是因著妻子的話語，而是因著妻子的品行， Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your own husbands so that, even if some disobey the [Christian] message, they may be won over without a message by the way their wives live,
2. 因為看見了你們懷有敬畏之心的貞潔品行。 when they observe your pure, reverent lives.
3. 你們的美麗之處不應該是外在的，如編頭髮、戴金飾、穿華服， Your beauty should not consist of outward things [like] elaborate hairstyles and the wearing of gold ornaments or fine clothes;
4. 而應該是心裡面內在的人，帶著不朽壞的品性，出於謙和、安靜的靈；這在神面前是極其貴重的。 instead, [it should consist of] the hidden person of the heart with the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very valuable in God's eyes.
5. 實際上，從前盼望神的那些聖潔婦女，也是這樣裝飾自己，服從自己丈夫的； For in the past, the holy women who hoped in God also beautified themselves in this way, submitting to their own husbands,
6. 就像 撒拉 順從 亞伯拉罕，稱他為主那樣；當你們行善而不怕任何驚擾的時候，就成為 撒拉 的兒女了。 just as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. You have become her children when you do good and aren't frightened by anything alarming.
7. 同樣，你們做丈夫的，要按情理與妻子同住，將女性當做比較軟弱的器皿而尊重她們，也當做是生命之恩的共同繼承人。這樣，你們的禱告就不會受攔阻。 Husbands, in the same way, live with your wives with understanding of their weaker nature yet showing them honor as co-heirs of the grace of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
8. 總而言之，你們大家都要心思一致，互相同情，相愛如弟兄，心存憐憫，滿有謙卑 。 Now finally, all of you should be like-minded and sympathetic, should love believers, and be compassionate and humble,
9. 不要以惡報惡，以辱罵還辱罵，反要祝福，因為 你們是為此蒙召的，好使你們繼承祝福。 not paying back evil for evil or insult for insult but, on the contrary, giving a blessing, since you were called for this, so that you can inherit a blessing.
10. 要知道， 「那願意愛惜生命、 願意見到好日子的人， 要停止舌頭出惡言， 不讓嘴唇說詭詐的話； For the one who wants to love life and to see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit,
11. 要遠離邪惡，要行美善， 要尋求和睦，要竭力追求； and he must turn away from evil and do good. He must seek peace and pursue it,
12. 因為主的眼睛看顧義人， 主的耳朵垂聽他們的祈禱； 但主的臉卻敵對作惡的人。」 because the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and His ears are open to their request. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.
13. 如果你們是為美善而熱心 的人，誰會傷害你們呢？ And who will harm you if you are passionate for what is good?
14. 然而，即使你們為義受苦，也是蒙福的。 不要怕他們所懼怕的，也不要驚慌不安， But even if you should suffer for righteousness, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear or be disturbed,
15. 只要你們心裡尊主基督 為聖，無論誰要你們對你們裡面的盼望做個交代，你們都要隨時預備好答覆他； but set apart the Messiah as Lord in your hearts, and always be ready to give a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you.
16. 不過要以溫柔、敬畏的心答覆，並且持守無愧的良心，以致誰詆毀你們在基督裡的良好品行，誰就要在你們受到誹謗的事上蒙羞。 However, do this with gentleness and respect, keeping your conscience clear, so that when you are accused, those who denounce your Christian life will be put to shame.
17. 要知道，即使神的旨意要你們因行善而受苦，也比因作惡而受苦更好， For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God's will, than for doing evil.
18. 因為基督也曾一次為了贖罪而受苦， 就是義的代替不義的， 為要把你們 帶到神的面前。 照著肉身說，基督固然被處死了； 但照著靈說，他卻得以復活了。 For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, that He might bring you to God, after being put to death in the fleshly realm but made alive in the spiritual realm.
19. 藉著靈，他也曾去傳道給那些被監禁的靈魂， In that state He also went and made a proclamation to the spirits in prison
20. 就是從前在 挪亞 建造方舟的那些日子裡，在神耐心等待的時候那些不肯信從的靈魂。當時進入方舟，藉著水獲救的人很少，只有八個人 。 who in the past were disobedient, when God patiently waited in the days of Noah while an ark was being prepared; in it, a few-- that is, eight people-- were saved through water.
21. 這水所象徵的洗禮，如今也藉著耶穌基督的復活拯救你們，不是清除肉體的汙穢，而是向神懇求 無愧的良心。 Baptism, which corresponds to this, now saves you (not the removal of the filth of the flesh, but the pledge of a good conscience toward God) through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
22. 耶穌基督已經升天，就在神的右邊，天使們、掌權的、有勢力的，都服從了他。 Now that He has gone into heaven, He is at God's right hand, with angels, authorities, and powers subjected to Him.
1 Peter 4
1. 所以，基督既然在肉身上 受過苦，你們也應該以同樣的心志裝備自己，因為那在肉身上受過苦的，就已經與罪斷絕了， Therefore, since Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same resolve-- because the One who suffered in the flesh has finished with sin--
2. 以致不再順著人的欲望，而是順著神的旨意，在世上 度餘下的時間。 in order to live the remaining time in the flesh, no longer for human desires, but for God's will.
3. 要知道， 過往的日子，你們做了外邦人願意做的事，活在好色、私欲、酗酒、荒宴、狂飲和律法所禁止的 拜偶像之中——這已經夠了。 For there has already been enough time spent in doing the will of the pagans: carrying on in unrestrained behavior, evil desires, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and lawless idolatry.
4. 如今在這些事上，因你們不與他們一起跑進那同樣放蕩的洪流中，他們就感到奇怪，毀謗你們。 In regard to this, they are surprised that you don't plunge with them into the same flood of dissipation-- and they slander you.
5. 他們將要向那預備好審判活人和死人的神 做出交代。 They will give an account to the One who stands ready to judge the living and the dead.
6. 原來福音也是為此而傳給了那些死去的人，以致照著肉身說，他們按人的意思 被定罪；但照著靈說，卻按神的意思 活著。 For this reason the gospel was also preached to [those who are now] dead, so that, although they might be judged by men in the fleshly realm, they might live by God in the spiritual realm.
7. 萬物的結局臨近了，所以你們為了禱告的緣故應當清醒、謹慎。 Now the end of all things is near; therefore, be clear-headed and disciplined for prayer.
8. 最要緊的是：要持守彼此之間熱切的愛，因為 愛能遮蓋眾多的罪孽。 Above all, keep your love for one another at full strength, since love covers a multitude of sins.
9. 你們要毫無怨言地彼此款待。 Be hospitable to one another without complaining.
10. 每個人要照著自己所領受的恩賜來彼此服事，做神各種恩典的好管家。 Based on the gift they have received, everyone should use it to serve others, as good managers of the varied grace of God.
11. 如果有人講說，要照著神的話語講說；如果有人服事，要照著神所賜的力量服事，好讓神在一切事上藉著耶穌基督得榮耀。願榮耀和權能都歸於他，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 If anyone speaks, [his speech should be] like the oracles of God; if anyone serves, [his service should be] from the strength God provides, so that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ. To Him belong the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
12. 各位蒙愛的人哪，當火一樣的考驗臨到你們中間，給你們試煉的時候，你們不要感到奇怪，好像發生了怪異的事。 Dear friends, when the fiery ordeal arises among you to test you, don't be surprised by it, as if something unusual were happening to you.
13. 相反，你們既然在基督的苦難上有份，就應該照此歡喜，好使你們在他榮耀顯現的時候，也可以歡喜、快樂。 Instead, as you share in the sufferings of the Messiah rejoice, so that you may also rejoice with great joy at the revelation of His glory.
14. 你們如果因基督的名受責罵，就是蒙福的，因為榮耀的靈，就是神的靈，住在你們身上。 If you are ridiculed for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
15. 你們當中不可有人因殺人、偷竊、作惡 、好管閒事而受苦； None of you, however, should suffer as a murderer, a thief, an evildoer, or as a meddler.
16. 但如果有人因為是基督徒而受苦，他不應該感到羞恥，反要奉這名 來榮耀神； But if [anyone suffers] as a Christian, he should not be ashamed, but should glorify God with that name.
17. 因為時候到了，審判要從神的家開始。如果先從我們開始，那麼，那些不肯信從神福音的人會有什麼樣的結局呢？ For the time has come for judgment to begin with God's household; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
18. 「如果連義人都好不容易得救， 那麼，不敬神的人和罪人將會怎麼樣呢 ？」 And if the righteous is saved with difficulty, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?
19. 因此，那些照著神的旨意受苦的人，要藉著行善把自己的靈魂 交託給那位信實的造物主。 So those who suffer according to God's will should, in doing good, entrust themselves to a faithful Creator.
1 Peter 5
1. 所以，我這同做長老的、做基督苦難見證人的、也在那將要顯現的榮耀中有份的，我懇求你們中間的長老們： Therefore, as a fellow elder and witness to the sufferings of the Messiah, and also a participant in the glory about to be revealed, I exhort the elders among you:
2. 你們應當牧養你們中間神的羊群，要按神的意思 照顧他們，不是出於勉強，而是出於甘心；也不是出於貪財，而是出於樂意； shepherd God's flock among you, not overseeing out of compulsion but freely, according to God's [will]; not for the money but eagerly;
3. 也不要壓制所分配給你們的那些人，而要做羊群的榜樣。 not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
4. 這樣，在大牧者顯現的時候，你們將領受那永不衰殘的榮耀冠冕。 And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
5. 同樣，你們年輕的，當服從年長的。每個人當彼此 以謙卑束腰，因為 「神抵擋驕傲的人， 賜恩典給謙卑的人。」 Likewise, you younger men, be subject to the elders. And all of you clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.
6. 所以，你們當在神大能的手下降卑，好讓他在所定的時候高舉你們。 Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, so that He may exalt you in due time,
7. 你們要把一切憂慮都卸給神，因為他顧念你們。 casting all your care upon Him, because He cares about you.
8. 你們要謹慎，要警醒。你們的仇敵魔鬼就像咆哮的獅子走來走去，尋找可吞吃的人。 Be sober! Be on the alert! Your adversary the Devil is prowling around like a roaring lion, looking for anyone he can devour.
9. 你們要用堅固的信仰來抵擋它，因為你們知道，你們在世上的弟兄姐妹也都經歷著同樣的苦難。 Resist him, firm in the faith, knowing that the same sufferings are being experienced by your brothers in the world.
10. 然而，那賜一切恩典的神，就是在基督耶穌 裡召喚你們 進入他永恆榮耀的那一位，在你們暫時受苦之後，將親自使你們完備、堅固、剛強、根基穩固。 Now the God of all grace, who called you to His eternal glory in Christ Jesus, will personally restore, establish, strengthen, and support you after you have suffered a little.
11. 願權能 歸於他，直到永遠 ！阿們。 To Him be the dominion forever. Amen.
12. 藉著我看為忠心的弟兄 賽拉斯，我簡要地寫了這封信，勸勉你們，並且證明這是神真實的恩典。你們要在這恩典中站立得住。 Through Silvanus, whom I consider a faithful brother, I have written briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Take your stand in it!
13. 那與你們同蒙揀選的、在 巴比倫 的婦人 問候你們。我兒子 馬可 也問候你們。 She who is in Babylon, also chosen, sends you greetings, as does Mark, my son.
14. 你們要用愛心的親吻禮彼此問候。願平安臨到你們所有在基督 裡的人！ Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
2 Peter
2 Peter 1
1. 耶穌基督的奴僕和使徒 西門彼得， 致那些藉著我們的神、救主耶穌基督的義，與我們領受同樣寶貴信仰的人： Simeon Peter, a slave and an apostle of Jesus Christ: To those who have obtained a faith of equal privilege with ours through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ.
2. 願恩典與平安，藉著你們真正認識神，我們的主耶穌，多多地加給你們！ May grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
3. 主耶穌 神性的大能，因我們真正認識以自己的榮耀和美德召喚我們的那一位，就把一切有關生命和敬神的事都賜給了我們。 For His divine power has given us everything required for life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and goodness.
4. 藉著這榮耀和美德，他把那些又寶貴又極大的應許賜給了我們，好使你們能藉著這些應許，逃脫世上因欲望而來的衰朽，成為在神的本性上有份的人。 By these He has given us very great and precious promises, so that through them you may share in the divine nature, escaping the corruption that is in the world because of evil desires.
5. 是的，也正是為此，你們應當盡量地殷勤，在信仰上加美德；在美德上加知識； For this very reason, make every effort to supplement your faith with goodness, goodness with knowledge,
6. 在知識上加自制；在自制上加忍耐；在忍耐上加敬神； knowledge with self-control, self-control with endurance, endurance with godliness,
7. 在敬神上加弟兄之情；在弟兄之情上加愛； godliness with brotherly affection, and brotherly affection with love.
8. 因為你們如果有了這些，並且不斷增多這些，它們就會使你們在真正認識我們主耶穌基督的事上，不會成為懶惰的 或不結果子的人； For if these qualities are yours and are increasing, they will keep you from being useless or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
9. 就是說，沒有具備這些的就是瞎眼的，他只看得見眼前的，忘記自己過去的罪孽已經得了潔淨。 The person who lacks these things is blind and shortsighted, and has forgotten the cleansing from his past sins.
10. 所以弟兄們，你們當更加努力地確定你們所蒙的召喚和揀選。要知道，如果你們如此行，就絕不會跌倒； Therefore, brothers, make every effort to confirm your calling and election, because if you do these things you will never stumble.
11. 而這樣，你們就豐豐富富地得到供應，進入我們的主、救主耶穌基督永恆的國度。 For in this way, entry into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be richly supplied to you.
12. 所以，雖然你們已經知道這些事，又在你們已有的真理上得了堅固，我還是要 不斷地提醒你們。 Therefore I will always remind you about these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you have.
13. 我認為，只要我還在這帳篷裡，就理當用提醒的話來激發你們， I consider it right, as long as I am in this tent, to wake you up with a reminder,
14. 因為我知道我脫離這帳篷的時候快到了，就像我們的主耶穌基督也曾向我指明的。 knowing that I will soon lay aside my tent, as our Lord Jesus Christ has also shown me.
15. 我也要努力，使你們在我離世以後，時常想起這些事。 And I will also make every effort that after my departure you may be able to recall these things at any time.
16. 要知道，我們從前讓你們明白我們主耶穌基督的大能和他來臨的事，並不是隨從巧言編造的故事，相反，我們是親眼見過他威榮的人。 For we did not follow cleverly contrived myths when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ; instead, we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
17. 他從父神領受尊貴和榮耀的時候，從那威嚴的榮耀中，有這樣的聲音向他傳來，說： 「這是我的愛子， 我所喜悅的。」 For when He received honor and glory from God the Father, a voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory: This is My beloved Son. I take delight in Him!
18. 這從天上傳來的聲音，是我們與他一起在聖山上的時候聽見的， And we heard this voice when it came from heaven while we were with Him on the holy mountain.
19. 並且我們有先知更確切的話語。你們如果留心這些話語，把它當做照耀在暗處的燈，一直到天光破曉、晨星在你們心中升起，你們就做得很好了。 So we have the prophetic word strongly confirmed. You will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dismal place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts.
20. 你們首先要知道這一點：經上的一切預言都不是出於人自己的解釋 ； First of all, you should know this: no prophecy of Scripture comes from one's own interpretation,
21. 因為預言從來不是藉著人的意思傳來的，而是人受聖靈的感動 說出從神而來的話 。 because no prophecy ever came by the will of man; instead, moved by the Holy Spirit, men spoke from God.
2 Peter 2
1. 不過，在子民當中也出現過假先知；照樣，在你們當中也會有假教師。他們會偷偷引進使人滅亡 的異端，甚至否認那救贖他們的主，給自己招來快速的滅亡 。 But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, and will bring swift destruction on themselves.
2. 許多人會隨從他們好色 的事；真理之道 也會因他們的緣故，受到褻瀆。 Many will follow their unrestrained ways, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed.
3. 他們因著貪心，會用捏造的話利用你們 。對他們的懲罰，從太古的時候就沒有失效，他們的滅亡 也不耽延 。 In their greed they will exploit you with deceptive words. Their condemnation, [pronounced] long ago, is not idle, and their destruction does not sleep.
4. 要知道：既然神沒有顧惜那些犯罪的天使，把他們扔進地獄，囚禁在幽暗的坑裡，拘留到審判的時候； For if God didn't spare the angels who sinned, but threw them down into Tartarus and delivered them to be kept in chains of darkness until judgment;
5. 既然神也沒有顧惜上古的世界，使洪水臨到那不敬神的世界，只保守了義的傳道者 挪亞 一家八口； and if He didn't spare the ancient world, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, and seven others, when He brought a flood on the world of the ungodly;
6. 既然神又定了 所多瑪 和 格摩拉 的罪，把這二城傾覆，燒成灰燼，做為以後不敬神之人的鑒戒； and if He reduced the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes and condemned them to ruin, making them an example to those who were going to be ungodly;
7. 既然神拯救了那因惡人 的好色行為而哀傷的義人 羅得 —— and if He rescued righteous Lot, distressed by the unrestrained behavior of the immoral
8. 因為這義人住在他們中間，看見又聽見他們的不法行為，他公義的心天天受到折磨—— (for as he lived among them, that righteous man tormented himself day by day with the lawless deeds he saw and heard)--
9. 那麼，主就知道怎樣拯救敬神的人脫離試煉，卻把不義的人留在懲罰之下，直到審判的日子， then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
10. 尤其對那些隨從肉體而在汙穢的欲望中生活 、輕視主權者的人，更是這樣。 這些人膽大、任性，毫不戰兢地褻瀆那些有榮耀的。 especially those who follow the polluting desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold, arrogant people! They do not tremble when they blaspheme the glorious ones;
11. 就算是天使們，雖然有更大的力量和權能，也不在主面前用毀謗的話控告他們。 however, angels, who are greater in might and power, do not bring a slanderous charge against them before the Lord.
12. 但這些人就像沒有理性的動物，生來就是靠本能的，是為了捕捉和宰殺的；他們褻瀆自己所不明白的，也將在自己的衰朽 中被毀滅 。 But these people, like irrational animals-- creatures of instinct born to be caught and destroyed-- speak blasphemies about things they don't understand, and in their destruction they too will be destroyed,
13. 他們行不義，就得不義的酬報 ；他們把白晝的放蕩看做是享樂；他們是汙漬和瑕疵；他們與你們一起吃喝的時候，以自己的詭詐為樂； suffering harm as the payment for unrighteousness. They consider it a pleasure to carouse in the daytime. They are blots and blemishes, delighting in their deceptions as they feast with you,
14. 他們眼中充滿了淫欲和無止境的罪；他們引誘不堅定的人 ；他們心中習慣了貪婪；他們是被詛咒的兒女； having eyes full of adultery and always looking for sin, seducing unstable people, and with hearts trained in greed. Accursed children!
15. 他們離開了正道就被迷惑，隨從了 比珥 的兒子 巴蘭 的路——這 巴蘭 喜愛不義的酬報， By abandoning the straight path, they have gone astray and have followed the path of Balaam, the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness,
16. 卻為自己的過犯受了責備：一頭不能說話的驢，竟用人的聲音說出話來，攔阻了這先知的狂妄。 but received a rebuke for his transgression: a speechless donkey spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet's madness.
17. 這些人是無水的泉源，是被暴風吹逐的雲霧；有漆黑的幽暗 為他們存留。 These people are springs without water, mists driven by a whirlwind. The gloom of darkness has been reserved for them.
18. 他們說虛妄誇大的話，以肉體的欲望和好色的事來引誘人；這些被引誘的人好不容易才 逃脫那些生活在迷途中的人； For uttering bombastic, empty words, they seduce, by fleshly desires and debauchery, people who have barely escaped from those who live in error.
19. 他們許諾給這些人自由，自己卻是衰朽 的奴隸。要知道，一個人被什麼制伏，就成為什麼的奴隸。 They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption, since people are enslaved to whatever defeats them.
20. 原來，他們如果藉著認識我們的主、救主耶穌基督而逃脫這世界的汙穢，卻又被這些汙穢糾纏、制伏了，那麼，他們最後的情況就比先前更壞了； For if, having escaped the world's impurity through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in these things and defeated, the last state is worse for them than the first.
21. 因為認識了義的道路以後，背離那交託給他們的神聖誡命，對他們來說，倒不如不認識還好。 For it would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
22. 在他們身上正應驗了這真實的俗語：「 狗轉身回到自己所吐的東西； 豬洗乾淨了又到汙泥中打滾。」 It has happened to them according to the true proverb: A dog returns to its own vomit, and, "a sow, after washing itself, wallows in the mud."
2 Peter 3
1. 各位蒙愛的人哪，這已經是我寫給你們的第二封信。在這兩封信中，我都用提醒的話來激發你們純潔的意念， Dear friends, this is now the second letter I've written you; in both, I awaken your pure understanding with a reminder,
2. 要使你們想起聖先知們曾經說過的話，以及你們 的使徒們所傳 的主、救主的命令。 so that you can remember the words previously spoken by the holy prophets, and the commandment of our Lord and Savior [given] through your apostles.
3. 你們首先要知道這一點：在末後的日子裡，將有好譏誚的人出來譏誚，他們順著自己的欲望生活， First, be aware of this: scoffers will come in the last days to scoff, following their own lusts,
4. 並且說：「他 來臨的應許在哪裡呢？其實自從祖先睡了以來，一切 都繼續存留，與創世之初一樣。」 saying, "Where is the promise of His coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they have been since the beginning of creation."
5. 他們故意忽略這一點：就是從太古的時候，藉著神的話語有了諸天，也有了從水而出、藉水而成的大地； They willfully ignore this: long ago the heavens and the earth existed out of water and through water by the word of God.
6. 藉著神的話語和水，當時的世界被水淹沒就毀滅了； Through these the world of that time perished when it was flooded by water.
7. 但現在的天和地，藉著他的話語得以存留，一直留到不敬神的人受審判和滅亡 的日子，被火焚燒 。 But by the same word the present heavens and earth are held in store for fire, being kept until the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
8. 可是，各位蒙愛的人哪，你們不可忽略這一點：在主看來，一日如千年，千年如一日。 Dear friends, don't let this one thing escape you: with the Lord one day is like 1,000 years, and 1,000 years like one day.
9. 主沒有像有些人認為的那樣，拖延所應許的；相反，他對你們恆久忍耐，不願任何人滅亡，而願所有人都來悔改。 The Lord does not delay His promise, as some understand delay, but is patient with you, not wanting any to perish, but all to come to repentance.
10. 不過，主的日子要來臨，就像 賊來臨那樣。在那日，諸天要轟然一聲地消逝，天體 將被火焚燒而廢除，地和地上的作為也都將被暴露出來 。 But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief; on that [day] the heavens will pass away with a loud noise, the elements will burn and be dissolved, and the earth and the works on it will be disclosed.
11. 既然這一切都要如此被廢除，那麼，你們應該做什麼樣的人呢？應該行為聖潔、敬畏神， Since all these things are to be destroyed in this way, [it is clear] what sort of people you should be in holy conduct and godliness
12. 等候並催促 神的日子來臨。因為在那日，諸天將被焚燒而廢除，天體 要被火焚燒而熔化。 as you wait for and earnestly desire the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be on fire and be dissolved, and the elements will melt with the heat.
13. 但照著他的應許，我們等候著一個新天新地，有公義居住在那裡。 But based on His promise, we wait for new heavens and a new earth, where righteousness will dwell.
14. 所以，各位蒙愛的人哪，你們既然等候這些事，就當努力地使自己被神 看做是與他和好、毫無玷汙、毫無瑕疵的； Therefore, dear friends, while you wait for these things, make every effort to be found in peace without spot or blemish before Him.
15. 並且你們要把我們主的耐心看做救恩，就像我們親愛的弟兄 保羅，照著所賜他的智慧寫給你們的那樣。 Also, regard the patience of our Lord as [an opportunity for] salvation, just as our dear brother Paul, according to the wisdom given to him, has written to you.
16. 他在所有的信中也都說到這些事。那些沒有知識、不堅定的人曲解了他信中一些難懂的地方，正如他們也曲解其他經文，就導致了他們自己的滅亡 。 He speaks about these things in all his letters, in which there are some matters that are hard to understand. The untaught and unstable twist them to their own destruction, as they also do with the rest of the Scriptures.
17. 因此，各位蒙愛的人哪，你們既然預先知道了這些，就應該警惕，免得被那些惡人 的迷惑 引入歧途，從自己堅固的地步墜落。 Therefore, dear friends, since you have been forewarned, be on your guard, so that you are not led away by the error of the immoral and fall from your own stability.
18. 你們要在我們的主、救主耶穌基督的恩典和知識中不斷長進。願榮耀歸於他，從現在直到永遠之日！阿們。 But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
1 John
1 John 1
1. 有關生命之道， 是從太初就有的， 是我們所聽到、 所親眼看到、 所觀察過、 又親手摸過的—— What was from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we have observed, and have touched with our hands, concerning the Word of life--
2. 的確，這生命已經顯明出來； 我們看到了， 現在也做見證， 並向你們宣揚這永恆的生命； 這生命原來與父同在、 又向我們顯明出來了。 that life was revealed, and we have seen it and we testify and declare to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us--
3. 我們把所看到、 所聽到的也向你們宣揚， 好使你們也能夠與我們相契合 ； 而我們又是與父 和他的兒子耶穌基督相契合的。 what we have seen and heard we also declare to you, so that you may have fellowship along with us; and indeed our fellowship is with the Father and with His Son Jesus Christ.
4. 我們寫 這些事， 好使我們 大家的喜樂得以滿足。 We are writing these things so that our joy may be complete.
5. 我們從基督 所聽到，現在又傳講給你們的信息是這樣的：神就是光，在他裡面毫無黑暗。 Now this is the message we have heard from Him and declare to you: God is light, and there is absolutely no darkness in Him.
6. 如果我們說自己與神相契合，卻仍然在黑暗中行走，我們就是在說謊，沒有遵行真理； If we say, "We have fellowship with Him," and walk in darkness, we are lying and are not practicing the truth.
7. 但如果我們在光明中行走，就像神在光明中那樣，我們就是彼此相契合 的；而且神的兒子耶穌 的血也潔淨我們脫離一切的罪。 But if we walk in the light as He Himself is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
8. 如果我們說自己沒有罪，我們就是在欺騙自己，真理就不在我們裡面了； If we say, "We have no sin," we are deceiving ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
9. 如果我們承認自己的罪孽，神 是信實的、公義的，他就會赦免我們的罪孽，潔淨我們脫離一切的不義。 If we confess our sins, He is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
10. 如果我們說自己沒有犯罪，我們就是把神 當做說謊者，他的話語就不在我們裡面了。 If we say, "We have not sinned," we make Him a liar, and His word is not in us.
1 John 2
1. 我的孩子們哪，我把這些事寫給你們，免得你們犯罪。但如果有人犯了罪，在父那裡我們有一位辯護者，就是那義者耶穌基督。 My little children, I am writing you these things so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father-- Jesus Christ the righteous One.
2. 他自己為我們的罪孽做了平息祭，不僅是為我們的罪，也是為全世界的罪。 He Himself is the propitiation for our sins, and not only for ours, but also for those of the whole world.
3. 如果我們遵守基督 的命令，從這一點我們就知道我們已經認識他。 This is how we are sure that we have come to know Him: by keeping His commands.
4. 那說「我已經認識他」，卻不遵守他命令的，就是說謊者，真理也不在這個人裡面； The one who says, "I have come to know Him," without keeping His commands, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
5. 但如果有人遵守他的話語，屬神的愛就確實在這個人裡面得以完全了；從這一點我們就知道我們是在他裡面。 But whoever keeps His word, truly in him the love of God is perfected. This is how we know we are in Him:
6. 那說自己住在他裡面的，自己也應該按基督 所行的照樣去行。 the one who says he remains in Him should walk just as He walked.
7. 各位蒙愛的人哪，我寫給你們的不是一條新命令，而是你們從起初就有的舊命令；這條舊命令就是你們 所聽過的那話 。 Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command, but an old command that you have had from the beginning. The old command is the message you have heard.
8. 另一方面，我寫給你們的也是一條新命令；這命令在他、在你們，都是真實的，因為黑暗正在消逝，真光已經在照耀。 Yet I am writing you a new command, which is true in Him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining.
9. 那說自己在光裡卻恨自己弟兄的，至今還在黑暗裡； The one who says he is in the light but hates his brother is in the darkness until now.
10. 那愛自己弟兄的，就住在光裡，而且在他裡面 沒有什麼絆腳的事； The one who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause for stumbling in him.
11. 但那恨自己弟兄的，就是在黑暗裡，並且在黑暗裡行走，也不知道自己往哪裡去，因為黑暗使他的眼睛瞎了。 But the one who hates his brother is in the darkness, walks in the darkness, and doesn't know where he's going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
12. 孩子們哪，我寫信給你們， 因為你們的罪孽藉著基督 的名已經被赦免了； I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of His name.
13. 父老們哪，我寫信給你們， 因為你們已經認識了從太初就有的那一位； 年輕人哪，我寫信給你們， 因為你們已經勝過了那惡者。 I am writing to you, fathers, because you have come to know the One who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have had victory over the evil one.
14. 孩子們哪，我寫了信給你們， 因為你們已經認識了父； 父老們哪，我寫了信給你們， 因為你們已經認識了從太初就有的那一位； 年輕人哪，我寫了信給你們， 因為你們是強壯的， 神的話語 住在你們裡面， 你們也已經勝過了那惡者。 I have written to you, children, because you have come to know the Father. I have written to you, fathers, because you have come to know the One who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, God's word remains in you, and you have had victory over the evil one.
15. 你們不要愛世界，也不要愛世界上的事物。如果有人愛世界，父的愛 就不在他裡面了。 Do not love the world or the things that belong to the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in him. Because everything that belongs to the world--
16. 原來世界上一切肉體的欲望、眼目的欲望、今生的驕傲，都不是出於父，而是出於世界的。 the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride in one's lifestyle-- is not from the Father, but is from the world.
17. 世界和屬世的欲望正在消逝；但那遵行神旨意的，卻永遠長存。 And the world with its lust is passing away, but the one who does God's will remains forever.
18. 孩子們哪，現在是末後的時期了。正如你們聽說過敵基督的要來，現在確實已經有許多敵基督的出現了；故此我們知道，現在是末後的時期了。 Children, it is the last hour. And as you have heard, "Antichrist is coming," even now many antichrists have come. We know from this that it is the last hour.
19. 他們從我們中間出去，但他們本來就不屬於我們，因為他們如果屬於我們，就會留下與我們在一起；不過這樣就顯明出，他們都不屬於我們。 They went out from us, but they did not belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. However, they went out so that it might be made clear that none of them belongs to us.
20. 至於你們，你們從那位聖者領受了恩膏，並且你們大家都已經知道了這事 。 But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
21. 我寫了信給你們，不是因為你們不認識真理，而是因為你們已經認識了真理，又因為一切虛假都不是出於真理。 I have not written to you because you don't know the truth, but because you do know it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
22. 誰是說謊者呢？難道不是那否認耶穌是基督的嗎？那否認父和子的，這個人就是敵基督的。 Who is the liar, if not the one who denies that Jesus is the Messiah? He is the antichrist, the one who denies the Father and the Son.
23. 所有否認子的，就沒有父；那承認子的，連父也有了。 No one who denies the Son can have the Father; he who confesses the Son has the Father as well.
24. 你們應當使那從起初所聽到的，住在你們裡面。如果那從起初所聽到的住在你們裡面，你們就會住在子裡面，也住在父裡面。 What you have heard from the beginning must remain in you. If what you have heard from the beginning remains in you, then you will remain in the Son and in the Father.
25. 這就是那應許，是他所應許我們的，就是永恆的生命。 And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
26. 我寫給你們的這些，是關於迷惑你們之人的。 I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
27. 至於你們，你們從那一位所領受的恩膏住在你們裡面，這樣你們就不需要人來教導你們。其實，就像他的恩膏在一切事上所教導你們的——是真實的，不是虛假的——又像他曾經所教導的，你們要住在他裡面。 The anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you don't need anyone to teach you. Instead, His anointing teaches you about all things, and is true and is not a lie; just as it has taught you, remain in Him.
28. 如今，孩子們哪，你們當住在他裡面，好使他顯現的時候，我們可以坦然無懼，他來臨的時候，我們可以在他面前不至於蒙羞。 So now, little children, remain in Him, so that when He appears we may have boldness and not be ashamed before Him at His coming.
29. 你們如果知道他是公義的，也就知道所有行義的人，都是由他所生的。 If you know that He is righteous, you know this as well: everyone who does what is right has been born of Him.
1 John 3
1. 你們看，父所賜給我們的是何等的愛，為要使我們被稱為「神的兒女」，而我們就是神的兒女 。世人之所以不認識我們，是因為不認識父 。 Look at how great a love the Father has given us, that we should be called God's children. And we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it didn't know Him.
2. 各位蒙愛的人哪，現在我們是神的兒女，將來會怎樣，尚未顯明。 我們已經知道的是：基督 顯現的時候，我們就會像他，因為我們將看見他的本相。 Dear friends, we are God's children now, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when He appears, we will be like Him, because we will see Him as He is.
3. 每一個對基督 懷有這盼望的，都會使自己純潔，正如基督 是純潔的。 And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself just as He is pure.
4. 凡是犯罪的，也是行惡 的；罪就是惡 。 Everyone who commits sin also breaks the law; sin is the breaking of law.
5. 你們知道，基督 曾經顯現，是為了除去罪孽 ；在他裡面並沒有罪。 You know that He was revealed so that He might take away sins, and there is no sin in Him.
6. 凡是住在基督 裡面的，就不繼續犯罪；凡是繼續犯罪的，就未曾看到他，也未曾認識他。 Everyone who remains in Him does not sin; everyone who sins has not seen Him or known Him.
7. 孩子們哪，不要讓任何人迷惑你們。行義的人是公義的，正如基督 是公義的。 Little children, let no one deceive you! The one who does what is right is righteous, just as He is righteous.
8. 繼續犯罪的人屬於魔鬼，因為魔鬼從起初就一直犯罪。為此，神的兒子顯現了，是為了廢除魔鬼的作為。 The one who commits sin is of the Devil, for the Devil has sinned from the beginning. The Son of God was revealed for this purpose: to destroy the Devil's works.
9. 凡是由神所生的，不繼續犯罪，因為神的種子住在他裡面；他也不能繼續犯罪，因為他是由神所生的。 Everyone who has been born of God does not sin, because His seed remains in him; he is not able to sin, because he has been born of God.
10. 從這一點，誰是神的兒女，誰是魔鬼的兒女就清清楚楚了。 凡是不行公義的，就不屬於神；不愛自己弟兄的，也不屬於神。 This is how God's children-- and the Devil's children-- are made evident. Whoever does not do what is right is not of God, especially the one who does not love his brother.
11. 因為你們從起初所聽見的信息是這樣的：我們要彼此相愛。 For this is the message you have heard from the beginning: we should love one another,
12. 不要像 該隱，他屬於那惡者，殺了自己的弟弟 。他為什麼殺弟弟呢？因為他自己的行為是惡的，而他弟弟的行為是義的。 unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his works were evil, and his brother's were righteous.
13. 弟兄們，如果世界恨你們，不要感到驚奇。 Do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
14. 我們知道，因為我們愛弟兄，我們就已經出死入生了；那不愛弟兄的，就住在死亡中。 We know that we have passed from death to life because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
15. 凡是恨自己弟兄的，就是殺人的，而你們知道：凡是殺人的，就沒有永恆的生命住在他裡面。 Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life residing in him.
16. 我們從這一點就知道了愛：基督 為我們捨棄了自己的生命，我們也應該為弟兄捨棄生命。 This is how we have come to know love: He laid down His life for us. We should also lay down our lives for our brothers.
17. 但如果有人擁有世界的財產，看見自己的弟兄有需要，卻封閉情感，那麼，屬神的愛怎麼能住在他裡面呢？ If anyone has this world's goods and sees his brother in need but shuts off his compassion from him-- how can God's love reside in him?
18. 孩子們哪，讓我們不在語言或口頭上相愛，而在行為和真理中相愛， Little children, we must not love in word or speech, but in deed and truth;
19. 從這一點我們就會知道我們屬於真理。 that is how we will know we are of the truth, and will convince our hearts in His presence,
20. 就算我們的心責備自己，我們在神面前也可以安心，因為神比我們的心更大，並且他知道一切。 because if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts and knows all things.
21. 各位蒙愛的人哪，如果我們的心不責備我們，我們在神面前就可以坦然無懼， Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn [us] we have confidence before God,
22. 這樣，凡是我們所求的，就會從他得著；因為我們遵守他的命令，行他看為可喜悅的事。 and can receive whatever we ask from Him because we keep His commands and do what is pleasing in His sight.
23. 而神的命令是這樣的：我們要信他兒子耶穌基督的名，並且照著他所賜給我們的命令彼此相愛。 Now this is His command: that we believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love one another as He commanded us.
24. 遵守神 命令的，就住在神 裡面，神 也住在他裡面；而且我們從這一點就知道神 住在我們裡面，是藉著他所賜給我們的聖靈。 The one who keeps His commands remains in Him, and He in him. And the way we know that He remains in us is from the Spirit He has given us.
1 John 4
1. 各位蒙愛的人哪，你們不要每一個靈都相信，而要分辨這些靈是否出於神，因為有許多假先知已經在世上出現了。 Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to determine if they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
2. 你們從這一點就認出神的靈：任何靈承認耶穌基督是以肉身而來的，這靈就是出於神； This is how you know the Spirit of God: Every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God.
3. 任何靈不承認耶穌 的，這靈就不是出於神，而是那敵基督者的靈。你們聽說過這靈要來，而它現在已經在世上了。 But every spirit who does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist; you have heard that he is coming, and he is already in the world now.
4. 孩子們哪，你們屬於神，而且你們已經勝過了假先知們，因為那在你們裡面的，比那在世界上的更大。 You are from God, little children, and you have conquered them, because the One who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
5. 他們屬於世界，所以他們說的屬於世界，而世界也聽從他們。 They are from the world. Therefore what they say is from the world, and the world listens to them.
6. 我們屬於神，那認識神的，就聽從我們；那不屬於神的，就不聽從我們。由此，我們就認出真理的靈和迷惑人的靈。 We are from God. Anyone who knows God listens to us; anyone who is not from God does not listen to us. From this we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
7. 各位蒙愛的人哪，讓我們彼此相愛，因為愛是出於神的。凡是有愛的，都由神所生，並且認識神； Dear friends, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
8. 那沒有愛的，就不認識神，因為神就是愛。 The one who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
9. 神差派了自己的獨生子到世上來，好使我們能藉著他而活；如此，屬神的愛就在我們裡面顯明了。 God's love was revealed among us in this way: God sent His One and Only Son into the world so that we might live through Him.
10. 並不是我們愛了神，而是神愛了我們，差派他的兒子來，為我們的罪孽做了平息祭 ——在這裡就是愛了。 Love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
11. 各位蒙愛的人哪，既然神如此愛我們，我們也應該彼此相愛。 Dear friends, if God loved us in this way, we also must love one another.
12. 從來沒有人見過神；如果我們彼此相愛，神就住在我們裡面，他的愛也就在我們裡面得以完全。 No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God remains in us and His love is perfected in us.
13. 我們從這一點知道：我們住在他裡面，而他也住在我們裡面，是因為神把他的靈賜給了我們； This is how we know that we remain in Him and He in us: He has given to us from His Spirit.
14. 我們已經見過，並且現在見證：父差派子做世界的救主， And we have seen and we testify that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.
15. 凡是承認耶穌是神兒子的，神就住在他裡面，他也住在神裡面。 Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God-- God remains in him and he in God.
16. 這樣，我們已經認識並相信了神對我們所懷的愛。神就是愛；那住在愛裡面的，就住在神裡面，神也住 在他裡面。 And we have come to know and to believe the love that God has for us. God is love, and the one who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
17. 從這一點，愛在我們裡面得以完全，使我們在審判的日子可以坦然無懼，因為基督 怎樣，我們在這世上也怎樣。 In this, love is perfected with us so that we may have confidence in the day of judgment; for we are as He is in this world.
18. 愛裡沒有懼怕；相反，完美的愛能除去懼怕，因為懼怕帶有懲罰；而那懼怕的，在愛裡沒有得以完全。 There is no fear in love; instead, perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. So the one who fears has not reached perfection in love.
19. 我們愛，是因為他先愛了我們。 We love because He first loved us.
20. 如果有人說「我愛神」，卻恨自己的弟兄，他就是說謊者，因為一個人不愛自己所看到的弟兄，就不能愛沒有看到的神。 If anyone says, "I love God," yet hates his brother, he is a liar. For the person who does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.
21. 這是我們從基督 所領受的命令：愛神的，也要愛自己的弟兄。 And we have this command from Him: the one who loves God must also love his brother.
1 John 5
1. 凡是相信耶穌是基督的，都是由神所生的。凡是愛那生身之父的，也都愛那由父所生的。 Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Messiah has been born of God, and everyone who loves the parent also loves his child.
2. 當我們愛神，並遵行 他命令的時候，從這一點就知道我們愛神的兒女了。 This is how we know that we love God's children when we love God and obey His commands.
3. 原來屬神的愛是這樣的，就是我們要遵守他的命令；而他的命令並不是沉重的， For this is what love for God is: to keep His commands. Now His commands are not a burden,
4. 因為凡是由神所生的，就勝過世界；而這勝過世界的勝利，就是我們的信仰。 because whatever has been born of God conquers the world. This is the victory that has conquered the world: our faith.
5. 勝過世界的到底是誰呢？難道不是那相信耶穌是神兒子的嗎？ And who is the one who conquers the world but the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
6. 藉著水和血而來的那一位，就是耶穌基督，不僅藉著水，也藉著水和血；並且聖靈是做見證的那一位，因為聖靈就是真理。 Jesus Christ-- He is the One who came by water and blood; not by water only, but by water and by blood. And the Spirit is the One who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
7. 原來，做見證的有三者： For there are three that testify:
8. 聖靈、水和血；而這三者是一致的 。 the Spirit, the water, and the blood-- and these three are in agreement.
9. 我們既然接受人的見證，神的見證就更應該接受 了，因為這是神的見證，就是神為他的兒子所做的見證。 If we accept the testimony of men, God's testimony is greater, because it is God's testimony that He has given about His Son.
10. 那信神兒子的，就有這見證在他裡面；那不信神的，就把神當做說謊者，因為他不相信神為自己的兒子所做的見證。 (The one who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. The one who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.)
11. 這見證就是：神把永恆的生命賜給了我們，並且這生命在他兒子裡面。 And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
12. 那有了神兒子的，就有了這生命；那沒有神兒子的，就沒有這生命。 The one who has the Son has life. The one who doesn't have the Son of God does not have life.
13. 我把這些事寫給你們信神兒子之名的人，好讓你們知道：你們有永恆的生命 。 I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
14. 我們對神所懷的確信是這樣的：如果我們按照他的旨意求什麼，他就垂聽我們。 Now this is the confidence we have before Him: whenever we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
15. 如果我們已經知道凡是我們所求的他都垂聽，我們就知道我們已經擁有了向他所求的。 And if we know that He hears whatever we ask, we know that we have what we have asked Him for.
16. 如果有人看見自己的弟兄在犯不至於死的罪，就應該為他祈求；這樣，神 將把生命賜給他，就是給那些犯不至於死的罪的人。有一種罪是至於死的；關於那種罪我不說要祈求。 If anyone sees his brother committing a sin that does not bring death, he should ask, and God will give life to him-- to those who commit sin that doesn't bring death. There is sin that brings death. I am not saying he should pray about that.
17. 一切不義都是罪，也有不至於死的罪。 All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin that does not bring death.
18. 我們知道：凡是由神所生的人，就不會繼續犯罪；原來，由神所生的那一位保守著他，那惡者也就不碰他。 We know that everyone who has been born of God does not sin, but the One who is born of God keeps him, and the evil one does not touch him.
19. 我們知道：我們屬於神，但整個世界都伏在那惡者之下。 We know that we are of God, and the whole world is under the sway of the evil one.
20. 我們也知道：神的兒子已經來了，並且把領悟的心賜給了我們，使我們能認識真實的那一位 。我們在真實的那一位裡面，也就是在他的兒子耶穌基督裡面——這一位就是真神，就是永恆的生命。 And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding so that we may know the true One. We are in the true One-- that is, in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
21. 孩子們哪，你們要保守自己遠離偶像。 Little children, guard yourselves from idols.
2 John
2 John 1
1. 我 這做長老的， 致蒙揀選的夫人 和她的兒女： 你們 就是我在真理中所愛的，不單是我，也是所有認識真理的人所愛的， The Elder: To the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth-- and not only I, but also all who have come to know the truth--
2. 因為真理住在我們裡面，也將與我們同在，直到永遠。 because of the truth that remains in us and will be with us forever.
3. 從父神和父的兒子耶穌基督 而來的恩典、憐憫、平安，在真理和愛中，將與我們同在。 Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
4. 我極其歡喜，因為我看見你的兒女當中有人照著我們從父所領受的命令，在真理中行事 。 I was very glad to find some of your children walking in truth, in keeping with a command we have received from the Father.
5. 夫人 哪，現在我請求你：讓我們大家 彼此相愛；我寫給你的，不是一條新命令，而是我們從起初就有的命令。 So now I urge you, lady-- not as if I were writing you a new command, but one we have had from the beginning-- that we love one another.
6. 我們要按照他的命令行事，這就是愛；你們要照著你們從起初所聽見的在其中行事，這就是命令。 And this is love: that we walk according to His commands. This is the command as you have heard it from the beginning: you must walk in love.
7. 原來，有許多迷惑人的已經在世上出現，他們不承認耶穌基督是以肉身而來的；這樣的人是迷惑人的，敵基督的。 Many deceivers have gone out into the world; they do not confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
8. 你們自己要當心，免得失去我們 大家 為之所做的工，而要得著你們完滿的報償。 Watch yourselves so that you don't lose what we have worked for, but you may receive a full reward.
9. 凡是越過基督的教導，不住在這教導中的，就沒有神；那住在這教導中的，他才有了父，也有了子。 Anyone who does not remain in the teaching about Christ, but goes beyond it, does not have God. The one who remains in that teaching, this one has both the Father and the Son.
10. 如果有人到你們那裡去，不帶著這教導，你們就不要接他到家裡，也不要問候他， If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home, and don't say, "Welcome," to him;
11. 因為問候他的，就在他的惡行上有份了。 for the one who says, "Welcome," to him shares in his evil works.
12. 我雖然有很多話要寫給你們，但不想用紙墨，只希望到你們那裡去，並且與你們面對面交談，好使我們 的喜樂得以滿足。 Though I have many things to write to you, I don't want to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to be with you and talk face to face so that our joy may be complete.
13. 你那蒙揀選的姐妹的兒女問候你。 The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
3 John
3 John 1
1. 我 這做長老的， 致蒙愛的 蓋尤斯，就是我在真理中所愛的： The Elder: To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in truth.
2. 蒙愛的人哪，我願你凡事安順，身體健康，正如你的靈魂 安順。 Dear friend, I pray that you may prosper in every way and be in good health, just as your soul prospers.
3. 有些弟兄來到這裡，見證了你對真理的忠信，就是你怎樣在真理中行事，這使我極其歡喜。 For I was very glad when some brothers came and testified to your [faithfulness] to the truth-- how you are walking in the truth.
4. 聽到我的兒女在真理中行事，我的喜樂沒有比這更大的了。 I have no greater joy than this: to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
5. 蒙愛的人哪，你為弟兄們，尤其是為異鄉的弟兄們所做的，都是忠心的。 Dear friend, you are showing your faith by whatever you do for the brothers, and this [you are doing] for strangers;
6. 他們在教會面前見證了你的愛。你如果以神喜悅的方式送他們上路，就做得很好了， they have testified to your love before the church. You will do well to send them on their journey in a manner worthy of God,
7. 因為他們為了基督的名 出去，並沒有從外邦人接受什麼。 since they set out for the sake of the name, accepting nothing from pagans.
8. 所以，我們應該幫助這樣的人，好讓我們為真理成為同工 。 Therefore, we ought to support such men, so that we can be co-workers with the truth.
9. 我寫了信給教會，但是他們中那喜歡為首的 迪奧特菲 不接納我們。 I wrote something to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to have first place among them, does not receive us.
10. 所以，如果我來了，我一定要提起他所做的事，就是他用壞話汙衊我們；而且他在這些事上還不滿足，不但自己不接納弟兄們，也阻止那些願意接納的人，甚至把他們趕出教會。 This is why, if I come, I will remind him of the works he is doing, slandering us with malicious words. And he is not satisfied with that! He not only refuses to welcome the brothers himself, but he even stops those who want to do so and expels them from the church.
11. 蒙愛的人哪，不要效法惡，而要效法善。那行善的屬於神；那作惡的未曾看見神。 Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
12. 迪米特斯 受到了大家的讚許，也得了真理本身的讚許；我們也為他做見證，而且你知道我們的見證是真實的。 Demetrius has a [good] testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. And we also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
13. 我有很多話要寫給你，但不願意用筆墨寫給你。 I have many things to write you, but I don't want to write to you with pen and ink.
14. 我希望立刻見到你，並且面對面交談。 I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face. Peace be with you. The friends send you greetings. Greet the friends by name.
15. 願你平安！朋友們都問候你。請你一一提名問候各位朋友。
Jude
Jude 1
1. 耶穌基督的奴僕、 雅各 的弟弟 猶大， 致那些蒙召、在父神裡蒙愛 、在耶穌基督裡 蒙保守的人： Jude, a slave of Jesus Christ, and a brother of James: To those who are the called, loved by God the Father and kept by Jesus Christ.
2. 願憐憫、平安、慈愛多多地加給你們！ May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
3. 各位蒙愛的人哪，我一直十分殷切地要寫信給你們，談論我們共有的救恩；我感到有必要寫信鼓勵你們，為曾經一次性地託付給聖徒們的信仰而努力爭戰， Dear friends, although I was eager to write you about our common salvation, I found it necessary to write and exhort you to contend for the faith that was delivered to the saints once for all.
4. 因為有些人已經偷偷進來了。他們是先前早就被記載的要受那懲罰的人；他們是不敬神的人，把我們神的恩典變為好色的藉口，並且否認那獨一的主宰 ——我們的主耶穌基督。 For certain men, who were designated for this judgment long ago, have come in by stealth; they are ungodly, turning the grace of our God into promiscuity and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
5. 你們雖然知道這一切，我還想提醒你們：主 一次性地把子民從 埃及 地救了出來，後來把那些不信的人都毀滅了， Now I want to remind you, though you know all these things: the Lord, having first of all saved a people out of Egypt, later destroyed those who did not believe;
6. 並且用永恆的鎖鏈把那些不守本位、離開自己居所的天使拘留在幽暗裡，直到那大日子的審判。 and He has kept, with eternal chains in darkness for the judgment of the great day, angels who did not keep their own position but deserted their proper dwelling.
7. 同樣， 所多瑪 、 格摩拉 及其周圍的城市，照著他們的樣子放縱行淫，隨從變態的肉欲，就遭受永火的刑罰，成為我們的 鑒戒。 In the same way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them committed sexual immorality and practiced perversions, just as they did, and serve as an example by undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
8. 不過，這些做夢的人一方面也同樣地汙穢身體，另一方面拒絕有主權的，又褻瀆那些有榮耀的。 Nevertheless, these dreamers likewise defile their flesh, despise authority, and blaspheme glorious beings.
9. 即使是天使長 米迦勒，當他與魔鬼爭辯，為 摩西 的屍體爭論的時候，也不敢用毀謗的話定它的罪，只說：「願主責備你！」 Yet Michael the archangel, when he was disputing with the Devil in a debate about Moses' body, did not dare bring an abusive condemnation against him, but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"
10. 但這些人一方面褻瀆自己所不知道的事，另一方面對自己本能所知道的事，像沒有理性的動物那樣；他們就在這些事上被毀滅 。 But these people blaspheme anything they don't understand, and what they know by instinct, like unreasoning animals-- they destroy themselves with these things.
11. 他們有禍了！因為他們走了「 該隱 的路」，又為財利奔上「 巴蘭 的迷途」，並且在「 科拉 的背叛」中滅亡了。 Woe to them! For they have traveled in the way of Cain, have abandoned themselves to the error of Balaam for profit, and have perished in Korah's rebellion.
12. 這些人在你們的愛筵中是汙點，與你們 一起吃喝也無所懼怕；他們只牧養自己；他們是無水的雲，隨風飄蕩；是深秋不結果子的樹，死了又死，被連根拔起； These are the ones who are like dangerous reefs at your love feasts. They feast with you, nurturing only themselves without fear. They are waterless clouds carried along by winds; trees in late autumn-- fruitless, twice dead, pulled out by the roots;
13. 是海中的狂浪，湧出自己可恥的泡沫；是流蕩的星辰，有漆黑的幽暗永遠為他們存留。 wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shameful deeds; wandering stars for whom is reserved the blackness of darkness forever!
14. 亞當 的第七代子孫 以諾 也曾預言這些人，說： 「看哪，主帶著他的千萬聖者來臨， And Enoch, in the seventh [generation] from Adam, prophesied about them: Look! The Lord comes with thousands of His holy ones
15. 要對所有的人施行審判， 又要指證每個人 以不敬神的方式所做的一切不敬神的事， 以及不敬神的罪人所說的一切頂撞神的狂妄話。」 to execute judgment on all, and to convict them of all their ungodly deeds that they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things ungodly sinners have said against Him.
16. 這些人滿腹抱怨，責怪他人，順著自己的欲望生活；他們嘴裡說誇大的話，為了利益諂媚他人。 These people are discontented grumblers, walking according to their desires; their mouths utter arrogant words, flattering people for their own advantage.
17. 至於你們蒙愛的人哪，你們當想起我們主耶穌基督的使徒們先前所說的話。 But you, dear friends, remember the words foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
18. 他們曾對你們說過：「在末後的時代，將有好譏誚的人順著自己不敬神的欲望生活。」 they told you, "In the end time there will be scoffers walking according to their own ungodly desires."
19. 這些人是製造分裂的、屬血氣的、沒有聖靈的。 These people create divisions and are merely natural, not having the Spirit.
20. 至於你們蒙愛的人哪，要在你們至聖的信仰上造就自己，藉著聖靈禱告， But you, dear friends, building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
21. 保守自己在神的愛中，仰望 我們主耶穌基督的憐憫，進入永恆的生命。 keep yourselves in the love of God, expecting the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ for eternal life.
22. 有些人疑惑不定，你們要憐憫他們； Have mercy on some who doubt;
23. 有些人，你們要把他們從火裡搶出來，拯救他們；有些人，你們要懷著懼怕的心憐憫他們，連他們被肉欲玷汙的衣服也要恨惡。 save others by snatching [them] from the fire; on others have mercy in fear, hating even the garment defiled by the flesh.
24. 那位獨一的神能夠保守你們不失足，並且使你們毫無瑕疵、懷著喜樂站在他的榮耀面前； Now to Him who is able to protect you from stumbling and to make you stand in the presence of His glory, blameless and with great joy,
25. 願榮耀、尊嚴、大能、權柄，藉著我們的主耶穌基督 歸於獨一 的神我們的救主，從萬古以前 到現在，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, power, and authority before all time, now, and forever. Amen.
Revelation
Revelation 1
1. 耶穌基督的啟示，就是神賜給他，要他指示給他奴僕們的那些必須快發生的事。基督 藉著他的天使，向他的奴僕 約翰 傳達並指明了那些事。 The revelation of Jesus Christ that God gave Him to show His slaves what must quickly take place. He sent it and signified it through His angel to His slave John,
2. 約翰 把神的話語 和有關耶穌基督的見證，凡是他所看到的，都見證出來。 who testified to God's word and to the testimony about Jesus Christ, in all he saw.
3. 那宣讀這預言之話的，那些聽見這預言之話並遵守其中所記載的，都是蒙福的，因為時候快到了。 Blessed is the one who reads and blessed are those who hear the words of this prophecy and keep what is written in it, because the time is near!
4. 約翰， 致那在 亞細亞 省的七個教會： 願恩典與平安，從今在、昔在、將要來臨的 那一位，從他寶座前的七個靈， John: To the seven churches in the province of Asia. Grace and peace to you from the One who is, who was, and who is coming; from the seven spirits before His throne;
5. 從那信實的見證者、死人中首先復活的 、地上眾君王的元首耶穌基督，臨到你們！ 他愛我們，用自己的血，把我們從我們的罪孽中釋放出來， and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has set us free from our sins by His blood,
6. 又使我們成為國度，做他父神的祭司。願榮耀和權能都歸於他，直到永永遠遠！阿們。 and made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father-- to Him be the glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
7. 「看哪，他在雲彩中來臨， 所有人的眼睛都將看見他， 連那些刺他的人也將看見他； 地上的萬族都要因他捶胸哀哭。」 確實如此，阿們。 Look! He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, including those who pierced Him. And all the families of the earth will mourn over Him. This is certain. Amen.
8. 主、神 說：「我就是『阿爾法』，也是『歐米伽』， 是今在、昔在、將要來臨的 那一位，是全能者。」 "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "the One who is, who was, and who is coming, the Almighty."
9. 我 約翰，是你們的弟兄，是與你們在耶穌 的患難、國度、忍耐裡一同有份的，為神的話語 和有關耶穌 的見證，曾經住在那叫做 帕特莫斯 的海島上。 I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation, kingdom, and perseverance in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of God's word and the testimony about Jesus.
10. 有一個主日，我在靈裡，聽見我後面有一個大聲音，如同號角聲， I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet
11. 說： 「 把你所看見的寫在書卷上，送到 那七個教會： 以弗所 、 士每拿 佩爾伽馬 錫亞蒂拉 薩迪斯 費拉德菲亞 和 勞迪西亞 。」 saying, "Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
12. 我轉過身，要看看誰的聲音對我說話。我轉過身就看見了七座金燈臺。 I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me. When I turned I saw seven gold lampstands,
13. 燈臺 中間有一位彷彿人子的，身穿垂到腳的長袍，胸間束著金帶。 and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, and with a gold sash wrapped around His chest.
14. 他的頭和頭髮潔白，如白羊毛、如雪；他的眼睛如同火焰； His head and hair were white like wool-- white as snow, His eyes like a fiery flame,
15. 他的兩腳彷彿在爐中被煉過的精銅；他的聲音好像眾水的聲音； His feet like fine bronze fired in a furnace, and His voice like the sound of cascading waters.
16. 在他的右手中拿著七顆星；從他口中發出一把雙刃的利劍；他的面容好像烈日發光。 In His right hand He had seven stars; from His mouth came a sharp two-edged sword; and His face was shining like the sun at midday.
17. 我一看見他，就仆倒在他的腳前，像死人那樣。他把右手放在我身上，說： 「不要怕！我就是首先的，是末後的， When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. He laid His right hand on me, and said, "Don't be afraid! I am the First and the Last,
18. 是那永生的。我曾經死過，可是看哪，我現在活著，直到永永遠遠， 並且拿著死亡和陰間的鑰匙。 and the Living One. I was dead, but look-- I am alive forever and ever, and I hold the keys of death and Hades.
19. 因此，你要把所看見的，就是現在的事，和此後將要發生的事，都寫下來。 Therefore write what you have seen, what is, and what will take place after this.
20. 你所看見的，我右手中的七顆星，和這七座金燈臺的奧祕就是：七顆星是七個教會的使者， 七座燈臺是七個教會。 The secret of the seven stars you saw in My right hand, and of the seven gold lampstands, is this: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
Revelation 2
1. 「你要給那在 以弗所 教會的使者 寫信說： 「那位右手握著七顆星、在七座金燈臺中間行走的，這樣說： "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: "The One who holds the seven stars in His right hand and who walks among the seven gold lampstands says:
2. 我知道你的行為，包括你的勞苦和忍耐，也知道你不能容忍惡人 。你曾考驗那些自稱是使徒，其實不是使徒的，而且看出他們是假的。 I know your works, your labor, and your endurance, and that you cannot tolerate evil. You have tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and you have found them to be liars.
3. 你也有忍耐，曾為我的名勞苦，並不疲乏。 You also possess endurance and have tolerated [many things] because of My name, and have not grown weary.
4. 然而，我有事要責備你，就是你放棄了你起初的愛； But I have this against you: you have abandoned the love [you had] at first.
5. 所以你應當記住你是從哪裡跌落的，應當悔改，應當行你起初所做的事！否則我 就要來到你那裡；如果你不悔改，我就要把你的燈臺從原處挪去。 Remember then how far you have fallen; repent, and do the works you did at first. Otherwise, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place-- unless you repent.
6. 不過，你有這一點可取之處，就是你恨惡 尼古拉 派的行為，那些行為也是我所恨惡的。 Yet you do have this: you hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
7. 「凡是有耳的，就應當聽聖靈向各教會所說的話！那得勝的，我將要准許他吃神樂園中生命樹的果子 。 "Anyone who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will give the victor the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.
8. 「你要給 士每拿 教會的使者 寫信說： 「那位首先的、末後的，那位曾經死去又活過來的，這樣說： "To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: "The First and the Last, the One who was dead and came to life, says:
9. 我知道你的 患難和貧窮；其實你是富有的。我也知道從那些自稱是 猶太 人而來的毀謗，其實他們不是 人，而是屬於 撒旦 會堂的。 I know your tribulation and poverty, yet you are rich. [I know] the slander of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
10. 你不要怕將要受的苦。看哪，魔鬼要把你們當中一些人投進監獄，使你們受考驗；你們將受十天的患難。你應當至死忠心，我就把生命的冠冕賜給你。 Don't be afraid of what you are about to suffer. Look, the Devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will have tribulation for 10 days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
11. 「凡是有耳的，就應當聽聖靈向各教會所說的話！那得勝的，絕不會被第二次的死亡所傷害。 "Anyone who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The victor will never be harmed by the second death.
12. 「你要給那在 佩爾伽馬 教會的使者 寫信說： 「那位有雙刃利劍的，這樣說： "To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: "The One who has the sharp, two-edged sword says:
13. 我知道 你居住的地方，就是 撒旦 寶座所在的地方。不過即使在我忠心的見證人 安提帕 的那些日子裡，你還持守我的名，也沒有否認對我的信仰；這 是在你們那裡，也就是在 居住的地方被殺害的。 I know where you live-- where Satan's throne is! And you are holding on to My name and did not deny your faith in Me, even in the days of Antipas, My faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan lives.
14. 然而，我有幾件事要責備你，就是在你那裡有些人持守 巴蘭 的教導。這 曾教唆 巴勒 把絆腳石放在 以色列 子民面前，就是使他們吃祭過偶像的食物，並且行淫亂。 But I have a few things against you. You have some there who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block in front of the sons of Israel: to eat meat sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.
15. 同樣，你那裡也有些人持守與 尼古拉 派一樣的教導。 In the same way, you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
16. 所以，你應當悔改，否則我就會立即來到你那裡，用我口中的劍與他們交戰。 Therefore repent! Otherwise, I will come to you quickly and fight against them with the sword of My mouth.
17. 「凡是有耳的，就應當聽聖靈向各教會所說的話！那得勝的，我將要賜給他那隱藏的嗎哪。我還要賜給他 一塊白石頭，石頭上有一個寫好的新名字，除了那領受的人以外，沒有人認識這名字。 "Anyone who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will give the victor some of the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name is inscribed that no one knows except the one who receives it.
18. 「你要給那在 錫亞蒂拉 教會的使者 寫信說： 「神的兒子，就是那位眼睛如火焰、兩腳彷彿精銅的，這樣說： "To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: "The Son of God, the One whose eyes are like a fiery flame, and whose feet are like fine bronze says:
19. 我知道你的行為，包括你的愛心、信仰、服事和忍耐，也知道你最近所做的比先前的更多。 I know your works-- your love, faithfulness, service, and endurance. Your last works are greater than the first.
20. 然而，我有事 要責備你，就是你容忍那自稱是女先知的婦人 耶洗別，教唆並迷惑我的奴僕們行淫亂、吃祭過偶像的食物。 But I have this against you: you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and teaches and deceives My slaves to commit sexual immorality and to eat meat sacrificed to idols.
21. 我曾給她時間，好讓她悔改，她卻不肯 悔改離開自己的淫亂。 I gave her time to repent, but she does not want to repent of her sexual immorality.
22. 看哪，我要把她扔在痛苦的 床上。那些與她通姦的人，如果不悔改離開她 的行為，我也要把他們扔在大患難中。 Look! I will throw her into a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of her practices.
23. 我要用瘟疫 擊殺她的兒女，這樣各教會就將知道我就是洞察情感和心思的那一位；我也要照著你們的行為回報你們每個人。 I will kill her children with the plague. Then all the churches will know that I am the One who examines minds and hearts, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
24. 至於你們其餘在 錫亞蒂拉 的人，就是那些不接受這教訓的、那些不知道所謂「 撒旦 深奧之事」的，我告訴你們：我不會把另一個重擔放在你們身上。 I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching, who haven't known the deep things of Satan-- as they say-- I do not put any other burden on you.
25. 不過你們應當持守你們所擁有的，直到我來。 But hold on to what you have until I come.
26. 那得勝的，那把我的工作持守到底的，我將要賜給他權柄統管列國—— The victor and the one who keeps My works to the end: I will give him authority over the nations--
27. 他將用鐵杖治理 列國， 如同打碎陶器那樣 —— 就像我也從我父那裡領受了權柄一樣； and He will shepherd them with an iron scepter; He will shatter them like pottery-- just as I have received [this] from My Father.
28. 我還要把晨星賜給他。 I will also give him the morning star.
29. 「凡是有耳的，就應當聽聖靈向各教會所說的話！ "Anyone who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
Revelation 3
1. 「你要給那在 薩迪斯 教會的使者 寫信說： 「那位有神的七個靈和七顆星的，這樣說：我知道你的行為，你名義上是活的，其實你是死的。 "To the angel of the church in Sardis write: "The One who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars says: I know your works; you have a reputation for being alive, but you are dead.
2. 你當警醒，堅固那些剩餘的、快要死去的人 。實際上，我看出你的行為在我的神面前是不完全的； Be alert and strengthen what remains, which is about to die, for I have not found your works complete before My God.
3. 所以你應當記住你所領受、所聽見的是什麼；你應當持守，應當悔改。如果你不警醒，我就要來臨，就像賊來臨那樣；而你絕不會知道我什麼時候臨到你。 Remember therefore what you have received and heard; keep it, and repent. But if you are not alert, I will come like a thief, and you have no idea at what hour I will come against you.
4. 然而在 薩迪斯，你還有幾名是沒有玷汙自己衣服的，他們將要身穿白衣與我同行，因為他們是配得上的。 But you have a few people in Sardis who have not defiled their clothes, and they will walk with Me in white, because they are worthy.
5. 那得勝的，將要同樣穿上白衣，我絕不從生命冊上抹去他的名字；而且我將要在我父面前、在我父的眾天使面前，承認他的名字。 In the same way, the victor will be dressed in white clothes, and I will never erase his name from the book of life, but will acknowledge his name before My Father and before His angels.
6. 「凡是有耳的，就應當聽聖靈向各教會所說的話！ "Anyone who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
7. 「你要給那在 費拉德菲亞 教會的使者 寫信說： 「那位神聖的、真實的，拿著 大衛 的鑰匙、開了就沒有人能關、關了就沒有人能開的，這樣說： "To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: "The Holy One, the True One, the One who has the key of David, who opens and no one will close, and closes and no one opens says:
8. 我知道你的行為。看哪，我在你面前賜下了一個敞開的門，是沒有人能關上的；這是因為你能力小，但你遵守了我的話語，沒有否認我的名。 I know your works. Because you have limited strength, have kept My word, and have not denied My name, look, I have placed before you an open door that no one is able to close.
9. 看哪，我要使那些屬於 撒旦 會堂的，就是那些自稱是 猶太 人，其實不是 人，而是說謊的人——看哪，我要使他們來，在你腳前下拜；他們就會知道我已經愛了你， Take note! I will make those from the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews and are not, but are lying-- note this-- I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I have loved you.
10. 因為你遵守了我忍耐的教導，我還要保守你脫離那試煉的時刻，就是那將要臨到普天下，考驗住在地上之人的時刻。 Because you have kept My command to endure, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is going to come over the whole world to test those who live on the earth.
11. 我快要來了！你應當持守你所擁有的，免得有人拿走你的冠冕。 I am coming quickly. Hold on to what you have, so that no one takes your crown.
12. 那得勝的，我將要讓他在我神的聖所中做柱石，他絕不再出去。我要把我神的名，我神之城的名——就是從我的神那裡、從天上降下來的新 耶路撒冷 的名，和我的新名，都寫在他身上。 The victor: I will make him a pillar in the sanctuary of My God, and he will never go out again. I will write on him the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God-- the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God-- and My new name.
13. 「凡是有耳的，就應當聽聖靈向各教會所說的話！ "Anyone who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
14. 「你要給那在 勞迪西亞 教會的使者 寫信說： 「那位阿們，就是那信實的、真實的見證者，神創造之物的本源，這樣說： "To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: "The Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God's creation says:
15. 我知道你的行為，你既不冷也不熱；我真希望你或冷或熱。 I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish that you were cold or hot.
16. 正因為你是溫的，既不熱也不冷，我就要把你從我口中吐出去， So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I am going to vomit you out of My mouth.
17. 因為你說『我是富有的；我發了財，什麼都不缺』，卻不知道你是可悲的、可憐的、貧窮的、瞎眼的、赤身的。 Because you say, 'I'm rich; I have become wealthy, and need nothing,' and you don't know that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked,
18. 我建議你向我買被火煉過的金子，使你富足；又買白衣穿上，使你赤身的羞恥不露出來；又買眼藥抹你的眼睛，使你能看見。 I advise you to buy from Me gold refined in the fire so that you may be rich, and white clothes so that you may be dressed and your shameful nakedness not be exposed, and ointment to spread on your eyes so that you may see.
19. 凡是我所愛的，我都責備、管教。所以你應當熱心，應當悔改。 As many as I love, I rebuke and discipline. So be committed and repent.
20. 看哪，我站在門口敲門。如果有人聽見我的聲音就開門，我就會進到他那裡，而且我與他、他與我，將要一同吃宴席。 Listen! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and have dinner with him, and he with Me.
21. 那得勝的，我將要准許他與我一起坐在我的寶座上；就像我已經得勝，與我父一起坐在他的寶座上那樣。 The victor: I will give him the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I also won the victory and sat down with My Father on His throne.
22. 「凡是有耳的，就應當聽聖靈向各教會所說的話！」 "Anyone who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
Revelation 4
1. 這些事以後，我觀看，看哪，天上有一個敞開的門。我先前所聽見的，那如同號角對我說話的聲音就說：「你上到這裡來！我要把此後必須發生的事指示給你。」 After this I looked, and there in heaven was an open door. The first voice that I had heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this."
2. 我立刻就在靈裡了，看哪，有一個寶座安放在天上，有一位坐在寶座上。 Immediately I was in the Spirit, and there in heaven a throne was set. One was seated on the throne,
3. 坐著的那一位， 看起來彷彿碧玉和紅寶石；又有一道彩虹 圍著寶座，看起來彷彿綠寶石。 and the One seated looked like jasper and carnelian stone. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
4. 座位 的周圍，還有二十四個座位 ； 在那些寶座上，坐著二十四位長老，身穿白衣，頭戴金冠冕； Around that throne were 24 thrones, and on the thrones sat 24 elders dressed in white clothes, with gold crowns on their heads.
5. 從寶座中發出閃電、聲音和雷鳴；在寶座前，有七支燃燒著的火把，就是神的七個靈； From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and thunder. Burning before the throne were seven fiery torches, which are the seven spirits of God.
6. 寶座前面，好像玻璃海，彷彿水晶；在寶座中間和寶座周圍，有四個活物，遍體前後布滿眼睛。 Also before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle and around the throne were four living creatures covered with eyes in front and in back.
7. 第一個活物彷彿獅子，第二個活物彷彿牛犢，第三個活物有像人一樣的臉，第四個活物彷彿飛翔的鷹。 The first living creature was like a lion; the second living creature was like a calf; the third living creature had a face like a man; and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.
8. 那四個活物，各個都有六個翅膀，遍體內外都布滿了眼睛。他們日夜不停地 說： 「聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！ 主、神、全能者， 昔在、今在、將要來臨的 那一位！」 Each of the four living creatures had six wings; they were covered with eyes around and inside. Day and night they never stop, saying: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God, the Almighty, who was, who is, and who is coming.
9. 每當四個活物把榮耀、尊貴和感謝歸給坐在寶座上、活到永永遠遠的那一位時， Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne, the One who lives forever and ever,
10. 二十四位長老就俯伏在坐寶座的那一位面前，敬拜活到永永遠遠的那一位，並且把自己的冠冕放在寶座前，說： the 24 elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, worship the One who lives forever and ever, cast their crowns before the throne, and say:
11. 「我們的主、我們的神哪， 你配接受榮耀、尊貴和權能， 因為你創造了萬有； 萬有是因著你的旨意而存在、被創造的。」 Our Lord and God, You are worthy to receive glory and honor and power, because You have created all things, and because of Your will they exist and were created.
Revelation 5
1. 接著，我看見坐在寶座上的那一位右手中拿著一個書卷，內外都寫著字，用七個封印封住。 Then I saw in the right hand of the One seated on the throne a scroll with writing on the inside and on the back, sealed with seven seals.
2. 我又看見一位強有力的天使，大聲地宣告：「誰配打開這書卷，解開它的封印呢？」 I also saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?"
3. 可是在天上、在地上、在地底下，都沒有一個能打開或閱讀那書卷的。 But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or even to look in it.
4. 於是我就大哭，因為找不到配打開 或閱讀那書卷的。 And I cried and cried because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or even to look in it.
5. 可是長老中有一位對我說：「不要哭了！看哪，那出於 猶大 支派的獅子、 大衛 的根已經得勝，可以打開那書卷和 它的七個封印。」 Then one of the elders said to me, "Stop crying. Look! The Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has been victorious so that He may open the scroll and its seven seals."
6. 隨後，我看見 在寶座和四個活物當中，在長老們當中，站著一隻羔羊，好像是被殺過的。羔羊有七隻角和七隻眼，那七隻眼就是神的七個靈，是奉差派往全地去的。 Then I saw one like a slaughtered lamb standing between the throne and the four living creatures and among the elders. He had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent into all the earth.
7. 羔羊上前去，從坐在寶座上那一位的右手中拿了書卷 。 He came and took [the scroll] out of the right hand of the One seated on the throne.
8. 他一接到書卷，四個活物和二十四位長老就俯伏在羔羊面前，他們各拿著一把豎琴和盛滿香的金碗；這些香就是聖徒們的禱告。 When He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the 24 elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and gold bowls filled with incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
9. 他們唱著一首新歌，說： 「你配接受那書卷， 配打開它的封印， 因為你曾被殺， 用自己的血， 從各支派、各語言群體、 各民族、各國家， 為神贖回了人， And they sang a new song: You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals; because You were slaughtered, and You redeemed [people] for God by Your blood from every tribe and language and people and nation.
10. 使他們 成為我們神的國度 和祭司； 他們 將要在地上做王 。」 You made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they will reign on the earth.
11. 我又觀看，就聽見在寶座、活物和長老們的周圍，有許多天使的聲音；他們的數目有千千萬萬。 Then I looked, and heard the voice of many angels around the throne, and also of the living creatures, and of the elders. Their number was countless thousands, plus thousands of thousands.
12. 他們大聲說： 「那被殺的羔羊配接受 權能、財富、智慧、力量、 尊貴、榮耀和頌讚！」 They said with a loud voice: The Lamb who was slaughtered is worthy to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!
13. 我又聽見天上、地上、地底下和海中的一切被造之物，以及天地間 的萬有，都在說： 「願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀和權能， 都歸於坐在寶座上的那一位， 都歸於羔羊，直到永永遠遠！」 I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them say: Blessing and honor and glory and dominion to the One seated on the throne, and to the Lamb, forever and ever!
14. 四個活物就說：「阿們！」長老們 也都俯伏敬拜 。 The four living creatures said, "Amen," and the elders fell down and worshiped.
Revelation 6
1. 我又觀看，羔羊打開七個封印 中第一個封印的時候，我就聽見四個活物中的一個，用像雷鳴一樣的聲音說：「來 ！」 Then I saw the Lamb open one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say with a voice like thunder, "Come!"
2. 我又觀看，看哪，有一匹白馬。那騎馬的拿著一張弓；他被賜予了一頂冠冕，就出去，得勝了又要得勝。 I looked, and there was a white horse. The horseman on it had a bow; a crown was given to him, and he went out as a victor to conquer.
3. 羔羊打開第二個封印的時候，我聽見第二個活物說：「來 ！」 When He opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"
4. 就另有一匹馬出來，是火紅色的。那騎馬的被准許從地上奪走和平，使人們互相殘殺；他又被賜予了一把大刀。 Then another horse went out, a fiery red one, and its horseman was empowered to take peace from the earth, so that people would slaughter one another. And a large sword was given to him.
5. 羔羊打開第三個封印的時候，我聽見第三個活物說：「來 ！」我又觀看，看哪，有一匹黑色的馬。那騎馬的，手裡拿著天平。 When He opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come!" And I looked, and there was a black horse. The horseman on it had a balance scale in his hand.
6. 我就聽見在四個活物中間好像有聲音說：「一升小麥一個銀幣，三升大麥一個銀幣；油和酒不可糟蹋！」 Then I heard something like a voice among the four living creatures say, "A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius-- but do not harm the olive oil and the wine."
7. 羔羊打開第四個封印的時候，我聽見第四個活物的聲音，說：「來 ！」 When He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come!"
8. 我又觀看，看哪，有一匹灰綠色的馬。那騎馬的，名叫「死亡」，陰間伴隨著他。他們被賜予了權柄可以統管地上的四分之一，用刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫 和地上的野獸去殺害人。 And I looked, and there was a pale green horse. The horseman on it was named Death, and Hades was following after him. Authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill by the sword, by famine, by plague, and by the wild animals of the earth.
9. 羔羊打開第五個封印的時候，我看見在祭壇底下有那些為了神的話語 、為了自己所持守的見證而被殺之人的靈魂。 When He opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those slaughtered because of God's word and the testimony they had.
10. 他們大聲呼喊說：「神聖、真實的主啊！你不施行審判，不為我們的血向住在地上的人討回公道，還要多久呢？」 They cried out with a loud voice: "O Lord, holy and true, how long until You judge and avenge our blood from those who live on the earth?"
11. 於是他們每個人都被賜予了一件白袍；有話吩咐他們還要安息一些時候，直到那些與他們同做奴僕 的和他們的弟兄，就是那些將要像他們一樣被殺的人，滿足了數目 。 So a white robe was given to each of them, and they were told to rest a little while longer until [the number of] their fellow slaves and their brothers, who were going to be killed just as they had been, would be completed.
12. 我又觀看，羔羊打開第六個封印的時候， 發生了大地震。太陽變黑像粗毛布，整個月亮 變得像血。 Then I saw Him open the sixth seal. A violent earthquake occurred; the sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair; the entire moon became like blood;
13. 天上的星辰墜落到地上，就像無花果樹被大風搖動，落下它未熟的果子那樣。 the stars of heaven fell to the earth as a fig tree drops its unripe figs when shaken by a high wind;
14. 天被劈裂，好像書卷被捲起來；一切山嶺和海島也都從原處被挪開了。 the sky separated like a scroll being rolled up; and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
15. 地上的眾君王、大臣、軍官、富有的、有權的、所有的奴隸和自由人，都藏在洞穴裡和山嶺的岩石間。 Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the military commanders, the rich, the powerful, and every slave and free person hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
16. 他們對山嶺和岩石說：「倒在我們身上吧！把我們藏起來，好躲避坐在寶座上那一位的臉和羔羊的震怒； And they said to the mountains and to the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb,
17. 因為他們 震怒的大日子到了，誰能站得住呢？」 because the great day of Their wrath has come! And who is able to stand?"
Revelation 7
1. 這事以後，我看見四位天使站在大地的四角上，掌握著大地四方的風，不讓風吹在大地、海洋或任何樹木上。 After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, restraining the four winds of the earth so that no wind could blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree.
2. 接著，我看見另一位天使，拿著永生神的封印，從東方 上來。他對那些被准許傷害大地和海洋的四位天使大聲呼喊， Then I saw another angel rise up from the east, who had the seal of the living God. He cried out in a loud voice to the four angels who were empowered to harm the earth and the sea:
3. 說：「不要傷害大地、海洋和樹木，直到我們在我們神的奴僕們額上蓋了印。」 "Don't harm the earth or the sea or the trees until we seal the slaves of our God on their foreheads."
4. 我又聽見了那些被蓋上印之人的數目， 以色列 子民各支派中被蓋上印的有十四萬四千人： And I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:
5. 猶大 支派中被蓋上印的有一萬二千 人； 魯本 支派中 有一萬二千人； 迦得 支派中有一萬二千人； 12,000 sealed from the tribe of Judah, 12,000 from the tribe of Reuben, 12,000 from the tribe of Gad,
6. 亞設 支派中有一萬二千人； 拿弗他利 支派中有一萬二千人； 瑪拿西 支派中有一萬二千人； 12,000 from the tribe of Asher, 12,000 from the tribe of Naphtali, 12,000 from the tribe of Manasseh,
7. 西緬 支派中有一萬二千人； 利未 支派中有一萬二千人； 以薩迦 支派中有一萬二千人； 12,000 from the tribe of Simeon, 12,000 from the tribe of Levi, 12,000 from the tribe of Issachar,
8. 西布倫 支派中有一萬二千人； 約瑟 支派中有一萬二千人； 便雅憫 支派中被蓋上印的有一萬二千人。 12,000 from the tribe of Zebulun, 12,000 from the tribe of Joseph, 12,000 sealed from the tribe of Benjamin.
9. 這些事以後，我觀看，看哪，有一大群人，沒有人能夠數過來。他們來自各國家、各支派、各民族、各語言群體。他們身穿白袍，手裡拿著棕櫚枝，站在寶座和羔羊面前， After this I looked, and there was a vast multitude from every nation, tribe, people, and language, which no one could number, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were robed in white with palm branches in their hands.
10. 大聲呼喊說： 「救恩屬於坐在寶座上我們的神、 屬於羔羊！」 And they cried out in a loud voice: Salvation belongs to our God, who is seated on the throne, and to the Lamb!
11. 所有的天使都站在寶座、長老們和四個活物的周圍；他們在寶座前，把臉伏在地上，敬拜神， All the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
12. 說： 「阿們！願頌讚、榮耀、智慧、 感謝、尊貴、權能、力量 都歸於我們的神，直到永永遠遠！阿們。」 saying: Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and strength, be to our God forever and ever. Amen.
13. 長老中有一位問我，說：「這些身穿白袍的是誰？他們是從哪裡來的？」 Then one of the elders asked me, "Who are these people robed in white, and where did they come from?"
14. 我對他說：「我主啊，你是知道的。」 他就對我說： 「這些人都是從大患難中出來的。 他們用羔羊的血 洗淨了自己的袍子，使它們潔白了。 I said to him, "Sir, you know." Then he told me: These are the ones coming out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
15. 因此他們在神的寶座前， 日夜在他的聖所中事奉他。 那位坐在寶座上的也將庇護他們 ： For this reason they are before the throne of God, and they serve Him day and night in His sanctuary. The One seated on the throne will shelter them:
16. 他們將不再飢餓，也不再乾渴； 太陽或任何炎熱也不會傷到他們 ； no longer will they hunger; no longer will they thirst; no longer will the sun strike them, or any heat.
17. 因為在寶座中的羔羊將牧養他們， 領他們到生命 水的泉源； 神要從他們的眼中抹去一切淚水。」 Because the Lamb who is at the center of the throne will shepherd them; He will guide them to springs of living waters, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
Revelation 8
1. 羔羊打開第七個封印的時候，天上寂靜無聲，約有半小時。 When He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
2. 接著，我看見站在神面前的七位天使，被賜予了七支號角。 Then I saw the seven angels who stand in the presence of God; seven trumpets were given to them.
3. 隨後，另一位天使來了，拿著金香爐，站在祭壇旁邊。他被賜予了很多香，要和所有聖徒的禱告一起獻在寶座前的金祭壇上。 Another angel, with a gold incense burner, came and stood at the altar. He was given a large amount of incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints on the gold altar in front of the throne.
4. 那香的煙和聖徒們的禱告，從天使的手中升到神的面前。 The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up in the presence of God from the angel's hand.
5. 接著，那位天使拿起香爐，把它裝滿了祭壇上的火，扔到地上；於是就有雷鳴、聲音、閃電和地震。 The angel took the incense burner, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; there were thunders, rumblings, lightnings, and an earthquake.
6. 這時候，拿著七支號角的七位天使就預備要吹響號角。 And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to blow them.
7. 第一位天使 吹響號角，就有冰雹和火，混著血被撒在地上；於是大地的三分之一被燒掉， 樹木的三分之一被燒掉，所有的青草也都被燒掉了。 The first [angel] blew his trumpet, and hail and fire, mixed with blood, were hurled to the earth. So a third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
8. 第二位天使吹響號角，就有一座像被火燃燒著的大山被丟進海裡；於是海的三分之一變成血， The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a great mountain ablaze with fire was hurled into the sea. So a third of the sea became blood,
9. 海中有生命的被造之物的三分之一也死了，眾船隻的三分之一也被毀了。 a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
10. 第三位天使吹響號角，就有一顆像火把一樣燃燒著的大星，從天上墜落，落在江河的三分之一和眾水的泉源上。 The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from heaven. It fell on a third of the rivers and springs of water.
11. 這顆星的名字叫「苦艾」。於是眾水的三分之一變為苦艾，許多人就因這水變苦而死去了。 The name of the star is Wormwood, and a third of the waters became wormwood. So, many of the people died from the waters, because they had been made bitter.
12. 第四位天使吹響號角，太陽的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一都被擊打，以致它們的三分之一變黑了；於是白晝的三分之一沒有光，夜晚也是如此。 The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them were darkened. A third of the day was without light, and the night as well.
13. 我又觀看，就聽見一隻在空中飛翔的鷹 大聲說：「有禍了！有禍了！住在地上的人有禍了！因為三位天使快要吹響其餘的號角。」 I looked, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid-heaven, saying in a loud voice, "Woe! Woe! Woe to those who live on the earth, because of the remaining trumpet blasts that the three angels are about to sound!"
Revelation 9
1. 第五位天使吹響號角，我就看見從天上墜落到地上的一顆星。它被賜予了無底坑口的鑰匙。 The fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth. The key to the shaft of the abyss was given to him.
